@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=14913 sha256=a4b93a8da5f31237cb0f904fef5da44221d433c8796ca07aaa085b9fa9d97a9a path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/ClosureDAG.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.RegressionFixtures
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.AnalyticProviders
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.MinorRepair
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.EndpointCRT
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Positional
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.RepairedRecurrence
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Physical
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Firewalls

/-!
# Erdős #287 (post-V71 → V87) — machine-checkable closure DAG

Every node of the audited bank carries

* a status: `bankedExact` (proved unconditionally in Lean), `conditional` (proved in Lean
  from an explicit, never-inhabited provider), `retired` (proved, but not a closure route), or
  `open` (no proof; either a provider interface or an unformalised claim);
* the Lean declaration it refers to (double-backtick name literals, so a renamed or missing declaration
  breaks the build), or `none` for claims that have no formal statement;
* its list of direct dependencies.

The structural invariants below are checked by `decide` (kernel reduction, no
`native_decide`):

* `dag_acyclic`        — every edge strictly decreases the rank;
* `dag_exact_closed`   — a banked-exact node depends only on banked-exact nodes;
* `dag_exact_support`  — the whole transitive support of a banked-exact node is banked exact;
* `dag_conditional_has_open` — every conditional node transitively depends on an open node;
* `dag_no_retired_use` — no exact or conditional node transitively depends on a retired node;
* `dag_erdos287_open`, `dag_erdos287_no_decl` — the Erdős #287 node is `open`, with no Lean
  declaration claiming it;
* `dag_erdos287_inputs_not_exact`, `dag_erdos287_open_support` — no direct input of the
  Erdős #287 node is banked exact, and its support contains exactly the open nodes
  `crossScaleSync`, `finiteExclusion`, `proximity`, `intermediateScales`.
-/

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87.DAG

/-- Status of a node in the closure DAG. -/
inductive Status
  | bankedExact
  | conditional
  | retired
  | open
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Nodes of the post-V71 → V87 bank. -/
inductive Node
  -- model
  | exactWordModel
  | counterexampleEquiv
  | surrogateSeparation
  -- V83 (retired minor route)
  | minorRelation
  | minorDenominator
  | fixedDepthCompression
  | fixedDepthNotExact
  | integerDetIntegral
  | minorRouteClosure
  -- V84/V85 positional
  | topLayerTwo
  | singletonRejection
  | conditionedRowRejection
  | positionalChain
  | qTwoLeD
  -- V84/V85 analytic providers and consequences
  | providerFixedSupply
  | providerUniformSupply
  | fixedModulusSaturation
  | fixedBaseGrowth
  | uniformModulusSaturation
  | growingBaseGrowth
  | maximalCarrierUniform
  -- V86 endpoint-anchored CRT
  | endpointCRT
  | qPairBound
  | smallCeilingUnique
  | lowStartChamber
  | dyadicSaturation
  | ceilingAnnulus
  | ownerDisjoint
  | roughPartAggregate
  -- V87 reciprocal image / minimal grid
  | chebyshevImported

  | logSrecBound

  | erdos287ConditionalOnSync
  | erdos287
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Fintype

open Node Status

/-- Status assignment. -/
def status : Node → Status
  | exactWordModel | counterexampleEquiv | surrogateSeparation => bankedExact
  | minorRelation | minorDenominator | fixedDepthCompression | fixedDepthNotExact
  | integerDetIntegral => bankedExact
  | minorRouteClosure => retired
  | topLayerTwo | singletonRejection | conditionedRowRejection | positionalChain
  | qTwoLeD => bankedExact
  | providerFixedSupply | providerUniformSupply => .open
  | fixedModulusSaturation | fixedBaseGrowth | uniformModulusSaturation | growingBaseGrowth
  | maximalCarrierUniform => conditional
  | endpointCRT | qPairBound | smallCeilingUnique | lowStartChamber | dyadicSaturation
  | ceilingAnnulus | ownerDisjoint => bankedExact
  | roughPartAggregate => .open
  | chebyshevImported | srecBlockBound | logSrecBound | shellFingerprint | entropyInequality
  | entropyInversion | repairedRecurrence => bankedExact
  | internalMultiples | guardPattern | disjointGuards | carrierReserve | carrierOverlap
  | carrierUnion => bankedExact
  | highShellTrivial => bankedExact
  | providerHighShell => .open
  | highShellEmptyRow => conditional
  | intermediateScales | nearbyTransition => .open
  | polylogWindowFirewall => bankedExact
  | proximity | crossScaleSync | finiteExclusion => .open
  | tailClosure | erdos287ConditionalOnSync => conditional
  | erdos287 => .open

/-- Lean declaration backing each node (`none` = no formal statement exists). -/
def decl : Node → Option Lean.Name
  | exactWordModel => some ``ExactWord
  | counterexampleEquiv => some ``ExactWord.toCounterexample
  | surrogateSeparation => some ``reg_surrogate_not_exact
  | minorRelation => some ``MinorData.actual_sub_target
  | minorDenominator => some ``MinorData.den_actual
  | fixedDepthCompression => some ``fixed_depth_compression
  | fixedDepthNotExact => some ``fixed_depth_not_exact_mass
  | integerDetIntegral => some ``integer_det_integral
  | minorRouteClosure => none
  | topLayerTwo => some ``ExactWord.two_le_layer_card
  | singletonRejection => some ``ExactWord.not_active_of_lt_two_mul
  | conditionedRowRejection => some ``ExactWord.conditioned_row_rejection
  | positionalChain => some ``ExactWord.positional_chain
  | qTwoLeD => some ``ExactWord.Q_two_le_D
  | providerFixedSupply => some ``FixedModulusDyadicSupply
  | providerUniformSupply => some ``UniformDyadicSupply
  | fixedModulusSaturation => some ``fixed_modulus_saturation
  | fixedBaseGrowth => some ``fixed_base_primary_growth
  | uniformModulusSaturation => some ``uniform_modulus_saturation
  | growingBaseGrowth => some ``growing_base_primary_growth
  | maximalCarrierUniform => some ``maximal_carrier_of_uniform
  | endpointCRT => some ``Word.endpoint_anchored_crt
  | qPairBound => some ``Word.Q_mul_Q_gt_D
  | smallCeilingUnique => some ``Word.card_small_ceilings_le_one
  | lowStartChamber => some ``Word.low_start_chamber
  | dyadicSaturation => some ``ExactWord.dyadic_two_sided_saturation
  | ceilingAnnulus => some ``ExactWord.ceiling_annulus
  | ownerDisjoint => some ``Word.owner_disjoint
  | roughPartAggregate => none
  | chebyshevImported => some ``chebyshev_upper
  | srecBlockBound => some ``Srec_block_bound
  | logSrecBound => some ``log_Srec_le
  | shellFingerprint => some ``ExactWord.shell_fingerprint
  | entropyInequality => some ``entropy_inequality
  | entropyInversion => some ``entropy_inversion
  | repairedRecurrence => some ``repaired_recurrence
  | internalMultiples => some ``Word.card_internalMultiples_ge
  | guardPattern => some ``Word.guard_at_internal_qstar
  | disjointGuards => some ``many_disjoint_guards
  | carrierReserve => some ``Word.carrier_reserve
  | carrierOverlap => some ``Word.carrier_overlap_le_four
  | carrierUnion => some ``ExactWord.carrier_union_lower
  | highShellTrivial => some ``highShell_trivial
  | providerHighShell => some ``HighShellExtinction
  | highShellEmptyRow => some ``highShell_some_empty_row
  | intermediateScales => some ``IntermediateScaleControl287
  | nearbyTransition => some ``NearbyTransition287
  | polylogWindowFirewall => some ``polylog_window_not_excluded
  | proximity => some ``Proximity287
  | crossScaleSync => some ``CrossScaleSynchronization287
  | finiteExclusion => some ``FiniteExclusionBelow
  | tailClosure => some ``tail_closure_of_crossScale
  | erdos287ConditionalOnSync => some ``erdos287_of_crossScale_and_finite
  | erdos287 => none

/-- Direct dependencies. -/
def deps : Node → List Node
  | exactWordModel => []
  | counterexampleEquiv => [exactWordModel]
  | surrogateSeparation => [exactWordModel, fixedDepthNotExact]
  | minorRelation => []
  | minorDenominator => [minorRelation]
  | fixedDepthCompression => [minorDenominator]
  | fixedDepthNotExact => [fixedDepthCompression]
  | integerDetIntegral => []
  | minorRouteClosure => [fixedDepthCompression, fixedDepthNotExact]
  | topLayerTwo => [exactWordModel]
  | singletonRejection => [topLayerTwo]
  | conditionedRowRejection => [topLayerTwo]
  | positionalChain => [exactWordModel, singletonRejection]
  | qTwoLeD => [topLayerTwo]
  | providerFixedSupply => []
  | providerUniformSupply => []
  | fixedModulusSaturation => [providerFixedSupply, positionalChain]
  | fixedBaseGrowth => [fixedModulusSaturation]
  | uniformModulusSaturation => [providerUniformSupply, positionalChain]
  | growingBaseGrowth => [uniformModulusSaturation]
  | maximalCarrierUniform => [growingBaseGrowth, topLayerTwo]
  | endpointCRT => [exactWordModel]
  | qPairBound => [endpointCRT]
  | smallCeilingUnique => [qPairBound]
  | lowStartChamber => [endpointCRT]
  | dyadicSaturation => [endpointCRT, singletonRejection]
  | ceilingAnnulus => [qPairBound]
  | ownerDisjoint => [exactWordModel]
  | roughPartAggregate => [qPairBound, ownerDisjoint]
  | chebyshevImported => []
  | srecBlockBound => []
  | logSrecBound => [srecBlockBound, chebyshevImported]
  | shellFingerprint => [topLayerTwo]
  | entropyInequality => [shellFingerprint]
  | entropyInversion => []
  | repairedRecurrence => [logSrecBound, entropyInequality, entropyInversion]
  | internalMultiples => [exactWordModel]
  | guardPattern => [positionalChain]
  | disjointGuards => [guardPattern, internalMultiples, repairedRecurrence]
  | carrierReserve => [qPairBound, ceilingAnnulus]
  | carrierOverlap => [carrierReserve]
  | carrierUnion => [carrierOverlap, smallCeilingUnique]
  | highShellTrivial => [singletonRejection]
  | providerHighShell => []
  | highShellEmptyRow => [providerHighShell]
  | intermediateScales => []
  | nearbyTransition => []
  | polylogWindowFirewall => [repairedRecurrence]
  | proximity => []
  | crossScaleSync => []
  | finiteExclusion => []
  | tailClosure => [crossScaleSync, counterexampleEquiv, disjointGuards, shellFingerprint,
      carrierReserve, highShellTrivial]
  | erdos287ConditionalOnSync => [tailClosure, finiteExclusion]
  | erdos287 => [erdos287ConditionalOnSync, proximity, intermediateScales]

/-- Topological rank (dependencies have strictly smaller rank). -/
def rank : Node → ℕ
  | exactWordModel => 0 | minorRelation => 0 | integerDetIntegral => 0
  | providerFixedSupply => 0 | providerUniformSupply => 0 | chebyshevImported => 0
  | srecBlockBound => 0 | entropyInversion => 0 | providerHighShell => 0
  | intermediateScales => 0 | nearbyTransition => 0 | proximity => 0
  | crossScaleSync => 0 | finiteExclusion => 0
  | counterexampleEquiv => 1 | minorDenominator => 1 | topLayerTwo => 1 | endpointCRT => 1
  | ownerDisjoint => 1 | logSrecBound => 1 | internalMultiples => 1 | highShellEmptyRow => 1
  | fixedDepthCompression => 2 | singletonRejection => 2 | conditionedRowRejection => 2
  | qTwoLeD => 2 | qPairBound => 2 | lowStartChamber => 2 | shellFingerprint => 2
  | fixedDepthNotExact => 3 | positionalChain => 3 | smallCeilingUnique => 3
  | dyadicSaturation => 3 | ceilingAnnulus => 3 | roughPartAggregate => 3
  | entropyInequality => 3 | highShellTrivial => 3
  | surrogateSeparation => 4 | minorRouteClosure => 4 | fixedModulusSaturation => 4
  | uniformModulusSaturation => 4 | carrierReserve => 4 | repairedRecurrence => 4
  | guardPattern => 4
  | fixedBaseGrowth => 5 | growingBaseGrowth => 5 | carrierOverlap => 5
  | disjointGuards => 5 | polylogWindowFirewall => 5
  | maximalCarrierUniform => 6 | carrierUnion => 6 | tailClosure => 6
  | erdos287ConditionalOnSync => 7
  | erdos287 => 8

theorem dag_acyclic : ∀ n : Node, ∀ m ∈ deps n, rank m < rank n := by decide

theorem dag_max_rank : ∀ n : Node, rank n ≤ 8 := by decide

/-- Nodes reachable from `n` by following dependency edges, within `k` steps.  Since every
edge decreases the rank and ranks are `≤ 8`, `supportWithin 9 n` is the full transitive
support of `n`. -/
def supportWithin : ℕ → Node → List Node
  | 0, n => [n]
  | k + 1, n => n :: (deps n).flatMap (supportWithin k)

/-- The transitive support of a node. -/
def support (n : Node) : List Node := supportWithin 9 n

theorem dag_exact_closed :
    ∀ n : Node, status n = bankedExact → ∀ m ∈ deps n, status m = bankedExact := by decide

/-- The transitive support of a banked-exact node contains only banked-exact nodes. -/
theorem dag_exact_support :
    ∀ n : Node, status n = bankedExact → ∀ m ∈ support n, status m = bankedExact := by decide

/-- Every conditional node transitively depends on an open node (its provider). -/
theorem dag_conditional_has_open :
    ∀ n : Node, status n = conditional → ∃ m ∈ support n, status m = .open := by decide

/-- No non-retired node depends directly on a retired node. -/
theorem dag_no_retired_edge :
    ∀ n : Node, status n ≠ retired → ∀ m ∈ deps n, status m ≠ retired := by decide

theorem supportWithin_not_retired (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : Node, status n ≠ retired → ∀ m ∈ supportWithin k n, status m ≠ retired := by
  induction k with
  | zero => intro n hn m hm; simp [supportWithin] at hm; subst hm; exact hn
  | succ k ih =>
    intro n hn m hm
    simp only [supportWithin, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap] at hm
    rcases hm with rfl | ⟨j, hj, hmj⟩
    · exact hn
    · exact ih j (dag_no_retired_edge n hn j hj) m hmj

/-- No banked-exact or conditional node transitively uses a retired node. -/
theorem dag_no_retired_use :
    ∀ n : Node, (status n = bankedExact ∨ status n = conditional) →
      ∀ m ∈ support n, status m ≠ retired := by
  intro n hn
  apply supportWithin_not_retired
  rcases hn with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> decide

theorem dag_erdos287_open : status erdos287 = .open := rfl

theorem dag_erdos287_no_decl : decl erdos287 = none := rfl

/-- Every direct route into the Erdős #287 node is open or conditional — none is banked
exact. -/
theorem dag_erdos287_inputs_not_exact :
    ∀ m ∈ deps erdos287, status m ≠ bankedExact := by decide

/-- The open frontier nodes in the support of the Erdős #287 node. -/
theorem dag_erdos287_open_support :
    (support erdos287).filter (fun n => status n == .open) =
      [erdos287, crossScaleSync, finiteExclusion, proximity, intermediateScales] := by decide

/-- Every banked-exact or conditional node has a backing Lean declaration. -/
theorem dag_proved_have_decls :
    ∀ n : Node, (status n = bankedExact ∨ status n = conditional) → (decl n).isSome := by
  decide

end Erdos287.PostV71V87.DAG

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Positional

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V86 endpoint-anchored CRT (unconditional)

For coprime absent moduli `d, e ≥ 2` of a gap-two word on `[a, M]` the two *oriented CRT
contacts* are the residue classes modulo `de` of

* `x` with `d ∣ x` and `e ∣ x + 1`  (orientation `d → e`), and
* `x` with `e ∣ x` and `d ∣ x + 1`  (orientation `e → d`).

A contact `x` with `a ≤ x` and `x + 1 ≤ M` would be two consecutive omissions.  We prove
the exact **endpoint-anchored theorem** (`endpoint_anchored_crt`):

  `de > M`   or   `M - a < de < 2a`,

valid for every word (no exact mass needed), all endpoint cases included (`a ≤ x`,
`x + 1 ≤ M` are the only constraints; the endpoints themselves are selected).  In fact
`M - a < de` always holds (`window_lt_mul`), and `de ≤ M` forces `de < 2a`.

Consequences:

* `Q_mul_Q_gt_D`        — `Q_p Q_r > M - a` for distinct primes;
* `small_ceiling_unique` / `card_small_ceilings_le_one` — at most one prime has
  `Q_p² ≤ M - a`, i.e. `#{p : Q_p ≤ √(M-a)} ≤ 1`;
* `low_start_chamber`   — if `3a ≤ M + 1` then every coprime absent pair has `de > M`;
* `dyadic_two_sided_saturation` — (exact words, `a > 1`) the window contains an interior
  multiple `y` of `Q_2`, and every such `y` carries the guard `(1,0,1)`;
* `ceiling_annulus`     — every non-exceptional prime has `M - a < Q_p²` and `Q_p ≤ p·M`;
* `owner_disjoint`      — rows of distinct primes `ℓ, ℓ'` with `ℓℓ' > M` are disjoint, and
  a prime `ℓ > M - a` divides at most one window position.

The aggregate rough-part estimate is **not** claimed here (it is OPEN in the ledger).
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- Every residue class modulo `m ≥ 1` meets every interval `[N, N + m)`. -/
theorem exists_residue_in_window {N m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (c : ℕ) :
    ∃ x, N ≤ x ∧ x < N + m ∧ x ≡ c [MOD m] := by
  have hc : c % m ∈ Finset.range m := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  rw [← Nat.image_Ico_mod N m] at hc
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxm⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hx
  exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, hxm⟩

/-- An oriented CRT contact `d → e`: `d ∣ x` and `e ∣ x + 1`. -/
def Contact (d e x : ℕ) : Prop := d ∣ x ∧ e ∣ x + 1

/-- The oriented contact `d → e` exists below `de`. -/
theorem exists_contact {d e : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d e) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (he : 1 ≤ e) :
    ∃ r, r < d * e ∧ Contact d e r := by
  let k := Nat.chineseRemainder hcop 0 (e - 1)
  refine ⟨k.1, Nat.chineseRemainder_lt_mul hcop 0 (e - 1) (by omega) (by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1 k.2.1
  · have h2 : k.1 % e = (e - 1) % e := k.2.2
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : e - 1 < e)] at h2
    exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by rw [Nat.add_mod, h2]; simp; rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel he]; simp)

/-- Contacts are periodic modulo `de`. -/
theorem contact_of_modEq {d e x r : ℕ} (h : Contact d e r) (hx : x ≡ r [MOD d * e]) :
    Contact d e x := by
  constructor
  · exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (Nat.ModEq.of_mul_right e hx) (dvd_refl d)).2 h.1
  · exact (Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff (Nat.ModEq.add_right 1 (Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left d hx))
      (dvd_refl e)).2 h.2

/-- The reflected contact: if `r → (d,e)` then `de - 1 - r` is a contact `e → d`. -/
theorem contact_reflect {d e r : ℕ} (h : Contact d e r) (hr : r < d * e) :
    Contact e d (d * e - 1 - r) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩ := h
  have hw1 : 1 ≤ w := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos w with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; simp at hw
    · exact h0
  constructor
  · refine ⟨d - w, ?_⟩
    have : d * e - 1 - r = d * e - (r + 1) := by omega
    rw [this, hw, Nat.mul_sub, mul_comm e d]
  · refine ⟨e - u, ?_⟩
    have : d * e - 1 - r + 1 = d * e - r := by omega
    rw [this, hu, Nat.mul_sub]

namespace Word

variable (W : Word)

/-- A contact of two absent moduli cannot sit inside the window. -/
theorem no_contact_in_window {d e x : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent d) (he : W.Absent e)
    (h : Contact d e x) (hx : W.a ≤ x) (hx1 : x + 1 ≤ W.M) : False := by
  rcases W.gap x hx hx1 with h1 | h1
  · exact hd x h1 h.1
  · exact he (x + 1) h1 h.2

/-- **`M - a < de` for every coprime absent pair.** -/
theorem window_lt_mul {d e : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d e) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (had : W.Absent d) (hae : W.Absent e) : W.M - W.a < d * e := by
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := exists_contact hcop hd he
  have hm : 1 ≤ d * e := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2, hxr⟩ := exists_residue_in_window (N := W.a) hm r
  have hc := contact_of_modEq hr hxr
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  exact W.no_contact_in_window had hae hc hx1 (by have := W.a_le_M; omega)

/-- **`de ≤ M` forces `de < 2a`.** -/
theorem mul_lt_two_a {d e : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d e) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (had : W.Absent d) (hae : W.Absent e) (hle : d * e ≤ W.M) : d * e < 2 * W.a := by
  obtain ⟨r, hrlt, hr⟩ := exists_contact hcop hd he
  have hr' := contact_reflect hr hrlt
  -- both contacts `r` and `de - 1 - r` have `x + 1 ≤ de ≤ M`, so both lie below `a`
  have h1 : r < W.a := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    exact W.no_contact_in_window had hae hr hc (by omega)
  have h2 : d * e - 1 - r < W.a := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    exact W.no_contact_in_window hae had hr' hc (by omega)
  omega

/-- **V86 endpoint-anchored CRT theorem.**  For coprime absent moduli `d, e ≥ 2`:
`de > M` or `M - a < de < 2a`. -/
theorem endpoint_anchored_crt {d e : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d e) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (he : 2 ≤ e)
    (had : W.Absent d) (hae : W.Absent e) :
    W.M < d * e ∨ (W.M - W.a < d * e ∧ d * e < 2 * W.a) := by
  by_cases h : W.M < d * e
  · exact Or.inl h
  · push_neg at h
    exact Or.inr ⟨W.window_lt_mul hcop (by omega) (by omega) had hae,
      W.mul_lt_two_a hcop (by omega) (by omega) had hae h⟩

/-- Ceilings of distinct primes are coprime. -/
theorem Q_coprime {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpr : p ≠ r) :
    Nat.Coprime (W.Q p) (W.Q r) :=
  Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ ((Nat.coprime_primes hp hr).2 hpr)

/-- **`Q_p Q_r > M - a`** for distinct primes `p ≠ r`. -/
theorem Q_mul_Q_gt_D {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpr : p ≠ r) :
    W.D < W.Q p * W.Q r :=
  W.window_lt_mul (W.Q_coprime hp hr hpr) (W.one_lt_Q hp).le (W.one_lt_Q hr).le
    (W.Q_absent hp) (W.Q_absent hr)

/-- A prime is *exceptional* when its ceiling is at most `√(M - a)`, i.e. `Q_p² ≤ M - a`. -/
def Exceptional (p : ℕ) : Prop := W.Q p * W.Q p ≤ W.D

instance : DecidablePred W.Exceptional := fun p => by unfold Exceptional; infer_instance

/-- At most one prime is exceptional. -/
theorem small_ceiling_unique {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime)
    (hpE : W.Exceptional p) (hrE : W.Exceptional r) : p = r := by
  by_contra hpr
  have h := W.Q_mul_Q_gt_D hp hr hpr
  unfold Exceptional at hpE hrE
  rcases le_total (W.Q p) (W.Q r) with hle | hle
  · have : W.Q p * W.Q r ≤ W.Q r * W.Q r := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hle
    omega
  · have : W.Q p * W.Q r ≤ W.Q p * W.Q p := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hle
    omega

/-- **`#{p : Q_p ≤ √(M-a)} ≤ 1`** (over any finite set of primes). -/
theorem card_small_ceilings_le_one (S : Finset ℕ) :
    (S.filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ W.Exceptional p)).card ≤ 1 := by
  refine Finset.card_le_one.2 ?_
  intro p hp r hr
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hp hr
  exact W.small_ceiling_unique hp.2.1 hr.2.1 hp.2.2 hr.2.2

/-- **Low-start chamber.**  If `3a ≤ M + 1`, the second alternative is empty: every coprime
absent pair `d, e ≥ 2` has `de > M`. -/
theorem low_start_chamber (hlow : 3 * W.a ≤ W.M + 1) {d e : ℕ} (hcop : Nat.Coprime d e)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (he : 2 ≤ e) (had : W.Absent d) (hae : W.Absent e) : W.M < d * e := by
  rcases W.endpoint_anchored_crt hcop hd he had hae with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact h
  · have := W.a_le_M; omega

/-- In the low-start chamber, distinct primes have `Q_p Q_r > M`. -/
theorem low_start_Q_mul_Q_gt_M (hlow : 3 * W.a ≤ W.M + 1) {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hr : r.Prime) (hpr : p ≠ r) : W.M < W.Q p * W.Q r :=
  W.low_start_chamber hlow (W.Q_coprime hp hr hpr) (W.one_lt_Q hp) (W.one_lt_Q hr)
    (W.Q_absent hp) (W.Q_absent hr)

/-- Outside the low-start chamber, a pair of ceilings with product at most `M` lies in the
annulus `M - a < Q_p Q_r < 2a`. -/
theorem Q_pair_annulus {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpr : p ≠ r)
    (hle : W.Q p * W.Q r ≤ W.M) : W.D < W.Q p * W.Q r ∧ W.Q p * W.Q r < 2 * W.a := by
  rcases W.endpoint_anchored_crt (W.Q_coprime hp hr hpr) (W.one_lt_Q hp) (W.one_lt_Q hr)
    (W.Q_absent hp) (W.Q_absent hr) with h | h
  · omega
  · exact h

/-- A prime larger than the window length divides at most one window position. -/
theorem large_prime_unique_multiple {ℓ x y : ℕ} (hℓ : W.D < ℓ)
    (hx : W.a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ W.M) (hy : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M) (hxd : ℓ ∣ x) (hyd : ℓ ∣ y) :
    x = y := by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hyd hxd)
    unfold D at hℓ; omega
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hxd hyd)
    unfold D at hℓ; omega

/-- **Owner-disjointness.**  Selected rows of distinct primes `ℓ ≠ ℓ'` with `ℓ ℓ' > M` are
disjoint: a selected element has at most one such large prime owner. -/
theorem owner_disjoint {ℓ ℓ' : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓ' : ℓ'.Prime) (hne : ℓ ≠ ℓ')
    (hbig : W.M < ℓ * ℓ') : Disjoint (W.selRow ℓ) (W.selRow ℓ') := by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hn hn'
  simp only [selRow, Finset.mem_filter] at hn hn'
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime ℓ ℓ' := (Nat.coprime_primes hℓ hℓ').2 hne
  have hd := Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hcop hn.2 hn'.2
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd (W.pos_of_mem hn.1) hd
  have := (W.mem_Icc hn.1).2
  omega

/-- A prime `ℓ ≥ 3` divides at most one element of a guard triple `(y-1, y, y+1)`. -/
theorem guard_triple_owner_unique {ℓ y u w : ℕ} (hℓ : 3 ≤ ℓ)
    (hu : y ≤ u + 1 ∧ u ≤ y + 1) (hw : y ≤ w + 1 ∧ w ≤ y + 1) (hud : ℓ ∣ u) (hwd : ℓ ∣ w) :
    u = w := by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hwd hud); omega
  · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hud hwd); omega

end Word

namespace ExactWord

variable (W : ExactWord)

/-- **Dyadic two-sided saturation.**  For an exact word with `a > 1` the window contains a
multiple `y` of the dyadic ceiling `Q_2`, it is interior, and both its neighbours are
selected; moreover every multiple of `Q_2` in the window carries the guard `(1,0,1)`. -/
theorem dyadic_two_sided_saturation (ha : 1 < W.a) :
    (∃ y, W.Q 2 ∣ y ∧ W.a < y ∧ y < W.M ∧ y - 1 ∈ W.A ∧ y ∉ W.A ∧ y + 1 ∈ W.A) ∧
    (∀ y, W.Q 2 ∣ y → W.a ≤ y → y ≤ W.M →
      W.x (y - 1) = true ∧ W.x y = false ∧ W.x (y + 1) = true) := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun y hy h1 h2 => W.guard_pattern (W.Q_absent Nat.prime_two) hy ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
  have hQ := W.Q_two_le_D ha
  have hQ1 := W.one_lt_Q Nat.prime_two
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2, hyr⟩ := exists_residue_in_window (N := W.a) (m := W.Q 2) (by omega) 0
  have hdy : W.Q 2 ∣ y := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1 hyr
  have hwin : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M := ⟨hy1, by unfold Word.D at hQ; have := W.a_le_M; omega⟩
  have hom := W.forced_omitted (W.Q_absent Nat.prime_two) hdy
  have hi := W.interior_of_omitted hwin hom
  have hn := W.neighbours_of_omitted hwin hom
  exact ⟨y, hdy, hi.1, hi.2, hn.1, hom, hn.2⟩

/-- **Primary-ceiling annulus.**  Every non-exceptional prime has `M - a < Q_p²`, and every
prime has `Q_p ≤ p · M`. -/
theorem ceiling_annulus {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hne : ¬ W.Exceptional p) :
    W.D < W.Q p * W.Q p ∧ W.Q p ≤ p * W.M := by
  refine ⟨by unfold Word.Exceptional at hne; omega, ?_⟩
  rw [W.Q_eq_mul]
  refine Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ?_
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := W.layer_nonempty p
  exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (W.pos_of_mem (W.mem_of_mem_layer hn))
    (W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp hn)) (W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer hn)).2

end ExactWord

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.ShellFingerprint
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.ReciprocalImageBound

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V87 entropy inequality (unconditional, from imported Chebyshev bounds)

* `shellPrimes_card_lower` — for `q ≥ q0`,
  `#{p prime : q/16 < p < q} ≥ q / (8 log q)`
  (lower bound from the central binomial coefficient, proved in `AnalyticToolkit`, upper bound
  from Mathlib's Chebyshev theorem);
* `entropy_inequality` — for every exact word with `a > 1` and `q_* ≥ q0`, with
  `H = ⌊16 M / q_*⌋`:

    `log q_* ≤ log 16 + log S_rec(H) + 2 log(H + 1)`.

  This combines the fingerprint/entropy core (`ExactWord.entropy_core`, `K = 16`) with the
  prime count.  No analytic hypothesis is assumed.
-/

open Real
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- The shell primes `{p prime : p < q, q < K p}`. -/
def shellPrimes (K q : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range q).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ q < K * p)

theorem ExactWord.topShellPrimes_eq (W : ExactWord) (K : ℕ) :
    W.topShellPrimes K = shellPrimes K W.qstar := rfl

/-- `π(q - 1) ≤ #shellPrimes K q + π(q / K)`. -/
theorem shellPrimes_card_ge (K q : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    Nat.primeCounting (q - 1) ≤ (shellPrimes K q).card + Nat.primeCounting (q / K) := by
  classical
  rw [Nat.primeCounting_sub_one, ← Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting']
  have hsub : Nat.primesBelow q ⊆
      shellPrimes K q ∪ Nat.primesBelow (q / K + 1) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow] at hp
    by_cases h : q < K * p
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_range.2 hp.1, hp.2, h⟩)
    · push_neg at h
      refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
      rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow]
      refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
      have : p ≤ q / K := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h)
      omega
  have hc : (Nat.primesBelow (q / K + 1)).card = Nat.primeCounting (q / K) := by
    rw [Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting']; rfl
  calc (Nat.primesBelow q).card ≤ (shellPrimes K q ∪ Nat.primesBelow (q / K + 1)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ (shellPrimes K q).card + (Nat.primesBelow (q / K + 1)).card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [hc]

/-- `log x ≤ x / 16` for `x ≥ 256`. -/
theorem log_le_div_sixteen {x : ℝ} (hx : 256 ≤ x) : Real.log x ≤ x / 16 := by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  set t := x ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
  have ht4 : t ^ 4 = x := rpow_quarter_pow_four hx0
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0 _
  have ht : 4 ≤ t := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have : t ^ 4 < 4 ^ 4 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc ht0 (by norm_num)
    norm_num at this; linarith
  have h1 := log_le_four_rpow hx0
  have h3 : (64 : ℝ) ≤ t ^ 3 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) ht 3; norm_num at this; linarith
  have h4 : 64 * t ≤ t ^ 4 := by
    have : t ^ 4 = t ^ 3 * t := by ring
    rw [this]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 ht0
  linarith

/-- **Top-shell prime count.**  For `q ≥ q0`: `q / (8 log q) ≤ #{p prime : q/16 < p < q}`. -/
theorem shellPrimes_card_lower :
    ∃ q0 : ℕ, 256 ≤ q0 ∧ ∀ q : ℕ, q0 ≤ q →
      (q : ℝ) ≤ 8 * Real.log q * (shellPrimes 16 q).card := by
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0, hcheb⟩ := chebyshev_upper
  refine ⟨max 256 ⌈16 * X0⌉₊, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  have hq256 : 256 ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hq
  have hqX : 16 * X0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
    have := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hq
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (by exact_mod_cast this)
  have hqr : (256 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq256
  set L := Real.log q with hLdef
  have hLpos : 0 < L := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hLle : L ≤ q / 16 := log_le_div_sixteen hqr
  -- lower count
  set n := (q - 1) / 2 with hndef
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have h2n : 2 * n ≤ q - 1 := by omega
  have hnr : ((q : ℝ) - 2) / 2 ≤ n := by
    have : q - 2 ≤ 2 * n := by omega
    have h' : ((q - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * n := by exact_mod_cast this
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)] at h'
    push_cast at h'; linarith
  set A := (Nat.primeCounting (2 * n) : ℝ) with hA
  have hlow := primeCounting_lower n hn1
  have hlog2n : Real.log (2 * n) ≤ L := by
    rw [hLdef]
    refine Real.log_le_log (by positivity) ?_
    have : ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 * n ≤ q)
    push_cast at this; exact this
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A + 1 := by positivity
  have hAL : (n : ℝ) * Real.log 4 ≤ (A + 1) * L :=
    le_trans hlow (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2n hA0)
  -- upper count
  set B := (Nat.primeCounting (q / 16) : ℝ) with hB
  have hfl : ⌊(q : ℝ) / 16⌋₊ = q / 16 := by
    have := Nat.floor_div_eq_div (K := ℝ) q 16; push_cast at this; exact this
  have hBup : B ≤ Cpi * ((q : ℝ) / 16) / Real.log ((q : ℝ) / 16) := by
    have := hcheb ((q : ℝ) / 16) (by linarith); rw [hfl] at this; exact this
  have hlog16 : L / 2 ≤ Real.log ((q : ℝ) / 16) := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    have : Real.log 16 ≤ L / 2 := by
      have h256 : Real.log 256 ≤ L := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hqr
      have : Real.log 256 = 2 * Real.log 16 := by
        rw [show (256 : ℝ) = 16 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
      linarith
    linarith
  have hl16pos : 0 < Real.log ((q : ℝ) / 16) := by linarith
  have hBL : B * L ≤ Cpi * q / 8 := by
    have h1 : B * Real.log ((q : ℝ) / 16) ≤ Cpi * ((q : ℝ) / 16) := by
      rwa [le_div_iff₀ hl16pos] at hBup
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
    have h2 : B * (L / 2) ≤ B * Real.log ((q : ℝ) / 16) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog16 hB0
    linarith
  -- combine
  have hcount := shellPrimes_card_ge 16 q (by norm_num)
  have hmono : Nat.primeCounting (2 * n) ≤ Nat.primeCounting (q - 1) :=
    Nat.monotone_primeCounting h2n
  set P := ((shellPrimes 16 q).card : ℝ) with hP
  have hAPB : A ≤ P + B := by
    have : Nat.primeCounting (2 * n) ≤ (shellPrimes 16 q).card + Nat.primeCounting (q / 16) :=
      le_trans hmono hcount
    have h' : ((Nat.primeCounting (2 * n) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((shellPrimes 16 q).card : ℝ) + (Nat.primeCounting (q / 16) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast this
    simpa [hA, hP, hB] using h'
  have hAPBL : A * L ≤ (P + B) * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAPB hLpos.le
  have hl4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hl2' := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  have hCpi : Cpi = 2 * Real.log 2 + 1 := by unfold Cpi; rw [hl4]
  have hnl : ((q : ℝ) - 2) / 2 * Real.log 4 ≤ n * Real.log 4 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnr (by rw [hl4]; linarith)
  rw [hl4] at hnl hAL
  rw [hCpi] at hBL
  nlinarith

/-- `H · H! ≤ (H + 1)^(H + 1)`. -/
theorem mul_factorial_le (H : ℕ) : H * H.factorial ≤ (H + 1) ^ (H + 1) := by
  calc H * H.factorial ≤ (H + 1) * (H + 1) ^ H :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_trans (Nat.factorial_le_pow H)
          (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) H))
    _ = (H + 1) ^ (H + 1) := by ring

/-- **V87 entropy inequality.**  There is `q0` such that every exact word with `a > 1` and
`q_* ≥ q0` satisfies, with `H = ⌊16 M / q_*⌋`,
`log q_* ≤ log 16 + log S_rec(H) + 2 log(H + 1)`. -/
theorem entropy_inequality :
    ∃ q0 : ℕ, 256 ≤ q0 ∧ ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → q0 ≤ W.qstar →
      Real.log W.qstar ≤ Real.log 16 + Real.log (Srec (16 * W.M / W.qstar)) +
        2 * Real.log ((16 * W.M / W.qstar : ℕ) + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨q0, hq0, hcnt⟩ := shellPrimes_card_lower
  refine ⟨q0, hq0, fun W ha hq => ?_⟩
  have hqD : W.qstar ≤ W.D := le_trans (W.qstar_le Nat.prime_two) (W.Q_two_le_D ha)
  have hDM : W.D ≤ W.M := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hqpos : 0 < W.qstar := by omega
  have hH : 1 ≤ 16 * W.M / W.qstar := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hqpos).2 (by omega)
  have hcore := W.entropy_core 16 hH
  rw [W.topShellPrimes_eq] at hcore
  have hc := hcnt W.qstar hq
  set q := W.qstar with hqdef
  set H := 16 * W.M / q with hHdef
  set P := (shellPrimes 16 q).card with hPdef
  set S := Srec H with hSdef
  have hqr : (256 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast le_trans hq0 hq
  have hqrpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hHr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hH
  have hSpos : (0 : ℝ) < S := by exact_mod_cast Srec_pos H
  have hcore' : (q : ℝ) ^ P ≤ (16 : ℝ) ^ P * ((H : ℝ) * H.factorial) ^ S := by
    exact_mod_cast hcore
  have hmf : (H : ℝ) * H.factorial ≤ ((H : ℝ) + 1) ^ (H + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast mul_factorial_le H
  have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < (H : ℝ) * H.factorial := by
    have := Nat.factorial_pos H; positivity
  have hlogc := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hcore'
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
    at hlogc
  have hlogmf : Real.log ((H : ℝ) * H.factorial) ≤ ((H : ℝ) + 1) * ((H : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h1 := Real.log_le_log hfpos hmf
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h1
    have h2 : Real.log ((H : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (H : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (H : ℝ) + 1); linarith
    have h3 : (((H + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.log ((H : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ((H : ℝ) + 1) * ((H : ℝ) + 1) := by
      push_cast; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
    linarith
  set L := Real.log q with hLdef
  have hl16 : Real.log 16 ≤ L / 2 := by
    have h256 : Real.log 256 ≤ L := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hqr
    have : Real.log 256 = 2 * Real.log 16 := by
      rw [show (256 : ℝ) = 16 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    linarith
  have hPr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hS0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ S := hSpos.le
  have hkey : (P : ℝ) * (L - Real.log 16) ≤ S * (((H : ℝ) + 1) * ((H : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogmf hS0
    linarith
  have hkey2 : (q : ℝ) / 16 ≤ S * ((H : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (P : ℝ) * (L / 2) ≤ (P : ℝ) * (L - Real.log 16) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hPr
    have h2 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 8 * L * P := hc
    nlinarith
  have hfin := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hkey2
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by norm_num), Real.log_mul hSpos.ne' (by positivity),
    Real.log_pow] at hfin
  push_cast at hfin
  linarith

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Physical

/-!
# Erdős #287 — high-shell scope firewall, terminal-window firewall, open frontier

## Three-zone picture (V87 high-shell result, repaired domain)

1. **Below `q_*` (PROVED):** every prime row is active and carries the fingerprint
   (`zone_one_below_qstar`).
2. **Sufficiently high shells:**
   * shells `(X, 2X]` with `X ≥ ⌊M/2⌋` are *totally* empty — **PROVED** unconditionally
     (`highShell_trivial`);
   * "almost all rows empty" at lower admissible thresholds `X ≥ X0(M)` is the explicit
     provider `HighShellExtinction X0 ε` — **CONDITIONAL** (the analytic estimate is not
     formalised; we only derive `highShell_some_empty_row` from it).
3. **Intermediate scales `q_* < X < X0(M)`: OPEN** (`IntermediateScaleControl287`).

**Not claimed:** almost-empty shells immediately above `q_*`; `q_*` being a sharp
active/empty transition (`NearbyTransition287`, a fictitious provider recorded only to be
fenced off); control of every intermediate scale.

## Terminal-window firewall

`polylog_window_not_excluded`: for every `c` and every `B ≥ 2`, the repaired recurrence
conclusion `c · g(log D) ≤ D/q` holds **automatically** whenever `q ≤ D/(log D)^B` and `D` is
large.  Hence the recurrence theorem alone does **not** exclude a terminal window
`M/(log M)^B < q_* ≪ M/T(M)`.

## Open frontier

* `Proximity287` — substantial empty-row information at scales `(q_*, K q_*]` (OPEN).
* `CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0` — no exact word with `M ≥ M0` realises the full
  cross-scale package `CrossScaleRealisation` (OPEN).  We prove that *every* exact word
  realises the package (`realisation_of_exact`), so this interface is **equivalent** to the
  nonexistence of counterexamples with `M ≥ M0` (`crossScale_iff_tail`): it is not weaker than
  the tail of #287, and it is the actual dependency of the hypothetical tail closure
  `tail_closure_of_crossScale`.

Neither provider is constructed anywhere in this subtree.
-/

open Real
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-! ## Shells -/

/-- Active primes in the shell `(X, 2X]`. -/
noncomputable def Word.activeShell (W : Word) (X : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.Ioc X (2 * X)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ W.Active p)

/-- Number of primes in the shell `(X, 2X]`. -/
def shellPrimeCount (X : ℕ) : ℕ := ((Finset.Ioc X (2 * X)).filter Nat.Prime).card

/-- **Zone 1 (PROVED).**  Below `q_*` every prime row is active and fingerprinted. -/
theorem zone_one_below_qstar (W : ExactWord) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hlt : p < W.qstar) :
    W.Active p ∧ 2 ≤ (W.layer p).card ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ (W.sigma p).num :=
  W.shell_fingerprint hp hlt

/-- **(Provider, CONDITIONAL.)**  High-shell extinction above the threshold `X0(M)`: the
active primes of every shell `(X, 2X]` with `X ≥ X0(M)` form at most an `ε`-fraction of the
shell's primes. -/
def HighShellExtinction (X0 : ℕ → ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → ∀ X : ℕ, X0 W.M ≤ X →
    ((W.activeShell X).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * shellPrimeCount X

/-- **Zone 2, trivial range (PROVED).**  Shells above `⌊M/2⌋` are completely empty. -/
theorem highShell_trivial : HighShellExtinction (fun M => M / 2) 0 := by
  intro W ha X hX
  simp only at hX
  have : W.activeShell X = ∅ := by
    classical
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro p hp
    simp only [Word.activeShell, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, hpp, hact⟩ := hp
    exact W.not_active_of_lt_two_mul hpp (by omega) hact
  rw [this]; simp

/-- Bertrand: every shell `(X, 2X]` with `X ≥ 1` contains a prime. -/
theorem shellPrimeCount_pos {X : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) : 0 < shellPrimeCount X := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h1, h2⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_lt_and_le_two_mul X (by omega)
  exact Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨p, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩, hp⟩⟩

/-- **Zone 2 (CONDITIONAL consequence).**  Under `HighShellExtinction X0 ε` with `ε < 1`, every
shell above the threshold contains an empty prime row. -/
theorem highShell_some_empty_row {X0 : ℕ → ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (h : HighShellExtinction X0 ε)
    (hε : ε < 1) (W : ExactWord) (ha : 1 < W.a) {X : ℕ} (hX : X0 W.M ≤ X) (hX1 : 1 ≤ X) :
    ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ X < p ∧ p ≤ 2 * X ∧ ¬ W.Active p := by
  classical
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hsub : (Finset.Ioc X (2 * X)).filter Nat.Prime ⊆ W.activeShell X := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    simp only [Word.activeShell, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc]
    exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2, hc p hp.2 hp.1.1 hp.1.2⟩
  have h1 : (shellPrimeCount X : ℝ) ≤ (W.activeShell X).card := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have h2 := h W ha X hX
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < shellPrimeCount X := by exact_mod_cast shellPrimeCount_pos hX1
  nlinarith

/-- **Zone 3 (OPEN).**  Control of every intermediate scale between `q_*` and `X0(M)`. -/
def IntermediateScaleControl287 (X0 : ℕ → ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → ∀ X : ℕ, W.qstar ≤ X → X < X0 W.M →
    ((W.activeShell X).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * shellPrimeCount X

/-- **Fictitious provider (never assumed).**  "`q_*` is a sharp active/empty transition":
every prime row in `(q_*, 2 q_*]` is empty for large words.  Recorded only so that closure
statements can be shown not to depend on it. -/
def NearbyTransition287 : Prop :=
  ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M →
    ∀ p, p.Prime → W.qstar < p → p ≤ 2 * W.qstar → ¬ W.Active p

/-! ## Open frontier interfaces -/

open Classical in
/-- **OPEN — `Proximity287`.**  Substantial empty-row information at scales quantitatively
close to `q_*`: for some fixed `K ≥ 2`, in all large exact words at most half of the primes in
`(q_*, K q_*]` have active rows. -/
def Proximity287 : Prop :=
  ∃ K : ℕ, 2 ≤ K ∧ ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M →
    2 * ((Finset.Ioc W.qstar (K * W.qstar)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ W.Active p)).card ≤
      ((Finset.Ioc W.qstar (K * W.qstar)).filter Nat.Prime).card

/-- The fictitious sharp transition would already give `Proximity287` (with `K = 2`); it is
therefore at least as strong as an OPEN statement and is not available. -/
theorem nearbyTransition_implies_proximity (h : NearbyTransition287) : Proximity287 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := h
  refine ⟨2, le_refl 2, M0, fun W ha hM => ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr (Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr ?_)]
  · simp
  · intro p hp hpa
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    exact hM0 W ha hM p hpa.1 hp.1 hp.2 hpa.2

/-- **Scope firewall.**  Any derivation of `Proximity287` from high-shell extinction at the
trivially available threshold `⌊M/2⌋` would prove `Proximity287` outright. -/
theorem proximity_not_from_trivial_highShell
    (h : HighShellExtinction (fun M => M / 2) 0 → Proximity287) : Proximity287 :=
  h highShell_trivial

/-- The full cross-scale package realised by an exact word. -/
structure CrossScaleRealisation (W : ExactWord) : Prop where
  /-- Repeated minimal-ceiling guard triples. -/
  guards : ∀ y ∈ W.internalMultiples W.qstar,
    W.x (y - 1) = true ∧ W.x y = false ∧ W.x (y + 1) = true
  /-- All complete rows below `q_*` active, with fingerprint. -/
  rows_below : ∀ p, p.Prime → p < W.qstar → W.Active p ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ (W.sigma p).num
  /-- Polynomial maximal-carrier reserve. -/
  carrier_reserve : ∀ p ∈ W.reservePrimes, p ≤ W.P p ∧ W.D < W.P p ^ 4
  /-- High shells (above `⌊M/2⌋`) empty. -/
  high_shells : ∀ X, W.M / 2 ≤ X → W.activeShell X = ∅
  /-- All lower carry digits: no prime divides the reduced denominator of the mass. -/
  carry_digits : ∀ p, p.Prime → ¬ p ∣ (∑ n ∈ W.A, (1 : ℚ) / n).den
  /-- Exact mass one. -/
  exact_mass : ∑ n ∈ W.A, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1

/-- **Every exact word realises the full cross-scale package** (all components
are proved in this subtree). -/
theorem realisation_of_exact (W : ExactWord) : CrossScaleRealisation W where
  guards := fun y hy => W.guard_at_internal_qstar hy
  rows_below := fun p hp hlt =>
    ⟨(W.shell_fingerprint hp hlt).1, (W.shell_fingerprint hp hlt).2.2⟩
  carrier_reserve := fun p hp => by
    have h := W.mem_reservePrimes.1 hp
    exact W.toWord.carrier_reserve h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2
  high_shells := fun X hX => by
    classical
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro p hp
    simp only [Word.activeShell, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    exact W.not_active_of_lt_two_mul hp.2.1 (by omega) hp.2.2
  carry_digits := fun p hp => by rw [W.mass]; simpa using hp.one_lt.ne'
  exact_mass := W.mass

/-- **OPEN — `CrossScaleSynchronization287`.**  No exact word with `M ≥ M0` realises the full
cross-scale package. -/
def CrossScaleSynchronization287 (M0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M → ¬ CrossScaleRealisation W

/-- **Exposure theorem.**  `CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0` is equivalent to the
nonexistence of exact words with `a > 1`, `M ≥ M0`. -/
theorem crossScale_iff_tail (M0 : ℕ) :
    CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0 ↔ ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M → False := by
  constructor
  · intro h W ha hM; exact h W ha hM (realisation_of_exact W)
  · intro h W ha hM _; exact h W ha hM

/-- Finite exclusion below `M0` (an explicit, unproved input). -/
def FiniteExclusionBelow (M0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, A.max' h.nonempty < M0 → False

/-- **Hypothetical tail closure (CONDITIONAL on `CrossScaleSynchronization287`).** -/
theorem tail_closure_of_crossScale {M0 : ℕ} (h : CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0)
    (A : Finset ℕ) (hA : Erdos287Counterexample A) : A.max' hA.nonempty < M0 := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hW := ofCounterexample_one_lt_a hA
  exact h (ofCounterexample hA) hW hc (realisation_of_exact _)

/-- **Conditional global statement.**  `CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0` together with the
finite exclusion below `M0` would give Erdős #287.  Both inputs are OPEN / unproved. -/
theorem erdos287_of_crossScale_and_finite {M0 : ℕ} (h : CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0)
    (hfin : FiniteExclusionBelow M0) (A : Finset ℕ) : ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A :=
  fun hA => hfin A hA (tail_closure_of_crossScale h A hA)

/-! ## Terminal-window firewall -/

/-- `k · log x ≤ x` for `x ≥ 4k²`, `k > 0`. -/
theorem mul_log_le_self {k x : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hx : 4 * k ^ 2 ≤ x) (hx1 : 1 ≤ x) :
    k * Real.log x ≤ x := by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  have h1 := Real.log_le_rpow_div hx0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
  rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at h1
  have hs : 2 * k ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    rw [show 2 * k = Real.sqrt ((2 * k) ^ 2) by rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
  have hsx := Real.mul_self_sqrt hx0
  have : Real.log x ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt x := by linarith [show Real.sqrt x / (1 / 2) = 2 * Real.sqrt x by ring]
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg x]

/-- **Terminal-window firewall.**  For every constant `c > 0` and every `B ≥ 2`, the repaired
recurrence conclusion `c · g(log D) ≤ D/q` holds automatically for every `q ≤ D/(log D)^B`
once `D` is large.  Hence superlogarithmic recurrence alone cannot exclude a polylogarithmic
terminal window `M/(log M)^B < q_* ≪ M/T(M)`. -/
theorem polylog_window_not_excluded (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (B : ℕ) (hB : 2 ≤ B) :
    ∃ D0 : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D0 ≤ D → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ D / Real.log D ^ B →
      c * gRec (Real.log D) ≤ D / q := by
  refine ⟨Real.exp (max 256 (4 * c ^ 2)), fun D hD q hq hqD => ?_⟩
  have hDpos : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hD
  set x := Real.log D with hxdef
  have hx : max 256 (4 * c ^ 2) ≤ x := by rw [hxdef, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hDpos]; exact hD
  have hx256 : 256 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hxc : 4 * c ^ 2 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by linarith
  -- `c · g(x) ≤ x²`
  have hee : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x := le_trans exp_exp_one_le_256 hx256
  have hll : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := one_le_loglog hx256
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hg : gRec x ≤ x * Real.log x := by
    unfold gRec
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [mul_pos hxpos hlx]
  have hcl : c * Real.log x ≤ x := mul_log_le_self hc hxc (by linarith)
  have h1 : c * gRec x ≤ x ^ 2 := by
    calc c * gRec x ≤ c * (x * Real.log x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg hc.le
      _ = x * (c * Real.log x) := by ring
      _ ≤ x * x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcl hxpos.le
      _ = x ^ 2 := by ring
  have h2 : x ^ 2 ≤ x ^ B := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) hB
  have hxB : 0 < x ^ B := pow_pos hxpos B
  have h3 : x ^ B ≤ D / q := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hxB] at hqD
    linarith
  linarith

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Model

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V83 repair: actual principal minors vs target-one substitutes (RETIRED route)

The V83 audit separated two quantities attached to a complement block `R`:

* the **actual** quantity `C_R`, computed with the true reciprocal mass `S = ∑ 1/n`; it is
  affine in `S` with integer slope `B_R` and integer offset `K_R`:  `C_R = B_R·S + K_R`;
* the **target-one substitute** `D_R = B_R + K_R`, obtained by substituting `S := 1`.

We prove

* `actual_sub_target`  — `C_R − D_R = B_R (S − 1)`;
* `den_intCast_mul`    — `den(B·S) = den(S) / gcd(den S, |B|)`;
* `den_actual`         — `den(C_R) = den(S) / gcd(den S, |B_R|)`;
* `actual_integral_iff` — `C_R ∈ ℤ ↔ den(S) ∣ B_R`;
* `fixed_depth_compression` — a whole family of fixed-depth complement-minor integrality
  tests is equivalent to the single condition `den(S) ∣ gcd_R B_R`;
* `fixed_depth_tests_pass_at_two` / `fixed_depth_not_exact_mass` — every such test passes at
  `S = 2`, realised by the reciprocal set `{1,2,3,6}`; fixed depths **never** imply exact
  mass one.  The hierarchy is therefore **RETIRED** as a closure route.
* `target_integral` — the target-one substitute is always integral, and
  `integer_det_integral` — the determinant of an actual integer matrix is automatically
  integral; so no "non-integral principal minor" claim may be made about an integer matrix.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- Integer data of an affine minor `C = B·S + K`. -/
structure MinorData where
  /-- Slope (coefficient of the mass `S`). -/
  B : ℤ
  /-- Integer offset. -/
  K : ℤ

namespace MinorData

variable (m : MinorData)

/-- The actual quantity `C_R = B_R·S + K_R`. -/
def actual (S : ℚ) : ℚ := m.B * S + m.K

/-- The target-one substitute `D_R = B_R + K_R`. -/
def target : ℚ := m.B + m.K

/-- **`C_R − D_R = B_R (S − 1)`.** -/
theorem actual_sub_target (S : ℚ) : m.actual S - m.target = m.B * (S - 1) := by
  unfold actual target; ring

/-- The actual quantity agrees with the substitute exactly at `S = 1`, and in general
only when `B_R = 0` or `S = 1`. -/
theorem actual_eq_target_iff (S : ℚ) : m.actual S = m.target ↔ m.B = 0 ∨ S = 1 := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, actual_sub_target]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast h)
    · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]

end MinorData

/-- **Reduced denominator of an integer multiple.** `den(B·S) = den(S) / gcd(den S, |B|)`. -/
theorem den_intCast_mul (B : ℤ) (S : ℚ) :
    ((B : ℚ) * S).den = S.den / Nat.gcd S.den B.natAbs := by
  rw [Rat.mul_den]
  simp only [Rat.den_intCast, Rat.num_intCast, one_mul, Int.natAbs_mul]
  rw [Nat.Coprime.gcd_mul_right_cancel _ S.reduced, Nat.gcd_comm]

namespace MinorData

variable (m : MinorData)

/-- **`den(C_R) = den(S) / gcd(den(S), B_R)`.** -/
theorem den_actual (S : ℚ) : (m.actual S).den = S.den / Nat.gcd S.den m.B.natAbs := by
  unfold actual
  rw [Rat.add_intCast_den, den_intCast_mul]

/-- `d / gcd(d, b) = 1 ↔ d ∣ b` for `d > 0`. -/
theorem div_gcd_eq_one_iff {d b : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) : d / Nat.gcd d b = 1 ↔ d ∣ b := by
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd d b := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hd
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left d b)
    rw [h, one_mul] at h2
    rw [← Nat.gcd_eq_left_iff_dvd]
    exact h2
  · intro h
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_left h, Nat.div_self hd]

/-- **Integrality of the actual quantity:** `C_R ∈ ℤ ↔ den(S) ∣ B_R`. -/
theorem actual_integral_iff (S : ℚ) : (m.actual S).den = 1 ↔ (S.den : ℤ) ∣ m.B := by
  rw [den_actual, div_gcd_eq_one_iff S.den_pos, Int.natCast_dvd]

/-- The target-one substitute is always integral (so it carries no information). -/
theorem target_integral : m.target.den = 1 := by
  unfold target
  rw [Rat.add_intCast_den]; simp

end MinorData

/-- **Fixed-depth compression.**  A finite family of complement-minor integrality tests is
equivalent to the single denominator condition `den(S) ∣ gcd_R B_R`. -/
theorem fixed_depth_compression {ι : Type*} (F : Finset ι) (m : ι → MinorData) (S : ℚ) :
    (∀ i ∈ F, ((m i).actual S).den = 1) ↔ (S.den : ℤ) ∣ F.gcd (fun i => (m i).B) := by
  simp_rw [MinorData.actual_integral_iff]
  exact Finset.dvd_gcd_iff.symm

/-- Every fixed-depth integrality test passes at `S = 2`. -/
theorem fixed_depth_tests_pass_at_two (m : MinorData) : (m.actual 2).den = 1 := by
  rw [MinorData.actual_integral_iff]
  simp

/-- The reciprocal set `{1,2,3,6}` has mass `2`. -/
theorem mass_one_two_three_six : ∑ n ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 6} : Finset ℕ), (1 : ℚ) / n = 2 := by
  norm_num

/-- **Fixed depths do not imply exact mass one.**  The genuine reciprocal set `{1,2,3,6}`
passes every complement-minor integrality test, at every depth, yet its mass is `2 ≠ 1`. -/
theorem fixed_depth_not_exact_mass :
    ∃ A : Finset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ A, 0 < n) ∧
      (∀ m : MinorData, (m.actual (∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / n)).den = 1) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / n ≠ 1 := by
  refine ⟨{1, 2, 3, 6}, by decide, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m; rw [mass_one_two_three_six]; exact fixed_depth_tests_pass_at_two m
  · rw [mass_one_two_three_six]; norm_num

/-- **Actual integer-matrix determinants are automatically integral.**  For an integer
matrix, the determinant of its image in `ℚ` is the cast of an integer: a principal minor of
an integer matrix can never be "non-integral". -/
theorem integer_det_integral {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (X : Matrix n n ℤ) :
    ((Int.castRingHom ℚ).mapMatrix X).det = ((X.det : ℤ) : ℚ) ∧
      (((Int.castRingHom ℚ).mapMatrix X).det).den = 1 := by
  have h : ((Int.castRingHom ℚ).mapMatrix X).det = ((X.det : ℤ) : ℚ) :=
    (RingHom.map_det (Int.castRingHom ℚ) X).symm
  exact ⟨h, by rw [h]; simp⟩

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@END_FILE@@

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ProblemStatement
import RequestProject.Erdos287.TopLayer

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V71 → V87 bank: the formal counterexample model

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  Nothing in this subtree proves it.**

A *word* is a finite set `A` of distinct positive denominators contained in an interval
`[a, M]` whose two endpoints are selected and which has no two consecutive omissions
(gap-two / 2-syndetic).  An *exact word* additionally has reciprocal mass exactly one.

We keep the exact mass statement (`ExactWord`) strictly separate from the weaker surrogates
(`ValuationSurrogate`, see also `MinorRepair.lean`), and we prove that an exact word with
`a > 1` is literally the same thing as an `Erdos287Counterexample`
(`ExactWord.toCounterexample`, `ofCounterexample`).

Prime-adic data (all for an arbitrary base `p`, usually prime):

* `v p n = n.factorization p`  — the `p`-adic valuation;
* `maxVal W p = max_{n ∈ A} v p n` (the project-wide `topExp`);
* `P W p = p ^ maxVal`        — the maximal primary power;
* `Q W p = p ^ (1 + maxVal)`  — the primary ceiling;
* `carrier W p`               — the maximal carrier set (selected multiples of `P W p`),
  shown equal to the maximal primary layer `topLayer`;
* `qstar W` — the minimal ceiling `min_p Q_p` over primes;
* `row W q` / `selRow W q` — the complete prime-power row `{n ∈ [a,M] : q ∣ n}` and its
  selected part.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- A gap-two word on `[a, M]` with both endpoints selected. -/
structure Word where
  /-- The selected denominators. -/
  A : Finset ℕ
  /-- Left endpoint. -/
  a : ℕ
  /-- Right endpoint. -/
  M : ℕ
  /-- Denominators are positive. -/
  a_pos : 0 < a
  /-- Every selected denominator lies in `[a, M]`. -/
  sub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc a M
  /-- The left endpoint is selected. -/
  a_mem : a ∈ A
  /-- The right endpoint is selected. -/
  M_mem : M ∈ A
  /-- No two consecutive omissions inside `[a, M]`. -/
  gap : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ M → x ∈ A ∨ x + 1 ∈ A

/-- An exact word: a word with reciprocal mass exactly one. -/
structure ExactWord extends Word where
  /-- Exact reciprocal mass one. -/
  mass : ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1

namespace Word

variable (W : Word)

/-- Boolean selection `x_n`. -/
def x (n : ℕ) : Bool := decide (n ∈ W.A)

theorem x_eq_true_iff (n : ℕ) : W.x n = true ↔ n ∈ W.A := by simp [x]

/-- Reciprocal mass of the word. -/
def mass : ℚ := ∑ n ∈ W.A, (1 : ℚ) / n

/-- Window length `D = M - a`. -/
def D : ℕ := W.M - W.a

theorem a_le_M : W.a ≤ W.M := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (W.sub W.a_mem)).2

theorem mem_Icc {n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ W.A) : W.a ≤ n ∧ n ≤ W.M := Finset.mem_Icc.1 (W.sub h)

theorem pos_of_mem {n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ W.A) : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le W.a_pos (W.mem_Icc h).1

/-- The `p`-adic valuation. -/
def v (p n : ℕ) : ℕ := n.factorization p

/-- Maximal `p`-adic valuation over the word (the project-wide `topExp`). -/
def maxVal (p : ℕ) : ℕ := topExp W.A p

/-- Maximal primary power `P_p = p ^ maxVal`. -/
def P (p : ℕ) : ℕ := p ^ W.maxVal p

/-- Primary ceiling `Q_p = p ^ (1 + maxVal)`. -/
def Q (p : ℕ) : ℕ := p ^ (1 + W.maxVal p)

theorem Q_eq_mul (p : ℕ) : W.Q p = p * W.P p := by
  simp [Q, P, pow_add]

/-- The maximal primary layer `{n ∈ A : v_p n = maxVal}`. -/
def layer (p : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := topLayer W.A p

/-- The maximal carrier set: selected multiples of the maximal primary power. -/
def carrier (p : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := W.A.filter (fun n => W.P p ∣ n)

/-- A modulus is *absent* when it divides no selected denominator. -/
def Absent (d : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ n ∈ W.A, ¬ d ∣ n

/-- The complete `q`-row of the window. -/
def row (q : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc W.a W.M).filter (fun n => q ∣ n)

/-- The selected part of the `q`-row. -/
def selRow (q : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := W.A.filter (fun n => q ∣ n)

/-- The row of prime `p` is *active* when `p` divides some selected denominator. -/
def Active (p : ℕ) : Prop := 1 ≤ W.maxVal p

theorem selRow_subset_row (q : ℕ) : W.selRow q ⊆ W.row q := by
  intro n hn
  simp only [selRow, Finset.mem_filter] at hn
  simp only [row, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨W.sub hn.1, hn.2⟩

theorem v_le_maxVal {n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ W.A) (p : ℕ) : v p n ≤ W.maxVal p :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => Nat.factorization a p) h

/-- The maximal valuation is attained. -/
theorem exists_mem_v_eq_maxVal (p : ℕ) : ∃ n ∈ W.A, v p n = W.maxVal p := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup W.A ⟨W.a, W.a_mem⟩
    (fun a => Nat.factorization a p)
  exact ⟨n, hn, h.symm⟩

theorem layer_nonempty (p : ℕ) : (W.layer p).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := W.exists_mem_v_eq_maxVal p
  exact ⟨n, mem_topLayer.2 ⟨hn, h⟩⟩

/-- The primary ceiling is absent. -/
theorem Q_absent {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : W.Absent (W.Q p) := by
  intro n hn hdvd
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (W.pos_of_mem hn).ne'
  have := (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn0).1 hdvd
  have := W.v_le_maxVal hn p
  simp only [v] at this
  omega

/-- The maximal primary power divides an element of the maximal layer. -/
theorem P_dvd_of_mem_layer {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : W.P p ∣ n := by
  have h := mem_topLayer.1 hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (W.pos_of_mem h.1).ne'
  exact (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn0).2 (by simp [maxVal, h.2])

/-- The maximal carrier set coincides with the maximal primary layer. -/
theorem carrier_eq_layer {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : W.carrier p = W.layer p := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    simp only [carrier, Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (W.pos_of_mem hn.1).ne'
    have h1 := (hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn0).1 hn.2
    have h2 := W.v_le_maxVal hn.1 p
    exact mem_topLayer.2 ⟨hn.1, le_antisymm h2 h1⟩
  · intro hn
    simp only [carrier, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨(mem_topLayer.1 hn).1, W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp hn⟩

theorem one_lt_Q {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : 1 < W.Q p :=
  Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hp.one_lt

theorem P_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : 0 < W.P p := pow_pos hp.pos _

/-- If the row of `p` is inactive, the ceiling is `p` itself. -/
theorem Q_eq_self_of_not_active {p : ℕ} (h : ¬ W.Active p) : W.Q p = p := by
  simp [Active] at h
  simp [Q, h]

theorem le_P_of_active {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h : W.Active p) : p ≤ W.P p := by
  unfold P
  calc p = p ^ 1 := (pow_one p).symm
    _ ≤ p ^ W.maxVal p := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos h

/-! ## Minimal ceiling `q_*` -/

theorem exists_ceiling : ∃ q, ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ W.Q p = q := ⟨_, 2, Nat.prime_two, rfl⟩

open Classical in
/-- The minimal primary ceiling `q_* = min_{p prime} Q_p`. -/
noncomputable def qstar : ℕ := Nat.find W.exists_ceiling

theorem qstar_le {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : W.qstar ≤ W.Q p := by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' W.exists_ceiling ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

theorem qstar_spec : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ W.Q p = W.qstar := by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_spec W.exists_ceiling

theorem one_lt_qstar : 1 < W.qstar := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := W.qstar_spec
  rw [← h]; exact W.one_lt_Q hp

theorem qstar_absent : W.Absent W.qstar := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h⟩ := W.qstar_spec
  rw [← h]; exact W.Q_absent hp

/-- Every prime strictly below `q_*` has an active row. -/
theorem active_of_lt_qstar {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hlt : p < W.qstar) : W.Active p := by
  by_contra h
  have := W.qstar_le hp
  rw [W.Q_eq_self_of_not_active h] at this
  omega

/-! ## Forced omissions and forced neighbours (positional mechanism) -/

/-- An absent modulus forces every one of its multiples in the window to be omitted. -/
theorem forced_omitted {d y : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent d) (hy : d ∣ y) : y ∉ W.A :=
  fun h => hd y h hy

/-- An omitted position of the window is strictly interior. -/
theorem interior_of_omitted {y : ℕ} (hy : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M) (h : y ∉ W.A) :
    W.a < y ∧ y < W.M := by
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hy.1 ?_, lt_of_le_of_ne hy.2 ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl; exact h W.a_mem
  · rintro rfl; exact h W.M_mem

/-- Gap-two forces both neighbours of an omitted window position to be selected. -/
theorem neighbours_of_omitted {y : ℕ} (hy : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M) (h : y ∉ W.A) :
    y - 1 ∈ W.A ∧ y + 1 ∈ W.A := by
  have hi := W.interior_of_omitted hy h
  constructor
  · have := W.gap (y - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rcases this with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd (by rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)] at h1) h
  · have := W.gap y (by omega) (by omega)
    rcases this with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd h1 h
    · exact h1

/-- **Literal guard pattern** `(x_{y-1}, x_y, x_{y+1}) = (1,0,1)` at every multiple of an
absent modulus inside the window. -/
theorem guard_pattern {d y : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent d) (hdy : d ∣ y) (hy : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M) :
    W.x (y - 1) = true ∧ W.x y = false ∧ W.x (y + 1) = true := by
  have h := W.forced_omitted hd hdy
  have hn := W.neighbours_of_omitted hy h
  simp [x, h, hn.1, hn.2]

end Word

/-! ## Faithfulness of the model -/

namespace ExactWord

variable (W : ExactWord)

/-- An exact word with left endpoint `a > 1` is an Erdős #287 counterexample. -/
theorem toCounterexample (ha : 1 < W.a) : Erdos287Counterexample W.A where
  card_ge := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have hsub : W.A ⊆ {W.a} := by
      intro n hn
      have := Finset.card_le_one.1 (by omega) n hn W.a W.a_mem
      simp [this]
    have hle := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (f := fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℚ) / n) hsub
      (fun i _ _ => by positivity)
    rw [W.mass] at hle
    simp at hle
    have : (1 : ℚ) < W.a := by exact_mod_cast ha
    have : (W.a : ℚ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ this
    linarith
  one_lt := fun n hn => lt_of_lt_of_le ha (W.mem_Icc hn).1
  sum_one := W.mass
  gap_le_two := by
    intro n hn ⟨b, hb, hnb⟩
    have hbM := (W.mem_Icc hb).2
    by_cases h1 : n + 1 ∈ W.A
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · right
      have hn1 : n + 1 < W.M := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show n + 1 ≤ W.M by omega) with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (h ▸ W.M_mem) h1
      rcases W.gap (n + 1) (by have := (W.mem_Icc hn).1; omega) (by omega) with h2 | h2
      · exact absurd h2 h1
      · exact h2

end ExactWord

/-- Every Erdős #287 counterexample is an exact word on `[min A, max A]`. -/
noncomputable def ofCounterexample {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) :
    ExactWord where
  A := A
  a := A.min' h.nonempty
  M := A.max' h.nonempty
  a_pos := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (h.one_lt _ (Finset.min'_mem A h.nonempty))
  sub := fun _ hn => Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨Finset.min'_le _ _ hn, Finset.le_max' _ _ hn⟩
  a_mem := Finset.min'_mem _ _
  M_mem := Finset.max'_mem _ _
  gap := fun x hx hxM => h.toGap2CE.holes_isolated x hx hxM
  mass := h.sum_one

@[simp] theorem ofCounterexample_A {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) :
    (ofCounterexample h).A = A := rfl

theorem ofCounterexample_one_lt_a {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) :
    1 < (ofCounterexample h).a := h.one_lt _ (Finset.min'_mem A h.nonempty)

/-! ## Exact mass versus weaker surrogates -/

/-- A weaker *valuation surrogate* for exact mass at a finite set of primes `S`: the reduced
denominator of the reciprocal mass is coprime to every `p ∈ S`.  This is strictly weaker
than exact mass one (see `surrogate_not_exact` in `RegressionFixtures.lean`). -/
def ValuationSurrogate (A : Finset ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ S, ¬ p ∣ (∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / n).den

/-- Exact mass implies every valuation surrogate. -/
theorem exact_implies_surrogate {A : Finset ℕ} (h : ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 1) : ValuationSurrogate A S := by
  intro p hp
  rw [h]
  simpa using hS p hp

end Erdos287.PostV71V87
