@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=14603 sha256=dac1584b03908ab01a355f947bed6badd0a0d2097cf772e41b8c43cabda8f37d path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/Physical.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.RepairedRecurrence

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V86/V87 physical consequences

* `Word.card_internalMultiples_ge` — the window contains at least `⌊D/d⌋ − 1` interior
  multiples of `d`;
* `Word.guard_at_internal_qstar` — the literal pattern `(x_{y−1}, x_y, x_{y+1}) = (1,0,1)` at
  every interior multiple `y` of `q_*`;
* `Word.disjoint_guards`, `Word.exists_disjoint_guard_family` — pairwise-disjoint guard
  triples: at least `⌊D/(2 q_*)⌋ − 1` of them always, and `⌊D/q_*⌋ − 1` when `q_* ≥ 3`;
* `many_disjoint_guards` — combined with the repaired recurrence theorem: the number of
  pairwise-disjoint guard triples is `≥ c · log D log log D / log log log D − 2`;
* `Word.carrier_reserve` — for every non-exceptional prime `p` with `p² ≤ D`:
  `P_p ≥ p` and `P_p⁴ > D` (i.e. `P_p > D^{1/4}`); **no largeness condition is needed**, and
  only `P_p ≥ p` (not the unsupported strict `P_p > p`) is claimed;
* `Word.carrier_overlap_le_four` — under `M⁴ < (D+1)⁵` an element lies in at most four such
  carrier sets; `ExactWord.overlap_condition` shows the condition holds for exact words with
  `a > 1`, `M ≥ 34`;
* `ExactWord.carrier_union_lower` — `#E ≤ 2 · |⋃_{p ∈ E} carrier p|` for any finite set `E` of
  non-exceptional primes with `p² ≤ D`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- Pairwise coprime divisors: their product divides. -/
theorem prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime {s : Finset ℕ} (f : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ}
    (hcop : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a ≠ b → Nat.Coprime (f a) (f b)) (hd : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∣ n) :
    ∏ a ∈ s, f a ∣ n := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime (f a) (∏ b ∈ s, f b) := by
      refine Nat.Coprime.prod_right (fun b hb => ?_)
      exact hcop a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb)
        (fun h => ha (h ▸ hb))
    refine Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd h1 (hd a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) ?_
    exact ih (fun x hx y hy hxy => hcop x (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx) y
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hy) hxy) (fun x hx => hd x (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx))

/-- The guard triple centred at `y`. -/
def guardTriple (y : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := {y - 1, y, y + 1}

namespace Word

variable (W : Word)

/-- Interior multiples of `d` in the window. -/
def internalMultiples (d : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioo W.a W.M).filter (fun y => d ∣ y)

/-- **Count of interior multiples.**  `⌊D/d⌋ ≤ #(interior multiples of d) + 1`. -/
theorem card_internalMultiples_ge {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    W.D / d ≤ (W.internalMultiples d).card + 1 := by
  set k := W.D / d
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i => d * (W.a / d + i)) (Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro i _ j _ h
    simp only at h
    have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) h
    omega
  have hmaps : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1), d * (W.a / d + i) ∈ W.internalMultiples d := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hi1, hik⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hi
    simp only [internalMultiples, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioo]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩
    · have h1 := Nat.mod_add_div W.a d
      have h2 := Nat.mod_lt W.a (show d > 0 by omega)
      have h3 : d * i ≥ d := by nlinarith
      rw [mul_add]; omega
    · have h1 := Nat.mod_add_div W.a d
      have h4 : d * k ≤ W.D := Nat.mul_div_le _ _
      have h5 : d * i ≤ d * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hik
      have h6 : d * (k - 1) + d = d * k := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h0 | h0
        · omega
        · rw [← Nat.mul_succ]; congr 1; omega
      have h7 : W.D = W.M - W.a := rfl
      have := W.a_le_M
      rw [mul_add]; omega
  have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _
    (fun i hi => Finset.mem_coe.2 (hmaps i (Finset.mem_coe.1 hi))) hinj
  simp at this
  omega

/-- **Guard pattern at interior `q_*`-multiples.** -/
theorem guard_at_internal_qstar {y : ℕ} (hy : y ∈ W.internalMultiples W.qstar) :
    W.x (y - 1) = true ∧ W.x y = false ∧ W.x (y + 1) = true := by
  simp only [internalMultiples, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioo] at hy
  exact W.guard_pattern W.qstar_absent hy.2 ⟨hy.1.1.le, hy.1.2.le⟩

/-- Guard triples at distinct positive multiples of `d ≥ 3` are disjoint. -/
theorem disjoint_guards {d y y' : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hy : d ∣ y) (hy' : d ∣ y') (hne : y ≠ y')
    (h1 : 1 ≤ y) (h1' : 1 ≤ y') : Disjoint (guardTriple y) (guardTriple y') := by
  have hsep : y + 3 ≤ y' ∨ y' + 3 ≤ y := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · left
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hy' hy)
      omega
    · right
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_sub hy hy')
      omega
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro z hz hz'
  simp only [guardTriple, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz hz'
  omega

/-- Interior multiples are positive. -/
theorem pos_of_mem_internalMultiples {d y : ℕ} (hy : y ∈ W.internalMultiples d) : 1 ≤ y := by
  simp only [internalMultiples, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioo] at hy
  omega

/-- **Pairwise-disjoint guard triples.**  There is a family `Y` of interior `q_*`-multiples
whose guard triples are pairwise disjoint, with `⌊D/(2 q_*)⌋ ≤ |Y| + 1`; if `q_* ≥ 3` one may
take all interior multiples, with `⌊D/q_*⌋ ≤ |Y| + 1`. -/
theorem exists_disjoint_guard_family :
    ∃ Y ⊆ W.internalMultiples W.qstar,
      (Y : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint guardTriple ∧ W.D / (2 * W.qstar) ≤ Y.card + 1 ∧
      (3 ≤ W.qstar → W.D / W.qstar ≤ Y.card + 1) := by
  have hq := W.one_lt_qstar
  by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ W.qstar
  · refine ⟨W.internalMultiples W.qstar, Finset.Subset.refl _, ?_, ?_, fun _ => ?_⟩
    · intro y hy y' hy' hne
      have hd := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy)).2
      have hd' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy')).2
      exact disjoint_guards h3 hd hd' hne (W.pos_of_mem_internalMultiples hy)
        (W.pos_of_mem_internalMultiples hy')
    · exact le_trans (Nat.div_le_div_left (by omega) (by omega))
        (W.card_internalMultiples_ge (by omega))
    · exact W.card_internalMultiples_ge (by omega)
  · refine ⟨W.internalMultiples (2 * W.qstar), ?_, ?_, W.card_internalMultiples_ge (by omega),
      fun h => absurd h h3⟩
    · intro y hy
      simp only [internalMultiples, Finset.mem_filter] at hy ⊢
      exact ⟨hy.1, dvd_trans (dvd_mul_left _ _) hy.2⟩
    · intro y hy y' hy' hne
      have hd := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy)).2
      have hd' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy')).2
      exact disjoint_guards (by omega) hd hd' hne (W.pos_of_mem_internalMultiples hy)
        (W.pos_of_mem_internalMultiples hy')

/-! ## Carrier reserve -/

/-- **Carrier reserve (V86/V87).**  For every non-exceptional prime `p` with `p² ≤ D`:
`P_p ≥ p` and `P_p⁴ > D`.  No largeness assumption is needed; only `P_p ≥ p` is claimed. -/
theorem carrier_reserve {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpD : p * p ≤ W.D) (hne : ¬ W.Exceptional p) :
    p ≤ W.P p ∧ W.D < W.P p ^ 4 := by
  have hact : W.Active p := by
    by_contra h
    apply hne
    unfold Exceptional
    rw [W.Q_eq_self_of_not_active h]; exact hpD
  have hPp := W.le_P_of_active hp hact
  refine ⟨hPp, ?_⟩
  have hQ : W.D < W.Q p * W.Q p := by unfold Exceptional at hne; omega
  rw [W.Q_eq_mul] at hQ
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  by_cases h4 : W.D < p ^ 4
  · have : p ^ 4 ≤ W.P p ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hPp 4
    omega
  · push_neg at h4
    have h1 : (p * W.P p * (p * W.P p)) ^ 2 = p ^ 4 * W.P p ^ 4 := by ring
    have h2 : p ^ 4 * W.P p ^ 4 ≤ W.D * W.D := Nat.mul_le_mul h4 hc
    have h3 : (W.D + 1) * (W.D + 1) ≤ (p * W.P p * (p * W.P p)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul hQ hQ
    nlinarith

/-- Maximal primary powers of distinct primes are coprime. -/
theorem P_coprime {p r : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hr : r.Prime) (hpr : p ≠ r) :
    Nat.Coprime (W.P p) (W.P r) :=
  Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ ((Nat.coprime_primes hp hr).2 hpr)

/-- The finite set of non-exceptional primes `p` with `p² ≤ D`. -/
noncomputable def reservePrimes : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (W.D + 1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p * p ≤ W.D ∧ ¬ W.Exceptional p)

theorem mem_reservePrimes {p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ W.reservePrimes ↔ p.Prime ∧ p * p ≤ W.D ∧ ¬ W.Exceptional p := by
  unfold reservePrimes
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, h⟩
    have := h.1.two_le
    nlinarith [h.2.1]

/-- **At most four overlaps.**  If `M⁴ < (D+1)⁵`, every selected element lies in at most four
carrier sets of reserve primes. -/
theorem carrier_overlap_le_four (hMD : W.M ^ 4 < (W.D + 1) ^ 5) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ W.A) :
    (W.reservePrimes.filter (fun p => n ∈ W.carrier p)).card ≤ 4 := by
  set S := W.reservePrimes.filter (fun p => n ∈ W.carrier p)
  have hdvd : ∏ p ∈ S, W.P p ∣ n := by
    refine prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime _ (fun p hp r hr hpr => ?_) (fun p hp => ?_)
    · have hp' := (W.mem_reservePrimes.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).1).1
      have hr' := (W.mem_reservePrimes.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hr).1).1
      exact W.P_coprime hp' hr' hpr
    · have := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
      simp only [carrier, Finset.mem_filter] at this
      exact this.2
  have hle : ∏ p ∈ S, W.P p ≤ W.M :=
    le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (W.pos_of_mem hn) hdvd) (W.mem_Icc hn).2
  have hlow : (W.D + 1) ^ S.card ≤ (∏ p ∈ S, W.P p) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_pow, ← Finset.prod_const]
    refine Finset.prod_le_prod' (fun p hp => ?_)
    have h := W.mem_reservePrimes.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).1
    exact (W.carrier_reserve h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2).2
  have h4 : (∏ p ∈ S, W.P p) ^ 4 ≤ W.M ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hle 4
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h5 : (W.D + 1) ^ 5 ≤ (W.D + 1) ^ S.card := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hc
  omega

end Word

namespace ExactWord

variable (W : ExactWord)

/-- The overlap condition `M⁴ < (D+1)⁵` holds for exact words with `a > 1`, `M ≥ 34`. -/
theorem overlap_condition (ha : 1 < W.a) (hM : 34 ≤ W.M) : W.M ^ 4 < (W.D + 1) ^ 5 := by
  have hs := W.two_mul_a_add_two_le ha (by omega)
  have hMD : W.M ≤ 2 * W.D := by unfold Word.D; omega
  have hD : 16 ≤ W.D := by unfold Word.D; omega
  have h1 : W.M ^ 4 ≤ (2 * W.D) ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hMD 4
  have h2 : (2 * W.D) ^ 4 ≤ W.D ^ 5 := by
    calc (2 * W.D) ^ 4 = 16 * W.D ^ 4 := by ring
      _ ≤ W.D * W.D ^ 4 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hD
      _ = W.D ^ 5 := by ring
  have h3 : W.D ^ 5 < (W.D + 1) ^ 5 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (by omega) (by norm_num)
  omega

/-- **Carrier-union lower bound.**  For exact words with `a > 1`, `M ≥ 34`:
`#reservePrimes ≤ 2 · |⋃_{p} carrier p|`. -/
theorem carrier_union_lower (ha : 1 < W.a) (hM : 34 ≤ W.M) :
    W.reservePrimes.card ≤ 2 * (W.reservePrimes.biUnion W.carrier).card := by
  classical
  set E := W.reservePrimes
  set U := E.biUnion W.carrier
  have hcond := W.overlap_condition ha hM
  have hsum := Finset.sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow
    (fun p n => n ∈ W.carrier p) (s := E) (t := U)
  have habove : ∀ p ∈ E, Finset.bipartiteAbove (fun p n => n ∈ W.carrier p) U p = W.carrier p := by
    intro p hp
    ext n
    simp only [Finset.bipartiteAbove, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · exact fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨p, hp, h⟩, h⟩
  have hlow : 2 * E.card ≤ ∑ p ∈ E, (W.carrier p).card := by
    rw [mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul]
    refine Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ _ (fun p hp => ?_)
    have h := W.mem_reservePrimes.1 hp
    have hres := W.toWord.carrier_reserve h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2
    have hact : W.Active p := by
      by_contra hc
      have := W.le_P_of_active h.1
      unfold Word.Active at hc
      push_neg at hc
      have hP : W.P p = 1 := by unfold Word.P; rw [show W.maxVal p = 0 by omega]; simp
      have := h.1.two_le
      omega
    rw [W.carrier_eq_layer h.1]
    simpa using W.two_le_layer_card h.1 hact
  have hup : ∑ n ∈ U, (Finset.bipartiteBelow (fun p n => n ∈ W.carrier p) E n).card ≤ 4 * U.card := by
    rw [mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ (fun n hn => ?_)
    obtain ⟨p, -, hpn⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hn
    have hnA : n ∈ W.A := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hpn).1
    have := W.toWord.carrier_overlap_le_four hcond hnA
    simpa [Finset.bipartiteBelow] using this
  have hcongr : ∑ p ∈ E, (Finset.bipartiteAbove (fun p n => n ∈ W.carrier p) U p).card =
      ∑ p ∈ E, (W.carrier p).card := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => by rw [habove p hp])
  omega

end ExactWord

/-- **Many disjoint guard triples (V87 consequence).**  There are `c > 0` and `M0` such that
every exact word with `a > 1`, `M ≥ M0` has a family of pairwise-disjoint guard triples, all
centred at interior multiples of `q_*`, of size at least
`c · log D · log log D / log log log D − 2`. -/
theorem many_disjoint_guards :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M →
      ∃ Y ⊆ W.internalMultiples W.qstar, (Y : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint guardTriple ∧
        (∀ y ∈ Y, W.x (y - 1) = true ∧ W.x y = false ∧ W.x (y + 1) = true) ∧
        c * gRec (Real.log W.D) ≤ (Y.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, M0, hrec⟩ := repaired_recurrence
  refine ⟨c / 2, by positivity, M0, fun W ha hM => ?_⟩
  have hq1 := W.one_lt_qstar
  obtain ⟨Y, hY, hdisj, hcount, -⟩ := W.exists_disjoint_guard_family
  refine ⟨Y, hY, hdisj, fun y hy => W.guard_at_internal_qstar (hY hy), ?_⟩
  have h1 := hrec W ha hM
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < W.qstar := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < W.qstar by have := W.one_lt_qstar; omega)
  have h2 : (W.D : ℝ) / (2 * W.qstar) - 1 ≤ (W.D / (2 * W.qstar) : ℕ) := by
    have := Nat.lt_div_mul_add (a := W.D) (show 0 < 2 * W.qstar by omega)
    have h3 : (W.D : ℝ) < (W.D / (2 * W.qstar) : ℕ) * (2 * W.qstar) + 2 * W.qstar := by
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [sub_le_iff_le_add, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have h4 : ((W.D / (2 * W.qstar) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y.card + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hcount
  have h5 : (W.D : ℝ) / (2 * W.qstar) = ((W.D : ℝ) / W.qstar) / 2 := by
    field_simp
  rw [h5] at h2
  have : c / 2 * gRec (Real.log W.D) = (c * gRec (Real.log W.D)) / 2 := by ring
  rw [this]
  linarith

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=9168 sha256=123499b84f9b3f02d66b6d5e366de49c47963cd0f4b45ba57dbe70ab799280a5 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/Positional.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Model

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V84/V85 positional bank (exact, unconditional part)

The positional implication pattern

  absent modulus → forced omitted position → gap-two forced neighbour
    → singleton / conditioned prime-row rejection

is formalised here for exact words.  Everything in this file is **unconditional**
(no analytic input).  The analytic prime-supply deductions are in
`AnalyticProviders.lean`, behind explicit hypotheses.

Main results:

* `ExactWord.two_le_layer_card` — an active maximal primary layer has at least two elements
  (from the project's `topLayer_card_ne_one`);
* `ExactWord.P_le_D` — an active maximal primary power is at most `D = M - a`;
* `ExactWord.prime_le_D_of_active` — every active prime is at most `D`;
* `ExactWord.Q_two_le_D` — the dyadic ceiling satisfies `Q_2 ≤ M - a` (for `a > 1`);
* `ExactWord.not_active_of_lt_two_mul` — singleton prime-row rejection: a prime `ℓ` with
  `M < 2ℓ` has an empty row;
* `ExactWord.conditioned_row_rejection` — a layer that can contain at most one selected
  element cannot be the maximal layer;
* `ExactWord.positional_chain` — the full chain, ending in a contradiction.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

namespace ExactWord

variable (W : ExactWord)

theorem pos_of_mem' : ∀ n ∈ W.A, 0 < n := fun _ hn => W.pos_of_mem hn

/-- An active maximal primary layer is not a singleton. -/
theorem layer_card_ne_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) :
    (W.layer p).card ≠ 1 :=
  topLayer_card_ne_one W.A p hp W.pos_of_mem' W.mass hact

/-- An active maximal primary layer has at least two elements. -/
theorem two_le_layer_card {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) :
    2 ≤ (W.layer p).card := by
  have h1 := W.layer_card_ne_one hp hact
  have h2 := (W.layer_nonempty p).card_pos
  omega

/-- Two distinct elements of an active maximal layer. -/
theorem exists_two_in_layer {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) :
    ∃ n₁ ∈ W.layer p, ∃ n₂ ∈ W.layer p, n₁ < n₂ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 (W.two_le_layer_card hp hact)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxy with h | h
  · exact ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h⟩
  · exact ⟨y, hy, x, hx, h⟩

theorem mem_of_mem_layer {p n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ W.layer p) : n ∈ W.A :=
  (mem_topLayer.1 h).1

/-- An active maximal primary power is at most the window length `D = M - a`. -/
theorem P_le_D {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) : W.P p ≤ W.D := by
  obtain ⟨n₁, h₁, n₂, h₂, hlt⟩ := W.exists_two_in_layer hp hact
  have d₁ := W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp h₁
  have d₂ := W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp h₂
  have hd : W.P p ∣ n₂ - n₁ := Nat.dvd_sub d₂ d₁
  have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
  have m₁ := W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer h₁)
  have m₂ := W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer h₂)
  unfold Word.D
  omega

/-- Every active prime is at most `D`. -/
theorem prime_le_D_of_active {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) : p ≤ W.D :=
  le_trans (W.le_P_of_active hp hact) (W.P_le_D hp hact)

/-- Primes beyond the window length have empty rows. -/
theorem not_active_of_D_lt {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (h : W.D < p) : ¬ W.Active p :=
  fun hact => by have := W.prime_le_D_of_active hp hact; omega

/-- A selected element divisible by a prime makes that prime active. -/
theorem active_of_dvd {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ∈ W.A) (hd : p ∣ n) : W.Active p := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (W.pos_of_mem hn).ne'
  have h1 : 1 ≤ n.factorization p := (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hn0).1 hd
  exact le_trans h1 (W.v_le_maxVal hn p)

/-- Elements of an active maximal layer are divisible by the prime. -/
theorem prime_dvd_of_mem_layer {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p)
    (h : n ∈ W.layer p) : p ∣ n :=
  Nat.dvd_trans (by unfold Word.P; exact dvd_pow_self p (by unfold Word.Active at hact; omega))
    (W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp h)

/-- **Singleton prime-row rejection.**  A prime `ℓ` with `M < 2ℓ` has an empty row: the only
possible selected multiple would be `ℓ` itself, giving a singleton maximal layer. -/
theorem not_active_of_lt_two_mul {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (h : W.M < 2 * ℓ) :
    ¬ W.Active ℓ := by
  intro hact
  obtain ⟨n₁, h₁, n₂, h₂, hlt⟩ := W.exists_two_in_layer hℓ hact
  have d₁ := W.prime_dvd_of_mem_layer hℓ hact h₁
  have d₂ := W.prime_dvd_of_mem_layer hℓ hact h₂
  obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := d₁
  obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := d₂
  have m₁ := W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer h₁)
  have m₂ := W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer h₂)
  have p₁ := W.pos_of_mem (W.mem_of_mem_layer h₁)
  have hℓ2 := hℓ.two_le
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k₁ := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k₁ with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; simp at hk₁; omega
    · exact h0
  have hk2 : k₂ ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have : ℓ * 2 ≤ ℓ * k₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ℓ hc
    omega
  have : ℓ * k₁ < ℓ * k₂ := by omega
  have := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left this
  omega

/-- A prime `ℓ` with `M < 2ℓ` is never selected. -/
theorem prime_not_mem_of_lt_two_mul {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (h : W.M < 2 * ℓ) : ℓ ∉ W.A :=
  fun hm => W.not_active_of_lt_two_mul hℓ h (W.active_of_dvd hℓ hm (dvd_refl ℓ))

/-- **Conditioned prime-row rejection.**  If, for some `k ≥ 1`, every selected element of
exact `p`-adic valuation `k` lies in a set `T` with at most one element (e.g. because all
other candidate positions are forced omissions), then `k` is not the maximal valuation. -/
theorem conditioned_row_rejection {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (T : Finset ℕ)
    (hT : T.card ≤ 1) (hcover : ∀ n ∈ W.A, Word.v p n = k → n ∈ T) : W.maxVal p ≠ k := by
  intro hmax
  have hact : W.Active p := by unfold Word.Active; omega
  have hsub : W.layer p ⊆ T := by
    intro n hn
    have h := mem_topLayer.1 hn
    exact hcover n h.1 (by simp only [Word.v]; rw [h.2]; exact hmax)
  have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have := W.two_le_layer_card hp hact
  omega

/-- **Positional chain.**  Let `d` be an absent modulus and `y` a multiple of `d` in the
window.  Then `y` is omitted, both neighbours are selected, and therefore neither neighbour
can be a prime `ℓ` with `M < 2ℓ`. -/
theorem positional_chain {d y ℓ : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent d) (hdy : d ∣ y)
    (hy : W.a ≤ y ∧ y ≤ W.M) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓM : W.M < 2 * ℓ)
    (hl : ℓ + 1 = y ∨ ℓ = y + 1) : False := by
  have hom := W.forced_omitted hd hdy
  have hn := W.neighbours_of_omitted hy hom
  rcases hl with h | h
  · exact W.prime_not_mem_of_lt_two_mul hℓ hℓM (by
      have : ℓ = y - 1 := by omega
      rw [this]; exact hn.1)
  · exact W.prime_not_mem_of_lt_two_mul hℓ hℓM (h ▸ hn.2)

/-! ## The dyadic ceiling `Q_2 ≤ M - a` -/

/-- Two distinct odd multiples of `2^e` differ by at least `2^(e+1)`. -/
theorem two_pow_succ_le_sub {e n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (hlt : n₁ < n₂)
    (h₁ : n₁.factorization 2 = e) (h₂ : n₂.factorization 2 = e) (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) :
    2 ^ (e + 1) ≤ n₂ - n₁ := by
  have hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0 := by omega
  have e₁ := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self n₁ 2
  have e₂ := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self n₂ 2
  have o₁ := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hn₁
  have o₂ := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hn₂
  rw [h₁] at e₁ o₁
  rw [h₂] at e₂ o₂
  set m₁ := n₁ / 2 ^ e
  set m₂ := n₂ / 2 ^ e
  have hm : m₁ < m₂ := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have : 2 ^ e * m₂ ≤ 2 ^ e * m₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    omega
  have hev : 2 ∣ m₂ - m₁ := by omega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hev
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by omega
  have : n₂ - n₁ = 2 ^ e * (m₂ - m₁) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_sub, e₁, e₂]
  rw [this, ht, pow_succ]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)

/-- **`Q_2 ≤ M - a`.**  For an exact word with `a > 1` the dyadic primary ceiling is at most
the window length. -/
theorem Q_two_le_D (ha : 1 < W.a) : W.Q 2 ≤ W.D := by
  by_cases hact : W.Active 2
  · obtain ⟨n₁, h₁, n₂, h₂, hlt⟩ := W.exists_two_in_layer Nat.prime_two hact
    have l₁ := mem_topLayer.1 h₁
    have l₂ := mem_topLayer.1 h₂
    have := two_pow_succ_le_sub hlt l₁.2 l₂.2 (W.pos_of_mem l₁.1).ne'
    have m₁ := W.mem_Icc l₁.1
    have m₂ := W.mem_Icc l₂.1
    unfold Word.Q Word.D
    rw [add_comm]
    unfold Word.maxVal
    omega
  · rw [W.Q_eq_self_of_not_active hact]
    -- every selected element is odd; `a` and `M` are distinct odd numbers
    have hodd : ∀ n ∈ W.A, ¬ 2 ∣ n := fun n hn hd => hact (W.active_of_dvd Nat.prime_two hn hd)
    have hce := W.toCounterexample ha
    have hcard := hce.card_ge
    have hne : W.a ≠ W.M := by
      intro h
      have hsub : W.A ⊆ {W.a} := by
        intro n hn
        have := W.mem_Icc hn
        simp; omega
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      simp at this; omega
    have h1 := hodd _ W.a_mem
    have h2 := hodd _ W.M_mem
    have := W.a_le_M
    unfold Word.D
    omega

end ExactWord

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10588 sha256=8954515b1eec9259140ed6a0baa124e2b92ef7eab97519dd4f5f1a151ade199b path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/ReciprocalImage.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Model

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V87 reciprocal subset-sum image: definitions and the block decomposition

`S_rec(H) = |{ ∑_{j ∈ J} 1/j : J ⊆ [1, H] }|`.

Unconditional (elementary) results:

* `recipImage_card_le_two_pow` — `|Img(X)| ≤ 2^|X|`;
* `recipImage_union_card_le`  — `|Img(X ∪ Y)| ≤ |Img X| · |Img Y|` (sumset bound);
* `smoothPart`, `roughPart`  — the `y`-smooth / large-prime block decomposition of `[1,H]`;
* `roughPart_card_le`        — `|rough| ≤ ∑_{y < p ≤ H} ⌊H/p⌋` (large-prime blocks);
* `smoothImage_card_le`      — `|Img(smooth)| ≤ H · H^{π(y)} + 1`;
* `Srec_block_bound`         — **block decomposition bound**
  `S_rec(H) ≤ (H·H^{π(y)} + 1) · 2^{∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋}`;
* `recip_sum_num_le`         — the reduced numerator of any element of `Img([1,H])` is at
  most `H · H!`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- The reciprocal subset-sum image of a finite set `X`. -/
def recipImage (X : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℚ :=
  X.powerset.image (fun J : Finset ℕ => ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℚ) / (j : ℚ))

/-- `S_rec(H) = |Img([1, H])|`. -/
def Srec (H : ℕ) : ℕ := (recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 H)).card

theorem mem_recipImage {X : Finset ℕ} {σ : ℚ} :
    σ ∈ recipImage X ↔ ∃ J ⊆ X, ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℚ) / j = σ := by
  simp [recipImage]

theorem recipImage_card_le_two_pow (X : Finset ℕ) : (recipImage X).card ≤ 2 ^ X.card := by
  unfold recipImage
  exact le_trans Finset.card_image_le (by rw [Finset.card_powerset])

theorem Srec_pos (H : ℕ) : 0 < Srec H :=
  Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨0, mem_recipImage.2 ⟨∅, Finset.empty_subset _, by simp⟩⟩

/-- Sumset bound for the reciprocal image of a union. -/
theorem recipImage_union_card_le (X Y : Finset ℕ) :
    (recipImage (X ∪ Y)).card ≤ (recipImage X).card * (recipImage Y).card := by
  classical
  have hsub : recipImage (X ∪ Y) ⊆ Finset.image₂ (· + ·) (recipImage X) (recipImage Y) := by
    intro σ hσ
    obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := mem_recipImage.1 hσ
    refine Finset.mem_image₂.2 ⟨∑ j ∈ J ∩ X, (1 : ℚ) / j,
      mem_recipImage.2 ⟨J ∩ X, Finset.inter_subset_right, rfl⟩,
      ∑ j ∈ J \ X, (1 : ℚ) / j, mem_recipImage.2 ⟨J \ X, ?_, rfl⟩,
      Finset.sum_inter_add_sum_diff _ _ _⟩
    intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hj
    rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (hJ hj.1) with h | h
    · exact absurd h hj.2
    · exact h
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (Finset.card_image₂_le _ _ _)

theorem recipImage_mono {X Y : Finset ℕ} (h : X ⊆ Y) : recipImage X ⊆ recipImage Y := by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := mem_recipImage.1 hσ
  exact mem_recipImage.2 ⟨J, hJ.trans h, rfl⟩

/-! ## Smooth / large-prime decomposition -/

/-- The `y`-smooth part of `[1, H]`. -/
def smoothPart (y H : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 H).filter (fun n => ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ≤ y)

/-- The rough part: elements of `[1,H]` with a prime factor `> y`. -/
def roughPart (y H : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 H).filter (fun n => ¬ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ≤ y)

/-- The large primes `y < p ≤ H`. -/
def largePrimes (y H : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ioc y H).filter Nat.Prime

/-- The large-prime block sum `∑_{y < p ≤ H} ⌊H/p⌋`. -/
def blockSum (y H : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ p ∈ largePrimes y H, H / p

theorem Icc_eq_smooth_union_rough (y H : ℕ) :
    Finset.Icc 1 H = smoothPart y H ∪ roughPart y H := by
  unfold smoothPart roughPart
  rw [Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq]

/-- Multiples of `p` in `[1, H]` number `⌊H/p⌋`. -/
theorem card_multiples_Icc (H p : ℕ) : ((Finset.Icc 1 H).filter (fun n => p ∣ n)).card = H / p := by
  have : Finset.Icc 1 H = Finset.Ioc 0 H := by ext n; simp; omega
  rw [this]; exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div H p

/-- **Large-prime blocks.**  `|rough part| ≤ ∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋`. -/
theorem roughPart_card_le (y H : ℕ) : (roughPart y H).card ≤ blockSum y H := by
  classical
  have hsub : roughPart y H ⊆
      (largePrimes y H).biUnion (fun p => (Finset.Icc 1 H).filter (fun n => p ∣ n)) := by
    intro n hn
    simp only [roughPart, Finset.mem_filter, not_forall, not_le] at hn
    obtain ⟨hnI, p, hp, hpy⟩ := hn
    have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hn1 := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hnI
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨p, ?_, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hnI, hpd⟩⟩
    simp only [largePrimes, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc]
    exact ⟨⟨hpy, le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpd) hn1.2⟩, hpp⟩
  refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (le_trans Finset.card_biUnion_le ?_)
  unfold blockSum
  exact le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => card_multiples_Icc H p))

/-- The smooth modulus `P_y(H) = ∏_{p ≤ y} p^{⌊log_p H⌋}`. -/
def smoothModulus (y H : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ Nat.primesBelow (y + 1), p ^ Nat.log p H

theorem smoothModulus_pos (y H : ℕ) : 0 < smoothModulus y H :=
  Finset.prod_pos (fun _ hp => pow_pos (Nat.prime_of_mem_primesBelow hp).pos _)

/-- `P_y(H) ≤ H^{π(y)}` for `H ≥ 1`. -/
theorem smoothModulus_le (y H : ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) :
    smoothModulus y H ≤ H ^ Nat.primeCounting y := by
  unfold smoothModulus
  have hc : (Nat.primesBelow (y + 1)).card = Nat.primeCounting y := by
    rw [Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting']; rfl
  rw [← hc]
  exact Finset.prod_le_pow_card _ _ _ (fun p _ => Nat.pow_log_le_self p (by omega))

/-- Every `y`-smooth `n ≤ H` divides `P_y(H)`. -/
theorem dvd_smoothModulus {y H n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ smoothPart y H) : n ∣ smoothModulus y H := by
  simp only [smoothPart, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn
  obtain ⟨⟨hn1, hnH⟩, hsm⟩ := hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hn0]
  rw [Nat.prod_factorization_eq_prod_primeFactors]
  unfold smoothModulus
  have hsub : n.primeFactors ⊆ Nat.primesBelow (y + 1) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow]
    exact ⟨by have := hsm p hp; omega, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩
  refine dvd_trans (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ (fun p hp => ?_))
    (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ hsub)
  have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
  refine pow_dvd_pow p ?_
  have hle : p ^ n.factorization p ≤ H :=
    le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.ordProj_dvd n p)) hnH
  exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le hp.one_lt hle

/-- A subset sum over a set of divisors of `L` is `k / L` with `k ≤ |J| · L`. -/
theorem subset_sum_eq_div {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) {J : Finset ℕ} (hJ : ∀ j ∈ J, j ∣ L)
    (hJ0 : ∀ j ∈ J, 0 < j) :
    ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℚ) / j = ((∑ j ∈ J, L / j : ℕ) : ℚ) / L ∧ ∑ j ∈ J, L / j ≤ J.card * L := by
  constructor
  · rw [Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
    rw [Nat.cast_div (hJ j hj) (by have := hJ0 j hj; positivity)]
    have : (j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by have := hJ0 j hj; positivity
    have : (L : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  · calc ∑ j ∈ J, L / j ≤ ∑ _j ∈ J, L := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.div_le_self _ _)
      _ = J.card * L := by simp

/-- If every element of `X ⊆ [1, H]` divides `L > 0`, then `|Img X| ≤ H · L + 1`. -/
theorem recipImage_card_le_of_dvd {X : Finset ℕ} {H L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hX : X ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 H) (hdvd : ∀ n ∈ X, n ∣ L) :
    (recipImage X).card ≤ H * L + 1 := by
  have hsub : recipImage X ⊆ (Finset.range (H * L + 1)).image (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℚ) / L) := by
    intro σ hσ
    obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := mem_recipImage.1 hσ
    have hJ0 : ∀ j ∈ J, 0 < j := fun j hj => by have := Finset.mem_Icc.1 (hX (hJ hj)); omega
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := subset_sum_eq_div hL (fun j hj => hdvd j (hJ hj)) hJ0
    refine Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨∑ j ∈ J, L / j, Finset.mem_range.2 ?_, h1.symm⟩
    have hcard : J.card ≤ H := by
      have := Finset.card_le_card (hJ.trans hX); simp at this; omega
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L hcard
    omega
  exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (le_trans Finset.card_image_le (by simp))

/-- **Smooth image bound.**  `|Img(smooth part)| ≤ H · P_y(H) + 1`. -/
theorem smoothImage_card_le_modulus (y H : ℕ) :
    (recipImage (smoothPart y H)).card ≤ H * smoothModulus y H + 1 :=
  recipImage_card_le_of_dvd (smoothModulus_pos y H) (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    (fun _ hn => dvd_smoothModulus hn)

/-- `|Img(smooth part)| ≤ H · H^{π(y)} + 1`. -/
theorem smoothImage_card_le (y H : ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) :
    (recipImage (smoothPart y H)).card ≤ H * H ^ Nat.primeCounting y + 1 := by
  refine le_trans (smoothImage_card_le_modulus y H) ?_
  have := smoothModulus_le y H hH
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left H this
  omega

/-- **Block decomposition bound.**
`S_rec(H) ≤ (H · H^{π(y)} + 1) · 2^{∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋}`. -/
theorem Srec_block_bound (y H : ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) :
    Srec H ≤ (H * H ^ Nat.primeCounting y + 1) * 2 ^ blockSum y H := by
  unfold Srec
  rw [Icc_eq_smooth_union_rough y H]
  refine le_trans (recipImage_union_card_le _ _) (Nat.mul_le_mul (smoothImage_card_le y H hH) ?_)
  exact le_trans (recipImage_card_le_two_pow _) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
    (roughPart_card_le y H))

/-! ## Numerator bound -/

/-- The reduced numerator of a nonnegative element of `Img([1,H])` is at most `H · H!`. -/
theorem recip_sum_num_le {H : ℕ} {σ : ℚ} (hσ : σ ∈ recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 H)) :
    σ.num.natAbs ≤ H * H.factorial := by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ := mem_recipImage.1 hσ
  have hJ0 : ∀ j ∈ J, 0 < j := fun j hj => by have := Finset.mem_Icc.1 (hJ hj); omega
  have hdvd : ∀ j ∈ J, j ∣ H.factorial := fun j hj =>
    Nat.dvd_factorial (hJ0 j hj) (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (hJ hj)).2
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := subset_sum_eq_div (Nat.factorial_pos H) hdvd hJ0
  rw [h1]
  set k := ∑ j ∈ J, H.factorial / j
  have hk : k ≤ H * H.factorial := by
    have hc : J.card ≤ H := by
      have := Finset.card_le_card hJ; simp at this; omega
    exact le_trans h2 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc)
  have hnd : ((k : ℚ) / (H.factorial : ℚ)).num ∣ (k : ℤ) := by
    have := Rat.num_dvd (k : ℤ) (b := (H.factorial : ℤ))
      (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_pos H).ne')
    rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div] at this
    simpa using this
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0]; simp
  · have := Int.natAbs_le_of_dvd_ne_zero hnd (by exact_mod_cast hpos.ne')
    simp at this
    omega

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=12442 sha256=57f0f36172eab1bfb79968008280e1c1e1c280d54dad2fd1ca4fb8782b6aa83c path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/ReciprocalImageBound.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.ReciprocalImage
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.AnalyticToolkit

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V87: `log S_rec(H) ≪ H log log H / log H`

From the block decomposition (`Srec_block_bound`) and Chebyshev's upper bound (imported from
Mathlib, `chebyshev_upper`) we prove, with no further analytic input,

  `log S_rec(H) ≤ C · H · log log H / log H`   for all `H ≥ H0`   (`log_Srec_le`).

Steps:

* `blockSum_le_sum_primeCounting` — `∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋ ≤ ∑_{m ≤ H/(y+1)} π(⌊H/m⌋)`
  (count pairs `(p, m)` with `pm ≤ H`);
* `blockSum_real_le` — `∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋ ≤ C_π H (1 + log ⌊H/(y+1)⌋) / log y`;
* `log_Srec_le_explicit` — `log S_rec(H) ≤ (π(y) + 2) log H + ∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋`;
* `log_Srec_le` — the asymptotic bound, with `y = ⌊H / log H⌋`.
-/

open Real
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- Double counting of the large-prime blocks. -/
theorem blockSum_le_sum_primeCounting (y H : ℕ) :
    blockSum y H ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H / (y + 1)), Nat.primeCounting (H / m) := by
  classical
  set L := H / (y + 1)
  have h1 : ∀ p ∈ largePrimes y H,
      H / p = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, if m * p ≤ H then 1 else 0 := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [largePrimes, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    have hp0 : 0 < p := by omega
    rw [Finset.sum_boole]
    have : (Finset.Icc 1 L).filter (fun m => m * p ≤ H) = Finset.Icc 1 (H / p) := by
      ext m
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h3⟩; exact ⟨h1, (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hp0).2 h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        refine ⟨⟨h1, le_trans h2 (Nat.div_le_div_left (by omega) (by omega))⟩, ?_⟩
        exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hp0).1 h2
    rw [this]; simp
  unfold blockSum
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_boole]
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1
  have hsub : (largePrimes y H).filter (fun p => m * p ≤ H) ⊆ Nat.primesBelow (H / m + 1) := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [largePrimes, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc] at hp
    rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow]
    refine ⟨?_, hp.1.2⟩
    have : p ≤ H / m := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hp.2)
    omega
  have hc : (Nat.primesBelow (H / m + 1)).card = Nat.primeCounting (H / m) := by
    rw [Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting']; rfl
  simpa [hc] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

/-- Real form of the block bound. -/
theorem blockSum_real_le {X0 : ℝ} (hX0 : 2 ≤ X0)
    (hcheb : ∀ x : ℝ, X0 ≤ x → (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ Cpi * x / Real.log x)
    {y H : ℕ} (hy : X0 ≤ y) :
    (blockSum y H : ℝ) ≤ Cpi * H * (1 + Real.log ((H / (y + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / Real.log y := by
  have hy2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ y := le_trans hX0 hy
  have hlogy : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hCH : 0 ≤ Cpi * (H : ℝ) / Real.log y :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg Cpi_pos.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hlogy.le
  have hstep : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H / (y + 1)),
      (Nat.primeCounting (H / m) : ℝ) ≤ Cpi * H / Real.log y * (1 / (m : ℝ)) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨hm1, hmL⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm
    have hmy : m * (y + 1) ≤ H := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).1 hmL
    have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm1
    have hmy' : ((y : ℝ) + 1) * m ≤ H := by
      have : ((m * (y + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ H := by exact_mod_cast hmy
      push_cast at this; linarith
    have hx : (y : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (H : ℝ) / m := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hmpos]; exact hmy'
    have hfl : ⌊(H : ℝ) / m⌋₊ = H / m := Nat.floor_div_eq_div H m
    have h1 := hcheb ((H : ℝ) / m) (by linarith)
    rw [hfl] at h1
    have hlog : Real.log y ≤ Real.log ((H : ℝ) / m) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    calc (Nat.primeCounting (H / m) : ℝ) ≤ Cpi * ((H : ℝ) / m) / Real.log ((H : ℝ) / m) := h1
      _ ≤ Cpi * ((H : ℝ) / m) / Real.log y :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg Cpi_pos.le (by positivity)) hlogy hlog
      _ = Cpi * H / Real.log y * (1 / (m : ℝ)) := by field_simp
  calc (blockSum y H : ℝ) ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H / (y + 1)), (Nat.primeCounting (H / m) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast blockSum_le_sum_primeCounting y H
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (H / (y + 1)), Cpi * H / Real.log y * (1 / (m : ℝ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hstep
    _ = Cpi * H / Real.log y * (harmonic (H / (y + 1)) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc]; push_cast; simp [one_div]
    _ ≤ Cpi * H / Real.log y * (1 + Real.log ((H / (y + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (harmonic_le_one_add_log _) hCH
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Explicit form: `log S_rec(H) ≤ (π(y) + 2) log H + ∑_{y<p≤H} ⌊H/p⌋` for `H ≥ 2`. -/
theorem log_Srec_le_explicit (y H : ℕ) (hH : 2 ≤ H) :
    Real.log (Srec H) ≤ ((Nat.primeCounting y : ℝ) + 2) * Real.log H + blockSum y H := by
  have hb := Srec_block_bound y H (by omega)
  have h1 : H * H ^ Nat.primeCounting y + 1 ≤ H ^ (Nat.primeCounting y + 2) := by
    have hp : 1 ≤ H * H ^ Nat.primeCounting y := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
    have : H ^ (Nat.primeCounting y + 2) = H * (H * H ^ Nat.primeCounting y) := by ring
    rw [this]; nlinarith
  have h2 : Srec H ≤ H ^ (Nat.primeCounting y + 2) * 2 ^ blockSum y H :=
    le_trans hb (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1)
  have h3 : (Srec H : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) ^ (Nat.primeCounting y + 2) * 2 ^ blockSum y H := by
    exact_mod_cast h2
  have hS : (0 : ℝ) < Srec H := by exact_mod_cast Srec_pos H
  have hH0 : (0 : ℝ) < H := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < H by omega)
  have h4 := Real.log_le_log hS h3
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow] at h4
  have hl2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; linarith
  have hB : (blockSum y H : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ blockSum y H := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ blockSum y H := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  push_cast at h4
  linarith

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
/-- **V87 reciprocal-image entropy bound.**
`log S_rec(H) ≤ C · H · log log H / log H` for all `H ≥ H0`. -/
theorem log_Srec_le :
    ∃ C H0 : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ H : ℕ, H0 ≤ H →
      Real.log (Srec H) ≤ C * H * Real.log (Real.log H) / Real.log H := by
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0, hcheb⟩ := chebyshev_upper
  refine ⟨6 * Cpi + 2, max 4096 (X0 ^ 2), by linarith [Cpi_pos], ?_⟩
  intro H hH
  have h4096 : (4096 : ℝ) ≤ H := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hH
  have hX : X0 ^ 2 ≤ (H : ℝ) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hH
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < H := by linarith
  have hH2 : 2 ≤ H := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ H := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  set s := (H : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) with hsdef
  have hs4 : s ^ 4 = H := rpow_quarter_pow_four hpos.le
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = Real.sqrt H := rpow_quarter_sq hpos.le
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.rpow_nonneg hpos.le _
  have hs8 : 8 ≤ s := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have : s ^ 4 < 8 ^ 4 := by
      have := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc hs0 (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0); exact this
    norm_num at this; linarith
  set lH := Real.log H with hlHdef
  have hlH : lH ≤ 4 * s := log_le_four_rpow hpos.le
  have hexp3 : Real.exp 3 ≤ (H : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : Real.exp 3 = Real.exp 1 ^ 3 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
    have h2 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have h3 : Real.exp 1 ^ 3 < 2.7182818286 ^ 3 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ h2 (Real.exp_pos 1).le (by norm_num)
    rw [h1]; nlinarith
  have hlH3 : 3 ≤ lH := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).2 hexp3
  have hlHpos : 0 < lH := by linarith
  clear_value s lH
  -- the cut `y = ⌊H / log H⌋`
  set y : ℕ := ⌊(H : ℝ) / lH⌋₊ with hydef
  have hy_le : (y : ℝ) ≤ H / lH := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hy_gt : (H : ℝ) / lH < y + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  clear_value y
  have hhl : 2 * s ^ 2 ≤ (H : ℝ) / lH := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hlHpos]
    have : 2 * s ^ 2 * lH ≤ 2 * s ^ 2 * (4 * s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlH (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hys : s ^ 2 ≤ y := by nlinarith
  have hsqX : X0 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    rw [hs2]
    calc X0 = Real.sqrt (X0 ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt H := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hX
  have hyX : X0 ≤ y := le_trans hsqX hys
  have hy2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ y := le_trans hX0 hyX
  have hlogy : lH / 2 ≤ Real.log y := by
    have h1 : Real.log (s ^ 2) ≤ Real.log y := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hys
    have h2 : lH = Real.log (s ^ 4) := by rw [hs4]; exact hlHdef
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h1 h2
    push_cast at h1 h2
    linarith
  have hlogypos : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  -- `π(y) log H ≤ 2 C_π H / log H`
  set u := (H : ℝ) / lH with hudef
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by positivity
  have hu_eq : u * lH = H := by rw [hudef]; field_simp
  clear_value u
  have hpi : (Nat.primeCounting y : ℝ) ≤ Cpi * y / Real.log y := by
    have := hcheb y hyX; rwa [Nat.floor_natCast] at this
  have F1 : (Nat.primeCounting y : ℝ) * lH ≤ 2 * Cpi * u := by
    have h1 : Cpi * y / Real.log y ≤ Cpi * u / (lH / 2) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlogypos (by positivity)]
      have := mul_le_mul hy_le hlogy (by positivity) hu0
      nlinarith [Cpi_pos]
    have h2 : Cpi * u / (lH / 2) * lH = 2 * Cpi * u := by field_simp
    nlinarith
  -- block sum
  set L := H / (y + 1) with hLdef
  have hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ lH := by
    have h1 : (L : ℝ) ≤ (H : ℝ) / ((y : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have := Nat.cast_div_le (α := ℝ) (m := H) (n := y + 1); push_cast at this; exact this
    have h2 : (H : ℝ) / ((y : ℝ) + 1) ≤ lH := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hy_gt hlHpos
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hlogL : Real.log L ≤ Real.log lH := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos L with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]; simp; exact Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    · exact Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast h0) hL
  set ll := Real.log lH with hlldef
  have hll1 : 1 ≤ ll := by
    rw [hlldef, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hlHpos]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  clear_value ll L
  have hB := blockSum_real_le hX0 hcheb (y := y) (H := H) hyX
  rw [← hLdef] at hB
  have F2 : (blockSum y H : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Cpi * u * (1 + ll) := by
    have h1 : Cpi * H * (1 + Real.log L) / Real.log y ≤ Cpi * H * (1 + ll) / (lH / 2) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlogypos (by positivity)]
      have hA : 0 ≤ Cpi * (H : ℝ) := mul_nonneg Cpi_pos.le hpos.le
      have := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : 1 + Real.log L ≤ 1 + ll) hA)
        hlogy (by positivity) (mul_nonneg hA (by linarith))
      linarith
    have h2 : Cpi * H * (1 + ll) / (lH / 2) = 2 * Cpi * u * (1 + ll) := by
      rw [hudef]; field_simp
    linarith
  have F3 : lH ≤ u := by
    have h1 : lH * lH ≤ (4 * s) * (4 * s) := mul_le_mul hlH hlH hlHpos.le (by positivity)
    have h16 : (16 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8) hs8 2; norm_num at this; linarith
    have h2 : (4 * s) * (4 * s) ≤ s ^ 4 := by
      have : (4 * s) * (4 * s) = 16 * s ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this]
      have : s ^ 4 = s ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h16 (by positivity)
    have hlHH : lH * lH ≤ u * lH := by
      rw [hu_eq]; exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 (le_of_eq hs4))
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hlHH hlHpos
  have hE := log_Srec_le_explicit y H hH2
  rw [← hlHdef] at hE
  have hgoal : (6 * Cpi + 2) * H * ll / lH = (6 * Cpi + 2) * (u * ll) := by
    rw [← hu_eq, div_eq_iff hlHpos.ne']; ring
  rw [hgoal]
  have hul : u * 1 ≤ u * ll := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hll1 hu0
  have hc1 : Cpi * (u * 1) ≤ Cpi * (u * ll) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hul Cpi_pos.le
  have hexp : ((Nat.primeCounting y : ℝ) + 2) * lH = (Nat.primeCounting y : ℝ) * lH + 2 * lH := by
    ring
  have hF2 : 2 * Cpi * u * (1 + ll) = 2 * (Cpi * (u * 1)) + 2 * (Cpi * (u * ll)) := by ring
  have hR : (6 * Cpi + 2) * (u * ll) = 6 * (Cpi * (u * ll)) + 2 * (u * ll) := by ring
  have hF1 : 2 * Cpi * u = 2 * (Cpi * (u * 1)) := by ring
  rw [hR]
  rw [hexp] at hE
  rw [hF2] at F2
  rw [hF1] at F1
  linarith

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4887 sha256=1ce5dbed075f7cc5644bd70d2f5e8022cb99f163419162b15708215c18f829ea path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/RecurrenceGrowth.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.AnalyticToolkit

/-!
# Erdős #287 — the recurrence growth function `g(L) = L log L / log log L`

Elementary real-analysis facts about `gRec L = L · log L / log log L` used by the repaired
V87 recurrence theorem:

* `gRec_mono`     — monotone on `[e^e, ∞)`;
* `gRec_half`     — `g(x/2) ≥ g(x)/4` for `x ≥ e^{2e}`;
* `gRec_le_sq`    — `g(x) ≤ x²` for `x ≥ e^e`;
* `gRec_nonneg`.
-/

open Real

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- `g(L) = L · log L / log log L`. -/
noncomputable def gRec (L : ℝ) : ℝ := L * Real.log L / Real.log (Real.log L)

/-- `u / log u` is monotone on `[e, ∞)`. -/
theorem div_log_mono {u v : ℝ} (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    u / Real.log u ≤ v / Real.log v := by
  have hv : Real.exp 1 ≤ v := le_trans hu huv
  have hupos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hu
  have hvpos : 0 < v := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hv
  have hlu : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hupos]; exact hu
  have hlv : 1 ≤ Real.log v := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hvpos]; exact hv
  have h := Real.log_div_self_antitoneOn hu hv huv
  simp only at h
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hvpos hupos] at h
  linarith

theorem log_ge_e_of {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x) : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x := by
  rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx)]; exact hx

theorem gRec_eq (x : ℝ) : gRec x = x * (Real.log x / Real.log (Real.log x)) := by
  unfold gRec; ring

theorem gRec_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x) : 0 ≤ gRec x := by
  have h1 := log_ge_e_of hx
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
  have hl : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
  have hll : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hl]; exact h1
  unfold gRec; positivity

/-- `g` is monotone on `[e^e, ∞)`. -/
theorem gRec_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) : gRec x ≤ gRec y := by
  have hy : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ y := le_trans hx hxy
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
  have h1 := log_ge_e_of hx
  have h2 : Real.log x ≤ Real.log y := Real.log_le_log hxpos hxy
  have hφ := div_log_mono h1 h2
  rw [gRec_eq, gRec_eq]
  have hl : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
  have hll : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hl]; exact h1
  have hφ0 : 0 ≤ Real.log x / Real.log (Real.log x) := by positivity
  exact mul_le_mul hxy hφ hφ0 (by linarith)

/-- `g(x) ≤ x²` for `x ≥ e^e`. -/
theorem gRec_le_sq {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x) : gRec x ≤ x ^ 2 := by
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
  have h1 := log_ge_e_of hx
  have hl : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
  have hll : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hl]; exact h1
  have hlx : Real.log x ≤ x := by have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hxpos; linarith
  rw [gRec_eq]
  have : Real.log x / Real.log (Real.log x) ≤ x := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; nlinarith
  calc x * (Real.log x / Real.log (Real.log x)) ≤ x * x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hxpos.le
    _ = x ^ 2 := by ring

/-- `g(x/2) ≥ g(x)/4` once `x ≥ e^{2e}`. -/
theorem gRec_half {x : ℝ} (hx : Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1) ≤ x) : gRec x / 4 ≤ gRec (x / 2) := by
  have he := Real.exp_pos 1
  have he1 : (1 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ); linarith
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
  set u := Real.log x with hudef
  have hu : 2 * Real.exp 1 ≤ u := by rw [hudef, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hxpos]; exact hx
  have hl2 : Real.log 2 < 1 := by have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; linarith
  have hlog2 : Real.log (x / 2) = u - Real.log 2 := Real.log_div hxpos.ne' (by norm_num)
  have hhalf : u / 2 ≤ Real.log (x / 2) := by rw [hlog2]; linarith
  have hu2e : Real.exp 1 ≤ u / 2 := by linarith
  have hφ1 := div_log_mono hu2e hhalf
  have hupos : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hlu2 : 0 < Real.log (u / 2) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlu2le : Real.log (u / 2) ≤ Real.log u := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hφ2 : (u / 2) / Real.log u ≤ (u / 2) / Real.log (u / 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hlu2 hlu2le
  have hlu : 0 < Real.log u := lt_of_lt_of_le hlu2 hlu2le
  rw [gRec_eq, gRec_eq, ← hudef]
  have hkey : u / Real.log u / 2 ≤ Real.log (x / 2) / Real.log (Real.log (x / 2)) := by
    have : u / Real.log u / 2 = (u / 2) / Real.log u := by ring
    linarith
  calc x * (u / Real.log u) / 4 = (x / 2) * (u / Real.log u / 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ (x / 2) * (Real.log (x / 2) / Real.log (Real.log (x / 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (by linarith)

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.Firewalls
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.MinorRepair

/-!
# Erdős #287 (post-V71 → V87) — negative / hostile regression fixtures

Each fixture is a kernel-checked witness that a tempting but invalid upgrade fails.

* `reg_dvd_ne_zero`             — `D ∣ X` must not be confused with `X = 0`.
* `reg_actual_ne_target`        — an actual principal minor `C_R = B_R·S + K_R` is not the
                                  target-one quantity `D_R = B_R + K_R` when `S ≠ 1`.
* `reg_surrogate_not_exact`     — fixed-depth minor / valuation surrogates do not imply exact
                                  mass one (`{1,2,3,6}` has mass `2`).
* `reg_pointwise_not_uniform`   — a pointwise ("for each fixed prime, eventually") statement
                                  does not upgrade to a uniform one without a provider.
* `reg_endpoint_second_branch`  — the second V86 alternative `M - a < de < 2a` really occurs
                                  (gap-two word `{10,11,13,14}`, `d = 3`, `e = 4`), so the CRT
                                  theorem cannot be strengthened to `de > M`.
* `reg_active_above_qstar`      — for the same word, `q_* = 3` but the prime `5 ∈ (q_*, 2q_*]`
                                  has an active row: an active/empty transition at `q_*` is not
                                  a structural consequence of the definitions.
* `reg_superlog_not_polylog`    — superlogarithmic recurrence holds automatically in every
                                  polylogarithmic window (re-export of
                                  `polylog_window_not_excluded`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- `D ∣ X` is not `X = 0`: with `D = 2`, `X = 2`. -/
theorem reg_dvd_ne_zero : ∃ D X : ℤ, D ∣ X ∧ X ≠ 0 ∧ D ≠ 1 :=
  ⟨2, 2, dvd_refl _, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩

/-- The actual minor and its target-one substitute differ as soon as `B ≠ 0`, `S ≠ 1`:
`B = 1, K = 0, S = 2` gives `C = 2`, `D = 1`. -/
theorem reg_actual_ne_target :
    (MinorData.mk 1 0).actual 2 ≠ (MinorData.mk 1 0).target := by
  simp [MinorData.actual, MinorData.target]

/-- Valuation surrogates (at every prime set) and all fixed-depth minor tests hold for
`{1,2,3,6}`, whose mass is `2 ≠ 1`. -/
theorem reg_surrogate_not_exact :
    (∀ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 1) → ValuationSurrogate {1, 2, 3, 6} S) ∧
      (∀ m : MinorData, (m.actual (∑ n ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 6} : Finset ℕ), (1 : ℚ) / n)).den = 1) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 6} : Finset ℕ), (1 : ℚ) / n ≠ 1 := by
  refine ⟨fun S hS p hp => ?_, fun m => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mass_one_two_three_six]
    simpa using hS p hp
  · rw [mass_one_two_three_six]; exact fixed_depth_tests_pass_at_two m
  · rw [mass_one_two_three_six]; norm_num

/-- Quantifier-swap fixture: "for every fixed `q`, eventually `q < X`" holds, while the
uniform statement "eventually, for every `q`, `q < X`" is false. -/
theorem reg_pointwise_not_uniform :
    (∀ q : ℕ, ∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ X, X0 ≤ X → q < X) ∧
      ¬ (∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ q X : ℕ, X0 ≤ X → q < X) := by
  refine ⟨fun q => ⟨q + 1, fun X hX => by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨X0, h⟩
  exact lt_irrefl _ (h X0 X0 le_rfl)

/-- The gap-two word `{10, 11, 13, 14}` on `[10, 14]`. -/
def fixtureWord : Word where
  A := {10, 11, 13, 14}
  a := 10
  M := 14
  a_pos := by norm_num
  sub := by decide
  a_mem := by decide
  M_mem := by decide
  gap := by
    intro x h1 h2
    have hx : x = 10 ∨ x = 11 ∨ x = 12 ∨ x = 13 := by
      have h1' : 10 ≤ x := h1
      have h2' : x + 1 ≤ 14 := h2
      omega
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

theorem fixtureWord_absent_three : fixtureWord.Absent 3 := by
  intro n hn
  simp only [fixtureWord, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
  rcases hn with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

theorem fixtureWord_absent_four : fixtureWord.Absent 4 := by
  intro n hn
  simp only [fixtureWord, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
  rcases hn with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

/-- **The second endpoint branch is realised.**  For coprime absent moduli `3, 4` of the
gap-two word `{10,11,13,14}`: `de = 12 ≤ M = 14`, while `M - a = 4 < 12 < 20 = 2a`. -/
theorem reg_endpoint_second_branch :
    Nat.Coprime 3 4 ∧ fixtureWord.Absent 3 ∧ fixtureWord.Absent 4 ∧
      ¬ fixtureWord.M < 3 * 4 ∧
      (fixtureWord.M - fixtureWord.a < 3 * 4 ∧ 3 * 4 < 2 * fixtureWord.a) :=
  ⟨by decide, fixtureWord_absent_three, fixtureWord_absent_four, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

theorem fixtureWord_not_active_three : ¬ fixtureWord.Active 3 := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hv⟩ := fixtureWord.exists_mem_v_eq_maxVal 3
  have h0 : Word.v 3 n = 0 :=
    Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (fixtureWord_absent_three n hn)
  unfold Word.Active at h
  omega

theorem fixtureWord_active_two : fixtureWord.Active 2 := by
  have h := fixtureWord.v_le_maxVal (n := 10) (by decide) 2
  have h10 : Word.v 2 10 = 1 := by
    have : (10 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 1 * 5 := by norm_num
    rw [Word.v, this, Nat.factorization_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
      Nat.Prime.factorization_pow Nat.prime_two]
    simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (show ¬ 2 ∣ 5 by decide)]
  unfold Word.Active
  omega

theorem fixtureWord_active_five : fixtureWord.Active 5 := by
  have h := fixtureWord.v_le_maxVal (n := 10) (by decide) 5
  have h10 : Word.v 5 10 = 1 := by
    have : (10 : ℕ) = 5 ^ 1 * 2 := by norm_num
    rw [Word.v, this, Nat.factorization_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
      Nat.Prime.factorization_pow Nat.prime_five]
    simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (show ¬ 5 ∣ 2 by decide)]
  unfold Word.Active
  omega

/-- For the fixture word the minimal ceiling is `q_* = 3`. -/
theorem fixtureWord_qstar : fixtureWord.qstar = 3 := by
  have hle : fixtureWord.qstar ≤ 3 := by
    have := fixtureWord.qstar_le Nat.prime_three
    rwa [fixtureWord.Q_eq_self_of_not_active fixtureWord_not_active_three] at this
  have hgt := fixtureWord.one_lt_qstar
  have hne : fixtureWord.qstar ≠ 2 := by
    intro h2
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hQ⟩ := fixtureWord.qstar_spec
    rw [h2] at hQ
    have hpd : p ∣ 2 := by
      rw [← hQ, Word.Q]; exact dvd_pow_self p (by omega)
    have hp2 : p = 2 := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).1 hpd
    subst hp2
    have h1 := fixtureWord_active_two
    unfold Word.Active at h1
    have : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (1 + fixtureWord.maxVal 2) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    rw [Word.Q] at hQ
    omega
  omega

/-- **High-shell extinction is not adjacent to `q_*`.**  In the fixture word, the prime
`5 ∈ (q_*, 2 q_*]` has an active row although `q_* = 3`. -/
theorem reg_active_above_qstar :
    fixtureWord.qstar = 3 ∧ (5 : ℕ).Prime ∧ fixtureWord.qstar < 5 ∧
      5 ≤ 2 * fixtureWord.qstar ∧ fixtureWord.Active 5 := by
  refine ⟨fixtureWord_qstar, Nat.prime_five, ?_, ?_, fixtureWord_active_five⟩ <;>
    rw [fixtureWord_qstar] <;> norm_num

/-- **Superlogarithmic recurrence ≠ closure of polylogarithmic terminal windows.** -/
theorem reg_superlog_not_polylog (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (B : ℕ) (hB : 2 ≤ B) :
    ∃ D0 : ℝ, ∀ D : ℝ, D0 ≤ D → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q ≤ D / Real.log D ^ B →
      c * gRec (Real.log D) ≤ D / q :=
  polylog_window_not_excluded c hc B hB

/-- **Non-vacuity of the exact-word model.**  The trivial exact word `{1}` exists (with
`a = 1`, so it is not an Erdős #287 counterexample). -/
def trivialExactWord : ExactWord where
  A := {1}
  a := 1
  M := 1
  a_pos := by norm_num
  sub := by decide
  a_mem := by decide
  M_mem := by decide
  gap := by intro x h1 h2; omega
  mass := by norm_num

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=15889 sha256=12630d19be58f0079f0d120fcb0f04d5bfb15781d7557332a9e0ab937d137e7c path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87/RepairedRecurrence.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.EntropyInversion
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.RecurrenceGrowth
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.AnalyticProviders

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V87 repaired recurrence theorem (Astra-repaired, two-case proof)

**Theorem (`repaired_recurrence`).**  There are an absolute constant `c > 0` and `M0` such
that every exact word with `a > 1` and `M ≥ M0` satisfies

  `(M - a) / q_*  ≥  c · log D · log log D / log log log D`,   `D = M - a`.

Proof (two cases, **no dependence on V85's `δ₀`**):

* if `q_*` is bounded or `q_* < √D`, then `D / q_* ≥ √D`, which dominates;
* otherwise the entropy inequality (`entropy_inequality`) and the reciprocal-image bound
  (`log_Srec_le`) give, by the inversion lemma `entropy_inversion`,
  `H = ⌊16M/q_*⌋ ≥ c · g(log q_*)`, and `log q_* ≥ ½ log D`.

All inputs are proved in this subtree from Mathlib (Chebyshev's upper bound is imported; the
lower bound is proved from the central binomial coefficient).  **No analytic provider is
assumed.**  This is the *superlogarithmic recurrence* of the minimal grid; it does **not**
close polylogarithmic terminal windows (see `Firewalls.lean`).
-/

open Real
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- `log S_rec(H) ≤ H` (trivial bound from `S_rec(H) ≤ 2^H`). -/
theorem log_Srec_le_self (H : ℕ) : Real.log (Srec H) ≤ H := by
  have h1 : Srec H ≤ 2 ^ H := by
    have := recipImage_card_le_two_pow (Finset.Icc 1 H); simpa [Srec] using this
  have h2 : (Srec H : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ H := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have h3 := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast Srec_pos H) h2
  rw [Real.log_pow] at h3
  have := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  have hH : (0 : ℝ) ≤ H := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith

theorem exp_exp_one_le_256 : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ 256 := by
  have h1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := by have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  have h2 : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ Real.exp 3 := Real.exp_le_exp.2 h1
  have h3 : Real.exp 3 = Real.exp 1 ^ 3 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
  have h4 : Real.exp 1 ^ 3 ≤ 3 ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos 1).le h1 3
  linarith

theorem log_ge_e_of_ge_256 {L : ℝ} (hL : 256 ≤ L) : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log L :=
  log_ge_e_of (le_trans exp_exp_one_le_256 hL)

theorem one_le_loglog {L : ℝ} (hL : 256 ≤ L) : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log L) := by
  have h := log_ge_e_of_ge_256 hL
  rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) h)]; exact h

theorem four_log_add_five_le {L : ℝ} (hL : 256 ≤ L) : 4 * Real.log L + 5 ≤ L / 2 := by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  set t := L ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
  have ht4 : t ^ 4 = L := rpow_quarter_pow_four hx0
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0 _
  have ht : 4 ≤ t := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have : t ^ 4 < 4 ^ 4 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc ht0 (by norm_num)
    norm_num at this; linarith
  have h1 := log_le_four_rpow hx0
  have h3 : (64 : ℝ) ≤ t ^ 3 := by
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) ht 3; norm_num at this; linarith
  have h4 : 64 * t ≤ t ^ 4 := by
    have : t ^ 4 = t ^ 3 * t := by ring
    rw [this]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 ht0
  linarith

theorem sqrt_le_div_sixteen {L : ℝ} (hL : 256 ≤ L) : Real.sqrt L ≤ L / 16 := by
  have h16 : 16 ≤ Real.sqrt L := by
    rw [show (16 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 256 by
      rw [show (256 : ℝ) = 16 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hL
  have := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ L by linarith)
  nlinarith

theorem log_sixteen_lt_three : Real.log 16 < 3 := by
  have : Real.log 16 = 4 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (16 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 4 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; linarith

/-- **Entropy inversion.**  If `F` satisfies the reciprocal-image bound
`F(H) ≤ C H log log H / log H` (for `H ≥ H0`) and `F(H) ≤ H`, then
`L ≤ log 16 + F(H) + 2 log(H + 1)` with `L ≥ L0` forces `H ≥ c · g(L)`. -/
theorem entropy_inversion {F : ℕ → ℝ} {C H0 : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C)
    (hF : ∀ H : ℕ, H0 ≤ H → F H ≤ C * H * Real.log (Real.log H) / Real.log H)
    (hFtriv : ∀ H : ℕ, F H ≤ H) :
    ∃ c L0 : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ c ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ (H : ℕ) (L : ℝ), L0 ≤ L → 1 ≤ H →
      L ≤ Real.log 16 + F H + 2 * Real.log ((H : ℝ) + 1) → c * gRec L ≤ H := by
  set c := 1 / (16 * (C + 1)) with hcdef
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := by rw [hcdef, div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  have hCc : C * c ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    rw [hcdef, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; linarith
  refine ⟨c, max 256 ((max H0 1) ^ 2), hc0, hc1, ?_⟩
  intro H L hL hH1 hineq
  by_contra hlt
  push_neg at hlt
  have hL256 : 256 ≤ L := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hL
  have hLH0 : (max H0 1) ^ 2 ≤ L := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hL
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hl16 := log_sixteen_lt_three
  have hlog1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → Real.log (x + 1) ≤ x := fun x hx => by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x + 1); linarith
  have hsq := sqrt_le_div_sixteen hL256
  by_cases hcase : (H : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt L
  · have h1 := hFtriv H
    have h2 := hlog1 H (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    linarith
  · push_neg at hcase
    have hsq16 : 16 ≤ Real.sqrt L := by
      rw [show (16 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 256 by

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

theorem two_e_le_exp_e : 2 * Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1) := by
  have h1 : Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1) = Real.exp (Real.exp 1) * Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := by
    have h3 := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.exp 1)
    have h4 := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  rw [h1]; nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (Real.exp 1)]

/-- `(log D)^2 ≤ √D` for `D ≥ 2^24`. -/
theorem log_sq_le_sqrt {D : ℝ} (hD : 2 ^ 24 ≤ D) : Real.log D ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt D := by
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by linarith
  set r := D ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ)
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := Real.rpow_nonneg hD0 _
  have hr8 : r ^ 8 = D := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hD0]; norm_num
  have hr4 : r ^ 4 = Real.sqrt D := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hD0, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]; norm_num
  have hr : 8 ≤ r := by
    by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
    have : r ^ 8 < 8 ^ 8 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc hr0 (by norm_num)
    norm_num at this; linarith
  have hlog : Real.log D ≤ 8 * r := by
    have := Real.log_le_rpow_div hD0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
    linarith [show r / (1 / 8) = 8 * r by ring]
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log D := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have h1 : Real.log D ^ 2 ≤ (8 * r) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlog0 hlog 2
  have h2 : (8 * r) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 4 := by
    have h64 : (64 : ℝ) ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8) hr 2; norm_num at this; linarith
    have : r ^ 4 = r ^ 2 * r ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this]; nlinarith
  rw [← hr4]; linarith

/-- **V87 repaired recurrence theorem.**  There are `c > 0` and `M0` such that every exact
word with `a > 1` and `M ≥ M0` satisfies
`(M - a)/q_* ≥ c · log D · log log D / log log log D` with `D = M - a`. -/
theorem repaired_recurrence :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M →
      c * gRec (Real.log W.D) ≤ (W.D : ℝ) / W.qstar := by
  obtain ⟨C, H0, hC, hS⟩ := log_Srec_le
  obtain ⟨c, L0, hc0, hc1, hinv⟩ :=
    entropy_inversion (F := fun H => Real.log (Srec H)) hC hS log_Srec_le_self
  obtain ⟨q0, hq0, hent⟩ := entropy_inequality
  set Q0 : ℝ := max (q0 : ℝ) (Real.exp L0) with hQ0
  set D0 : ℝ := max (max (2 ^ 24) (Real.exp (Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1)))) (Q0 ^ 2) with hD0
  refine ⟨c / 128, by positivity, ⌈2 * D0⌉₊ + 16, ?_⟩
  intro W ha hM
  have hM16 : 16 ≤ W.M := by omega
  have hs := W.two_mul_a_add_two_le ha hM16
  have hMD : W.M + 2 ≤ 2 * W.D := by unfold Word.D; omega
  have hqD : W.qstar ≤ W.D := le_trans (W.qstar_le Nat.prime_two) (W.Q_two_le_D ha)
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ W.qstar := W.one_lt_qstar
  have hDM : W.D ≤ W.M := Nat.sub_le _ _
  set q := W.qstar with hqdef
  set D := W.D with hDdef
  have hDr : D0 ≤ (D : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : 2 * D0 ≤ (W.M : ℝ) := by
      have := Nat.le_ceil (2 * D0)
      have h2 : ((⌈2 * D0⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ W.M := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : ⌈2 * D0⌉₊ ≤ W.M)
      linarith
    have h3 : (W.M : ℝ) + 2 ≤ 2 * D := by exact_mod_cast hMD
    linarith
  have hD24 : (2 : ℝ) ^ 24 ≤ D := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hDr
  have hDee : Real.exp (Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1)) ≤ D :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hDr
  have hDQ : Q0 ^ 2 ≤ (D : ℝ) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hDr
  have hDpos : (0 : ℝ) < D := by linarith [show (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ 24 by norm_num]
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
  set x := Real.log (D : ℝ) with hxdef
  have hx : Real.exp (2 * Real.exp 1) ≤ x := by
    rw [hxdef, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hDpos]; exact hDee
  have hxee : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x / 2 := by
    have := two_e_le_exp_e; linarith
  have hxe : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x := by have := Real.exp_pos (Real.exp 1); linarith
  have hgx0 : 0 ≤ gRec x := gRec_nonneg hxe
  have hgsqrt : gRec x ≤ Real.sqrt D := by
    have h1 := gRec_le_sq hxe
    have h2 := log_sq_le_sqrt hD24
    rw [← hxdef] at h2; linarith
  have hsqrtpos : 0 < Real.sqrt D := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDpos
  have hQ0sqrt : Q0 ≤ Real.sqrt D := by
    have hQ0pos : 0 ≤ Q0 := le_trans (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
    calc Q0 = Real.sqrt (Q0 ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq hQ0pos).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt D := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hDQ
  by_cases hcase : (q : ℝ) < Q0 ∨ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < D
  · -- small minimal ceiling: `D / q ≥ √D`
    have hqs : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt D := by
      rcases hcase with h | h
      · linarith
      · exact (Real.lt_sqrt hqpos.le).2 h |>.le
    have h1 : Real.sqrt D ≤ (D : ℝ) / q := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hqpos]
      calc Real.sqrt D * q ≤ Real.sqrt D * Real.sqrt D :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqs hsqrtpos.le
        _ = D := Real.mul_self_sqrt hDpos.le
    have h2 : c / 128 * gRec x ≤ gRec x := by
      have : c / 128 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith
    linarith
  · push_neg at hcase
    obtain ⟨hqQ, hqD2⟩ := hcase
    have hqq0 : q0 ≤ q := by
      have : (q0 : ℝ) ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hqQ
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hlq : L0 ≤ Real.log q := by
      rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hqpos]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hqQ
    have hE := hent W ha hqq0
    have hH1 : 1 ≤ 16 * W.M / q := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).2 (by omega)
    have hI := hinv (16 * W.M / q) (Real.log q) hlq hH1 hE
    -- `log q ≥ x / 2`
    have hlqx : x / 2 ≤ Real.log q := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hDpos hqD2
      rw [Real.log_pow] at this; push_cast at this; rw [← hxdef] at this; linarith
    have hg1 : gRec (x / 2) ≤ gRec (Real.log q) := gRec_mono hxee hlqx
    have hg2 : gRec x / 4 ≤ gRec (x / 2) := gRec_half hx
    have hH : ((16 * W.M / q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 32 * (D : ℝ) / q := by
      have h1 : ((16 * W.M / q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (16 * W.M : ℕ) / (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_div_le
      have h2 : ((16 * W.M : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 32 * (D : ℝ) := by
        have : (W.M : ℝ) + 2 ≤ 2 * D := by exact_mod_cast hMD
        push_cast; linarith
      calc ((16 * W.M / q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (16 * W.M : ℕ) / (q : ℝ) := h1
        _ ≤ 32 * (D : ℝ) / q := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 hqpos.le
    have hchain : c * (gRec x / 4) ≤ 32 * (D : ℝ) / q := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hg2 hg1) hc0.le
      linarith
    have : c / 128 * gRec x = c * (gRec x / 4) / 32 := by ring
    rw [this, div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    have e : (D : ℝ) / q * 32 = 32 * (D : ℝ) / q := by ring
    rw [e]; exact hchain

end Erdos287.PostV71V87

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.ReciprocalImage
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87.EndpointCRT

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V87 all-base shell fingerprint and the entropy core (unconditional)

**All-base shell fingerprint** (`shell_fingerprint`).  For every prime `p < q_*` the maximal
primary layer is genuinely active (`maxVal ≥ 1`, at least two elements), and its reciprocal
cofactor sum

  `σ_p = ∑_{n ∈ layer p} 1 / (n / P_p)`

has reduced numerator divisible by `p`.

**Entropy core** (`entropy_core`).  Fix `K ≥ 1` and put `q = q_*`, `H = ⌊K M / q⌋`.  Every
prime `p` with `q < K p` and `p < q` has all cofactors in `[1, H]`, so `σ_p` is a non-zero
element of the reciprocal image `Img([1,H])` whose numerator is divisible by `p`.  Hence

  `q ^ #P ≤ K ^ #P · (H · H!) ^ {S_rec(H)}`,   `P = {p prime : p < q < K p}`.

This is the purely arithmetic input of the V87 entropy inversion; the analytic part is in
`EntropyInversion.lean`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- If `∑ (f n)⁻¹ = 0` in `ZMod p` with every `f n` prime to `p`, then `p` divides the
reduced numerator of `∑ 1 / f n`. -/
theorem num_dvd_of_zmod_inv_sum {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (T : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ n ∈ T, ¬ p ∣ f n) (hsum : ∑ n ∈ T, ((f n : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ = 0) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ (∑ n ∈ T, (1 : ℚ) / (f n : ℚ)).num := by
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hf0 : ∀ n ∈ T, f n ≠ 0 := fun n hn h => hf n hn (h ▸ dvd_zero p)
  set L := ∏ n ∈ T, f n with hLdef
  have hLp : ¬ p ∣ L := by
    rw [Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime]
    rintro ⟨n, hn, h⟩; exact hf n hn h
  have hL0 : L ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 hf0
  have hdvd : ∀ n ∈ T, f n ∣ L := fun n hn => Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f hn
  set K := ∑ n ∈ T, L / f n with hKdef
  -- `σ · L = K`
  have hσ : (∑ n ∈ T, (1 : ℚ) / (f n : ℚ)) * L = K := by
    rw [hKdef, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => ?_)
    rw [Nat.cast_div (hdvd n hn) (by exact_mod_cast hf0 n hn)]
    have : (f n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hf0 n hn
    field_simp
  -- `p ∣ K`
  have hK : p ∣ K := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, hKdef, Nat.cast_sum]
    have : ∀ n ∈ T, ((L / f n : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (L : ZMod p) * ((f n : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
      intro n hn
      have hfn : ((f n : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]; exact hf n hn
      rw [Nat.cast_div (hdvd n hn) hfn, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum, mul_zero]
  -- transfer to the numerator
  set σ := ∑ n ∈ T, (1 : ℚ) / (f n : ℚ)
  have hnd : σ.num * (L : ℤ) = (K : ℤ) * σ.den := by
    have h1 : (σ.num : ℚ) / σ.den * L = K := by rw [Rat.num_div_den]; exact hσ
    have hd : (σ.den : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast σ.den_pos.ne'
    have h2 : (σ.num : ℚ) * L = K * σ.den := by field_simp at h1; linarith
    exact_mod_cast h2
  have h3 : (p : ℤ) ∣ σ.num * (L : ℤ) := by
    rw [hnd]; exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (by exact_mod_cast hK) _
  rcases (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.2 (by simpa using hp)).dvd_or_dvd h3 with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast h) hLp

namespace ExactWord

variable (W : ExactWord)

/-- The cofactor of a layer element: `n / P_p`. -/
def cof (p n : ℕ) : ℕ := n / W.P p

/-- The reciprocal cofactor sum of the maximal `p`-layer. -/
def sigma (p : ℕ) : ℚ := ∑ n ∈ W.layer p, (1 : ℚ) / (W.cof p n : ℚ)

theorem cof_eq_ordCompl {p n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : W.cof p n = ordCompl[p] n := by
  unfold cof Word.P
  rw [(mem_topLayer.1 hn).2]; rfl

theorem cof_mul {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : W.P p * W.cof p n = n :=
  Nat.mul_div_cancel' (W.P_dvd_of_mem_layer hp hn)

theorem cof_pos {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : 0 < W.cof p n := by
  have h1 := W.cof_mul hp hn
  have h2 := W.pos_of_mem (W.mem_of_mem_layer hn)
  refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => ?_)
  rw [h, mul_zero] at h1; omega

theorem not_dvd_cof {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : ¬ p ∣ W.cof p n := by
  rw [W.cof_eq_ordCompl hn]
  exact Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp (W.pos_of_mem (W.mem_of_mem_layer hn)).ne'

/-- **Fingerprint for an active prime.**  `p` divides the reduced numerator of `σ_p`. -/
theorem prime_dvd_sigma_num {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ (W.sigma p).num := by
  refine num_dvd_of_zmod_inv_sum hp (W.layer p) (W.cof p) (fun n hn => W.not_dvd_cof hp hn) ?_
  have := topLayer_congruence W.A p hp W.pos_of_mem' W.mass hact
  rw [← this]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => by rw [W.cof_eq_ordCompl hn])

theorem sigma_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : 0 < W.sigma p := by
  unfold sigma
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun n hn => by have := W.cof_pos hp hn; positivity) (W.layer_nonempty p)

/-- **All-base shell fingerprint.**  For every prime `p < q_*`: the row is active, the
maximal layer has at least two elements, and `p` divides the reduced numerator of the
reciprocal cofactor sum `σ_p`. -/
theorem shell_fingerprint {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hlt : p < W.qstar) :
    W.Active p ∧ 2 ≤ (W.layer p).card ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ (W.sigma p).num := by
  have hact := W.active_of_lt_qstar hp hlt
  exact ⟨hact, W.two_le_layer_card hp hact, W.prime_dvd_sigma_num hp hact⟩

/-- Cofactors are injective on a layer. -/
theorem cof_injOn {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Set.InjOn (W.cof p) (W.layer p : Set ℕ) := by
  intro n hn m hm h
  have h1 := W.cof_mul hp hn
  have h2 := W.cof_mul hp hm
  rw [← h1, ← h2, h]

/-- `σ_p` is an element of the reciprocal image of `[1, H]` as soon as `M ≤ H · P_p`… more
precisely as soon as every cofactor is at most `H`. -/
theorem sigma_mem_recipImage {p H : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hH : ∀ n ∈ W.layer p, W.cof p n ≤ H) : W.sigma p ∈ recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 H) := by
  classical
  refine mem_recipImage.2 ⟨(W.layer p).image (W.cof p), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m hm
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hm
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨W.cof_pos hp hn, hH n hn⟩
  · unfold sigma
    rw [Finset.sum_image (W.cof_injOn hp)]

/-- Cofactor bound in the top shell: if `p` is active, `q < K p`, then every cofactor is at
most `⌊K M / q⌋`. -/
theorem cof_le_shell {p K q n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hact : W.Active p) (hq0 : 0 < q)
    (hq : q < K * p) (hn : n ∈ W.layer p) : W.cof p n ≤ K * W.M / q := by
  have hpos := W.cof_pos hp hn
  have hmul := W.cof_mul hp hn
  have hPp := W.le_P_of_active hp hact
  have hnM := (W.mem_Icc (W.mem_of_mem_layer hn)).2
  have h1 : W.cof p n * p ≤ W.M := by
    calc W.cof p n * p ≤ W.cof p n * W.P p := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hPp
      _ = n := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hmul
      _ ≤ W.M := hnM
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)]
  calc W.cof p n * q ≤ W.cof p n * (K * p) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hq.le
    _ = K * (W.cof p n * p) := by ring
    _ ≤ K * W.M := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1

/-- The top-shell primes `{p prime : p < q_*, q_* < K p}`. -/
noncomputable def topShellPrimes (K : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range W.qstar).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ W.qstar < K * p)

/-- **Entropy core (divisibility form).**  The product of the top-shell primes divides the
product of the numerators of the non-zero elements of `Img([1, ⌊K M / q_*⌋])`. -/
theorem entropy_core_dvd (K : ℕ) :
    ∏ p ∈ W.topShellPrimes K, p ∣
      ∏ σ ∈ (recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 (K * W.M / W.qstar))).filter (· ≠ 0), σ.num.natAbs := by
  refine Finset.prod_primes_dvd _ (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p hp => ?_)
  · simp only [topShellPrimes, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    exact hp.2.1.prime
  · simp only [topShellPrimes, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    obtain ⟨hlt, hpp, hK⟩ := hp
    have hact := W.active_of_lt_qstar hpp hlt
    have hmem := W.sigma_mem_recipImage hpp (fun n hn => W.cof_le_shell hpp hact (by have := W.one_lt_qstar; omega) hK hn)
    have hne : W.sigma p ≠ 0 := (W.sigma_pos hpp).ne'
    have h1 : p ∣ (W.sigma p).num.natAbs := by
      have := W.prime_dvd_sigma_num hpp hact
      exact Int.natCast_dvd.1 this
    exact dvd_trans h1 (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hmem, hne⟩))

/-- **Entropy core (size form).**
`q_*^{#P} ≤ K^{#P} · (H · H!)^{S_rec(H)}` with `H = ⌊K M / q_*⌋ ≥ 1`. -/
theorem entropy_core (K : ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ K * W.M / W.qstar) :
    W.qstar ^ (W.topShellPrimes K).card ≤
      K ^ (W.topShellPrimes K).card *
        ((K * W.M / W.qstar) * (K * W.M / W.qstar).factorial) ^ Srec (K * W.M / W.qstar) := by
  set H := K * W.M / W.qstar
  set S := W.topShellPrimes K
  have hlow : W.qstar ^ S.card ≤ K ^ S.card * ∏ p ∈ S, p := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_const, ← Finset.prod_const, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_le_prod' (fun p hp => ?_)
    simp only [S, topShellPrimes, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    exact hp.2.2.le
  have hN : 0 < ∏ σ ∈ (recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 H)).filter (· ≠ 0), σ.num.natAbs :=
    Finset.prod_pos (fun σ hσ => by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hσ
      exact Int.natAbs_pos.2 (Rat.num_ne_zero.2 hσ.2))
  have hmid := Nat.le_of_dvd hN (W.entropy_core_dvd K)
  have hup : ∏ σ ∈ (recipImage (Finset.Icc 1 H)).filter (· ≠ 0), σ.num.natAbs ≤
      (H * H.factorial) ^ Srec H := by
    refine le_trans (Finset.prod_le_pow_card _ _ _ (fun σ hσ =>
      recip_sum_num_le (Finset.mem_filter.1 hσ).1)) ?_
    refine Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (Nat.factorial_pos H)) ?_
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  calc W.qstar ^ S.card ≤ K ^ S.card * ∏ p ∈ S, p := hlow
    _ ≤ K ^ S.card * (H * H.factorial) ^ Srec H :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (le_trans hmid hup)

end ExactWord

end Erdos287.PostV71V87
