@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=14493 sha256=ca6ce97b21369bf1b680425ba8c84a5b061edaa6217bb31e34036545fe88b988 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV10/Providers.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.HBSupportCoverage
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.RoughSeedIdentities
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIRescaling
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIRoughness
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIICompatibleCells
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIICoefficient

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §C: external analytic providers (no custom axioms)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Every genuinely analytic input is a `Prop`-valued **structure** (never an `axiom`).  No theorem
constructs any of them for a nontrivial error term: the only inhabitants in this bank are the
zero-error / zero-kernel models (`*_zero`), used to show the hypotheses are satisfiable.

* `LogPowerSaving f` — `∀ A > 0, ∃ C X₀, ∀ X ≥ X₀, |f X| ≤ C · X · (log X)^{-A}`;
* `ZhengKloostermanInput Kl κ` — `|Kl(c)| ≤ C_ε c^{κ+ε}`;
* `GeneralizedBVInput Δ` — log-power saving of a generalized BV error;
* `OrdinaryBVInput P E` — log-power saving of every box in the small-total-modulus region;
* `SiegelWalfiszSeedInput Δ` — the pointwise rough-seed SW bound (`RoughSeedSWProvider`);
* `SmoothTypeIInput P E Kl κ` — the (external) Type-I reduction: *spectral input + the exact
  Type-I combinatorics (`TypeICombinatorialFacts`: `e`-lattice count, Bonferroni sandwich) ⟹*
  log-power saving on the frozen Type-I region;
* `RestoredTypeIIInput P E Kl κ packets` — the (external) restored Type-II reduction: *spectral
  input + the compatible-cell count (`CompatibleCellFacts`) + the reciprocal phases of the packets
  (`ReciprocalPhaseFacts`) ⟹* log-power saving on the restored Type-II region.

The combinatorial premises are **proved** in this bank (`typeICombinatorialFacts_holds`,
`compatibleCellFacts_holds`, `reciprocalPhaseFacts_of_coprime`), so the analytic reductions are
visibly fed by kernel-checked finite inputs.

Proved here:
* closure of `LogPowerSaving` under `+` and finite sums, and `not_logPowerSaving_sq`;
* `seed_aggregate_of_SW` — the **elementary** aggregation of the pointwise SW seed bound over the
  `≤ (log X)^B` small moduli (a genuine, if easy, proof — no analytic input beyond the provider);
* **dependency checks** (`*_not_automatic`, `providers_not_from_frozen`): each provider is
  satisfiable (e.g. by the zero error) but is **false** for an explicit bad error/kernel, so no
  provider follows from combinatorial facts alone.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace Providers

open HBSelection HBSupportCoverage RoughSeedIdentities Real

/-- Log-power saving. -/
def LogPowerSaving (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C X₀ : ℝ, ∀ X : ℝ, X₀ ≤ X → |f X| ≤ C * X * Real.log X ^ (-A)

theorem logPowerSaving_zero : LogPowerSaving (fun _ => 0) :=
  fun _ _ => ⟨0, 0, fun X _ => by simp⟩

theorem logPowerSaving_add {f g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : LogPowerSaving f) (hg : LogPowerSaving g) :
    LogPowerSaving (fun X => f X + g X) := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨C₁, X₁, h₁⟩ := hf A hA
  obtain ⟨C₂, X₂, h₂⟩ := hg A hA
  refine ⟨C₁ + C₂, max X₁ X₂, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  have := h₁ X (le_of_max_le_left hX)
  have := h₂ X (le_of_max_le_right hX)
  calc |f X + g X| ≤ |f X| + |g X| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ C₁ * X * Real.log X ^ (-A) + C₂ * X * Real.log X ^ (-A) := by linarith
    _ = (C₁ + C₂) * X * Real.log X ^ (-A) := by ring

theorem logPowerSaving_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, LogPowerSaving (f i)) : LogPowerSaving (fun X => ∑ i ∈ s, f i X) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using logPowerSaving_zero
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    have h1 := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have h2 := ih (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    have := logPowerSaving_add h1 h2
    simpa [Finset.sum_insert ha] using this

/-- An explicit error with no log-power saving: `f(X) = X²`. -/
theorem not_logPowerSaving_sq : ¬ LogPowerSaving (fun X => X ^ 2) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨C, X₀, hC⟩ := h 1 one_pos
  set X : ℝ := max (max 3 (|C| + 3)) X₀
  have hX3 : 3 ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hXC : |C| + 3 ≤ X := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hX0 : X₀ ≤ X := le_max_right _ _
  have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log X := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  have h := hC X hX0
  rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at h
  have hinv : (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hlog
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ (Real.log X)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have : C * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ |C| * X := by
    calc C * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ |C| * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ := by
          gcongr; exact le_abs_self C
      _ ≤ |C| * X * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |C| * X := by ring
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg C]

/-! ## The provider structures -/

/-- **Zheng-type Kloosterman input** (external): `|Kl(c)| ≤ C_ε c^{κ+ε}`. -/
structure ZhengKloostermanInput (Kl : ℕ → ℝ) (κ : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ c : ℕ, 1 ≤ c → |Kl c| ≤ C * (c : ℝ) ^ (κ + ε)

/-- **Generalized BV input** (external). -/
structure GeneralizedBVInput (Δ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : LogPowerSaving Δ

/-- **Ordinary BV input** (external): log-power saving on the small-total-modulus region. -/
structure OrdinaryBVInput (P : CoverageParams) (E : SupportBox → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∀ b, InBV P b → LogPowerSaving (E b)

/-- **Siegel–Walfisz seed input** (external): the pointwise rough-seed SW bound. -/
structure SiegelWalfiszSeedInput (Δ : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  sw : RoughSeedSWProvider Δ

/-- The exact Type-I combinatorics consumed by the Type-I reduction (proved below). -/
def TypeICombinatorialFacts : Prop :=
  (∀ e X : ℕ, 0 < e →
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (e * X)).filter (fun v => e ∣ v)).card = X) ∧
  (∀ (z₀ L J m : ℕ), Odd J →
    TypeIRoughness.bonf (TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes z₀ L) J m ≤
        TypeIRoughness.roughInd (TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes z₀ L) m ∧
      TypeIRoughness.roughInd (TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes z₀ L) m ≤
        TypeIRoughness.bonf (TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes z₀ L) (J - 1) m)

theorem typeICombinatorialFacts_holds : TypeICombinatorialFacts :=
  ⟨fun _ X he => TypeIRescaling.lattice_card he X,
   fun _ _ _ m hJ => ⟨TypeIRoughness.lowerBonf_le TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes_prime hJ m,
     TypeIRoughness.le_upperBonf TypeIRoughness.allowedPrimes_prime hJ m⟩⟩

/-- The compatible-cell count consumed by the Type-II reduction (proved below). -/
def CompatibleCellFacts : Prop :=
  ∀ K d n₁ : ℕ, 0 < K → (TypeIICompatibleCells.compatibleAlpha K d n₁).card = d

theorem compatibleCellFacts_holds : CompatibleCellFacts :=
  fun _ d n₁ hK => TypeIICompatibleCells.compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d hK d n₁

/-- The reciprocal phases `ū (mod v)` of a finite set of Type-II packets. -/
def ReciprocalPhaseFacts (packets : Finset TypeIICoefficient.CoeffVars) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ packets, ∃ ubar : ℤ,
    (TypeIICoefficient.indexMap x).1 * ubar ≡ 1 [ZMOD (TypeIICoefficient.indexMap x).2.1]

/-- The packet coprimality (conductor/root/base) hypotheses. -/
def PacketCoprime (packets : Finset TypeIICoefficient.CoeffVars) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ packets, IsCoprime x.C x.q₂ ∧ IsCoprime x.q₁ x.q₂ ∧ IsCoprime x.n₂ x.q₂ ∧
    IsCoprime x.n₂' x.q₂

theorem reciprocalPhaseFacts_of_coprime {packets : Finset TypeIICoefficient.CoeffVars}
    (h : PacketCoprime packets) : ReciprocalPhaseFacts packets :=
  fun x hx => TypeIICoefficient.exists_reciprocal x (h x hx).1 (h x hx).2.1 (h x hx).2.2.1
    (h x hx).2.2.2

/-- **Smooth Type-I input** (external): the Type-I reduction, *relative to the explicit spectral
input* and the exact Type-I combinatorics. -/
structure SmoothTypeIInput (P : CoverageParams) (E : SupportBox → ℝ → ℝ) (Kl : ℕ → ℝ) (κ : ℝ) :
    Prop where
  reduction : ZhengKloostermanInput Kl κ → TypeICombinatorialFacts →
    ∀ b, InTypeI P b → LogPowerSaving (E b)

/-- **Restored Type-II input** (external): the restored compatible-cell Type-II reduction,
*relative to the explicit spectral input*, the compatible-cell count and the reciprocal phases. -/
structure RestoredTypeIIInput (P : CoverageParams) (E : SupportBox → ℝ → ℝ) (Kl : ℕ → ℝ) (κ : ℝ)
    (packets : Finset TypeIICoefficient.CoeffVars) : Prop where
  reduction : ZhengKloostermanInput Kl κ → CompatibleCellFacts → ReciprocalPhaseFacts packets →
    ∀ b, InTypeII P b → LogPowerSaving (E b)

/-! ## Elementary aggregation of the seed bound -/

/-- The aggregated seed error over the small moduli `q ≤ (log X)^B` (one residue `a(q)` each). -/
noncomputable def seedAggregate (Δ : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊, |Δ q (a q) X|

/-- **Aggregation**: the pointwise SW seed bound implies log-power saving of the aggregate over
`q ≤ (log X)^B`. -/
theorem seed_aggregate_of_SW {Δ : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ → ℝ} (hSW : SiegelWalfiszSeedInput Δ) (a : ℕ → ℤ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) : LogPowerSaving (seedAggregate Δ a B) := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hSW.sw.bound (A + B) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨|C|, 3, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log X := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log X := by linarith
  have hXpos : 0 < X := by linarith
  have hLB : 1 ≤ Real.log X ^ B := Real.one_le_rpow hlog hB
  have hLAB : Real.log X ^ B ≤ Real.log X ^ (A + B) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hlog (by linarith)
  unfold seedAggregate
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)]
  have hterm : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊,
      |Δ q (a q) X| ≤ |C| * X * Real.log X ^ (-(A + B)) := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.log X ^ (A + B) := by
      have h1 : q ≤ ⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊ := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).2
      have h2 : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.log X ^ B :=
        le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) (Nat.floor_le (by positivity))
      linarith
    refine (hC q (a q) X (by linarith) hq').trans ?_
    gcongr; exact le_abs_self C
  calc ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊, |Δ q (a q) X|
      ≤ ∑ _q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊, |C| * X * Real.log X ^ (-(A + B)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (⌊Real.log X ^ B⌋₊ : ℝ) * (|C| * X * Real.log X ^ (-(A + B))) := by simp
    _ ≤ Real.log X ^ B * (|C| * X * Real.log X ^ (-(A + B))) := by
        gcongr; exact Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
    _ = |C| * X * (Real.log X ^ B * Real.log X ^ (-(A + B))) := by ring
    _ = |C| * X * Real.log X ^ (-A) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hlogpos]; ring_nf

/-! ## Dependency checks: providers are not automatic -/

/-- A Case I box (`μ = 1`). -/
def boxI : SupportBox :=
  ⟨0, ⟨[(1, true)], by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩, 0, 0⟩

/-- A Case II box (factors `1/4, 3/4`, partial product `1/4`). -/
def boxII : SupportBox :=
  ⟨0, ⟨[(1 / 4, true), (3 / 4, true)], by simp, by
    intro x hx; simp at hx; rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num, by norm_num, by
    intro x hx; simp at hx; rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> simp⟩, 0, 0⟩

theorem boxI_typeI (P : CoverageParams) : InTypeI P boxI := by
  left; unfold CaseI maxSmooth; norm_num [boxI]

theorem boxII_typeII (P : CoverageParams) : InTypeII P boxII :=
  Or.inl ⟨1 / 4, ⟨[(1 / 4, true)], by simp [boxII], by simp⟩, by norm_num, le_rfl⟩

theorem boxI_BV (P : CoverageParams) : InBV P boxI := by
  unfold InBV; simp [boxI]; have := P.ζ_le; linarith

/-- The bad error `E(b, X) = X²`. -/
def badError : SupportBox → ℝ → ℝ := fun _ X => X ^ 2

theorem zheng_zero (κ : ℝ) : ZhengKloostermanInput (fun _ => 0) κ :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => ⟨0, fun c _ => by simp⟩⟩

/-- Zheng input is not automatic: `Kl(c) = c` with `κ = 0` violates it. -/
theorem zheng_not_automatic : ¬ ZhengKloostermanInput (fun c => (c : ℝ)) 0 := by
  intro ⟨h⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  set n : ℕ := ⌈|C|⌉₊ + 1
  have hn : |C| < n := by
    have := Nat.le_ceil |C|; push_cast [n]; linarith
  have h1 := hC (n ^ 2) (Nat.one_le_pow 2 n (by omega))
  have hsq : ((n ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((0 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) = n := by
    rw [zero_add, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]; push_cast; exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  rw [hsq, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at h1
  push_cast at h1
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by positivity
  have : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ |C| * n := h1.trans (by gcongr; exact le_abs_self C)
  nlinarith

theorem ordinaryBV_zero (P : CoverageParams) : OrdinaryBVInput P (fun _ _ => 0) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => logPowerSaving_zero⟩

theorem ordinaryBV_not_automatic (P : CoverageParams) : ¬ OrdinaryBVInput P badError :=
  fun h => not_logPowerSaving_sq (h.bound boxI (boxI_BV P))

theorem typeI_zero (P : CoverageParams) (Kl : ℕ → ℝ) (κ : ℝ) :
    SmoothTypeIInput P (fun _ _ => 0) Kl κ :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ => logPowerSaving_zero⟩

theorem typeI_not_automatic (P : CoverageParams) (κ : ℝ) :
    ¬ SmoothTypeIInput P badError (fun _ => 0) κ :=
  fun h => not_logPowerSaving_sq
    (h.reduction (zheng_zero κ) typeICombinatorialFacts_holds boxI (boxI_typeI P))

theorem typeII_zero (P : CoverageParams) (Kl : ℕ → ℝ) (κ : ℝ) (packets) :
    RestoredTypeIIInput P (fun _ _ => 0) Kl κ packets :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ => logPowerSaving_zero⟩

theorem typeII_not_automatic (P : CoverageParams) (κ : ℝ) :
    ¬ RestoredTypeIIInput P badError (fun _ => 0) κ ∅ :=
  fun h => not_logPowerSaving_sq (h.reduction (zheng_zero κ) compatibleCellFacts_holds
    (fun x hx => absurd hx (Finset.notMem_empty x)) boxII (boxII_typeII P))

theorem gbv_not_automatic : ¬ GeneralizedBVInput (fun X => X ^ 2) :=
  fun h => not_logPowerSaving_sq h.bound

theorem sw_not_automatic : ¬ SiegelWalfiszSeedInput (fun _ _ X => X ^ 2) :=
  fun h => roughSeedSW_not_automatic h.sw

end Providers
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8931 sha256=b78d48872f0bebb00667a3e852467b20fc9e70bf8174aad0002e955c60cfe5cb path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV10/RoughSeedIdentities.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §N: rough HB seed identities

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Exact Dirichlet-convolution identities (Mathlib `ArithmeticFunction` API):

* `rough_eq_zeta_mul` — `ρ_z = 1 ⋆ (μ · 1_{P⁺ ≤ z})`;
* `moebius_rough_eq` — `μ ρ_z = μ ⋆ 1_{P⁺ ≤ z}`;

where `ρ_z(n) = 1` iff every prime factor of `n` exceeds `z` (`z`-rough), and `1_{P⁺ ≤ z}(n) = 1`
iff every prime factor of `n` is `≤ z` (`z`-smooth).  Both sides are multiplicative and agree on
prime powers.

* `rankin_split` — the elementary Rankin inequality used to split small/large smooth divisors:
  `∑_{d ∈ S, d > Y} a_d ≤ Y^{-σ} ∑_{d ∈ S} a_d d^σ` for `a ≥ 0`, `σ ≥ 0`, `Y > 0`;
* `RoughSeedSWProvider` — the genuinely analytic Siegel–Walfisz-type estimate for the rough seed,
  an explicit **hypothesis structure** (never inhabited here; Siegel–Walfisz is not proved).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace RoughSeedIdentities

open ArithmeticFunction Finset

/-- Indicator of "`n ≠ 0` and every prime factor satisfies `P`". -/
def primeInd (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] : ArithmeticFunction ℤ :=
  ⟨fun n => if n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, P p then 1 else 0, by simp⟩

theorem primeInd_apply (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (n : ℕ) :
    primeInd P n = if n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, P p then 1 else 0 := rfl

/-- `1_{P⁺ ≤ z}`: the `z`-smooth indicator. -/
def smoothInd (z : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ := primeInd (· ≤ z)

/-- `ρ_z`: the `z`-rough indicator. -/
def roughInd (z : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℤ := primeInd (z < ·)

theorem primeInd_isMultiplicative (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (primeInd P).IsMultiplicative := by
  rw [IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨by simp [primeInd_apply], ?_⟩
  intro m n hm hn _
  have key : (m * n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ (m * n).primeFactors, P p) ↔
      (m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ m.primeFactors, P p) ∧ (n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, P p) := by
    rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hm hn]
    simp only [Finset.mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hm, fun p hp => h p (Or.inl hp)⟩, ⟨hn, fun p hp => h p (Or.inr hp)⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨-, h1⟩, ⟨-, h2⟩⟩
      exact ⟨mul_ne_zero hm hn, fun p hp => hp.elim (h1 p) (h2 p)⟩
  rw [primeInd_apply, primeInd_apply, primeInd_apply]
  by_cases h1 : m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ m.primeFactors, P p <;>
    by_cases h2 : n ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, P p
  · rw [if_pos (key.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩), if_pos h1, if_pos h2, mul_one]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h2 (key.1 h).2), if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h1 (key.1 h).1), if_neg h1, zero_mul]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h1 (key.1 h).1), if_neg h1, zero_mul]

theorem primeInd_prime_pow (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (i : ℕ) :
    primeInd P (p ^ i) = if i = 0 then 1 else if P p then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [primeInd_apply]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow hi.ne' hp]
    simp [hi.ne', hp.ne_zero]

theorem moebius_prime_pow_int {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (i : ℕ) :
    (moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) (p ^ i) = if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then -1 else 0 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi
  · simp
  · rw [if_neg hi.ne', moebius_apply_prime_pow hp hi.ne']

/-- **`ρ_z = 1 ⋆ (μ · 1_{P⁺ ≤ z})`.** -/
theorem rough_eq_zeta_mul (z : ℕ) :
    roughInd z = (zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) * (moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ).pmul (smoothInd z) := by
  refine (IsMultiplicative.eq_iff_eq_on_prime_powers _ (primeInd_isMultiplicative _) _
    (isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast.mul (isMultiplicative_moebius.pmul
      (primeInd_isMultiplicative _)))).2 ?_
  intro p i hp
  rw [coe_zeta_mul_apply, Nat.sum_divisors_prime_pow hp]
  simp only [pmul_apply, primeInd_prime_pow _ hp, moebius_prime_pow_int hp]
  rcases i with _ | m
  · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have h0 : ∀ j ∈ range m, (if j + 1 + 1 = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else if j + 1 + 1 = 1 then -1 else 0) *
        (if j + 1 + 1 = 0 then 1 else if p ≤ z then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
      intro j _; simp
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero h0]
    by_cases hz : p ≤ z
    · simp [hz]
    · simp [hz, not_le.1 hz]

/-- **`μ ρ_z = μ ⋆ 1_{P⁺ ≤ z}`.** -/
theorem moebius_rough_eq (z : ℕ) :
    (moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ).pmul (roughInd z) =
      (moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) * smoothInd z := by
  refine (IsMultiplicative.eq_iff_eq_on_prime_powers _
    (isMultiplicative_moebius.pmul (primeInd_isMultiplicative _)) _
    (isMultiplicative_moebius.mul (primeInd_isMultiplicative _))).2 ?_
  intro p i hp
  rw [mul_apply]
  erw [Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal (fun a b => (moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) a *
    smoothInd z b)]
  rw [Nat.sum_divisors_prime_pow hp]
  have hdiv : ∀ j ∈ range (i + 1), p ^ i / p ^ j = p ^ (i - j) := by
    intro j hj
    exact Nat.pow_div (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hj) hp.pos
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [hdiv j hj]]
  simp only [pmul_apply, smoothInd, primeInd_prime_pow _ hp, moebius_prime_pow_int hp]
  rcases i with _ | m
  · simp
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have h0 : ∀ j ∈ range m, (if j + 1 + 1 = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else if j + 1 + 1 = 1 then -1 else 0) *
        (if m + 1 - (j + 1 + 1) = 0 then 1 else if p ≤ z then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
      intro j _; simp
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero h0]
    rcases m with _ | m
    · by_cases hz : p ≤ z
      · simp [hz]
      · simp [hz, not_le.1 hz]
    · by_cases hz : p ≤ z
      · simp [hz]
      · simp [hz]

/-- **Rankin's elementary split**: `∑_{d ∈ S, d > Y} a_d ≤ Y^{-σ} ∑_{d ∈ S} a_d d^σ`. -/
theorem rankin_split (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ d, 0 ≤ a d) {Y σ : ℝ} (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) :
    ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d : ℕ => Y < (d : ℝ)), a d ≤ Y ^ (-σ) * ∑ d ∈ S, a d * (d : ℝ) ^ σ := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d : ℕ => Y < (d : ℝ)), a d
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ S.filter (fun d : ℕ => Y < (d : ℝ)), Y ^ (-σ) * (a d * (d : ℝ) ^ σ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun d hd => ?_
        have hYd : Y < d := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hd).2
        have h1 : 1 ≤ Y ^ (-σ) * (d : ℝ) ^ σ := by
          rw [Real.rpow_neg hY.le, ← div_eq_inv_mul, one_le_div (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hY σ)]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hY.le hYd.le hσ
        nlinarith [ha d]
    _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ S, Y ^ (-σ) * (a d * (d : ℝ) ^ σ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        intro d _ _
        have : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ σ := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d) σ
        have : 0 ≤ Y ^ (-σ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hY.le _
        have := ha d
        positivity

/-- **The rough-seed Siegel–Walfisz provider** (external, never inhabited here).  For the error
`Δ(q, a; X)` of the rough seed `μ ρ_z` in the progression `a (mod q)`, for every `A > 0` there is a
constant `C` such that `|Δ(q, a; X)| ≤ C · X (log X)^{-A}` for all `q ≤ (log X)^A`, `X ≥ 2`. -/
structure RoughSeedSWProvider (Δ : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ a : ℤ, ∀ X : ℝ, 2 ≤ X →
    (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.log X ^ A → |Δ q a X| ≤ C * X * Real.log X ^ (-A)

/-- The provider is not vacuous: the zero error satisfies it. -/
theorem roughSeedSW_zero : RoughSeedSWProvider (fun _ _ _ => 0) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => ⟨0, fun q a X _ _ => by simp⟩⟩

/-- The provider is not automatic: the error `Δ = X²` violates it. -/
theorem roughSeedSW_not_automatic : ¬ RoughSeedSWProvider (fun _ _ X => X ^ 2) := by
  intro ⟨h⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h 1 one_pos
  -- choose X large: X² > C X (log X)^{-1} fails for large X
  set X : ℝ := max 3 (|C| + 3) with hXdef
  have hX3 : 3 ≤ X := le_max_left _ _
  have hXC : |C| + 3 ≤ X := le_max_right _ _
  have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log X := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by linarith)]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  have hq : ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log X ^ (1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_one]; push_cast; linarith
  have h := hC 0 0 X (by linarith) hq
  rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at h
  have hX0 : 0 < X := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at h
  have hinv : (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hlog
  have : C * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ |C| * X := by
    calc C * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ ≤ |C| * X * (Real.log X)⁻¹ := by
          gcongr; exact le_abs_self C
      _ ≤ |C| * X * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |C| * X := by ring
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg C]

end RoughSeedIdentities
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5595 sha256=f11e1bc3b8c9e08f54e7eaac715fbb05985e89ffe66d5407ef3794811af841eb path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV10/TypeIGroupedCoefficient.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §F: the Type-I grouped-coefficient dependency contract

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

A semantic / type-level firewall.

* `CoeffIndex`, `SpectralIndex`, `OuterIndex` — three **distinct** index types (coefficient-side
  variables, later spectral variables, outer variables on which root/base factors may depend);
* `GroupedCoeff` — the trusted grouped Type-I coefficient: a function of `CoeffIndex` **only**,
  with the unit bound.  Its constructor `GroupedCoeff.ofCoeffSide` accepts only coefficient-side
  data; by its type it cannot receive a `SpectralIndex`;
* `GroupedCoeff.lift_spectral_invariant` — a grouped coefficient, viewed as a function of
  `(CoeffIndex, SpectralIndex)`, never depends on the spectral argument;
* `root_removed_in_abs` — a unimodular root/base factor depending only on the **outer** variable
  is removed inside the absolute value *before* the grouped coefficient is formed;
* `root_depending_on_inner_not_removable` — the same removal fails if the root factor depends on
  the inner (summed) variable (explicit numerical countermodel);
* `not_factorsThrough_of_depends` and `spectralDependent_fails_interface` — **negative fixture**:
  a coefficient that genuinely depends on a `SpectralIndex` does **not** inhabit the trusted
  `GroupedCoeff` interface.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIGroupedCoefficient

/-- Coefficient-side variables of the grouped Type-I coefficient. -/
structure CoeffIndex where
  /-- First coefficient-side variable. -/
  m : ℕ
  /-- Second coefficient-side variable. -/
  n : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Later spectral variables (e.g. the level `c` and the frequency `r`). -/
structure SpectralIndex where
  /-- The spectral level. -/
  c : ℕ
  /-- The spectral frequency. -/
  r : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Outer variables, on which root/base factors are allowed to depend. -/
structure OuterIndex where
  /-- The outer variable. -/
  x : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- **The trusted grouped Type-I coefficient**: a function of the coefficient-side index only,
bounded by `1`.  There is no field through which a `SpectralIndex` could enter. -/
structure GroupedCoeff where
  /-- The coefficient. -/
  coeff : CoeffIndex → ℂ
  /-- Unit bound. -/
  bound : ∀ i, ‖coeff i‖ ≤ 1

/-- The only constructor: coefficient-side data only. -/
def GroupedCoeff.ofCoeffSide (w : CoeffIndex → ℂ) (hw : ∀ i, ‖w i‖ ≤ 1) : GroupedCoeff :=
  ⟨w, hw⟩

/-- A grouped coefficient viewed on `(CoeffIndex, SpectralIndex)`. -/
def GroupedCoeff.lift (g : GroupedCoeff) : CoeffIndex → SpectralIndex → ℂ :=
  fun i _ => g.coeff i

/-- **Spectral invariance by construction.** -/
theorem GroupedCoeff.lift_spectral_invariant (g : GroupedCoeff) (i : CoeffIndex)
    (s s' : SpectralIndex) : g.lift i s = g.lift i s' := rfl

/-- A two-variable coefficient *inhabits the trusted interface* iff it is the lift of a
`GroupedCoeff`. -/
def FactorsThroughCoeff (f : CoeffIndex → SpectralIndex → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : GroupedCoeff, ∀ i s, f i s = g.coeff i

/-- Genuine dependence on a spectral variable. -/
def DependsOnSpectral (f : CoeffIndex → SpectralIndex → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i s s', f i s ≠ f i s'

/-- **Negative fixture (general)**: a coefficient depending on a spectral variable does not
inhabit the grouped-coefficient interface. -/
theorem not_factorsThrough_of_depends {f : CoeffIndex → SpectralIndex → ℂ}
    (h : DependsOnSpectral f) : ¬ FactorsThroughCoeff f := by
  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
  obtain ⟨i, s, s', hne⟩ := h
  exact hne ((hg i s).trans (hg i s').symm)

/-- The explicit spectral-dependent coefficient `f(i, s) = 1_{s.c = 0}`. -/
def spectralDependent : CoeffIndex → SpectralIndex → ℂ :=
  fun _ s => if s.c = 0 then 1 else 0

/-- **Negative fixture (explicit)**: `spectralDependent` fails the trusted interface. -/
theorem spectralDependent_fails_interface : ¬ FactorsThroughCoeff spectralDependent := by
  apply not_factorsThrough_of_depends
  refine ⟨⟨0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0⟩, ⟨1, 0⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [spectralDependent]

/-- Positive control: a coefficient-side function does inhabit the interface. -/
theorem coeffSide_inhabits (w : CoeffIndex → ℂ) (hw : ∀ i, ‖w i‖ ≤ 1) :
    FactorsThroughCoeff (fun i _ => w i) :=
  ⟨GroupedCoeff.ofCoeffSide w hw, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

/-- **Root/base factors are removed inside the absolute value**: a unimodular factor `ρ(o)`
depending only on the outer variable `o` drops out of `|∑_i ρ(o) a(i) K(i, s)|`, so the grouped
coefficient can be formed from `a` alone. -/
theorem root_removed_in_abs {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (ρ : OuterIndex → ℂ) (o : OuterIndex)
    (hρ : ‖ρ o‖ = 1) (a : ι → ℂ) (K : ι → SpectralIndex → ℂ) (s : SpectralIndex) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ I, ρ o * (a i * K i s)‖ = ‖∑ i ∈ I, a i * K i s‖ := by
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, norm_mul, hρ, one_mul]

/-- **Firewall**: if the root factor depends on the inner summation variable, it can **not** be
removed inside the absolute value (explicit countermodel with two inner terms). -/
theorem root_depending_on_inner_not_removable :
    ∃ (ρ : Fin 2 → ℂ) (a : Fin 2 → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖ρ i‖ = 1) ∧
      ‖∑ i, ρ i * a i‖ ≠ ‖∑ i, a i‖ := by
  refine ⟨![1, -1], ![1, 1], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp
  · simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]; norm_num

end TypeIGroupedCoefficient
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4795 sha256=238462274b245540d2d9c00bf431c400348db11c24e1ee7e51081c8835f4a0f0 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV10/TypeIICoefficient.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §H: the Type-II grouped coefficient

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The exact index map of the restored Type-II estimate

  `u = C q₁ n₂ n₂'`,  `v = q₂`,  `w = a k (h n₂' − h' n₂)`,

and the grouped coefficient defined **only on `(u, v, w)`**.

* `CoeffVars` — the coefficient-side packet variables `C, q₁, q₂, n₂, n₂', a, k, h, h'`;
  `SpectralVars` — the later spectral variables `c, r₁`, which are a **different type**;
* `indexMap` and `grouped S φ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ → ℂ` — the grouped coefficient is a fibre sum over the
  index map; its type contains neither `c` nor `r₁`;
* `grouped_factorization` — the construction factors through the triple: for every spectral
  kernel `F`, `∑_x φ(x) F(u(x), v(x), w(x); σ) = ∑_{(u,v,w)} G(u, v, w) F(u, v, w; σ)`;
* `u_coprime_v`, `exists_reciprocal` — the exact gcd / invertibility conditions: from the packet
  coprimality hypotheses `(C, q₂) = (q₁, q₂) = (n₂, q₂) = (n₂', q₂) = 1`, `gcd(u, v) = 1`, hence the
  reciprocal `ū (mod v)` needed for the reciprocal phase exists;
* `w_ne_zero_iff` — `w ≠ 0 ⟺ a ≠ 0 ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ h n₂' ≠ h' n₂`.

The Kloosterman-sum estimate itself stays external (`ZhengKloostermanInput` in `Providers`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIICoefficient

open Finset

/-- Coefficient-side packet variables. -/
structure CoeffVars where
  C : ℤ
  q₁ : ℤ
  q₂ : ℤ
  n₂ : ℤ
  n₂' : ℤ
  a : ℤ
  k : ℤ
  h : ℤ
  h' : ℤ
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The later spectral variables — a different type, never an argument of the coefficient. -/
structure SpectralVars where
  c : ℤ
  r₁ : ℤ
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The index map `(u, v, w)`. -/
def indexMap (x : CoeffVars) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ :=
  (x.C * x.q₁ * x.n₂ * x.n₂', x.q₂, x.a * x.k * (x.h * x.n₂' - x.h' * x.n₂))

/-- The grouped coefficient type: functions of `(u, v, w)` only. -/
abbrev GroupedCoeff2 := ℤ × ℤ × ℤ → ℂ

/-- The grouped coefficient: fibre sum of the packet weight over the index map. -/
noncomputable def grouped (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ) : GroupedCoeff2 :=
  fun t => ∑ x ∈ S.filter (fun x => indexMap x = t), φ x

/-- **Factorization through the triple.** -/
theorem grouped_factorization (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ)
    (F : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ → SpectralVars → ℂ) (σ : SpectralVars) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, φ x * F (indexMap x) σ = ∑ t ∈ S.image indexMap, grouped S φ t * F t σ := by
  unfold grouped
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := indexMap) (fun x hx => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2]

/-- A cleaner restatement: the grouped coefficient only sees `(u, v, w)`: two packets with the same
triple contribute to the same grouped value. -/
theorem grouped_depends_only_on_triple (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ)
    {x y : CoeffVars} (h : indexMap x = indexMap y) :
    grouped S φ (indexMap x) = grouped S φ (indexMap y) := by rw [h]

/-- **Coprimality of `u` and `v`** from the packet hypotheses. -/
theorem u_coprime_v (x : CoeffVars) (hC : IsCoprime x.C x.q₂) (h1 : IsCoprime x.q₁ x.q₂)
    (h2 : IsCoprime x.n₂ x.q₂) (h3 : IsCoprime x.n₂' x.q₂) :
    IsCoprime (indexMap x).1 (indexMap x).2.1 := by
  simp only [indexMap]
  exact ((hC.mul_left h1).mul_left h2).mul_left h3

/-- **The reciprocal `ū (mod v)` exists.** -/
theorem exists_reciprocal (x : CoeffVars) (hC : IsCoprime x.C x.q₂) (h1 : IsCoprime x.q₁ x.q₂)
    (h2 : IsCoprime x.n₂ x.q₂) (h3 : IsCoprime x.n₂' x.q₂) :
    ∃ ubar : ℤ, (indexMap x).1 * ubar ≡ 1 [ZMOD (indexMap x).2.1] := by
  obtain ⟨α, β, hαβ⟩ := u_coprime_v x hC h1 h2 h3
  refine ⟨α, ?_⟩
  rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  exact ⟨β, by linarith⟩

/-- `w ≠ 0 ⟺ a ≠ 0 ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ h n₂' ≠ h' n₂`. -/
theorem w_ne_zero_iff (x : CoeffVars) :
    (indexMap x).2.2 ≠ 0 ↔ x.a ≠ 0 ∧ x.k ≠ 0 ∧ x.h * x.n₂' ≠ x.h' * x.n₂ := by
  simp only [indexMap, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or, sub_eq_zero, and_assoc]

/-- `w = 0 ⟺ h n₂' = h' n₂` when `a, k ≠ 0` (the primitive-ratio diagonal). -/
theorem w_eq_zero_iff {x : CoeffVars} (ha : x.a ≠ 0) (hk : x.k ≠ 0) :
    (indexMap x).2.2 = 0 ↔ x.h * x.n₂' = x.h' * x.n₂ := by
  have := w_ne_zero_iff x
  constructor
  · intro h; by_contra h'; exact (this.2 ⟨ha, hk, h'⟩) h
  · intro h; by_contra h'; exact (this.1 h').2.2 h

end TypeIICoefficient
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5269 sha256=06fa49fe1f165497c8d9841bcb92f2927147d4dd11f9a87e3f12b03a7b068d56 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV10/TypeIICompatibleCells.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §G: the compatible-cell Type-II count

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The repaired residue-cell saving.  **This is finite combinatorics, not a Kloosterman theorem**:
it is a counting input to the (external) analytic Type-II estimate.

Setting: `k ≠ 0`, `K = |k|`, `d = C·q₁·q₂ > 0`; detector geometry
`n₁ ≡ α (mod K)`, `n₂ ≡ α (mod K d)`.

* `compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d` — for fixed `n₁` (and `k`), the number of `α`-classes modulo `K d`
  compatible with `n₁ (mod K)` is **exactly `d`**, not `K d`;
* `compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d_int` — the same with `k : ℤ`, `k ≠ 0`, `d = C q₁ q₂`;
* `old_count_fails_2_3` / `old_count_fails` — hostile fixtures with `K > 1`: the old count `K d`
  is wrong;
* `detector_n2_determined` — once `α` is fixed modulo `K d`, `n₂` is determined modulo `K d` and is
  automatically compatible with `n₁` modulo `K`;
* `outer_cell_ratio` / `outer_total_comparison` — the outer-cell comparison and the symbolic
  prefactor improvement `old_count / new_count = K`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIICompatibleCells

open Finset

/-- The compatible `α`-classes modulo `K d` for a fixed `n₁`. -/
def compatibleAlpha (K d n₁ : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range (K * d)).filter (fun α => α % K = n₁ % K)

/-- **The compatible-cell count is exactly `d`.** -/
theorem compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (d n₁ : ℕ) :
    (compatibleAlpha K d n₁).card = d := by
  unfold compatibleAlpha
  suffices h : (range d).card = ((range (K * d)).filter (fun α => α % K = n₁ % K)).card by
    rw [← h, card_range]
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun j => n₁ % K + K * j) (fun α => α / K) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    simp only [coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, coe_filter, mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *
    have hm : n₁ % K < K := Nat.mod_lt _ hK
    refine ⟨by nlinarith, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_mod]
  · intro α hα
    simp only [coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, coe_filter, mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at *
    exact Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul hα.1
  · intro j _
    have hm : n₁ % K < K := Nat.mod_lt _ hK
    simp only
    rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hK, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hm, zero_add]
  · intro α hα
    simp only [coe_filter, mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hα
    simp only
    rw [← hα.2]; exact Nat.mod_add_div α K

/-- Integer form: `k ≠ 0`, `d = C q₁ q₂`. -/
theorem compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d_int {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (C q₁ q₂ n₁ : ℕ) :
    (compatibleAlpha k.natAbs (C * q₁ * q₂) n₁).card = C * q₁ * q₂ :=
  compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hk) _ _

/-- **Hostile fixture** `k = 2`, `C = q₁ = 1`, `q₂ = 3`: the compatible count is `3 = d`, and the
old count `|k|·d = 6` is wrong. -/
theorem old_count_fails_2_3 :
    (compatibleAlpha 2 3 0).card = 3 ∧ (compatibleAlpha 2 3 0).card ≠ 2 * 3 := by
  decide

/-- **Hostile fixture (general)**: whenever `K > 1` and `d > 0`, the old count `K d` is wrong. -/
theorem old_count_fails {K d : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) (hd : 0 < d) (n₁ : ℕ) :
    (compatibleAlpha K d n₁).card ≠ K * d := by
  rw [compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d (by omega)]
  intro h
  have : 1 * d < K * d := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hK hd
  omega

/-- **Detector geometry**: `n₂ ≡ α (mod K d)` forces `n₂ ≡ α (mod K)`; so if `α` is compatible with
`n₁` then so is `n₂`, and `n₂` is determined modulo `K d` by `α`. -/
theorem detector_n2_determined {K d α n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (hα : α % K = n₁ % K)
    (h2 : n₂ % (K * d) = α % (K * d)) : n₂ % K = n₁ % K := by
  have h3 : n₂ % (K * d) % K = n₂ % K := Nat.mod_mul_right_mod n₂ K d
  have h4 : α % (K * d) % K = α % K := Nat.mod_mul_right_mod α K d
  rw [← h3, h2, h4, hα]

/-- **Symbolic prefactor improvement**: `old_count / new_count = K`. -/
theorem outer_cell_ratio {K d : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (hd : 0 < d) (n₁ : ℕ) :
    ((K * d : ℕ) : ℚ) / (compatibleAlpha K d n₁).card = K := by
  rw [compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d hK]
  have : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
  push_cast; field_simp

/-- **Outer-cell comparison** over a finite family of nonzero `k`: the old total `∑ |k| d`
dominates the new total `∑ d = #k · d`; with all `|k| = K₀` it is exactly `K₀` times larger. -/
theorem outer_total_comparison (ks : Finset ℤ) (hks : ∀ k ∈ ks, k ≠ 0) (d n₁ : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ ks, (compatibleAlpha k.natAbs d n₁).card = ks.card * d ∧
    ks.card * d ≤ ∑ k ∈ ks, k.natAbs * d := by
  constructor
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => compatibleAlpha_card_eq_d (Int.natAbs_pos.2 (hks k hk)) d n₁]
    simp
  · rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    calc ks.card = ∑ _k ∈ ks, 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ ks, k.natAbs := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => Int.natAbs_pos.2 (hks k hk)

theorem outer_total_uniform (ks : Finset ℤ) {K₀ : ℕ} (hK : ∀ k ∈ ks, k.natAbs = K₀) (d : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ ks, k.natAbs * d = K₀ * (ks.card * d) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by rw [hK k hk]]
  simp; ring

end TypeIICompatibleCells
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIICoefficient

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §I: high-H / low-H local counting

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The positive decomposition-count identities underlying the two coefficient norms, with the three
layers kept **separate**:

1. **exact counting quantity** — `collision_identity`: `∑_t |fibre(t)|² = #{(x, y) : t(x) = t(y)}`
   (restricted to any predicate on `t`, e.g. `w ≠ 0` or `w = 0`); `norm_sq_le_collisions`: for unit
   weights, `‖G‖₂² ≤ #collisions`; `collisions_split`: collisions = (`w = 0`) + (`w ≠ 0`);
2. **divisor multiplicity factor** — the explicit real parameter `Dmult`;
3. **external asymptotic envelope** — `HighHCountEnvelope`: the `w ≠ 0` collision count is at most
   `Dmult·(Q⁻²N²H² + K N H³ + N²H + K N Q² H²)`.  This is a *hypothesis* (no `x^ε` magic constant).

`highH_norm_bound` composes them into the high-H skeleton.  The `w = 0` primitive-ratio count
(`wZero_count_le`: `≤ H N²`) and the low-H diagonal (`lowH_w_eq`, `lowH_diag_card`: `= H N`) are
exact.

**Cost comparison** (`lowH_cost_identity`, `lowH_cost_lt_one`): with the correct prefactor
relation `P_lo · C Q² = P_hi · H`,
`(P_lo/P_hi)² · (H N²)/(Q⁻² N² H²) = H/(C² Q²) < 1` under `H < Q²`, `C ≥ 1`.
Fixtures `smaller_norm_insufficient` and `wrong_prefactor_fails`: a smaller norm **without** the
correct prefactor does not give low-H success.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIIHighLow

open Finset TypeIICoefficient

variable {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

/-- Fibre of `f` over `t` inside `S`. -/
def fibre (S : Finset α) (f : α → β) (t : β) : Finset α := S.filter (fun x => f x = t)

/-- **Collision identity** (restricted to a predicate `P` on the image). -/
theorem collision_identity (S : Finset α) (f : α → β) (P : β → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ∑ t ∈ (S.image f).filter P, (fibre S f t).card ^ 2 =
      ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2 ∧ P (f p.1))).card := by
  classical
  have hprod : ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2 ∧ P (f p.1))) =
      ((S.image f).filter P).biUnion (fun t => fibre S f t ×ˢ fibre S f t) := by
    ext ⟨x, y⟩
    simp only [fibre, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_biUnion, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hxy, hP⟩
      exact ⟨f x, ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hP⟩, ⟨hx, rfl⟩, hy, hxy.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, ⟨⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hP⟩, ⟨hx, hfx⟩, hy, hfy⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hfx.trans hfy.symm, hfx ▸ hP⟩
  rw [hprod, Finset.card_biUnion]
  · simp [sq, Finset.card_product]
  · intro t₁ _ t₂ _ hne
    simp only [Function.onFun]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ h1 h2
    simp only [fibre, mem_product, mem_filter] at h1 h2
    exact hne (h1.1.2.symm.trans h2.1.2)

/-- **Collision split**: collisions with `P` plus collisions with `¬P` = all collisions. -/
theorem collisions_split (S : Finset α) (f : α → β) (P : β → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2 ∧ P (f p.1))).card +
      ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2 ∧ ¬ P (f p.1))).card =
      ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2)).card := by
  rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
  · congr 1; ext p; simp only [mem_union, mem_filter]; tauto
  · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro p h1 h2
    simp only [mem_filter] at h1 h2; exact h2.2.2 h1.2.2

omit [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] in
/-- Cauchy–Schwarz on one fibre: `‖∑_{fibre} φ‖² ≤ |fibre|²` for unit weights. -/
theorem fibre_norm_sq_le (T : Finset α) (φ : α → ℂ) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖∑ x ∈ T, φ x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  have h1 : ‖∑ x ∈ T, φ x‖ ≤ T.card := by
    calc ‖∑ x ∈ T, φ x‖ ≤ ∑ x ∈ T, ‖φ x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ T, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => hφ x
      _ = T.card := by simp
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2

/-- **Norm ≤ collisions**: for unit packet weights, the squared `ℓ²` norm of the grouped
coefficient restricted to `P` is at most the restricted collision count. -/
theorem norm_sq_le_collisions (S : Finset α) (f : α → β) (P : β → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (φ : α → ℂ) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∑ t ∈ (S.image f).filter P, ‖∑ x ∈ fibre S f t, φ x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => f p.1 = f p.2 ∧ P (f p.1))).card : ℝ) := by
  rw [← collision_identity]
  push_cast
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => fibre_norm_sq_le _ φ hφ

/-! ## The Type-II instance -/

/-- `‖B^{≠0}‖₂²`: the squared norm of the grouped coefficient on `w ≠ 0`. -/
noncomputable def normSqNonzero (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ (S.image indexMap).filter (fun t => t.2.2 ≠ 0), ‖grouped S φ t‖ ^ 2

/-- The `w ≠ 0` collision count. -/
def collisionsNonzero (S : Finset CoeffVars) : ℕ :=
  ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => indexMap p.1 = indexMap p.2 ∧ (indexMap p.1).2.2 ≠ 0)).card

/-- **Exact layer**: `‖B^{≠0}‖₂² ≤ #collisions(w ≠ 0)` for unit weights. -/
theorem normSqNonzero_le (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1) :
    normSqNonzero S φ ≤ collisionsNonzero S :=
  norm_sq_le_collisions S indexMap (fun t => t.2.2 ≠ 0) φ hφ

/-- **External envelope** (hypothesis, never proved here): the `w ≠ 0` collision count is at
most the divisor-multiplicity factor times the four-term high-H envelope. -/
structure HighHCountEnvelope (S : Finset CoeffVars) (Dmult Q N H K : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : (collisionsNonzero S : ℝ) ≤
    Dmult * (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2 + K * N * H ^ 3 + N ^ 2 * H + K * N * Q ^ 2 * H ^ 2)

/-- **High-H skeleton**: exact counting + divisor factor + external envelope. -/
theorem highH_norm_bound (S : Finset CoeffVars) (φ : CoeffVars → ℂ) (hφ : ∀ x, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1)
    {Dmult Q N H K : ℝ} (henv : HighHCountEnvelope S Dmult Q N H K) :
    normSqNonzero S φ ≤
      Dmult * (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2 + K * N * H ^ 3 + N ^ 2 * H + K * N * Q ^ 2 * H ^ 2) :=
  (normSqNonzero_le S φ hφ).trans henv.bound

/-! ## The `w = 0` primitive-ratio count -/

/-- The box of `(h, h', n₂, n₂') ∈ [1,H]² × [1,N]²` with `h n₂' = h' n₂`. -/
def wZeroSet (H N : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (Icc 1 H ×ˢ Icc 1 H ×ˢ Icc 1 N ×ˢ Icc 1 N).filter
    (fun p => p.1 * p.2.2.2 = p.2.1 * p.2.2.1)

/-- **`w = 0` count**: `#{h n₂' = h' n₂} ≤ H N²` (since `h'` is determined by `h, n₂, n₂'`). -/
theorem wZero_count_le (H N : ℕ) : (wZeroSet H N).card ≤ H * N ^ 2 := by
  have : (wZeroSet H N).card ≤ (Icc 1 H ×ˢ Icc 1 N ×ˢ Icc 1 N).card := by
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun p => (p.1, p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)) ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      simp only [wZeroSet, coe_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc, Set.mem_setOf_eq, coe_product,
        Set.mem_prod, coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc] at hp ⊢
      exact ⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2.2.1, hp.1.2.2.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h₁, h₁', n₁, n₁'⟩ hp ⟨h₂, h₂', n₂, n₂'⟩ hq heq
      simp only [wZeroSet, coe_filter, mem_product, mem_Icc, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp hq
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
      have hn : 0 < n₁ := hp.1.2.2.1.1
      have : h₁' * n₁ = h₂' * n₁ := by rw [← hp.2, ← hq.2]
      have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hn this
      subst this; rfl
  simpa [Finset.card_product, sq, mul_assoc] using this

/-! ## Low-H -/

/-- **Low-H index**: for `h = h'`, `w = a k h (n₂' − n₂)`. -/
theorem lowH_w_eq (a k h n₂ n₂' : ℤ) : a * k * (h * n₂' - h * n₂) = a * k * h * (n₂' - n₂) := by
  ring

/-- The low-H diagonal `(h, n₂, n₂')` with `n₂ = n₂'`. -/
def lowHDiag (H N : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (Icc 1 H ×ˢ Icc 1 N ×ˢ Icc 1 N).filter (fun p => p.2.1 = p.2.2)

/-- **Low-H diagonal count** `= H N`. -/
theorem lowH_diag_card (H N : ℕ) : (lowHDiag H N).card = H * N := by
  unfold lowHDiag
  rw [Finset.filter_product_right (q := fun q : ℕ × ℕ => q.1 = q.2)]
  rw [Finset.card_product]
  have : ((Icc 1 N ×ˢ Icc 1 N).filter (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => q.1 = q.2)) = (Icc 1 N).diag := by
    ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp only [mem_filter, mem_product, Finset.mem_diag]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, -⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨ha, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨ha, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨ha, ha⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [this, Finset.diag_card]
  simp

/-! ## The cost comparison -/

/-- **Cost identity**: with the prefactor relation `P_lo · C Q² = P_hi · H`,
`(P_lo/P_hi)² · (H N²)/(Q⁻² N² H²) = H/(C² Q²)`. -/
theorem lowH_cost_identity {Plo Phi H N Q C : ℝ} (hPhi : Phi ≠ 0) (hH : H ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hC : C ≠ 0) (hrel : Plo * (C * Q ^ 2) = Phi * H) :
    (Plo / Phi) ^ 2 * ((H * N ^ 2) / (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2)) = H / (C ^ 2 * Q ^ 2) := by
  have hP : Plo = Phi * H / (C * Q ^ 2) := by
    field_simp; linarith [hrel]
  rw [hP]
  field_simp

/-- **Low-H is cheaper**: `H/(C² Q²) < 1` under `H < Q²`, `C ≥ 1`. -/
theorem lowH_cost_lt_one {H Q C : ℝ} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hHQ : H < Q ^ 2) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    H / (C ^ 2 * Q ^ 2) < 1 := by
  have hQ2 : 0 < Q ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hC2 : 1 ≤ C ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hC
  rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
  nlinarith

/-- The composed low-H conclusion. -/
theorem lowH_cost_comparison {Plo Phi H N Q C : ℝ} (hPhi : Phi ≠ 0) (hH : H ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hrel : Plo * (C * Q ^ 2) = Phi * H) (hHQ : H < Q ^ 2) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    (Plo / Phi) ^ 2 * ((H * N ^ 2) / (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2)) < 1 := by
  rw [lowH_cost_identity hPhi hH hN hQ (by linarith) hrel]
  exact lowH_cost_lt_one hQ hHQ hC

/-- **Fixture**: a smaller coefficient norm alone does not give a smaller cost. -/
theorem smaller_norm_insufficient :
    ¬ ∀ Plo Phi nlo nhi : ℝ, 0 < Plo → 0 < Phi → 0 < nlo → nlo < nhi →
      Plo ^ 2 * nlo < Phi ^ 2 * nhi := by
  intro h
  have := h 2 1 1 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at this

/-- **Fixture**: with the *wrong* prefactor `P_lo = P_hi`, the low-H/high-H cost ratio is
`Q²/H > 1` under `H < Q²` — low-H would *fail*. -/
theorem wrong_prefactor_fails {P H N Q : ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hH : 0 < H) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (hHQ : H < Q ^ 2) :
    1 < (P / P) ^ 2 * ((H * N ^ 2) / (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2)) := by
  have : (P / P) ^ 2 * ((H * N ^ 2) / (Q⁻¹ ^ 2 * N ^ 2 * H ^ 2)) = Q ^ 2 / H := by
    field_simp
  rw [this, one_lt_div hH]
  exact hHQ

end TypeIIHighLow
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.Providers
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIRescaling
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIRoughness
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV10.TypeIGroupedCoefficient

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10: the smooth Type-I provider interface and `∑_e T_e`

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The repaired Type-I layer is *banked relative to explicit spectral input*.  This module composes
the exact pieces:

* the `e`-rescaling (`TypeIRescaling`) gives each shell term `T_e` the density factor `1/e`;
* the external per-`e` estimate is the hypothesis `RescaledTypeIBound`
  (`|T_e| ≤ K · Y / e` for each shell modulus `e = ∏d`, `|d| = J`), itself to be supplied by the
  external `SmoothTypeIInput` (spectral input ⟹ Type-I bound);
* the shell sum is controlled by the **proved** symmetric-sum bound (`TypeIRoughness`).

Proved:
* `sum_e_T_e_bound` — `∑_{ω(e) = J} |T_e| ≤ K · Y · s₀^J / J!`;
* `sum_e_T_e_bound_exp` — `∑_{ω(e) = J} |T_e| ≤ K · Y · (e·s₀/J)^J`;
* `smoothTypeI_of_spectral` — the Type-I provider, applied to the spectral input, yields the
  Type-I region bound (a direct restatement of the provider's contract; no analytic content is
  created).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIProvider

open Finset TypeIRoughness Providers HBSupportCoverage

/-- **External per-`e` Type-I estimate** after the `e`-rescaling: `|T_e| ≤ K · Y / e`. -/
structure RescaledTypeIBound (P : Finset ℕ) (J : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ → ℝ) (K Y : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∀ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, |T d| ≤ K * Y * (1 / ((∏ p ∈ d, p : ℕ) : ℝ))

/-- **`∑_e T_e` bound** from the per-`e` estimate and the proved symmetric-sum bound. -/
theorem sum_e_T_e_bound {P : Finset ℕ} {J : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ → ℝ} {K Y : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h : RescaledTypeIBound P J T K Y) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, |T d| ≤ K * Y * ((∑ p ∈ P, (1 / (p : ℝ))) ^ J / J.factorial) := by
  calc ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, |T d|
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, K * Y * (1 / ((∏ p ∈ d, p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum h.bound
    _ = K * Y * ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, (1 / ((∏ p ∈ d, p : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ K * Y * ((∑ p ∈ P, (1 / (p : ℝ))) ^ J / J.factorial) := by
        gcongr; exact shell_reciprocal_le P J

/-- The same with the factorial estimate pushed through. -/
theorem sum_e_T_e_bound_exp {P : Finset ℕ} {J : ℕ} (hJ : 1 ≤ J) {T : Finset ℕ → ℝ} {K Y : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h : RescaledTypeIBound P J T K Y) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, |T d| ≤ K * Y * (Real.exp 1 * (∑ p ∈ P, (1 / (p : ℝ))) / J) ^ J :=
  (sum_e_T_e_bound hK hY h).trans (by
    gcongr
    exact pow_div_factorial_le_exp_bound (Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => by positivity) hJ)

/-- The Type-I provider's contract, applied to the spectral input. -/
theorem smoothTypeI_of_spectral {P : CoverageParams} {E : SupportBox → ℝ → ℝ} {Kl : ℕ → ℝ}
    {κ : ℝ} (hI : SmoothTypeIInput P E Kl κ) (hZ : ZhengKloostermanInput Kl κ) :
    ∀ b, InTypeI P b → LogPowerSaving (E b) :=
  fun b hb => hI.reduction hZ typeICombinatorialFacts_holds b hb

end TypeIProvider
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §D: Type-I `e`-rescaling (exact reproof)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The repaired Type-I change of variables, kernel-proved in its exact finite form:

* `rescale_product` — `M_e · N_e = M · N` for `M_e = M/e`, `N_e = e·N` (rational scale model);
* `betaE` — the transformed coefficient `β_e(v) = 1_{e ∣ v} β(v/e)`;
* `betaE_support` — support preservation: `β_e(v) ≠ 0 ⟺ v = e·w` with `β(w) ≠ 0`;
* `betaE_divisor_bound` — divisor-bound inheritance `|β| ≤ τ^k ⟹ |β_e| ≤ τ^k`;
* `betaE_sum` — the exact change-of-variable bijection `v = e·w` on `[1, eV] ↔ [1, V]`;
* `physical_product_preserved` — `(u/e)·(e·v) = u·v` together with the scale bounds;
* `reference_term_preserved` — the bilinear reference sum is unchanged by the rescaling;
* `lattice_card` / `lattice_density` — the `e`-lattice has exactly `X` points in `[1, eX]`;
* `lattice_congruence_iff`, `lattice_set_iff`, `lattice_sum` — the Poisson/lattice identity in its
  exact congruence form: `e ∣ ρ, ρ ≡ r (mod L)` ⟺ `ρ = e·u`, `u ≡ ē·r (mod L)` (`ē e ≡ 1 mod L`),
  with spacing `eL` (`lattice_spacing`, `lattice_translate`);
* `density_diagnostic_2_5_1` — the hostile fixture `e = 2, L = 5, r = 1`: forgetting `e ∣ ρ`
  doubles the density from `1/10` to `1/5`; `old_transform_rejected` fails if the old incorrect
  transformation is reintroduced.

No analytic Fourier transform is claimed: only the lattice and congruence statements are proved.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIRescaling

open Finset

/-! ## Scales -/

/-- **Scale invariant**: `M_e · N_e = M · N` for `M_e = M/e`, `N_e = e·N`, `e > 0`. -/
theorem rescale_product (M N : ℚ) {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) : (M / e) * (e * N) = M * N := by
  have : (e : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast he.ne'
  field_simp

/-! ## The transformed coefficient -/

/-- `β_e(v) = 1_{e ∣ v} β(v/e)`. -/
def betaE {R : Type*} [Zero R] (e : ℕ) (β : ℕ → R) (v : ℕ) : R :=
  if e ∣ v then β (v / e) else 0

theorem betaE_mul {R : Type*} [Zero R] {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (β : ℕ → R) (w : ℕ) :
    betaE e β (e * w) = β w := by
  simp [betaE, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]

theorem betaE_of_not_dvd {R : Type*} [Zero R] {e v : ℕ} (β : ℕ → R) (h : ¬ e ∣ v) :
    betaE e β v = 0 := by
  simp [betaE, h]

/-- **Support preservation.** -/
theorem betaE_support {R : Type*} [Zero R] {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (β : ℕ → R) (v : ℕ) :
    betaE e β v ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ w, v = e * w ∧ β w ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold betaE at h
    split_ifs at h with hd
    · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hd
      exact ⟨w, rfl, by rwa [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he] at h⟩
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl, hw⟩
    rwa [betaE_mul he]

/-- **Divisor-bound inheritance**: `‖β(w)‖ ≤ τ(w)^k` for all `w ≥ 1` implies the same bound for
`β_e`. -/
theorem betaE_divisor_bound {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (β : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ)
    (hβ : ∀ w, 0 < w → ‖β w‖ ≤ ((Nat.divisors w).card : ℝ) ^ k) (v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) :
    ‖betaE e β v‖ ≤ ((Nat.divisors v).card : ℝ) ^ k := by
  unfold betaE
  split_ifs with hd
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hd
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]
    have hw : 0 < w := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos w with h | h
      · simp [h] at hv
      · exact h
    refine (hβ w hw).trans ?_
    have hc : ((Nat.divisors w).card : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.divisors (e * w)).card := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd hv.ne' (dvd_mul_left w e))
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hc k
  · simp only [norm_zero]; positivity

/-- **Exact change of variables** `v = e·w`: the `β_e`-weighted sum over `[1, eV]` equals the
`β`-weighted sum over `[1, V]` with the argument rescaled. -/
theorem betaE_sum {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (β f : ℕ → R) (V : ℕ) :
    ∑ v ∈ Icc 1 (e * V), betaE e β v * f v = ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 V, β w * f (e * w) := by
  have h1 : ∑ v ∈ Icc 1 (e * V), betaE e β v * f v =
      ∑ v ∈ (Icc 1 (e * V)).filter (fun v => e ∣ v), β (v / e) * f v := by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
    unfold betaE; split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [h1]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun w => e * w) (fun v => v / e) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro w hw
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at *
    exact ⟨⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩
  · intro v hv
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at *
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, w, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro w _; simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]
  · intro v hv
    simp only [mem_filter] at hv
    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' hv.2
  · intro w _; simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]

/-! ## The physical product and the reference term -/

/-- **Physical product preservation**: for `e ∣ u`, the rescaled pair `(u/e, e·v)` has the same
product `u·v`, and it lies in the rescaled box `[0, M/e] × [0, eN]` whenever `(u, v)` lies in
`[0, M] × [0, N]`. -/
theorem physical_product_preserved {e u v : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (hu : e ∣ u) {M N : ℚ}
    (huM : (u : ℚ) ≤ M) (hvN : (v : ℚ) ≤ N) :
    (u / e) * (e * v) = u * v ∧ ((u / e : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ M / e ∧ ((e * v : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ e * N := by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hu
  have he' : (0 : ℚ) < e := by exact_mod_cast he
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]; ring
  · rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he, le_div_iff₀ he']
    push_cast at huM ⊢; linarith
  · push_cast; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvN he'.le

/-- **Reference-term preservation.**  The bilinear reference sum
`∑_{u ≤ U} ∑_{v ≤ eV} α(e u) β_e(v) Φ(u v)` of the rescaled problem equals the original
`∑_{u ≤ U} ∑_{w ≤ V} α(e u) β(w) Φ((e u) w)`, i.e. the physical products are unchanged. -/
theorem reference_term_preserved {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e)
    (α β Φ : ℕ → R) (U V : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 U, ∑ v ∈ Icc 1 (e * V), α (e * u) * (betaE e β v * Φ (u * v)) =
      ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 U, ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 V, α (e * u) * (β w * Φ ((e * u) * w)) := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [betaE_sum he β (fun v => Φ (u * v)) V]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
  congr 2; ring

/-! ## The `e`-lattice density -/

/-- The `e`-lattice has exactly `X` points in `[1, eX]`. -/
theorem lattice_card {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (X : ℕ) :
    ((Icc 1 (e * X)).filter (fun v => e ∣ v)).card = X := by
  have h := betaE_sum (R := ℕ) he (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) X
  simp only [mul_one, sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, add_tsub_cancel_right, smul_eq_mul] at h
  calc ((Icc 1 (e * X)).filter (fun v => e ∣ v)).card
      = ∑ v ∈ Icc 1 (e * X), betaE e (fun _ => 1) v := by
        rw [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
        exact sum_congr rfl fun v _ => by unfold betaE; split_ifs <;> simp
    _ = X := h

/-- Density `1/e` of the `e`-lattice. -/
theorem lattice_density {e X : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) (hX : 0 < X) :
    (((Icc 1 (e * X)).filter (fun v => e ∣ v)).card : ℚ) / ((e * X : ℕ) : ℚ) = 1 / e := by
  rw [lattice_card he]
  have : (X : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hX.ne'
  have : (e : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast he.ne'
  push_cast; field_simp

/-! ## The lattice / congruence identity -/

/-- **Congruence transfer**: if `e·ē ≡ 1 (mod L)`, then `e·u ≡ r (mod L) ⟺ u ≡ ē·r (mod L)`. -/
theorem lattice_congruence_iff {e ebar L : ℤ} (hinv : e * ebar ≡ 1 [ZMOD L]) (u r : ℤ) :
    e * u ≡ r [ZMOD L] ↔ u ≡ ebar * r [ZMOD L] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 : ebar * (e * u) ≡ ebar * r [ZMOD L] := h.mul_left ebar
    have h2 : ebar * (e * u) ≡ u [ZMOD L] := by
      have := hinv.mul_right u
      rw [one_mul] at this
      calc ebar * (e * u) = e * ebar * u := by ring
        _ ≡ u [ZMOD L] := this
    exact h2.symm.trans h1
  · intro h
    have h1 : e * u ≡ e * (ebar * r) [ZMOD L] := h.mul_left e
    have h2 : e * (ebar * r) ≡ r [ZMOD L] := by
      have := hinv.mul_right r
      rw [one_mul] at this
      calc e * (ebar * r) = e * ebar * r := by ring
        _ ≡ r [ZMOD L] := this
    exact h1.trans h2

/-- The set description: `e ∣ ρ ∧ ρ ≡ r (mod L)` ⟺ `ρ = e·u` with `u ≡ ē·r (mod L)`. -/
theorem lattice_set_iff {e ebar L : ℤ} (hinv : e * ebar ≡ 1 [ZMOD L]) (ρ r : ℤ) :
    (e ∣ ρ ∧ ρ ≡ r [ZMOD L]) ↔ ∃ u, ρ = e * u ∧ u ≡ ebar * r [ZMOD L] := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, rfl⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨u, rfl, (lattice_congruence_iff hinv u r).1 h⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl, h⟩
    exact ⟨dvd_mul_right _ _, (lattice_congruence_iff hinv u r).2 h⟩

/-- **Spacing `eL`**: two points of the lattice progression differ by a multiple of `eL`. -/
theorem lattice_spacing {e ebar L : ℤ} (hinv : e * ebar ≡ 1 [ZMOD L]) {ρ₁ ρ₂ r : ℤ}
    (h₁ : e ∣ ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ ≡ r [ZMOD L]) (h₂ : e ∣ ρ₂ ∧ ρ₂ ≡ r [ZMOD L]) : e * L ∣ ρ₁ - ρ₂ := by
  obtain ⟨u₁, rfl, hu₁⟩ := (lattice_set_iff hinv ρ₁ r).1 h₁
  obtain ⟨u₂, rfl, hu₂⟩ := (lattice_set_iff hinv ρ₂ r).1 h₂
  have : L ∣ u₁ - u₂ := Int.ModEq.dvd (hu₂.trans hu₁.symm)
  rw [← mul_sub]
  exact mul_dvd_mul_left e this

/-- Conversely the progression is closed under translation by `eL`. -/
theorem lattice_translate {e L ρ r : ℤ} (h : e ∣ ρ ∧ ρ ≡ r [ZMOD L]) :
    e ∣ ρ + e * L ∧ ρ + e * L ≡ r [ZMOD L] := by
  refine ⟨dvd_add h.1 (dvd_mul_right _ _), ?_⟩
  have : ρ + e * L ≡ ρ [ZMOD L] := by
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]; exact ⟨-e, by ring⟩
  exact this.trans h.2

/-- **The lattice sum identity**: a sum over `ρ ∈ [0, e·U)` with `e ∣ ρ` and `ρ ≡ r (mod L)`
becomes a sum over `u ∈ [0, U)` with `u ≡ ē·r (mod L)` of `f(e·u)`. -/
theorem lattice_sum {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) {ebar L : ℤ}
    (hinv : (e : ℤ) * ebar ≡ 1 [ZMOD L]) (r : ℤ) (U : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) :
    ∑ ρ ∈ (range (e * U)).filter (fun ρ : ℕ => e ∣ ρ ∧ (ρ : ℤ) ≡ r [ZMOD L]), f ρ =
      ∑ u ∈ (range U).filter (fun u : ℕ => (u : ℤ) ≡ ebar * r [ZMOD L]), f (e * u) := by
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun u => e * u) (fun ρ => ρ / e) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro u hu
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range] at *
    refine ⟨by nlinarith [hu.1], dvd_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    exact (lattice_congruence_iff hinv u r).2 hu.2
  · intro ρ hρ
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range] at *
    obtain ⟨h1, ⟨w, rfl⟩, h3⟩ := hρ
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left w he]
    refine ⟨by nlinarith, ?_⟩
    push_cast at h3
    exact (lattice_congruence_iff hinv w r).1 h3
  · intro u _; simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left u he]
  · intro ρ hρ
    simp only [mem_filter] at hρ
    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' hρ.2.1
  · intro u _; rfl

/-! ## Hostile regression fixture: `e = 2, L = 5, r = 1` -/

/-- The correct rescaled progression `2 ∣ ρ, ρ ≡ 1 (mod 5)`: `1` point in `[0, 10)`. -/
theorem correct_count_2_5_1 :
    ((range 10).filter (fun ρ => 2 ∣ ρ ∧ ρ % 5 = 1)).card = 1 := by decide

/-- The *old incorrect* transformation forgets `e ∣ ρ`: `2` points in `[0, 10)`. -/
theorem old_count_2_5_1 : ((range 10).filter (fun ρ => ρ % 5 = 1)).card = 2 := by decide

/-- **Density diagnostic** `e = 2, L = 5, r = 1`: the correct density is `1/10`; forgetting
`e ∣ ρ` gives `1/5`, i.e. doubles it. -/
theorem density_diagnostic_2_5_1 :
    (((range 10).filter (fun ρ => 2 ∣ ρ ∧ ρ % 5 = 1)).card : ℚ) / 10 = 1 / 10 ∧
    (((range 10).filter (fun ρ => ρ % 5 = 1)).card : ℚ) / 10 = 1 / 5 ∧
    (((range 10).filter (fun ρ => ρ % 5 = 1)).card : ℚ) =
      2 * ((range 10).filter (fun ρ => 2 ∣ ρ ∧ ρ % 5 = 1)).card := by
  rw [correct_count_2_5_1, old_count_2_5_1]; norm_num

/-- **Regression firewall**: the old transformation (dropping `e ∣ ρ`) does not have the
density `1/(eL)` of the correct rescaled lattice. -/
theorem old_transform_rejected :
    (((range 10).filter (fun ρ => ρ % 5 = 1)).card : ℚ) / 10 ≠ 1 / (2 * 5) := by
  rw [old_count_2_5_1]; norm_num

end TypeIRescaling
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V10 §E: the common Bonferroni roughness layer

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Finite combinatorics of the repaired common roughness reduction.

* `allowedPrimes z₀ L` — primes `p ≤ z₀` with `p ∤ L` (the **unit condition**: only primes that are
  units modulo `L` are sieved);
* `bonf P J m = ∑_{d ⊆ P, |d| ≤ J} (-1)^{|d|} 1_{∏d ∣ m}` — Bonferroni truncation at depth `J`;
* `roughInd P m = 1_{no p ∈ P divides m}`;
* `bonf_eq` — exact evaluation: `bonf P J m = 1` if no allowed prime divides `m`, and
  `(-1)^J · C(t-1, J)` if exactly `t ≥ 1` allowed primes divide `m`;
* `lowerBonf_le` / `le_upperBonf` — for **odd** `J`: `L_J(m) ≤ 1_{rough}(m) ≤ U_J(m)` with
  `L_J = bonf J`, `U_J = bonf (J-1)`;
* `upper_sub_lower_eq_shell` — `U_J − L_J` is **exactly** the shell `ω(e) = J`:
  `∑_{d ⊆ P, |d| = J} 1_{∏d ∣ m}`;
* `shell_modulus_le` — every shell modulus satisfies `e = ∏d ≤ z₀^J`;
* `esymm_le` / `shell_reciprocal_le` — `∑_{ω(e)=J} 1/e ≤ s₀^J / J!` with `s₀ = ∑_{p} 1/p`;
* `shell_reciprocal_le_exp` — the factorial estimate pushed through: `s₀^J/J! ≤ (e·s₀/J)^J`;
* `exp_loglog_sq_le_rpow` — the asymptotic statement `exp(C (log log X)²) ≤ X^δ` eventually,
  for every `C, δ > 0` (i.e. `exp(O((log log X)²)) = X^{o(1)}`), **proved** from Mathlib's
  `log^2 = o(id)`; no external provider is needed for this step.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV10
namespace TypeIRoughness

open Finset

/-- Allowed small primes: `p ≤ z₀`, `p` prime, `p ∤ L` (unit condition). -/
def allowedPrimes (z₀ L : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range (z₀ + 1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ p ∣ L)

theorem mem_allowedPrimes {z₀ L p : ℕ} :
    p ∈ allowedPrimes z₀ L ↔ p ≤ z₀ ∧ p.Prime ∧ ¬ p ∣ L := by
  simp [allowedPrimes]

/-- Bonferroni truncation at depth `J` over a finite set of primes `P`. -/
def bonf (P : Finset ℕ) (J m : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ d ∈ P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card ≤ J), (-1) ^ d.card * if (∏ p ∈ d, p) ∣ m then 1 else 0

/-- The shell `ω(e) = J`: squarefree moduli `e = ∏d`, `d ⊆ P`, `|d| = J`, dividing `m`. -/
def shell (P : Finset ℕ) (J m : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ d ∈ P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card = J), if (∏ p ∈ d, p) ∣ m then 1 else 0

/-- Roughness indicator. -/
def roughInd (P : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) : ℤ := if ∀ p ∈ P, ¬ p ∣ m then 1 else 0

/-- For a set of primes, `∏d ∣ m ⟺ d ⊆ {p ∈ P : p ∣ m}` (for `d ⊆ P`). -/
theorem prod_dvd_iff {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) {d : Finset ℕ} (hd : d ⊆ P)
    (m : ℕ) : (∏ p ∈ d, p) ∣ m ↔ d ⊆ P.filter (· ∣ m) := by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hd hp, (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hp).trans h⟩
  · intro h
    exact Finset.prod_primes_dvd m (fun p hp => (hP p (hd hp)).prime)
      (fun p hp => (mem_filter.1 (h hp)).2)

/-- Bonferroni sum reduced to the powerset of the divisor set `T = {p ∈ P : p ∣ m}`. -/
theorem bonf_eq_sum_T {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (J m : ℕ) :
    bonf P J m = ∑ d ∈ (P.filter (· ∣ m)).powerset, if d.card ≤ J then (-1) ^ d.card else 0 := by
  classical
  unfold bonf
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  have hsub : (P.filter (· ∣ m)).powerset ⊆ P.powerset :=
    Finset.powerset_mono.2 (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd => ?_
    have hdT := Finset.mem_powerset.1 hd
    have hdP : d ⊆ P := hdT.trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    rw [if_pos ((prod_dvd_iff hP hdP m).2 hdT)]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · intro d hd hdT
    have hdP := Finset.mem_powerset.1 hd
    rw [if_neg (fun h => hdT (Finset.mem_powerset.2 ((prod_dvd_iff hP hdP m).1 h)))]
    split_ifs <;> simp

/-- **Exact evaluation of the Bonferroni truncation**, via the partial alternating binomial sum. -/
theorem bonf_eq {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (J m : ℕ) :
    bonf P J m = if (P.filter (· ∣ m)).card = 0 then 1
      else (-1) ^ J * ((((P.filter (· ∣ m)).card - 1).choose J : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  rw [bonf_eq_sum_T hP]
  set T := P.filter (· ∣ m)
  have h := Finset.sum_powerset_apply_card (fun k => if k ≤ J then ((-1 : ℤ) ^ k) else 0) (x := T)
  simp only at h
  rw [h]
  split_ifs with hT
  · rw [hT]; simp
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, T.card = t + 1 := ⟨T.card - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [ht, Nat.add_sub_cancel, ← Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_eq_choose]
    have hext : ∀ k, ((t + 1).choose k) • (if k ≤ J then ((-1 : ℤ) ^ k) else 0) =
        if k ≤ J then (-1) ^ k * (((t + 1).choose k : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0 := by
      intro k; split_ifs <;> simp [mul_comm]
    simp_rw [hext]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    have hS : (range (t + 1 + 1)).filter (· ≤ J) ⊆ range (J + 1) := by
      intro k hk; simp only [mem_filter, mem_range] at hk ⊢; omega
    apply Finset.sum_subset hS
    intro k hk hk'
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range, not_and] at hk hk'
    rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)]; simp

/-- `roughInd` in terms of the divisor set. -/
theorem roughInd_eq (P : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    roughInd P m = if (P.filter (· ∣ m)).card = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold roughInd
  congr 1
  apply propext
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]

/-- **Lower Bonferroni inequality** (odd depth): `L_J(m) ≤ 1_{rough}(m)`. -/
theorem lowerBonf_le {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) {J : ℕ} (hJ : Odd J) (m : ℕ) :
    bonf P J m ≤ roughInd P m := by
  rw [bonf_eq hP, roughInd_eq]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · rw [hJ.neg_one_pow]; simp

/-- **Upper Bonferroni inequality** (odd `J`, upper truncation at the even depth `J - 1`):
`1_{rough}(m) ≤ U_J(m)`. -/
theorem le_upperBonf {P : Finset ℕ} (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) {J : ℕ} (hJ : Odd J) (m : ℕ) :
    roughInd P m ≤ bonf P (J - 1) m := by
  rw [bonf_eq hP, roughInd_eq]
  have he : Even (J - 1) := by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hJ; exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · rw [he.neg_one_pow]; simp

/-- **`U_J − L_J` is exactly the shell `ω(e) = J`** (odd `J`). -/
theorem upper_sub_lower_eq_shell (P : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (hJ : Odd J) (m : ℕ) :
    bonf P (J - 1) m - bonf P J m = shell P J m := by
  have hJ1 : 1 ≤ J := hJ.pos
  unfold bonf shell
  have hsplit : P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card ≤ J) =
      P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card ≤ J - 1) ∪ P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card = J) := by
    ext d
    by_cases h : d ∈ P.powerset
    · simp only [mem_filter, mem_union, h, true_and]; omega
    · simp only [mem_filter, mem_union, h, false_and, or_self]
  have hdisj : Disjoint (P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card ≤ J - 1))
      (P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card = J)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]; intro d _ h1 h2; omega
  rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  have : ∀ d ∈ P.powerset.filter (fun d => d.card = J),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ d.card * (if (∏ p ∈ d, p) ∣ m then 1 else 0) =
        -(if (∏ p ∈ d, p) ∣ m then 1 else 0) := by
    intro d hd
    rw [(mem_filter.1 hd).2, hJ.neg_one_pow]; ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  ring

/-- **Shell moduli are bounded**: `e = ∏d ≤ z₀^J` for `d ⊆ allowedPrimes z₀ L`, `|d| = J`. -/
theorem shell_modulus_le {z₀ L J : ℕ} {d : Finset ℕ} (hd : d ⊆ allowedPrimes z₀ L)
    (hJ : d.card = J) : ∏ p ∈ d, p ≤ z₀ ^ J := by
  rw [← hJ]
  exact Finset.prod_le_pow_card _ _ _ fun p hp => (mem_allowedPrimes.1 (hd hp)).1

/-- The allowed primes are primes. -/
theorem allowedPrimes_prime {z₀ L : ℕ} : ∀ p ∈ allowedPrimes z₀ L, p.Prime :=
  fun _ hp => (mem_allowedPrimes.1 hp).2.1

/-! ## The elementary symmetric bound -/

/-- Bernoulli-type expansion bound: `s^{n+1} + (n+1) x s^n ≤ (s + x)^{n+1}` for `s, x ≥ 0`. -/
theorem pow_succ_add_le {s x : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (n : ℕ) :
    s ^ (n + 1) + (n + 1) * x * s ^ n ≤ (s + x) ^ (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 : 0 ≤ s ^ n := pow_nonneg hs n
    have h2 : 0 ≤ x * x * s ^ n := by positivity
    calc s ^ (n + 1 + 1) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * x * s ^ (n + 1)
        ≤ (s + x) * (s ^ (n + 1) + (n + 1) * x * s ^ n) := by
          push_cast; ring_nf; nlinarith [h2]
      _ ≤ (s + x) * (s + x) ^ (n + 1) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
      _ = (s + x) ^ (n + 1 + 1) := by ring

/-- **Elementary symmetric sum bound** `e_J(x) ≤ (∑ x)^J / J!` for nonnegative weights. -/
theorem esymm_le (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ p, 0 ≤ x p) (P : Finset ℕ) (J : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, ∏ p ∈ d, x p ≤ (∑ p ∈ P, x p) ^ J / J.factorial := by
  induction P using Finset.induction_on generalizing J with
  | empty =>
    cases J with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j => rw [Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty.2 (by simp)]; simp
  | insert a P ha ih =>
    cases J with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j =>
      rw [Finset.powersetCard_succ_insert ha, Finset.sum_union]
      · rw [Finset.sum_image]
        · have hins : ∀ d ∈ P.powersetCard j, ∏ p ∈ insert a d, x p = x a * ∏ p ∈ d, x p := by
            intro d hd
            have : a ∉ d := fun h => ha ((mem_powersetCard.1 hd).1 h)
            rw [Finset.prod_insert this]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hins, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_insert ha]
          have h1 := ih (j + 1)
          have h2 := ih j
          set s := ∑ p ∈ P, x p
          have hs : 0 ≤ s := Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => hx p
          have hxa := hx a
          have hf : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos j
          have hB := pow_succ_add_le hs hxa j
          have hfs : ((j + 1).factorial : ℝ) = (j + 1) * j.factorial := by
            push_cast [Nat.factorial_succ]; ring
          calc ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard (j + 1), ∏ p ∈ d, x p + x a * ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard j, ∏ p ∈ d, x p
              ≤ s ^ (j + 1) / (j + 1).factorial + x a * (s ^ j / j.factorial) := by
                gcongr
            _ = (s ^ (j + 1) + (j + 1) * x a * s ^ j) / (j + 1).factorial := by
                rw [hfs]; field_simp
            _ ≤ (x a + s) ^ (j + 1) / (j + 1).factorial := by
                gcongr; rw [add_comm (x a) s]; exact hB
        · intro d₁ hd₁ d₂ hd₂ h
          have h1 : a ∉ d₁ := fun h' => ha ((mem_powersetCard.1 hd₁).1 h')
          have h2 : a ∉ d₂ := fun h' => ha ((mem_powersetCard.1 hd₂).1 h')
          rw [← Finset.erase_insert h1, ← Finset.erase_insert h2, h]
      · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro d hd hd'
        obtain ⟨d', -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hd'
        exact ha ((mem_powersetCard.1 hd).1 (Finset.mem_insert_self a d'))

/-- **Shell reciprocal bound**: `∑_{d ⊆ P, |d| = J} 1/∏d ≤ s₀^J / J!` with `s₀ = ∑_{p∈P} 1/p`. -/
theorem shell_reciprocal_le (P : Finset ℕ) (J : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, (1 / ((∏ p ∈ d, p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (∑ p ∈ P, (1 / (p : ℝ))) ^ J / J.factorial := by
  have := esymm_le (fun p => 1 / (p : ℝ)) (fun p => by positivity) P J
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) this
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const_one]

/-- The factorial estimate pushed through: `s^J / J! ≤ (e·s/J)^J` (`J ≥ 1`, `s ≥ 0`). -/
theorem pow_div_factorial_le_exp_bound {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) {J : ℕ} (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    s ^ J / J.factorial ≤ (Real.exp 1 * s / J) ^ J := by
  have hJ' : (0 : ℝ) < J := by exact_mod_cast hJ
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < J.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos J
  have key := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (J : ℝ) hJ'.le J
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hf] at key
  have hexp : Real.exp (J : ℝ) = Real.exp 1 ^ J := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hexp] at key
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hf, div_pow, mul_pow]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  calc s ^ J * (J : ℝ) ^ J ≤ s ^ J * (Real.exp 1 ^ J * J.factorial) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp 1 ^ J * s ^ J * J.factorial := by ring

/-- Combined: `∑_{ω(e)=J} 1/e ≤ (e·s₀/J)^J`. -/
theorem shell_reciprocal_le_exp (P : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (hJ : 1 ≤ J) :
    ∑ d ∈ P.powersetCard J, (1 / ((∏ p ∈ d, p : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 * (∑ p ∈ P, (1 / (p : ℝ))) / J) ^ J :=
  (shell_reciprocal_le P J).trans
    (pow_div_factorial_le_exp_bound (Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => by positivity) hJ)

/-! ## The asymptotic step `exp(O((log log X)²)) = X^{o(1)}` -/

open Filter Real in
/-- **`exp(C (log log X)²) ≤ X^δ` eventually**, for every `C, δ > 0`. -/
theorem exp_loglog_sq_le_rpow {C δ : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ X in atTop, exp (C * (log (log X)) ^ 2) ≤ X ^ δ := by
  have h1 := (Real.isLittleO_pow_log_id_atTop (n := 2)).def (c := δ / C) (by positivity)
  have h2 := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually h1
  filter_upwards [h2, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with X hX hX1
  have hlog : 0 < log X := log_pos hX1
  rw [rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith), exp_le_exp]
  simp only [id, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hX
  rw [abs_of_pos hlog] at hX
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX hC.le
  calc C * log (log X) ^ 2 ≤ C * (δ / C * log X) := this
    _ = log X * δ := by field_simp

end TypeIRoughness
end ResearchBankV10
end Erdos287
