import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §7: exact cell colouring

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

This REPLACES the invalid literal cell-indicator convolution.

Setting: a finite prime universe `α` (a `Fintype`), a rough sub-universe `Ur`, logarithmic
cells `cell : α → J`, and a three-bin allocation `kbin : Fin 3 → J → ℕ` (`k_j = Σ_i k_{j,i}`).
Every prime is coloured independently and uniformly with one of 3 colours: the colourings are
`ω : α → Fin 3` with the uniform probability `3^{-|α|}` (total mass one, `colouring_mass_one`).

* `G cell Ur kbin i ω B = 1` iff `B ⊆ Ur`, every atom of `B` has colour `i`, and cell `j`
  contains exactly `k_{j,i}` atoms of `B` — a `{0,1}`-valued, one-bounded weight
  (`G_zero_or_one`, `G_oneBounded`);
* `colourConv ω = G_0 ⋆ (G_1 ⋆ G_2)`;
* `pat A ω j i` = number of atoms of `A` in cell `j` with colour `i`.

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* `conv_collapse` — for weights on DISJOINT universes the convolution has at most one nonzero
  term: `(f ⋆ g)(A) = f(A ∩ U₁) g(A ∩ U₂)` (so no prime is double counted and no `p²` is
  created);
* **`colourConv_eq`** — `(G_0 ⋆ G_1 ⋆ G_2)(A) = 1(A ⊆ Ur ∧ pat A ω = k)` — `{0,1}`-valued;
* **`card_pattern`** — the number of colourings with pattern `κ` is
  `3^{|α|} · π(A, κ)` with the explicit multinomial probability
  `π = ∏_j [k_j! / (k_{j,0}! k_{j,1}! k_{j,2}!)] 3^{-k_j}` (induction on `A`, multinomial
  Pascal rule `pascal3`);
* **`exact_colouring_identity`** —
  `1(specified squarefree cell pattern of A) = π^{-1} · E_ω[(G_0 ⋆ G_1 ⋆ G_2)(A)]`;
* **`piProb_inv_le`** — `π^{-1} ≤ 3^R` whenever `Σ_j k_j ≤ R`.

The expectation is a FINITE average of total mass one; the number `3^{|α|}` of colourings
never appears as a multiplicative cost.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace CellColouring

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve CompletedPositiveWeight

/-! ### Collapse of convolutions on disjoint universes -/

section Collapse

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- **Collapse**: on disjoint universes the convolution has at most one nonzero term. -/
theorem conv_collapse {f g : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 : Finset γ} (hf : SupportedIn f U1)
    (hg : SupportedIn g U2) (hd : Disjoint U1 U2) (A : Finset γ) :
    conv f g A = if A ⊆ U1 ∪ U2 then f (A ∩ U1) * g (A ∩ U2) else 0 := by
  unfold conv
  split_ifs with hA
  · rw [sum_eq_single (A ∩ U1)]
    · congr 2
      ext p; simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_inter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hp, hn⟩
        rcases mem_union.1 (hA hp) with h | h
        · exact absurd ⟨hp, h⟩ hn
        · exact ⟨hp, h⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp, h⟩; exact ⟨hp, fun ⟨_, h'⟩ => disjoint_left.1 hd h' h⟩
    · intro B hB hne
      rw [mem_powerset] at hB
      by_contra hprod
      have h1 := hf B (left_ne_zero_of_mul hprod)
      have h2 := hg _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hprod)
      apply hne
      ext p; simp only [mem_inter]
      constructor
      · intro hp; exact ⟨hB hp, h1 hp⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp, hp1⟩
        by_contra hpB
        exact disjoint_left.1 hd hp1 (h2 (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hp, hpB⟩))
    · intro h; exact absurd (mem_powerset.2 inter_subset_left) h
  · refine sum_eq_zero fun B hB => ?_
    by_contra hprod
    have h1 := hf B (left_ne_zero_of_mul hprod)
    have h2 := hg _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hprod)
    apply hA
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpB : p ∈ B
    · exact mem_union_left _ (h1 hpB)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (h2 (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hp, hpB⟩))

theorem conv_oneBounded_of_disjoint {f g : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 : Finset γ}
    (hf : SupportedIn f U1) (hg : SupportedIn g U2) (hd : Disjoint U1 U2) (hf1 : OneBounded f)
    (hg1 : OneBounded g) : OneBounded (conv f g) := by
  intro A
  rw [conv_collapse hf hg hd]
  split_ifs
  · rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_one₀ (hf1 _) (abs_nonneg _) (hg1 _)
  · simp

end Collapse

/-! ### The colouring model -/

variable {α J : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (cell : α → J)

/-- Number of atoms of `A` in cell `j` with colour `i`. -/
def pat (A : Finset α) (ω : α → Fin 3) : J → Fin 3 → ℕ :=
  fun j i => (A.filter fun p => cell p = j ∧ ω p = i).card

/-- Number of atoms of `A` in cell `j`. -/
def cnt (A : Finset α) (j : J) : ℕ := (A.filter fun p => cell p = j).card

/-- `k₀! k₁! k₂!`. -/
def fact3 (κ : Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((κ 0).factorial : ℝ) * (κ 1).factorial * (κ 2).factorial

theorem fact3_pos (κ : Fin 3 → ℕ) : 0 < fact3 κ := by
  unfold fact3; have := Nat.factorial_pos (κ 0); have := Nat.factorial_pos (κ 1)
  have := Nat.factorial_pos (κ 2); positivity

/-- The cell pattern condition: cell `j` of `A` has `Σ_i κ j i` atoms. -/
def PatCond (A : Finset α) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) : Prop := ∀ j, ∑ i, κ j i = cnt cell A j

open Classical in
/-- **The multinomial probability** `π(A,κ) = ∏_j [k_j!/(k_{j0}! k_{j1}! k_{j2}!)] 3^{-k_j}`
(and `0` if the cell counts of `A` do not match). -/
noncomputable def piProb (A : Finset α) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if PatCond cell A κ then
    ∏ j, (((cnt cell A j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (κ j) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A j)
  else 0

/-- Number of colourings with pattern `κ` on `A`. -/
def N (A : Finset α) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => pat cell A ω = κ).card

/-- Decrement of the `(c, v)` entry. -/
def dec (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) (c : J) (v : Fin 3) : J → Fin 3 → ℕ :=
  fun j i => κ j i - if c = j ∧ v = i then 1 else 0

/-- **Multinomial Pascal rule** for three colours. -/
theorem pascal3 (a b d n : ℕ) (h : a + b + d = n + 1) :
    ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) / (a.factorial * b.factorial * d.factorial) =
      (if 1 ≤ a then (n.factorial : ℝ) / ((a - 1).factorial * b.factorial * d.factorial)
        else 0) +
      (if 1 ≤ b then (n.factorial : ℝ) / (a.factorial * (b - 1).factorial * d.factorial)
        else 0) +
      (if 1 ≤ d then (n.factorial : ℝ) / (a.factorial * b.factorial * (d - 1).factorial)
        else 0) := by
  have hf : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (m.factorial : ℝ) = m * (m - 1).factorial := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
  have ha := Nat.factorial_pos a
  have hb := Nat.factorial_pos b
  have hd := Nat.factorial_pos d
  have hn : ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) = (n + 1) * n.factorial := by
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  have hsum : ((n : ℝ) + 1) = a + b + d := by exact_mod_cast h.symm
  have e : ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : ℝ), 0 < X →
      (if 1 ≤ m then (n.factorial : ℝ) / ((m - 1).factorial * X) else 0) =
        (n.factorial : ℝ) * m / (m.factorial * X) := by
    intro m X hX
    split_ifs with hm
    · rw [hf m hm]
      have := Nat.factorial_pos (m - 1)
      have hm' : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
      field_simp
    · simp [show m = 0 by omega]
  have e1 := e a (b.factorial * d.factorial) (by positivity)
  have e2 := e b (a.factorial * d.factorial) (by positivity)
  have e3 := e d (a.factorial * b.factorial) (by positivity)
  rw [show ((a - 1).factorial : ℝ) * b.factorial * d.factorial =
    (a - 1).factorial * (b.factorial * d.factorial) by ring]
  rw [show (a.factorial : ℝ) * (b - 1).factorial * d.factorial =
    (b - 1).factorial * (a.factorial * d.factorial) by ring]
  rw [show (a.factorial : ℝ) * b.factorial * (d - 1).factorial =
    (d - 1).factorial * (a.factorial * b.factorial) by ring]
  rw [e1, e2, e3, hn, hsum]
  field_simp

/-- Symmetry of the colour at a single atom `x` for a predicate not looking at `ω x`. -/
theorem card_eval_eq (x : α) (P : (α → Fin 3) → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hP : ∀ ω v, P (Function.update ω x v) ↔ P ω) (v : Fin 3) :
    3 * (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ P ω).card =
      (univ.filter P).card := by
  have hfib : ∀ v v' : Fin 3, (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ P ω).card =
      (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v' ∧ P ω).card := by
    intro v v'
    refine card_bij' (fun ω _ => Function.update ω x v') (fun ω _ => Function.update ω x v)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro ω hω
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hω ⊢
      exact ⟨by simp, (hP ω v').2 hω.2⟩
    · intro ω hω
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hω ⊢
      exact ⟨by simp, (hP ω v).2 hω.2⟩
    · intro ω hω
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hω
      simp [← hω.1]
    · intro ω hω
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hω
      simp [← hω.1]
  conv_rhs => rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x) (t := univ)
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))]
  simp only [filter_filter]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have e : ∀ v' : Fin 3, (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => P ω ∧ ω x = v').card =
      (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ P ω).card := by
    intro v'
    rw [hfib v v']
    congr 1; ext ω; simp [and_comm]
  rw [e 0, e 1, e 2]
  ring

omit [Fintype α] [Fintype J] in
theorem cnt_insert {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (j : J) :
    cnt cell (insert x A) j = cnt cell A j + if cell x = j then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold cnt
  rw [filter_insert]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [card_insert_of_notMem (fun h' => hx (mem_filter.1 h').1)]
  · simp

omit [Fintype α] [Fintype J] in
theorem pat_insert {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (ω : α → Fin 3) (j : J) (i : Fin 3) :
    pat cell (insert x A) ω j i = pat cell A ω j i + if cell x = j ∧ ω x = i then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold pat
  rw [filter_insert]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [card_insert_of_notMem (fun h' => hx (mem_filter.1 h').1)]
  · simp

omit [Fintype α] [Fintype J] in
theorem pat_update {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (ω : α → Fin 3) (v : Fin 3) :
    pat cell A (Function.update ω x v) = pat cell A ω := by
  funext j i
  unfold pat
  congr 1
  refine filter_congr fun p hp => ?_
  have : p ≠ x := fun h => hx (h ▸ hp)
  simp [Function.update_of_ne this]

/-- **Counting recurrence**: `3 N(A ∪ {x}, κ) = Σ_v 1(κ_{c,v} ≥ 1) N(A, κ - e_{c,v})`. -/
theorem N_insert {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    (3 * N cell (insert x A) κ : ℝ) =
      ∑ v : Fin 3, if 1 ≤ κ (cell x) v then (N cell A (dec κ (cell x) v) : ℝ) else 0 := by
  have hsplit : N cell (insert x A) κ = ∑ v : Fin 3,
      (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ pat cell (insert x A) ω = κ).card := by
    unfold N
    rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x) (t := univ)
      (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
    congr 1; ext ω; simp [and_comm]
  have hterm : ∀ v : Fin 3,
      (3 * (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ pat cell (insert x A) ω = κ).card : ℝ) =
        if 1 ≤ κ (cell x) v then (N cell A (dec κ (cell x) v) : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro v
    have hiff : ∀ ω : α → Fin 3, ω x = v →
        (pat cell (insert x A) ω = κ ↔
          1 ≤ κ (cell x) v ∧ pat cell A ω = dec κ (cell x) v) := by
      intro ω hωx
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h1 : ∀ j i, pat cell A ω j i + (if cell x = j ∧ ω x = i then 1 else 0) = κ j i :=
          fun j i => by rw [← pat_insert cell hx, h]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have := h1 (cell x) v; simp [hωx] at this; omega
        · funext j i; have := h1 j i; unfold dec; rw [hωx] at this
          split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> omega
      · rintro ⟨hk, h⟩
        funext j i
        rw [pat_insert cell hx, h]
        unfold dec; rw [hωx]
        split_ifs with h'
        · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h'; omega
        · omega
    split_ifs with hk
    · have hset : (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ pat cell (insert x A) ω = κ) =
          univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ pat cell A ω = dec κ (cell x) v := by
        ext ω; simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, ((hiff ω h1).1 h2).2⟩
        · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, (hiff ω h1).2 ⟨hk, h2⟩⟩
      rw [hset]
      have := card_eval_eq x (fun ω => pat cell A ω = dec κ (cell x) v)
        (fun ω v' => by simp only [pat_update cell hx]) v
      unfold N
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have hset : (univ.filter fun ω : α → Fin 3 => ω x = v ∧ pat cell (insert x A) ω = κ) =
          ∅ := by
        rw [filter_eq_empty_iff]
        rintro ω - ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact hk ((hiff ω h1).1 h2).1
      simp [hset]
  rw [hsplit]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_sum]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun v _ => hterm v

omit [Fintype α] [Fintype J] in
/-- The decremented pattern condition. -/
theorem patCond_dec {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) (v : Fin 3)
    (hk : 1 ≤ κ (cell x) v) :
    PatCond cell A (dec κ (cell x) v) ↔ PatCond cell (insert x A) κ := by
  have key : ∀ j, ∑ i, dec κ (cell x) v j i + (if cell x = j then 1 else 0) = ∑ i, κ j i := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : cell x = j
    · subst hj
      fin_cases v <;> simp [dec, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hk ⊢ <;> omega
    · simp [dec, hj]
  unfold PatCond
  constructor
  · intro h j; rw [cnt_insert cell hx, ← key j, h j]
  · intro h j; have := key j; rw [h j, cnt_insert cell hx] at this; omega

omit [Fintype α] in
/-- **Probability recurrence** mirroring `N_insert`. -/
theorem piProb_insert {x : α} {A : Finset α} (hx : x ∉ A) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    3 * piProb cell (insert x A) κ =
      ∑ v : Fin 3, if 1 ≤ κ (cell x) v then piProb cell A (dec κ (cell x) v) else 0 := by
  classical
  set c := cell x
  by_cases hP : PatCond cell (insert x A) κ
  · have hPd : ∀ v, 1 ≤ κ c v → PatCond cell A (dec κ c v) :=
      fun v hk => (patCond_dec cell hx κ v hk).2 hP
    have hrest : ∀ v, ∀ j ∈ ({c}ᶜ : Finset J),
        (((cnt cell A j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (dec κ c v j) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A j) =
        (((cnt cell (insert x A) j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (κ j) *
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell (insert x A) j) := by
      intro v j hj
      have hjc : c ≠ j := fun h => by simp [h] at hj
      have hd : dec κ c v j = κ j := by funext i; simp [dec, hjc]
      rw [hd, cnt_insert cell hx, if_neg hjc, add_zero]
    set Rest := ∏ j ∈ ({c}ᶜ : Finset J), (((cnt cell (insert x A) j).factorial : ℝ) /
      fact3 (κ j) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell (insert x A) j)
    have hL : piProb cell (insert x A) κ =
        ((cnt cell A c + 1).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (κ c) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (cnt cell A c + 1) *
          Rest := by
      unfold piProb; rw [if_pos hP, Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_compl c, cnt_insert cell hx,
        if_pos rfl]
    have hR : ∀ v, 1 ≤ κ c v → piProb cell A (dec κ c v) =
        ((cnt cell A c).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (dec κ c v c) * (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A c *
          Rest := by
      intro v hk
      unfold piProb; rw [if_pos (hPd v hk), Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_compl c]
      congr 1
      exact prod_congr rfl (hrest v)
    have hsum : κ c 0 + κ c 1 + κ c 2 = cnt cell A c + 1 := by
      have := hP c; rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, cnt_insert cell hx, if_pos rfl] at this; exact this
    have hpas := pascal3 (κ c 0) (κ c 1) (κ c 2) (cnt cell A c) hsum
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hL]
    have t0 : (if 1 ≤ κ c 0 then piProb cell A (dec κ c 0) else 0) =
        (if 1 ≤ κ c 0 then ((cnt cell A c).factorial : ℝ) /
          ((κ c 0 - 1).factorial * (κ c 1).factorial * (κ c 2).factorial) else 0) *
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A c * Rest := by
      split_ifs with hk
      · rw [hR 0 hk]; simp [fact3, dec]
      · simp
    have t1 : (if 1 ≤ κ c 1 then piProb cell A (dec κ c 1) else 0) =
        (if 1 ≤ κ c 1 then ((cnt cell A c).factorial : ℝ) /
          ((κ c 0).factorial * (κ c 1 - 1).factorial * (κ c 2).factorial) else 0) *
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A c * Rest := by
      split_ifs with hk
      · rw [hR 1 hk]; simp [fact3, dec]
      · simp
    have t2 : (if 1 ≤ κ c 2 then piProb cell A (dec κ c 2) else 0) =
        (if 1 ≤ κ c 2 then ((cnt cell A c).factorial : ℝ) /
          ((κ c 0).factorial * (κ c 1).factorial * (κ c 2 - 1).factorial) else 0) *
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A c * Rest := by
      split_ifs with hk
      · rw [hR 2 hk]; simp [fact3, dec]
      · simp
    rw [t0, t1, t2]
    unfold fact3
    rw [hpas]
    ring
  · have hL : piProb cell (insert x A) κ = 0 := by unfold piProb; rw [if_neg hP]
    rw [hL, mul_zero]
    symm
    refine sum_eq_zero fun v _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hk
    · unfold piProb
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hP ((patCond_dec cell hx κ v hk).1 h))]
    · rfl

/-- **Exact count of colourings with a given cell/colour pattern.** -/
theorem card_pattern (A : Finset α) (κ : J → Fin 3 → ℕ) :
    (N cell A κ : ℝ) = 3 ^ Fintype.card α * piProb cell A κ := by
  classical
  induction A using Finset.induction_on generalizing κ with
  | empty =>
    have hpat : ∀ ω : α → Fin 3, pat cell ∅ ω = fun _ _ => 0 := fun ω => by
      funext j i; simp [pat]
    by_cases hκ : κ = fun _ _ => 0
    · subst hκ
      have hN : N cell ∅ (fun _ _ => 0) = 3 ^ Fintype.card α := by
        unfold N; simp [hpat]
      have hPi : piProb cell ∅ (fun _ _ => 0) = 1 := by
        unfold piProb
        rw [if_pos (show PatCond cell ∅ (fun _ _ => 0) from fun j => by simp [cnt])]
        refine prod_eq_one fun j _ => ?_
        simp [cnt, fact3]
      rw [hN, hPi]; push_cast; ring
    · have hN : N cell ∅ κ = 0 := by
        unfold N
        rw [card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff]
        intro ω _ h; exact hκ (by rw [← h, hpat])
      have hPi : piProb cell ∅ κ = 0 := by
        unfold piProb
        rw [if_neg]
        intro h
        apply hκ
        funext j i
        have := h j
        simp only [cnt, filter_empty, card_empty] at this
        have hle : κ j i ≤ ∑ i', κ j i' :=
          single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ i)
        omega
      rw [hN, hPi]; simp
  | insert x A hx ih =>
    have h1 := N_insert cell hx κ
    have h2 := piProb_insert cell hx κ
    have : (3 : ℝ) * N cell (insert x A) κ = 3 * (3 ^ Fintype.card α * piProb cell (insert x A) κ)
        := by
      rw [h1, mul_left_comm, h2, mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
      split_ifs
      · exact ih _
      · simp
    linarith

/-! ### The colour-class weights `G_i` and the exact colouring identity -/

variable (Ur : Finset α) (kbin : Fin 3 → J → ℕ)

open Classical in
/-- `G_{i,ω}(B) = 1` iff `B ⊆ Ur`, all atoms of `B` have colour `i`, and cell `j` contains
exactly `k_{j,i}` atoms of `B`. -/
noncomputable def G (i : Fin 3) (ω : α → Fin 3) (B : Finset α) : ℝ :=
  if B ⊆ Ur ∧ (∀ p ∈ B, ω p = i) ∧ (∀ j, cnt cell B j = kbin i j) then 1 else 0

theorem G_zero_or_one (i : Fin 3) (ω : α → Fin 3) (B : Finset α) :
    G cell Ur kbin i ω B = 0 ∨ G cell Ur kbin i ω B = 1 := by
  unfold G; split_ifs <;> simp

theorem G_oneBounded (i : Fin 3) (ω : α → Fin 3) : OneBounded (G cell Ur kbin i ω) := by
  intro B; unfold G; split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The colour class `{p : ω p = i}`. -/
def colourClass (ω : α → Fin 3) (i : Fin 3) : Finset α := univ.filter fun p => ω p = i

theorem G_supported (i : Fin 3) (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    SupportedIn (G cell Ur kbin i ω) (colourClass ω i) := by
  intro B hB p hp
  unfold G at hB
  split_ifs at hB with h
  · exact mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, h.2.1 p hp⟩
  · exact absurd rfl hB

theorem G_supported_rough (i : Fin 3) (ω : α → Fin 3) : SupportedIn (G cell Ur kbin i ω) Ur := by
  intro B hB
  unfold G at hB
  split_ifs at hB with h
  · exact h.1
  · exact absurd rfl hB

omit [DecidableEq α] in
theorem colourClass_disjoint (ω : α → Fin 3) {i i' : Fin 3} (h : i ≠ i') :
    Disjoint (colourClass ω i) (colourClass ω i') := by
  rw [disjoint_left]; intro p hp hp'
  simp only [colourClass, mem_filter] at hp hp'
  exact h (hp.2.symm.trans hp'.2)

/-- `colourConv ω = G_0 ⋆ (G_1 ⋆ G_2)`. -/
noncomputable def colourConv (ω : α → Fin 3) : Finset α → ℝ :=
  conv (G cell Ur kbin 0 ω) (conv (G cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G cell Ur kbin 2 ω))

/-- The target pattern `κ j i = k_{j,i}`. -/
def target : J → Fin 3 → ℕ := fun j i => kbin i j

omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J] in
theorem cnt_filter_colour (A : Finset α) (ω : α → Fin 3) (i : Fin 3) (j : J) :
    cnt cell (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) j = pat cell A ω j i := by
  unfold cnt pat; rw [filter_filter]; congr 1; ext p; simp [and_comm]

open Classical in
/-- **The colour convolution is `{0,1}`-valued** and detects exactly the specified pattern:
`(G_0 ⋆ G_1 ⋆ G_2)(A) = 1(A ⊆ Ur ∧ pat A ω = k)`. -/
theorem colourConv_eq (ω : α → Fin 3) (A : Finset α) :
    colourConv cell Ur kbin ω A =
      if A ⊆ Ur ∧ pat cell A ω = target kbin then 1 else 0 := by
  unfold colourConv
  have h12 := conv_collapse (G_supported cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 2 ω)
    (colourClass_disjoint ω (by decide))
  have hsup12 : SupportedIn (conv (G cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G cell Ur kbin 2 ω))
      (colourClass ω 1 ∪ colourClass ω 2) :=
    conv_supported (G_supported cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 2 ω)
  have hd : Disjoint (colourClass ω 0) (colourClass ω 1 ∪ colourClass ω 2) :=
    disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨colourClass_disjoint ω (by decide),
      colourClass_disjoint ω (by decide)⟩
  have hall : ∀ B : Finset α, B ⊆ colourClass ω 0 ∪ (colourClass ω 1 ∪ colourClass ω 2) := by
    intro B p _
    simp only [colourClass, mem_union, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases (show ∀ v : Fin 3, v = 0 ∨ v = 1 ∨ v = 2 by decide) (ω p) with h | h | h <;>
      simp [h]
  rw [conv_collapse (G_supported cell Ur kbin 0 ω) hsup12 hd, if_pos (hall A), h12,
    if_pos inter_subset_right]
  have e1 : A ∩ (colourClass ω 1 ∪ colourClass ω 2) ∩ colourClass ω 1 =
      A.filter fun p => ω p = 1 := by
    ext p; simp [colourClass]
  have e2 : A ∩ (colourClass ω 1 ∪ colourClass ω 2) ∩ colourClass ω 2 =
      A.filter fun p => ω p = 2 := by
    ext p; simp [colourClass]
  have e0 : A ∩ colourClass ω 0 = A.filter fun p => ω p = 0 := by
    ext p; simp [colourClass]
  rw [e0, e1, e2]
  have hG : ∀ i : Fin 3, G cell Ur kbin i ω (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) =
      if (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) ⊆ Ur ∧ ∀ j, pat cell A ω j i = kbin i j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i
    unfold G
    simp only [cnt_filter_colour]
    congr 1
    apply propext
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, -, h3⟩; exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩; exact ⟨h1, fun p hp => (mem_filter.1 hp).2, h3⟩
  rw [hG 0, hG 1, hG 2]
  have hUr : A ⊆ Ur ↔ ∀ i : Fin 3, (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) ⊆ Ur := by
    constructor
    · intro h i; exact (filter_subset _ _).trans h
    · intro h p hp; exact h (ω p) (mem_filter.2 ⟨hp, rfl⟩)
  have hpat : pat cell A ω = target kbin ↔ ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, pat cell A ω j i = kbin i j := by
    constructor
    · intro h i j; rw [h]; rfl
    · intro h; funext j i; exact h i j
  by_cases hc : A ⊆ Ur ∧ pat cell A ω = target kbin
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    have h1 := hUr.1 hc.1
    have h2 := hpat.1 hc.2
    rw [if_pos ⟨h1 0, h2 0⟩, if_pos ⟨h1 1, h2 1⟩, if_pos ⟨h1 2, h2 2⟩]; norm_num
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    have : ¬ ((∀ i : Fin 3, (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) ⊆ Ur) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ j, pat cell A ω j i = kbin i j) := fun h =>
      hc ⟨hUr.2 h.1, hpat.2 h.2⟩
    by_contra hne
    apply this
    have hne' : ∀ i : Fin 3, (A.filter fun p => ω p = i) ⊆ Ur ∧
        ∀ j, pat cell A ω j i = kbin i j := by
      intro i
      by_contra hi
      apply hne
      fin_cases i <;> simp_all
    exact ⟨fun i => (hne' i).1, fun i => (hne' i).2⟩

/-- The uniform finite average over colourings. -/
noncomputable def colourExp (F : (α → Fin 3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ ω : α → Fin 3, F ω) / 3 ^ Fintype.card α

/-- The colouring probability measure has total mass one. -/
theorem colouring_mass_one : colourExp (α := α) (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
  unfold colourExp
  simp [Fintype.card_fin]

/-- The explicit multinomial probability `π = ∏_j [k_j!/(k_{j0}!k_{j1}!k_{j2}!)] 3^{-k_j}`. -/
noncomputable def piConst : ℝ :=
  ∏ j, (((∑ i, kbin i j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (target kbin j) *
    (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (∑ i, kbin i j))

omit [DecidableEq J] in
theorem piConst_pos : 0 < piConst (J := J) kbin := by
  unfold piConst
  refine prod_pos fun j _ => ?_
  have := Nat.factorial_pos (∑ i, kbin i j)
  have := fact3_pos (target kbin j)
  positivity

/-- The specified squarefree cell pattern: `A ⊆ Ur` and cell `j` contains `k_j` atoms of `A`. -/
def CellPattern (A : Finset α) : Prop := A ⊆ Ur ∧ PatCond cell A (target kbin)

open Classical in
/-- **The exact colouring identity**:
`1(specified squarefree cell pattern) = π^{-1} · E_ω[(G_0 ⋆ G_1 ⋆ G_2)(A)]`. -/
theorem exact_colouring_identity (A : Finset α) :
    (if CellPattern cell Ur kbin A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (piConst kbin)⁻¹ * colourExp (fun ω => colourConv cell Ur kbin ω A) := by
  have hpos := piConst_pos (J := J) kbin
  have hE : colourExp (fun ω => colourConv cell Ur kbin ω A) =
      if A ⊆ Ur then piProb cell A (target kbin) else 0 := by
    unfold colourExp
    simp_rw [colourConv_eq]
    split_ifs with hA
    · simp only [hA, true_and]
      rw [sum_boole]
      have := card_pattern cell A (target kbin)
      unfold N at this
      rw [this]
      have : (3 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card α ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    · simp [hA]
  rw [hE]
  unfold CellPattern
  by_cases hA : A ⊆ Ur
  · rw [if_pos hA]
    unfold piProb
    by_cases hP : PatCond cell A (target kbin)
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hA, hP⟩, if_pos hP]
      have : ∏ j, (((cnt cell A j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (target kbin j) *
          (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ cnt cell A j) = piConst kbin := by
        unfold piConst
        refine prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        have hj := hP j
        simp only [target] at hj
        rw [← hj]
      rw [this, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hP h.2), if_neg hP, mul_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => hA h.1), if_neg hA, mul_zero]

omit [DecidableEq J] in
/-- **`π^{-1} ≤ 3^R`** when the total number of rough atoms `Σ_j k_j` is at most `R`. -/
theorem piProb_inv_le {R : ℕ} (hR : ∑ j, ∑ i, kbin i j ≤ R) :
    (piConst (J := J) kbin)⁻¹ ≤ 3 ^ R := by
  have hpos := piConst_pos (J := J) kbin
  have hlow : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ R ≤ piConst kbin := by
    unfold piConst
    calc (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ R ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (∑ j, ∑ i, kbin i j) :=
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hR
      _ = ∏ j, (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (∑ i, kbin i j) := by rw [prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine prod_le_prod (fun j _ => by positivity) fun j _ => ?_
          have hm : fact3 (target kbin j) ≤ ((∑ i, kbin i j).factorial : ℝ) := by
            have := Nat.multinomial_spec (s := univ) (f := fun i => kbin i j)
            have hpos := Nat.multinomial_pos (s := univ) (f := fun i => kbin i j)
            have hle : ∏ i, (kbin i j).factorial ≤ (∑ i, kbin i j).factorial := by
              rw [← this]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hpos
            unfold fact3 target
            rw [Fin.prod_univ_three] at hle
            exact_mod_cast hle
          have hf := fact3_pos (target kbin j)
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ i, kbin i j).factorial : ℝ) / fact3 (target kbin j) := by
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hf]; linarith
          have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 3) ^ (∑ i, kbin i j) := by positivity
          nlinarith
  calc (piConst kbin)⁻¹ ≤ ((1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ R)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hlow
    _ = 3 ^ R := by rw [one_div, inv_pow, inv_inv]

end CellColouring
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.SmallPrimeUpperSieve

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §6: the completed positive upper-sieve weight

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

* `conv f g A = ∑_{B ⊆ A} f(B) g(A \ B)` — Dirichlet convolution of squarefree-supported weights
  (in the atom-set model a product `bc` of squarefree moduli with DISJOINT atom sets);
* `muE E A = μ(A) · 1_{A ⊆ E}` — `μ_E(e) = μ(e) · 1(e ∣ P_E)`;
* `completedWeight E β ℓ = μ_E ⋆ β ⋆ ℓ` — **the completed weight `Λ_new^+`**, instantiated
  (`LambdaNewPlus`) with the ACTUAL Rosser weight `β_sm^+` (§5) and the ACTUAL rounded rough
  weight `ℓ_rd` (§3).

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* `dsum_conv_eq`, **`dsum_conv_disjoint`** — for weights on disjoint prime universes
  `S_{f⋆g} = S_f · S_g`;
* `dsum_muE` — `S_{μ_E}(n) = 1(gcd(n, P_E) = 1)` (Möbius tail);
* **`dsum_completed_eq`** — `S_Λ(n) = 1(gcd(n,P_E)=1) · S_β(n) · S_ℓ(n)`;
* **`dsum_completed_nonneg`** — `S_Λ(n) ≥ 0`;
* **`dsum_completed_ge_survivor`** — `S_Λ(n) ≥ 1(n survives the entire auxiliary sieve)`;
* `LambdaNewPlus_nonneg`, `LambdaNewPlus_ge_survivor` — the same for the concrete `Λ_new^+`;
* `natDivSum_lift` — transfer to genuine divisor sums over `ℕ`:
  `∑_{d ∣ n} Λ(d) = S_Λ({p ∈ U : p ∣ n})`, and `natDivSum_LambdaNewPlus`;
* **`completed_support_budget`** — every modulus in the support of `Λ_new^+` satisfies
  `d ≤ P_E · level · X`, i.e. `P_E · x^{rho} · x^{vartheta0} = P_E · x^{vartheta}`.  The fixed
  factor `P_E` is kept explicitly (never set to `1`, never absorbed into `W0`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace CompletedPositiveWeight

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve FirstForbiddenPrefix SmallPrimeUpperSieve

section Generic

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- Dirichlet convolution of squarefree-supported weights. -/
def conv (f g : Finset γ → ℝ) (A : Finset γ) : ℝ := ∑ B ∈ A.powerset, f B * g (A \ B)

theorem dsum_conv_eq (f g : Finset γ → ℝ) (D : Finset γ) :
    dsum (conv f g) D = ∑ B ∈ D.powerset, f B * dsum g (D \ B) := by
  unfold dsum conv
  rw [Finset.sum_comm' (t' := D.powerset) (s' := fun B => D.powerset.filter (B ⊆ ·))]
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun B hB => ?_
    rw [mul_sum]
    refine sum_nbij' (fun A => A \ B) (fun C => C ∪ B) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro A hA
      rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset] at hA
      rw [mem_powerset]
      exact sdiff_subset_sdiff hA.1 (Subset.refl B)
    · intro C hC
      rw [mem_powerset] at hC
      rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset]
      exact ⟨union_subset (hC.trans sdiff_subset) (mem_powerset.1 hB), subset_union_right⟩
    · intro A hA
      rw [mem_filter, mem_powerset] at hA
      exact sdiff_union_of_subset hA.2
    · intro C hC
      rw [mem_powerset] at hC
      refine union_sdiff_cancel_right ?_
      exact disjoint_of_subset_left hC sdiff_disjoint
    · intro A _; rfl
  · intro A B
    simp only [mem_powerset, mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩; exact ⟨⟨hA, hB⟩, hB.trans hA⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hA, hB⟩, -⟩; exact ⟨hA, hB⟩

/-- **Disjoint prime universes factor the divisor sum**: `S_{f⋆g} = S_f · S_g`. -/
theorem dsum_conv_disjoint {f g : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 : Finset γ} (hf : SupportedIn f U1)
    (hg : SupportedIn g U2) (hd : Disjoint U1 U2) (D : Finset γ) :
    dsum (conv f g) D = dsum f D * dsum g D := by
  rw [dsum_conv_eq]
  unfold dsum
  rw [sum_mul]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun B _ => ?_
  by_cases hB : f B = 0
  · simp [hB]
  congr 1
  have hBU := hf B hB
  change dsum g (D \ B) = dsum g D
  rw [dsum_inter hg, dsum_inter hg D]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [mem_inter, mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, -⟩, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1, fun h => disjoint_left.1 hd (hBU h) h2⟩, h2⟩

/-- The support of a convolution lies in the union of the supports. -/
theorem conv_supported {f g : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 : Finset γ} (hf : SupportedIn f U1)
    (hg : SupportedIn g U2) : SupportedIn (conv f g) (U1 ∪ U2) := by
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hA
  have h1 := hf B (left_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
  have h2 := hg _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpB : p ∈ B
  · exact mem_union_left _ (h1 hpB)
  · exact mem_union_right _ (h2 (mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hp, hpB⟩))

/-- `μ_E(A) = μ(A) · 1_{A ⊆ E}`. -/
noncomputable def muE (E : Finset γ) (A : Finset γ) : ℝ :=
  if A ⊆ E then (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card else 0

theorem muE_supported (E : Finset γ) : SupportedIn (muE E) E := by
  intro A hA; by_contra h; exact hA (by simp [muE, h])

/-- `S_{μ_E}(D) = 1(D ∩ E = ∅)` — i.e. `1(gcd(n, P_E) = 1)`. -/
theorem dsum_muE (E D : Finset γ) : dsum (muE E) D = if D ∩ E = ∅ then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [dsum_inter (muE_supported E), ← mobius_tail]
  unfold dsum
  refine sum_congr rfl fun A hA => ?_
  simp [muE, (mem_powerset.1 hA).trans inter_subset_right]

/-- **The completed weight** `Λ = μ_E ⋆ β ⋆ ℓ`. -/
noncomputable def completedWeight (E : Finset γ) (β ℓ : Finset γ → ℝ) : Finset γ → ℝ :=
  conv (conv (muE E) β) ℓ

variable {E Psm Prd : Finset γ} {β ℓ : Finset γ → ℝ}

/-- **Factorization of the completed divisor sum**
`S_Λ(n) = 1(gcd(n,P_E)=1) · S_β(n) · S_ℓ(n)` (three disjoint prime universes). -/
theorem dsum_completed_eq (hβ : SupportedIn β Psm) (hℓ : SupportedIn ℓ Prd)
    (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd) (D : Finset γ) :
    dsum (completedWeight E β ℓ) D = (if D ∩ E = ∅ then 1 else 0) * dsum β D * dsum ℓ D := by
  unfold completedWeight
  rw [dsum_conv_disjoint (conv_supported (muE_supported E) hβ) hℓ
      (disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨h2, h3⟩),
    dsum_conv_disjoint (muE_supported E) hβ h1, dsum_muE]

/-- **Positivity** `S_Λ(n) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem dsum_completed_nonneg (hβ : SupportedIn β Psm) (hℓ : SupportedIn ℓ Prd)
    (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd)
    (hβ0 : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum β D) (hℓ0 : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum ℓ D) (D : Finset γ) :
    0 ≤ dsum (completedWeight E β ℓ) D := by
  rw [dsum_completed_eq hβ hℓ h1 h2 h3]
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hβ0 D)) (hℓ0 D)

/-- **Upper-sieve property** `S_Λ(n) ≥ 1(n survives the entire auxiliary sieve)`. -/
theorem dsum_completed_ge_survivor (hβ : SupportedIn β Psm) (hℓ : SupportedIn ℓ Prd)
    (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd)
    (hβu : ∀ D, (if D ∩ Psm = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum β D)
    (hℓu : ∀ D, (if D ∩ Prd = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum ℓ D) (D : Finset γ) :
    (if D ∩ (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum (completedWeight E β ℓ) D := by
  have hβ0 : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum β D := fun D => le_trans (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hβu D)
  have hℓ0 : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum ℓ D := fun D => le_trans (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hℓu D)
  split_ifs with hs
  · rw [dsum_completed_eq hβ hℓ h1 h2 h3]
    have hE : D ∩ E = ∅ := by
      rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hs ⊢
      intro p hp; exact hs p (by simp only [mem_inter, mem_union] at hp ⊢; tauto)
    have hS : D ∩ Psm = ∅ := by
      rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hs ⊢
      intro p hp; exact hs p (by simp only [mem_inter, mem_union] at hp ⊢; tauto)
    have hR : D ∩ Prd = ∅ := by
      rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at hs ⊢
      intro p hp; exact hs p (by simp only [mem_inter, mem_union] at hp ⊢; tauto)
    have a := hβu D; have b := hℓu D
    rw [if_pos hS] at a; rw [if_pos hR] at b
    rw [if_pos hE, one_mul]
    nlinarith
  · exact dsum_completed_nonneg hβ hℓ h1 h2 h3 hβ0 hℓ0 D

end Generic

/-! ### The concrete completed weight `Λ_new^+` on actual primes -/

/-- **`Λ_new^+ = μ_E ⋆ β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd`** with the actual Rosser small weight at level `level`
(`= x^rho`) and the actual rounded rough weight at level `X` (`= x^{vartheta0}`). -/
noncomputable def LambdaNewPlus (E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ) (level : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) :
    Finset ℕ → ℝ :=
  completedWeight E (rosserBeta Psm level) (ellRd Prd w X)

section Concrete

variable {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ}

theorem LambdaNewPlus_nonneg (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd)
    (D : Finset ℕ) : 0 ≤ dsum (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) D :=
  dsum_completed_nonneg (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (ellRd_supported _ _ _) h1 h2 h3
    (dsum_ellRd_nonneg _ _ _) (dsum_ellRd_nonneg _ _ _) D

theorem LambdaNewPlus_ge_survivor (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd)
    (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    (if D ∩ (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) D :=
  dsum_completed_ge_survivor (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (ellRd_supported _ _ _) h1 h2 h3
    (dsum_ellRd_ge _ _ _) (dsum_ellRd_ge _ _ _) D

theorem LambdaNewPlus_supported :
    SupportedIn (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) :=
  conv_supported (conv_supported (muE_supported E) (ellRd_supported _ _ _))
    (ellRd_supported _ _ _)

end Concrete

/-! ### Transfer to genuine divisor sums over `ℕ` -/

/-- Lift of an atom-set weight on the prime universe `U` to an arithmetic function. -/
def liftN (U : Finset ℕ) (f : Finset ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ A ∈ U.powerset, if ∏ p ∈ A, p = d then f A else 0

/-- **Divisor-sum transfer**: `∑_{d ∣ n} (lift f)(d) = S_f({p ∈ U : p ∣ n})` for `n ≠ 0`. -/
theorem natDivSum_lift {U : Finset ℕ} (hU : ∀ p ∈ U, p.Prime) (f : Finset ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, liftN U f d = dsum f (U.filter (· ∣ n)) := by
  unfold liftN
  rw [sum_comm]
  simp_rw [sum_ite_eq, Nat.mem_divisors]
  unfold dsum
  rw [← sum_filter]
  congr 1
  ext A
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_powerset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hA, hd, -⟩ p hp
    exact mem_filter.2 ⟨hA hp, dvd_trans (dvd_prod_of_mem _ hp) hd⟩
  · intro hA
    refine ⟨hA.trans (filter_subset _ _), ?_, hn⟩
    exact prod_primes_dvd n (fun p hp => (hU p (mem_filter.1 (hA hp)).1).prime)
      (fun p hp => (mem_filter.1 (hA hp)).2)

/-- **`S_Λ(n)` as a genuine divisor sum** for the concrete completed weight. -/
theorem natDivSum_LambdaNewPlus {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hU : ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd, p.Prime) (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd)
    (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (if ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd, ¬ p ∣ n then 1 else 0) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, liftN (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) d ∧
    0 ≤ ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, liftN (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) d := by
  rw [natDivSum_lift hU _ hn]
  refine ⟨le_trans ?_ (LambdaNewPlus_ge_survivor h1 h2 h3 _), LambdaNewPlus_nonneg h1 h2 h3 _⟩
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  · exact le_rfl
  · exfalso; apply hb
    rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro p hp
    simp only [mem_inter, mem_filter] at hp
    exact ha p hp.1.1 hp.1.2
  · exact zero_le_one
  · exact le_rfl

/-! ### Support budget `P_E · x^{rho} · x^{vartheta0}` -/

/-- **Support budget**: every modulus in the support of `Λ_new^+` has size at most
`P_E · level · X` (`= P_E · x^{rho + vartheta0} = P_E · x^{vartheta}`). -/
theorem completed_support_budget {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, 1 ≤ p) (hPsm : ∀ p ∈ Psm, 1 ≤ p) (hlev : 1 ≤ level) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hwp : ∀ p ∈ Prd, (p : ℝ) ≤ w p) (hw1 : ∀ p ∈ Prd, 1 ≤ w p)
    (hmono : ∀ p ∈ Prd, ∀ q ∈ Prd, p ≤ q → w p ≤ w q) {A : Finset ℕ}
    (hA : LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X A ≠ 0) :
    (∏ p ∈ A, (p : ℝ)) ≤ (∏ p ∈ E, (p : ℝ)) * level * X := by
  unfold LambdaNewPlus completedWeight conv at hA
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hA
  have hB1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have hB2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hne'⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hB1
  have hC1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne'
  have hC2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne'
  have hBA := mem_powerset.1 hB
  have hCB := mem_powerset.1 hC
  have hCE : C ⊆ E := muE_supported E C hC1
  have hsm := (rosserSmallProvider Psm level hlev hPsm).level_supp (B \ C) hC2
  have hRd : A \ B ⊆ Prd := ellRd_supported Prd w X _ hB2
  have hrd : (∏ p ∈ A \ B, w p) ≤ X := by
    unfold ellRd at hB2
    rw [if_pos hRd] at hB2
    unfold ellW at hB2
    split_ifs at hB2 with hadm
    · exact ellW_support_prod_le hX (fun p hp => hw1 p (hRd hp))
        (fun p hp q hq h => hmono p (hRd hp) q (hRd hq) h) hadm
    · exact absurd rfl hB2
  have hrd' : (∏ p ∈ A \ B, (p : ℝ)) ≤ X :=
    le_trans (prod_le_prod (fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg p) (fun p hp => hwp p (hRd hp))) hrd
  have hEC : (∏ p ∈ C, (p : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ p ∈ E, (p : ℝ) := by
    have : ∏ p ∈ C, p ≤ ∏ p ∈ E, p :=
      prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' hCE (fun p hp _ => hE p hp)
    have h' : ((∏ p ∈ C, p : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((∏ p ∈ E, p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    simpa only [Nat.cast_prod] using h'
  rw [← prod_sdiff hBA, ← prod_sdiff hCB]
  have p1 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ C, (p : ℝ) := prod_nonneg fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg p
  have p2 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ B \ C, (p : ℝ) := prod_nonneg fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg p
  have p3 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ A \ B, (p : ℝ) := prod_nonneg fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg p
  calc (∏ p ∈ A \ B, (p : ℝ)) * ((∏ p ∈ B \ C, (p : ℝ)) * ∏ p ∈ C, (p : ℝ))
      ≤ X * (level * ∏ p ∈ E, (p : ℝ)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul hrd' (mul_le_mul hsm hEC p1 (by linarith)) (by positivity)
          (by linarith)
    _ = (∏ p ∈ E, (p : ℝ)) * level * X := by ring

end CompletedPositiveWeight
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §2: the fixed finite exceptional prime set

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`excSet K base slopes` is the fixed finite set `E` of primes consisting of

* all primes `≤ 2K + 2`;
* the primes dividing the base;
* the primes dividing the slopes;
* the primes dividing the nonzero slope differences.

`P_E = ∏_{p ∈ E} p`.  **This is an AUXILIARY presieve only**: `excSet` takes no `W0` argument and
the historical `W0` is not modified; `P_E` is a fixed positive integer and is never set to `1`.

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK): `mem_excSet_prime`, `small_prime_mem`, `base_prime_mem`,
`slope_prime_mem`, `diff_prime_mem`, `P_E_pos`, `not_dvd_P_E_of_not_mem`,
`good_prime_gt` (a prime outside `E` exceeds `2K+2`), `coprime_P_E_iff`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace ExceptionalPrimeSet

/-- The fixed exceptional prime set `E`. -/
def excSet (K base : ℕ) (slopes : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (2 * K + 3)).filter Nat.Prime ∪ base.primeFactors ∪
    slopes.biUnion Nat.primeFactors ∪
    (slopes ×ˢ slopes).biUnion fun ab => (Int.natAbs ((ab.1 : ℤ) - ab.2)).primeFactors

/-- `P_E = ∏_{p ∈ E} p`. -/
def P_E (K base : ℕ) (slopes : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ excSet K base slopes, p

variable {K base : ℕ} {slopes : Finset ℕ}

theorem mem_excSet_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ excSet K base slopes) : p.Prime := by
  simp only [excSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_biUnion,
    Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hp
  rcases hp with ((⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩) | ⟨_, -, h, -⟩) | ⟨_, -, h, -⟩ <;> exact h

theorem small_prime_mem {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hle : p ≤ 2 * K + 2) :
    p ∈ excSet K base slopes := by
  simp only [excSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨by omega, hp⟩))

theorem base_prime_mem {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hd : p ∣ base) (hb : base ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ excSet K base slopes := by
  simp only [excSet, Finset.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr (Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, hd, hb⟩)))

theorem slope_prime_mem {p a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ slopes) (hp : p.Prime) (hd : p ∣ a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) :
    p ∈ excSet K base slopes := by
  simp only [excSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨a, ha, Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, hd, ha0⟩⟩)

theorem diff_prime_mem {p a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ slopes) (hb : b ∈ slopes) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hd : (p : ℤ) ∣ (a : ℤ) - b) (hab : a ≠ b) : p ∈ excSet K base slopes := by
  simp only [excSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  refine Or.inr ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩, Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact Int.natCast_dvd.1 hd
  · simp only [ne_eq, Int.natAbs_eq_zero]; omega

theorem P_E_pos : 0 < P_E K base slopes :=
  Finset.prod_pos fun _ hp => (mem_excSet_prime hp).pos

theorem not_dvd_P_E_of_not_mem {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hE : p ∉ excSet K base slopes) :
    ¬ p ∣ P_E K base slopes := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).1 h
  have hq' := mem_excSet_prime hq
  rw [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq').1 hpq] at hE
  exact hE hq

/-- A good prime (outside `E`) exceeds `2K + 2`. -/
theorem good_prime_gt {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hE : p ∉ excSet K base slopes) : 2 * K + 2 < p := by
  by_contra h
  exact hE (small_prime_mem hp (by omega))

/-- `gcd(n, P_E) = 1` iff no prime of `E` divides `n`. -/
theorem coprime_P_E_iff (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime n (P_E K base slopes) ↔ ∀ p ∈ excSet K base slopes, ¬ p ∣ n := by
  unfold P_E
  rw [Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff]
  refine forall₂_congr fun _ hp => ?_
  rw [Nat.coprime_comm, Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd (mem_excSet_prime hp)]

end ExceptionalPrimeSet
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=11064 sha256=93653b039d618bc4777aa2ac53caa0759e4a5908eb0c69f5efaf9647c36a6779 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV22/FirstForbiddenPrefix.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.RoundedRoughSieve

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §4: first-forbidden-prefix positivity

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Kernel-proved finite combinatorics (LEAN BANK), for ANY prefix condition `cond`:

* `FirstFail cond B` — `B` is a **first failed prefix**: its last (= smallest) atom `m` sits at
  index `|B|`, the previous prefix `B \ {m}` is admissible, `|B \ {m}|` is even (so the index
  `|B|` is ODD — `firstFail_odd`), and `cond (B \ {m}) m` fails (`firstFail_not_adm`);
* `adm_insert_min` — adding a new smallest atom `m` to `A` keeps all earlier conditions and adds
  exactly one condition at `m`;
* **`dsum_ellW_classification`** — for nonempty `D` with smallest atom `m`,

      ∑_{A ⊆ D} μ(A) 1_{Adm A} = #{A ⊆ D \ {m} : FirstFail (A ∪ {m})}.

  Reading: every non-admissible `A ⊆ D` is classified by its first failed prefix `B`; that
  prefix has odd index, so the omitted correction `-μ(B) = +1` is nonnegative; the remaining
  Möbius tail over the atoms of `D` below `min B` is `∑_{C ⊆ T} μ(C) = 1_{T = ∅} ∈ {0,1}`
  (`mobius_tail`), so only the prefixes ending at the smallest atom of `D` survive, each
  contributing `+1`;
* **`dsum_ellW_ge`** — `∑_{A ⊆ D} ℓ(A) ≥ 1_{D = ∅}`, hence `≥ 0` (`dsum_ellW_nonneg`);
* **`dsum_ellRd_ge`** — for the rounded rough sieve:
  `S_{ℓ_rd}(n) ≥ 1(no rough prime divides n)` and `S_{ℓ_rd}(n) ≥ 0`;
* `ellW_support_prod_le` — support bound: an admissible `A` has `∏_{p∈A} w(p) ≤ X`
  (for `w ≥ 1` monotone), i.e. `ℓ_rd` has level `X = x^{vartheta0}`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace FirstForbiddenPrefix

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve

variable {γ : Type*} [LinearOrder γ]

/-- `B` is a first failed prefix (its smallest atom `m` is at odd index `|B|` and fails). -/
def FirstFail (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (B : Finset γ) : Prop :=
  ∃ m ∈ B, (∀ q ∈ B, m ≤ q) ∧ Adm cond (B.erase m) ∧ Even (B.erase m).card ∧
    ¬ cond (B.erase m) m

/-- **The first failed prefix has odd index.** -/
theorem firstFail_odd {cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop} {B : Finset γ} (h : FirstFail cond B) :
    Odd B.card := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, -, -, he, -⟩ := h
  rw [← Finset.card_erase_add_one hm]
  exact he.add_one

theorem above_eq_erase_of_min {B : Finset γ} {m : γ} (hmin : ∀ q ∈ B, m ≤ q) :
    above B m = B.erase m := by
  ext q
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hlt⟩; exact ⟨ne_of_gt hlt, hq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hq⟩; exact ⟨hq, lt_of_le_of_ne (hmin q hq) (Ne.symm hne)⟩

/-- A first failed prefix is not admissible. -/
theorem firstFail_not_adm {cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop} {B : Finset γ} (h : FirstFail cond B) :
    ¬ Adm cond B := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin, -, he, hc⟩ := h
  intro hadm
  have := hadm m hm
  rw [above_eq_erase_of_min hmin] at this
  exact hc (this he)

/-- **Adding a new smallest atom** adds exactly one condition. -/
theorem adm_insert_min (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) {A : Finset γ} {m : γ}
    (hlt : ∀ q ∈ A, m < q) :
    Adm cond (insert m A) ↔ Adm cond A ∧ (Even A.card → cond A m) := by
  have hmA : m ∉ A := fun h => lt_irrefl m (hlt m h)
  have h1 : above (insert m A) m = A := by
    ext q; simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_insert]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨rfl | hq, hq'⟩
      · exact absurd hq' (lt_irrefl _)
      · exact hq
    · intro hq; exact ⟨Or.inr hq, hlt q hq⟩
  have h2 : ∀ q ∈ A, above (insert m A) q = above A q := by
    intro q hq; ext r; simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_insert]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨rfl | hr, hr'⟩
      · exact absurd (hlt q hq) (not_lt.2 hr'.le)
      · exact ⟨hr, hr'⟩
    · rintro ⟨hr, hr'⟩; exact ⟨Or.inr hr, hr'⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun q hq he => ?_, fun he => ?_⟩
    · have := h q (mem_insert_of_mem hq); rw [h2 q hq] at this; exact this he
    · have := h m (mem_insert_self m A); rw [h1] at this; exact this he
  · rintro ⟨hA, hm⟩ q hq
    rcases mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · rw [h1]; exact hm
    · rw [h2 q hq]; exact hA q hq

/-- `FirstFail (A ∪ {m})` for a new smallest atom `m`. -/
theorem firstFail_insert_iff (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) {A : Finset γ} {m : γ}
    (hlt : ∀ q ∈ A, m < q) :
    FirstFail cond (insert m A) ↔ Adm cond A ∧ Even A.card ∧ ¬ cond A m := by
  have hmA : m ∉ A := fun h => lt_irrefl m (hlt m h)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m', hm', hmin, hadm, he, hc⟩
    have hmm : m' = m := by
      apply le_antisymm (hmin m (mem_insert_self m A))
      rcases mem_insert.1 hm' with h | h
      · exact h.ge
      · exact (hlt m' h).le
    subst hmm
    rw [erase_insert hmA] at hadm he hc
    exact ⟨hadm, he, hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨hadm, he, hc⟩
    refine ⟨m, mem_insert_self m A, fun q hq => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | h
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact (hlt q h).le
    all_goals rw [erase_insert hmA]
    exacts [hadm, he, hc]

/-- **Möbius tail**: `∑_{C ⊆ T} μ(C) = 1_{T=∅}`, which is `0` or `1`. -/
theorem mobius_tail {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (T : Finset α) :
    ∑ C ∈ T.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ C.card = if T = ∅ then 1 else 0 := by
  have := Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card (x := T)
  split_ifs at this ⊢ <;> exact_mod_cast this

theorem mobius_tail_zero_or_one {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (T : Finset α) :
    ∑ C ∈ T.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ C.card = 0 ∨ ∑ C ∈ T.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ C.card = 1 := by
  rw [mobius_tail]; split_ifs <;> simp

open Classical in
/-- **First-forbidden-prefix classification** of the divisor sum of `ℓ = μ · 1_Adm`. -/
theorem dsum_ellW_classification (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (D : Finset γ) (hD : D.Nonempty) :
    dsum (ellW cond) D =
      (((D.erase (D.min' hD)).powerset.filter
        fun A => FirstFail cond (insert (D.min' hD) A)).card : ℝ) := by
  set m := D.min' hD with hm
  have hmD : m ∈ D := min'_mem D hD
  have hlt : ∀ A ∈ (D.erase m).powerset, ∀ q ∈ A, m < q := by
    intro A hA q hq
    have hq' := mem_powerset.1 hA hq
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (min'_le D q (mem_of_mem_erase hq')) (Ne.symm (ne_of_mem_erase hq'))
  unfold dsum
  conv_lhs => rw [← insert_erase hmD]
  rw [sum_powerset_insert (notMem_erase m D), ← sum_add_distrib, card_filter]
  push_cast
  refine sum_congr rfl fun A hA => ?_
  have hmA : m ∉ A := fun h => lt_irrefl m (hlt A hA m h)
  rw [firstFail_insert_iff cond (hlt A hA)]
  unfold ellW
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hmA]
  simp only [adm_insert_min cond (hlt A hA)]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd A.card with he | ho
  · by_cases hadm : Adm cond A <;> by_cases hc : cond A m <;>
      simp [hadm, he, hc, pow_succ, Even.neg_one_pow he]
  · have hne : ¬ Even A.card := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 ho
    by_cases hadm : Adm cond A <;> simp [hadm, hne, pow_succ, Odd.neg_one_pow ho]

/-- **Positivity of the rough sieve**: `∑_{A ⊆ D} ℓ(A) ≥ 1_{D = ∅}`. -/
theorem dsum_ellW_ge (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (D : Finset γ) :
    (if D = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum (ellW cond) D := by
  rcases D.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hD
  · simp [dsum, ellW_empty]
  · rw [if_neg hD.ne_empty, dsum_ellW_classification cond D hD]
    exact Nat.cast_nonneg _

theorem dsum_ellW_nonneg (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (D : Finset γ) :
    0 ≤ dsum (ellW cond) D :=
  le_trans (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (dsum_ellW_ge cond D)

/-- **Rounded rough sieve positivity**: `S_{ℓ_rd}(D) ≥ 1(no rough atom in D)`. -/
theorem dsum_ellRd_ge (U : Finset γ) (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) (D : Finset γ) :
    (if D ∩ U = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum (ellRd U w X) D := by
  rw [dsum_inter (ellRd_supported U w X)]
  have : dsum (ellRd U w X) (D ∩ U) = dsum (ellW (roundedCond w X)) (D ∩ U) := by
    unfold dsum
    refine sum_congr rfl fun A hA => ?_
    have : A ⊆ U := (mem_powerset.1 hA).trans inter_subset_right
    simp [ellRd, this]
  rw [this]
  exact dsum_ellW_ge _ _

theorem dsum_ellRd_nonneg (U : Finset γ) (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) (D : Finset γ) :
    0 ≤ dsum (ellRd U w X) D :=
  le_trans (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (dsum_ellRd_ge U w X D)

/-- **Support/level bound**: an admissible modulus has `∏_{p∈A} w(p) ≤ X`. -/
theorem ellW_support_prod_le {w : γ → ℝ} {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) {A : Finset γ}
    (hw1 : ∀ p ∈ A, 1 ≤ w p) (hmono : ∀ p ∈ A, ∀ q ∈ A, p ≤ q → w p ≤ w q)
    (hA : Adm (roundedCond w X) A) : ∏ p ∈ A, w p ≤ X := by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simpa using hX
  set m := A.min' hne
  have hmA : m ∈ A := min'_mem A hne
  have hmin : ∀ q ∈ A, m ≤ q := fun q hq => min'_le A q hq
  have hc := hA m hmA
  rw [above_eq_erase_of_min hmin] at hc
  have hwm : 1 ≤ w m := hw1 m hmA
  rw [← mul_prod_erase A w hmA]
  have hP : ∀ B ⊆ A, 1 ≤ ∏ q ∈ B, w q := fun B hB => by
    have := prod_le_prod (s := B) (f := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (g := w) (fun _ _ => zero_le_one)
      (fun q hq => hw1 q (hB hq))
    simpa using this
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd (A.erase m).card with he | ho
  · have h3 := hc he
    unfold roundedCond at h3
    have hP1 := hP _ (erase_subset m A)
    nlinarith [pow_le_pow_right₀ hwm (show 1 ≤ 3 by norm_num), pow_one (w m)]
  · have hne' : (A.erase m).Nonempty := by
      rw [← card_pos]; exact ho.pos
    set m2 := (A.erase m).min' hne'
    have hm2 : m2 ∈ A.erase m := min'_mem _ hne'
    have hm2A : m2 ∈ A := mem_of_mem_erase hm2
    have hmm2 : m < m2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hmin m2 hm2A) (Ne.symm (ne_of_mem_erase hm2))
    have habove : above A m2 = (A.erase m).erase m2 := by
      ext q; simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_erase]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hq, hlt⟩
        exact ⟨ne_of_gt hlt, ne_of_gt (lt_trans hmm2 hlt), hq⟩
      · rintro ⟨hq2, hqm, hq⟩
        exact ⟨hq, lt_of_le_of_ne ((A.erase m).min'_le q (mem_erase.2 ⟨hqm, hq⟩))
          (Ne.symm hq2)⟩
    have hcard : Even (above A m2).card := by
      rw [habove, card_erase_of_mem hm2]
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ho
      exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
    have h3 := hA m2 hm2A hcard
    rw [habove] at h3
    unfold roundedCond at h3
    rw [← mul_prod_erase (A.erase m) w hm2]
    have hwm2 : 1 ≤ w m2 := hw1 m2 hm2A
    have hle : w m ≤ w m2 := hmono m hmA m2 hm2A hmm2.le
    have hP2 := hP ((A.erase m).erase m2) ((erase_subset m2 _).trans (erase_subset m A))
    set Q := ∏ q ∈ (A.erase m).erase m2, w q
    have : w m * (w m2 * Q) ≤ Q * w m2 ^ 3 := by
      have h1 : w m * w m2 ≤ w m2 ^ 3 := by
        have a : w m * w m2 ≤ w m2 * w m2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (by linarith)
        have b : w m2 * w m2 * 1 ≤ w m2 * w m2 * w m2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwm2 (by positivity)
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
    linarith

end FirstForbiddenPrefix
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.CellColouring

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §8: independent coefficient factorization

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The small-prime factor is placed into the FIRST bin:

    Λ_ω = (β_sm^+ ⋆ G_{0,ω}) ⋆ (G_{1,ω} ⋆ G_{2,ω}).

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* `conv_assoc_disjoint` — associativity of `⋆` for weights on pairwise disjoint universes;
* **`beta_G0_oneBounded`** — `|β_sm^+ ⋆ G_0| ≤ 1` (disjoint smooth/rough support; uses only the
  one-boundedness of `β` from the `SmallPrimeRosserProvider` contract);
* `G1_G2_oneBounded`, `G1_G2_rough` — the second factor is one-bounded and rough-supported;
* **`coloured_weight_source_contract`** — for every colouring `ω`, `Λ_ω = g ⋆ h` with `g`, `h`
  one-bounded, `g` supported on (small ∪ rough) primes and `h` on rough primes: the V16-style
  bilinear source shape `λ(r) = Σ_{uv=r} g(u) h(v)` — proved from the collapse lemma, NOT merely
  from a factorization of the integer support;
* **`colouring_factorization_identity`** — `β ⋆ 1_{cell pattern} = π^{-1} E_ω[Λ_ω]`.

Firewall (FINITE REGRESSION):
* **`literal_cell_convolution_multiplicity_two`** — the literal cell-indicator convolution
  `(1_C ⋆ 1_C)(143) = 2` for the cell `C = {11, 13}`: the old multiplicity-two error;
* `colour_convolution_le_one` — the coloured convolution is always `≤ 1`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace IndependentFactorization

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve CompletedPositiveWeight CellColouring

section Generic

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

theorem supportedIn_inter {f : Finset γ → ℝ} {U V : Finset γ} (hU : SupportedIn f U)
    (hV : SupportedIn f V) : SupportedIn f (U ∩ V) :=
  fun A hA => subset_inter (hU A hA) (hV A hA)

/-- **Associativity** of `⋆` on pairwise disjoint universes. -/
theorem conv_assoc_disjoint {f g h : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 U3 : Finset γ}
    (hf : SupportedIn f U1) (hg : SupportedIn g U2) (hh : SupportedIn h U3)
    (d12 : Disjoint U1 U2) (d13 : Disjoint U1 U3) (d23 : Disjoint U2 U3) :
    conv f (conv g h) = conv (conv f g) h := by
  funext A
  rw [conv_collapse hf (conv_supported hg hh) (disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨d12, d13⟩),
    conv_collapse (conv_supported hf hg) hh (disjoint_union_left.2 ⟨d13, d23⟩),
    conv_collapse hg hh d23, conv_collapse hf hg d12]
  rw [if_pos inter_subset_right, if_pos inter_subset_right]
  have e1 : A ∩ (U2 ∪ U3) ∩ U2 = A ∩ (U1 ∪ U2) ∩ U2 := by
    ext p; simp only [mem_inter, mem_union]; tauto
  have e2 : A ∩ (U2 ∪ U3) ∩ U3 = A ∩ U3 := by
    ext p; simp only [mem_inter, mem_union]; tauto
  have e3 : A ∩ U1 = A ∩ (U1 ∪ U2) ∩ U1 := by
    ext p; simp only [mem_inter, mem_union]; tauto
  rw [e1, e2, ← e3, show U1 ∪ (U2 ∪ U3) = U1 ∪ U2 ∪ U3 from (union_assoc _ _ _).symm]
  split_ifs <;> ring

/-- The bilinear source-class coefficient shape `λ = g ⋆ h`, `g, h` one-bounded,
`g` on `Us ∪ Ur`, `h` on the rough universe `Ur`. -/
def SourceFactorization (lam : Finset γ → ℝ) (Us Ur : Finset γ) : Prop :=
  ∃ g h : Finset γ → ℝ, OneBounded g ∧ OneBounded h ∧ SupportedIn g (Us ∪ Ur) ∧
    SupportedIn h Ur ∧ lam = conv g h

end Generic

section Coloured

variable {α J : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
  (cell : α → J) (Us Ur : Finset α) (kbin : Fin 3 → J → ℕ) (β : Finset α → ℝ)

/-- The coloured completed coefficient `Λ_ω = (β ⋆ G_0) ⋆ (G_1 ⋆ G_2)`. -/
noncomputable def colouredWeight (ω : α → Fin 3) : Finset α → ℝ :=
  conv (conv β (G cell Ur kbin 0 ω)) (conv (G cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G cell Ur kbin 2 ω))

variable {Us Ur β}

/-- **`|β ⋆ G_0| ≤ 1`**. -/
theorem beta_G0_oneBounded (hβ : SupportedIn β Us) (hβ1 : OneBounded β) (hd : Disjoint Us Ur)
    (ω : α → Fin 3) : OneBounded (conv β (G cell Ur kbin 0 ω)) :=
  conv_oneBounded_of_disjoint hβ (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 0 ω) hd hβ1
    (G_oneBounded cell Ur kbin 0 ω)

theorem G1_G2_oneBounded (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    OneBounded (conv (G cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G cell Ur kbin 2 ω)) :=
  conv_oneBounded_of_disjoint (G_supported cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 2 ω)
    (colourClass_disjoint ω (by decide)) (G_oneBounded cell Ur kbin 1 ω)
    (G_oneBounded cell Ur kbin 2 ω)

theorem G1_G2_rough (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    SupportedIn (conv (G cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G cell Ur kbin 2 ω)) Ur := by
  have := conv_supported (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 1 ω)
    (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 2 ω)
  rwa [union_self] at this

/-- **The coloured weight has the bilinear source-class shape.** -/
theorem coloured_weight_source_contract (hβ : SupportedIn β Us) (hβ1 : OneBounded β)
    (hd : Disjoint Us Ur) (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    SourceFactorization (colouredWeight cell Ur kbin β ω) Us Ur :=
  ⟨_, _, beta_G0_oneBounded cell kbin hβ hβ1 hd ω, G1_G2_oneBounded cell kbin ω,
    conv_supported hβ (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 0 ω), G1_G2_rough cell kbin ω, rfl⟩

theorem colourConv_supported (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    SupportedIn (colourConv cell Ur kbin ω) (Ur ∩ (colourClass ω 0 ∪ (colourClass ω 1 ∪
      colourClass ω 2))) := by
  unfold colourConv
  refine supportedIn_inter ?_ ?_
  · have := conv_supported (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 0 ω)
      (conv_supported (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 2 ω))
    simpa using this
  · exact conv_supported (G_supported cell Ur kbin 0 ω)
      (conv_supported (G_supported cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 2 ω))

/-- `β ⋆ colourConv = (β ⋆ G_0) ⋆ (G_1 ⋆ G_2)` (associativity on disjoint universes). -/
theorem colouredWeight_eq (hβ : SupportedIn β Us) (hd : Disjoint Us Ur) (ω : α → Fin 3) :
    conv β (colourConv cell Ur kbin ω) = colouredWeight cell Ur kbin β ω := by
  unfold colourConv colouredWeight
  refine conv_assoc_disjoint hβ
    (supportedIn_inter (G_supported_rough cell Ur kbin 0 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 0 ω))
    (supportedIn_inter (G1_G2_rough cell kbin ω)
      (conv_supported (G_supported cell Ur kbin 1 ω) (G_supported cell Ur kbin 2 ω))) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_left hd
  · exact disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_left hd
  · rw [disjoint_left]
    intro p hp hp'
    simp only [mem_inter, mem_union, colourClass, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hp hp'
    rcases hp'.2 with h | h <;> rw [hp.2] at h <;> exact absurd h (by decide)

open Classical in
/-- **Exact factorization identity**: `(β ⋆ 1_{cell pattern})(A) = π^{-1} E_ω[Λ_ω(A)]`. -/
theorem colouring_factorization_identity (hβ : SupportedIn β Us) (hd : Disjoint Us Ur)
    (A : Finset α) :
    conv β (fun B => if CellPattern cell Ur kbin B then (1 : ℝ) else 0) A =
      (piConst kbin)⁻¹ * colourExp (fun ω => colouredWeight cell Ur kbin β ω A) := by
  simp_rw [← colouredWeight_eq cell kbin hβ hd]
  unfold conv colourExp
  simp_rw [exact_colouring_identity cell Ur kbin]
  unfold colourExp
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := (univ : Finset (α → Fin 3)))]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun B _ => sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
  ring

end Coloured

/-! ### Firewall: the literal cell-indicator convolution -/

/-- The literal indicator of the cell `C = {11, 13}` (primes in `[11, 13]`). -/
def literalCellInd (n : ℕ) : ℕ := if Nat.Prime n ∧ 11 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 13 then 1 else 0

/-- Literal Dirichlet convolution over `ℕ`. -/
def literalConv (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ ab ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, f ab.1 * g ab.2

/-- **Firewall**: the literal cell-indicator convolution counts `143 = 11·13 = 13·11` twice. -/
theorem literal_cell_convolution_multiplicity_two :
    literalConv literalCellInd literalCellInd 143 = 2 := by decide

/-- The coloured convolution never exceeds one. -/
theorem colour_convolution_le_one {α J : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq J] (cell : α → J) (Ur : Finset α) (kbin : Fin 3 → J → ℕ) (ω : α → Fin 3)
    (A : Finset α) : colourConv cell Ur kbin ω A ≤ 1 := by
  rw [colourConv_eq]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

end IndependentFactorization
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV21.Ledger
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.PackingRanges
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22: ledger (append-only)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The V22 ledger is the complete V21 ledger followed by the V22 rows.  The literal cell-indicator
convolution is `REPAIRED / RETIRED` (replaced by the exact colouring identity).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace Ledger

open ResearchBankV16.Ledger

def v22New : List RowV16 :=
  [ .new "exact positive-sieve parameters (vartheta, rho, vartheta0, b_z, s0)" .finiteRegression
  , .new "fixed exceptional prime set E, P_E kept explicit (auxiliary presieve)" .leanBank
  , .new "small-prime Rosser upper weight (beta = 2) satisfies finite contract" .leanBank
  , .new "rounded rough-sieve first-forbidden-prefix positivity" .leanBank
  , .new "completed positive weight Lambda_new^+ = mu_E * beta * ell_rd" .leanBank
  , .new "completed support budget P_E x^rho x^vartheta0" .leanBank
  , .new "exact cell-colouring identity" .leanBank
  , .new "independent coefficient factorization" .leanBank
  , .new "literal cell-indicator convolution (multiplicity 2 at 143)" .repairedRetired
  , .new "packing / range margins" .leanBank
  , .new "normalized-cost factorization and V21 monotonicity for actual weights" .leanBank
  , .new "Rosser scalar asymptotic" .externalProvider
  , .new "prime harmonic tuple rounding estimate" .externalProvider
  , .new "completed cost bound F(s0) + 1/10000 + o(1)" .leanConditional
  , .new "Erdős #287" .open ]

/-- The complete V22 ledger. -/
def v22Ledger : List RowV16 := ResearchBankV21.Ledger.v21Ledger ++ v22New

theorem v22_preserves_v21_ledger :
    v22Ledger.take ResearchBankV21.Ledger.v21Ledger.length = ResearchBankV21.Ledger.v21Ledger ∧
      ∀ r ∈ ResearchBankV21.Ledger.v21Ledger, r ∈ v22Ledger :=
  ⟨List.take_left, fun _ hr => List.mem_append_left _ hr⟩

def clsOf (n : String) : Option SemClass := ((v22New.find? fun r => r.nm = n).bind RowV16.cls?)

theorem v22_final_status :
    clsOf "rounded rough-sieve first-forbidden-prefix positivity" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "completed positive weight Lambda_new^+ = mu_E * beta * ell_rd" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "exact cell-colouring identity" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "independent coefficient factorization" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "packing / range margins" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "Rosser scalar asymptotic" = some .externalProvider ∧
    clsOf "literal cell-indicator convolution (multiplicity 2 at 143)" = some .repairedRetired ∧
    clsOf "Erdős #287" = some .open := by
  decide

theorem v22_erdos287_open : ∀ r ∈ v22New, r.nm = "Erdős #287" → r.cls? = some .open := by
  decide

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §9: packing / range ledger

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Exact added budgets (FINITE REGRESSION / parameter record):

    rho = 1/1000000,   sigma = 1/19000,   eta = 1/1100.

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK, exact rational arithmetic):
* `repaired_margins` — the four repaired margins as supplied:
  `216791/209000000 > 0`, `13/2750 > 0`, `18038791/209000000 > 0`, `38938791/209000000 > 0`;
* `margin_relations` — exact relations among the supplied margins
  (`m₄ = m₃ + 1/10`, `m₃ = m₁ + 469/5500`) — recorded, not reinterpreted;
* `support_exponent_budget` — `rho + vartheta0 = vartheta` (the completed support
  `P_E · x^{rho} · x^{vartheta0} = P_E · x^{vartheta}`, `P_E` kept explicitly);
* `rho_genuine_power` — `rho > 0` and `x^rho → ∞`: rho is a genuine polynomial exponent, NOT
  `x^{o(1)}`;
* `completed_weight_independent_of_HB_length` — `Λ_new^+` takes no Heath-Brown length
  argument: the SAME weight is used for every `N` (its valid bilinear representation — the
  colouring allocation — may depend on `N`).

Caveat: the formulas producing the four margins from (`rho`, `sigma`, `eta`) were not supplied
to this run; the margins are recorded exactly as given and only their positivity (and the exact
relations above) is certified.  Cell inflation is paid by the rounded endpoints `w(p)` inside
`ℓ_rd` (the level condition is imposed on `w`, not on `p`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace PackingRanges

open PositiveSieveParameters CompletedPositiveWeight

/-- `sigma = 1/19000`. -/
def sigma : ℚ := 1 / 19000
/-- `eta = 1/1100`. -/
def eta : ℚ := 1 / 1100

/-- The four supplied repaired margins. -/
def margin1 : ℚ := 216791 / 209000000
def margin2 : ℚ := 13 / 2750
def margin3 : ℚ := 18038791 / 209000000
def margin4 : ℚ := 38938791 / 209000000

/-- **The four repaired margins are positive.** -/
theorem repaired_margins : 0 < margin1 ∧ 0 < margin2 ∧ 0 < margin3 ∧ 0 < margin4 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num [margin1, margin2, margin3, margin4]

theorem margin_relations : margin4 = margin3 + 1 / 10 ∧ margin3 = margin1 + 469 / 5500 := by
  constructor <;> norm_num [margin1, margin3, margin4]

theorem budgets_pos : 0 < rho ∧ 0 < sigma ∧ 0 < eta := by
  refine ⟨rho_pos, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num [sigma, eta]

/-- `rho + vartheta0 = vartheta`. -/
theorem support_exponent_budget : rho + vartheta0 = vartheta := rho_add_vartheta0

/-- rho is a genuine polynomial exponent (not `x^{o(1)}`). -/
theorem rho_genuine_power : 0 < rho ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ ((rho : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
  ⟨rho_pos, rho_exponent_not_o1⟩

/-- The completed weight does not depend on the Heath-Brown length `N`. -/
theorem completed_weight_independent_of_HB_length (E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ) (level X : ℝ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (N₁ N₂ : ℕ) :
    (fun _ : ℕ => LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) N₁ =
      (fun _ : ℕ => LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) N₂ := rfl

end PackingRanges
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §1: exact positive-sieve parameters

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Exact rational parameters (FINITE REGRESSION / parameter record, all identities kernel-checked):

    vartheta  = 273/500,        rho = 1/1000000,
    vartheta0 = vartheta - rho = 545999/1000000,
    b_z       = 501/1000        (z = x^{b_z} at the provider level only),
    s0        = vartheta0 / b_z  with 1 < s0 < 3,
    nu(S)     = rho / S,        u = x^{nu},       R(S) = ⌊vartheta0 / nu(S)⌋.

The quantifier order used everywhere in V22–V24 is

    choose S  →  choose tau  →  then x → ∞,

recorded by `QuantifierOrder` (an `∀ ε, ∃ S, ∃ τ, ∃ x₀, ∀ x ≥ x₀` shape) and never reversed.

`rho_exponent_not_o1`: `x^rho → ∞` — rho is a genuine polynomial exponent, NOT `x^{o(1)}`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace PositiveSieveParameters

/-- `vartheta = 273/500`. -/
def vartheta : ℚ := 273 / 500
/-- `rho = 1/1000000`. -/
def rho : ℚ := 1 / 1000000
/-- `vartheta0 = vartheta - rho`. -/
def vartheta0 : ℚ := vartheta - rho
/-- `b_z = 501/1000`. -/
def b_z : ℚ := 501 / 1000
/-- `s0 = vartheta0 / b_z`. -/
def s0 : ℚ := vartheta0 / b_z
/-- `nu(S) = rho / S`. -/
def nu (S : ℕ) : ℚ := rho / S
/-- `R(S) = ⌊vartheta0 / nu(S)⌋`, the maximal number of rough prime atoms. -/
def R (S : ℕ) : ℕ := ⌊vartheta0 / nu S⌋₊

theorem vartheta0_eq : vartheta0 = 545999 / 1000000 := by norm_num [vartheta0, vartheta, rho]

theorem rho_add_vartheta0 : rho + vartheta0 = vartheta := by
  simp only [vartheta0]; ring

theorem s0_eq : s0 = 545999 / 501000 := by norm_num [s0, vartheta0, vartheta, rho, b_z]

theorem one_lt_s0 : 1 < s0 ∧ s0 < 3 := by rw [s0_eq]; norm_num

theorem b_z_gt_half : (1 : ℚ) / 2 < b_z := by norm_num [b_z]

theorem rho_pos : 0 < rho := by norm_num [rho]

theorem nu_pos {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) : 0 < nu S := by
  unfold nu; exact div_pos rho_pos (by exact_mod_cast hS)

theorem nu_le_b_z {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) : nu S ≤ b_z := by
  unfold nu
  have : (1 : ℚ) ≤ S := by exact_mod_cast hS
  calc rho / S ≤ rho := div_le_self rho_pos.le this
    _ ≤ b_z := by norm_num [rho, b_z]

/-- `R(S) · nu(S) ≤ vartheta0`. -/
theorem R_mul_nu_le {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) : (R S : ℚ) * nu S ≤ vartheta0 := by
  have hn := nu_pos hS
  have := Nat.floor_le (a := vartheta0 / nu S) (div_nonneg (by rw [vartheta0_eq]; norm_num) hn.le)
  unfold R
  calc (⌊vartheta0 / nu S⌋₊ : ℚ) * nu S ≤ vartheta0 / nu S * nu S :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hn.le
    _ = vartheta0 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hn.ne'

/-- **rho is a genuine polynomial exponent**: `x^rho → ∞` (it is NOT `x^{o(1)}`). -/
theorem rho_exponent_not_o1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ ((rho : ℚ) : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
  tendsto_rpow_atTop (by exact_mod_cast rho_pos)

/-- The quantifier order `S → tau → x` for an eventual bound `bound S τ x ≤ target + ε`. -/
def QuantifierOrder (bound : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (target : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, 0 < S ∧ ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀, bound S τ x ≤ target + ε

end PositiveSieveParameters
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287
