@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=14747 sha256=40268648fb8261f3a1f45d4ae2faf61de3c66fa62473ef56b5377be6808ca2b0 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV22/RosserCostProvider.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.CellColouring
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV21.NormalizedSieveMonotonicity
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Harmonic.EulerMascheroni

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §10: Rosser cost as an explicit provider

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Finite part (LEAN BANK)

* `costU U w q = (Σ_{A ⊆ U} w(A) ∏_{p∈A} q_p) / ∏_{p∈U} (1 - q_p)` — the normalized sieve cost
  of an atom-set weight on a finite prime universe `U`;
* `costU_eq_normCost` — it IS the V21 functional `C_λ(q)` of the pulled-back weight (bridge);
* **`costU_mono`** — V21 monotonicity for the actual weights: if the divisor sums are `≥ 0`
  (e.g. `ℓ_rd`, `β_sm^+`, `Λ_new^+`) then `q ≤ h < 1` implies `cost(q) ≤ cost(h)`;
* **`costU_conv`** — costs multiply over disjoint prime universes:
  `C_{f⋆g}(q) = C_f(q) · C_g(q)`;
* `thinLayer_length_le_R` — a thin-layer tuple with all `t_i ≥ nu` and total `≤ vartheta0` has
  at most `R = ⌊vartheta0/nu⌋` atoms;
* `CnuR S` — the explicit finite rounding constant
  `C_{nu,R} = vartheta0/3 · Σ_{k=1}^{R} ⌈k/2⌉ nu^{-k} (b_z - nu)^{k-1}`, `CnuR_pos`.

## Analytic part (EXTERNAL PROVIDER interfaces, never constructed)

* `DimensionOneDensity h K` — `h(p) = 1/p + O_K(1/p²)` and the two-sided Mertens condition;
* `RosserScalarProvider` — the ordinary dimension-one Rosser asymptotic, in ε/eventual form:
  small-prime cost `≤ F(S) + ε`, unrounded rough cost `≤ F(s0) + ε`, `F(s) = 2e^γ/s` on
  `[1,3]`, `F(S) → 1`;
* `PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider` — rounding error `≤ C_{nu,R} τ + ε` (thin-layer prime harmonic
  tuple estimate).

## Conditional consequence (LEAN CONDITIONAL)

* **`completed_cost_bound`** — in the quantifier order `S → τ → x`:
  `C_{β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd}(h) ≤ F(s0) + 1/10000 + ε` eventually, for every `ε > 0`
  (the `o(1)` is represented by the explicit `ε`/eventual quantifiers).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace RosserCostProvider

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve CompletedPositiveWeight CellColouring PositiveSieveParameters
open ResearchBankV21.FiniteSieveSetup ResearchBankV21.NormalizedSieveMonotonicity

section Cost

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- Numerator `Σ_{A ⊆ U} w(A) ∏_{p∈A} q_p`. -/
def numerU (U : Finset γ) (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (q : γ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ A ∈ U.powerset, w A * ∏ p ∈ A, q p

/-- Denominator `∏_{p∈U} (1 - q_p)`. -/
def denomU (U : Finset γ) (q : γ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∏ p ∈ U, (1 - q p)

/-- **Normalized sieve cost on the universe `U`.** -/
noncomputable def costU (U : Finset γ) (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (q : γ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  numerU U w q / denomU U q

/-- Pull-back of an atom-set weight to the finite type `U`. -/
def pull (U : Finset γ) (w : Finset γ → ℝ) : Finset U → ℝ :=
  fun A => w (A.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ U)))

theorem sum_univ_pull (U : Finset γ) (F : Finset γ → ℝ) :
    ∑ A : Finset U, F (A.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ U))) = ∑ B ∈ U.powerset, F B := by
  refine sum_nbij' (fun A => A.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ U)))
    (fun B => B.subtype (· ∈ U)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro A _
    rw [mem_powerset]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hx
    exact y.2
  · intro _ _; exact mem_univ _
  · intro A _
    ext x; simp
  · intro B hB
    exact subtype_map_of_mem fun x hx => mem_powerset.1 hB hx
  · intro _ _; rfl

theorem divSum_pull (U : Finset γ) (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (S : Finset U) :
    divSum (pull U w) S = dsum w (S.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ U))) := by
  unfold divSum dsum pull
  refine sum_nbij' (fun A => A.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ U)))
    (fun B => B.subtype (· ∈ U)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro A hA
    rw [mem_powerset] at hA ⊢
    exact map_subset_map.2 hA
  · intro B hB
    rw [mem_powerset] at hB ⊢
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_subtype] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := mem_map.1 (hB hx)
    have : y = x := Subtype.ext hyx
    exact this ▸ hy
  · intro A _
    ext x; simp
  · intro B hB
    rw [mem_powerset] at hB
    refine subtype_map_of_mem fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 (hB hx)
    exact y.2
  · intro _ _; rfl

/-- **Bridge**: `costU` is the V21 normalized functional of the pulled-back weight. -/
theorem costU_eq_normCost (U : Finset γ) (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (q : γ → ℝ) :
    costU U w q = normCost (pull U w) (fun p : U => q p) := by
  unfold costU normCost numerU numer denomU denom pull
  congr 1
  · rw [← sum_univ_pull U (fun B => w B * ∏ p ∈ B, q p)]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun A _ => ?_
    rw [prod_map]; rfl
  · rw [← prod_coe_sort]

/-- **V21 monotonicity for actual weights**: nonnegative divisor sums + `q ≤ h < 1`. -/
theorem costU_mono {U : Finset γ} {w : Finset γ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum w D) {q h : γ → ℝ}
    (hq0 : ∀ p ∈ U, 0 ≤ q p) (hqh : ∀ p ∈ U, q p ≤ h p) (hh : ∀ p ∈ U, h p < 1) :
    costU U w q ≤ costU U w h := by
  rw [costU_eq_normCost, costU_eq_normCost]
  exact normCost_mono _ (fun S => by rw [divSum_pull]; exact hw _)
    (fun p => hq0 p p.2) (fun p => hqh p p.2) (fun p => hh p p.2)

/-- **Costs multiply over disjoint prime universes.** -/
theorem costU_conv {f g : Finset γ → ℝ} {U1 U2 : Finset γ} (hf : SupportedIn f U1)
    (hg : SupportedIn g U2) (hd : Disjoint U1 U2) (q : γ → ℝ) :
    costU (U1 ∪ U2) (conv f g) q = costU U1 f q * costU U2 g q := by
  unfold costU
  rw [div_mul_div_comm]
  congr 1
  · unfold numerU
    rw [sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
    refine sum_nbij' (fun A => (A ∩ U1, A ∩ U2)) (fun BC => BC.1 ∪ BC.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro A _
      simp only [mem_product, mem_powerset]
      exact ⟨inter_subset_right, inter_subset_right⟩
    · intro BC hBC
      simp only [mem_product, mem_powerset] at hBC
      rw [mem_powerset]
      exact union_subset_union hBC.1 hBC.2
    · intro A hA
      rw [mem_powerset] at hA
      simp only
      rw [← inter_union_distrib_left, inter_eq_left.2 hA]
    · intro BC hBC
      simp only [mem_product, mem_powerset] at hBC
      obtain ⟨B, C⟩ := BC
      simp only at hBC ⊢
      have h1 : (B ∪ C) ∩ U1 = B := by
        rw [union_inter_distrib_right, inter_eq_left.2 hBC.1,
          disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 (disjoint_of_subset_left hBC.2 hd.symm), union_empty]
      have h2 : (B ∪ C) ∩ U2 = C := by
        rw [union_inter_distrib_right, inter_eq_left.2 hBC.2,
          disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 (disjoint_of_subset_left hBC.1 hd), empty_union]
      rw [h1, h2]
    · intro A hA
      rw [mem_powerset] at hA
      simp only
      rw [conv_collapse hf hg hd, if_pos hA]
      have hdis : Disjoint (A ∩ U1) (A ∩ U2) :=
        disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_right (disjoint_of_subset_right inter_subset_right hd)
      have hAu : A = (A ∩ U1) ∪ (A ∩ U2) := by
        rw [← inter_union_distrib_left, inter_eq_left.2 hA]
      conv_lhs => rw [hAu, prod_union hdis]
      rw [← hAu]
      ring
  · unfold denomU
    rw [prod_union hd]

end Cost

/-! ### Thin layers and the explicit rounding constant -/

/-- The thin-layer condition for an ordered tuple `t₁ ≥ t₂ ≥ ⋯` of log-sizes (at index `j`):
`vartheta0/(1+τ) < t₁+⋯+t_{j-1} + 3 t_j ≤ vartheta0`, all `t_i ∈ [nu, b_z]`. -/
def ThinLayer (S : ℕ) (τ : ℚ) (t : List ℚ) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ t, nu S ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b_z) ∧
    vartheta0 / (1 + τ) < (t.take j).sum + 3 * (t.getD j 0) ∧
    (t.take j).sum + 3 * (t.getD j 0) ≤ vartheta0

/-- **Atom count**: all `t_i ≥ nu` and total `≤ vartheta0` force at most `R` atoms. -/
theorem thinLayer_length_le_R {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) (t : List ℚ) (hlow : ∀ x ∈ t, nu S ≤ x)
    (htot : t.sum ≤ vartheta0) : t.length ≤ R S := by
  have hn := nu_pos hS
  have h1 : (t.length : ℚ) * nu S ≤ t.sum := by
    have := List.card_nsmul_le_sum t (nu S) hlow
    simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using this
  have h2 : (t.length : ℚ) ≤ vartheta0 / nu S := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hn]; linarith
  unfold R
  exact Nat.le_floor h2

/-- The explicit rounding constant
`C_{nu,R} = vartheta0/3 · Σ_{k=1}^{R} ⌈k/2⌉ nu^{-k} (b_z - nu)^{k-1}`. -/
def CnuR (S : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  vartheta0 / 3 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (R S),
    (((k + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (nu S)⁻¹ ^ k * (b_z - nu S) ^ (k - 1)

theorem CnuR_nonneg {S : ℕ} (hS : 0 < S) : 0 ≤ CnuR S := by
  unfold CnuR
  have hn := nu_pos hS
  have hb := nu_le_b_z hS
  refine mul_nonneg (by rw [vartheta0_eq]; norm_num) (sum_nonneg fun k _ => ?_)
  have : 0 ≤ b_z - nu S := by linarith
  positivity

/-! ### Analytic providers (interfaces only) -/

/-- Dimension-one density hypotheses on `h` (outside the exceptional range `p ≤ 2K+2`). -/
structure DimensionOneDensity (h : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ) : Prop where
  range : ∀ p, p.Prime → 2 * K + 2 < p → 0 ≤ h p ∧ h p < 1
  near_one_over_p : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ p, p.Prime → 2 * K + 2 < p → |h p - 1 / p| ≤ C / (p : ℝ) ^ 2
  mertens_two_sided : ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ w z : ℕ, 2 ≤ w → w ≤ z →
    |(∏ p ∈ (Finset.Ico w z).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - h p)⁻¹) - Real.log z / Real.log w| ≤
      L / Real.log w * (Real.log z / Real.log w)

/-- **Rosser scalar provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER): the ordinary dimension-one Rosser
asymptotic for the ACTUAL weights, in ε/eventual form.  `Psm S x`, `Prd S x` are the small and
rough prime universes, `lev x = x^rho`, `X x = x^{vartheta0}`. -/
structure RosserScalarProvider (K : ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ)
    (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  density : DimensionOneDensity h K
  F_rosser : ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 3 → F s = 2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant / s
  F_tendsto_one : Filter.Tendsto (fun S : ℕ => F S) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
  small : ∀ S : ℕ, 0 < S → ∀ ε > 0, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀,
    costU (Psm S x) (ellRd (Psm S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (lev x)) h ≤ F S + ε
  rough_unrounded : ∀ S : ℕ, 0 < S → ∀ ε > 0, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀,
    costU (Prd S x) (ellRd (Prd S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (X x)) h ≤ F (s0 : ℝ) + ε
  small_nonneg : ∀ S x, 0 ≤ costU (Psm S x) (ellRd (Psm S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (lev x)) h

/-- **Prime harmonic tuple provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER): the rounding error of the cell
endpoints `w_τ` is at most `C_{nu,R} τ + ε` eventually. -/
structure PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider (h : ℕ → ℝ) (Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (X : ℝ → ℝ)
    (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  rounding : ∀ S : ℕ, 0 < S → ∀ τ > 0, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x₀,
    costU (Prd S x) (ellRd (Prd S x) (wτ τ x) (X x)) h ≤
      costU (Prd S x) (ellRd (Prd S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (X x)) h + (CnuR S : ℝ) * τ + ε

/-- **Conditional completed-cost bound** in the order `S → τ → x`:
`C_{β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd}(h) ≤ F(s0) + 1/10000 + ε` eventually, for every `ε > 0`. -/
theorem completed_cost_bound {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ}
    {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hR : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X) (hT : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ)
    (hdisj : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x)) :
    QuantifierOrder (fun S τ x => costU (Psm S x ∪ Prd S x)
      (conv (ellRd (Psm S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (lev x)) (ellRd (Prd S x) (wτ τ x) (X x))) h)
      (F (s0 : ℝ) + 1 / 10000) := by
  intro ε hε
  set F0 := F (s0 : ℝ)
  have hF0 : F0 = 2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant / (s0 : ℝ) :=
    hR.F_rosser _ (by exact_mod_cast (one_lt_s0).1.le) (by exact_mod_cast (one_lt_s0).2.le)
  have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < (s0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast lt_trans one_pos one_lt_s0.1
  have hF0pos : 0 < F0 := by
    rw [hF0]; exact div_pos (by positivity) hs0
  -- δ-budget
  set M := F0 + 1 / 10000 + 1 with hM
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by linarith
  set δ := min (ε / (4 * M)) (1 / 40000) with hδ
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ ε / (4 * M) := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ2 : δ ≤ 1 / 40000 := min_le_right _ _
  -- choose S with F(S) ≤ 1 + δ
  obtain ⟨S0, hS0⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hR.F_tendsto_one) δ hδpos
  set S := max S0 1
  have hSpos : 0 < S := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _)
  have hFS : F S ≤ 1 + δ := by
    have := hS0 S (le_max_left _ _)
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at this
    linarith [(abs_lt.1 this).2]
  -- choose τ with C_{nu,R} τ ≤ 1/20000
  set τ : ℝ := 1 / (20000 * ((CnuR S : ℝ) + 1))
  have hC := CnuR_nonneg hSpos
  have hCr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (CnuR S : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hC
  have hτpos : 0 < τ := by positivity
  have hCτ : (CnuR S : ℝ) * τ ≤ 1 / 20000 := by
    have : (CnuR S : ℝ) * τ = (CnuR S : ℝ) / (20000 * ((CnuR S : ℝ) + 1)) := by ring
    rw [this, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨S, hSpos, τ, hτpos, ?_⟩
  -- eventual bounds
  obtain ⟨x1, h1⟩ := hR.small S hSpos δ hδpos
  obtain ⟨x2, h2⟩ := hR.rough_unrounded S hSpos δ hδpos
  obtain ⟨x3, h3⟩ := hT.rounding S hSpos τ hτpos δ hδpos
  refine ⟨max x1 (max x2 x3), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : x1 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hx2 : x2 ≤ x := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  have hx3 : x3 ≤ x := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  show costU _ _ _ ≤ _
  rw [costU_conv (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (hdisj S x)]
  set a := costU (Psm S x) (ellRd (Psm S x) (fun p => (p : ℝ)) (lev x)) h
  set b := costU (Prd S x) (ellRd (Prd S x) (wτ τ x) (X x)) h
  have ha : a ≤ 1 + 2 * δ := by linarith [h1 x hx1]
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := hR.small_nonneg S x
  have hb : b ≤ F0 + 1 / 10000 := by linarith [h2 x hx2, h3 x hx3]
  have hbM : b ≤ M := by linarith
  have hδM : 2 * δ * M ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ1 hMpos.le
    have e : ε / (4 * M) * M = ε / 4 := by field_simp
    rw [e] at this
    linarith
  by_cases hb0 : b ≤ 0
  · have : a * b ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha0 hb0
    linarith
  · push_neg at hb0
    have hab : a * b ≤ (1 + 2 * δ) * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hb0.le
    have h2b : 2 * δ * b ≤ 2 * δ * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbM (by positivity)
    nlinarith

end RosserCostProvider
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §3: the rounded rough sieve (definitions)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Squarefree moduli `d = p₁ ⋯ p_k` are represented by the finite sets `A = {p₁, …, p_k}` of their
prime atoms (over any linearly ordered atom type `γ`; for actual primes `γ = ℕ`).  A weight is a
function `Finset γ → ℝ`.

* `dsum w D = ∑_{A ⊆ D} w A` — the divisor sum `S_w(n)` of a squarefree-supported weight at an
  integer `n` whose set of relevant prime divisors is `D`;
* `SupportedIn w U` — every modulus in the support of `w` has all its atoms in `U`;
* `above A p = {q ∈ A : p < q}` — for `A` ordered decreasingly `p₁ > ⋯ > p_k`, the atoms before
  `p = p_j` are `above A p = {p₁,…,p_{j-1}}`, so `j = |above A p| + 1` and **`j` is odd iff
  `|above A p|` is even**;
* `Adm cond A` — for every odd index `j`, `cond {p₁,…,p_{j-1}} p_j` holds;
* `ellW cond A = μ(A) · 1_{Adm cond A} = (-1)^{|A|} 1_{Adm cond A}`;
* `roundedCond w X B p := (∏_{q∈B} w q) · w(p)³ ≤ X` — the rounded rough condition
  `w(p₁)⋯w(p_{j-1}) w(p_j)³ ≤ x^{vartheta0}` with `X = x^{vartheta0}`;
* `ellRd U w X` — the rounded rough sieve weight `ℓ_rd`, supported on the rough universe `U`;
* `RoundingData U τ w` — cell upper endpoints: `p ≤ w(p) ≤ p^{1+τ}`, monotone in `p`.

Kernel-proved: `dsum_inter` (support restriction), `ellW_empty`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace RoundedRoughSieve

open Finset

section Generic

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- Divisor sum of a squarefree-supported weight: `S_w(D) = ∑_{A ⊆ D} w A`. -/
def dsum (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (D : Finset γ) : ℝ := ∑ A ∈ D.powerset, w A

/-- Support of a weight inside an atom universe `U`. -/
def SupportedIn (w : Finset γ → ℝ) (U : Finset γ) : Prop := ∀ A, w A ≠ 0 → A ⊆ U

/-- One-boundedness `|w| ≤ 1`. -/
def OneBounded (w : Finset γ → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ A, |w A| ≤ 1

/-- **Support restriction**: a weight supported in `U` only sees `D ∩ U`. -/
theorem dsum_inter {w : Finset γ → ℝ} {U : Finset γ} (hw : SupportedIn w U) (D : Finset γ) :
    dsum w D = dsum w (D ∩ U) := by
  unfold dsum
  symm
  refine sum_subset (powerset_mono.2 inter_subset_left) fun A hA hA' => ?_
  by_contra hne
  have h1 := hw A hne
  exact hA' (mem_powerset.2 (subset_inter (mem_powerset.1 hA) h1))

end Generic

section Ordered

variable {γ : Type*} [LinearOrder γ]

/-- The atoms of `A` above `p`: for `A = {p₁ > ⋯ > p_k}` and `p = p_j`, `{p₁,…,p_{j-1}}`. -/
def above (A : Finset γ) (p : γ) : Finset γ := A.filter (p < ·)

/-- Admissibility: at every ODD index `j` (`|above A p_j|` even) the condition holds. -/
def Adm (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (A : Finset γ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ A, Even (above A p).card → cond (above A p) p

open Classical in
/-- `ℓ(A) = μ(A) · 1_{Adm cond A}`. -/
noncomputable def ellW (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (A : Finset γ) : ℝ :=
  if Adm cond A then (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card else 0

theorem adm_empty (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) : Adm cond ∅ := fun p hp => absurd hp (by simp)

theorem ellW_empty (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) : ellW cond ∅ = 1 := by
  simp [ellW, adm_empty]

theorem ellW_abs_le (cond : Finset γ → γ → Prop) (A : Finset γ) : |ellW cond A| ≤ 1 := by
  unfold ellW; split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The rounded rough condition `(∏_{q∈B} w q) · w(p)³ ≤ X`. -/
def roundedCond (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) (B : Finset γ) (p : γ) : Prop :=
  (∏ q ∈ B, w q) * w p ^ 3 ≤ X

open Classical in
/-- **The rounded rough sieve weight** `ℓ_rd`, supported on the rough universe `U`:
`ℓ_rd(d) = μ(d) · 1(∀ odd j, w(p₁)⋯w(p_{j-1}) w(p_j)³ ≤ X)`. -/
noncomputable def ellRd (U : Finset γ) (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) (A : Finset γ) : ℝ :=
  if A ⊆ U then ellW (roundedCond w X) A else 0

theorem ellRd_supported (U : Finset γ) (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : SupportedIn (ellRd U w X) U := by
  intro A hA
  by_contra h
  exact hA (by simp [ellRd, h])

theorem ellRd_oneBounded (U : Finset γ) (w : γ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : OneBounded (ellRd U w X) := by
  intro A; unfold ellRd; split_ifs
  · exact ellW_abs_le _ _
  · simp

end Ordered

/-- Cell rounding data on the rough universe `U ⊆ ℕ`: `p ≤ w(p) ≤ p^{1+τ}`, monotone. -/
structure RoundingData (U : Finset ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  lower : ∀ p ∈ U, (p : ℝ) ≤ w p
  upper : ∀ p ∈ U, w p ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (1 + τ)
  mono : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ q ∈ U, p ≤ q → w p ≤ w q

/-- The trivial rounding `w(p) = p` is admissible for every `τ ≥ 0`. -/
theorem roundingData_id (U : Finset ℕ) (hU : ∀ p ∈ U, 1 ≤ p) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    RoundingData U τ (fun p => (p : ℝ)) where
  lower _ _ := le_rfl
  upper p hp := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hU p hp
    calc (p : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (1 + τ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le this (by linarith)
  mono _ _ _ _ h := by exact_mod_cast h

end RoundedRoughSieve
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3408 sha256=14cff881b4ed29636ff8e9853810e8a1e19eccff378a04f0d06b78b001b9a05f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV22/SmallPrimeUpperSieve.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.FirstForbiddenPrefix
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.ExceptionalPrimeSet

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V22 §5: the small-prime upper sieve

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

* `smallUniverse E u` — the primes `< u` outside the exceptional set `E`;
* `SmallPrimeRosserProvider Psm level` — the FINITE / ALGEBRAIC contract of an upper weight
  `β_sm^+` on the small primes with level `level = x^rho`:
  support in `Psm`, one-bounded, `β(1) = 1`, support below the level, and
  `S_β(n) ≥ 1(no relevant small prime divides n)` (hence `S_β(n) ≥ 0`, `dsum_beta_nonneg`);
* `rosserBeta Psm level` — the ACTUAL ordinary Rosser upper weight of dimension one
  (β = 2): `μ(d) · 1(∀ odd j, p₁⋯p_{j-1} p_j³ ≤ level)`;
* **`rosserSmallProvider`** — the Rosser weight satisfies the contract, kernel-proved from
  first-forbidden-prefix positivity (§4).  So the small-prime upper weight is an actual object,
  constructed without any axiom.

The ANALYTIC input — the normalized cost `F(S) + error` of this weight — is NOT part of this
contract; it is the `RosserScalarProvider` of §10 (EXTERNAL PROVIDER).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV22
namespace SmallPrimeUpperSieve

open Finset RoundedRoughSieve FirstForbiddenPrefix

/-- The small-prime universe: primes `< u` outside `E`. -/
def smallUniverse (E : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range u).filter fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ∉ E

theorem smallUniverse_disjoint (E : Finset ℕ) (u : ℕ) : Disjoint (smallUniverse E u) E := by
  rw [disjoint_left]; intro p hp; exact (mem_filter.1 hp).2.2

/-- **Finite contract of the small-prime Rosser upper weight** (level `level = x^rho`). -/
structure SmallPrimeRosserProvider (Psm : Finset ℕ) (level : ℝ) where
  beta : Finset ℕ → ℝ
  supported : SupportedIn beta Psm
  oneBounded : OneBounded beta
  beta_empty : beta ∅ = 1
  level_supp : ∀ A, beta A ≠ 0 → (∏ p ∈ A, (p : ℝ)) ≤ level
  upper : ∀ D, (if D ∩ Psm = ∅ then 1 else 0) ≤ dsum beta D

theorem SmallPrimeRosserProvider.dsum_beta_nonneg {Psm : Finset ℕ} {level : ℝ}
    (B : SmallPrimeRosserProvider Psm level) (D : Finset ℕ) : 0 ≤ dsum B.beta D :=
  le_trans (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (B.upper D)

/-- The ordinary dimension-one Rosser upper weight (β = 2) on `Psm` at level `level`. -/
noncomputable def rosserBeta (Psm : Finset ℕ) (level : ℝ) : Finset ℕ → ℝ :=
  ellRd Psm (fun p => (p : ℝ)) level

/-- **The Rosser weight satisfies the small-prime contract** (kernel-proved). -/
noncomputable def rosserSmallProvider (Psm : Finset ℕ) (level : ℝ) (hlev : 1 ≤ level)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ Psm, 1 ≤ p) : SmallPrimeRosserProvider Psm level where
  beta := rosserBeta Psm level
  supported := ellRd_supported _ _ _
  oneBounded := ellRd_oneBounded _ _ _
  beta_empty := by simp [rosserBeta, ellRd, ellW_empty]
  level_supp A hA := by
    unfold rosserBeta ellRd at hA
    split_ifs at hA with hsub
    unfold ellW at hA
    split_ifs at hA with hadm
    · exact ellW_support_prod_le hlev (fun p hp => by exact_mod_cast hP p (hsub hp))
        (fun p _ q _ h => by exact_mod_cast h) hadm
    all_goals exact absurd rfl hA
  upper D := dsum_ellRd_ge Psm _ level D

end SmallPrimeUpperSieve
end ResearchBankV22
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.PrincipalCRTMeasure

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §2: the full-lcm principal modulus

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`fullLCM W0 s qs = lcm(W0, s, q₁, …, q_r)` — the COMPLETE modulus `L0` (shared primes counted
once).  Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* `dvd_fullLCM`, `W0_dvd_fullLCM`, `s_dvd_fullLCM`, `q_dvd_fullLCM`, `fullLCM_pos`;
* **`principal_prob_fullLCM`** — the exact principal probability at the full lcm:
  `Prob_i(t ≡ t0 mod L0) = φ(A_i W0)/φ(A_i L0) · 1(gcd(A_i t0 + 1, A_i L0) = 1)`;
* **`principal_sum_fullLCM`** — summed against any test function over the compatible residues:
  `Li/φ(A W0) · Σ_{t0} Prob(t0) F(t0) = Li/φ(A L0) · Σ_{t0} 1(unit) F(t0)`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace FullLCMPrincipal

open Finset PrincipalCRTMeasure

/-- `L0 = lcm(W0, s, q₁, …, q_r)`. -/
def fullLCM (W0 s : ℕ) (qs : List ℕ) : ℕ := (W0 :: s :: qs).foldr Nat.lcm 1

theorem dvd_foldr_lcm : ∀ (l : List ℕ), ∀ x ∈ l, x ∣ l.foldr Nat.lcm 1
  | [], x, hx => absurd hx (by simp)
  | a :: l, x, hx => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _
    · exact dvd_trans (dvd_foldr_lcm l x hx) (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)

theorem foldr_lcm_pos : ∀ (l : List ℕ), (∀ x ∈ l, 0 < x) → 0 < l.foldr Nat.lcm 1
  | [], _ => one_pos
  | a :: l, h => Nat.lcm_pos (h a (by simp)) (foldr_lcm_pos l fun x hx => h x (by simp [hx]))

theorem dvd_fullLCM {W0 s : ℕ} {qs : List ℕ} {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ W0 :: s :: qs) :
    x ∣ fullLCM W0 s qs := dvd_foldr_lcm _ x hx

theorem W0_dvd_fullLCM (W0 s : ℕ) (qs : List ℕ) : W0 ∣ fullLCM W0 s qs :=
  dvd_fullLCM (by simp)

theorem s_dvd_fullLCM (W0 s : ℕ) (qs : List ℕ) : s ∣ fullLCM W0 s qs := dvd_fullLCM (by simp)

theorem q_dvd_fullLCM (W0 s : ℕ) {qs : List ℕ} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ qs) : q ∣ fullLCM W0 s qs :=
  dvd_fullLCM (by simp [hq])

theorem fullLCM_pos {W0 s : ℕ} {qs : List ℕ} (hW : 0 < W0) (hs : 0 < s) (hq : ∀ q ∈ qs, 0 < q) :
    0 < fullLCM W0 s qs := by
  refine foldr_lcm_pos _ fun x hx => ?_
  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
  · exact hW
  rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
  · exact hs
  · exact hq x hx

variable {A W0 s tW : ℕ} {qs : List ℕ}

/-- **The exact principal probability at the COMPLETE modulus `L0 = lcm(W0, s, q₁..q_r)`.** -/
theorem principal_prob_fullLCM (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0) (hs : 0 < s) (hq : ∀ q ∈ qs, 0 < q)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) {t0 : ℕ} (ht0 : t0 < fullLCM W0 s qs)
    (hcompat : t0 ≡ tW [MOD W0]) :
    principalProb A W0 (fullLCM W0 s qs) tW t0 =
      (Nat.totient (A * W0) : ℝ) / Nat.totient (A * fullLCM W0 s qs) *
        (if Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * fullLCM W0 s qs) = 1 then 1 else 0) :=
  principal_prob hA hW (fullLCM_pos hW hs hq) (W0_dvd_fullLCM W0 s qs) hc ht0 hcompat

/-- **Principal sums at the full lcm** (any test function `F`, compatible residues only). -/
theorem principal_sum_fullLCM (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0) (hs : 0 < s) (hq : ∀ q ∈ qs, 0 < q)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) (Li : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Li / Nat.totient (A * W0) *
        ∑ t0 ∈ (range (fullLCM W0 s qs)).filter (· ≡ tW [MOD W0]),
          principalProb A W0 (fullLCM W0 s qs) tW t0 * F t0 =
      Li / Nat.totient (A * fullLCM W0 s qs) *
        ∑ t0 ∈ (range (fullLCM W0 s qs)).filter (· ≡ tW [MOD W0]),
          (if Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * fullLCM W0 s qs) = 1 then 1 else 0) * F t0 := by
  rw [mul_sum, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun t0 ht0 => ?_
  rw [mem_filter, mem_range] at ht0
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
    principal_Li_identity hA hW (fullLCM_pos hW hs hq) (W0_dvd_fullLCM W0 s qs) hc ht0.1 ht0.2]

end FullLCMPrincipal
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5313 sha256=31c6d4e2f98003057912939b94bebecadbe8a117debe3bc4b4ef83271c3dd65a path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV23/GoodPrimeEulerFactor.lean@@
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §4: the good-prime Euler factor

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

At a good prime `p` the pair `(L_i, L_j)` is a unit for exactly `n = p - 2` residues; each of
the `r` spectator forms vanishes at exactly one of them, at DISTINCT residues (`root`
injective).  With Mellin parameters `x_k = p^{-s_k}`, `y_k = p^{-t_k}` the local factor of the
signed divisor square `∏_k (1 - x_k 1_{p|L_k})(1 - y_k 1_{p|L_k})` is

    E_p(s,t) = 1 + 1/(p-2) · Σ_{k=1}^r ( p^{-s_k-t_k} - p^{-s_k} - p^{-t_k} ).

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* `prod_one_add_indicator` — distinct roots: `∏_k (1 + 1_{t=root k} c_k) = 1 + Σ_k 1_{t=root k} c_k`;
* **`local_signed_square_average`** — the finite average of the signed square equals
  `1 + (1/n) Σ_k (x_k y_k - x_k - y_k)`;
* **`eulerFactor_eq_local_average`** — `E_p(s,t)` IS that average (with `n = p - 2`);
* **`signed_square_zero_is_avoidance`** — at zero parameters the signed divisor square is the
  indicator that ALL spectator forms avoid `p`;
* **`eulerFactor_zero`** — `E_p(0,0) = (p - 2 - r)/(p - 2)` = the local probability that all
  spectator forms avoid `p`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace GoodPrimeEulerFactor

open Finset

/-- The good-prime local Euler factor `E_p(s,t)`. -/
noncomputable def eulerFactor (p r : ℕ) (s t : Fin r → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 2) *
    ∑ k, ((p : ℝ) ^ (-(s k + t k)) - (p : ℝ) ^ (-s k) - (p : ℝ) ^ (-t k))

variable {n r : ℕ} (root : Fin r → Fin n)

/-- Distinct roots: at most one indicator is on. -/
theorem prod_one_add_indicator (hroot : Function.Injective root) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (t : Fin n) :
    ∏ k, (1 + (if t = root k then c k else 0)) = 1 + ∑ k, (if t = root k then c k else 0) := by
  by_cases h : ∃ k, t = root k
  · obtain ⟨k0, hk0⟩ := h
    have hother : ∀ k, k ≠ k0 → ¬ t = root k := by
      intro k hk ht; exact hk (hroot (ht.symm.trans hk0))
    rw [prod_eq_single k0 (fun k _ hk => by simp [hother k hk]) (by simp),
      sum_eq_single k0 (fun k _ hk => by simp [hother k hk]) (by simp)]
  · push_neg at h
    simp [h]

/-- The signed square of one spectator form. -/
def signedSq (x y : ℝ) (b : Prop) [Decidable b] : ℝ :=
  (1 - if b then x else 0) * (1 - if b then y else 0)

theorem signedSq_eq (x y : ℝ) (b : Prop) [Decidable b] :
    signedSq x y b = 1 + if b then x * y - x - y else 0 := by
  unfold signedSq; split_ifs <;> ring

/-- **Finite average of the signed divisor square.** -/
theorem local_signed_square_average (hroot : Function.Injective root) (hn : 0 < n)
    (x y : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ t : Fin n, ∏ k, signedSq (x k) (y k) (t = root k) =
      1 + (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ k, (x k * y k - x k - y k) := by
  simp_rw [signedSq_eq]
  simp_rw [prod_one_add_indicator root hroot (fun k => x k * y k - x k - y k)]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, sum_comm]
  have : ∀ k, ∑ t : Fin n, (if t = root k then x k * y k - x k - y k else 0) =
      x k * y k - x k - y k := fun k => by simp
  simp_rw [this]
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

/-- **The Euler factor is the local average of the signed square** (`n = p - 2`, good `p`). -/
theorem eulerFactor_eq_local_average {p : ℕ} (hp : n + 2 = p) (hroot : Function.Injective root)
    (hn : 0 < n) (s t : Fin r → ℝ) :
    eulerFactor p r s t = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ τ : Fin n,
      ∏ k, signedSq ((p : ℝ) ^ (-s k)) ((p : ℝ) ^ (-t k)) (τ = root k) := by
  rw [local_signed_square_average root hroot hn]
  unfold eulerFactor
  have hpn : (p : ℝ) - 2 = n := by rw [← hp]; push_cast; ring
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by rw [← hp]; positivity
  rw [hpn]
  congr 2
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [neg_add, Real.rpow_add hp0]

/-- **At zero parameters the signed divisor square is the avoidance indicator.** -/
theorem signed_square_zero_is_avoidance (τ : Fin n) :
    ∏ k, signedSq 1 1 (τ = root k) = if ∀ k, τ ≠ root k then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : ∀ k, τ ≠ root k
  · rw [if_pos h]; exact prod_eq_one fun k _ => by simp [signedSq, h k]
  · rw [if_neg h]; push_neg at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    exact prod_eq_zero (mem_univ k) (by simp [signedSq, hk])

/-- **`E_p(0,0)` is the local probability that all spectator forms avoid `p`.** -/
theorem eulerFactor_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : n + 2 = p) (hroot : Function.Injective root)
    (hn : 0 < n) :
    eulerFactor p r 0 0 = ((n : ℝ) - r) / n ∧
      eulerFactor p r 0 0 =
        (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ∑ τ : Fin n, (if ∀ k, τ ≠ root k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
  have hav := eulerFactor_eq_local_average root hp hroot hn 0 0
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero] at hav
  simp_rw [signed_square_zero_is_avoidance] at hav
  refine ⟨?_, hav⟩
  unfold eulerFactor
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, add_zero, neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, sum_const, card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hpn : (p : ℝ) - 2 = n := by rw [← hp]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hpn]
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

end GoodPrimeEulerFactor
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Abs
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §7: the hat-reference approximation provider

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## EXTERNAL PROVIDER (interface only; never constructed)

`HatReferenceApproximationProvider K EAB` — the tensor/reference approximation

    E_ij |A - B|² ≤ C (log x)^{-(K+26)}   eventually,   C ≥ 0 fixed.

## Consequences

* `hat_approximation_eventually_small` (LEAN CONDITIONAL) — the provider makes `E_ij|A - B|²`
  eventually `≤ ε` for every `ε > 0` (`log x → ∞`), i.e. it is an `o(1)` error in explicit form.

## Firewall (LEAN BANK)

The piecewise-linear hat interpolant `hat x = max 0 (1 - |x|)` is NOT a smooth cutoff:
* **`hat_not_differentiableAt_zero`** — `hat` is not differentiable at `0`;
* `hat_ne_differentiable` — no everywhere-differentiable function equals `hat`, so the hat
  reference must never be identified with a smooth cutoff.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace HatApproximationProvider

open Filter

/-- **Hat-reference approximation provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed):
`EAB M = E_ij |A - B|²` at scale `M`. -/
structure HatReferenceApproximationProvider (K : ℕ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ M, 0 ≤ EAB M
  bound : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, EAB M ≤ C / Real.log M ^ (K + 26)

/-- **The hat approximation error is eventually `≤ ε`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem hat_approximation_eventually_small {K : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    (P : HatReferenceApproximationProvider K EAB) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, |EAB M| ≤ ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, M1, hM1⟩ := P.bound
  set T : ℝ := max 1 (C / ε)
  refine ⟨max M1 ⌈Real.exp T⌉₊, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have hM1' : M1 ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM
  have hceil : ⌈Real.exp T⌉₊ ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM
  have hMe : Real.exp T ≤ M := le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (by exact_mod_cast hceil)
  have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hMe
  have hlogT : T ≤ Real.log M := by
    rw [← Real.log_exp T]; exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hMe
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := le_max_left _ _
  have hlog1 : 1 ≤ Real.log M := le_trans hT1 hlogT
  have hpow : Real.log M ≤ Real.log M ^ (K + 26) := by
    calc Real.log M = Real.log M ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.log M ^ (K + 26) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hlog1 (by omega)
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log M := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (P.nonneg M)]
  calc EAB M ≤ C / Real.log M ^ (K + 26) := hM1 M hM1'
    _ ≤ C / Real.log M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC hlogpos hpow
    _ ≤ ε := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hlogpos]
      have : C / ε ≤ Real.log M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hlogT
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at this
      linarith

/-- The piecewise-linear hat interpolant. -/
noncomputable def hat (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (1 - |x|)

/-- **The hat interpolant is not differentiable at `0`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem hat_not_differentiableAt_zero : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ hat 0 := by
  intro hd
  have heq : (fun x : ℝ => 1 - hat x) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun x => |x| := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) one_pos] with x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hx
    unfold hat
    rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    ring
  exact not_differentiableAt_abs_zero
    (((differentiableAt_const (1 : ℝ)).sub hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq.symm)

/-- **Firewall**: no everywhere-differentiable (in particular no smooth) cutoff equals `hat`. -/
theorem hat_ne_differentiable (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) : f ≠ hat := by
  rintro rfl
  exact hat_not_differentiableAt_zero (hf 0)

end HatApproximationProvider
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.Ledger
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.PrincipalCRTMeasure
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.FullLCMPrincipal
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23: ledger (append-only)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The V23 ledger is the complete V22 ledger followed by the V23 rows.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace Ledger

open ResearchBankV16.Ledger

def v23New : List RowV16 :=
  [ .new "principal CRT probability phi(A W0)/phi(A L0) * unit indicator" .leanBank
  , .new "full-lcm principal normalizer L0 = lcm(W0, s, q_1..q_r)" .leanBank
  , .new "singular-factor finite cancellation" .leanBank
  , .new "good-prime Euler factor = local signed-square average" .leanBank
  , .new "signed expansion of the principal functional" .leanBank
  , .new "same-weight signed-principal bound M_new <= C(h) * sifted" .leanBank
  , .new "principal Euler/Mellin asymptotic" .externalProvider
  , .new "hat-reference approximation E|A-B|^2 <= C (log x)^-(K+26)" .externalProvider
  , .new "hat interpolant is not a smooth cutoff (firewall)" .leanBank
  , .new "same normalization sifted main term e^-gamma/b_z L(F)/I" .leanConditional
  , .new "exact rational principal slack" .leanBank
  , .new "principal budget M_new <= (2/vartheta0 + 1/5000) W_F + eps" .leanConditional
  , .new "same-weight signed-principal bound (analytic form)" .leanConditional
  , .new "V16 analytic source-class theorem" .externalProvider
  , .new "Erdős #287" .open ]

/-- The complete V23 ledger. -/
def v23Ledger : List RowV16 := ResearchBankV22.Ledger.v22Ledger ++ v23New

theorem v23_preserves_v22_ledger :
    v23Ledger.take ResearchBankV22.Ledger.v22Ledger.length = ResearchBankV22.Ledger.v22Ledger ∧
      ∀ r ∈ ResearchBankV22.Ledger.v22Ledger, r ∈ v23Ledger :=
  ⟨List.take_left, fun _ hr => List.mem_append_left _ hr⟩

def clsOf (n : String) : Option SemClass := ((v23New.find? fun r => r.nm = n).bind RowV16.cls?)

theorem v23_final_status :
    clsOf "principal CRT probability phi(A W0)/phi(A L0) * unit indicator" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "singular-factor finite cancellation" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "principal Euler/Mellin asymptotic" = some .externalProvider ∧
    clsOf "exact rational principal slack" = some .leanBank ∧
    clsOf "same-weight signed-principal bound (analytic form)" = some .leanConditional ∧
    clsOf "Erdős #287" = some .open := by
  decide

theorem v23_erdos287_open : ∀ r ∈ v23New, r.nm = "Erdős #287" → r.cls? = some .open := by
  decide

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=13436 sha256=adc766d975af6fee092bf16af7a383ccd785726a230f8ce32ca224f7b7c14f2f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV23/PrincipalBudget.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEulerProvider
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §8: the principal budget

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Exact rational arithmetic (LEAN BANK)

With `vartheta = 273/500`, `rho = 1/1000000`, `vartheta0 = 545999/1000000`, `b_z = 501/1000`,
`A_C = 1000273/273000` (the frozen V16 value):

* **`two_div_diff`** — `2/vartheta0 - 2/vartheta = 1000/149057727`;
* **`principal_slack`** — `A_C - 2/vartheta0 - 1/5000 = 147807727/186322158750 > 0`;
* `s0_mul_b_z` — `s0 · b_z = vartheta0`.

## Exact cost algebra for the completed weight (LEAN BANK)

* `costU_muE` — the exceptional presieve has normalized cost exactly `1`
  (`C_{μ_E}(q) = 1` whenever `q_p ≠ 1` on `E`); `P_E` is kept, it merely costs `1`;
* **`cost_LambdaNewPlus_eq`** — `C_{Λ_new^+}(h) = C_{β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd}(h)`.

## Conditional budget (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `RosserScalarProvider`,
## `PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider`, `PrincipalEulerProvider`)

* **`principal_budget_conditional`** — for every `ε > 0` there are `S`, then `τ`, then `M₀`
  (order `S → τ → x`) with

      M_new(S, τ, M) ≤ (2/vartheta0 + 1/5000) W_F + ε      for all M ≥ M₀,

  where `M_new` is the V23 principal functional of the SAME weight `Λ_new^+` and `W_F = L_ij(F)/I`;
* `principal_budget_conditional_mul` — the multiplicative form `≤ (2/vartheta0 + 1/5000 + ε) W_F`
  when `W_F > 0`;
* **`principal_budget_le_A_C`** — hence `M_new ≤ A_C W_F + ε` eventually.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace PrincipalBudget

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters ResearchBankV22.RoundedRoughSieve
open ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider
open ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization ResearchBankV22.SmallPrimeUpperSieve
open PrincipalEuler

/-! ### Exact rational arithmetic -/

/-- **`2/vartheta0 - 2/vartheta = 1000/149057727`.** -/
theorem two_div_diff : 2 / vartheta0 - 2 / vartheta = 1000 / 149057727 := by
  norm_num [vartheta0, vartheta, rho]

/-- **Principal slack** `A_C - 2/vartheta0 - 1/5000 = 147807727/186322158750 > 0`. -/
theorem principal_slack :
    ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters.A_C - 2 / vartheta0 - 1 / 5000 =
        147807727 / 186322158750 ∧
      (0 : ℚ) < 147807727 / 186322158750 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by norm_num⟩
  norm_num [ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters.A_C, vartheta0, vartheta, rho]

theorem s0_mul_b_z : s0 * b_z = vartheta0 := by norm_num [s0, vartheta0, vartheta, rho, b_z]

theorem budget_lt_A_C :
    ((2 / vartheta0 + 1 / 5000 : ℚ) : ℝ) < ((ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters.A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  have := principal_slack.1
  have h2 : (2 / vartheta0 + 1 / 5000 : ℚ) < ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters.A_C := by
    linarith [principal_slack.2]
  exact_mod_cast h2

/-! ### Exact cost algebra -/

section CostAlgebra

variable {γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ]

/-- **The exceptional presieve costs exactly `1`.** -/
theorem costU_muE (E : Finset γ) (q : γ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ p ∈ E, q p ≠ 1) :
    costU E (muE E) q = 1 := by
  unfold costU numerU denomU
  have hden : ∏ p ∈ E, (1 - q p) ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun p hp => sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm (hq p hp))
  rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq hden]
  have h1 : ∏ p ∈ E, (1 - q p) = ∏ p ∈ E, ((-q p) + 1) := prod_congr rfl fun p _ => by ring
  rw [h1, prod_add]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun A hA => ?_
  rw [mem_powerset] at hA
  simp only [muE, if_pos hA, prod_const_one, mul_one, prod_neg]

/-- **`C_{Λ_new^+}(h) = C_{β_sm^+ ⋆ ℓ_rd}(h)`** (disjoint universes, `h ≠ 1` on `E`). -/
theorem cost_LambdaNewPlus_eq {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ E, h p ≠ 1) :
    costU (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) h =
      costU (Psm ∪ Prd) (conv (rosserBeta Psm level) (ellRd Prd w X)) h := by
  unfold LambdaNewPlus completedWeight rosserBeta
  rw [← conv_assoc_disjoint (muE_supported E) (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (ellRd_supported _ _ _)
    h1 h2 h3, union_assoc,
    costU_conv (muE_supported E) (conv_supported (ellRd_supported _ _ _) (ellRd_supported _ _ _))
      (disjoint_union_right.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩), costU_muE E h hE, one_mul]

end CostAlgebra

/-! ### The conditional principal budget -/

/-- `F(s0) · e^{-γ}/b_z = 2/vartheta0`. -/
theorem F0_mul_g {F : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF : F (s0 : ℝ) = 2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant / (s0 : ℝ)) :
    F (s0 : ℝ) * gConst = ((2 / vartheta0 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
  rw [hF]
  unfold gConst
  have hs : (s0 : ℝ) * (b_z : ℝ) = (vartheta0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast s0_mul_b_z
  have hs0 : (s0 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have := one_lt_s0.1; have : (0 : ℝ) < s0 := by exact_mod_cast lt_trans one_pos this
    exact this.ne'
  have hb : (b_z : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num [b_z]
  have he : Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) = 1 :=
    by rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
  push_cast
  rw [← hs]
  field_simp
  linear_combination he

variable {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ}
  {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
  {S0 N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h}

/-- **The conditional principal budget** (LEAN CONDITIONAL).  In the order `S → τ → x`: -/
theorem principal_budget_conditional
    (hR : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X) (hT : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ)
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I S0 N Li phiW model)
    (hU : ∀ S M, (model S M).U = E ∪ Psm S M ∪ Prd S M)
    (h1 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Psm S x)) (h2 : ∀ S x, Disjoint E (Prd S x))
    (h3 : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x))
    (hh : ∀ S x, ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm S x ∪ Prd S x, h p < 1)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, 0 < S ∧ ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M)
          (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) ≤
        ((2 / vartheta0 + 1 / 5000 : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + ε := by
  intro ε hε
  set WF := LF / I
  set F0 := F (s0 : ℝ)
  have hF0 : F0 = 2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant / (s0 : ℝ) :=
    hR.F_rosser _ (by exact_mod_cast (one_lt_s0).1.le) (by exact_mod_cast (one_lt_s0).2.le)
  have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < (s0 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast lt_trans one_pos one_lt_s0.1
  have hF0pos : 0 < F0 := by rw [hF0]; exact div_pos (by positivity) hs0
  obtain ⟨hg0, hg2⟩ := gConst_pos_le_two
  have hFg := F0_mul_g hF0
  set ε1 := min (1 / 2) (ε / (4 * (WF + 1))) with hε1
  have hε1pos : 0 < ε1 := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hε1a : ε1 ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hε1b : ε1 ≤ ε / (4 * (WF + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨ε2, hε2⟩ : ∃ e : ℝ, e = ε / (2 * (F0 + 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε2pos : 0 < ε2 := by rw [hε2]; positivity
  obtain ⟨S, hS, τ, hτ, x0, hx0⟩ := completed_cost_bound hR hT h3 ε1 hε1pos
  refine ⟨S, hS, τ, hτ, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ := P.sifted_main S ε2 hε2pos
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := P.normalization_agreement 1 one_pos
  refine ⟨max (max M1 M2) ⌈x0⌉₊, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have hMa : M1 ≤ M := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hM
  have hMb : M2 ≤ M := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hM
  have hceil : ⌈x0⌉₊ ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM
  have hMc : x0 ≤ (M : ℝ) := le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (by exact_mod_cast hceil)
  have hN := (hM2 M hMb).1
  have hpref : 0 ≤ pref Li phiW N M := by
    unfold pref; exact div_nonneg (hLi M) (mul_pos hphi hN).le
  -- the same-weight bound
  set m := model S M
  have hmain : m.Mnew (pref Li phiW N M)
      (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) ≤
      costU m.U (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) h *

    (fun p hp => (hh S M p (mem_union_left _ (mem_union_left _ hp))).ne)] at hmain

  have hstep2 : A * sft ≤ A * (gConst * WF + ε2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsft hA0

  have ha : gConst / 10000 * WF ≤ 1 / 5000 * WF := by

  have hb : ε1 * gConst * WF ≤ ε / 2 := by

/-- **Multiplicative form** `M_new ≤ (2/vartheta0 + 1/5000 + ε) W_F` when `W_F > 0`. -/
theorem principal_budget_conditional_mul
    (hR : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X) (hT : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ)
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I S0 N Li phiW model)

    (h3 : ∀ S x, Disjoint (Psm S x) (Prd S x))
    (hh : ∀ S x, ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm S x ∪ Prd S x, h p < 1)

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §1: the exact principal CRT measure

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Principal model for the prime form `L_i(t) = A_i t + 1`: the base residue `t ≡ t_W (mod W0)` is
fixed with `gcd(A_i t_W + 1, A_i W0) = 1`, and `t (mod L0)` is uniformly distributed over the
compatible residues for which `A_i t + 1` is a unit modulo `A_i L0` (`W0 ∣ L0`):

    T = { t < L0 : t ≡ t_W (mod W0),  gcd(A_i t + 1, A_i L0) = 1 }.

Kernel-proved finite CRT algebra (LEAN BANK):
* **`crt_count`** — `|T| · φ(A_i W0) = φ(A_i L0)` (the reduction map on units
  `(ℤ/A_i L0)^× → (ℤ/A_i W0)^×` is surjective with equal fibres, and `t ↦ A_i t + 1` identifies
  `T` with one fibre);
* **`principal_prob`** — for a compatible residue `t0 < L0`,

      Prob_i(t ≡ t0 mod L0) = φ(A_i W0)/φ(A_i L0) · 1(gcd(A_i t0 + 1, A_i L0) = 1);

* **`principal_Li_identity`** — hence
  `Li_i(x)/φ(A_i W0) · Prob_i(t ≡ t0) = Li_i(x)/φ(A_i L0) · 1(unit)`.

The finite modulus `L0` here is the CRT modulus of the principal model; it is never passed as
a new modulus to any prime-distribution theorem.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace PrincipalCRTMeasure

open Finset

/-- The compatible unit residues `T`. -/
def compatSet (A W0 L0 tW : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range L0).filter fun t => t ≡ tW [MOD W0] ∧ Nat.Coprime (A * t + 1) (A * L0)

/-- Fibres of a surjective hom of finite groups: `|fibre| · |H| = |G|`. -/
theorem card_fiber_mul {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] [Group H] [Fintype H] [DecidableEq H]
    (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (c : H) :
    (univ.filter fun g => f g = c).card * Fintype.card H = Fintype.card G := by
  have hall : ∀ y : H, (univ.filter fun g => f g = y).card =
      (univ.filter fun g => f g = c).card := fun y =>
    MonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range f (hf y) (hf c)
  have := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := (univ : Finset G)) (t := (univ : Finset H)) (f := f)
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))
  simp only [card_univ] at this
  rw [this]
  simp_rw [hall]
  rw [sum_const, card_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

variable {A W0 L0 tW : ℕ}

/-- **The CRT count** `|T| · φ(A W0) = φ(A L0)`. -/
theorem crt_count (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0) (hL : 0 < L0) (hWL : W0 ∣ L0)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) :
    (compatSet A W0 L0 tW).card * Nat.totient (A * W0) = Nat.totient (A * L0) := by
  have hm : 0 < A * L0 := Nat.mul_pos hA hL
  haveI : NeZero (A * L0) := ⟨hm.ne'⟩
  haveI : NeZero (A * W0) := ⟨(Nat.mul_pos hA hW).ne'⟩
  have hdvd : A * W0 ∣ A * L0 := Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left A hWL
  set f := ZMod.unitsMap hdvd
  set c : (ZMod (A * W0))ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime (A * tW + 1) hc
  have hfib := card_fiber_mul f (ZMod.unitsMap_surjective hdvd) c
  rw [ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient] at hfib
  rw [← hfib]
  congr 1
  refine card_bij (fun t ht => ZMod.unitOfCoprime (A * t + 1) (mem_filter.1 ht).2.2) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro t ht
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    have ht' := (mem_filter.1 ht).2.1
    apply Units.ext
    rw [ZMod.unitsMap_val]
    simp only [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime, c]
    rw [ZMod.cast_natCast hdvd, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
    exact (Nat.ModEq.mul_left' A ht').add_right 1
  · intro t ht t' ht' h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun u : (ZMod (A * L0))ˣ => (u : ZMod (A * L0))) h
    simp only [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime] at h1
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at h1
    have h2 : A * t ≡ A * t' [MOD A * L0] := Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' 1 h1
    have h3 : t ≡ t' [MOD L0] := Nat.ModEq.mul_left_cancel' hA.ne' h2
    have ht1 := mem_range.1 (mem_filter.1 ht).1
    have ht2 := mem_range.1 (mem_filter.1 ht').1
    unfold Nat.ModEq at h3
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ht1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ht2] at h3
  · intro u hu
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hu
    set n := (u : ZMod (A * L0)).val with hn
    have hnu : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod (A * L0)) = u := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
    -- reduction of `n` modulo `A W0`
    have hred : n ≡ A * tW + 1 [MOD A * W0] := by
      have h1 := congrArg (fun v : (ZMod (A * W0))ˣ => (v : ZMod (A * W0))) hu
      simp only [c, ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime] at h1
      rw [show (f u : ZMod (A * W0)) = ((u : ZMod (A * L0)).cast) from
        ZMod.unitsMap_val hdvd u] at h1
      rw [← hnu, ZMod.cast_natCast hdvd] at h1
      exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).1 h1
    have hmodA : n ≡ 1 [MOD A] := by
      have := Nat.ModEq.of_mul_right W0 hred
      refine this.trans ?_
      unfold Nat.ModEq; simp [Nat.add_mod]
    -- choose `q` with `A q + 1 = n + A L0`
    have hdivA : A ∣ n + A * L0 - 1 := by
      have h1 : (n + A * L0 - 1) % A = 0 := by
        have hn1 : n % A = 1 % A := hmodA
        have : n + A * L0 - 1 + 1 = n + A * L0 := by omega
        have h2 : (n + A * L0 - 1 + 1) % A = (0 + 1) % A := by
          rw [this, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, hn1]
        exact (Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' 1 h2)
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdivA
    set t := q % L0
    have htL : t < L0 := Nat.mod_lt _ hL
    have hAt : A * t + 1 ≡ n [MOD A * L0] := by
      have e1 : A * t ≡ A * q [MOD A * L0] := Nat.ModEq.mul_left' A (Nat.mod_modEq q L0)
      have e2 : A * q + 1 = n + A * L0 := by omega
      calc A * t + 1 ≡ A * q + 1 [MOD A * L0] := e1.add_right 1
        _ = n + A * L0 := e2
        _ ≡ n [MOD A * L0] := by unfold Nat.ModEq; simp
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (A * t + 1) (A * L0) := by
      have hu' : Nat.Coprime n (A * L0) := by
        have := ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime u
        exact this
      rw [Nat.Coprime, Nat.ModEq.gcd_eq hAt]
      exact hu'
    have hcompat : t ≡ tW [MOD W0] := by
      have e1 : A * t + 1 ≡ A * tW + 1 [MOD A * W0] :=
        (Nat.ModEq.of_mul_right (L0 / W0) (by
          rw [mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hWL]; exact hAt)).trans hred
      exact Nat.ModEq.mul_left_cancel' hA.ne' (Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' 1 e1)
    refine ⟨t, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_range.2 htL, hcompat, hcop⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]
    rw [← hnu, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff]
    exact hAt

/-- The principal probability `Prob_i(t ≡ t0 mod L0)` (uniform on `T`). -/
noncomputable def principalProb (A W0 L0 tW t0 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if t0 ∈ compatSet A W0 L0 tW then 1 / ((compatSet A W0 L0 tW).card : ℝ) else 0

/-- **The principal CRT probability**
`Prob_i(t ≡ t0) = φ(A W0)/φ(A L0) · 1(gcd(A t0 + 1, A L0) = 1)` for compatible `t0 < L0`. -/
theorem principal_prob (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0) (hL : 0 < L0) (hWL : W0 ∣ L0)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) {t0 : ℕ} (ht0 : t0 < L0)
    (hcompat : t0 ≡ tW [MOD W0]) :
    principalProb A W0 L0 tW t0 =
      (Nat.totient (A * W0) : ℝ) / Nat.totient (A * L0) *
        (if Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * L0) = 1 then 1 else 0) := by
  have hcount := crt_count hA hW hL hWL hc
  have hφW : 0 < Nat.totient (A * W0) := Nat.totient_pos.2 (Nat.mul_pos hA hW)
  have hφL : 0 < Nat.totient (A * L0) := Nat.totient_pos.2 (Nat.mul_pos hA hL)
  have hT : ((compatSet A W0 L0 tW).card : ℝ) =
      (Nat.totient (A * L0) : ℝ) / Nat.totient (A * W0) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast hφW.ne')]
    exact_mod_cast hcount
  unfold principalProb
  by_cases hg : Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * L0) = 1
  · rw [if_pos (show t0 ∈ compatSet A W0 L0 tW from mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_range.2 ht0, hcompat, hg⟩),
      if_pos hg, hT]
    have : (Nat.totient (A * L0) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hφL.ne'
    have : (Nat.totient (A * W0) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hφW.ne'
    field_simp
  · rw [if_neg (by intro h; unfold compatSet at h; exact hg (mem_filter.1 h).2.2), if_neg hg,
      mul_zero]

/-- **The principal `Li` identity**
`Li_i(x)/φ(A W0) · Prob_i(t ≡ t0) = Li_i(x)/φ(A L0) · 1(unit)`. -/
theorem principal_Li_identity (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0) (hL : 0 < L0) (hWL : W0 ∣ L0)
    (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) {t0 : ℕ} (ht0 : t0 < L0)
    (hcompat : t0 ≡ tW [MOD W0]) (Li : ℝ) :
    Li / Nat.totient (A * W0) * principalProb A W0 L0 tW t0 =
      Li / Nat.totient (A * L0) * (if Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * L0) = 1 then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [principal_prob hA hW hL hWL hc ht0 hcompat]
  have hφW : (Nat.totient (A * W0) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.2 (Nat.mul_pos hA hW)).ne'
  field_simp

/-- Regression fixture: `A = 2, W0 = 1, L0 = 3, t_W = 0`: `T = {0, 2}` and
`|T| · φ(2) = 2 · 1 = 2 = φ(6)`. -/
theorem crt_count_fixture : compatSet 2 1 3 0 = {0, 2} ∧
    (compatSet 2 1 3 0).card * Nat.totient 2 = Nat.totient 6 := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

end PrincipalCRTMeasure
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.SameWeightPrincipal
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.GoodPrimeEulerFactor
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Harmonic.ZetaAsymp

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §6: the principal Euler/Mellin provider and the SAME
# normalization theorem

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Finite principal models (definitions)

`PrincipalModel h` bundles ONE finite principal CRT model: spectator / root-collision states
`Ys` with nonnegative weights `μ`, the sieve-prime universe `U`, conditional densities
`qY y p ∈ [0, min(1, h p)]` and a complex amplitude `B`.  `PrincipalModel.Mnew` and
`PrincipalModel.sifted` are the V23 functionals `M_new` and
`Li/(φ(A_i W0) N) · E[|B|² 1(L_j sifted)]` of that model; `pref Li phiW N M = Li(M)/(φ·N(M))`
is the principal prefactor with the frozen normalization `N`.

## EXTERNAL PROVIDER (interface only; never constructed)

`PrincipalEulerProvider` contains, with explicit fields:
* `euler_product` — the EXACT Euler product: generating function = exact exceptional local
  factor × `∏_{good p} E_p(s,t)` with the V23 good-prime factor `eulerFactor`;
* `zeta_simple_pole` — the simple pole of `ζ` at `1` with residue `1`
  (this field is DISCHARGED from Mathlib: `zeta_simple_pole_available`);
* `mellin_truncation` — Fourier/Mellin truncation error `o((log x)^{-r})`, in ε/eventual form;
* `mixed_derivative` — the mixed-derivative integral: truncated Mellin term
  `= (S_all/S_ij + o(1)) (log x)^{-r} L_ij(F)`;
* `normalization_agreement` — the provider's normalization `N` satisfies the frozen V14/V15
  `S0Contract` for the frozen `S0` (i.e. it IS the S0/S1 normalization);
* `sifted_main` — the sifted principal term tends to
  `S_i·(S_ij/S_i)·(S_all/S_ij)/S_all · e^{-γ}/b_z · L_ij(F)/I`, uniformly in the family index.

## LEAN CONDITIONAL / LEAN BANK consequences

* `zeta_simple_pole_available` (LEAN BANK, Mathlib) — the pole field is provable;
* `euler_product_at_zero` (LEAN BANK given the product field) — at zero parameters every good
  local factor is `(p-2-r)/(p-2)`;
* **`principal_euler_asymptotic`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL) —
  `|E_ij|A|² (log x)^r - S_all/S_ij · L_ij(F)| ≤ ε` eventually;
* **`same_normalization_sifted_main`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL) — with `N` the SAME frozen
  normalization used by S0/S1 (the statement carries `S0Contract (S0 τ W) N` for the frozen
  Route-C `S0`),

      Li/(φ(A_i W0) N) · E[|B|² 1(L_j sifted to z)] = e^{-γ}/b_z · L_ij(F)/I + o(1),

  the singular chain cancelling by `singular_cancellation` (no informal cancellation).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace PrincipalEuler

open Finset Filter
open ResearchBankV21.QuadraticDomination
open SameWeightPrincipal SingularFactors GoodPrimeEulerFactor
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)

/-- **One finite principal CRT model** (states, universe, conditional densities, amplitude). -/
structure PrincipalModel (h : ℕ → ℝ) where
  Ys : Type
  fin : Fintype Ys
  U : Finset ℕ
  μ : Ys → ℝ
  μ_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y
  qY : Ys → U → ℝ
  q_nonneg : ∀ y p, 0 ≤ qY y p
  q_le_h : ∀ y p, qY y p ≤ h p
  q_le_one : ∀ y p, qY y p ≤ 1
  B : Ys → ℂ

attribute [instance] PrincipalModel.fin

namespace PrincipalModel

variable {h : ℕ → ℝ} (m : PrincipalModel h)

/-- `M_new` of the model for the weight `Λ`, with prefactor `pref`. -/
noncomputable def Mnew (pref : ℝ) (Λ : Finset ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  SameWeightPrincipal.Mnew m.U pref Λ m.μ m.qY m.B

/-- The sifted principal term of the model, with prefactor `pref`. -/
noncomputable def sifted (pref : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  SameWeightPrincipal.principalSifted m.U pref m.μ m.qY m.B

theorem sifted_nonneg {pref : ℝ} (hpref : 0 ≤ pref) : 0 ≤ m.sifted pref :=
  principalSifted_nonneg hpref m.μ_nonneg m.q_nonneg m.q_le_one m.B

end PrincipalModel

/-- The principal prefactor `Li(M) / (φ(A_i W0) · N(M))` with the frozen normalization `N`. -/
noncomputable def pref (Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ) (N : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℕ) : ℝ := Li M / (phiW * N M)

/-- The principal main-term constant `e^{-γ}/b_z`. -/
noncomputable def gConst : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / (ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.b_z : ℝ)

/-- **The principal Euler/Mellin provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). -/
structure PrincipalEulerProvider (h : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (Sd : SingularData) (LF I : ℝ)
    (S0 N Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ) (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) where
  /-- generating Dirichlet series of the principal second moment (truncated at scale `M`) -/
  Zgen : ℕ → (Fin r → ℝ) → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℝ
  /-- the good primes at scale `M` -/
  good : ℕ → Finset ℕ
  /-- the exact local factor of the finitely many exceptional primes -/
  excLocal : ℕ → (Fin r → ℝ) → (Fin r → ℝ) → ℝ
  good_gt : ∀ M p, p ∈ good M → r + 2 < p
  euler_product : ∀ M s t, Zgen M s t = excLocal M s t * ∏ p ∈ good M, eulerFactor p r s t
  zeta_simple_pole :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℂ => (s - 1) * riemannZeta s) (nhdsWithin 1 {1}ᶜ) (nhds 1)
  /-- `E_ij |A_{e,x}|²` -/
  EA : ℕ → ℝ
  /-- the truncated Mellin integral -/
  mellin : ℕ → ℝ
  mellin_truncation : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
    |EA M - mellin M| * Real.log M ^ r ≤ ε
  mixed_derivative : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
    |mellin M * Real.log M ^ r - Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij * LF| ≤ ε
  Sall_ne : Sd.Sall ≠ 0
  normalization_agreement : S0Contract S0 N
  sifted_main : ∀ S : ℕ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
    |(model S M).sifted (pref Li phiW N M) -
      Sd.Si * (Sd.Sij / Sd.Si) * (Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij) / Sd.Sall * gConst * (LF / I)| ≤ ε

/-- **The zeta simple-pole field is provable** (LEAN BANK, from Mathlib). -/
theorem zeta_simple_pole_available :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℂ => (s - 1) * riemannZeta s) (nhdsWithin 1 {1}ᶜ) (nhds 1) :=
  riemannZeta_residue_one

/-- At zero parameters a good local factor is `(p - 2 - r)/(p - 2)`. -/
theorem eulerFactor_zero_value {p r : ℕ} (hp : 2 < p) :
    eulerFactor p r 0 0 = ((p : ℝ) - 2 - r) / ((p : ℝ) - 2) := by
  unfold eulerFactor
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, add_zero, neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, sum_const, card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have : (p : ℝ) - 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
    linarith
  field_simp
  ring

/-- **The exact Euler product at zero parameters** (LEAN BANK given the product field). -/
theorem euler_product_at_zero {h : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {S0 N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h}
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I S0 N Li phiW model) (M : ℕ) :
    P.Zgen M 0 0 = P.excLocal M 0 0 * ∏ p ∈ P.good M, (((p : ℝ) - 2 - r) / ((p : ℝ) - 2)) := by
  rw [P.euler_product]
  congr 1
  exact prod_congr rfl fun p hp => eulerFactor_zero_value (by have := P.good_gt M p hp; omega)

/-- **Principal Euler asymptotic** (LEAN CONDITIONAL):
`|E_ij|A_{e,x}|² (log x)^r - S_all/S_ij · L_ij(F)| ≤ ε` eventually. -/
theorem principal_euler_asymptotic {h : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {S0 N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h}
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I S0 N Li phiW model) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, |P.EA M * Real.log M ^ r - Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij * LF| ≤ ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M1, h1⟩ := P.mellin_truncation (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M2, h2⟩ := P.mixed_derivative (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨max M1 M2, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have a := h1 M (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM)
  have b := h2 M (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM)
  have e : P.EA M * Real.log M ^ r - Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij * LF =
      (P.EA M - P.mellin M) * Real.log M ^ r +
        (P.mellin M * Real.log M ^ r - Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij * LF) := by ring
  rw [e]
  have hlog : |(P.EA M - P.mellin M) * Real.log M ^ r| ≤ |P.EA M - P.mellin M| * Real.log M ^ r := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    gcongr
    rw [abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by
      rcases M with _ | M
      · simp
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos M))]) r
  calc _ ≤ |(P.EA M - P.mellin M) * Real.log M ^ r| +
        |P.mellin M * Real.log M ^ r - Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij * LF| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ε := by linarith

/-- The main-term constant after the exact singular cancellation. -/
theorem singular_chain_normalized (Sd : SingularData) (hSall : Sd.Sall ≠ 0) :
    Sd.Si * (Sd.Sij / Sd.Si) * (Sd.Sall / Sd.Sij) / Sd.Sall = 1 := by
  rw [singular_cancellation, div_self hSall]

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **The SAME normalization theorem** (LEAN CONDITIONAL).  The normalization `N` in the
principal prefactor is the SAME frozen normalization used by the S0/S1 contracts: the
hypothesis `h0 : S0Contract (S0 τ W) N` is carried in the statement for the frozen Route-C
zeroth moment, and the provider is required to use the very same `S0`, `N`.  Then

    Li/(φ(A_i W0) N) · E[|B|² 1(L_j sifted to z)] = e^{-γ}/b_z · L_ij(F)/I + o(1)

(in ε/eventual form, uniformly for every family index `S`). -/
theorem same_normalization_sifted_main {h : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    (τ : ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer.FixedTupleC V)
    (W : ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer.WeightSystem τ) {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h}
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I (ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer.S0 τ W) N Li phiW
      model) :
    S0Contract (ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer.S0 τ W) N ∧
      ∀ S : ℕ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
        |(model S M).sifted (pref Li phiW N M) - gConst * (LF / I)| ≤ ε := by
  refine ⟨P.normalization_agreement, fun S ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM⟩ := P.sifted_main S ε hε
  refine ⟨M₀, fun M hM' => ?_⟩
  have := hM M hM'
  rwa [singular_chain_normalized Sd P.Sall_ne, one_mul] at this

/-- `e^{-γ}/b_z ≤ 2` (used for the principal budget). -/
theorem gConst_pos_le_two : 0 < gConst ∧ gConst ≤ 2 := by
  have hb : (ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.b_z : ℝ) = 501 / 1000 := by
    unfold ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.b_z; push_cast; ring
  unfold gConst
  rw [hb]
  have hγ := Real.one_half_lt_eulerMascheroniConstant
  have he : Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]; linarith
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
  linarith

end PrincipalEuler
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8655 sha256=f69c6c123ba957d05d99cc8ee3c8e2f8a0e70e1293b47fc19962f30b3891d24c path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV23/SameWeightPrincipal.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV21.QuadraticDomination
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV23.FullLCMPrincipal

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §5: the same-weight signed principal functional

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The finite principal model is the V21 product model over the sieve-prime coordinates
(spectator / root-collision states `y ∈ Ys`, divisibility pattern `D` of `L_j`).  For the
completed weight `Λ` (atom-set weight on the universe `U`),

    M_new = Li / (φ(A_i W0) · N) · E[ |B|² S_Λ(L_j) ],
    principalSifted = Li / (φ(A_i W0) · N) · E[ |B|² 1(L_j sifted) ].

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* **`signed_expansion`** — `E[|B|² S_λ(L_j)]` with `B = Σ_e c_e φ_e` expands EXACTLY to the
  original signed expression `Σ_d λ(d) Σ_{e,e'} c_e \bar c_{e'} E[φ_e \bar φ_{e'} 1_{d|L_j}]`
  (tensor signs before squaring, every spectator state, the same `λ`);
* **`same_weight_principal_bound`** — after the signs have recombined inside `|B|²`,

      M_new ≤ C_Λ(h) · principalSifted,

  with `C_Λ(h) = costU U Λ h` the normalized cost of the SAME weight (V21 quadratic domination);
* **`same_weight_principal_bound_LambdaNewPlus`** — the same for the concrete `Λ_new^+` of V22
  (its divisor sums are nonnegative, so no sign condition on its coefficients is needed);
* `principal_normalizer_fullLCM` — the prefactor `Li/φ(A_i W0)` against the principal CRT
  probability equals `Li/φ(A_i L0)` times the unit indicator at the complete modulus `L0`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace SameWeightPrincipal

open Finset
open ResearchBankV21.FiniteSieveSetup ResearchBankV21.QuadraticDomination
open ResearchBankV22.RoundedRoughSieve ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider

/-- Moving a block of two finite sums past a third. -/
theorem sum_comm_block {α β γ : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] (F : α → β → γ → ℂ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, F a b c = ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, F a b c := by
  calc ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, F a b c = ∑ a, ∑ c, ∑ b, F a b c :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, F a b c := Finset.sum_comm
/-- **Signed expansion** of the principal functional: the positive square `|B|²` of the signed
tensor `B = Σ_e c_e φ_e`, weighted by `S_λ(L_j)`, equals the ORIGINAL signed expression
`Σ_d λ(d) Σ_{e,e'} c_e \bar c_{e'} E[φ_e \bar φ_{e'} 1_{d ∣ L_j}]` — tensor signs, all spectator
(root-collision) states and the same weight `λ` retained. -/
theorem signed_expansion {P Ys ι : Type*} [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [Fintype Ys] [Fintype ι]
    (lam : Finset P → ℝ) (μ : Ys → ℝ) (qY : Ys → P → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (φ : ι → Ys → ℂ) :
    ((jointExp μ qY (fun y D => ‖∑ e, c e * φ e y‖ ^ 2 * divSum lam D) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ A : Finset P, (lam A : ℂ) * ∑ e, ∑ e', c e * starRingEnd ℂ (c e') *
        ∑ y, ∑ D : Finset P, ((μ y * patternProb (qY y) D : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (if A ⊆ D then φ e y * starRingEnd ℂ (φ e' y) else 0) := by
  have hsq : ∀ z : ℂ, (‖z‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 = z * starRingEnd ℂ z := by
    intro z; rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.mul_conj]
  have hdiv : ∀ D : Finset P, ((divSum lam D : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ A : Finset P, if A ⊆ D then (lam A : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro D; unfold divSum; push_cast; rw [← Finset.sum_filter]; congr 1; ext A; simp
  have hpt : ∀ y (D : Finset P),
      ((μ y * patternProb (qY y) D * (‖∑ e, c e * φ e y‖ ^ 2 * divSum lam D) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ A : Finset P, ∑ e, ∑ e', (lam A : ℂ) * (c e * starRingEnd ℂ (c e')) *
        (((μ y * patternProb (qY y) D : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (if A ⊆ D then φ e y * starRingEnd ℂ (φ e' y) else 0)) := by
    intro y D
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul]
    rw [hdiv, Complex.ofReal_pow, hsq, map_sum,
      Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun A _ => sum_congr rfl fun e _ => sum_congr rfl fun e' _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> simp [map_mul]; ring
  unfold jointExp
  rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]
  simp_rw [Complex.ofReal_sum, hpt]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [sum_comm_block]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun A _ => ?_
  rw [sum_comm_block]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  rw [sum_comm_block]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun e' _ => sum_congr rfl fun y _ => sum_congr rfl fun D _ => ?_
  ring


section Principal

variable {Ys : Type*} [Fintype Ys] (U : Finset ℕ)

/-- `M_new = Li/(φ N) · E[|B|² S_Λ(L_j)]` in the finite principal model. -/
noncomputable def Mnew (pref : ℝ) (Λ : Finset ℕ → ℝ) (μ : Ys → ℝ) (qY : Ys → U → ℝ)
    (B : Ys → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  pref * jointExp μ qY (fun y D => ‖B y‖ ^ 2 * divSum (pull U Λ) D)

/-- `principalSifted = Li/(φ N) · E[|B|² 1(L_j sifted)]`. -/
noncomputable def principalSifted (pref : ℝ) (μ : Ys → ℝ) (qY : Ys → U → ℝ) (B : Ys → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  pref * jointExp μ qY (fun y D => ‖B y‖ ^ 2 * (if D = ∅ then 1 else 0))

variable {U}

/-- **Same-weight signed-principal bound** `M_new ≤ C_Λ(h) · principalSifted`. -/
theorem same_weight_principal_bound {pref : ℝ} (hpref : 0 ≤ pref) {Λ : Finset ℕ → ℝ}
    (hΛ : ∀ D, 0 ≤ dsum Λ D) {μ : Ys → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) {qY : Ys → U → ℝ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} (hq0 : ∀ y p, 0 ≤ qY y p) (hqh : ∀ y p, qY y p ≤ h p) (hh : ∀ p ∈ U, h p < 1)
    (B : Ys → ℂ) :
    Mnew U pref Λ μ qY B ≤ costU U Λ h * principalSifted U pref μ qY B := by
  unfold Mnew principalSifted
  have hdom := quadratic_domination (pull U Λ) (fun S => by rw [divSum_pull]; exact hΛ _) μ hμ qY
    (fun p : U => h p) hq0 hqh (fun p => hh p p.2) B
  rw [← costU_eq_normCost] at hdom
  calc pref * jointExp μ qY (fun y D => ‖B y‖ ^ 2 * divSum (pull U Λ) D)
      ≤ pref * (costU U Λ h * jointExp μ qY (fun y D => ‖B y‖ ^ 2 * (if D = ∅ then 1 else 0))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdom hpref
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- **The bound for the concrete completed weight `Λ_new^+`.** -/
theorem same_weight_principal_bound_LambdaNewPlus {E Psm Prd : Finset ℕ} {level X : ℝ}
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} (h1 : Disjoint E Psm) (h2 : Disjoint E Prd) (h3 : Disjoint Psm Prd)
    {pref : ℝ} (hpref : 0 ≤ pref) {μ : Ys → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    {qY : Ys → (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd : Finset ℕ) → ℝ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} (hq0 : ∀ y p, 0 ≤ qY y p)
    (hqh : ∀ y p, qY y p ≤ h p) (hh : ∀ p ∈ E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd, h p < 1) (B : Ys → ℂ) :
    Mnew (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) pref (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) μ qY B ≤
      costU (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) (LambdaNewPlus E Psm Prd level w X) h *
        principalSifted (E ∪ Psm ∪ Prd) pref μ qY B :=
  same_weight_principal_bound hpref (LambdaNewPlus_nonneg h1 h2 h3) hμ hq0 hqh hh B

theorem principalSifted_nonneg {pref : ℝ} (hpref : 0 ≤ pref) {μ : Ys → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    {qY : Ys → U → ℝ} (hq0 : ∀ y p, 0 ≤ qY y p) (hq1 : ∀ y p, qY y p ≤ 1) (B : Ys → ℂ) :
    0 ≤ principalSifted U pref μ qY B := by
  unfold principalSifted jointExp
  refine mul_nonneg hpref (sum_nonneg fun y _ => sum_nonneg fun D _ => ?_)
  refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hμ y) (patternProb_nonneg (hq0 y) (hq1 y) D)) ?_
  exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)

end Principal

/-- **Principal normalizer at the complete modulus**: the prefactor `Li/φ(A W0)` against the
exact principal CRT probability is `Li/φ(A L0)` times the unit indicator,
`L0 = lcm(W0, s, q₁, …, q_r)`. -/
theorem principal_normalizer_fullLCM {A W0 s tW : ℕ} {qs : List ℕ} (hA : 0 < A) (hW : 0 < W0)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hq : ∀ q ∈ qs, 0 < q) (hc : Nat.Coprime (A * tW + 1) (A * W0)) (Li : ℝ)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Li / Nat.totient (A * W0) *
        ∑ t0 ∈ (range (FullLCMPrincipal.fullLCM W0 s qs)).filter (· ≡ tW [MOD W0]),
          PrincipalCRTMeasure.principalProb A W0 (FullLCMPrincipal.fullLCM W0 s qs) tW t0 * F t0 =
      Li / Nat.totient (A * FullLCMPrincipal.fullLCM W0 s qs) *
        ∑ t0 ∈ (range (FullLCMPrincipal.fullLCM W0 s qs)).filter (· ≡ tW [MOD W0]),
          (if Nat.gcd (A * t0 + 1) (A * FullLCMPrincipal.fullLCM W0 s qs) = 1 then 1 else 0) *
            F t0 :=
  FullLCMPrincipal.principal_sum_fullLCM hA hW hs hq hc Li F

end SameWeightPrincipal
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V23 §3: singular factors and their finite cancellation

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The singular factors `S_i`, `S_ij`, `S_all` enter as explicit real numbers bundled with their
nonvanishing hypotheses (`SingularData`).  The ratios `S_ij/S_i` and `S_all/S_ij` are only
formed under these hypotheses.

Kernel-proved (LEAN BANK):
* **`singular_cancellation`** — `S_i · (S_ij/S_i) · (S_all/S_ij) = S_all`;
* `ratio_chain_pos` — all ratios are positive when the factors are positive;
* `cancellation_needs_nonzero` — without `S_i ≠ 0` the "cancellation" fails (Lean's `x/0 = 0`):
  the nonzero hypotheses are load-bearing, not decoration.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV23
namespace SingularFactors

/-- The three singular factors with explicit nonvanishing hypotheses. -/
structure SingularData where
  Si : ℝ
  Sij : ℝ
  Sall : ℝ
  Si_ne : Si ≠ 0
  Sij_ne : Sij ≠ 0

/-- **Finite cancellation** `S_i · (S_ij/S_i) · (S_all/S_ij) = S_all`. -/
theorem singular_cancellation (S : SingularData) :
    S.Si * (S.Sij / S.Si) * (S.Sall / S.Sij) = S.Sall := by
  have h1 := S.Si_ne
  have h2 := S.Sij_ne
  field_simp

theorem ratio_chain_pos (S : SingularData) (h1 : 0 < S.Si) (h2 : 0 < S.Sij)
    (h3 : 0 < S.Sall) : 0 < S.Sij / S.Si ∧ 0 < S.Sall / S.Sij :=
  ⟨div_pos h2 h1, div_pos h3 h2⟩

/-- **The nonzero hypotheses are load-bearing**: with `S_i = 0` the chain is `0 ≠ S_all`. -/
theorem cancellation_needs_nonzero :
    ∃ Si Sij Sall : ℝ, Si * (Sij / Si) * (Sall / Sij) ≠ Sall :=
  ⟨0, 1, 1, by norm_num⟩

end SingularFactors
end ResearchBankV23
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3200 sha256=3e1b5eedbd5e9550242fb9bdb2486e8edab17517e031b72f4ad21516ee3a4d15 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV28/AxiomAudit.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.FinalPairComposition
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.PreEffectivityTheorem
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.EffectivityFirewall
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.FinalStatus

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28: axiom audit

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV24.FinalFirewalls
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Ledger
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures
