/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §14–15: effectivity and historical-overclaim firewalls

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## §14 Effectivity ledger (OPEN items, recorded as data)

`EffectivityItem` lists `noExplicitM0Yet`, `finiteSpliceOpen`, `exceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen`;
every item has status `OPEN` (`effectivity_all_open`).  The pre-effectivity theorem is an
`∃ M₀` statement that may rest on ineffective analytic constants; it is never converted into a
computable `M₀`.

## §15 Historical overclaim firewalls (FINITE REGRESSION / LEAN BANK)

1. `fw1_small_cost_not_SW` — a fixed-modulus discrepancy of size `1` (small cost) coexists with
   failure of the balance (SW-type) statement;
2. `fw2_residue_restriction_not_SW` — residue restriction does not preserve global balance;
3. `fw3_raw_density_ne_weighted` — raw density `≠` conditioned weighted density;
4. `fw4_support_not_coefficient_factorization` — product support does not force a product
   coefficient;
5. `fw5_no_kloosterman_decoration` — a decoration depending on a final Kloosterman variable is not
   an inner decoration;
6. `fw6_labels_cost_sqrt` — separate labels cost `√L` (not `L`) on the linear sum via the common
   Cauchy; `√2 < 2`;
7. `fw7_character_free_not_DI` — the character-free colour route does not prove DI: the DI
   conclusion fails for some admissible form;
8. `fw8_finite_verifier_not_spectral` — no finite check yields the spectral provider: the
   unrestricted provider is false although it holds vacuously on the empty list;
9. `fw9_asymptotic_not_explicit` — `∃ M₀` does not give an explicit `M₀`;
10. `fw10_explicit_needs_splice` — even an explicit `M₀` needs the finite splice for global #287.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV28
namespace EffectivityFirewall

open ResearchBankV25.Ledger

/-- The open effectivity items. -/
inductive EffectivityItem
  | noExplicitM0Yet
  | finiteSpliceOpen
  | exceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open EffectivityItem

/-- Status of the effectivity items. -/
def effectivityStatus : EffectivityItem → StatusClass
  | noExplicitM0Yet => .openProblem
  | finiteSpliceOpen => .openProblem
  | exceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen => .openProblem

theorem effectivity_all_open : ∀ i, effectivityStatus i = .openProblem := by
  intro i; cases i <;> rfl

/-- `NoExplicitM0Yet`: an `∃ M₀` statement never fixes a numerical bound (LEAN BANK). -/
def NoExplicitM0Yet : Prop :=
  ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ Q : ℕ → Prop, (∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, Q M) ∧ ¬ ∀ M ≥ B, Q M

theorem noExplicitM0Yet_holds : NoExplicitM0Yet :=
  ResearchBankV24.FinalFirewalls.fw8_conditional_asymptotic_no_explicit_M0

/-- `FiniteSpliceOpen`: asymptotic + a bounded range check does not give all `M` (LEAN BANK). -/
def FiniteSpliceOpen : Prop :=
  ∀ U : ℕ, ¬ ∀ bad : ℕ → Prop, (∃ M₀, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ¬ bad M) → (∀ M ≤ U, ¬ bad M) → ∀ M, ¬ bad M

theorem finiteSpliceOpen_holds : FiniteSpliceOpen :=
  ResearchBankV24.FinalFirewalls.fw9_explicit_M0_required_for_splice

/-- `ExceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen`: recorded as an OPEN ledger item (no mathematical content is
claimed; the exceptional-zero effectivity programme is separate). -/
def ExceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen : Prop :=
  effectivityStatus exceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen = .openProblem

theorem exceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen_recorded : ExceptionalZeroEffectivityOpen := rfl

/-- 1. Small fixed-modulus cost does NOT imply an unchanged SW contract. -/
theorem fw1_small_cost_not_SW :
    ResearchBankV25.FixedResidueEnergy.Disc 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6)
        (ResearchBankV25.FixedResidueEnergy.alphaLoc (f := 3) (fun _ => 1) 1)
        ((1 : (ZMod 3)ˣ) : ZMod 3) = 1 ∧
      ¬ ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.Balanced 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6)
        (ResearchBankV25.FixedResidueEnergy.alphaLoc (f := 3) (fun _ => 1) 1) :=
  ⟨ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.restricted_sequence_unbalanced,
    ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.residue_restriction_breaks_SW.2⟩

/-- 2. Residue restriction does NOT preserve global SW automatically. -/
theorem fw2_residue_restriction_not_SW :
    ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.Balanced 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6) (fun _ => 1) ∧
      ¬ ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.Balanced 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6)
        (ResearchBankV25.FixedResidueEnergy.alphaLoc (f := 3) (fun _ => 1) 1) :=
  ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures.residue_restriction_breaks_SW

/-- 3. Raw density does NOT equal the conditioned weighted density. -/
theorem fw3_raw_density_ne_weighted :
    ResearchBankV21.DensityCounterfixture.weightedDensity ≠
      ResearchBankV21.DensityCounterfixture.rawDensity :=
  ResearchBankV24.FinalFirewalls.fw1_spectator_square_not_raw_density.2.2

/-- 4. Support factorization does NOT imply coefficient factorization. -/
theorem fw4_support_not_coefficient_factorization :
    ¬ ∃ a b : ℤ → ℂ, ∀ v h, (if v = h then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = a v * b h :=
  ResearchBankV27.OuterInnerSeparation.joint_dependence_allowed.2

/-- 5. Arbitrary bounded decorations may NOT depend on the final Kloosterman variables. -/
theorem fw5_no_kloosterman_decoration :
    ∃ Φ : (ℤ × ℤ) × Bool → ℂ, ∀ Ψ : ResearchBankV27.OuterInnerSeparation.InnerCoeff,
      ∃ i b, Φ (i, b) ≠ Ψ i :=
  ResearchBankV27.OuterInnerSeparation.decoration_firewall

/-- 6. Separate colour labels cost `√L` (not `L`) with the common Cauchy. -/
theorem fw6_labels_cost_sqrt {O I J : Type*} [Fintype O] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : O → ℂ) (w : O → ℝ) (hA : ∀ o, ‖A o‖ ^ 2 ≤ w o) (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ)
    (κ : O → J) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsingle : ∀ j, (∑ o, w o) * ResearchBankV27.CommonCauchy.energy K (Ψ j) ≤ B ^ 2) :
    ‖ResearchBankV27.FiniteLabelEnergy.labelSum A K Ψ κ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card J) * B ∧
      Real.sqrt 2 < 2 := by
  refine ⟨ResearchBankV27.FiniteLabelEnergy.labelled_sqrt_cost A w hA K Ψ κ hB hsingle, ?_⟩
  rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num

/-- 7. The character-free route does NOT prove DI itself. -/
theorem fw7_character_free_not_DI :
    ¬ ∀ K : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData, ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.DIConclusion K :=
  ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.DI_not_automatic

/-- 8. A finite verifier does NOT prove the spectral theorem. -/
theorem fw8_finite_verifier_not_spectral (η : ℝ) :
    (∀ K ∈ ([] : List ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData),
        ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.DIConclusion K) ∧
      ¬ ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => True) :=
  ⟨fun _ h => absurd h List.not_mem_nil, ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.unrestricted_provider_false η⟩

/-- 9. An asymptotic `M₀` does NOT imply an explicit `M₀`. -/
theorem fw9_asymptotic_not_explicit : NoExplicitM0Yet := noExplicitM0Yet_holds

/-- 10. Even an explicit asymptotic `M₀` still requires the finite splice for global #287. -/
theorem fw10_explicit_needs_splice : FiniteSpliceOpen := finiteSpliceOpen_holds

end EffectivityFirewall
end ResearchBankV28
end Erdos287

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §10: exact parameter instantiation

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

All values are exact rationals / naturals; no floating point.  The parameters are REUSED from the
frozen banks (no redefinition):

* `K = 2^41252000`, `P = 12K`, `a = 28593810`, `δ = 1/40000` — `ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters`;
* `ϑ = 273/500`, `ρ = 1/1000000`, `ϑ₀ = 545999/1000000` — `ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters`;

The audited functional bounds `μ_F > 7147687/10000`, `W_F < 98278402/10000` are CERTIFIED INPUTS
(the frozen `ThinFunctionalCertificate` shape); they are not computed here.

**LEAN BANK.**
* `parameter_values` — the literal values above;
* `principal_slack_reused` — `A_C − 2/ϑ₀ − 1/5000 = 147807727/186322158750 > 0` (V23, reused);
* `norm_transfer_witness_pos` — `8746001/25000000 > 0` (supplied witness value; its derivation
  formula is not part of the frozen banks and is recorded as supplied);
* `thin_margin_check_final` — the frozen exact check `ThinMarginCheck μ_lo W_hi (−423/5)`;
  `90 − 423/5 = 27/5`;
* `score_margin_exact` — `μ_lo − (A_C W_hi + 27/5)/99 − 350 − 1/20 = 11479502057/12285000000 > 0`
  (the `1/20` is the reserved slack of the score ledger);
* `clean_savings` — `347/418000 > 0` and `347/836000 > 0` (V27, reused).

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV28
namespace ExactParameterInstantiation

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters

/-- Audited lower bound for `μ_F` (certified input value). -/
def muLo : ℚ := 7147687 / 10000

/-- Audited upper bound for `W_F` (certified input value). -/
def WHi : ℚ := 98278402 / 10000

/-- The off-principal constant used in the final composition: `90 + err = 27/5`. -/
def errFinal : ℚ := -423 / 5

/-- The supplied norm-transfer witness. -/
def normTransferWitness : ℚ := 8746001 / 25000000

/-- **Parameter values** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem parameter_values :
    ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.K = 2 ^ 41252000 ∧
    ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.P = 12 * ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.K ∧
    ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.aParam = 28593810 ∧
    ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.delta = 1 / 40000 ∧
    ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.vartheta = 273 / 500 ∧
    ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.rho = 1 / 1000000 ∧
    ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.vartheta0 = 545999 / 1000000 ∧
    A_C = 1000273 / 273000 ∧
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.eta = 1 / 1100 ∧
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.sigma = 1 / 19000 := by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.vartheta0_eq, rfl,
    rfl, rfl⟩
  unfold ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.K
  rw [ResearchBankV17.ThinParameters.L_def]

/-- **Principal slack** (LEAN BANK, reused from V23). -/
theorem principal_slack_reused :
    A_C - 2 / ResearchBankV22.PositiveSieveParameters.vartheta0 - 1 / 5000 =
        147807727 / 186322158750 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < 147807727 / 186322158750 :=
  ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget.principal_slack

/-- **Norm-transfer witness** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem norm_transfer_witness_pos : normTransferWitness = 8746001 / 25000000 ∧
    (0 : ℚ) < normTransferWitness := by
  unfold normTransferWitness; norm_num

/-- `90 + err = 27/5` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem baseline_constant : baselineConst + errFinal = 27 / 5 := by
  unfold baselineConst errFinal; norm_num

/-- **The frozen exact thin margin check at the final constants** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem thin_margin_check_final :
    ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional.ThinMarginCheck muLo WHi errFinal := by
  unfold ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional.ThinMarginCheck RouteCMarginCheck threshold
    pairDen baselineConst A_C muLo WHi errFinal
  norm_num

/-- **Exact score margin** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem score_margin_exact :
    muLo - (A_C * WHi + 27 / 5) / 99 - 350 - 1 / 20 = 11479502057 / 12285000000 ∧
      (0 : ℚ) < 11479502057 / 12285000000 := by
  unfold muLo WHi A_C; norm_num

/-- **Clean savings** (LEAN BANK, reused from V27). -/
theorem clean_savings :
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.eta - 3 * ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.sigma / 2 =
        347 / 418000 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < 347 / 418000 ∧
    (ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.eta -
        3 * ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.sigma / 2) / 2 = 347 / 836000 ∧
      (0 : ℚ) < 347 / 836000 :=
  ⟨ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.clean_energy_saving.1,
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.clean_energy_saving.2,
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.clean_discrepancy_saving.1,
    ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum.clean_discrepancy_saving.2⟩

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8786 sha256=de008f8f9cd11eb25e626f5009d81b752275b05b464ca1d7ff0486efd875e1c7 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV28/FinalPairComposition.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §12: end-to-end pair composition

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**
**This is NOT a proved pair theorem: it is LEAN CONDITIONAL on `FinalAnalyticProviders`.**

The composition uses, for ONE and the SAME completed weight `Λ = LamFam S τ M` (V24):
1. the completed positive sieve and its coefficient contract (`lamFam_source_decomposition`,
   V24 LEAN BANK);
2./3. the zero-frequency (masked SW / BDH, V25 localization), one-large, two-large and
   product-boundary (V26) branch class bounds, combined through the DERIVED source-class provider;
4. the V27 DERIVED clean-nonzero theorem (`nonzero_branch_small`);
5./6. the zero-frequency and one-large / two-large branches (inside `sumDE`);
7. the V23 same-weight principal budget `principal_budget_le_A_C`;
8. the actual tensor approximation (`hat_approximation_eventually_small`).
No auxiliary weight changes between error and principal; the normalization `N` is the frozen one.

* **`routeC_pair_baseline_after_full_repair`** — the frozen V16 `RouteCBaselineProvider`:
  eventually `Pair/N ≤ A_C W_F + 90 + err + η`.
* `bx_norm_bound` — the non-off-principal part `‖B_x‖²_ν := M_new + |DE_src| + [DE_nz]_+ +
  C_t √|E_AB|` is eventually `≤ A_C W_F + η` (i.e. `A_C W_F + o(1)`).
* `pair_ratio_final` — at `err = −423/5`: eventually `P_actual/N ≤ A_C W_F + 27/5 + η`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV28
namespace FinalPairComposition

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalBudget
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV16.ConditionalRouteCImplication
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedProvider ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open RepairedAnalyticBundle

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- The non-off-principal part of the pair bound for the SAME weight. -/
noncomputable def BxSq {h : ℕ → ℝ} (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (pref : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ) (DEsrc DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Ct : ℝ) (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (model S M).Mnew (pref M) (Λ S τ M) + |DEsrc M (Λ S τ M)| + max (DEnz M (Λ S τ M)) 0 +
    Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M|

/-- **`‖B_x‖² ≤ A_C W_F + o(1)`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `FinalAnalyticProviders`). -/
theorem bx_norm_bound {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ}
    {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ}
    {muLo WHi : ℚ} {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz err muLo WHi muF DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    ∀ η > 0, ∃ S : ℕ, ∃ τ : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      BxSq model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ) (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) DEnz EAB Ct
        S τ M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η := by
  intro η hη
  -- 7. same-weight principal (V23)
  obtain ⟨S, -, τ, -, M1, hM1⟩ := principal_budget_le_A_C B.rosser B.tuple B.euler G.hU G.d1 G.d2
    G.d3 G.hh hLi hphi hWF (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 1.–3., 5., 6. source branches via the DERIVED source-class provider
  have Psrc := derived_source_class_provider B.zeroFreq B.oneLarge B.twoLarge B.boundary
  set Cm : ℝ := (((cd.R S τ + 1) ^ cd.nC S τ : ℕ) : ℝ) * 3 ^ cd.R S τ
  have hCm : 0 ≤ Cm := by positivity
  have hdec : ∀ M, SourceDecomposition (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) (Us S M) (Ur S M) Cm := by
    intro M
    rw [G.hUs, G.hUr]
    exact lamFam_source_decomposition cd G.d1 G.d2 G.d3 S τ M
  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := distribution_error_small Psrc S (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ) hCm hdec
    (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 4. the derived clean-nonzero theorem (V27)
  obtain ⟨M4, hM4⟩ := nonzero_branch_small B.di (fun M => DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M))
    (fun M => B.nonzero S τ M) (η / 4) (by positivity)
  -- 8. tensor approximation
  have hCt := B.tensor.Ct_nonneg
  set δ : ℝ := η / (4 * (Ct + 1))
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨M3, hM3⟩ := hat_approximation_eventually_small B.hat (δ ^ 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨S, τ, max (max M1 M2) (max M3 M4), fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have e1 := hM1 M (by omega)
  have e2 := hM2 M (by omega)
  have e4 := hM4 M (by omega)
  have e3 : Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ δ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left hδ.le]; exact hM3 M (by omega)
  have e3' : Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ η / 4 := by
    calc Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| ≤ Ct * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hCt
      _ ≤ (Ct + 1) * δ := by nlinarith
      _ = η / 4 := by simp only [δ]; field_simp
  have hmain : (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) ≤
      ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + η / 4 := e1
  unfold BxSq
  simp only at e4
  linarith

/-- **Route-C pair baseline after the full repair** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on
`FinalAnalyticProviders`; no monolithic source-class provider is used). -/
theorem routeC_pair_baseline_after_full_repair {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC}
    {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ}
    {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ} {muLo WHi : ℚ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz err muLo WHi muF DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    RouteCBaselineProvider τC W N (LF / I) err := by
  refine ⟨fun η hη => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨S, τ, M0, hM0⟩ := bx_norm_bound B G cd hLi hphi hWF η hη
  refine ⟨M0, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have hdec := B.tensor.decomp S τ M
  have hb := hM0 M hM
  unfold BxSq at hb
  linarith

/-- **Final pair ratio** (LEAN CONDITIONAL): with `err = −423/5`, eventually
`P_actual / N ≤ A_C W_F + 27/5 + η`. -/
theorem pair_ratio_final {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC}
    {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ}
    {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ} {muLo WHi : ℚ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz ((ExactParameterInstantiation.errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) muLo WHi muF DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    ∀ η > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀,
      Pair τC W M / N M ≤ ((A_C : ℚ) : ℝ) * (LF / I) + 27 / 5 + η := by
  intro η hη
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := (routeC_pair_baseline_after_full_repair B G cd hLi hphi hWF).eventual η hη
  refine ⟨M0, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have := hM0 M hM
  have herr : ((ExactParameterInstantiation.errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) = -423 / 5 := by
    unfold ExactParameterInstantiation.errFinal; push_cast; ring
  rw [herr] at this
  linarith

end FinalPairComposition
end ResearchBankV28

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Ledger

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §18: final ledger

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Status classes are those of `ResearchBankV25.Ledger.StatusClass`
(LEAN BANK / LEAN CONDITIONAL / EXTERNAL PROVIDER / FINITE REGRESSION / REPAIRED-RETIRED / OPEN).
V21–V24 are FROZEN (recorded as the inherited LEAN CONDITIONAL / LEAN BANK chain; not modified).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV28
namespace FinalStatus

open ResearchBankV25.Ledger
open ResearchBankV25.Ledger.StatusClass

/-- The final ledger rows (§18). -/
inductive FinalItem
  | fixedModulusCentering
  | fixedResidueEnergyContraction
  | goodModulusAffineClearing
  | roughHBExactIdentities
  | hbSourceAdapter
  | decoratedCoefficientGrouping
  | representationMoment
  | diSpectralTheorem
  | finiteLabelEnergyGrouping
  | crtColourOrbitCardinality
  | characterFreeColourCost
  | smoothCutoffRecovery
  | globalDAggregationArithmetic
  | cleanNonzeroTheorem
  | sameWeightPrincipal
  | actualPairBaseline
  | preEffectivityAsymptotic
  | parameterArithmetic
  | overclaimFirewalls
  | monolithicSourceClassProvider
  | explicitM0
  | finiteSplice
  | globalErdos287
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open FinalItem

def status : FinalItem → StatusClass
  | fixedModulusCentering => leanBank
  | fixedResidueEnergyContraction => leanBank
  | goodModulusAffineClearing => leanBank
  | roughHBExactIdentities => leanBank
  | hbSourceAdapter => leanBank
  | decoratedCoefficientGrouping => leanBank
  | representationMoment => leanConditional
  | diSpectralTheorem => externalProvider
  | finiteLabelEnergyGrouping => leanBank
  | crtColourOrbitCardinality => leanBank
  | characterFreeColourCost => leanConditional
  | smoothCutoffRecovery => leanConditional
  | globalDAggregationArithmetic => leanBank
  | cleanNonzeroTheorem => leanConditional
  | sameWeightPrincipal => leanConditional
  | actualPairBaseline => leanConditional
  | preEffectivityAsymptotic => leanConditional
  | parameterArithmetic => leanBank
  | overclaimFirewalls => finiteRegression
  | monolithicSourceClassProvider => repairedRetired
  | explicitM0 => openProblem
  | finiteSplice => openProblem
  | globalErdos287 => openProblem

/-- **Final classification** (checked by `decide`). -/
theorem final_status :
    status fixedModulusCentering = leanBank ∧ status fixedResidueEnergyContraction = leanBank ∧
    status goodModulusAffineClearing = leanBank ∧ status roughHBExactIdentities = leanBank ∧
    status decoratedCoefficientGrouping = leanBank ∧ status diSpectralTheorem = externalProvider ∧
    status finiteLabelEnergyGrouping = leanBank ∧ status crtColourOrbitCardinality = leanBank ∧
    status characterFreeColourCost = leanConditional ∧
    status cleanNonzeroTheorem = leanConditional ∧ status actualPairBaseline = leanConditional ∧
    status preEffectivityAsymptotic = leanConditional ∧
    status monolithicSourceClassProvider = repairedRetired ∧
    status explicitM0 = openProblem ∧ status finiteSplice = openProblem ∧
    status globalErdos287 = openProblem := by
  decide

/-- The OPEN rows are exactly explicit `M₀`, finite splice and global #287. -/
theorem open_rows : ∀ i, status i = openProblem ↔ i = explicitM0 ∨ i = finiteSplice ∨
    i = globalErdos287 := by
  intro i; cases i <;> simp [status]

end FinalStatus
end ResearchBankV28
end Erdos287

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §13: the pre-effectivity asymptotic theorem

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

* **`pre_effectivity_asymptotic_287_after_full_repair`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on
  `FinalAnalyticProviders` only, plus the structural sieve geometry / rounding data):

      FinalAnalyticProviders  ⟹  ∃ M₀, ∀ M ≥ M₀, no counterexample has maximum denominator M.

  It reuses the frozen S0 (from the principal provider's normalization field), S1, graph, score,
  compiler, contact, row rigidity and harmonic contradiction chain through
  `ResearchBankV20.ConditionalAsymptotic287.conditional_asymptotic_287_of_baseline`, with the
  exact final margin check `thin_margin_check_final` at `err = −423/5`.

This theorem is NOT the global Erdős #287: `M₀` is only asserted to exist (it may depend on
ineffective analytic constants), no explicit `M₀` is produced, and the finite splice is not
performed.
-/

namespace Erdos287

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Pre-effectivity asymptotic #287 after the full repair** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem pre_effectivity_asymptotic_287_after_full_repair {τC : FixedTupleC V}
    {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz : ℝ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz ((errFinal : ℚ) : ℝ) muLo WHi muF DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10732 sha256=9489fcc65c236a60da2de9651052232529fe816d31630f9b75ddb10df782f362 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV28/RepairedAnalyticBundle.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV24.ConditionalAsymptotic287
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.CleanNonzero
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V28 §11: the minimal final analytic bundle

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`FinalAnalyticProviders` collects ONLY genuinely unformalized analytic inputs (EXTERNAL
PROVIDER interfaces; the bundle is never constructed):

* `rosser`, `tuple` — Rosser scalar asymptotic and prime-harmonic tuple input (V22);
* `euler` — principal Euler/Mellin provider (V23; carries the frozen S0 normalization);
* `hat` — tensor/hat reference approximation (V23);
* `di` — the ONE minimal `DISpectralProvider` (V27) at `η = 1/1100` for the class `DIClass`
  of public DI forms (the realized forms must lie in `DIClass`);
* `zeroFreq` — the masked-SW / BDH zero-frequency branch class bound;
* `oneLarge`, `twoLarge` — the one-large / two-large HB branch class bounds;
* `boundary` — the product-boundary branch class bound (V26 union-of-boundary estimate);
* `nonzero` — for every family weight, a clean realization of the nonzero-frequency branch: clean
  states at scale `x = M` together with their per-instance `RepresentationMomentProvider`,
  `DivisorSumProvider` and the named `NonzeroPruningContract` (V27);
* `tensor` — the same-weight actual-measure decomposition `BranchedActualMeasureProvider`
  (tensor approximation / actual measure, still external);
* `s1` — the S1 contract; `cert` — the certified functional bounds `μ_F > μ_lo`, `W_F < W_hi`.

It does NOT contain fixed-modulus centering, residue-energy projection, HB algebra, cell
colouring, positive-sieve finite algebra, finite-label colour grouping, CRT orbit counting or
parameter arithmetic: those are kernel theorems (V21–V27).  Nor does it contain the retired
monolithic source-class provider: the V24 `SourceClassDistributionProvider` is DERIVED here
(`derived_source_class_provider`) from the four branch class bounds.

**LEAN BANK / LEAN CONDITIONAL.**
* `derived_source_class_provider` — the four branch class bounds give the V24
  `SourceClassDistributionProvider` for the summed branch functional;
* `nonzero_branch_small` — from the V27 derived clean-nonzero theorem:
  eventually `[DE_nz(Λ)]_+ ≤ ε`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV28
namespace RepairedAnalyticBundle

open Finset
open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)
open ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedProvider ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.CleanNonzero ResearchBankV27.DecoratedLemma ResearchBankV27.DISpectral
  ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum

/-- A branch class bound (EXTERNAL PROVIDER shape): the branch functional is linear and is
eventually small on every source-factorized weight. -/
structure BranchClassBound (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) (DEb : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop where
  linear : ∀ M {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → Finset ℕ → ℝ),
    DEb M (fun A => ∑ i, c i * g i A) = ∑ i, c i * DEb M (g i)
  class_bound : ∀ S : ℕ, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ∀ g : Finset ℕ → ℝ,
    SourceFactorization g (Us S M) (Ur S M) → |DEb M g| ≤ ε

/-- The summed branch functional `DE_src = DE_zero + DE_one + DE_two + DE_bdry`. -/
def sumDE (D0 D1 D2 Db : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ :=
  fun M g => D0 M g + D1 M g + D2 M g + Db M g

/-- **The V24 source-class provider is DERIVED** from the four branch class bounds (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem derived_source_class_provider {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} (h0 : BranchClassBound Us Ur D0)
    (h1 : BranchClassBound Us Ur D1) (h2 : BranchClassBound Us Ur D2)
    (hb : BranchClassBound Us Ur Db) :
    SourceClassDistributionProvider Us Ur (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) := by
  refine ⟨fun M ι _ c g => ?_, fun S ε hε => ?_⟩
  · simp only [sumDE]
    rw [h0.linear, h1.linear, h2.linear, hb.linear, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  · obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ := h0.class_bound S (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ := h1.class_bound S (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨A2, hA2⟩ := h2.class_bound S (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨Ab, hAb⟩ := hb.class_bound S (ε / 4) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨max (max A0 A1) (max A2 Ab), fun M hM g hg => ?_⟩
    have e0 := hA0 M (by omega) g hg
    have e1 := hA1 M (by omega) g hg
    have e2 := hA2 M (by omega) g hg
    have eb := hAb M (by omega) g hg
    simp only [sumDE]
    calc |D0 M g + D1 M g + D2 M g + Db M g| ≤ |D0 M g| + |D1 M g| + |D2 M g| + |Db M g| := by
          have := abs_add_le (D0 M g + D1 M g + D2 M g) (Db M g)
          have := abs_add_le (D0 M g + D1 M g) (D2 M g)
          have := abs_add_le (D0 M g) (D1 M g)
          linarith
      _ ≤ ε := by linarith

/-- **Clean realization of the nonzero-frequency branch** at scale `x` for the value `val`
(named composition interface; its analytic content is the per-instance
`RepresentationMomentProvider`, `DivisorSumProvider` and `NonzeroPruningContract`). -/
def NonzeroCleanRealization (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) (x val Cnz : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (β : Type) (ε NU : ℝ) (Rnz : ℂ) (Ds : Finset ℕ) (bs : ℕ → Finset β)
    (st : ℕ → β → CleanState x) (Γ : ℕ → β → ℂ) (C : ℕ),
    0 ≤ NU ∧ NU ≤ Cnz ∧ ε ≤ 347 / 836000 ∧
    (∀ D ∈ Ds, ∀ b ∈ bs D, (st D b).D = D) ∧
    (∀ D ∈ Ds, ∀ b ∈ bs D, (st D b).DD.KD.Nq / (st D b).d = NU) ∧
    (∀ D ∈ Ds, ∀ b ∈ bs D, RepresentationMomentProvider (st D b).DD) ∧
    (∀ D ∈ Ds, ∀ b ∈ bs D, CleanAdmissible DIClass (1 / 1100) (st D b)) ∧
    (∀ D ∈ Ds, ∑ b ∈ bs D, ‖Γ D b‖ ≤ ((Nat.divisors D).card : ℝ) ^ C) ∧
    DivisorSumProvider Ds C x (1 / 19000) ε ∧
    NonzeroPruningContract Rnz Ds bs Γ (fun D b => (st D b).P) NU x ∧
    val = Rnz.re

/-- **Nonzero branch is eventually small** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `DISpectralProvider` and the
clean realizations): derived from the V27 clean-nonzero THEOREM with `A = 1`. -/
theorem nonzero_branch_small {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop} {Cnz : ℝ}
    (hDI : DISpectralProvider (1 / 1100) DIClass) (val : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hreal : ∀ M : ℕ, NonzeroCleanRealization DIClass M (val M) Cnz) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, max (val M) 0 ≤ ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0⟩ := clean_nonzero_derived 1
  refine ⟨⌈max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε))⌉₊ + 3, fun M hM => ?_⟩
  have hMr : max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε)) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.le_ceil (max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε)))
    have : ((⌈max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε))⌉₊ + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
    push_cast at this; linarith
  have hM3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    have : ((⌈max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε))⌉₊ + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
    push_cast at this; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) ⌈max X0 (Real.exp (|Cnz| / ε))⌉₊]
  obtain ⟨β, ε', NU, Rnz, Ds, bs, st, Γ, C, hNU, hNUC, hε', hstD, hnorm, hRep, hadm, hroot, hdiv,
    hprune, hval⟩ := hreal M
  have hb := hX0 M (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hMr) ε' NU Rnz hNU hε' hDI Ds bs st Γ C hstD hnorm
    hRep hadm hroot hdiv hprune
  rw [Real.rpow_one] at hb
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log M := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog : |Cnz| / ε ≤ Real.log M := by
    rw [← Real.log_exp (|Cnz| / ε)]
    exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hMr)
  rw [hval]
  refine hb.trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hlogpos]
  have h1 : NU ≤ |Cnz| := hNUC.trans (le_abs_self _)
  have h2 : |Cnz| ≤ ε * Real.log M := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at hlog; linarith
  linarith

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **Same-weight branched actual-measure / tensor decomposition** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never
constructed): for the SAME weight `Λ S τ M` in every term,
`Pair/N ≤ M_new(Λ) + |DE_src(Λ)| + [DE_nz(Λ)]_+ + C_t √|E_AB| + 90 + err`. -/
structure BranchedActualMeasureProvider (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC) (N : ℕ → ℝ)
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (pref : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ) (DEsrc DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Ct err : ℝ) : Prop where
  Ct_nonneg : 0 ≤ Ct
  decomp : ∀ S τ M, Pair τC W M / N M ≤
    (model S M).Mnew (pref M) (Λ S τ M) + |DEsrc M (Λ S τ M)| + max (DEnz M (Λ S τ M)) 0 +
      Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err

/-- **The final analytic bundle** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER interfaces only; never constructed). -/
structure FinalAnalyticProviders (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC)
    (K : ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (E : Finset ℕ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ)
    (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData) (LF I : ℝ)
    (N Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ) (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (Kh : ℕ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) (D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (Ct Cnz err : ℝ)
    (muLo WHi : ℚ) (muF : ℝ) (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) where
  rosser : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X
  tuple : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ
  euler : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I (S0 τC W) N Li phiW model
  hat : HatReferenceApproximationProvider Kh EAB
  di : DISpectralProvider (1 / 1100) DIClass
  zeroFreq : BranchClassBound Us Ur D0
  oneLarge : BranchClassBound Us Ur D1
  twoLarge : BranchClassBound Us Ur D2
  boundary : BranchClassBound Us Ur Db
  nonzero : ∀ (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ),
    NonzeroCleanRealization DIClass M (DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)) Cnz
  tensor : BranchedActualMeasureProvider τC W N model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ)
    (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) DEnz EAB Ct err
  s1 : S1Contract (S1 τC W) N muF
  cert : ThinFunctionalCertificate muLo WHi muF (LF / I)

end RepairedAnalyticBundle
end ResearchBankV28

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.PhysicalCleanState

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §4: DIClass membership (audit, STOP point)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

In V27/V28 `DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop` is a **free parameter** of
`DISpectralProvider`, `CleanAdmissible`, `NonzeroCleanRealization` and `FinalAnalyticProviders`.
It is never defined.  The following facts (all LEAN BANK / FINITE REGRESSION) show that the V28
typing does not determine it, so `actual_clean_state_mem_DIClass` cannot be proved in this bank:

* `di_provider_empty_class` — with `DIClass := False` the DI provider holds trivially;
* `di_provider_full_class_false` — with `DIClass := True` it is false (V27 regression, restated);
* `DIClass_underdetermined` — both at once: the same V28 type admits a vacuous and a false reading;
* `cleanAdmissible_empty_class` — with `DIClass := False` no clean state is admissible, so the
  V27 clean-nonzero theorem is then applicable only to EMPTY clean families.

**Earliest remaining composition hole (task §4 STOP):** `ActualCleanStateMemDIClass` below — for
the (non-existent) physical clean states of the nonzero branch, membership `DIClass s.DD.KD` for a
DIClass that is (a) the literal public DI class and (b) contains those states.  Neither (a) a
definition of that class nor (b) a physical clean-state generator exists in V2–V28.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace DIClassRealization

open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV27.CleanNonzero

/-- **Vacuous DI class** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem di_provider_empty_class (η : ℝ) : DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => False) :=
  ⟨fun _ h _ => h.elim⟩

/-- **Unrestricted DI class is false** (FINITE REGRESSION, V27 restated). -/
theorem di_provider_full_class_false (η : ℝ) : ¬ DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => True) :=
  unrestricted_provider_false η

/-- **`DIClass` is underdetermined by the V28 typing** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem DIClass_underdetermined (η : ℝ) :
    DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => False) ∧ ¬ DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => True) :=
  ⟨di_provider_empty_class η, di_provider_full_class_false η⟩

/-- With the vacuous class no clean state is admissible (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem cleanAdmissible_empty_class {η x : ℝ} (s : CleanState x) :
    ¬ CleanAdmissible (fun _ => False) η s := fun h => h.1

/-- **The earliest remaining composition hole** (named statement; NOT proved, NOT assumed by any
V29 theorem except through the explicitly labelled internal glue owner of `ProviderElimination`):
every clean state produced by a physical realization `gen` lies in `DIClass`. -/
def ActualCleanStateMemDIClass (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) {β : Type} {x : ℝ}
    (gen : β → CleanState x) : Prop :=
  ∀ b, DIClass (gen b).DD.KD

end DIClassRealization
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.SourceNormalization
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §10–§11: functional certificate and score formula

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## §10 Functional certificate — FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT

A repository-wide search (all `.lean` files and all reports) for `7147687` and `98278402` finds
only the V28 constants `muLo`, `WHi`, their V28 report and `ARISTOTLE_SUMMARY.md`.  **No rational
certificate data (quadrature nodes, interval enclosures, optimisation witnesses) exists in the
repository**, so `μ_F > 7147687/10000` and `W_F < 98278402/10000` cannot be derived here.  They are
isolated in the narrowly named `FunctionalKernelCertificate` (NOT inside any analytic provider
bundle), labelled FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT, with provenance string `certificateProvenance`.

The exponent `−1079/1900` (V27 `realCorrectionExponent`) likewise has no derivation formula in the
repository; only `−1079/1900 = −1/2 − 129/1900` and its sign comparisons are checked
(`exponent_supplied_facts`).  Missing derivation: the real-correction analytic estimate producing
the `129/1900` excess.  The witness `8746001/25000000` (V28) is in the same situation.

## §11 Score formula — MISMATCH REPORTED

The consumer of the final theorem is `ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters.RouteCMarginCheck`
(through `ThinMarginCheck`), i.e. `350 + (A_C W_hi + 90 + err)/99 < μ_lo`.  With `err = −423/5`
(`errFinal`) the quantity actually consumed is

    μ_lo − (A_C W_hi + 27/5)/99 − 350          (= 12093752057/12285000000),

**without** the `− 1/20` of the task's formula.  The task formula equals the consumed quantity
minus `1/20` (`score_formula_relation`) and equals `11479502057/12285000000 > 0`; since it is
strictly smaller, its positivity IMPLIES the consumer check (`task_score_implies_consumer`), but
it is NOT literally the consumed quantity: the `1/20` is an unconsumed reserve slack.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace FunctionalCertificate

open ResearchBankV16.RouteCParameters ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional
open ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation

/-- Provenance of the certified functional inequalities. -/
def certificateProvenance : String :=
  "Route-C functional certificate (FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT): mu_F > 7147687/10000 and " ++
  "W_F < 98278402/10000, supplied as audited numerical bounds in the V28/V29 task statements; " ++
  "no rational certificate data exists in this repository."

/-- **FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT** — only the two certified inequalities (plus `W_F ≥ 0`). -/
structure FunctionalKernelCertificate (muF WF : ℝ) : Prop where
  muF_gt : ((7147687 / 10000 : ℚ) : ℝ) < muF
  WF_lt : WF < ((98278402 / 10000 : ℚ) : ℝ)
  WF_nonneg : 0 ≤ WF

theorem mu_F_lower {muF WF : ℝ} (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF WF) :
    ((7147687 / 10000 : ℚ) : ℝ) < muF := C.muF_gt

theorem W_F_upper {muF WF : ℝ} (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF WF) :
    WF < ((98278402 / 10000 : ℚ) : ℝ) := C.WF_lt

/-- The certificate is exactly the frozen thin certificate at `(muLo, WHi)` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem certificate_iff_thin (muF WF : ℝ) :
    FunctionalKernelCertificate muF WF ↔ ThinFunctionalCertificate muLo WHi muF WF := by
  constructor
  · intro C; exact ⟨by simpa [muLo] using C.muF_gt, by simpa [WHi] using C.WF_lt, C.WF_nonneg⟩
  · intro C
    exact ⟨by simpa [muLo] using C.muF_gt, by simpa [WHi] using C.WF_lt, C.WF_nonneg⟩

/-- The exponent `−1079/1900`: supplied value, rational facts only (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem exponent_supplied_facts :
    ResearchBankV27.SmoothFrequencyRecovery.realCorrectionExponent = -1 / 2 - 129 / 1900 ∧
      ResearchBankV27.SmoothFrequencyRecovery.realCorrectionExponent < -(1 / 1100) :=
  ⟨ResearchBankV27.SmoothFrequencyRecovery.real_correction_exponent_facts.2.2.2,
    ResearchBankV27.SmoothFrequencyRecovery.real_correction_exponent_facts.2.2.1⟩

/-- The quantity literally consumed by the final consumer. -/
def consumedMargin : ℚ := muLo - (A_C * WHi + baselineConst + errFinal) / pairDen - threshold

/-- The task's score formula. -/
def taskScore : ℚ := muLo - (A_C * WHi + 27 / 5) / 99 - 350 - 1 / 20

/-- **The consumer check is positivity of `consumedMargin`** (LEAN BANK, from definitions). -/
theorem consumer_check_iff : ThinMarginCheck muLo WHi errFinal ↔ 0 < consumedMargin := by
  unfold ThinMarginCheck RouteCMarginCheck consumedMargin
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

/-- The consumed margin in closed form (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem consumedMargin_value :
    consumedMargin = muLo - (A_C * WHi + 27 / 5) / 99 - 350 ∧
      consumedMargin = 12093752057 / 12285000000 := by
  unfold consumedMargin muLo WHi A_C baselineConst errFinal pairDen threshold
  constructor <;> norm_num

/-- **Score-formula relation / mismatch** (LEAN BANK): task score = consumed margin − 1/20. -/
theorem score_formula_relation : taskScore = consumedMargin - 1 / 20 := by
  unfold taskScore consumedMargin baselineConst errFinal pairDen threshold; ring

/-- The task score value (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem taskScore_value : taskScore = 11479502057 / 12285000000 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < taskScore := by
  unfold taskScore muLo WHi A_C; constructor <;> norm_num

/-- **Task score positivity implies the consumer check** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem task_score_implies_consumer (h : 0 < taskScore) : ThinMarginCheck muLo WHi errFinal := by
  rw [consumer_check_iff]; rw [score_formula_relation] at h; linarith

/-- **The task score is NOT the consumed quantity** (LEAN BANK): they differ by exactly `1/20`. -/
theorem taskScore_ne_consumed : taskScore ≠ consumedMargin := by
  rw [score_formula_relation]; norm_num

end FunctionalCertificate
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=2955 sha256=a1110b08eef289f967b7c24f0564990dc90cf0c70e3fd1018bb327fa12beffdc path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV29/KernelRealization.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.DIClassRealization

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §5: physical smooth source → kernel (audit)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Audit finding

The only smooth-cutoff objects in V27 (`SmoothFrequencyRecovery`) are an ABSTRACT Fourier profile
`psiHat : ℝ → ℝ` and an abstract weight sequence `b : ℕ → ℝ`, constrained only through the
providers `SchwartzFrequencyProvider`, `FrequencyCapProvider`, `SmoothRecoveryProvider`.  No
physical cutoff `ψ` (support, normalization, smoothness class) is defined, and the kernel `Kl` of a
`KloostermanData` is an arbitrary function `B → Z → ℂ`.  Hence `realize_clean_kernel :
PhysicalCleanState → DIKernel` cannot be constructed from the bank without inventing the DI kernel
formula, which task §24 forbids.

**Proved here (FINITE REGRESSION / LEAN BANK):**
* `zeroKernelForm_DI` — the form with kernel `0` (same numeric data as the degenerate form)
  satisfies the DI conclusion;
* `kernel_is_load_bearing` — two Kloosterman forms with IDENTICAL numeric parameters
  `Q,R,S,N,d,x,ε_DI,Ξ,mass,Rep,N_q,T,Δ₂,Δ₃` and identical off-diagonal set differ in the DI
  conclusion.  So membership in any correct DI class depends on the kernel itself, which must be
  constructed from the physical cutoff: the numeric parameters do not suffice.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace KernelRealization

open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral

/-- The degenerate form with the kernel replaced by `0`. -/
noncomputable def zeroKernelForm (η : ℝ) : KloostermanData :=
  { degenerateForm η with Kl := fun _ _ => 0 }

/-- **The zero-kernel form satisfies the DI conclusion** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem zeroKernelForm_DI (η : ℝ) : DIConclusion (zeroKernelForm η) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [zeroKernelForm, degenerateForm], fun c _ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [bilinear, zeroKernelForm, degenerateForm]
  · simp [zeroKernelForm, degenerateForm]

/-- **The kernel is load-bearing** (FINITE REGRESSION): same numeric data, different DI verdict. -/
theorem kernel_is_load_bearing (η : ℝ) :
    (zeroKernelForm η).Q = (degenerateForm η).Q ∧ (zeroKernelForm η).R = (degenerateForm η).R ∧
    (zeroKernelForm η).S = (degenerateForm η).S ∧ (zeroKernelForm η).N = (degenerateForm η).N ∧
    (zeroKernelForm η).d = (degenerateForm η).d ∧ (zeroKernelForm η).x = (degenerateForm η).x ∧
    (zeroKernelForm η).epsDI = (degenerateForm η).epsDI ∧
    (zeroKernelForm η).Xi = (degenerateForm η).Xi ∧
    (zeroKernelForm η).Nq = (degenerateForm η).Nq ∧ (zeroKernelForm η).T = (degenerateForm η).T ∧
    DIConclusion (zeroKernelForm η) ∧ ¬ DIConclusion (degenerateForm η) :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, zeroKernelForm_DI η, degenerateForm_not_DI η⟩

end KernelRealization
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3687 sha256=8e346ae9ac5aeb2478746bd7d7dd8c71bac56c716896f60e8182957ac66af84a path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV29/Ledger.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Ledger
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.ProviderElimination

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29: ledger

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

One row per V28 bundle field (plus the V29 task items), with (a) its status class
(`ResearchBankV25.Ledger.StatusClass`) and (b) its INTERNAL / EXTERNAL classification and whether
V29 eliminated it.  Checked by `decide`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace Ledger

open ResearchBankV25.Ledger
open ResearchBankV25.Ledger.StatusClass

/-- Classification of an assumption (task §2). -/
inductive Kind
  | internal
  | external
  | finiteCertified
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Outcome of the V29 elimination attempt. -/
inductive Outcome
  | eliminated
  | keptExternal
  | keptInternalGlue
  | isolatedCertificate
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The rows. -/
inductive V29Item
  | rosser | tuple | euler | hat | di | zeroFreq | oneLarge | twoLarge | boundary
  | nonzero | tensor | s1 | cert
  | sameNormalization | sameWeight | scoreFormula | pruningContract | diClassMembership
  | kernelRealization
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open V29Item Kind Outcome

def kind : V29Item → Kind
  | rosser => external | tuple => external | euler => external | hat => external
  | di => external | zeroFreq => external | oneLarge => external | twoLarge => external
  | boundary => external | nonzero => internal | tensor => internal | s1 => external
  | cert => finiteCertified | sameNormalization => internal | sameWeight => internal
  | scoreFormula => internal | pruningContract => internal | diClassMembership => internal
  | kernelRealization => internal

def outcome : V29Item → Outcome
  | rosser => keptExternal | tuple => keptExternal | euler => keptExternal
  | hat => keptExternal | di => keptExternal | zeroFreq => keptExternal
  | oneLarge => keptExternal | twoLarge => keptExternal | boundary => keptExternal
  | nonzero => keptInternalGlue | tensor => keptInternalGlue | s1 => keptExternal
  | cert => isolatedCertificate | sameNormalization => eliminated | sameWeight => eliminated
  | scoreFormula => eliminated | pruningContract => keptInternalGlue
  | diClassMembership => keptInternalGlue | kernelRealization => keptInternalGlue

def status : V29Item → StatusClass
  | rosser => externalProvider | tuple => externalProvider | euler => externalProvider
  | hat => externalProvider | di => externalProvider | zeroFreq => externalProvider
  | oneLarge => externalProvider | twoLarge => externalProvider
  | boundary => externalProvider | nonzero => openProblem | tensor => openProblem
  | s1 => externalProvider | cert => externalProvider | sameNormalization => leanBank
  | sameWeight => leanBank | scoreFormula => leanBank | pruningContract => openProblem
  | diClassMembership => openProblem | kernelRealization => openProblem

/-- **No internal row is kept as an external provider** (checked). -/
theorem internal_not_external : ∀ i, kind i = internal → outcome i ≠ keptExternal := by
  intro i; cases i <;> decide

/-- **The internal rows NOT eliminated are exactly the glue-owner rows** (checked). -/
theorem remaining_internal :
    ∀ i, (kind i = internal ∧ outcome i ≠ eliminated) ↔
      i = nonzero ∨ i = tensor ∨ i = pruningContract ∨ i = diClassMembership ∨
        i = kernelRealization := by
  intro i; cases i <;> decide

/-- The certificate is isolated, not an analytic provider (checked). -/
theorem cert_isolated : kind cert = finiteCertified ∧ outcome cert = isolatedCertificate := by
  decide

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5531 sha256=e9088470c8ad8dbb97fb6d1925e353ddb8fe70ab3b75b3332ac8e9422822afd2 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV29/NonzeroPruning.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.KernelRealization

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §6: the nonzero pruning contract

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Audit finding

`NonzeroPruningContract Rnz Ds bs Γ P NU x` (V27) takes the nonzero-frequency value `Rnz : ℂ` as a
free argument.  In V28 it enters only through `NonzeroCleanRealization`, whose value is
`DEnz M (Λ)` for an UNINTERPRETED functional `DEnz`.  There is no physical operator `R_nonzero` in
V2–V28, so the exact decomposition `R_nonzero = P_clean + E_mixed + … + E_other` cannot be
reconstructed "from the physical operator".  **The contract is therefore NOT retired in V29**; it
remains inside the explicitly labelled internal glue owner (`ProviderElimination`).

## What is proved (LEAN BANK)

* `NonzeroSectorDecomposition` — the exact seven-sector decomposition shape required by §6
  (mixed, reference, shared-gcd, cross-gcd, short-difference, diagonal, other), with one bound per
  sector, stated BEFORE estimates as an exact identity;
* `nonzero_pruning_from_sector_decomposition` — any such exact sector decomposition whose sector
  bounds sum to at most `NU · x^{−347/836000}` yields `NonzeroPruningContract` (no combination by
  name: the seven norms are added by the triangle inequality);
* `pruning_contract_empty` / `nonzero_realization_zero` — for the value `0` the contract and the
  whole V28 clean realization are satisfied by the EMPTY clean family.  This is the formal reason the
  V28 `nonzero` field carries no source content while `DEnz` is uninterpreted (see `SameSourceChain`
  in V30);
* `pruning_contract_nontrivial` — the contract is not vacuous in general (`Rnz = 1`, empty family,
  `NU = 0` fails).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace NonzeroPruning

open Finset ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV27.CleanNonzero
  ResearchBankV27.GlobalConductorSum ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle

/-- The seven error sectors of the nonzero-frequency operator, with an EXACT identity and one
bound per sector (the shape demanded by task §6). -/
structure NonzeroSectorDecomposition {β : Type*} (Rnz : ℂ) (Ds : Finset ℕ) (bs : ℕ → Finset β)
    (Γ P : ℕ → β → ℂ) where
  Emixed : ℂ
  Eref : ℂ
  Eshared : ℂ
  Ecross : ℂ
  Eshort : ℂ
  Ediag : ℂ
  Eother : ℂ
  bmixed : ℝ
  bref : ℝ
  bshared : ℝ
  bcross : ℝ
  bshort : ℝ
  bdiag : ℝ
  bother : ℝ
  exact : Rnz = (∑ D ∈ Ds, ∑ b ∈ bs D, Γ D b * P D b) + Emixed + Eref + Eshared + Ecross +
    Eshort + Ediag + Eother
  hmixed : ‖Emixed‖ ≤ bmixed
  href : ‖Eref‖ ≤ bref
  hshared : ‖Eshared‖ ≤ bshared
  hcross : ‖Ecross‖ ≤ bcross
  hshort : ‖Eshort‖ ≤ bshort
  hdiag : ‖Ediag‖ ≤ bdiag
  hother : ‖Eother‖ ≤ bother

/-- **Pruning contract from an exact sector decomposition** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem nonzero_pruning_from_sector_decomposition {β : Type*} {Rnz : ℂ} {Ds : Finset ℕ}
    {bs : ℕ → Finset β} {Γ P : ℕ → β → ℂ} {NU x : ℝ}
    (S : NonzeroSectorDecomposition Rnz Ds bs Γ P)
    (hsum : S.bmixed + S.bref + S.bshared + S.bcross + S.bshort + S.bdiag + S.bother ≤
      NU * x ^ (-(347 / 836000 : ℝ))) :
    NonzeroPruningContract Rnz Ds bs Γ P NU x := by
  refine ⟨⟨S.Emixed + S.Eref + S.Eshared + S.Ecross + S.Eshort + S.Ediag + S.Eother, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := S.exact
    linear_combination this
  · have h1 := norm_add_le (S.Emixed + S.Eref + S.Eshared + S.Ecross + S.Eshort + S.Ediag) S.Eother
    have h2 := norm_add_le (S.Emixed + S.Eref + S.Eshared + S.Ecross + S.Eshort) S.Ediag
    have h3 := norm_add_le (S.Emixed + S.Eref + S.Eshared + S.Ecross) S.Eshort
    have h4 := norm_add_le (S.Emixed + S.Eref + S.Eshared) S.Ecross
    have h5 := norm_add_le (S.Emixed + S.Eref) S.Eshared
    have h6 := norm_add_le S.Emixed S.Eref
    linarith [S.hmixed, S.href, S.hshared, S.hcross, S.hshort, S.hdiag, S.hother]

/-- The contract for value `0` with any family is satisfied by `E = −(clean aggregate)` only if
that is small; for the EMPTY family it holds outright (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem pruning_contract_empty {β : Type*} (bs : ℕ → Finset β) (Γ P : ℕ → β → ℂ) {NU x : ℝ}
    (hNU : 0 ≤ NU) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : NonzeroPruningContract (0 : ℂ) ∅ bs Γ P NU x :=
  ⟨⟨0, by simp, by simpa using mul_nonneg hNU (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _)⟩⟩

/-- **The contract is not vacuous** (FINITE REGRESSION). -/
theorem pruning_contract_nontrivial {β : Type*} (bs : ℕ → Finset β) (Γ P : ℕ → β → ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    ¬ NonzeroPruningContract (1 : ℂ) ∅ bs Γ P 0 x := by
  rintro ⟨E, hE, hb⟩
  simp only [sum_empty, zero_add] at hE
  subst hE
  norm_num at hb

/-- **The V28 clean realization holds for the value `0` with the empty clean family** (LEAN BANK),
for EVERY `DIClass`. -/
theorem nonzero_realization_zero (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) {x Cnz : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hC : 0 ≤ Cnz) : NonzeroCleanRealization DIClass x 0 Cnz := by
  refine ⟨Empty, 0, 0, 0, ∅, fun _ => ∅, fun _ b => b.elim, fun _ _ => 0, 0, le_rfl, hC,
    by norm_num, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, pruning_contract_empty _ _ _ le_rfl hx, by simp⟩
  · intro D hD; simp at hD
  · intro D hD; simp at hD
  · intro D hD; simp at hD
  · intro D hD; simp at hD
  · intro D hD; simp at hD
  · exact ⟨by simpa using Real.rpow_nonneg hx _⟩

end NonzeroPruning
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.TypeIIBranchComposition

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §7.3: one-large branch composition

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Audit finding

The one-large branch enters V28 only as `oneLarge : BranchClassBound Us Ur D1` with `D1`
UNINTERPRETED.  No coefficient sequence / modulus of the one-large branch is constructed from the
physical source anywhere in V2–V28, and no separate one-large analytic theorem with literal
hypotheses (sequence, modulus range, coefficient bound) exists in the bank.  The field is
therefore kept as the external-shape provider `OneLargeAnalyticProvider` (a class bound over
source-factorized weights), and the identification `D1 = physical one-large functional` is
recorded as missing.

## Proved here (LEAN BANK)

* `oneLarge_sum_split` — the one-large contribution may be split over any finite family of
  sub-boxes with the class bound applied to each (linearity + triangle inequality), i.e. the
  composition step from "every box satisfies the provider hypotheses" to the branch bound.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace OneLargeComposition

open ResearchBankV22.IndependentFactorization ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle

/-- **Box-wise composition of a branch class bound** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem oneLarge_sum_split {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D1 : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (P : BranchClassBound Us Ur D1) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ) (S : ℕ) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ∀ g : ι → Finset ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ i, SourceFactorization (g i) (Us S M) (Ur S M)) →
      |D1 M (fun A => ∑ i, c i * g i A)| ≤ (∑ i, |c i|) * ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := P.class_bound S ε hε
  refine ⟨M₀, fun M hM g hg => ?_⟩
  rw [P.linear]
  calc |∑ i, c i * D1 M (g i)| ≤ ∑ i, |c i * D1 M (g i)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, |c i| * |D1 M (g i)| := by simp [abs_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |c i| * ε := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM₀ M hM (g i) (hg i)) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ i, |c i|) * ε := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

end OneLargeComposition
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §4: the physical clean state (audit)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## Audit finding (source-literal)

The V27 object `ResearchBankV27.CleanNonzero.CleanState x` is an ABSTRACT structure: it bundles a
`DecoratedData` (whose Kloosterman form `KloostermanData` carries only the real numbers
`Q, R, S, N, d, x, ε_DI, Ξ, mass, Rep, N_q, T, Δ₂, Δ₃`, an arbitrary finite kernel `Kl` and an
off-diagonal set) together with colour data.  **No V25–V28 declaration produces a clean state from
a physical source**: there is no definition of `q = D q₀`, `r₁, r₂`, `n₁, n₂`, `u₁, u₂`, `v₁, v₂`,
canonical roots, or rough supports as fields of any clean state.  The DI arithmetic conditions of
the task (§4) are therefore not even *expressible* on `KloostermanData`.

This file makes the missing arithmetic layer explicit (`DIArithmeticData`,
`DIArithmeticConditions`) so that the earliest hole can be stated precisely, and proves:

* `DIArithmeticConditions_satisfiable` — the conditions are consistent (a concrete witness);
* `DIArithmeticConditions_nontrivial` — they are not automatic (a concrete failure);
* `arithOnlyClass_provider_false` — (FINITE REGRESSION) the class of Kloosterman forms that merely
  *carry* arithmetic data satisfying every §4 gcd/congruence/separation condition, with matching
  `N, d, x`, still makes the DI provider FALSE.  Hence the arithmetic conditions alone cannot serve
  as `DIClass`: kernel realization (§5) is load-bearing, and DIClass must not be weakened to them.

**STOP (task §4).** The earliest remaining composition hole is the field
`DIClass s.DD.KD` of `CleanAdmissible` for every clean state `s` used in the nonzero branch: it
has no source derivation because (i) `DIClass` is an uninterpreted predicate parameter of the V28
bundle and (ii) no physical clean state exists in the bank.  See `DIClassRealization`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace PhysicalCleanState

open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral

/-- The arithmetic data of one clean DI state as listed in task §4 (NOT present in V25–V28). -/
structure DIArithmeticData where
  q0 : ℕ
  D : ℕ
  d : ℕ
  r1 : ℕ
  r2 : ℕ
  n1 : ℕ
  n2 : ℕ
  N : ℝ
  x : ℝ
  C : ℝ

/-- The modulus `q = D q₀`. -/
def DIArithmeticData.q (a : DIArithmeticData) : ℕ := a.D * a.q0

/-- The literal §4 gcd / congruence / separation conditions. -/
def DIArithmeticConditions (a : DIArithmeticData) : Prop :=
  Nat.Coprime a.r1 a.r2 ∧
  Nat.Coprime (a.q * a.d) a.r2 ∧
  Nat.Coprime a.n1 a.n2 ∧
  Nat.Coprime a.n1 (a.q * a.d * a.r1) ∧
  Nat.Coprime a.n2 (a.q * a.d * a.r2) ∧
  a.n1 ≡ a.n2 [MOD a.q * a.d] ∧
  a.N / Real.log a.x ^ a.C ≤ |(a.n1 : ℝ) - a.n2| ∧
  Nat.Coprime a.D (a.q0 * a.d * a.r1 * a.r2)

/-- A concrete witness: `q₀ = 1, D = 1, d = 1, r₁ = 2, r₂ = 3, n₁ = 5, n₂ = 7, N = 0`. -/
def witness : DIArithmeticData :=
  { q0 := 1, D := 1, d := 1, r1 := 2, r2 := 3, n1 := 5, n2 := 7, N := 0, x := 2, C := 1 }

/-- **The §4 conditions are consistent** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem DIArithmeticConditions_satisfiable : DIArithmeticConditions witness := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, ?_, ?_, by decide⟩
  · simp [witness, DIArithmeticData.q, Nat.ModEq, Nat.mod_one]
  · simp [witness]

/-- **The §4 conditions are not automatic** (LEAN BANK): `r₁ = r₂ = 2` fails `gcd(r₁,r₂)=1`. -/
theorem DIArithmeticConditions_nontrivial :
    ¬ DIArithmeticConditions { witness with r1 := 2, r2 := 2 } := by
  rintro ⟨h, -⟩
  exact absurd h (by decide)

/-- Arithmetic data attached to the degenerate form (`N = 0`, `d = 0`, `x = 2`). -/
def degenerateArith : DIArithmeticData :=
  { q0 := 1, D := 1, d := 0, r1 := 1, r2 := 1, n1 := 1, n2 := 1, N := 0, x := 2, C := 1 }

theorem degenerateArith_conditions : DIArithmeticConditions degenerateArith := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, Nat.ModEq.refl _, ?_, by decide⟩
  simp [degenerateArith]

/-- The class of forms that merely carry §4-admissible arithmetic data with matching `N, d, x`
(no kernel realization).  Recorded ONLY to show it is too weak to be `DIClass`. -/
def ArithOnlyClass (K : KloostermanData) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : DIArithmeticData, DIArithmeticConditions a ∧ K.N = a.N ∧ K.d = a.d ∧ K.x = a.x

/-- **Arithmetic conditions alone do not give a valid DI class** (FINITE REGRESSION). -/
theorem arithOnlyClass_provider_false (η : ℝ) : ¬ DISpectralProvider η ArithOnlyClass := by
  intro h
  refine degenerateForm_not_DI η (h.spectral _ ?_ (degenerateForm_admissible η))
  exact ⟨degenerateArith, degenerateArith_conditions, by simp [degenerateForm, degenerateArith],
    by simp [degenerateForm, degenerateArith], by simp [degenerateForm, degenerateArith]⟩

end PhysicalCleanState
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §12: provider elimination

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## The split of the V28 bundle

`FinalAnalyticProviders` (V28) has 14 fields.  V29 splits them into three disjoint groups:

1. `MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders` — ONLY analytic inputs: `rosser`, `tuple`, `euler`, `hat`,
   `di`, `zeroFreq`, `oneLarge`, `twoLarge`, `boundary`, `s1`.  It contains no DIClass membership,
   no kernel realization, no pruning identity, no branch classification, no normalization or weight
   equality (those are definitional, `SourceNormalization`), no parameter arithmetic, no graph /
   compiler fact and no finite certificate.
2. `FunctionalKernelCertificate` — FINITE CERTIFIED INPUT (`FunctionalCertificate`).
3. `InternalGlueOwner` — the INTERNAL composition content that V29 could NOT eliminate, because
   the bank has no physical source object from which to derive it:
   * `tensor` — the same-weight actual-measure majorization `Pair/N ≤ M_new(Λ) + |DE_src(Λ)| +
     [DE_nz(Λ)]_+ + C_t √|E_AB| + 90 + err` for the given branch functionals;
   * `nonzero` — the clean realization of `DE_nz` (clean states in `DIClass`, per-state
     representation moments, divisor-sum bound, `NonzeroPruningContract`).
   Both are statements about how the PHYSICAL pair source decomposes into the branch functionals
   `D0, D1, D2, Db, DEnz`, which are uninterpreted parameters in V2–V28.

`old_FinalAnalyticProviders_of_minimal` rebuilds the old bundle FROM
(minimal external) + (certificate) + (internal glue owner) — the requested direction.

## Why the glue owner cannot simply be dropped (SUCCESS C / D evidence)

`old_FinalAnalyticProviders_of_degenerate` shows that the old bundle can ALSO be built with
`D0 = D1 = D2 = Db = DEnz = 0`, `DIClass = ∅`, `C_nz = 0` from a `DegenerateTensorProvider`
alone (plus rosser/tuple/euler/hat/s1/certificate): then `zeroFreq`, `oneLarge`, `twoLarge`,
`boundary`, `di` and `nonzero` are all discharged VACUOUSLY (`branchClassBound_zero`,
`di_provider_empty_class`, `nonzero_realization_zero`).  The price is that the degenerate tensor
provider asserts `Pair/N ≤ M_new(Λ) + C_t √|E_AB| + 90 + err` with NO distribution remainder —
strictly stronger than any tensor-approximation theorem, i.e. it is the pair baseline itself.
Hence: the V28 branch fields constrain nothing until the branch functionals are DEFINED from the
physical source; the same-source chain is not established in the bank (SUCCESS D), and using the
degenerate route would be a provider mismatch (SUCCESS C).  V29/V30 do NOT use it for the final
theorem.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace ProviderElimination

open ResearchBankV22.RosserCostProvider ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler
open ResearchBankV23.HatApproximationProvider ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)
open ResearchBankV17.ThinFunctional ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV27.DISpectral ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle
open ResearchBankV28.ExactParameterInstantiation ResearchBankV13.FiniteRepresentationModel
open FunctionalCertificate

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **The minimal external analytic providers** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER interfaces only). -/
structure MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC)
    (K : ℕ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ)
    (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData) (LF I : ℝ)
    (N Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ) (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (Kh : ℕ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) (D0 D1 D2 Db : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (muF : ℝ)
    (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) where
  rosser : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X
  tuple : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ
  euler : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I (S0 τC W) N Li phiW model
  hat : HatReferenceApproximationProvider Kh EAB
  di : DISpectralProvider (1 / 1100) DIClass
  zeroFreq : BranchClassBound Us Ur D0
  oneLarge : BranchClassBound Us Ur D1
  twoLarge : BranchClassBound Us Ur D2
  boundary : BranchClassBound Us Ur Db
  s1 : S1Contract (S1 τC W) N muF

/-- **The internal glue owner** (INTERNAL COMPOSITION OBLIGATION, NOT eliminated in V29). -/
structure InternalGlueOwner (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (E : Finset ℕ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ) (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (N Li : ℕ → ℝ) (phiW : ℝ) (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ)
    (D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (Ct Cnz err : ℝ)
    (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) : Prop where
  tensor : BranchedActualMeasureProvider τC W N model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ)
    (sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db) DEnz EAB Ct err
  nonzero : ∀ (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ),
    NonzeroCleanRealization DIClass M (DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)) Cnz

/-- **The old bundle FROM the minimal bundle + certificate + internal glue owner**. -/
def old_FinalAnalyticProviders_of_minimal {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ}
    {muF : ℝ} {DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop}
    (Mn : MinimalExternalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model
      Kh EAB Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db muF DIClass)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (Gl : InternalGlueOwner τC W h E Psm Prd lev X wτ N Li phiW model EAB D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz
      err DIClass) :
    FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB Us Ur
      D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz err muLo WHi muF DIClass where
  rosser := Mn.rosser
  tuple := Mn.tuple
  euler := Mn.euler
  hat := Mn.hat
  di := Mn.di
  zeroFreq := Mn.zeroFreq
  oneLarge := Mn.oneLarge
  twoLarge := Mn.twoLarge
  boundary := Mn.boundary
  nonzero := Gl.nonzero
  tensor := Gl.tensor
  s1 := Mn.s1
  cert := (certificate_iff_thin muF (LF / I)).1 C

/-- The remainder-free tensor provider of the degenerate route (recorded ONLY as a mismatch
witness: it is the pair baseline itself, not an external theorem). -/
structure DegenerateTensorProvider (τC : FixedTupleC V) (W : WeightSystem τC) (N : ℕ → ℝ)
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} (model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h) (pref : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℝ → ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℝ) (EAB : ℕ → ℝ) (Ct err : ℝ) : Prop where
  Ct_nonneg : 0 ≤ Ct
  decomp : ∀ S τ M, Pair τC W M / N M ≤
    (model S M).Mnew (pref M) (Λ S τ M) + Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err

/-- **Degenerate reconstruction of the old bundle** (LEAN BANK): every V28 field except
rosser/tuple/euler/hat/s1/cert/tensor is discharged vacuously with zero branch functionals. -/
def old_FinalAnalyticProviders_of_degenerate {τC : FixedTupleC V} {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ}
    {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ} {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ}
    {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ}
    {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ} {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ}
    {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ} {Ct err : ℝ} {muF : ℝ}
    (hR : RosserScalarProvider K h F Psm Prd lev X) (hT : PrimeHarmonicTupleProvider h Prd X wτ)
    (P : PrincipalEulerProvider h r Sd LF I (S0 τC W) N Li phiW model)
    (hH : HatReferenceApproximationProvider Kh EAB) (h1 : S1Contract (S1 τC W) N muF)
    (C : FunctionalKernelCertificate muF (LF / I))
    (T : DegenerateTensorProvider τC W N model (pref Li phiW N) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ) EAB
      Ct err) :
    FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB Us Ur
      (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) Ct 0 err
      muLo WHi muF (fun _ => False) where
  rosser := hR
  tuple := hT
  euler := P
  hat := hH
  di := DIClassRealization.di_provider_empty_class _
  zeroFreq := ZeroBranchComposition.branchClassBound_zero Us Ur
  oneLarge := ZeroBranchComposition.branchClassBound_zero Us Ur
  twoLarge := ZeroBranchComposition.branchClassBound_zero Us Ur
  boundary := ZeroBranchComposition.branchClassBound_zero Us Ur
  nonzero := fun _ _ M =>
    NonzeroPruning.nonzero_realization_zero _ (Nat.cast_nonneg M) le_rfl
  tensor := ⟨T.Ct_nonneg, fun S τ M => by
    have := T.decomp S τ M
    simp only [sumDE, add_zero, abs_zero, max_self]
    linarith⟩
  s1 := h1
  cert := (certificate_iff_thin muF (LF / I)).1 C

end ProviderElimination
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV29.TwoLargeComposition

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V29 §8–§9: one normalization, one auxiliary weight

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## §8 `RouteCNormalization`

`RouteCNormalization` wraps ONE function `N : ℕ → ℝ`.  `all_components_same_normalization` proves,
from the V28 bundle instantiated at `R.N`, that the SAME `R.N` (no shadow copy) is the
normalization of:
* `S0` — `S0Contract (S0 τC W) R.N` (the principal provider's `normalization_agreement` field);
* `S1` — `S1Contract (S1 τC W) R.N μ_F`;
* the principal term — `pref Li phiW R.N M = Li M / (phiW · R.N M)`;
* the pair norm / actual-measure transfer — the tensor decomposition bounds `Pair/R.N`;
* the score consumer — `RouteCBaselineProvider τC W R.N (LF/I) err`, the exact object consumed by
  `ResearchBankV20.ConditionalAsymptotic287.conditional_asymptotic_287_of_baseline`.

## §9 `LambdaNewPlus`

`principal_weight_eq_error_weight`: the weight in the principal term, in the source-branch
remainder `DE_src`, in the nonzero remainder `DE_nz`, and in the V24 source decomposition is the
ONE family `LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M`, which is DEFINITIONALLY the V22
`LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)` (no factorable proxy).  The proof is
the tensor decomposition re-stated with `LambdaNewPlus` substituted in every slot — it type-checks
only because all slots carry the same weight.

Both results are LEAN BANK / LEAN CONDITIONAL on the bundle only through projections.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV29
namespace SourceNormalization

open ResearchBankV22.CompletedPositiveWeight
open ResearchBankV23.PrincipalEuler
open ResearchBankV16.RouteCConsumer ResearchBankV16.ConditionalRouteCImplication
open ResearchBankV14.ConditionalAsymptoticImplication (S0Contract S1Contract)
open ResearchBankV24.RepairedRouteCBaseline
open ResearchBankV28.RepairedAnalyticBundle ResearchBankV28.FinalPairComposition

/-- **The one canonical Route-C normalization** `N_x`. -/
structure RouteCNormalization where
  N : ℕ → ℝ

variable {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- **All components use the same normalization** (LEAN CONDITIONAL, projections of the bundle). -/
theorem all_components_same_normalization (R : RouteCNormalization) {τC : FixedTupleC V}
    {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ} {muLo WHi : ℚ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I R.N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz err muLo WHi muF DIClass)
    (G : SieveGeometry E Psm Prd h model Us Ur) (cd : RoundedCellData Prd wτ X)
    (hLi : ∀ M, 0 ≤ Li M) (hphi : 0 < phiW) (hWF : 0 ≤ LF / I) :
    S0Contract (S0 τC W) R.N ∧
    S1Contract (S1 τC W) R.N muF ∧
    (∀ M, pref Li phiW R.N M = Li M / (phiW * R.N M)) ∧
    (∀ S τ M, Pair τC W M / R.N M ≤
      (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW R.N M) (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M) +
        |sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)| +
        max (DEnz M (LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M)) 0 + Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err) ∧
    RouteCBaselineProvider τC W R.N (LF / I) err :=
  ⟨B.euler.normalization_agreement, B.s1, fun _ => rfl, B.tensor.decomp,
    routeC_pair_baseline_after_full_repair B G cd hLi hphi hWF⟩

/-- `LamFam` IS `LambdaNewPlus` (LEAN BANK, definitional). -/
theorem lamFam_eq_lambdaNewPlus (E : Finset ℕ) (Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ) (lev X : ℝ → ℝ)
    (wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    LamFam E Psm Prd lev X wτ S τ M =
      LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M) := rfl

/-- **The principal weight is the error weight** (LEAN CONDITIONAL, projection of the bundle):
the tensor decomposition with `LambdaNewPlus` in the principal, `DE_src` and `DE_nz` slots. -/
theorem principal_weight_eq_error_weight {τC : FixedTupleC V}
    {W : WeightSystem τC} {K : ℕ} {h : ℕ → ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} {E : Finset ℕ}
    {Psm Prd : ℕ → ℝ → Finset ℕ} {lev X : ℝ → ℝ} {wτ : ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    {Sd : ResearchBankV23.SingularFactors.SingularData} {LF I : ℝ} {N Li : ℕ → ℝ} {phiW : ℝ}
    {model : ℕ → ℕ → PrincipalModel h} {Kh : ℕ} {EAB : ℕ → ℝ} {Us Ur : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ}
    {D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz : ℕ → (Finset ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ} {Ct Cnz err : ℝ} {muLo WHi : ℚ} {muF : ℝ}
    {DIClass : ResearchBankV27.DISpectral.KloostermanData → Prop}
    (B : FinalAnalyticProviders τC W K h F E Psm Prd lev X wτ r Sd LF I N Li phiW model Kh EAB
      Us Ur D0 D1 D2 Db DEnz Ct Cnz err muLo WHi muF DIClass) (S : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) :
    Pair τC W M / N M ≤
      (model S M).Mnew (pref Li phiW N M)
          (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M)) +
        |sumDE D0 D1 D2 Db M (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M))| +
        max (DEnz M (LambdaNewPlus E (Psm S M) (Prd S M) (lev M) (wτ τ M) (X M))) 0 +
        Ct * Real.sqrt |EAB M| + 90 + err :=
  B.tensor.decomp S τ M

end SourceNormalization
end ResearchBankV29
end Erdos287
