@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10167 sha256=2df8cb4cb7c138ff458445fdee508e40fa66487bea1fe8f74011318cde24be0e path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Atoms.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Tensor

/-!
# Erdős #287 — the legal three-factor atoms of `ℓ_X`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

* `partCount_le` — at most `γ_k` partial tuples of class `k` have a given product (injection
  into the stabiliser of the class/box labelling; repeated-box multiplicity), hence
  `colFactor_nonneg`, `colFactor_le_one`: **every colour factor is one-bounded**.
* `colFactor_support` — `γ_{k,χ}(m) ≠ 0` forces every prime of `m` to be high, `χ`-coloured
  `k`, and `m ≤ E_k = ∏_{c(i)=k} D_{P_i}^{1+τ}` (the factor size range).
* `lowFactor = κ_J * γ_{0,χ}`; `abs_lowFactor_le` — `|κ_J * γ_{0,χ}| ≤ 1` (unique low/high
  split); `lowFactor_support` — `n ≤ D_low E₀`.
* `lowFactor_coprime` — the colour-0 factor (with the low primes) is coprime to the colour-1
  and colour-2 factors (disjoint prime-support colouring), and so are colours 1 and 2.
* `ellX_tensor` — **exact identity for every modulus `d`**:
  `ℓ_X(d) = ∑_{J ≤ T²} ∑_{P ∈ 𝐃_J^+} (-1)^J w_{J,P} ∑_χ ((κ_J * γ_{0,χ}) * γ_{1,χ} * γ_{2,χ})(d)`,
  for **any** colouring rule `(J,P) ↦ c_{J,P}` (in particular the Pascadi colouring).
* `atomWeight_nonneg`, `atomWeight_mul_le` — `0 ≤ w_{J,P}` and `3^K w_{J,P} ≤ 3^J`
  (`∏_k γ_k ≤ γ(P)`, multinomial); `total_variation_le` —
  `∑_{J,P,χ} |(-1)^J w_{J,P}| ≤ ∑_{J ≤ T²} H^J 3^J`.
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

open Erdos287.Physical.Factor

variable {S : ScalarParams}

/-! ### One-boundedness of the colour factors -/

/-- The class/box labelling whose stabiliser has order `γ_k`. -/
def classLabel {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) :
    Fin J → Fin S.H ⊕ Fin J :=
  fun i => if c i.val = k then Sum.inl (P i) else Sum.inr i

lemma card_stab_classLabel {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) :
    (univ.filter (fun π : Equiv.Perm (Fin J) => classLabel P c k ∘ π = classLabel P c k)).card =
      S.gammaCol J P c k := by
  classical
  rw [perm_count_eq_gamma (π₀ := Equiv.refl _) (by rfl), Fintype.prod_sum_type, gammaCol]
  have h2 : ∏ j : Fin J, (univ.filter (fun i => classLabel P c k i = Sum.inr j)).card.factorial
      = 1 := by
    refine prod_eq_one (fun j _ => Nat.factorial_eq_one.2 ?_)
    refine (card_le_card (s := univ.filter (fun i => classLabel P c k i = Sum.inr j))
      (t := {j}) ?_).trans (by simp)
    intro i hi
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, classLabel] at hi
    split_ifs at hi; simp_all
  rw [h2, mul_one]
  refine prod_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 2
  ext i
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, classLabel]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

lemma prime_dvd_prod_tuple {J : ℕ} {q : Fin J → ℕ} (hq : ∀ i, q i = 1 ∨ (q i).Prime)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hd : p ∣ ∏ i, q i) : ∃ i, (q i).Prime ∧ p = q i := by
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime q).1 hd
  rcases hq i with h | h
  · rw [h] at hi; exact absurd (Nat.dvd_one.1 hi) hp.one_lt.ne'
  · exact ⟨i, h, (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp h).1 hi⟩

lemma partTuples_entry (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {k : Fin 3} {q : Fin J → ℕ} (hq : q ∈ S.partTuples J P c χ k)
    (i : Fin J) : q i = 1 ∨ (q i).Prime := by
  have := hS
  by_cases h : c i.val = k
  · right
    have hm := (((mem_partTuples.1 hq).1 i).1 h).1
    classical
    unfold boxPrimes at hm
    exact (mem_filter.1 hm).2.1
  · left; exact ((mem_partTuples.1 hq).1 i).2 h

open Classical in
/-- **At most `γ_k` partial tuples of class `k` have a given product.** -/
theorem partCount_le (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    ((S.partTuples J P c χ k).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = m)).card ≤ S.gammaCol J P c k := by
  set A := (S.partTuples J P c χ k).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = m) with hA
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | ⟨q0, hq0⟩
  · rw [h]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  rw [← card_stab_classLabel P c k]
  obtain ⟨hq0p, hq0m⟩ := mem_filter.1 hq0
  refine card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun π => q0 ∘ π) ?_
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨hqp, hqm⟩ := mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hq)
  have hmq := mem_partTuples.1 hqp
  have hmq0 := mem_partTuples.1 hq0p
  -- every entry of `q` in the class is an entry of `q0` in the class
  have hex : ∀ i : {i : Fin J // c i.val = k}, ∃ j : {j : Fin J // c j.val = k},
      q0 j.1 = q i.1 := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hpi : (q i).Prime := by
      rcases partTuples_entry hS hqp i with h | h
      · exfalso
        have hb := ((hmq.1 i).1 hi).1
        unfold boxPrimes at hb
        have := (mem_filter.1 hb).2.1; rw [h] at this; exact Nat.not_prime_one this
      · exact h
    have hd : q i ∣ ∏ j, q0 j := by
      rw [hq0m, ← hqm]; exact dvd_prod_of_mem q (mem_univ i)
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hji⟩ := prime_dvd_prod_tuple (partTuples_entry hS hq0p) hpi hd
    have hcj : c j.val = k := by
      by_contra hne
      rw [(hmq0.1 j).2 hne] at hj; exact Nat.not_prime_one hj
    exact ⟨⟨j, hcj⟩, hji.symm⟩
  choose σ hσ using hex
  have hσinj : Function.Injective σ := by
    intro i i' h
    have := hσ i; rw [h, hσ i'] at this
    exact Subtype.ext (hmq.2 i.1 i'.1 i.2 i'.2 this.symm)
  set e : Equiv.Perm {i : Fin J // c i.val = k} :=
    Equiv.ofBijective σ (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.1 hσinj)
  refine ⟨Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    by_cases hi : c i.val = k
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem e hi]
      have hc' := (e ⟨i, hi⟩).2
      simp only [classLabel, if_pos hc', if_pos hi]
      congr 1
      -- the boxes agree
      have h1 := ((hmq0.1 (e ⟨i, hi⟩).1).1 hc').1
      have h2 := ((hmq.1 i).1 hi).1
      have heq : q0 (e ⟨i, hi⟩).1 = q i := hσ ⟨i, hi⟩
      unfold boxPrimes at h1 h2
      have b1 := (mem_filter.1 h1).2.2
      have b2 := (mem_filter.1 h2).2.2
      rw [heq] at b1
      exact Fin.ext (inBox_unique hS b1 b2)
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem e hi]
  · funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    by_cases hi : c i.val = k
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem e hi]; exact hσ ⟨i, hi⟩
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem e hi, (hmq0.1 i).2 hi, (hmq.1 i).2 hi]

lemma colFactor_apply {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3)
    (k : Fin 3) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) [DecidableEq ℕ] :
    S.colFactor J P c χ k m = (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      (((S.partTuples J P c χ k).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = m)).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  unfold colFactor
  rw [scaleAF_apply, cntAF_apply _ _ hm]

theorem colFactor_nonneg {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ S.colFactor J P c χ k m := by
  classical
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm; simp
  rw [colFactor_apply P c χ k hm]; positivity

/-- **One-boundedness of every colour factor.** -/
theorem colFactor_le_one (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : S.colFactor J P c χ k m ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm; simp
  rw [colFactor_apply P c χ k hm]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < S.gammaCol J P c k := by exact_mod_cast gammaCol_pos J P c k
  rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hpos, mul_one]
  exact_mod_cast partCount_le hS P c χ k m

theorem abs_colFactor_le (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) : |S.colFactor J P c χ k m| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (colFactor_nonneg P c χ k m)]; exact colFactor_le_one hS P c χ k m

/-! ### Support and size range of the colour factors -/

/-- **Support of a colour factor**: `m ≠ 0`, every prime factor of `m` is high and
`χ`-coloured `k`, and `m ≤ E_k`. -/
theorem colFactor_support (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {k : Fin 3} {m : ℕ} (h : S.colFactor J P c χ k m ≠ 0) :
    m ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ m → S.IsHigh p ∧ S.chiAt χ p = k) ∧
      (m : ℝ) ≤ cprod (S.boxVec J P) c k J := by
  classical
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; simp at h
  rw [colFactor_apply P c χ k hm] at h
  have hne : ((S.partTuples J P c χ k).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = m)).Nonempty := by
    rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; intro he; rw [he] at h; simp at h
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨hqp, hqm⟩ := mem_filter.1 hq
  have hmq := mem_partTuples.1 hqp
  refine ⟨hm, fun p hp hd => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hqm] at hd
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := prime_dvd_prod_tuple (partTuples_entry hS hqp) hp hd
    have hci : c i.val = k := by
      by_contra hne; rw [(hmq.1 i).2 hne] at hi; exact Nat.not_prime_one hi
    obtain ⟨hb, hχ⟩ := (hmq.1 i).1 hci
    unfold boxPrimes at hb
    obtain ⟨-, hpr, hbox⟩ := mem_filter.1 hb
    exact ⟨⟨hpr, P i, (P i).2, hbox⟩, hχ⟩
  · rw [← hqm]
    push_cast
    have e1 : ∏ i, (q i : ℝ) = ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = k), (q i : ℝ) := by
      rw [prod_filter]
      refine prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      split_ifs with hi
      · rfl
      · rw [(hmq.1 i).2 hi]; simp
    rw [e1]
    have e := prod_fin_filter_eq J c k (fun i => S.boxTop (P i))
    have e' : ∀ i ∈ (range J).filter (fun i => c i = k),
        (if h : i < J then S.boxTop (P ⟨i, h⟩) else 1) = S.boxVec J P i := fun i _ => rfl
    rw [prod_congr rfl e'] at e
    unfold cprod
    rw [← e]
    refine prod_le_prod (fun i _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _) (fun i hi => ?_)
    have hci : c i.val = k := (mem_filter.1 hi).2
    have hb := ((hmq.1 i).1 hci).1
    unfold boxPrimes at hb
    exact (mem_filter.1 hb).2.2.2

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=2631 sha256=95acef21e53f45ca250acc2122d71d2ee254df9bd4712b8655d45329e3983bf3 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Colouring.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — the random three-colouring count

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

`card_compat_mul`: if `q : Fin J ↪ Fin K` and `c : Fin J → Fin 3`, the number of colourings
`χ : Fin K → Fin 3` with `χ (q i) = c i` for all `i` is `3^{K-J}`, i.e.
`#{χ compatible} · 3^J = 3^K`.  This is the exact normalisation behind the prime-colouring
decoupling of distinctness across the three Pascadi factors.
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Factor

theorem card_compat_mul {K J : ℕ} (q : Fin J → Fin K) (hq : Function.Injective q)
    (c : Fin J → Fin 3) :
    (univ.filter (fun χ : Fin K → Fin 3 => ∀ i, χ (q i) = c i)).card * 3 ^ J = 3 ^ K := by
  classical
  set F : Fin K → Fin 3 → ℕ := fun x v => if ∀ i, q i = x → c i = v then 1 else 0 with hF
  have step12 : (univ.filter (fun χ : Fin K → Fin 3 => ∀ i, χ (q i) = c i)).card =
      ∑ χ : Fin K → Fin 3, ∏ x, F x (χ x) := by
    rw [card_filter]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [hF, prod_boole]
    simp only [mem_univ, true_implies]
    congr 1
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro h x i hi; rw [← hi, h i]
    · intro h i; exact (h (q i) i rfl).symm
  have step3 : ∑ χ : Fin K → Fin 3, ∏ x, F x (χ x) = ∏ x, ∑ v, F x v := by
    rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum, Fintype.piFinset_univ]
  have step4 : ∀ x, ∑ v, F x v = if x ∈ univ.image q then 1 else 3 := by
    intro x
    rw [hF, sum_boole]
    split_ifs with hx
    · obtain ⟨i0, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx
      have : univ.filter (fun v : Fin 3 => ∀ i, q i = q i0 → c i = v) = {c i0} := by
        ext v
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · intro h; exact (h i0 rfl).symm
        · rintro rfl i hi; rw [hq hi]
      rw [this]; simp
    · have : univ.filter (fun v : Fin 3 => ∀ i, q i = x → c i = v) = univ := by
        ext v
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
        intro i hi
        exact absurd (mem_image.2 ⟨i, mem_univ _, hi⟩) hx
      rw [this]; simp
  have hJK : J ≤ K := by
    simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective q hq
  rw [step12, step3, prod_congr rfl (fun x _ => step4 x), prod_ite, prod_const_one, one_mul,
    prod_const]
  have hcard : (univ.filter (fun x : Fin K => x ∉ univ.image q)).card = K - J := by
    rw [filter_not, filter_mem_eq_inter, univ_inter, card_sdiff_of_subset (subset_univ _),
      card_image_of_injective _ hq]
    simp
  rw [hcard, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hJK]

end Erdos287.Physical.Factor

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=12995 sha256=96f8b92ed44f5d885bd7f75d9c215c639341fcebc20f3adb770fc4f9192b09fb path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Decomposition.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Atoms

/-!
# Erdős #287 — exact source decomposition of `ℓ_X` into legal three-factor atoms

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

An atom is `λ = (J, P, χ)` with `P ∈ 𝐃_J^+` and a prime colouring `χ`; its coefficient is
`(-1)^J w_{J,P}` and its three factors are

* `a₁ = κ_J * γ_{0,χ}` (`lowFactor`: low sieve weight times the colour-0 high primes),
* `a₂ = γ_{1,χ}`, `a₃ = γ_{2,χ}`,

all built from the Pascadi colouring of the sector (or any colouring rule `col`).

* `ellX_tensor` — exact identity `ℓ_X(d) = ∑_λ (-1)^J w_{J,P} (a₁ * a₂ * a₃)(d)` for every `d`;
* `abs_lowFactor_le`, `abs_colFactor_le` — all three factors are one-bounded;
* `lowFactor_support`, `colFactor_support` — size ranges `a₁ : n ≤ D_low E₀`, `a_k : m ≤ E_k`;
* `lowFactor_coprime_high`, `colFactor_coprime` — disjoint prime supports of the three factors;
* `atomWeight_nonneg`, `atomWeight_mul_le`, `total_variation_le` — total atom variation
  `∑_λ |(-1)^J w_{J,P}| ≤ ∑_{J ≤ T²} H^J 3^J`, and `H_eq_of_T`: `H` depends only on `T`
  (so the bound is independent of `X`).
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

open Erdos287.Physical.Factor

variable {S : ScalarParams}

variable (S) in
/-- **The first (low) factor** `a₁ = κ_J * γ_{0,χ}`. -/
noncomputable def lowFactor (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  S.kappaAF J * S.colFactor J P c χ 0

lemma kappaAF_apply {J b : ℕ} (hb : b ≠ 0) : S.kappaAF J b = S.kappa J b := by
  simp [kappaAF, hb]

lemma lowFactor_term_ne {J n : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3} {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3}
    (h : S.lowFactor J P c χ n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 ≠ 0 ∧ S.colFactor J P c χ 0 x.2 ≠ 0 := by
  unfold lowFactor at h
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply] at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
  have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.1 (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors (Nat.fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx))
  rw [kappaAF_apply hx1] at hne
  exact ⟨x, hx, left_ne_zero_of_mul hne, right_ne_zero_of_mul hne⟩

/-- **The low factor is one-bounded** (unique low/high split). -/
theorem abs_lowFactor_le (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (n : ℕ) : |S.lowFactor J P c χ n| ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  unfold lowFactor
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply]
  refine abs_sum_le_one_of_unique _ _ ?_ ?_
  · have key : ∀ z ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        S.kappaAF J z.1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 0 z.2 ≠ 0 →
        z.1 = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0), p := by
      intro z hz hf
      obtain ⟨hzm, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hz
      have hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hn0 (by rw [← hzm, h, zero_mul])
      rw [kappaAF_apply hz1] at hf
      obtain ⟨hsq, hlow⟩ := kappa_support (left_ne_zero_of_mul hf)
      obtain ⟨hz2, hhigh, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS (right_ne_zero_of_mul hf)
      have hpf : z.1.primeFactors = n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0) := by
        rw [← hzm, Nat.primeFactors_mul hz1 hz2]
        ext p
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_union]
        constructor
        · intro hp; exact ⟨Or.inl hp, hlow p hp⟩
        · rintro ⟨hp | hp, hlt⟩
          · exact hp
          · exact absurd hlt (not_low_of_high hS (hhigh p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
              (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).1)
      rw [← hpf, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
    intro x hx y hy hfx hfy
    have h1 := key x hx hfx
    have h2 := key y hy hfy
    obtain ⟨hxm, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    obtain ⟨hym, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hy
    have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hn0 (by rw [← hxm, h, zero_mul])
    have heq1 : x.1 = y.1 := h1.trans h2.symm
    have heq2 : x.2 = y.2 := by
      have : x.1 * x.2 = x.1 * y.2 := by rw [hxm, heq1, hym]
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx1) this
    exact Prod.ext heq1 heq2
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxm, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hn0 (by rw [← hxm, h, zero_mul])
    rw [kappaAF_apply hx1, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_one₀ (abs_kappa_le J x.1) (abs_nonneg _) (abs_colFactor_le hS P c χ 0 x.2)

/-- **Size range of the low factor**: `a₁(n) ≠ 0 ⇒ n ≤ D_low E₀`. -/
theorem lowFactor_support (hS : S.Good) {J n : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} (h : S.lowFactor J P c χ n ≠ 0) :
    (n : ℝ) ≤ S.Dlow * cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 0 J := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hk, hc⟩ := lowFactor_term_ne h
  obtain ⟨hxm, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
  have h1 := kappa_level hS hk
  obtain ⟨-, -, h2⟩ := colFactor_support hS hc
  rw [← hxm]; push_cast
  exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith [Dlow_ge_one hS])

/-- **Disjoint prime support**: colours 1 and 2 are coprime. -/
theorem colFactor_coprime (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {k k' : Fin 3} (hkk : k ≠ k') {a a' : ℕ}
    (ha : S.colFactor J P c χ k a ≠ 0) (ha' : S.colFactor J P c χ k' a' ≠ 0) :
    Nat.Coprime a a' := by
  obtain ⟨-, h1, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS ha
  obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS ha'
  refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd (fun p hp hpa hpa' => hkk ?_)
  rw [← (h1 p hp hpa).2, ← (h2 p hp hpa').2]

/-- **Disjoint prime support**: the low factor is coprime to `a₂ * a₃`. -/
theorem lowFactor_coprime_high (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {l r : ℕ} (hl : S.lowFactor J P c χ l ≠ 0)
    (hr : (S.colFactor J P c χ 1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 2) r ≠ 0) : Nat.Coprime l r := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hk, hc⟩ := lowFactor_term_ne hl
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply] at hr
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hr
  have hy1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have hy2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  obtain ⟨hxm, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
  obtain ⟨hym, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hy
  obtain ⟨hsqb, hlow⟩ := kappa_support hk
  obtain ⟨-, h0, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS hc
  obtain ⟨-, h1, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS hy1
  obtain ⟨-, h2, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS hy2
  have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := hsqb.ne_zero
  refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd (fun p hp hpl hpr => ?_)
  have hpr' : p ∣ y.1 ∨ p ∣ y.2 := by rw [← hym] at hpr; exact (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 hpr
  have hhigh : S.IsHigh p ∧ (S.chiAt χ p = 1 ∨ S.chiAt χ p = 2) := by
    rcases hpr' with h | h
    · exact ⟨(h1 p hp h).1, Or.inl (h1 p hp h).2⟩
    · exact ⟨(h2 p hp h).1, Or.inr (h2 p hp h).2⟩
  rw [← hxm] at hpl
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 hpl with h | h
  · exact not_low_of_high hS hhigh.1 (hlow p (Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, h, hx1⟩))
  · have := (h0 p hp h).2
    rcases hhigh.2 with h' | h' <;> rw [this] at h' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)

/-! ### The exact decomposition of `ℓ_X` -/

lemma mul_scaleAF (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    f * scaleAF r g = scaleAF r (f * g) := by
  ext m
  simp only [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, scaleAF_apply, mul_sum]
  exact sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring)

open Classical in
/-- **Exact decomposition of the actual scalar coefficient into legal three-factor atoms**,
for every modulus `d` and any colouring rule `col` (e.g. the Pascadi colouring). -/
theorem ellX_tensor (hS : S.Good) (col : (J : ℕ) → (Fin J → Fin S.H) → ℕ → Fin 3) (d : ℕ) :
    S.ellX d = ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H,
      if S.BoxAdm J P then
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.atomWeight J P (col J P) * ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
          (S.lowFactor J P (col J P) χ * S.colFactor J P (col J P) χ 1 *
            S.colFactor J P (col J P) χ 2) d
      else 0 := by
  unfold ellX
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => ?_))
  split_ifs with hP
  · have hA : ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 * S.Bcoef J P x.2 =
        (S.kappaAF J * S.bcoefAF J P) d := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply]
      refine sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
      obtain ⟨hxm, hd0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
      have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hd0 (by rw [← hxm, h, zero_mul])
      have hx2 : x.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hd0 (by rw [← hxm, h, mul_zero])
      simp [kappaAF, bcoefAF, hx1, hx2]
    rw [hA, bcoef_tensor hS P (col J P), mul_scaleAF, scaleAF_apply, mul_sum, af_sum_apply]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1; congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    unfold lowFactor
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  · rfl

/-! ### Weights and total variation -/

theorem atomWeight_nonneg {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ S.atomWeight J P c := by
  unfold atomWeight; positivity

lemma prod_gammaCol_le {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    ∏ k : Fin 3, S.gammaCol J P c k ≤ S.gammaP J P := by
  classical
  unfold gammaCol gammaP
  rw [prod_comm]
  refine prod_le_prod' (fun b _ => ?_)
  have hcard : (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => P i = b)).card =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = k ∧ P i = b)).card := by
    rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun i : Fin J => c i.val) (t := univ)
      (fun _ _ => mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [filter_filter]; congr 1; ext i; simp [and_comm]
  rw [hcard, Fin.prod_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  set a := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = 0 ∧ P i = b)).card
  set b' := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = 1 ∧ P i = b)).card
  set e := (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = 2 ∧ P i = b)).card
  refine Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.factorial_pos _) ?_
  calc a.factorial * b'.factorial * e.factorial ∣ (a + b').factorial * e.factorial :=
        Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right (Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add a b') _
    _ ∣ (a + b' + e).factorial := Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add _ _

/-- `3^K w_{J,P} ≤ 3^J`. -/
theorem atomWeight_mul_le {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    S.atomWeight J P c * 3 ^ S.Kc ≤ 3 ^ J := by
  unfold atomWeight
  have hγP : (0 : ℝ) < S.gammaP J P := by exact_mod_cast gammaP_pos P
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < 3 ^ S.Kc := by positivity
  have hle : (∏ k : Fin 3, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)) ≤ S.gammaP J P := by
    exact_mod_cast prod_gammaCol_le P c
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have : (3 : ℝ) ^ J * (∏ k : Fin 3, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)) ≤ 3 ^ J * S.gammaP J P :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by positivity)
  nlinarith

open Classical in
/-- **Total atom variation**: `∑_{J,P,χ} |(-1)^J w_{J,P}| ≤ ∑_{J ≤ T²} H^J 3^J`. -/
theorem total_variation_le (col : (J : ℕ) → (Fin J → Fin S.H) → ℕ → Fin 3) :
    ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H,
      (if S.BoxAdm J P then ∑ _χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3, |(-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.atomWeight J P (col J P)|
        else 0) ≤ ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (S.H : ℝ) ^ J * 3 ^ J := by
  refine sum_le_sum (fun J _ => ?_)
  have hcard : ∑ _P : Fin J → Fin S.H, (3 : ℝ) ^ J = (S.H : ℝ) ^ J * 3 ^ J := by
    rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
    simp
  rw [← hcard]
  refine sum_le_sum (fun P _ => ?_)
  split_ifs
  · rw [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin, abs_mul,
      abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg (atomWeight_nonneg P _),
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    rw [mul_comm]; exact atomWeight_mul_le P _
  · positivity

/-- `D_j ≤ √D_int ↔ ε₀² (1+τ)^j ≤ 1/2`: the box count is determined by `T` alone. -/
lemma boxEnd_le_sqrt_iff (hS : S.Good) (j : ℕ) :
    S.boxEnd j ≤ Real.sqrt S.Dint ↔ S.eps0 ^ 2 * (1 + S.tau) ^ j ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  have hD := Dint_gt_one hS
  unfold boxEnd u0
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hD]

/-- **The number of boxes `H` depends only on `T`** (not on `X`). -/
theorem H_eq_of_T {S' : ScalarParams} (hS : S.Good) (hS' : S'.Good) (hT : S.T = S'.T) :
    S.H = S'.H := by
  have he : S.eps0 = S'.eps0 := by unfold eps0; rw [hT]
  have ht : S.tau = S'.tau := by unfold tau; rw [he]
  have key : ∀ j, j < S.H ↔ j < S'.H := by
    intro j
    rw [lt_H_iff hS, lt_H_iff hS', boxEnd_le_sqrt_iff hS, boxEnd_le_sqrt_iff hS', he, ht]
  exact le_antisymm (not_lt.1 (fun h => lt_irrefl _ ((key _).1 h)))
    (not_lt.1 (fun h => lt_irrefl _ ((key _).2 h)))

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Mult

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Pascadi's Proposition 5.2 for finite vectors and for actual moduli

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

* `VecHyp D P r` — a finite vector `P₀ ≥ ⋯ ≥ P_{r-1} ≥ 1` in Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_r(D)` (Def. 5.1,
  `(5.2)`), only the odd (1-indexed) prefix conditions.
* `VecHyp.prod_le` — such a vector has `∏ P_i ≤ D` (needed for the padding).
* `prop52_vector` — Pascadi Prop. 5.2 for such vectors: the padding by `1` handles `r = 0`
  (`d = 1`) and `r < 6`.
* `InDplus D d` — **Pascadi Definition 5.1** for a positive integer, using the *actual ordered
  prime-factor list with multiplicity* `p₁ ≥ p₂ ≥ ⋯ ≥ p_r` (`descPrimes d`).
* `prop52_nat` — **Pascadi Proposition 5.2**: for every `d ∈ 𝒟⁺(x^{3/5-50δ})` there are
  `d = d₁ d₂ d₃` (products of the coloured primes) obeying (5.3).
-/

open Finset Real

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Factor

/-- Pad a length-`r` vector by `1`. -/
noncomputable def padOne (P : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if i < r then P i else 1

/-- A finite vector in Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_r(D)`. -/
structure VecHyp (D : ℝ) (P : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : Prop where
  one_le : ∀ i < r, 1 ≤ P i
  anti : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j < r → P j ≤ P i
  plus : ∀ j < r, Even j → (∏ i ∈ range j, P i) * P j ^ 3 ≤ D

lemma VecHyp.prod_le {D : ℝ} {P : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} (h : VecHyp D P r) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    ∏ i ∈ range r, P i ≤ D := by
  have hpos : ∀ j ≤ r, 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ range j, P i := fun j hj =>
    prod_nonneg (fun i hi => le_trans zero_le_one (h.one_le i (by simp at hi; omega)))
  rcases r with _ | m
  · simpa using hD
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with hm | hm
  · have h1 := h.plus m (by omega) hm
    have hPm := h.one_le m (by omega)
    rw [prod_range_succ]
    refine le_trans ?_ h1
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_self_pow₀ hPm (by norm_num)) (hpos m (by omega))
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hm
    have h1 := h.plus (2 * k) (by omega) (even_two_mul k)
    have hPk := h.one_le (2 * k) (by omega)
    have hPk1 := h.one_le (2 * k + 1) (by omega)
    have ha := h.anti (2 * k) (2 * k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ, mul_assoc]
    refine le_trans ?_ h1
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hpos (2 * k) (by omega))
    calc P (2 * k) * P (2 * k + 1) ≤ P (2 * k) * P (2 * k) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ P (2 * k) ^ 3 := by nlinarith

lemma prod_padOne_of_le (P : ℕ → ℝ) (r j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ r) :
    ∏ i ∈ range j, padOne P r i = ∏ i ∈ range j, P i :=
  prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => by simp [padOne, show i < r by simp at hi; omega])

lemma prod_padOne_of_ge (P : ℕ → ℝ) (r j : ℕ) (hj : r ≤ j) :
    ∏ i ∈ range j, padOne P r i = ∏ i ∈ range r, P i := by
  rw [← prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ hj, prod_padOne_of_le P r r le_rfl]
  have h1 : ∏ i ∈ Ico r j, padOne P r i = 1 :=
    prod_eq_one (fun i hi => by simp [padOne, show ¬ i < r by simp at hi; omega])
  rw [h1, mul_one]

lemma VecHyp.pad {D : ℝ} {P : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ} (h : VecHyp D P r) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    (∀ i, 1 ≤ padOne P r i) ∧ Antitone (padOne P r) ∧
      ∀ j, Even j → (∏ i ∈ range j, padOne P r i) * padOne P r j ^ 3 ≤ D := by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  · unfold padOne; split_ifs with hi
    · exact h.one_le i hi
    · exact le_rfl
  · unfold padOne
    by_cases hj : j < r
    · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos (by omega)]; exact h.anti i j hij hj
    · rw [if_neg hj]; split_ifs with hi
      · exact h.one_le i hi
      · exact le_rfl
  · by_cases hjr : j < r
    · rw [prod_padOne_of_le P r j hjr.le]
      simpa [padOne, hjr] using h.plus j hjr hj
    · rw [prod_padOne_of_ge P r j (by omega)]
      simpa [padOne, hjr] using h.prod_le hD

lemma cprod_padOne (P : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) :
    cprod (padOne P r) c k r = cprod P c k r :=
  prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => by simp at hi; simp [padOne, hi.1])

/-- **Pascadi, Proposition 5.2** for a finite vector in `𝒟⁺_r(x^{3/5-50δ})`, with every
published parameter condition. -/
theorem prop52_vector {x δ N : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ' : δ < 1 / 100000)
    (hN1 : x ^ (2 * δ) ≤ N) (hN2 : N ≤ x ^ (1 / 3 + δ)) {P : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (h : VecHyp (x ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ)) P r) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → Fin 3, Sys53 x δ N (cprod P c 0 r) (cprod P c 1 r) (cprod P c 2 r) := by
  have hD : 1 ≤ x ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ) := one_le_rpow hx.le (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h.pad hD
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := prop52_real ⟨hx, hδ, hδ', hN1, hN2, h1, h2, h3⟩ r
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  simpa only [cprod_padOne] using hc

/-! ### Actual moduli: the ordered prime-factor list -/

/-- The prime factors of `d` with multiplicity, in **decreasing** order `p₁ ≥ p₂ ≥ ⋯`. -/
def descPrimes (d : ℕ) : List ℕ := d.primeFactorsList.reverse

/-- The `i`-th prime factor (`0`-indexed, `1` beyond the end), as a real number. -/
noncomputable def primeAt (d i : ℕ) : ℝ := ((descPrimes d).getD i 1 : ℕ)

/-- **Pascadi, Definition 5.1**: `d ∈ 𝒟⁺(D)` iff `p₁ ⋯ p_{j-1} p_j³ ≤ D` for every odd `j ≤ r`
(`0`-indexed: even `j`), with the actual decreasing prime list. -/
def InDplus (D : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j < (descPrimes d).length, Even j → (∏ i ∈ range j, primeAt d i) * primeAt d j ^ 3 ≤ D

/-- The colour-`k` factor of `d`: the product of the primes of colour `k`. -/
noncomputable def natFactor (d : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i ∈ (range (descPrimes d).length).filter (fun i => c i = k), (descPrimes d).getD i 1

lemma prod_getD_range (l : List ℕ) : ∏ i ∈ range l.length, l.getD i 1 = l.prod := by
  rw [prod_range (fun i => l.getD i 1), ← Fin.prod_univ_getElem]
  exact prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => List.getD_eq_getElem l 1 i.2)

lemma natFactor_mul (d : ℕ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    natFactor d c 0 * natFactor d c 1 * natFactor d c 2 = d := by
  unfold natFactor
  have := Finset.prod_fiberwise (range (descPrimes d).length) c (fun i => (descPrimes d).getD i 1)
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_three] at this
  rw [this, prod_getD_range, descPrimes, List.prod_reverse, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hd]

lemma descPrimes_vecHyp (D : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hD : InDplus D d) :
    VecHyp D (primeAt d) (descPrimes d).length := by
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i j hij hj => ?_, hD⟩
  · unfold primeAt
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
    have hp : Nat.Prime (descPrimes d)[i] :=
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_reverse.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
    exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt.le
  · unfold primeAt
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by omega)]
    have hs : (descPrimes d).SortedGE := List.sortedGE_reverse.2 (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted d)
    have := hs (show (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin (descPrimes d).length) ≤ ⟨j, hj⟩ from hij)
    exact_mod_cast this

/-- **Pascadi, Proposition 5.2** for actual moduli: every `d ∈ 𝒟⁺(x^{3/5-50δ})` factors as
`d = d₁ d₂ d₃` (a colouring of its ordered prime factors) with
`d₁ ≤ N x^{-δ}`, `N² d₂ d₃² ≤ x^{1-δ}`, `N² d₂⁵ d₃² ≤ x^{2-δ}`. -/
theorem prop52_nat {x δ N : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ' : δ < 1 / 100000)
    (hN1 : x ^ (2 * δ) ≤ N) (hN2 : N ≤ x ^ (1 / 3 + δ)) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hD : InDplus (x ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ)) d) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → Fin 3, natFactor d c 0 * natFactor d c 1 * natFactor d c 2 = d ∧
      Sys53 x δ N (natFactor d c 0) (natFactor d c 1) (natFactor d c 2) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := prop52_vector hx hδ hδ' hN1 hN2 (descPrimes_vecHyp _ d hD)
  refine ⟨c, natFactor_mul d hd c, ?_⟩
  have e : ∀ k, (natFactor d c k : ℝ) = cprod (primeAt d) c k (descPrimes d).length := by
    intro k; unfold natFactor cprod primeAt; push_cast; rfl
  simpa only [e] using hc

end Erdos287.Physical.Factor

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4212 sha256=8d955befc5d093470a28d2e9c9b6854163054ba2e303aadd41f6884bcdd3ad17 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Mult.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Prop52

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Pascadi's Proposition 5.2, multiplicative form

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

`prop52_real`: for a decreasing sequence of reals `P₀ ≥ P₁ ≥ ⋯ ≥ 1` (primes, or box upper
endpoints, padded by `1`) in Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_r(D)` with `D = x^{3/5-50δ}`, and every published
parameter condition `0 < δ < 10⁻⁵`, `x^{2δ} ≤ N ≤ x^{1/3+δ}`, the greedy colouring gives

`d₁ ≤ N x^{-δ}`, `N² d₂ d₃² ≤ x^{1-δ}`, `N² d₂⁵ d₃² ≤ x^{2-δ}` (Pascadi (5.3)),

where `d_k` is the product of the `P_i` of colour `k`.  It is obtained from `prop52_additive`
by passing to `t_i = log_x P_i`.
-/

open Finset Real

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Factor

/-- The colour-`k` factor `d_k = ∏_{i < R, c i = k} P_i`. -/
noncomputable def cprod (P : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (R : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i ∈ (range R).filter (fun i => c i = k), P i

/-- Pascadi's hypotheses of Prop. 5.2, multiplicatively (`𝒟⁺_r(D)` for a real vector). -/
structure MultHyp (x δ N : ℝ) (P : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  x_gt : 1 < x
  δ_pos : 0 < δ
  δ_small : δ < 1 / 100000
  N_lo : x ^ (2 * δ) ≤ N
  N_hi : N ≤ x ^ (1 / 3 + δ)
  one_le : ∀ i, 1 ≤ P i
  anti : Antitone P
  plus : ∀ j, Even j → (∏ i ∈ range j, P i) * P j ^ 3 ≤ x ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ)

/-- Pascadi's system (5.3). -/
def Sys53 (x δ N d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  d₁ ≤ N * x ^ (-δ) ∧ N ^ 2 * d₂ * d₃ ^ 2 ≤ x ^ (1 - δ) ∧ N ^ 2 * d₂ ^ 5 * d₃ ^ 2 ≤ x ^ (2 - δ)

/-- **Pascadi, Proposition 5.2** (real-vector form, constructive greedy proof). -/
theorem prop52_real {x δ N : ℝ} {P : ℕ → ℝ} (h : MultHyp x δ N P) (R : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → Fin 3, Sys53 x δ N (cprod P c 0 R) (cprod P c 1 R) (cprod P c 2 R) := by
  have hx := h.x_gt
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := ne_of_gt hx
  have hP0 : ∀ i, 0 < P i := fun i => lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (h.one_le i)
  have hN0 : 0 < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _) h.N_lo
  set t : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => logb x (P i) with ht
  set n : ℝ := logb x N with hn
  have hlogb : ∀ a, logb x (x ^ a) = a := fun a => logb_rpow hx0 hx1
  have hA : AddHyp δ n t := by
    refine ⟨h.δ_pos, h.δ_small, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hlogb (2 * δ)]
      exact (logb_le_logb hx (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _) hN0).2 h.N_lo
    · rw [← hlogb (1 / 3 + δ)]
      exact (logb_le_logb hx hN0 (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _)).2 h.N_hi
    · intro i; exact logb_nonneg hx (h.one_le i)
    · intro i j hij; exact (logb_le_logb hx (hP0 j) (hP0 i)).2 (h.anti hij)
    · intro j hj
      have hpj := h.plus j hj
      have hprod : 0 < ∏ i ∈ range j, P i := prod_pos (fun i _ => hP0 i)
      have hL := (logb_le_logb hx (mul_pos hprod (pow_pos (hP0 j) 3))
        (rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _)).2 hpj
      rw [hlogb, logb_mul hprod.ne' (pow_pos (hP0 j) 3).ne', logb_pow,
        logb_prod _ _ (fun i _ => (hP0 i).ne')] at hL
      push_cast at hL
      exact hL
  obtain ⟨c, h1, h2, h3⟩ := prop52_additive hA R
  have hcp : ∀ k, cprod P c k R = x ^ csumS t c k (range R) := by
    intro k
    unfold cprod csumS
    rw [rpow_sum_of_pos hx0]
    exact prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => (rpow_logb hx0 hx1 (hP0 i)).symm)
  have hN : N = x ^ n := (rpow_logb hx0 hx1 hN0).symm
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcp, hN, ← rpow_add hx0]
    exact (rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx).2 (by linarith)
  · rw [hcp, hcp, hN]
    set a2 := csumS t c 1 (range R)
    set a3 := csumS t c 2 (range R)
    have e : (x ^ n) ^ 2 * x ^ a2 * (x ^ a3) ^ 2 = x ^ (n + n + a2 + a3 + a3) := by
      rw [rpow_add hx0, rpow_add hx0, rpow_add hx0, rpow_add hx0]; ring
    rw [e]
    exact (rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx).2 (by linarith)
  · rw [hcp, hcp, hN]
    set a2 := csumS t c 1 (range R)
    set a3 := csumS t c 2 (range R)
    have e : (x ^ n) ^ 2 * (x ^ a2) ^ 5 * (x ^ a3) ^ 2 =
        x ^ (n + n + a2 + a2 + a2 + a2 + a2 + a3 + a3) := by
      simp only [rpow_add hx0]; ring
    rw [e]
    exact (rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx).2 (by linarith)

end Erdos287.Physical.Factor

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Additive

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Pascadi's Proposition 5.2 (additive form): the full greedy proof

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

`prop52_additive` formalizes the proof of Pascadi, arXiv:2505.00653v2, Proposition 5.2:

* the first six positions are placed by Lemma 5.3 (`lemma53`);
* positions `j ≥ 7` (`0`-indexed `≥ 6`) are placed greedily; the greedy choice is made
  deterministic: they go into `d₂` (Pascadi's Case 2 shows `d₂` always has room, because
  `p_j ≤ D^{1/9} < x^{1/15}` — `AddHyp.tail_small`);
* the process is monitored with the lower thresholds `d₂ > x^{1/5-5δ}`, `d₃ > x^{1/3+2δ}/N`;
  the first time one of them is exceeded (`Nat.find`) the remaining positions are placed by the
  two-slot greedy of Case 3.1 (into `d₁, d₃`, with `D₃ = x^{3/5-3δ}/(N d₂)`) or Case 3.2 (into
  `d₁, d₂`, with `D₂ = x^{3/5-3δ}/(N d₃)`); if never exceeded we are in Case 1.
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Factor

lemma csumS_range_succ (t : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    csumS t c k (range (m + 1)) = csumS t c k (range m) + if c m = k then t m else 0 := by
  have := csumS_update_insert t c (c m) k (range m) m (by simp)
  rwa [Function.update_eq_self, ← range_add_one] at this

/-- **Pascadi, Proposition 5.2 (additive form).**  Under `0 < δ < 10⁻⁵`, `x^{2δ} ≤ N ≤
x^{1/3+δ}` and `d ∈ 𝒟⁺(x^{3/5-50δ})` (with the primes in decreasing order, padded by `1`'s),
the greedy placement produces a colouring of every initial segment of positions satisfying
Pascadi's system (5.3). -/
theorem prop52_additive {δ n : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (h : AddHyp δ n t) (R : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → Fin 3, Good53 δ n (csumS t c 0 (range R)) (csumS t c 1 (range R))
      (csumS t c 2 (range R)) := by
  classical
  have hδ := h.δ_pos; have hδ' := h.δ_small; have hn1 := h.n_lo; have hn2 := h.n_hi
  have ht := h.nonneg
  obtain ⟨c6, h60, h61, h62⟩ := lemma53 h
  set c0 : ℕ → Fin 3 := fun i => if i < 6 then c6 i else 1 with hc0
  have agree6 : ∀ k, csumS t c0 k (range 6) = csumS t c6 k (range 6) := by
    intro k; unfold csumS
    rw [Finset.filter_congr (p := fun i => c0 i = k) (q := fun i => c6 i = k)
      (fun i hi => by simp [hc0, mem_range.1 hi])]
  have frozen : ∀ k : Fin 3, k ≠ 1 → ∀ j, csumS t c0 k (range j) ≤ csumS t c0 k (range 6) := by
    intro k hk j
    unfold csumS
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg _ (fun i _ _ => ht i)
    intro i
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_range]
    rintro ⟨-, hci⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hci⟩
    by_contra hge
    simp only [hc0, if_neg hge] at hci
    exact hk hci.symm
  have b1 : ∀ j, csumS t c0 0 (range j) ≤ n - δ := fun j =>
    (frozen 0 (by decide) j).trans (by rw [agree6]; exact h60)
  have b3 : ∀ j, csumS t c0 2 (range j) ≤ 2 / 5 + 2 * δ - n := fun j =>
    (frozen 2 (by decide) j).trans (by rw [agree6]; exact h62)
  have b2 : ∀ j ≤ 6, csumS t c0 1 (range j) ≤ 4 / 15 - 5 * δ := fun j hj =>
    (csumS_mono t ht c0 1 (Finset.range_mono hj)).trans (by rw [agree6]; exact h61)
  have nn := csumS_nonneg t ht
  by_cases hex : ∃ j, j ≤ R ∧ (1 / 5 - 5 * δ < csumS t c0 1 (range j) ∨
      1 / 3 + 2 * δ - n < csumS t c0 2 (range j))
  swap
  · -- Case 1: the process terminates successfully.
    push_neg at hex
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hex R le_rfl
    refine ⟨c0, b1 R, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  -- Case 3: the first time a lower threshold is exceeded.
  obtain ⟨hjR, hj⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hmin : ∀ i < Nat.find hex, ¬ (i ≤ R ∧ (1 / 5 - 5 * δ < csumS t c0 1 (range i) ∨
      1 / 3 + 2 * δ - n < csumS t c0 2 (range i))) := fun i hi => Nat.find_min hex hi
  have j0 : Nat.find hex ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0] at hj; simp [csumS] at hj; rcases hj with hj | hj <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, Nat.find hex = m + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero j0
  have hprev := hmin m (by omega)
  rw [hm] at hj hjR
  have hp : csumS t c0 1 (range m) ≤ 1 / 5 - 5 * δ ∧
      csumS t c0 2 (range m) ≤ 1 / 3 + 2 * δ - n := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hprev ⟨by omega, by
      rcases not_and_or.1 hc with hc | hc
      · exact Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge hc)
      · exact Or.inr (lt_of_not_ge hc)⟩
  obtain ⟨hp2, hp3⟩ := hp
  have tot := csumS_total t c0 (range (m + 1))
  have h02 : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
  have h01 : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 := by decide
  obtain hcm | hcm | hcm : c0 m = 0 ∨ c0 m = 1 ∨ c0 m = 2 := by
    generalize c0 m = a; fin_cases a <;> simp
  · -- placing into `d₁` cannot trigger a threshold
    rw [csumS_range_succ, csumS_range_succ, hcm] at hj
    simp at hj
    rcases hj with hj | hj <;> linarith
  · -- Case 3.1: `d₂ > x^{1/5-5δ}`, `d₃ ≤ x^{1/3+2δ}/N`.
    have e2 : csumS t c0 1 (range (m + 1)) = csumS t c0 1 (range m) + t m := by
      rw [csumS_range_succ, hcm]; simp
    have e3 : csumS t c0 2 (range (m + 1)) = csumS t c0 2 (range m) := by
      rw [csumS_range_succ, hcm]; simp
    have hlow : 1 / 5 - 5 * δ < csumS t c0 1 (range (m + 1)) := by
      rcases hj with hj | hj
      · exact hj
      · rw [e3] at hj; linarith
    have hup : csumS t c0 1 (range (m + 1)) ≤ 4 / 15 - 5 * δ := by
      by_cases hm6 : m < 6
      · exact b2 _ (by omega)
      · have := h.tail_small m (by omega); rw [e2]; linarith
    set a2 := csumS t c0 1 (range (m + 1)) with ha2
    obtain ⟨c', g1, g3, g4⟩ := twoSlot t c0 (m + 1) R hjR 0 2 h02 (n - δ)
      (3 / 5 - 3 * δ - n - a2) (b1 _) (by rw [e3]; linarith)
      (fun k _ _ => by linarith [h.sq k])
    have g2 := g4 1 (by decide) (by decide)
    refine ⟨c', g1, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [g2] <;> nlinarith
  · -- Case 3.2: `d₂ ≤ x^{1/5-5δ}`, `d₃ > x^{1/3+2δ}/N`.
    have e2 : csumS t c0 1 (range (m + 1)) = csumS t c0 1 (range m) := by
      rw [csumS_range_succ, hcm]; simp
    have hlow : 1 / 3 + 2 * δ - n < csumS t c0 2 (range (m + 1)) := by
      rcases hj with hj | hj
      · rw [e2] at hj; linarith
      · exact hj
    have hup := b3 (m + 1)
    set a3 := csumS t c0 2 (range (m + 1)) with ha3
    obtain ⟨c', g1, g2, g4⟩ := twoSlot t c0 (m + 1) R hjR 0 1 h01 (n - δ)
      (3 / 5 - 3 * δ - n - a3) (b1 _) (by rw [e2]; linarith)
      (fun k _ _ => by linarith [h.sq k])
    have g3 := g4 2 (by decide) (by decide)
    refine ⟨c', g1, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [g3] <;> nlinarith

end Erdos287.Physical.Factor

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=13478 sha256=d446b6fc081691cd39b5f55bc5b96229c2616c5f883d345f683d3d9e7dac5ed1 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Support.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Bound
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Modulus

/-!
# Erdős #287 — structured support of the actual scalar atoms and their Pascadi allocation

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

An *atom* of `ℓ_X` is a sector `(J, P)` with `P ∈ 𝐃_J^+` (`BoxAdm J P`), a low factor `b` with
`κ_J(b) ≠ 0` and a labelled tuple `q ∈ tuples J P` of distinct primes `q_i ∈ I_{P_i}`; its
modulus is `d = b ∏ q_i`.  We do **not** infer anything from `ellX_level : d ≤ D_tot`.

* `kappa_sector` — the low factor is in Pascadi's `𝒟⁺(D_low)` for even `J` and in `𝒟⁻(D_low)`
  for odd `J` (signed parity routing), squarefree, all primes `< u`, `b ≤ D_low`.
* `boxVec_vecHyp` — the vector of actual box **upper endpoints** `U_i = D_{P_i}^{1+τ}` lies in
  Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_J(D_int^{1+τ})` (Def. 5.1, `(5.2)`); this is derived from Lichtman's
  `𝐃_J^+` condition with the parity-dependent threshold.
* `boxVec_vecHyp_pascadi` — hence in `𝒟⁺_J(X^{3/5-50δ})` for every `δ ≤ 1/5000` (because
  `D_int^{1+τ} ≤ D_tot = X^{59/100}`).
* `atomColour` — the colouring of the `J` box positions given by Pascadi's Proposition 5.2
  (`prop52_vector`), applied with `N' = N / D_low`; it depends **only on the sector `(J,P)`**
  (allocation fixed over each box, at the box upper endpoints).
* `atom_factorization` — for every actual atom, `d = d₁ d₂ d₃` with `d₁ = b · ∏_{colour 0} q_i`,
  `d₂ = ∏_{colour 1} q_i`, `d₃ = ∏_{colour 2} q_i`, and
  `d₁ ≤ N X^{-δ}`, `N² d₂ d₃² ≤ D_low² X^{1-δ}`, `N² d₂⁵ d₃² ≤ D_low² X^{2-δ}`.
  The factor `D_low²` is the explicit price of inserting the low factor `b ≤ D_low` into `d₁`
  (the source's `x^{4β}`); `atom_factorization_clean` removes it when `D_low² ≤ X^{δ/2}`.
-/

open Finset Real

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

open Erdos287.Physical.Factor

variable (S : ScalarParams)

/-- The vector of box upper endpoints `U_i = D_{P_i}^{1+τ}` of a sector, padded by `1`. -/
noncomputable def boxVec (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  fun i => if h : i < J then S.boxTop (P ⟨i, h⟩) else 1

variable {S}

/-- **Signed parity routing of the low factor.** -/
theorem kappa_sector {J b : ℕ} (h : S.kappa J b ≠ 0) :
    Squarefree b ∧ (∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0) ∧
      (Even J → DplusSet S.Dlow b.primeFactors) ∧ (¬ Even J → DminusSet S.Dlow b.primeFactors) := by
  unfold kappa at h
  by_cases hJ : Even J
  · rw [if_pos hJ] at h
    unfold lamLowPlus at h
    split_ifs at h with hc
    · exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1, fun _ => hc.2.2, fun h' => absurd hJ h'⟩
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · rw [if_neg hJ] at h
    unfold lamLowMinus at h
    split_ifs at h with hc
    · exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1, fun h' => absurd h' hJ, fun _ => hc.2.2⟩
    · exact absurd rfl h

/-- Products over the positions of `Fin J` of a given colour, as products over `range J`. -/
lemma prod_fin_filter_eq (J : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (f : Fin J → ℝ) :
    ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = k), f i =
      ∏ i ∈ (range J).filter (fun i => c i = k), (if h : i < J then f ⟨i, h⟩ else 1) := by
  rw [prod_filter, prod_filter, Finset.prod_fin_eq_prod_range]
  refine prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
  have hi' : i < J := mem_range.1 hi
  simp [hi']

lemma prod_range_boxVec (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ J) :
    ∏ i ∈ range j, S.boxVec J P i =
      ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => i.val < j), S.boxTop (P i) := by
  rw [prod_filter, Finset.prod_fin_eq_prod_range, ← prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ hj]
  have h1 : ∏ i ∈ Ico j J, (if h : i < J then (if (⟨i, h⟩ : Fin J).val < j then
      S.boxTop (P ⟨i, h⟩) else 1) else 1) = 1 :=
    prod_eq_one (fun i hi => by simp at hi; simp [show ¬ i < j by omega])
  rw [h1, mul_one]
  refine prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
  have hi' : i < j := mem_range.1 hi
  simp [boxVec, show i < J by omega, hi']

/-- **Structured support of the box vector**: Lichtman's `𝐃_J^+` condition (with its
parity-dependent threshold) at the box *lower* endpoints implies Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_J(D_int^{1+τ})`
at the box *upper* endpoints `U_i = D_{P_i}^{1+τ}`. -/
theorem boxVec_vecHyp (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} (hP : S.BoxAdm J P) :
    VecHyp (S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau)) (S.boxVec J P) J := by
  have hτ := tau_pos hS
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i j hij hj => ?_, fun j hj hje => ?_⟩
  · simp only [boxVec, dif_pos hi]
    rw [boxTop_eq hS]; exact (boxEnd_gt_one hS _).le
  · simp only [boxVec, dif_pos hj, dif_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj)]
    rw [boxTop_eq hS, boxTop_eq hS, boxEnd_le_iff hS]
    have : P ⟨j, hj⟩ ≤ P ⟨i, by omega⟩ := hP.1 (show (⟨i, _⟩ : Fin J) ≤ ⟨j, hj⟩ from hij)
    have : (P ⟨j, hj⟩ : ℕ) ≤ P ⟨i, by omega⟩ := this
    omega
  · have hadm := hP.2 ⟨j, hj⟩ hje
    rw [prod_range_boxVec J P j hj.le]
    simp only [boxVec, dif_pos hj]
    have hfilt : univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => i.val < j) = univ.filter (· < (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin J)) := by
      ext i; simp [Fin.lt_def]
    rw [hfilt]
    have hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ S.boxEnd i := fun i => (boxEnd_pos hS i).le
    unfold boxTop
    rw [Real.finset_prod_rpow _ _ (fun i _ => hpos _),
      ← Real.rpow_natCast (S.boxEnd ↑(P ⟨j, hj⟩) ^ (1 + S.tau)) 3,
      ← Real.rpow_mul (hpos _), mul_comm ((1 : ℝ) + S.tau), Real.rpow_mul (hpos _),
      Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.mul_rpow (prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hpos _)) (pow_nonneg (hpos _) 3)]
    refine le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_nonneg (prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hpos _))
      (pow_nonneg (hpos _) 3)) hadm.le (by linarith)) (threshold_rpow_le hS J)

theorem Dint_rpow_le_Dtot (hS : S.Good) : S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) ≤ S.Dtot := by
  rw [← Dlow_mul hS]
  have := Dlow_ge_one hS
  have : 0 ≤ S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) := Real.rpow_nonneg (Dint_pos hS).le _
  nlinarith

/-- The box vector lies in Pascadi's `𝒟⁺_J(X^{3/5-50δ})` for every `0 ≤ δ ≤ 1/5000`. -/
theorem boxVec_vecHyp_pascadi (hS : S.Good) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / 5000) {J : ℕ}
    {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} (hP : S.BoxAdm J P) :
    VecHyp (S.X ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ)) (S.boxVec J P) J := by
  have h := boxVec_vecHyp hS hP
  have hle : S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) ≤ S.X ^ (3 / 5 - 50 * δ) := by
    refine (Dint_rpow_le_Dtot hS).trans ?_
    unfold Dtot
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS.X_gt.le (by linarith)
  exact ⟨h.one_le, h.anti, fun j hj he => (h.plus j hj he).trans hle⟩

/-- **The Pascadi colouring of a sector** (finite choice; it depends only on `(J, P)`, i.e. the
allocation is fixed over each box).  Proposition 5.2 is applied to the box upper endpoints with
`N' = N / D_low`. -/
noncomputable def atomColour (δ N : ℝ) (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : ℕ → Fin 3 :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun c : ℕ → Fin 3 => Sys53 S.X δ (N / S.Dlow)
    (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 0 J) (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 1 J) (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 2 J))

/-- The parameter hypotheses for applying Proposition 5.2 to the scalar atoms. -/
structure AtomParams (S : ScalarParams) (δ N : ℝ) : Prop where
  good : S.Good
  δ_pos : 0 < δ
  δ_small : δ < 1 / 100000
  N_lo : S.X ^ (2 * δ) ≤ N / S.Dlow
  N_hi : N ≤ S.X ^ (1 / 3 + δ)

theorem atomColour_spec {δ N : ℝ} (hA : AtomParams S δ N) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H}
    (hP : S.BoxAdm J P) :
    Sys53 S.X δ (N / S.Dlow) (cprod (S.boxVec J P) (S.atomColour δ N J P) 0 J)
      (cprod (S.boxVec J P) (S.atomColour δ N J P) 1 J)
      (cprod (S.boxVec J P) (S.atomColour δ N J P) 2 J) := by
  have hS := hA.good
  have hDl := Dlow_ge_one hS
  apply Classical.epsilon_spec (p := fun c : ℕ → Fin 3 => Sys53 S.X δ (N / S.Dlow)
    (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 0 J) (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 1 J) (cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 2 J))
  refine prop52_vector hS.X_gt hA.δ_pos hA.δ_small hA.N_lo ?_
    (boxVec_vecHyp_pascadi hS (by linarith [hA.δ_small]) hP)
  refine le_trans ?_ hA.N_hi
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := by
    have := hA.N_lo
    have h0 : 0 < S.X ^ (2 * δ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith [hS.X_gt]) _
    have : 0 < N / S.Dlow := lt_of_lt_of_le h0 this
    exact (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by linarith)).1 this |>.le
  exact div_le_self hN0 hDl

/-- The colour-`k` part of a labelled tuple. -/
def tupleFactor {J : ℕ} (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (q : Fin J → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = k), q i

lemma tupleFactor_mul {J : ℕ} (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (q : Fin J → ℕ) :
    tupleFactor c 0 q * tupleFactor c 1 q * tupleFactor c 2 q = ∏ i, q i := by
  unfold tupleFactor
  have := Finset.prod_fiberwise (univ : Finset (Fin J)) (fun i => c i.val) q
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_three] at this
  exact this

lemma tupleFactor_le {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {q : Fin J → ℕ} (hq : q ∈ S.tuples J P)
    (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) :
    (tupleFactor c k q : ℝ) ≤ cprod (S.boxVec J P) c k J := by
  unfold tupleFactor cprod
  push_cast
  have e := prod_fin_filter_eq J c k (fun i => S.boxTop (P i))
  have e' : ∀ i ∈ (range J).filter (fun i => c i = k),
      (if h : i < J then S.boxTop (P ⟨i, h⟩) else 1) = S.boxVec J P i := fun i _ => rfl
  rw [prod_congr rfl e'] at e
  rw [← e]
  refine prod_le_prod (fun i _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _) (fun i _ => ?_)
  exact ((mem_tuples hq).2 i).2.2

/-- **Pascadi factorization of every actual scalar atom.** -/
theorem atom_factorization {δ N : ℝ} (hA : AtomParams S δ N) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H}
    (hP : S.BoxAdm J P) {b : ℕ} (hb : S.kappa J b ≠ 0) {q : Fin J → ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ S.tuples J P) :
    let c := S.atomColour δ N J P
    let d₁ := b * tupleFactor c 0 q
    let d₂ := tupleFactor c 1 q
    let d₃ := tupleFactor c 2 q
    b * ∏ i, q i = d₁ * d₂ * d₃ ∧
      (d₁ : ℝ) ≤ N * S.X ^ (-δ) ∧
      N ^ 2 * (d₂ : ℝ) * (d₃ : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (1 - δ) ∧
      N ^ 2 * (d₂ : ℝ) ^ 5 * (d₃ : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (2 - δ) := by
  intro c d₁ d₂ d₃
  have hS := hA.good
  have hDl := Dlow_ge_one hS
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3⟩ := atomColour_spec hA hP
  have hb' : (b : ℝ) ≤ S.Dlow := kappa_level hS hb
  have e0 := tupleFactor_le hq c 0
  have e1 := tupleFactor_le hq c 1
  have e2 := tupleFactor_le hq c 2
  set E0 := cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 0 J
  set E1 := cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 1 J
  set E2 := cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 2 J
  have n0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ tupleFactor c 0 q := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have n1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d₂ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have n2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d₃ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hNdl : N / S.Dlow * S.Dlow = N := div_mul_cancel₀ N (by linarith)
  have m1 : 0 ≤ E1 := n1.trans e1
  have m2 : 0 ≤ E2 := n2.trans e2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [d₁, d₂, d₃, mul_assoc]; rw [← tupleFactor_mul c q]; ring
  · simp only [d₁]; push_cast
    have hX : 0 ≤ S.X ^ (-δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hS.X_gt]) _
    calc (b : ℝ) * tupleFactor c 0 q ≤ S.Dlow * E0 :=
          mul_le_mul hb' e0 n0 (by linarith)
      _ ≤ S.Dlow * (N / S.Dlow * S.X ^ (-δ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s1 (by linarith)
      _ = N * S.X ^ (-δ) := by field_simp
  · calc N ^ 2 * (d₂ : ℝ) * (d₃ : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ N ^ 2 * E1 * E2 ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = S.Dlow ^ 2 * ((N / S.Dlow) ^ 2 * E1 * E2 ^ 2) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (1 - δ) := by gcongr
  · calc N ^ 2 * (d₂ : ℝ) ^ 5 * (d₃ : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ N ^ 2 * E1 ^ 5 * E2 ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = S.Dlow ^ 2 * ((N / S.Dlow) ^ 2 * E1 ^ 5 * E2 ^ 2) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (2 - δ) := by gcongr

/-- If the low level is negligible, `D_low² ≤ X^{δ/2}`, every actual atom satisfies Pascadi's
system (5.3) exactly with `δ/2`. -/
theorem atom_factorization_clean {δ N : ℝ} (hA : AtomParams S δ N)
    (hlow : S.Dlow ^ 2 ≤ S.X ^ (δ / 2)) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H}
    (hP : S.BoxAdm J P) {b : ℕ} (hb : S.kappa J b ≠ 0) {q : Fin J → ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ S.tuples J P) :
    let c := S.atomColour δ N J P
    b * ∏ i, q i = (b * tupleFactor c 0 q) * tupleFactor c 1 q * tupleFactor c 2 q ∧
      Sys53 S.X (δ / 2) N (b * tupleFactor c 0 q : ℕ) (tupleFactor c 1 q) (tupleFactor c 2 q) := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := atom_factorization hA hP hb hq
  have hS := hA.good
  have hX0 : 0 < S.X := by linarith [hS.X_gt]
  have hδ := hA.δ_pos
  refine ⟨h0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine h1.trans ?_
    have hN : 0 ≤ N := by
      have := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hX0 (2 * δ)).trans_le hA.N_lo
      exact ((div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by linarith [Dlow_ge_one hS])).1 this).le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hS.X_gt.le (by linarith)) hN
  · refine h2.trans ?_
    calc S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (1 - δ) ≤ S.X ^ (δ / 2) * S.X ^ (1 - δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow (Real.rpow_nonneg hX0.le _)
      _ = S.X ^ (1 - δ / 2) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hX0]; ring_nf
  · refine h3.trans ?_
    calc S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (2 - δ) ≤ S.X ^ (δ / 2) * S.X ^ (2 - δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow (Real.rpow_nonneg hX0.le _)
      _ = S.X ^ (2 - δ / 2) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hX0]; ring_nf

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=15746 sha256=d221827bb93d1cfb26ba9db7fd4c4a5b08387725026de89d24f63a6e8ecf1734 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Factorization/Tensor.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Support
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Colouring

/-!
# Erdős #287 — exact three-colour tensorization of the high-prime box weights

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Fix a sector `(J, P)` and **any** colouring `c` of the `J` box positions (in the application:
the Pascadi colouring `atomColour`).  Distinctness of the primes across the three colour
classes is decoupled by a uniformly random colouring `χ : Fin K → Fin 3` of all candidate
primes (`K = ⌊z⌋ + 1`): a labelled tuple `q` of distinct primes is kept for `χ` iff
`χ(q_i) = c(i)` for every position `i`, which happens for exactly `3^{K-J}` colourings
(`card_compat_mul`).  For a fixed `χ` the kept tuples are *exactly* the triples of partial
tuples (one per colour class, the primes of class `k` all `χ`-coloured `k`), so the count
becomes a triple Dirichlet convolution.

* `partTuples J P c χ k` — partial labelled tuples on the positions of colour `k`
  (dummy entry `1` elsewhere), distinct within the class, primes `χ`-coloured `k`;
* `colFactor J P c χ k = γ_k⁻¹ · #{partial tuples with product m}` where
  `γ_k = ∏_b (#{i : c i = k, P_i = b})!` is the repeated-box multiplicity of the class;
* `atomWeight J P c = 3^J ∏_k γ_k / (γ(P) 3^K)`;
* **`bcoef_tensor`** — `B_P = atomWeight • ∑_χ colFactor₀ * colFactor₁ * colFactor₂`
  (exact identity of arithmetic functions; `B_P = T_P/γ(P)` is the literal box weight).
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

open Erdos287.Physical.Factor

/-! ### Counting arithmetic functions -/

open Classical in
/-- `m ↦ #{x ∈ A : f x = m}` (and `0` at `m = 0`), as an arithmetic function. -/
noncomputable def cntAF {α : Type*} (A : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun m => if m = 0 then 0 else ((A.filter (fun x => f x = m)).card : ℝ), by simp⟩

lemma cntAF_apply {α : Type*} (A : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) [DecidableEq ℕ] :
    cntAF A f m = ((A.filter (fun x => f x = m)).card : ℝ) := by
  classical
  simp only [cntAF, ArithmeticFunction.coe_mk, if_neg hm]
  congr

/-- Dirichlet product of counting functions counts pairs. -/
lemma cntAF_mul {α β : Type*} (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) (f : α → ℕ) (g : β → ℕ) :
    cntAF A f * cntAF B g = cntAF (A ×ˢ B) (fun p => f p.1 * g p.2) := by
  classical
  ext m
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm; simp
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, cntAF_apply _ _ hm]
  have h1 : ∀ x ∈ m.divisorsAntidiagonal, cntAF A f x.1 * cntAF B g x.2 =
      ∑ a ∈ A, ∑ b ∈ B, if (f a, g b) = x then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have hx1' : x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hm (by rw [← hx1, h, zero_mul])
    have hx2' : x.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hm (by rw [← hx1, h, mul_zero])
    rw [cntAF_apply _ _ hx1', cntAF_apply _ _ hx2', card_filter, card_filter]
    push_cast
    rw [sum_mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    by_cases ha : f a = x.1 <;> by_cases hb : g b = x.2 <;>
      simp [ha, hb, Prod.ext_iff]
  rw [sum_congr rfl h1, sum_comm]
  rw [card_filter, sum_product]
  push_cast
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [sum_comm]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
  rw [sum_ite_eq]
  simp only [Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal]
  by_cases h : f a * g b = m
  · rw [if_pos ⟨h, hm⟩, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h h'.1), if_neg h]

/-- Scalar multiple of an arithmetic function. -/
noncomputable def scaleAF (r : ℝ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun m => r * f m, by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma scaleAF_apply (r : ℝ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    scaleAF r f m = r * f m := rfl

lemma scaleAF_mul (r s : ℝ) (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    scaleAF r f * scaleAF s g = scaleAF (r * s) (f * g) := by
  ext m
  simp only [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, scaleAF_apply, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => by ring)

lemma af_sum_apply {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (a : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i a := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert x s hx ih => rw [sum_insert hx, sum_insert hx, ArithmeticFunction.add_apply, ih]

/-! ### Candidate primes, the colouring range, partial tuples -/

variable (S : ScalarParams)

open Classical in
/-- The candidate primes of box `j` (exactly the range used in `tuples`). -/
noncomputable def boxPrimes (j : Fin S.H) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range (⌊S.boxTop j⌋₊ + 1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ S.InBox j p)

/-- Every candidate prime is `< K = ⌊z⌋ + 1`. -/
noncomputable def Kc : ℕ := ⌊S.ztop⌋₊ + 1

/-- The colour of a natural number under `χ` (`0` outside the colouring range). -/
noncomputable def chiAt (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (p : ℕ) : Fin 3 := if h : p < S.Kc then χ ⟨p, h⟩ else 0

open Classical in
/-- Partial labelled tuples of colour class `k` (entry `1` off the class). -/
noncomputable def partTuples (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) : Finset (Fin J → ℕ) :=
  (Fintype.piFinset fun i => if c i.val = k then
      (S.boxPrimes (P i)).filter (fun p => S.chiAt χ p = k) else {1}).filter
    (fun q => ∀ i j, c i.val = k → c j.val = k → q i = q j → i = j)

/-- Repeated-box multiplicity of colour class `k`: `γ_k = ∏_b (#{i : c i = k, P_i = b})!`. -/
noncomputable def gammaCol (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) : ℕ :=
  ∏ b : Fin S.H, (univ.filter (fun i : Fin J => c i.val = k ∧ P i = b)).card.factorial

/-- **The colour-`k` factor** `γ_{k,χ}(m) = γ_k⁻¹ #{partial tuples of class k with product m}`. -/
noncomputable def colFactor (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  scaleAF ((S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)⁻¹) (cntAF (S.partTuples J P c χ k) (fun q => ∏ i, q i))

/-- The atom weight `3^J ∏_k γ_k / (γ(P) 3^K)`. -/
noncomputable def atomWeight (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  (3 : ℝ) ^ J * (∏ k : Fin 3, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)) / ((S.gammaP J P : ℝ) * 3 ^ S.Kc)

/-- The literal box weight `B_P` as an arithmetic function. -/
noncomputable def bcoefAF (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun a => if a = 0 then 0 else S.Bcoef J P a, by simp⟩

/-- The low weight `κ_J` as an arithmetic function. -/
noncomputable def kappaAF (J : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun b => if b = 0 then 0 else S.kappa J b, by simp⟩

variable {S}

lemma fin3_cases (x : Fin 3) : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 ∨ x = 2 := by fin_cases x <;> simp

lemma boxPrimes_lt (hS : S.Good) {j : Fin S.H} {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ S.boxPrimes j) : p < S.Kc := by
  classical
  unfold boxPrimes at hp
  obtain ⟨-, -, hbox⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp
  have h1 : (p : ℝ) ≤ S.ztop := by
    refine hbox.2.trans ?_
    rw [boxTop_eq hS, ztop, boxEnd_le_iff hS]
    exact j.2
  have h2 : p ≤ ⌊S.ztop⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor h1
  unfold Kc; omega

lemma mem_tuples_iff {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {q : Fin J → ℕ} :
    q ∈ S.tuples J P ↔ (∀ i, q i ∈ S.boxPrimes (P i)) ∧ Function.Injective q := by
  classical
  unfold tuples boxPrimes
  rw [mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset]

/-! ### Step 1: the random colouring normalisation -/

lemma card_compat_tuple (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {q : Fin J → ℕ}
    (hq : q ∈ S.tuples J P) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    (univ.filter (fun χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3 => ∀ i : Fin J, S.chiAt χ (q i) = c i.val)).card *
      3 ^ J = 3 ^ S.Kc := by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hinj⟩ := mem_tuples_iff.1 hq
  have hlt : ∀ i, q i < S.Kc := fun i => boxPrimes_lt hS (hmem i)
  set q' : Fin J → Fin S.Kc := fun i => ⟨q i, hlt i⟩
  have hq' : Function.Injective q' := fun i j h => hinj (congrArg Fin.val h)
  have := card_compat_mul q' hq' (fun i => c i.val)
  convert this using 3
  ext χ
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, chiAt, q', dif_pos (hlt _)]

open Classical in
lemma Tcount_mul_pow (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (a : ℕ) :
    S.Tcount J P a * 3 ^ S.Kc = 3 ^ J * ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
      ((S.tuples J P).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = a ∧ ∀ i : Fin J,
        S.chiAt χ (q i) = c i.val)).card := by
  unfold Tcount
  rw [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_mul]
  have : ∀ q ∈ (S.tuples J P).filter (fun p => ∏ i, p i = a), 1 * 3 ^ S.Kc =
      3 ^ J * ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3, if (∀ i : Fin J, S.chiAt χ (q i) = c i.val) then 1 else 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [one_mul, ← card_compat_tuple hS (mem_filter.1 hq).1 c, mul_comm, card_filter]
  rw [sum_congr rfl this, ← mul_sum, sum_comm]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
  rw [card_filter, sum_filter]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => ?_)
  by_cases h1 : ∏ i, q i = a <;> simp [h1]

/-! ### Step 2: compatible tuples = triples of partial tuples -/

/-- The colour-`k` part of a tuple. -/
def mask {J : ℕ} (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) (q : Fin J → ℕ) : Fin J → ℕ :=
  fun i => if c i.val = k then q i else 1

/-- The `k`-th component of a triple. -/
def comp {J : ℕ} (t : ((Fin J → ℕ) × (Fin J → ℕ)) × (Fin J → ℕ)) (k : Fin 3) : Fin J → ℕ :=
  if k = 0 then t.1.1 else if k = 1 then t.1.2 else t.2

/-- Merge a triple of partial tuples. -/
def merge {J : ℕ} (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (t : ((Fin J → ℕ) × (Fin J → ℕ)) × (Fin J → ℕ)) :
    Fin J → ℕ := fun i => comp t (c i.val) i

lemma prod_mask {J : ℕ} (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (q : Fin J → ℕ) :
    ∏ i, q i = (∏ i, mask c 0 q i) * (∏ i, mask c 1 q i) * (∏ i, mask c 2 q i) := by
  rw [← prod_mul_distrib, ← prod_mul_distrib]
  refine prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rcases fin3_cases (c i.val) with h | h | h <;> simp [mask, h]

lemma mem_partTuples {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {c : ℕ → Fin 3} {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3}
    {k : Fin 3} {q : Fin J → ℕ} :
    q ∈ S.partTuples J P c χ k ↔
      (∀ i, (c i.val = k → q i ∈ S.boxPrimes (P i) ∧ S.chiAt χ (q i) = k) ∧
        (c i.val ≠ k → q i = 1)) ∧
      ∀ i j, c i.val = k → c j.val = k → q i = q j → i = j := by
  classical
  unfold partTuples
  rw [mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
  refine and_congr_left (fun _ => forall_congr' (fun i => ?_))
  by_cases h : c i.val = k
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

open Classical in
lemma card_compat_eq_triples {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (a : ℕ) :
    ((S.tuples J P).filter (fun q => ∏ i, q i = a ∧ ∀ i : Fin J,
        S.chiAt χ (q i) = c i.val)).card =
      (((S.partTuples J P c χ 0 ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 1) ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 2).filter
        (fun t => (∏ i, t.1.1 i) * (∏ i, t.1.2 i) * (∏ i, t.2 i) = a)).card := by
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun q => ((mask c 0 q, mask c 1 q), mask c 2 q)) (merge c) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hqt, hprod, hcomp⟩ := mem_filter.1 hq
    obtain ⟨hmem, hinj⟩ := mem_tuples_iff.1 hqt
    have hpart : ∀ k, mask c k q ∈ S.partTuples J P c χ k := by
      intro k
      rw [mem_partTuples]
      refine ⟨fun i => ⟨fun hk => ?_, fun hk => ?_⟩, fun i j hi hj hij => ?_⟩
      · simp only [mask, if_pos hk]; exact ⟨hmem i, (hcomp i).trans hk⟩
      · simp [mask, hk]
      · simp only [mask, if_pos hi, if_pos hj] at hij; exact hinj hij
    simp only [coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_product]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hpart 0, hpart 1⟩, hpart 2⟩, by rw [← prod_mask, hprod]⟩
  · intro t ht
    simp only [coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_product] at ht
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2⟩, hprod⟩ := ht
    have hk : ∀ k, comp t k ∈ S.partTuples J P c χ k := by
      intro k; rcases fin3_cases k with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simpa [comp]
    have hval : ∀ i, merge c t i ∈ S.boxPrimes (P i) ∧ S.chiAt χ (merge c t i) = c i.val :=
      fun i => ((mem_partTuples.1 (hk (c i.val))).1 i).1 rfl
    have hmask : ∀ k, mask c k (merge c t) = comp t k := by
      intro k; funext i
      by_cases hi : c i.val = k
      · simp [mask, merge, hi]
      · simp only [mask, if_neg hi]
        exact (((mem_partTuples.1 (hk k)).1 i).2 hi).symm
    refine mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_tuples_iff.2 ⟨fun i => (hval i).1, fun i j hij => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hc : c i.val = c j.val := by rw [← (hval i).2, ← (hval j).2, hij]
      have hij' : comp t (c i.val) i = comp t (c i.val) j := by
        have := hij; simp only [merge] at this; rw [← hc] at this; exact this
      exact (mem_partTuples.1 (hk (c i.val))).2 i j rfl hc.symm hij'
    · rw [prod_mask, hmask, hmask, hmask]
      simpa [comp] using hprod
    · exact fun i => (hval i).2
  · intro q hq
    funext i
    rcases fin3_cases (c i.val) with h | h | h <;> simp [merge, comp, mask, h]
  · intro t ht
    simp only [coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_product] at ht
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2⟩, -⟩ := ht
    have hk : ∀ k, comp t k ∈ S.partTuples J P c χ k := by
      intro k; rcases fin3_cases k with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simpa [comp]
    have hmask : ∀ k, mask c k (merge c t) = comp t k := by
      intro k; funext i
      by_cases hi : c i.val = k
      · simp [mask, merge, hi]
      · simp only [mask, if_neg hi]
        exact (((mem_partTuples.1 (hk k)).1 i).2 hi).symm
    simp only [hmask]
    simp [comp]

/-! ### Step 3: the tensor identity -/

lemma gammaCol_pos (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (k : Fin 3) :
    0 < S.gammaCol J P c k :=
  prod_pos (fun _ _ => Nat.factorial_pos _)

/-- **Exact three-colour tensorization of the box weight `B_P`.** -/
theorem bcoef_tensor (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3) :
    S.bcoefAF J P = scaleAF (S.atomWeight J P c) (∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
      S.colFactor J P c χ 0 * S.colFactor J P c χ 1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 2) := by
  classical
  ext a
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst ha; simp [bcoefAF]
  have hγ : ∀ k, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun k => by
    exact_mod_cast (gammaCol_pos J P c k).ne'
  have hcol : ∀ χ, S.colFactor J P c χ 0 * S.colFactor J P c χ 1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 2 =
      scaleAF (∏ k : Fin 3, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ))⁻¹
        (cntAF ((S.partTuples J P c χ 0 ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 1) ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 2)
          (fun t => (∏ i, t.1.1 i) * (∏ i, t.1.2 i) * (∏ i, t.2 i))) := by
    intro χ
    simp only [colFactor, scaleAF_mul, cntAF_mul, Fin.prod_univ_three, mul_inv]
  simp only [hcol, scaleAF_apply]
  rw [af_sum_apply]
  simp only [scaleAF_apply, cntAF_apply _ _ ha, ← mul_sum]
  simp only [bcoefAF, ArithmeticFunction.coe_mk, if_neg ha, Bcoef]
  have hT := Tcount_mul_pow hS P c a
  simp only [card_compat_eq_triples P c] at hT
  have hT' : (S.Tcount J P a : ℝ) = 3 ^ J * (∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
      ((((S.partTuples J P c χ 0 ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 1) ×ˢ S.partTuples J P c χ 2).filter
        (fun t => (∏ i, t.1.1 i) * (∏ i, t.1.2 i) * (∏ i, t.2 i) = a)).card : ℝ)) / 3 ^ S.Kc := by
    rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
    exact_mod_cast hT
  rw [hT', atomWeight]
  have hγP : (S.gammaP J P : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (gammaP_pos P).ne'
  have hprod : (∏ k : Fin 3, (S.gammaCol J P c k : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (fun k _ => hγ k)
  field_simp

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

@@END_FILE@@

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5013 sha256=9fa4cd801eec452421dd55962f4640f122425495b5ba01413d38e2129da54805 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Packet.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.CRT

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: designated-pair packets, `Γ_ξ`, `f_ξ`, `c_ξ`, `b_{ξ,d}`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Literal construction of
`sources/physical_spec.md` §§5–6 (the Maynard coefficient `ω_d`) and §§8–10 (packet index,
`f_ξ = a_j W q_0`, `Γ_ξ = ω_d ω_{d'}`, the CRT residue `c_ξ`, the reduced pair
`(A_{jℓ}, B_{jℓ})` and the CRT residue `b_{ξ,d}`).

Nothing here is assumed: every residue is *defined* (as the least solution below the modulus)
and its existence, uniqueness and unit property are *proved* from the explicit presieve
hypotheses `PhysData.WGood` (all prime factors of the slopes and of their non-zero differences
divide `W`; the source asserts this holds eventually for `W = ∏_{p ≤ log log log X} p`, which is
proved in `Physical/Presieve.lean`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

/-- Physical data at one scale: `k` affine forms `L_i(t) = a_i t + 1`, the presieve modulus
`W`, the scale `X`, the window constants `c₁ < c₂`, and the finite tensor decomposition
`F = ∑_v ∏_i f'_{i,v}` of the Maynard test function (§5). -/
structure PhysData where
  k : ℕ
  a : Fin k → ℕ
  W : ℕ
  X : ℝ
  c1 : ℝ
  c2 : ℝ
  V : ℕ
  fp : Fin V → Fin k → ℝ → ℝ

/-- The presieve hypotheses of §6: positive slopes, `W > 0`, every prime divisor of a slope
and of a non-zero slope difference divides `W`. -/
structure PhysData.WGood (P : PhysData) : Prop where
  a_pos : ∀ i, 0 < P.a i
  W_pos : 0 < P.W
  slope : ∀ i, ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ P.a i → p ∣ P.W
  diff : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℤ) ∣ (P.a i : ℤ) - P.a i' → p ∣ P.W

/-- A labelled designated-pair packet `ξ = (j, ℓ, d, d')` (§8). -/
structure Packet (k : ℕ) where
  j : Fin k
  l : Fin k
  d : Fin k → ℕ
  d' : Fin k → ℕ

namespace PhysData

variable (P : PhysData)

/-- The affine form `L_i(t) = a_i t + 1`. -/
def L (i : Fin P.k) (t : ℕ) : ℕ := P.a i * t + 1

/-- **The actual Maynard coefficient** (§6):
`ω_d = 1_{(∏ d_i, W)=1} (∏ μ(d_i)) ∑_v ∏_i f'_{i,v}(log d_i / log X)`. -/
noncomputable def omega (d : Fin P.k → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Nat.Coprime (∏ i, d i) P.W then
    (∏ i, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (d i) : ℝ)) *
      ∑ v, ∏ i, P.fp v i (Real.log (d i) / Real.log P.X)
  else 0

/-- `q_i = [d_i, d'_i]`. -/
def q (ξ : Packet P.k) (i : Fin P.k) : ℕ := Nat.lcm (ξ.d i) (ξ.d' i)

/-- Spectator coordinates `i ∉ {j, ℓ}`. -/
def spec (ξ : Packet P.k) : Finset (Fin P.k) := univ.filter (fun i => i ≠ ξ.j ∧ i ≠ ξ.l)

/-- `q_0 = ∏_{i ≠ j, ℓ} q_i`. -/
def q0 (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℕ := ∏ i ∈ P.spec ξ, P.q ξ i

/-- **`f_ξ = a_j W q_0`.** -/
def f (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℕ := P.a ξ.j * P.W * P.q0 ξ

/-- **`Γ_ξ = ω_d ω_{d'}`.** -/
noncomputable def Gamma (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℝ := P.omega ξ.d * P.omega ξ.d'

/-- The spectator residue `1 - a_j a_i⁻¹ (mod q_i)`, with the explicit Bézout inverse. -/
def specRes (ξ : Packet P.k) (i : Fin P.k) : ℤ :=
  1 - (P.a ξ.j : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA (P.a i) (P.q ξ i)

/-- The CRT system defining `c_ξ`: `x ≡ 1 (mod a_j W)` and `x ≡ 1 - a_j a_i⁻¹ (mod q_i)` for
every spectator `i`. -/
def System (ξ : Packet P.k) (x : ℤ) : Prop :=
  x ≡ 1 [ZMOD (P.a ξ.j * P.W : ℕ)] ∧ ∀ i ∈ P.spec ξ, x ≡ P.specRes ξ i [ZMOD (P.q ξ i : ℕ)]

open Classical in
/-- **`c_ξ`**: the least solution in `[0, f_ξ)` of the CRT system (`0` off the admissible
support, where it is never used). -/
noncomputable def cRes (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ c, c < P.f ξ ∧ P.System ξ c then Nat.find h else 0

/-- The admissible/compatible physical support (§8): `j < ℓ`, the designated entries are `1`,
all entries are positive and coprime to `W`, and the spectator `q_i` are pairwise coprime. -/
def Admissible (ξ : Packet P.k) : Prop :=
  ξ.j < ξ.l ∧ ξ.d ξ.j = 1 ∧ ξ.d' ξ.j = 1 ∧ ξ.d ξ.l = 1 ∧ ξ.d' ξ.l = 1 ∧
    (∀ i, 0 < ξ.d i ∧ 0 < ξ.d' i) ∧ (∀ i, Nat.Coprime (ξ.d i) P.W ∧ Nat.Coprime (ξ.d' i) P.W) ∧
    (P.spec ξ : Set (Fin P.k)).Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime (P.q ξ))

/-- `g_{jℓ} = (a_j, a_ℓ)`. -/
def g (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℕ := Nat.gcd (P.a ξ.j) (P.a ξ.l)

/-- `A_{jℓ} = a_ℓ / g_{jℓ}`. -/
def A (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℕ := P.a ξ.l / P.g ξ

/-- `B_{jℓ} = (a_ℓ - a_j) / g_{jℓ}` (an integer, possibly negative). -/
def B (ξ : Packet P.k) : ℤ := ((P.a ξ.l : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j) / (P.g ξ : ℤ)

open Classical in
/-- **`b_{ξ,d}`**: the least `b < f_ξ d` with `b ≡ c_ξ (mod f_ξ)` and
`A_{jℓ} b ≡ B_{jℓ} (mod d)`. -/
noncomputable def bRes (ξ : Packet P.k) (e : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ b, b < P.f ξ * e ∧ (b : ℤ) ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] ∧
      (P.A ξ : ℤ) * b ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)] then Nat.find h else 0

end PhysData

end Erdos287.Physical
