import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Residues

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: prime counts, the pair term and the exact pair identity

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Literal objects of
`sources/physical_spec.md` §§6, 8, 11, 12:

* `Tset` — the physical parameters `c₁X < t < c₂X`;
* `Pcount j q b` — `P_j(q,b) = #{p ∈ 𝒥_j(X) prime, p ≡ b (mod q)}` with
  `𝒥_j(X) = (a_j c₁X + 1, a_j c₂X + 1)` (prime counts, *not* von Mangoldt weights);
* `Vmain j = ∫_{a_j c₁X+1}^{a_j c₂X+1} dt / log t = Li(a_j c₂X+1) - Li(a_j c₁X+1)`;
* `Eerr j q b = P_j(q,b) - V_j(X)/φ(q)`;
* `MaynardInner j ℓ t = ∑_{d : d_j = d_ℓ = 1, d_i ∣ L_i(t)} ω_d` (the pair-term Maynard sum);
* `Xi j ℓ` — the labelled admissible packets `ξ = (j, ℓ, d, d')`;
* `ScalarSieve` — the scalar coefficient `ℓ_X` on a finite `W`-coprime support, with
  `U_X(v) = ∑_{d ∣ v} ℓ_X(d)`;
* `PairSum S j ℓ = ∑_t 1_{W ∣ t} 1_{L_j(t) prime} U_X(L_ℓ(t)) (∑ ω_d)(∑ ω_{d'})` — the literal
  designated-pair term of the Maynard square.

Kernel-proved:

* `maynardInner_eq_divisors` — the divisor-vector truncation in `MaynardInner` is lossless;
* `pairSum_eq_packets` — **the exact pair-indexing identity**
  `PairSum = ∑_{ξ ∈ Ξ_{jℓ}} Γ_ξ ∑_{d, (d,f_ξ)=1} ℓ_X(d) P_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`;
* `pairSum_eq_main_add_rem` — `PairSum = PairMain + PairRem`, with
  `PairRem = ∑_ξ Γ_ξ ∑_d ℓ_X(d) E_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`.

The coefficient `ℓ_X` is a *parameter* (`ScalarSieve`): the low-prime weights
`λ_low^±` that enter `ℓ_X` (§15) are not given by an explicit formula in the source.  Every
identity here holds for every choice of `ℓ_X` supported on `W`-coprime integers.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

namespace PhysData

variable (P : PhysData)

/-- `⌈c₂ X⌉`. -/
noncomputable def tMax : ℕ := ⌈P.c2 * P.X⌉₊

/-- The physical parameter range `c₁ X < t < c₂ X`. -/
noncomputable def Tset : Finset ℕ :=
  (range (P.tMax + 1)).filter (fun t => P.c1 * P.X < t ∧ (t : ℝ) < P.c2 * P.X)

/-- A bound for the prime window `𝒥_j(X)`. -/
noncomputable def pMax (j : Fin P.k) : ℕ := ⌈(P.a j : ℝ) * P.c2 * P.X⌉₊ + 2

/-- `p ∈ 𝒥_j(X) = (a_j c₁ X + 1, a_j c₂ X + 1)`. -/
def InJ (j : Fin P.k) (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (P.a j : ℝ) * P.c1 * P.X + 1 < p ∧ (p : ℝ) < P.a j * P.c2 * P.X + 1

open Classical in
/-- **`P_j(q,b)`**: the number of primes `p ∈ 𝒥_j(X)` with `p ≡ b (mod q)`. -/
noncomputable def Pcount (j : Fin P.k) (q b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((range (P.pMax j)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ P.InJ j p ∧ (p : ℤ) ≡ b [ZMOD q])).card

/-- **`V_j(X) = Li(a_j c₂X + 1) - Li(a_j c₁X + 1) = ∫ dt / log t`.** -/
noncomputable def Vmain (j : Fin P.k) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in ((P.a j : ℝ) * P.c1 * P.X + 1)..((P.a j : ℝ) * P.c2 * P.X + 1), 1 / Real.log u

/-- **`E_j(q,b) = P_j(q,b) - V_j(X)/φ(q)`.** -/
noncomputable def Eerr (j : Fin P.k) (q b : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (P.Pcount j q b : ℝ) - P.Vmain j / (Nat.totient q : ℝ)

/-- A divisor bound valid for every `L_i(t)`, `t ∈ Tset`. -/
noncomputable def Dmax : ℕ := (∑ i, P.a i) * P.tMax + 1

/-- Divisor vectors with designated entries `d_j = d_ℓ = 1`. -/
noncomputable def Dvec (j l : Fin P.k) : Finset (Fin P.k → ℕ) :=
  (Fintype.piFinset fun _ => Icc 1 P.Dmax).filter (fun d => d j = 1 ∧ d l = 1)

open Classical in
/-- The pair-term Maynard sum `∑_{d_j = d_ℓ = 1, d_i ∣ L_i(t)} ω_d`. -/
noncomputable def MaynardInner (j l : Fin P.k) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ (P.Dvec j l).filter (fun d => ∀ i, d i ∣ P.L i t), P.omega d

/-- The labelling map `(d, d') ↦ (j, ℓ, d, d')`. -/
def packetOf (j l : Fin P.k) : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ) ↪ Packet P.k where
  toFun x := ⟨j, l, x.1, x.2⟩
  inj' := by
    intro x y h
    simp only [Packet.mk.injEq, true_and] at h
    exact Prod.ext h.1 h.2

open Classical in
/-- **`Ξ_{jℓ}`**: the labelled admissible packets for the designated pair `(j, ℓ)`. -/
noncomputable def Xi (j l : Fin P.k) : Finset (Packet P.k) :=
  ((P.Dvec j l ×ˢ P.Dvec j l).filter (fun x => P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x))).map
    (P.packetOf j l)

end PhysData

/-- The scalar upper-sieve coefficient `ℓ_X` on a finite support (§15).  Its internal
formula (the low-prime weights `λ_low^±`) is not supplied by the source, so it is a
parameter of every statement below. -/
structure ScalarSieve where
  supp : Finset ℕ
  coeff : ℕ → ℝ

namespace ScalarSieve

/-- Support hypothesis: positive and coprime to `W` (§10, "the physical scalar divisor is
coprime to `W`"). -/
def Good (S : ScalarSieve) (W : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ S.supp, 0 < e ∧ Nat.Coprime e W

open Classical in
/-- `U_X(v) = ∑_{d ∣ v} ℓ_X(d)`. -/
noncomputable def U (S : ScalarSieve) (v : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (· ∣ v), S.coeff e

end ScalarSieve

namespace PhysData

variable (P : PhysData)

open Classical in
/-- **The literal designated-pair term**
`∑_t 1_{W∣t} 1_{L_j(t) prime} U_X(L_ℓ(t)) (∑_d ω_d)(∑_{d'} ω_{d'})`. -/
noncomputable def PairSum (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ P.Tset, (if P.W ∣ t ∧ (P.L j t).Prime then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * S.U (P.L l t) *
    P.MaynardInner j l t * P.MaynardInner j l t

open Classical in
/-- The packet-side form `∑_{ξ} Γ_ξ ∑_{d, (d,f_ξ)=1} ℓ_X(d) P_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`. -/
noncomputable def PairPackets (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ξ ∈ P.Xi j l, P.Gamma ξ * ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
    S.coeff e * (P.Pcount ξ.j (P.f ξ * e) (P.bRes ξ e) : ℝ)

open Classical in
/-- Main part `∑_ξ Γ_ξ ∑_d ℓ_X(d) V_j(X)/φ(f_ξ d)`. -/
noncomputable def PairMain (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ξ ∈ P.Xi j l, P.Gamma ξ * ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
    S.coeff e * (P.Vmain ξ.j / (Nat.totient (P.f ξ * e) : ℝ))

open Classical in
/-- **Pair remainder** `∑_ξ Γ_ξ ∑_d ℓ_X(d) E_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`. -/
noncomputable def PairRem (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ξ ∈ P.Xi j l, P.Gamma ξ * ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
    S.coeff e * P.Eerr ξ.j (P.f ξ * e) (P.bRes ξ e)

variable {P}

/-- `PairPackets = PairMain + PairRem` (definition of `E_j`). -/
theorem pairPackets_eq_main_add_rem (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) :
    P.PairPackets S j l = P.PairMain S j l + P.PairRem S j l := by
  unfold PairPackets PairMain PairRem Eerr
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ξ _ => ?_)
  rw [← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
  ring

/-! ### Proof of the exact pair identity -/

theorem expand_pair_square {β γ : Type*} (D : Finset β) (S : Finset γ)
    (A : Prop) [Decidable A] (C : β → Prop) [DecidablePred C]
    (E : γ → Prop) [DecidablePred E] (ω : β → ℝ) (l : γ → ℝ) :
    (if A then (1:ℝ) else 0) * (∑ e ∈ S.filter E, l e) *
      (∑ d ∈ D.filter C, ω d) * (∑ d ∈ D.filter C, ω d) =
      ∑ x ∈ D ×ˢ D, ∑ e ∈ S, ω x.1 * ω x.2 * l e *
        (if A ∧ C x.1 ∧ C x.2 ∧ E e then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d1 _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d2 _ =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)))
  by_cases hA : A <;> by_cases h1 : C d1 <;> by_cases h2 : C d2 <;>
    by_cases h3 : E e <;> simp [hA, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

variable (P) in
/-- The joint condition on `t` in the pair term. -/
def PairCond (j l : Fin P.k) (x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)) (e t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (P.W ∣ t ∧ (P.L j t).Prime) ∧ (∀ i, x.1 i ∣ P.L i t) ∧ (∀ i, x.2 i ∣ P.L i t) ∧ e ∣ P.L l t

variable (P) in
open Classical in
/-- The number of physical parameters `t` satisfying the joint condition. -/
noncomputable def cnt (j l : Fin P.k) (x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)) (e : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (P.Tset.filter (P.PairCond j l x e)).card

theorem pairSum_expand (S : ScalarSieve) (j l : Fin P.k) :
    P.PairSum S j l = ∑ x ∈ P.Dvec j l ×ˢ P.Dvec j l, ∑ e ∈ S.supp,
      P.omega x.1 * P.omega x.2 * S.coeff e * (P.cnt j l x e : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have h1 : ∀ t ∈ P.Tset, (if P.W ∣ t ∧ (P.L j t).Prime then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * S.U (P.L l t) *
      P.MaynardInner j l t * P.MaynardInner j l t =
      ∑ x ∈ P.Dvec j l ×ˢ P.Dvec j l, ∑ e ∈ S.supp, P.omega x.1 * P.omega x.2 * S.coeff e *
        (if P.PairCond j l x e t then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro t _
    unfold ScalarSieve.U MaynardInner PairCond
    convert expand_pair_square (P.Dvec j l) S.supp (P.W ∣ t ∧ (P.L j t).Prime)
      (fun d => ∀ i, d i ∣ P.L i t) (fun e => e ∣ P.L l t) P.omega S.coeff
  unfold PairSum
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, cnt, Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem packetOf_j (j l : Fin P.k) (x) : (P.packetOf j l x).j = j := rfl
theorem packetOf_l (j l : Fin P.k) (x) : (P.packetOf j l x).l = l := rfl
theorem packetOf_d (j l : Fin P.k) (x) : (P.packetOf j l x).d = x.1 := rfl
theorem packetOf_d' (j l : Fin P.k) (x) : (P.packetOf j l x).d' = x.2 := rfl

theorem pairCond_iff {j l : Fin P.k} {x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)}
    (hξ : P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x)) (e t : ℕ) :
    P.PairCond j l x e t ↔ (P.L j t).Prime ∧ (P.W ∣ t ∧
      (∀ i ∈ P.spec (P.packetOf j l x), P.q (P.packetOf j l x) i ∣ P.L i t) ∧
        e ∣ P.L l t) := by
  obtain ⟨-, h1, h2, h3, h4, -⟩ := hξ
  simp only [packetOf_j, packetOf_l, packetOf_d, packetOf_d'] at h1 h2 h3 h4
  unfold PairCond q spec
  simp only [packetOf_j, packetOf_l, packetOf_d, packetOf_d', Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Nat.lcm_dvd_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hW, hp⟩, hd, hd', he⟩
    exact ⟨hp, hW, fun i _ => ⟨hd i, hd' i⟩, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, hW, hd, he⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hW, hp⟩, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, he⟩
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; rw [h1]; exact one_dvd _
      by_cases hil : i = l
      · subst hil; rw [h3]; exact one_dvd _
      exact (hd i ⟨hij, hil⟩).1
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; rw [h2]; exact one_dvd _
      by_cases hil : i = l
      · subst hil; rw [h4]; exact one_dvd _
      exact (hd i ⟨hij, hil⟩).2

theorem L_injective (hP : P.WGood) (j : Fin P.k) : Function.Injective (P.L j) := by
  intro s t h
  unfold L at h
  have : P.a j * s = P.a j * t := by omega
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (hP.a_pos j) this

/-- `t ∈ Tset ↔ L_j(t) ∈ 𝒥_j(X)` (for `a_j > 0`). -/
theorem mem_Tset_iff (hP : P.WGood) (j : Fin P.k) (t : ℕ) :
    t ∈ P.Tset ↔ P.InJ j (P.L j t) := by
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < P.a j := by exact_mod_cast hP.a_pos j
  unfold Tset InJ L
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  push_cast
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h1' : P.c1 * P.X < t := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith
    have h2' : (t : ℝ) < P.c2 * P.X := by
      by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; nlinarith
    refine ⟨?_, h1', h2'⟩
    have : t ≤ P.tMax := by
      unfold tMax
      exact_mod_cast (show (t : ℝ) ≤ ⌈P.c2 * P.X⌉₊ from h2'.le.trans (Nat.le_ceil _))
    omega

/-- **Counting identity**: for an admissible packet and an admissible scalar divisor, the
number of physical `t` equals the prime count `P_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`. -/
theorem cnt_eq (hP : P.WGood) {j l : Fin P.k} {x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)}
    (hξ : P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x)) {e : ℕ} (he0 : 0 < e) (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W)
    (hfe : Nat.Coprime (P.f (P.packetOf j l x)) e) :
    P.cnt j l x e =
      P.Pcount j (P.f (P.packetOf j l x) * e) (P.bRes (P.packetOf j l x) e) := by
  classical
  have key := packet_congruence_iff hP hξ he0 heW hfe
  unfold cnt Pcount
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (L_injective hP j)]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨ht, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [pairCond_iff hξ] at hc
    obtain ⟨hp, hcong⟩ := hc
    have hcong' := (key t).1 hcong
    have hJ := (mem_Tset_iff hP j t).1 ht
    refine ⟨?_, hp, hJ, hcong'⟩
    have h2 := hJ.2
    have : (P.L j t : ℝ) ≤ ⌈(P.a j : ℝ) * P.c2 * P.X⌉₊ + 1 := by
      have := Nat.le_ceil ((P.a j : ℝ) * P.c2 * P.X); linarith
    unfold pMax
    exact_mod_cast (show (P.L j t : ℝ) < (⌈(P.a j : ℝ) * P.c2 * P.X⌉₊ + 2 : ℕ) by
      push_cast; linarith)
  · rintro ⟨-, hp, hJ, hcong⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hiffb⟩ := bRes_spec hP hξ he0 heW hfe
    have h1 := ((hiffb p).2 hcong).1
    have h2 := ((cRes_spec hP hξ).2 p).2 h1
    have h3 : (p : ℤ) ≡ 1 [ZMOD (P.a j : ℕ)] :=
      Int.ModEq.of_dvd (by exact_mod_cast Dvd.intro _ rfl) h2.1
    have h4 : P.a j ∣ p - 1 := by
      have := (Int.ModEq.dvd h3.symm)
      have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := hp.one_lt.le
      have : ((P.a j : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast [hp1]; exact this
      exact_mod_cast this
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h4
    have hLt : P.L j t = p := by
      unfold L; have := hp.one_lt; rw [← ht]; omega
    refine ⟨t, ⟨(mem_Tset_iff hP j t).2 (hLt ▸ hJ), ?_⟩, hLt⟩
    rw [pairCond_iff hξ]
    refine ⟨hLt ▸ hp, (key t).2 ?_⟩
    have : ((P.L (P.packetOf j l x).j t : ℕ) : ℤ) = p := by
      show ((P.L j t : ℕ) : ℤ) = p; rw [hLt]
    rw [this]; exact hcong

/-- A scalar divisor sharing a prime with `f_ξ` admits no physical `t`. -/
theorem cnt_zero_of_not_coprime (hP : P.WGood) {j l : Fin P.k}
    {x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)} (hξ : P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x)) {e : ℕ}
    (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (hnc : ¬ Nat.Coprime (P.f (P.packetOf j l x)) e) :
    P.cnt j l x e = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold cnt
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
  intro t _ hc
  rw [pairCond_iff hξ] at hc
  obtain ⟨-, hW, hq, he⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpf, hpe⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.1 hnc
  have hpW : ¬ p ∣ P.W := by
    intro h
    have := Nat.dvd_gcd hpe h
    rw [heW] at this
    exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp this)
  unfold f q0 at hpf
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 hpf with h1 | h1
  · rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 h1 with h2 | h2
    · exact hpW (hP.slope _ p hp h2)
    · exact hpW h2
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).1 h1
    have hil : i ≠ l := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2.2
    exact hP.no_common_prime heW hil hp hpe t (hpi.trans (hq i hi)) (hpe.trans he)

/-- `ω_d = 0` when some entry is not coprime to `W`. -/
theorem omega_eq_zero {d : Fin P.k → ℕ} {i : Fin P.k} (h : ¬ Nat.Coprime (d i) P.W) :
    P.omega d = 0 := by
  unfold omega
  rw [if_neg]
  intro hc
  exact h (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)) hc)

/-- Off the admissible support every term of the expanded pair sum vanishes. -/
theorem term_zero_of_not_admissible (hP : P.WGood) {j l : Fin P.k} (hjl : j < l)
    {x : (Fin P.k → ℕ) × (Fin P.k → ℕ)} (hx : x ∈ P.Dvec j l ×ˢ P.Dvec j l)
    (hna : ¬ P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x)) (e : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    P.omega x.1 * P.omega x.2 * c * (P.cnt j l x e : ℝ) = 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [Dvec, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset,
    Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hb1, h1j, h1l⟩, ⟨hb2, h2j, h2l⟩⟩ := hx
  by_cases hc : ∀ i, Nat.Coprime (x.1 i) P.W ∧ Nat.Coprime (x.2 i) P.W
  · -- the spectator `q_i` are not pairwise coprime: no physical `t`
    have hnpw : ¬ (P.spec (P.packetOf j l x) : Set (Fin P.k)).Pairwise
        (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime (P.q (P.packetOf j l x))) := by
      intro hpw
      exact hna ⟨hjl, h1j, h2j, h1l, h2l, fun i => ⟨(hb1 i).1, (hb2 i).1⟩, hc, hpw⟩
    have hzero : P.cnt j l x e = 0 := by
      unfold cnt
      rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
      intro t _ hct
      apply hnpw
      intro i _ i' _ hii'
      by_contra hnc
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpi, hpi'⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.1 hnc
      have hqW : Nat.Coprime (P.q (P.packetOf j l x) i) P.W :=
        Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul _ _)
          (Nat.Coprime.mul_left (hc i).1 (hc i).2)
      have hdi : ∀ m, P.q (P.packetOf j l x) m ∣ P.L m t := fun m =>
        Nat.lcm_dvd (hct.2.1 m) (hct.2.2.1 m)
      exact hP.no_common_prime hqW hii' hp hpi t (hpi.trans (hdi i)) (hpi'.trans (hdi i'))
    rw [hzero]; simp
  · push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hc
    by_cases h1 : Nat.Coprime (x.1 i) P.W
    · rw [omega_eq_zero (hi h1)]; simp
    · rw [omega_eq_zero h1]; simp

/-- **The exact pair-indexing identity** (§12): the literal designated-pair term of the
Maynard square equals the labelled packet sum
`∑_{ξ ∈ Ξ_{jℓ}} Γ_ξ ∑_{d ∈ supp ℓ_X, (d,f_ξ)=1} ℓ_X(d) P_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})`.
The designated coordinate is `j = j(ξ)`; there is no additional unrestricted `j`-sum. -/
theorem pairSum_eq_packets (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W)
    {j l : Fin P.k} (hjl : j < l) : P.PairSum S j l = P.PairPackets S j l := by
  classical
  rw [pairSum_expand, PairPackets, Xi, Finset.sum_map]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := fun x => P.Admissible (P.packetOf j l x))]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hξ := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2
    rw [Gamma, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f (P.packetOf j l x)) e)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e he => ?_)
      obtain ⟨heS, hfe⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 he
      rw [cnt_eq hP hξ (hS e heS).1 (hS e heS).2 hfe]
      simp only [packetOf_d, packetOf_d', packetOf_j]
      ring
    · intro e he hne
      by_contra hnc
      exact hne (by rw [cnt_zero_of_not_coprime hP hξ (hS e he).2 hnc]; simp)
  · intro x hx hne
    by_contra hna
    exact hne (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e _ =>
      term_zero_of_not_admissible hP hjl hx hna e (S.coeff e)))

/-- `PairSum = PairMain + PairRem`. -/
theorem pairSum_eq_main_add_rem (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W)
    {j l : Fin P.k} (hjl : j < l) :
    P.PairSum S j l = P.PairMain S j l + P.PairRem S j l := by
  rw [pairSum_eq_packets hP S hS hjl, pairPackets_eq_main_add_rem]

end PhysData

end Erdos287.Physical

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4510 sha256=4a4511d5c96678ca98c6dac319d1318af824bf0d822afc595abf5cfc26c5fe5b path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Presieve.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.PairIdentity

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: the presieve `W = ∏_{p ≤ log log log X} p` and truncation

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  `sources/physical_spec.md` §6.

* `physW X = primorial ⌊log log log X⌋` — the actual presieve modulus `W`.
* `wgood_eventually` — for fixed positive, pairwise distinct slopes, the presieve hypotheses
  `PhysData.WGood` hold with `W = physW X` for all sufficiently large `X` ("all prime divisors of
  the fixed slopes and their non-zero differences eventually divide `W`").  This discharges the
  hypothesis `hP` of every packet theorem at the physical `W`.
* `maynardInner_eq_divisors` — the divisor-vector range used in `MaynardInner` is lossless:
  it equals the sum over all `d` with `d_i ∣ L_i(t)` (`d_j = d_ℓ = 1`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

/-- **The physical presieve modulus** `W = ∏_{p ≤ w} p`, `w = log log log X`. -/
noncomputable def physW (X : ℝ) : ℕ := primorial ⌊Real.log (Real.log (Real.log X))⌋₊

theorem dvd_physW {X : ℝ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hle : (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.log (Real.log X))) : p ∣ physW X := by
  unfold physW primorial
  apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_floor hle), hp⟩

theorem le_logLogLog (B : ℝ) :
    ∀ X ≥ Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp B)), B ≤ Real.log (Real.log (Real.log X)) := by
  intro X hX
  have h1 : Real.exp (Real.exp B) ≤ Real.log X := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hX)]; exact hX
  have h2 : Real.exp B ≤ Real.log (Real.log X) := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) h1)]; exact h1
  rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) h2)]; exact h2

/-- **Eventual presieve property**: for positive, pairwise distinct slopes, `W = physW X`
satisfies `WGood` for every `X ≥ exp(exp(exp(∑ a_i)))`. -/
theorem wgood_eventually (P : PhysData) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < P.a i) (hinj : Function.Injective P.a) :
    ∃ X0 : ℝ, ∀ X ≥ X0, ({ P with W := physW X } : PhysData).WGood := by
  set B : ℕ := ∑ i, P.a i
  refine ⟨Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp B)), fun X hX => ?_⟩
  have hB := le_logLogLog (B : ℝ) X hX
  have hle : ∀ i, P.a i ≤ B := fun i =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  refine ⟨ha, primorial_pos _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i p hp hpi
    apply dvd_physW hp
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (ha i) hpi
    have : (p : ℝ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast this.trans (hle i)
    linarith
  · intro i i' hii p hp hpd
    apply dvd_physW hp
    have hne : (P.a i : ℤ) - P.a i' ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hii; apply hinj; exact_mod_cast (sub_eq_zero.1 h)
    have h1 : p ∣ ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a i').natAbs := Int.natCast_dvd.mp hpd
    have h2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hne) h1
    have h3 : ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a i').natAbs ≤ B := by
      have := hle i; have := hle i'; omega
    have : (p : ℝ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast h2.trans h3
    linarith

namespace PhysData

variable {P : PhysData}

/-- The truncation `d_i ≤ Dmax` in `MaynardInner` is lossless. -/
theorem maynardInner_eq_divisors (j l : Fin P.k) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ∈ P.Tset) :
    P.MaynardInner j l t = ∑ d ∈ (Fintype.piFinset fun i => (P.L i t).divisors).filter
      (fun d => d j = 1 ∧ d l = 1), P.omega d := by
  classical
  unfold MaynardInner
  have htm : t ≤ P.tMax := by
    have := (Finset.mem_filter.1 ht).1; rw [Finset.mem_range] at this; omega
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  ext d
  simp only [Dvec, Finset.mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.mem_divisors]
  have hL0 : ∀ i, P.L i t ≠ 0 := fun i => by unfold L; omega
  have hLle : ∀ i, P.L i t ≤ P.Dmax := by
    intro i
    unfold L Dmax
    have h1 : P.a i ≤ ∑ i, P.a i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul h1 htm
    omega
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, hj, hl⟩, hd⟩
    exact ⟨fun i => ⟨hd i, hL0 i⟩, hj, hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hj, hl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨fun i => ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hL0 i (by
      have := (hd i).1; rw [h] at this; exact zero_dvd_iff.1 this)), (Nat.le_of_dvd
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (hL0 i)) (hd i).1).trans (hLle i)⟩, hj, hl⟩, fun i => (hd i).1⟩

end PhysData

end Erdos287.Physical

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3341 sha256=612eca59b4176a927c4ad9da0e77e91e47f0bbb966cca0f2efcec6e7725d918d path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Profile.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.FourierPoisson

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: an explicit admissible smooth plateau `Ψ` (§24)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  `sources/physical_spec.md` §24 allows a
new explicit witness for the Ordering-B profile:

`η(t) = e^{-1/t} (t > 0)`, `θ(t) = η(t)/(η(t) + η(1-t))`, `Ψ(u) = θ(4u-2) θ(10-4u)`.

Mathlib's `Real.smoothTransition` is exactly `θ`.  Kernel-proved:

* `physPsi_contDiff` — `Ψ` is `C^∞`;
* `physPsi_nonneg`, `physPsi_le_one` — `0 ≤ Ψ ≤ 1`;
* `physPsi_eq_one` — `Ψ = 1` on `[3/4, 9/4]`, hence the plateau `physPsi_plateau`:
  `Ψ(u) ≥ 1` for `1 ≤ u ≤ 2`;
* `physPsi_support`, `physPsi_hasCompactSupport` — `supp Ψ ⊆ [1/2, 5/2]`.

No normalisation `∫Ψ = 1` is asserted.  `physPsiHat ξ = ∫ Ψ(u) e(-ξu) du` is the Fourier
transform in the convention of §26, and `physPF = PF physPsiHat` is the literal nonzero-mode
Poisson remainder `𝒫_M(q,ρ)` of the existing `FourierPoisson` layer, now with an actual profile.
The Poisson summation identity for this profile is NOT proved here.
-/

open Real

namespace Erdos287.Physical

/-- **The explicit Ordering-B profile** `Ψ(u) = θ(4u-2) θ(10-4u)`. -/
noncomputable def physPsi (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  smoothTransition (4 * u - 2) * smoothTransition (10 - 4 * u)

theorem physPsi_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) physPsi := by
  unfold physPsi
  apply ContDiff.mul
  · exact smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (by fun_prop)
  · exact smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (by fun_prop)

theorem physPsi_nonneg (u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ physPsi u :=
  mul_nonneg (smoothTransition.nonneg _) (smoothTransition.nonneg _)

theorem physPsi_le_one (u : ℝ) : physPsi u ≤ 1 :=
  mul_le_one₀ (smoothTransition.le_one _) (smoothTransition.nonneg _)
    (smoothTransition.le_one _)

theorem physPsi_eq_one {u : ℝ} (h1 : 3 / 4 ≤ u) (h2 : u ≤ 9 / 4) : physPsi u = 1 := by
  unfold physPsi
  rw [smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith), smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith),
    mul_one]

/-- **The required plateau** `Ψ(u) ≥ 1` on `[1, 2]`. -/
theorem physPsi_plateau {u : ℝ} (h1 : 1 ≤ u) (h2 : u ≤ 2) : 1 ≤ physPsi u :=
  (physPsi_eq_one (by linarith) (by linarith)).ge

theorem physPsi_eq_zero {u : ℝ} (h : u ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 5 / 2 ≤ u) : physPsi u = 0 := by
  unfold physPsi
  rcases h with h | h
  · rw [smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_mul]
  · rw [smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (show 10 - 4 * u ≤ 0 by linarith), mul_zero]

theorem physPsi_support : Function.support physPsi ⊆ Set.Icc (1 / 2) (5 / 2) := by
  intro u hu
  by_contra h
  simp only [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at h
  exact hu (physPsi_eq_zero (h.elim (fun h => Or.inl h.le) (fun h => Or.inr h.le)))

theorem physPsi_hasCompactSupport : HasCompactSupport physPsi :=
  HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact isCompact_Icc physPsi_support

/-- `Ψ̂(ξ) = ∫ Ψ(u) e(-ξu) du` (§26 convention). -/
noncomputable def physPsiHat (ξ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ u : ℝ, (physPsi u : ℂ) * Erdos287.SourceChain.eR (-(ξ * u))

/-- The literal nonzero-mode Poisson remainder `𝒫_M(q,ρ)` with the explicit profile. -/
noncomputable def physPF (M q : ℝ) (ρ : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  Erdos287.SourceChain.PF physPsiHat M q ρ

end Erdos287.Physical

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10298 sha256=91e38c1c0e2b8e959d9e57647ef395773f2225e0371518847a8dcea63f6eddad path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Remainder.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.PairIdentity
import RequestProject.Erdos287.CurrentTail.ExactSource

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: the literal remainder `R_Σ^P`, pair indexing and adapter

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  `sources/physical_spec.md` §12, §21.

* `RSigmaP S = ∑_{j<ℓ} ∑_{ξ ∈ Ξ_{jℓ}} Γ_ξ ∑_{d, (d,f_ξ)=1} ℓ_X(d) E_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d})` — the
  literal physical prime remainder (prime counts, scalar coefficient `ℓ_X` a parameter).
* `RSigmaP_eq_packetIndexed` — **exact pair-indexing identity**: the same sum written over the
  single labelled packet set `Ξ = ⋃_{j<ℓ} Ξ_{jℓ}` with designated coordinate `j = j(ξ)`.
* `pairTotal_eq_main_add_RSigmaP` — `∑_{j<ℓ} PairSum = Main + R_Σ^P` (exact).
* `RSigmaP_eq_rel_add_base` — `R_Σ^P = R_rel + R_base` on the same packet and scalar support
  (§21, from the already-proved `v99_relative_centering`).
* `packetTensor` / `RSigmaP_eq_sum_packetTensor` — **proved adapter** to the existing generic
  `Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource`: one single-packet tensor source per labelled packet
  (with `ell = 1`, `α_0 = 1_{prime} 1_{𝒥_{j(ξ)}}`, scalar support restricted to `(d,f_ξ)=1`),
  and `R_Σ^P = ∑_{ξ ∈ Ξ} (packetTensor ξ).RSigmaP`.  The generic tensor's `j`-sum is the
  trivial one-element sum, so no unrestricted `j`-sum is introduced.
* `pcount_eq_progSum`, `eerr_eq_progErr` — the prime count is the generic `progSum` of the
  prime indicator of the window.

A single global `TensorSource` cannot carry `R_Σ^P`: its scalar support must be coprime to
*every* `f_ξ` and its sequences `α_j` cannot depend on `ξ`.  This is why the adapter is
packet-wise.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

namespace PhysData

variable (P : PhysData)

/-- Designated pairs `j < ℓ`. -/
def pairs : Finset (Fin P.k × Fin P.k) := (univ ×ˢ univ).filter (fun p => p.1 < p.2)

open Classical in
/-- **`Ξ`**: all labelled admissible packets, `Ξ = ⋃_{j<ℓ} Ξ_{jℓ}`. -/
noncomputable def XiAll : Finset (Packet P.k) := (P.pairs).biUnion (fun p => P.Xi p.1 p.2)

/-- **The literal physical prime remainder `R_Σ^P`** (§12). -/
noncomputable def RSigmaP (S : ScalarSieve) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ P.pairs, P.PairRem S p.1 p.2

/-- Total main term `∑_{j<ℓ} PairMain`. -/
noncomputable def MainTotal (S : ScalarSieve) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ P.pairs, P.PairMain S p.1 p.2

/-- Total literal pair moment `∑_{j<ℓ} PairSum`. -/
noncomputable def PairTotal (S : ScalarSieve) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ P.pairs, P.PairSum S p.1 p.2

open Classical in
/-- Relative part `∑_ξ Γ_ξ ∑_d ℓ_X(d) [P_j(f_ξ d, b_{ξ,d}) - P_j(f_ξ, c_ξ)/φ(d)]`. -/
noncomputable def Rrel (S : ScalarSieve) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ξ ∈ P.XiAll, P.Gamma ξ * ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
    S.coeff e * ((P.Pcount ξ.j (P.f ξ * e) (P.bRes ξ e) : ℝ) -
      (P.Pcount ξ.j (P.f ξ) (P.cRes ξ) : ℝ) / (Nat.totient e : ℝ))

open Classical in
/-- Base part `∑_ξ Γ_ξ ∑_d ℓ_X(d) E_j(f_ξ, c_ξ)/φ(d)` (paid by ordinary BV; not zero). -/
noncomputable def Rbase (S : ScalarSieve) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ξ ∈ P.XiAll, P.Gamma ξ * ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
    S.coeff e * (P.Eerr ξ.j (P.f ξ) (P.cRes ξ) / (Nat.totient e : ℝ))

variable {P}

theorem mem_Xi {j l : Fin P.k} {ξ : Packet P.k} (h : ξ ∈ P.Xi j l) :
    ξ.j = j ∧ ξ.l = l ∧ P.Admissible ξ := by
  classical
  unfold Xi at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.1 h
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2⟩

theorem mem_XiAll {ξ : Packet P.k} (h : ξ ∈ P.XiAll) : P.Admissible ξ := by
  classical
  unfold XiAll at h
  obtain ⟨p, -, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 h
  exact (mem_Xi hp).2.2

/-- **Exact pair-indexing identity**: `R_Σ^P` is the sum over the labelled packet set `Ξ`
with designated coordinate `j(ξ)` — no extra unrestricted `j`-sum. -/
theorem RSigmaP_eq_packetIndexed (S : ScalarSieve) :
    P.RSigmaP S = ∑ ξ ∈ P.XiAll, P.Gamma ξ *
      ∑ e ∈ S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e),
        S.coeff e * P.Eerr ξ.j (P.f ξ * e) (P.bRes ξ e) := by
  classical
  unfold RSigmaP XiAll PairRem
  rw [Finset.sum_biUnion]
  intro p _ p' _ hne
  refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 (fun ξ h1 h2 => hne ?_)
  obtain ⟨a1, b1, -⟩ := mem_Xi h1
  obtain ⟨a2, b2, -⟩ := mem_Xi h2
  exact Prod.ext (a1.symm.trans a2) (b1.symm.trans b2)

/-- **`∑_{j<ℓ} PairSum = Main + R_Σ^P`** (exact, from the pair identity). -/
theorem pairTotal_eq_main_add_RSigmaP (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W) :
    P.PairTotal S = P.MainTotal S + P.RSigmaP S := by
  unfold PairTotal MainTotal RSigmaP
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => ?_)
  exact pairSum_eq_main_add_rem hP S hS (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2

/-- **`R_Σ^P = R_rel + R_base`** (§21), on the same packet and scalar-divisor support. -/
theorem RSigmaP_eq_rel_add_base (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W) :
    P.RSigmaP S = P.Rrel S + P.Rbase S := by
  classical
  rw [RSigmaP_eq_packetIndexed, Rrel, Rbase, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
  rw [← mul_add, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e he => ?_)
  obtain ⟨heS, hfe⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 he
  have hf := f_pos hP (mem_XiAll hξ)
  have he0 := (hS e heS).1
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient (P.f ξ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hf
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient e := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 he0
  unfold Eerr
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hfe, Nat.cast_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

/-! ### Adapter to the generic `TensorSource` -/

open Classical in
/-- The prime indicator of the window `𝒥_j(X)`. -/
noncomputable def primeWindow (P : PhysData) (j : Fin P.k) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n.Prime ∧ P.InJ j n then 1 else 0

/-- `P_j(q,b)` is the generic `progSum` of the prime indicator of the window. -/
theorem pcount_eq_progSum (j : Fin P.k) (q b : ℕ) :
    (P.Pcount j q b : ℝ) =
      Erdos287.CurrentTail.progSum (range (P.pMax j)) (P.primeWindow j) q b := by
  classical
  unfold Pcount Erdos287.CurrentTail.progSum primeWindow
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.card_filter]
  push_cast
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
  by_cases h1 : n ≡ b [MOD q]
  · have h1' : (n : ℤ) ≡ b [ZMOD q] := (Int.natCast_modEq_iff).2 h1
    by_cases h2 : n.Prime ∧ P.InJ j n
    · simp [h1, h1', h2]
    · simp only [h1, h1', h2, if_true, and_true]
  · have h1' : ¬ (n : ℤ) ≡ b [ZMOD q] := fun h => h1 ((Int.natCast_modEq_iff).1 h)
    simp [h1, h1']

/-- `E_j(q,b)` is the generic `progErr` with main mass `V_j(X)`. -/
theorem eerr_eq_progErr (j : Fin P.k) (q b : ℕ) :
    P.Eerr j q b =
      Erdos287.CurrentTail.progErr (range (P.pMax j)) (P.primeWindow j) (P.Vmain j) q b := by
  unfold Eerr Erdos287.CurrentTail.progErr
  rw [pcount_eq_progSum]

open Classical in
/-- **Single-packet tensor source** for the labelled packet `ξ`: `ell = 1`, packet set `{ξ}`,
scalar support `{d ∈ supp ℓ_X : d > 0, (d, f_ξ) = 1}`, sequence `α_0` the prime indicator of
`𝒥_{j(ξ)}(X)`, main mass `V_{j(ξ)}(X)`. -/
noncomputable def packetTensor (P : PhysData) (S : ScalarSieve) (ξ : Packet P.k) :
    Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource (Packet P.k) where
  ell := 1
  Xi := ({ξ} : Finset (Packet P.k)).filter (fun ξ' => 0 < P.f ξ')
  Γ := P.Gamma
  f := P.f
  c := P.cRes
  D := S.supp.filter (fun e => 0 < e ∧ Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e)
  lX := S.coeff
  b := P.bRes
  S := range (P.pMax ξ.j)
  α := fun _ => P.primeWindow ξ.j
  mass := fun _ => P.Vmain ξ.j
  f_pos := fun ξ' h => (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).2
  d_pos := fun e h => (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).2.1
  coprime := by
    intro ξ' h e he
    have := Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).1
    subst this
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 he).2.2

/-- **Proved adapter**: `R_Σ^P = ∑_{ξ ∈ Ξ} (packetTensor ξ).RSigmaP`. -/
theorem RSigmaP_eq_sum_packetTensor (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W) :
    P.RSigmaP S = ∑ ξ ∈ P.XiAll, (packetTensor P S ξ).RSigmaP := by
  classical
  rw [RSigmaP_eq_packetIndexed]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
  have hf := f_pos hP (mem_XiAll hξ)
  unfold Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource.RSigmaP packetTensor
  simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton]
  rw [Finset.filter_singleton, if_pos hf, Finset.sum_singleton]
  congr 1
  have hD : S.supp.filter (fun e => 0 < e ∧ Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) =
      S.supp.filter (fun e => Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) := by
    ext e
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, (hS e h.1).1, h.2⟩⟩
  rw [hD]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
  rw [eerr_eq_progErr]

/-- Centering through the adapter: `R_Σ^P = ∑_ξ (R_rel(ξ) + R_paid(ξ))` with the generic
`TensorSource.Rrel`/`Rpaid` of each single-packet source. -/
theorem RSigmaP_eq_sum_rel_paid (hP : P.WGood) (S : ScalarSieve) (hS : S.Good P.W) :
    P.RSigmaP S = ∑ ξ ∈ P.XiAll, ((packetTensor P S ξ).Rrel + (packetTensor P S ξ).Rpaid) := by
  rw [RSigmaP_eq_sum_packetTensor hP S hS]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ξ _ => (packetTensor P S ξ).RSigmaP_eq_Rrel_add_Rpaid)

end PhysData

end Erdos287.Physical

namespace Erdos287.Physical

/-- **Regression (why the naive instantiation is wrong).**  If a generic tensor source has
`j`-independent sequences and masses, its unrestricted `j`-sum multiplies the single-coordinate
remainder by `ell`: the generic `RSigmaP` with `ell = k` would count each labelled packet `k`
times.  The physical packets already carry their designated `j(ξ)`. -/
theorem generic_unrestricted_j_overcounts {ι : Type*} (T : Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource ι)
    (hα : ∀ j, T.α j = T.α 0) (hm : ∀ j, T.mass j = T.mass 0) :
    T.RSigmaP = T.ell * ({ T with ell := 1 } : Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource ι).RSigmaP := by
  unfold Erdos287.CurrentTail.TensorSource.RSigmaP
  simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hα j, hm j]), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range,
    nsmul_eq_mul]

end Erdos287.Physical

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Packet

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: residues `c_ξ`, `b_{ξ,d}` and the physical prime congruences

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Kernel-proved source identities of
`sources/physical_spec.md` §§9–10, under the explicit presieve hypotheses `PhysData.WGood`
and the admissible support `PhysData.Admissible`:

* `cRes_spec`, `cRes_unique`, `cRes_unit` — `c_ξ` is the unique CRT solution mod `f_ξ` of
  `p ≡ 1 (mod a_j W)`, `p ≡ 1 - a_j a_i⁻¹ (mod q_i)`, and `(c_ξ, f_ξ) = 1`;
* `AB_coprime` — `(A_{jℓ}, B_{jℓ}) = 1` (proved, *not* assumed);
* `g_coprime` — `(g_{jℓ}, d) = 1` for `(d, W) = 1`;
* `reduce_iff` — `a_ℓ p ≡ a_ℓ - a_j (mod d) ↔ A_{jℓ} p ≡ B_{jℓ} (mod d)`;
* `bRes_spec`, `bRes_unique`, `bRes_unit` — existence, uniqueness and unit status of
  `b_{ξ,d}` mod `f_ξ d`;
* `base_iff`, `spectator_iff`, `scalar_iff` — for `p = L_j(t) = a_j t + 1`:
  `W ∣ t ↔ p ≡ 1 (mod a_j W)`, `q_i ∣ L_i(t) ↔ p ≡ 1 - a_j a_i⁻¹ (mod q_i)`,
  `d ∣ L_ℓ(t) ↔ A_{jℓ} p ≡ B_{jℓ} (mod d)`;
* `packet_congruence_iff` — **all packet divisibility conditions on `t` together are
  equivalent to the single congruence `L_j(t) ≡ b_{ξ,d} (mod f_ξ d)`.**

No inverse is used without a proved coprimality: every `a⁻¹` is the explicit Bézout
coefficient `Nat.gcdA` and its validity is `gcdA_inv`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

/-- General form of the inverse lemma: for `(a, m) = 1`, `a x ≡ y ↔ x ≡ y a⁻¹ (mod m)`. -/
theorem mul_congr_iff_inv' {a m : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime a m) (x y : ℤ) :
    (a : ℤ) * x ≡ y [ZMOD m] ↔ x ≡ y * Nat.gcdA a m [ZMOD m] := by
  have hu := gcdA_inv h
  constructor
  · intro hx
    calc x = 1 * x := by ring
      _ ≡ (a * Nat.gcdA a m) * x [ZMOD m] := (hu.mul_right x).symm
      _ = Nat.gcdA a m * (a * x) := by ring
      _ ≡ Nat.gcdA a m * y [ZMOD m] := hx.mul_left _
      _ = y * Nat.gcdA a m := by ring
  · intro hx
    calc (a : ℤ) * x ≡ a * (y * Nat.gcdA a m) [ZMOD m] := hx.mul_left _
      _ = y * (a * Nat.gcdA a m) := by ring
      _ ≡ y * 1 [ZMOD m] := hu.mul_left _
      _ = y := by ring

namespace PhysData

variable {P : PhysData}

/-! ### Presieve consequences -/

theorem WGood.coprime_slope (hP : P.WGood) {n : ℕ} (hn : Nat.Coprime n P.W) (i : Fin P.k) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.a i) n := by
  apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
  intro p hp h1 h2
  have := Nat.dvd_gcd h2 (hP.slope i p hp h1)
  rw [hn] at this
  exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp this)

theorem WGood.not_dvd_diff (hP : P.WGood) {n : ℕ} (hn : Nat.Coprime n P.W) {i i' : Fin P.k}
    (hii : i ≠ i') {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (P.a i : ℤ) - P.a i' := by
  intro h
  have := Nat.dvd_gcd hpn (hP.diff i i' hii p hp h)
  rw [hn] at this
  exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.mp this)

/-- A prime coprime to `W` cannot divide two distinct affine forms at the same `t`. -/
theorem WGood.no_common_prime (hP : P.WGood) {n : ℕ} (hn : Nat.Coprime n P.W) {i i' : Fin P.k}
    (hii : i ≠ i') {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) (t : ℕ) (h1 : p ∣ P.L i t)
    (h2 : p ∣ P.L i' t) : False := by
  apply hP.not_dvd_diff hn (Ne.symm hii) hp hpn
  have e : (P.a i' : ℤ) - P.a i = P.a i' * (P.L i t : ℕ) - P.a i * (P.L i' t : ℕ) := by
    unfold L; push_cast; ring
  rw [e]
  exact dvd_sub (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h1) _)
    (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h2) _)

theorem q_coprime_W {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) (i : Fin P.k) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.q ξ i) P.W := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, hW, -⟩ := hξ
  exact Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul _ _)
    (Nat.Coprime.mul_left (hW i).1 (hW i).2)

theorem q_pos {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) (i : Fin P.k) : 0 < P.q ξ i := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hpos, -, -⟩ := hξ
  exact Nat.lcm_pos (hpos i).1 (hpos i).2

theorem q0_coprime_W {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) : Nat.Coprime (P.q0 ξ) P.W :=
  Nat.Coprime.prod_left (fun i _ => q_coprime_W hξ i)

theorem f_pos (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) : 0 < P.f ξ := by
  unfold f q0
  exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (hP.a_pos _) hP.W_pos)
    (Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => q_pos hξ i))

theorem aW_coprime_q (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) (i : Fin P.k) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.a ξ.j * P.W) (P.q ξ i) :=
  Nat.Coprime.mul_left (hP.coprime_slope (q_coprime_W hξ i) _) (q_coprime_W hξ i).symm

/-! ### `c_ξ` -/

/-- CRT existence for the `c_ξ` system. -/
theorem system_crt (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, c < P.f ξ ∧ ∀ x : ℤ, P.System ξ x ↔ x ≡ c [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] := by
  classical
  let s : Finset (Option (Fin P.k)) := insert none ((P.spec ξ).map Function.Embedding.some)
  let m : Option (Fin P.k) → ℕ := fun o => o.elim (P.a ξ.j * P.W) (P.q ξ)
  let r : Option (Fin P.k) → ℤ := fun o => o.elim 1 (P.specRes ξ)
  have hnone : none ∉ (P.spec ξ).map Function.Embedding.some := by simp
  have hprod : ∏ o ∈ s, m o = P.f ξ := by
    simp only [s, Finset.prod_insert hnone, Finset.prod_map]
    simp [m, f, q0, mul_assoc]
  have hpw := hξ.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hiff⟩ := crt_int s m r
    (by
      intro o ho
      rcases o with _ | i
      · exact Nat.mul_pos (hP.a_pos _) hP.W_pos
      · exact q_pos hξ i)
    (by
      intro o ho o' ho' hne
      simp only [s, Finset.coe_insert, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.coe_map, Set.mem_image,
        Finset.mem_coe] at ho ho'
      rcases o with _ | i <;> rcases o' with _ | i'
      · exact absurd rfl hne
      · exact aW_coprime_q hP hξ i'
      · exact (aW_coprime_q hP hξ i).symm
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := ho.resolve_left (by simp)
        obtain ⟨u', hv, hv'⟩ := ho'.resolve_left (by simp)
        simp only [Function.Embedding.some_apply, Option.some.injEq] at hu' hv'
        subst hu' hv'
        exact hpw hu hv (fun h => hne (by rw [h])))
  refine ⟨c, hprod ▸ hc, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [← hprod, ← hiff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ o ho
    simp only [s, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_map] at ho
    rcases ho with rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    · exact h1
    · exact h2 i hi
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h none (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _),
      fun i hi => h (some i) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_map_of_mem _ hi))⟩

/-- **`c_ξ` is the CRT residue**: `c_ξ < f_ξ` and the system is equivalent to
`x ≡ c_ξ (mod f_ξ)`. -/
theorem cRes_spec (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) :
    P.cRes ξ < P.f ξ ∧ ∀ x : ℤ, P.System ξ x ↔ x ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hiff⟩ := system_crt hP hξ
  have h : ∃ c, c < P.f ξ ∧ P.System ξ c := ⟨c, hc, (hiff c).2 (Int.ModEq.refl _)⟩
  have hdef : P.cRes ξ = Nat.find h := by unfold cRes; rw [dif_pos h]
  have hs := Nat.find_spec h
  rw [hdef]
  refine ⟨hs.1, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hcc : ((Nat.find h : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ c [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] := (hiff _).1 hs.2
  rw [hiff x]
  exact ⟨fun hx => hx.trans hcc.symm, fun hx => hx.trans hcc⟩

/-- Uniqueness of `c_ξ` in `[0, f_ξ)`. -/
theorem cRes_unique (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) {c' : ℕ}
    (hc' : c' < P.f ξ) (hs : P.System ξ c') : c' = P.cRes ξ := by
  obtain ⟨hlt, hiff⟩ := cRes_spec hP hξ
  exact Nat.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt ((Int.natCast_modEq_iff).mp ((hiff c').1 hs)) hc' hlt

/-- **`(c_ξ, f_ξ) = 1`.** -/
theorem cRes_unit (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.cRes ξ) (P.f ξ) := by
  obtain ⟨-, hiff⟩ := cRes_spec hP hξ
  have hsys := (hiff (P.cRes ξ)).2 (Int.ModEq.refl _)
  apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
  intro p hp hpc hpf
  have hpc' : (p : ℤ) ∣ (P.cRes ξ : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hpc
  unfold f q0 at hpf
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 hpf with h1 | h1
  · have h2 : ((P.a ξ.j * P.W : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ 1 - P.cRes ξ := hsys.1.dvd
    have h3 : (p : ℤ) ∣ 1 - P.cRes ξ := (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h1).trans h2
    have h4 : (p : ℤ) ∣ 1 := by simpa using dvd_add h3 hpc'
    exact hp.one_lt.ne' (by exact_mod_cast Int.eq_one_of_dvd_one (by positivity) h4)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).1 h1
    have hcop := q_coprime_W hξ i
    have hai : Nat.Coprime (P.a i) (P.q ξ i) := hP.coprime_slope hcop i
    have h2 := (mul_congr_iff_inv (a' := P.a ξ.j) hai (P.cRes ξ : ℤ)).2 (hsys.2 i hi)
    have h3 : ((P.q ξ i : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j) - P.a i * P.cRes ξ := h2.dvd
    have h4 : (p : ℤ) ∣ ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j) - P.a i * P.cRes ξ :=
      (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hpi).trans h3
    have h5 : (p : ℤ) ∣ (P.a i : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j := by
      have := dvd_add h4 (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hpc' (P.a i : ℤ))
      simpa using this
    have hij : i ≠ ξ.j := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2.1
    exact hP.not_dvd_diff hcop hij hp hpi h5

/-! ### The reduced pair `(A_{jℓ}, B_{jℓ})` -/

theorem g_pos (hP : P.WGood) (ξ : Packet P.k) : 0 < P.g ξ :=
  Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (hP.a_pos _)

/-- `a_ℓ = g_{jℓ} A_{jℓ}`. -/
theorem al_eq (ξ : Packet P.k) : (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) = P.g ξ * P.A ξ := by
  unfold A g
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).symm

/-- `a_ℓ - a_j = g_{jℓ} B_{jℓ}`. -/
theorem diff_eq (ξ : Packet P.k) : (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j = P.g ξ * P.B ξ := by
  unfold B
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel']
  unfold g
  exact dvd_sub (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))

/-- **`(A_{jℓ}, B_{jℓ}) = 1`** (proved from the definition; not assumed). -/
theorem AB_coprime (ξ : Packet P.k) (hpos : 0 < P.a ξ.j) :
    Int.gcd (P.A ξ : ℤ) (P.B ξ) = 1 := by
  have hg : 0 < P.g ξ := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hpos
  have h1 : Int.gcd ((P.g ξ : ℤ) * P.A ξ) ((P.g ξ : ℤ) * P.B ξ) =
      P.g ξ * Int.gcd (P.A ξ : ℤ) (P.B ξ) := by
    rw [Int.gcd_mul_left]; simp
  rw [← al_eq, ← diff_eq] at h1
  have h2 : Int.gcd (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) ((P.a ξ.l : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j) = P.g ξ := by
    rw [Int.gcd_self_sub_right]; unfold g; rw [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, Nat.gcd_comm]
  rw [h2] at h1
  have : P.g ξ * 1 = P.g ξ * Int.gcd (P.A ξ : ℤ) (P.B ξ) := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
  exact (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg this).symm

/-- **`(g_{jℓ}, d) = 1`** for a `W`-coprime scalar divisor `d`. -/
theorem g_coprime (hP : P.WGood) (ξ : Packet P.k) {e : ℕ} (he : Nat.Coprime e P.W) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.g ξ) e :=
  Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _) (hP.coprime_slope he ξ.j)

theorem A_coprime (hP : P.WGood) (ξ : Packet P.k) {e : ℕ} (he : Nat.Coprime e P.W) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.A ξ) e :=
  Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
    (hP.coprime_slope he ξ.l)

/-- **Reduced scalar congruence** (§10): for `(d, W) = 1`,
`a_ℓ x ≡ a_ℓ - a_j (mod d) ↔ A_{jℓ} x ≡ B_{jℓ} (mod d)`. -/
theorem reduce_iff (hP : P.WGood) (ξ : Packet P.k) {e : ℕ} (he : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (x : ℤ) :
    (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) * x ≡ (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j [ZMOD e] ↔
      (P.A ξ : ℤ) * x ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD e] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd, Int.modEq_iff_dvd, diff_eq, al_eq]
  have : (P.g ξ : ℤ) * P.B ξ - P.g ξ * P.A ξ * x = P.g ξ * (P.B ξ - P.A ξ * x) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact dvd_mul_cancel_coprime (g_coprime hP ξ he) _

/-! ### `b_{ξ,d}` -/

/-- **`b_{ξ,d}` is the CRT residue mod `f_ξ d`.** -/
theorem bRes_spec (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) {e : ℕ} (he0 : 0 < e)
    (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (hfe : Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) :
    P.bRes ξ e < P.f ξ * e ∧ ∀ x : ℤ,
      (x ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] ∧ (P.A ξ : ℤ) * x ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)]) ↔
        x ≡ P.bRes ξ e [ZMOD (P.f ξ * e : ℕ)] := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, hiff0⟩ := crt_two (f_pos hP hξ) he0 hfe (P.cRes ξ)
    (P.B ξ * Nat.gcdA (P.A ξ) e)
  have hiff : ∀ x : ℤ, (x ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] ∧
      (P.A ξ : ℤ) * x ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)]) ↔ x ≡ b0 [ZMOD (P.f ξ * e : ℕ)] := by
    intro x
    rw [← hiff0, mul_congr_iff_inv' (A_coprime hP ξ heW)]
  have h : ∃ b, b < P.f ξ * e ∧ (b : ℤ) ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)] ∧
      (P.A ξ : ℤ) * b ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)] := ⟨b0, hb0, (hiff b0).2 (Int.ModEq.refl _)⟩
  have hdef : P.bRes ξ e = Nat.find h := by unfold bRes; rw [dif_pos h]
  have hs := Nat.find_spec h
  rw [hdef]
  refine ⟨hs.1, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hbb : ((Nat.find h : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ b0 [ZMOD (P.f ξ * e : ℕ)] := (hiff _).1 hs.2
  rw [hiff x]
  exact ⟨fun hx => hx.trans hbb.symm, fun hx => hx.trans hbb⟩

/-- Uniqueness of `b_{ξ,d}` in `[0, f_ξ d)`. -/
theorem bRes_unique (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) {e : ℕ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (hfe : Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) {b' : ℕ}
    (hb' : b' < P.f ξ * e) (h1 : (b' : ℤ) ≡ P.cRes ξ [ZMOD (P.f ξ : ℕ)])
    (h2 : (P.A ξ : ℤ) * b' ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)]) : b' = P.bRes ξ e := by
  obtain ⟨hlt, hiff⟩ := bRes_spec hP hξ he0 heW hfe
  exact Nat.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt ((Int.natCast_modEq_iff).mp ((hiff b').1 ⟨h1, h2⟩)) hb' hlt

/-- **`(b_{ξ,d}, f_ξ d) = 1`.** -/
theorem bRes_unit (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) {e : ℕ} (he0 : 0 < e)
    (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (hfe : Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) :
    Nat.Coprime (P.bRes ξ e) (P.f ξ * e) := by
  obtain ⟨-, hiff⟩ := bRes_spec hP hξ he0 heW hfe
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hiff (P.bRes ξ e)).2 (Int.ModEq.refl _)
  apply Nat.Coprime.mul_right
  · have := ((Int.natCast_modEq_iff).mp h1).gcd_eq
    rw [Nat.Coprime, this]; exact cRes_unit hP hξ
  · apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
    intro p hp hpb hpe
    have h3 : ((e : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ P.B ξ - P.A ξ * P.bRes ξ e := h2.dvd
    have h4 : (p : ℤ) ∣ P.B ξ - P.A ξ * P.bRes ξ e :=
      (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hpe).trans h3
    have h5 : (p : ℤ) ∣ P.B ξ := by
      have := dvd_add h4 (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hpb) (P.A ξ : ℤ))
      simpa using this
    have h6 : (p : ℤ) ∣ (P.a ξ.l : ℤ) - P.a ξ.j := by
      rw [diff_eq]; exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left h5 _
    exact hP.not_dvd_diff heW (ne_of_gt hξ.1) hp hpe h6

/-! ### The physical prime `p = L_j(t)` and its congruences (§9) -/

/-- The key affine identity `a_i L_j(t) - (a_i - a_j) = a_j L_i(t)`. -/
theorem affine_shift (i j : Fin P.k) (t : ℕ) :
    (P.a i : ℤ) * (P.L j t : ℕ) - ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a j) = P.a j * (P.L i t : ℕ) := by
  unfold L; push_cast; ring

/-- For a modulus `m` coprime to `a_j`: `m ∣ L_i(t) ↔ a_i L_j(t) ≡ a_i - a_j (mod m)`. -/
theorem dvd_form_iff {m : ℕ} (i j : Fin P.k) (hm : Nat.Coprime (P.a j) m) (t : ℕ) :
    m ∣ P.L i t ↔ (P.a i : ℤ) * (P.L j t : ℕ) ≡ (P.a i : ℤ) - P.a j [ZMOD m] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_comm, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  have : (P.a i : ℤ) * (P.L j t : ℕ) - ((P.a i : ℤ) - P.a j) = P.a j * (P.L i t : ℕ) :=
    affine_shift i j t
  rw [this, dvd_mul_cancel_coprime hm]
  exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.symm

/-- `W ∣ t ↔ L_j(t) ≡ 1 (mod a_j W)`. -/
theorem base_iff (hP : P.WGood) (j : Fin P.k) (t : ℕ) :
    P.W ∣ t ↔ ((P.L j t : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ 1 [ZMOD (P.a j * P.W : ℕ)] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_comm, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  have : ((P.L j t : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = (P.a j : ℤ) * t := by unfold L; push_cast; ring
  rw [this]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by exact_mod_cast (hP.a_pos j).ne')]
  exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.symm

/-- **Spectator congruence**: `q_i ∣ L_i(t) ↔ L_j(t) ≡ 1 - a_j a_i⁻¹ (mod q_i)`. -/
theorem spectator_iff (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) (i : Fin P.k)
    (t : ℕ) :
    P.q ξ i ∣ P.L i t ↔ ((P.L ξ.j t : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ P.specRes ξ i [ZMOD (P.q ξ i : ℕ)] := by
  have hcop := q_coprime_W hξ i
  rw [dvd_form_iff i ξ.j (hP.coprime_slope hcop ξ.j) t]
  exact mul_congr_iff_inv (hP.coprime_slope hcop i) _

/-- **Scalar congruence**: for `(d, W) = 1`, `d ∣ L_ℓ(t) ↔ A_{jℓ} L_j(t) ≡ B_{jℓ} (mod d)`. -/
theorem scalar_iff (hP : P.WGood) (ξ : Packet P.k) {e : ℕ} (he : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (t : ℕ) :
    e ∣ P.L ξ.l t ↔ (P.A ξ : ℤ) * ((P.L ξ.j t : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ P.B ξ [ZMOD (e : ℕ)] := by
  rw [dvd_form_iff ξ.l ξ.j (hP.coprime_slope he ξ.j) t]
  exact reduce_iff hP ξ he _

/-- **Exact packet congruence.**  For an admissible packet and a scalar divisor `d` with
`(d, W) = 1`, `(d, f_ξ) = 1`: the conditions `W ∣ t`, `q_i ∣ L_i(t)` (all spectators) and
`d ∣ L_ℓ(t)` hold together iff `L_j(t) ≡ b_{ξ,d} (mod f_ξ d)`. -/
theorem packet_congruence_iff (hP : P.WGood) {ξ : Packet P.k} (hξ : P.Admissible ξ) {e : ℕ}
    (he0 : 0 < e) (heW : Nat.Coprime e P.W) (hfe : Nat.Coprime (P.f ξ) e) (t : ℕ) :
    (P.W ∣ t ∧ (∀ i ∈ P.spec ξ, P.q ξ i ∣ P.L i t) ∧ e ∣ P.L ξ.l t) ↔
      ((P.L ξ.j t : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ P.bRes ξ e [ZMOD (P.f ξ * e : ℕ)] := by
  rw [← (bRes_spec hP hξ he0 heW hfe).2, ← (cRes_spec hP hξ).2, System, base_iff hP,
    scalar_iff hP ξ heW]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1, fun i hi => (spectator_iff hP hξ i t).1 (h2 i hi)⟩, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h1, fun i hi => (spectator_iff hP hξ i t).2 (h2 i hi), h3⟩

end PhysData

end Erdos287.Physical
