@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4284 sha256=1fbe204ffcc797e469d7dd3ef44fda8e13d8cd315736a771b1d6bd6ed849c2aa path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/Bound.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Majorant

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: total-variation bound

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

`abs_ellX_le` — `|ℓ_X(d)| ≤ ε₀^{-2} + 1 = T² + 1` for every `d`: in each parity sector the
low/high split `d = b·a` is unique (`b` = product of the low prime factors), so each sector
contributes at most one term of size `≤ 1`.  The bound is independent of `X` (§17: "the total
variation is independent of `X` after fixing the scalar parameters").
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

theorem abs_sum_le_one_of_unique {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (huniq : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, f x ≠ 0 → f y ≠ 0 → x = y) (hle : ∀ x ∈ s, |f x| ≤ 1) :
    |∑ x ∈ s, f x| ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : ∃ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x (fun y hy hyx => by
      by_contra hne; exact hyx (huniq y hy x hx hne hfx)) (fun h => absurd hx h)]
    exact hle x hx
  · push_neg at h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero h]; simp

namespace ScalarParams

variable {S : ScalarParams}

theorem abs_kappa_le (J b : ℕ) : |S.kappa J b| ≤ 1 := by
  have hμ : |(ArithmeticFunction.moebius b : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one
  unfold kappa
  split_ifs
  · unfold lamLowPlus; split_ifs
    · exact hμ
    · simp
  · unfold lamLowMinus; split_ifs
    · exact hμ
    · simp

theorem hw_le_one (J a : ℕ) : S.hw J a ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  unfold hw; split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- The low part of a support element is determined by `d`. -/
theorem low_part_unique (hS : S.Good) {J d : ℕ} {x y : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hx : x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal) (hy : y ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal)
    (hfx : S.kappa J x.1 * S.hw J x.2 ≠ 0) (hfy : S.kappa J y.1 * S.hw J y.2 ≠ 0) : x = y := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hxm, hd0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
  obtain ⟨hym, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hy
  have key : ∀ z : ℕ × ℕ, z.1 * z.2 = d → S.kappa J z.1 * S.hw J z.2 ≠ 0 →
      z.1 = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0), p := by
    intro z hz hf
    have hk : S.kappa J z.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hf (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
    have hh : S.hw J z.2 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hf (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨hsq, hlow⟩ := kappa_support hk
    obtain ⟨⟨hsqa, hhigh, -⟩, -⟩ := hw_support hh
    have hz1 : z.1 ≠ 0 := hsq.ne_zero
    have hz2 : z.2 ≠ 0 := hsqa.ne_zero
    have hpf : z.1.primeFactors = d.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0) := by
      rw [← hz, Nat.primeFactors_mul hz1 hz2]
      ext p
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_union]
      constructor
      · intro hp; exact ⟨Or.inl hp, hlow p hp⟩
      · rintro ⟨hp | hp, hlt⟩
        · exact hp
        · exact absurd hlt (not_low_of_high hS (hhigh p hp))
    rw [← hpf, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
  have h1 := key x hxm hfx
  have h2 := key y hym hfy
  have hx1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hxm; exact hd0 hxm.symm
  have heq1 : x.1 = y.1 := h1.trans h2.symm
  have heq2 : x.2 = y.2 := by
    have : x.1 * x.2 = x.1 * y.2 := by rw [hxm, heq1, hym]
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx1) this
  exact Prod.ext heq1 heq2

/-- **Total variation**: `|ℓ_X(d)| ≤ T² + 1`, independent of `X`. -/
theorem abs_ellX_le (hS : S.Good) (d : ℕ) : |S.ellX d| ≤ (S.T : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1 := by
  rw [ellX_eq_setForm hS]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  have : ∀ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), |(-1 : ℝ) ^ J *
      ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 * S.hw J x.2| ≤ 1 := by
    intro J _
    rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    apply abs_sum_le_one_of_unique
    · intro x hx y hy hfx hfy; exact low_part_unique hS hx hy hfx hfy
    · intro x _
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw_nonneg J x.2)]
      have h1 := abs_kappa_le (S := S) J x.1
      have h2 := hw_le_one (S := S) J x.2
      have h3 := hw_nonneg (S := S) J x.2
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (S.kappa J x.1)]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum this).trans ?_
  simp

end ScalarParams

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=9591 sha256=513fd6ce8f1c1e0857cb1ce29fc4a8e40605e3bc499cebd4e68ff8a3aec63f30 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/Levels.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Weights

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: levels and the box grid

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Elementary facts about the levels of §13 and the high-prime box grid of §14:

* `Dtot_eq` — `D_tot = D_int^{1+ε₀+τ}` (the distinction `D_tot = X^{59/100}` vs `D_int` is kept);
* `Dlow_mul` — `D_low · D_int^{1+τ} = D_tot`;
* `u0_sq_le_Dlow` — `u² ≤ D_low` (`T ≥ 2`), so the lower-sieve condition `p_1² ≤ D_low` is
  automatic for low primes;
* `boxTop_eq` — `D_j^{1+τ} = D_{j+1}` (consecutive boxes tile `(u, D_H]`);
* `lt_H_iff` — `j < H ↔ D_j ≤ √D_int`;
* `inBox_unique`, `boxOf_spec`, `boxOf_mono` — the ownership rule;
* `prime_le_ztop` — every prime `p ≤ z = D_H` is low or high, or equals `u`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

variable {S : ScalarParams}

theorem T_pos (hS : S.Good) : (0 : ℝ) < S.T := by
  have := hS.T_two; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < S.T)

theorem eps0_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < S.eps0 := by
  unfold eps0; exact div_pos one_pos (T_pos hS)

theorem eps0_le_half (hS : S.Good) : S.eps0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  unfold eps0
  have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ S.T := by exact_mod_cast hS.T_two
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) this

theorem tau_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < S.tau := pow_pos (eps0_pos hS) 9

theorem Dtot_gt_one (hS : S.Good) : 1 < S.Dtot :=
  Real.one_lt_rpow hS.X_gt (by norm_num)

theorem Dtot_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < S.Dtot := lt_trans one_pos (Dtot_gt_one hS)

theorem expo_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < 1 + S.eps0 + S.tau := by
  linarith [eps0_pos hS, tau_pos hS]

theorem Dint_gt_one (hS : S.Good) : 1 < S.Dint :=
  Real.one_lt_rpow (Dtot_gt_one hS) (div_pos one_pos (expo_pos hS))

theorem Dint_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < S.Dint := lt_trans one_pos (Dint_gt_one hS)

theorem u0_gt_one (hS : S.Good) : 1 < S.u0 :=
  Real.one_lt_rpow (Dint_gt_one hS) (pow_pos (eps0_pos hS) 2)

theorem u0_pos (hS : S.Good) : 0 < S.u0 := lt_trans one_pos (u0_gt_one hS)

theorem Dlow_ge_one (hS : S.Good) : 1 ≤ S.Dlow :=
  (Real.one_lt_rpow (Dint_gt_one hS) (eps0_pos hS)).le

/-- **`D_tot = D_int^{1+ε₀+τ}`**. -/
theorem Dtot_eq (hS : S.Good) : S.Dtot = S.Dint ^ (1 + S.eps0 + S.tau) := by
  unfold Dint
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (Dtot_pos hS).le, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (expo_pos hS).ne',
    Real.rpow_one]

/-- **`D_low · D_int^{1+τ} = D_tot`**. -/
theorem Dlow_mul (hS : S.Good) : S.Dlow * S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) = S.Dtot := by
  rw [Dtot_eq hS, Dlow, ← Real.rpow_add (Dint_pos hS)]
  ring_nf

/-- `u^{T²} = D_int`. -/
theorem u0_pow_T_sq (hS : S.Good) : S.u0 ^ ((S.T : ℝ) ^ 2) = S.Dint := by
  unfold u0
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (Dint_pos hS).le, eps0, div_pow, one_pow,
    one_div_mul_cancel (pow_pos (T_pos hS) 2).ne', Real.rpow_one]

/-- **`u² ≤ D_low`** (since `2ε₀² ≤ ε₀`). -/
theorem u0_sq_le_Dlow (hS : S.Good) : S.u0 ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow := by
  unfold u0 Dlow
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (Dint_pos hS).le]
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (Dint_gt_one hS).le
  have h1 := eps0_pos hS
  have h2 := eps0_le_half hS
  push_cast
  nlinarith

theorem boxEnd_ge_u0 (hS : S.Good) (j : ℕ) : S.u0 ≤ S.boxEnd j := by
  unfold boxEnd
  conv_lhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one S.u0]
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (u0_gt_one hS).le
  exact one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [tau_pos hS])

theorem boxEnd_gt_one (hS : S.Good) (j : ℕ) : 1 < S.boxEnd j :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (u0_gt_one hS) (boxEnd_ge_u0 hS j)

theorem boxEnd_pos (hS : S.Good) (j : ℕ) : 0 < S.boxEnd j :=
  lt_trans one_pos (boxEnd_gt_one hS j)

theorem boxEnd_zero : S.boxEnd 0 = S.u0 := by simp [boxEnd]

/-- **`D_j^{1+τ} = D_{j+1}`**. -/
theorem boxTop_eq (hS : S.Good) (j : ℕ) : S.boxTop j = S.boxEnd (j + 1) := by
  unfold boxTop boxEnd
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (u0_pos hS).le, pow_succ]

theorem boxEnd_strictMono (hS : S.Good) : StrictMono S.boxEnd := by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro j
  unfold boxEnd
  apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt (u0_gt_one hS)
  rw [pow_succ]
  have := pow_pos (show 0 < 1 + S.tau by linarith [tau_pos hS]) j
  nlinarith [tau_pos hS]

theorem boxEnd_le_iff (hS : S.Good) {i j : ℕ} : S.boxEnd i ≤ S.boxEnd j ↔ i ≤ j :=
  (boxEnd_strictMono hS).le_iff_le

theorem boxEnd_unbounded (hS : S.Good) (M : ℝ) : ∃ j, M < S.boxEnd j := by
  -- `D_j ≥ u^{1 + jτ}` by Bernoulli
  have hu := u0_gt_one hS
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log S.u0 := Real.log_pos hu
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((Real.log (max M 1)) / (Real.log S.u0 * S.tau))
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  have hbern : 1 + (j : ℝ) * S.tau ≤ (1 + S.tau) ^ j :=
    one_add_mul_le_pow (by linarith [tau_pos hS]) j
  have h1 : S.u0 ^ (1 + (j : ℝ) * S.tau) ≤ S.boxEnd j :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hu.le hbern
  have h2 : max M 1 < S.u0 ^ (1 + (j : ℝ) * S.tau) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right M 1)),
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos (u0_pos hS)]
    apply Real.exp_lt_exp.2
    have hτ := tau_pos hS
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hlog hτ)] at hj
    nlinarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left M 1) (lt_of_lt_of_le h2 h1)

theorem H_spec (hS : S.Good) : ∀ j, j < S.H ↔ S.boxEnd j ≤ Real.sqrt S.Dint := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ j, Real.sqrt S.Dint < S.boxEnd j := boxEnd_unbounded hS _
  intro j
  have hH : S.H = Nat.find hex := by unfold H; rw [dif_pos hex]
  rw [hH]
  constructor
  · intro hj
    exact not_lt.1 (Nat.find_min hex hj)
  · intro hj
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hmono := (boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 hc
    linarith

theorem lt_H_iff (hS : S.Good) {j : ℕ} : j < S.H ↔ S.boxEnd j ≤ Real.sqrt S.Dint :=
  H_spec hS j

/-- Boxes are disjoint: a prime lies in at most one box. -/
theorem inBox_unique (hS : S.Good) {i j p : ℕ} (hi : S.InBox i p) (hj : S.InBox j p) :
    i = j := by
  unfold InBox at hi hj
  rw [boxTop_eq hS] at hi hj
  by_contra hne
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have := (boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 (show i + 1 ≤ j by omega)
    linarith [hi.2, hj.1]
  · have := (boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 (show j + 1 ≤ i by omega)
    linarith [hj.2, hi.1]

theorem boxOf_spec {p : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) : S.boxOf p < S.H ∧ S.InBox (S.boxOf p) p := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, j, hj, hb⟩ := hp
  have hex : ∃ j, j < S.H ∧ S.InBox j p := ⟨j, hj, hb⟩
  unfold boxOf
  rw [dif_pos hex]
  exact Nat.find_spec hex

theorem boxOf_eq (hS : S.Good) {p j : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) (hj : S.InBox j p) :
    S.boxOf p = j :=
  inBox_unique hS (boxOf_spec hp).2 hj

/-- Ownership is monotone: larger high primes lie in weakly larger boxes. -/
theorem boxOf_mono (hS : S.Good) {p q : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) (hq : S.IsHigh q) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    S.boxOf p ≤ S.boxOf q := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 := (boxOf_spec hp).2
  have h2 := (boxOf_spec hq).2
  unfold InBox at h1 h2
  rw [boxTop_eq hS] at h2
  have := (boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 (show S.boxOf q + 1 ≤ S.boxOf p by omega)
  have hpq' : (p : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hpq
  linarith [h1.1, h2.2]

theorem high_gt_u0 (hS : S.Good) {p : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) : S.u0 < p := by
  obtain ⟨-, j, -, hb, -⟩ := hp
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (boxEnd_ge_u0 hS j) hb

theorem not_low_of_high (hS : S.Good) {p : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) : ¬ (p : ℝ) < S.u0 :=
  not_lt.2 (high_gt_u0 hS hp).le

theorem high_le_ztop (hS : S.Good) {p : ℕ} (hp : S.IsHigh p) : (p : ℝ) ≤ S.ztop := by
  obtain ⟨-, j, hj, -, hb⟩ := hp
  rw [boxTop_eq hS] at hb
  exact hb.trans ((boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 hj)

/-- Every real `y ∈ (u, D_H]` lies in some box of the grid. -/
theorem exists_box (hS : S.Good) {y : ℝ} (h1 : S.u0 < y) (h2 : y ≤ S.ztop) :
    ∃ j < S.H, S.boxEnd j < y ∧ y ≤ S.boxTop j := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ j, y ≤ S.boxEnd j := ⟨S.H, h2⟩
  set n := Nat.find hex with hn
  have hspec : y ≤ S.boxEnd n := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0, boxEnd_zero] at hspec; linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have hmin : ¬ y ≤ S.boxEnd j := Nat.find_min hex (by omega)
  have hnH : n ≤ S.H := Nat.find_min' hex h2
  refine ⟨j, by omega, lt_of_not_ge hmin, ?_⟩
  rw [boxTop_eq hS, show j + 1 = n by omega]; exact hspec

/-- **Every prime `p ≤ z` is low, or high, or equals `u`.** -/
theorem prime_le_ztop (hS : S.Good) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : (p : ℝ) ≤ S.ztop) :
    (p : ℝ) < S.u0 ∨ S.IsHigh p ∨ (p : ℝ) = S.u0 := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (p : ℝ) S.u0 with h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hb⟩ := exists_box hS h hpz
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hp, j, hj, hb⟩)

theorem threshold_le_Dint (hS : S.Good) (J : ℕ) : S.threshold J ≤ S.Dint := by
  unfold threshold
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · conv_rhs => rw [← Real.rpow_one S.Dint]
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (Dint_gt_one hS).le
    rw [div_le_one (by linarith [tau_pos hS])]
    linarith [tau_pos hS]

theorem threshold_pos (hS : S.Good) (J : ℕ) : 0 < S.threshold J := by
  unfold threshold
  split_ifs
  · exact Dint_pos hS
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Dint_pos hS) _

/-- `threshold J ^ (1+τ) ≤ D_int^{1+τ}`, with equality to `D_int` for odd `J`. -/
theorem threshold_rpow_le (hS : S.Good) (J : ℕ) :
    S.threshold J ^ (1 + S.tau) ≤ S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) :=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow (threshold_pos hS J).le (threshold_le_Dint hS J) (by linarith [tau_pos hS])

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=12789 sha256=25773648da6ed78156e8a9458f262f5e17d1394aa9385b0b9e18cbf1669a921b path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/LowSieve.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Levels

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: the low-prime weights `λ^±_low`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

* `sum_divisors_eq_sum_powerset` — a divisor sum of a function supported on squarefree numbers
  with prime factors in `Q` is a sum over subsets of the `Q`-prime factors;
* `lamLowPlus_sum_ge` — `∑_{b ∣ v} λ⁺_low(b) ≥ 1_{(v, P(u)) = 1}` (upper sieve);
* `lamLowMinus_sum_le` — `∑_{b ∣ v} λ⁻_low(b) ≤ 1_{(v, P(u)) = 1}` (lower sieve; uses
  `u² ≤ D_low`, so the condition `p_1² ≤ D_low` never fails on low primes);
* `lamLowPlus_level`, `lamLowMinus_level` — support in `b ≤ D_low`;
* `lamLow_support` — support on squarefree `b` with all prime factors `< u`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

/-- Divisor sums of functions supported on squarefree numbers with prime factors in `Q`. -/
theorem sum_divisors_eq_sum_powerset {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] (g : ℕ → M)
    (hg : ∀ d, g d ≠ 0 → Squarefree d ∧ ∀ p ∈ d.primeFactors, Q p) :
    ∑ d ∈ v.divisors, g d = ∑ T ∈ (v.primeFactors.filter Q).powerset, g (∏ p ∈ T, p) := by
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun d _ _ => d.primeFactors) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro d hd hgd
    obtain ⟨-, hQ⟩ := hg d hgd
    rw [Finset.mem_powerset]
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Nat.primeFactors_mono (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd) hv hp, hQ p hp⟩
  · intro d1 _ h1 d2 _ h2 heq
    rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hg d1 h1).1,
      ← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hg d2 h2).1]
    simp only at heq
    rw [heq]
  · intro T hT hgT
    have hTp : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime := fun p hp =>
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_powerset.1 hT hp)).1
    refine ⟨∏ p ∈ T, p, ?_, hgT, Nat.primeFactors_prod hTp⟩
    rw [Nat.mem_divisors]
    refine ⟨?_, hv⟩
    apply Finset.prod_primes_dvd
    · intro p hp; exact (Nat.prime_iff.1 (hTp p hp))
    · intro p hp
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_powerset.1 hT hp)).1
  · intro d _ hgd
    rw [Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hg d hgd).1]

theorem squarefree_prod_primes' {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) :
    Squarefree (∏ p ∈ T, p) ∧ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ p ∈ T, p) = T.card := by
  classical
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a T haT ih =>
    have hT' : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime := fun p hp => hT p (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hp)
    have ha : a.Prime := hT a (Finset.mem_insert_self a T)
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih hT'
    rw [Finset.prod_insert haT, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem haT]
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime a (∏ p ∈ T, p) := by
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
      intro q hq
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes ha (hT' q hq)).2 (fun h => haT (h ▸ hq))
    refine ⟨Nat.squarefree_mul_iff.2 ⟨hcop, ha.squarefree, ih1⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul ha.ne_zero
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (fun p hp => (hT' p hp).ne_zero)),
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime ha, ih2, add_comm]

theorem squarefree_prod_primes {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) :
    Squarefree (∏ p ∈ T, p) := (squarefree_prod_primes' hT).1

theorem moebius_prod_primes {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) :
    (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (∏ p ∈ T, p) : ℝ) = (-1) ^ T.card := by
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_of_squarefree (squarefree_prod_primes hT),
    (squarefree_prod_primes' hT).2]
  push_cast; rfl

/-- The `u`-rough indicator `1_{(v, P(u)) = 1}`: no prime factor `p < u`. -/
noncomputable def roughLow (u : ℝ) (v : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < u) = ∅ then 1 else 0

namespace ScalarParams

variable {S : ScalarParams}

theorem lamLowPlus_support {b : ℕ} (h : S.lamLowPlus b ≠ 0) :
    Squarefree b ∧ ∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0 := by
  unfold lamLowPlus at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1⟩
  · exact absurd rfl h

theorem lamLowMinus_support {b : ℕ} (h : S.lamLowMinus b ≠ 0) :
    Squarefree b ∧ ∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0 := by
  unfold lamLowMinus at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.1⟩
  · exact absurd rfl h

theorem kappa_support {J b : ℕ} (h : S.kappa J b ≠ 0) :
    Squarefree b ∧ ∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0 := by
  unfold kappa at h
  split_ifs at h
  · exact lamLowPlus_support h
  · exact lamLowMinus_support h

theorem lamLowPlus_prod {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) (hu : ∀ p ∈ T, (p : ℝ) < S.u0)
    [Decidable (DplusSet S.Dlow T)] :
    S.lamLowPlus (∏ p ∈ T, p) = if DplusSet S.Dlow T then (-1) ^ T.card else 0 := by
  unfold lamLowPlus
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_prod hT, moebius_prod_primes hT]
  by_cases hD : DplusSet S.Dlow T
  · rw [if_pos ⟨squarefree_prod_primes hT, hu, hD⟩, if_pos hD]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => hD h.2.2), if_neg hD]

theorem lamLowMinus_prod {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) (hu : ∀ p ∈ T, (p : ℝ) < S.u0)
    [Decidable (DminusSet S.Dlow T)] :
    S.lamLowMinus (∏ p ∈ T, p) = if DminusSet S.Dlow T then (-1) ^ T.card else 0 := by
  unfold lamLowMinus
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_prod hT, moebius_prod_primes hT]
  by_cases hD : DminusSet S.Dlow T
  · rw [if_pos ⟨squarefree_prod_primes hT, hu, hD⟩, if_pos hD]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => hD h.2.2), if_neg hD]

theorem DplusSet_pre (D : ℝ) : ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → DplusSet D (insert p s) → DplusSet D s := by
  intro s p hp h q hq hev
  have := h q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
  rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at this
  exact this hev

theorem DplusSet_ext (D : ℝ) : ∀ s p, True → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → Odd s.card → DplusSet D s →
    DplusSet D (insert p s) := by
  intro s p _ hp hodd h q hq hev
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
  · rw [above_insert_self hp] at hev
    exact absurd hev (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hodd)
  · rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at hev ⊢
    exact h q hq hev

theorem DminusSet_pre (D : ℝ) :
    ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → DminusSet D (insert p s) → DminusSet D s := by
  intro s p hp h
  refine ⟨fun q hq hodd => ?_, fun q hq hemp => ?_⟩
  · have := h.1 q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
    rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at this
    exact this hodd
  · have := h.2 q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
    rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at this
    exact this hemp

theorem DminusSet_ext (D : ℝ) : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ), (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ D → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → Even s.card →
    DminusSet D s → DminusSet D (insert p s) := by
  intro s p hpD hp hev h
  refine ⟨fun q hq hodd => ?_, fun q hq hemp => ?_⟩
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · rw [above_insert_self hp] at hodd
      exact absurd hev (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hodd)
    · rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at hodd ⊢
      exact h.1 q hq hodd
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · exact hpD
    · rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at hemp
      exact h.2 q hq hemp

theorem DplusSet_empty (D : ℝ) : DplusSet D ∅ := fun p hp => absurd hp (Finset.notMem_empty p)

/-- **Upper low sieve**: `∑_{b ∣ v} λ⁺_low(b) ≥ 1_{(v, P(u)) = 1}`. -/
theorem lamLowPlus_sum_ge {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    roughLow S.u0 v ≤ ∑ b ∈ v.divisors, S.lamLowPlus b := by
  classical
  rw [sum_divisors_eq_sum_powerset hv (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0) S.lamLowPlus
    (fun d hd => lamLowPlus_support hd)]
  have hprime : ∀ T ∈ (v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0)).powerset,
      (∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) ∧ ∀ p ∈ T, (p : ℝ) < S.u0 := by
    intro T hT
    have h := Finset.mem_powerset.1 hT
    exact ⟨fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.1 (h hp)).1,
      fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.1 (h hp)).2⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T hT => lamLowPlus_prod (hprime T hT).1 (hprime T hT).2)]
  have key := rosser_upper (DplusSet S.Dlow) (fun _ => True) (DplusSet_empty _)
    (DplusSet_pre _) (DplusSet_ext _) (v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0))
    (fun _ _ => trivial)
  have := (Int.cast_le (R := ℝ)).2 key
  push_cast at this
  unfold roughLow
  convert this using 2

/-- **Lower low sieve**: `∑_{b ∣ v} λ⁻_low(b) ≤ 1_{(v, P(u)) = 1}`. -/
theorem lamLowMinus_sum_le (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∑ b ∈ v.divisors, S.lamLowMinus b ≤ roughLow S.u0 v := by
  classical
  rw [sum_divisors_eq_sum_powerset hv (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0) S.lamLowMinus
    (fun d hd => lamLowMinus_support hd)]
  have hprime : ∀ T ∈ (v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0)).powerset,
      (∀ p ∈ T, p.Prime) ∧ ∀ p ∈ T, (p : ℝ) < S.u0 := by
    intro T hT
    have h := Finset.mem_powerset.1 hT
    exact ⟨fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.1 (h hp)).1,
      fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.1 (h hp)).2⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun T hT => lamLowMinus_prod (hprime T hT).1 (hprime T hT).2)]
  have hU : ∀ p ∈ v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0), (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg p
    have := u0_sq_le_Dlow hS
    nlinarith
  have key := rosser_lower (DminusSet S.Dlow) (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow)
    (DminusSet_pre _) (DminusSet_ext _) (v.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < S.u0)) hU
  have := (Int.cast_le (R := ℝ)).2 key
  push_cast at this
  unfold roughLow
  convert this using 2

/-- **Level of `λ⁺_low`**: support in `b ≤ D_low`. -/
theorem lamLowPlus_level (hS : S.Good) {b : ℕ} (h : S.lamLowPlus b ≠ 0) : (b : ℝ) ≤ S.Dlow := by
  unfold lamLowPlus at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · obtain ⟨hsq, -, hD⟩ := hc
    rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
    push_cast
    by_cases hne : b.primeFactors.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hev, hle⟩ := exists_odd_position_witness (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ))
        b.primeFactors hne (fun x hx => by dsimp only; exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hx).one_lt.le)
        (fun x _ y _ hxy => by dsimp only; exact_mod_cast hxy)
      have h1 := hD p hp hev
      have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_lt.le
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ) := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity)
      have : (∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
          (∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ h0
        exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hp1 (by norm_num)
      linarith
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne, Finset.prod_empty]
      exact Dlow_ge_one hS
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- **Level of `λ⁻_low`**: support in `b ≤ D_low`. -/
theorem lamLowMinus_level (hS : S.Good) {b : ℕ} (h : S.lamLowMinus b ≠ 0) :
    (b : ℝ) ≤ S.Dlow := by
  unfold lamLowMinus at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · obtain ⟨hsq, -, hD⟩ := hc
    rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
    push_cast
    by_cases hne : b.primeFactors.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpos, hle⟩ := exists_even_position_witness (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ))
        b.primeFactors hne (fun x hx => by dsimp only; exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hx).one_lt.le)
        (fun x _ y _ hxy => by dsimp only; exact_mod_cast hxy)
      have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_lt.le
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ) :=
        Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity)
      rcases hpos with hodd | hemp
      · have h1 := hD.1 p hp hodd
        have : (∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
            (∏ q ∈ above b.primeFactors p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ h0
          exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hp1 (by norm_num)
        linarith
      · have h1 := hD.2 p hp hemp
        rw [hemp, Finset.prod_empty, one_mul] at hle
        linarith
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne, Finset.prod_empty]
      exact Dlow_ge_one hS
  · exact absurd rfl h

theorem kappa_level (hS : S.Good) {J b : ℕ} (h : S.kappa J b ≠ 0) : (b : ℝ) ≤ S.Dlow := by
  unfold kappa at h
  split_ifs at h
  · exact lamLowPlus_level hS h
  · exact lamLowMinus_level hS h

end ScalarParams

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=19703 sha256=93205983d8c764678dfa6bf31173285d308c199bfcf67c54649ba84be044687b path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/Majorant.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Ownership

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: support, level, parity and the pointwise majorant

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Main results about the actual coefficient `ℓ_X` of `Physical/Scalar/Weights.lean`:

* `kappa_even`, `kappa_odd` — `κ_J = λ⁺_low` for even `J`, `λ⁻_low` for odd `J`;
* `ellX_J0_sector` — the `J = 0` sector is the **entire** low upper-sieve weight `λ⁺_low(d)`;
* `ellX_support` — `ℓ_X(d) ≠ 0` only for squarefree `d = b·a` with `b` a product of low primes
  `< u` and `a` a product of high (boxed) primes;
* `ellX_level` — `ℓ_X(d) ≠ 0 ⇒ d ≤ D_tot = D_low · D_int^{1+τ}` (the internal level is
  `D_int`, the total level `D_tot`);
* `UX_eq_parity_sum` — `U_X(v) = ∑_J (-1)^J (∑_{b∣v} κ_J(b)) (∑_{a∣v} hw_J(a))`;
* `UX_nonneg` and `UX_majorant` — **the pointwise upper-majorant statement**:
  `U_X(v) ≥ 0`, and `U_X(v) ≥ 1` whenever `v` has no prime factor `≤ z = D_H`;
  `UX_ge_indicator` combines them, `UX_ge_one_of_prime` is the prime event.

The majorant is proved by the parity-sensitive sign argument of §15: for even `J` the upper
low sieve `∑_{b∣v} λ⁺_low(b) ≥ 1_{(v,P(u))=1}`, for odd `J` the lower low sieve
`∑_{b∣v} λ⁻_low(b) ≤ 1_{(v,P(u))=1}` *before* multiplication by `(-1)^J = -1`; then the high
box sum `∑_J (-1)^J ∑_{a∣v} hw_J(a) ≥ 1_{no high prime divides v}` by the Rosser inequality
for Lichtman's (parity-dependent) `𝐃_J^+`.  No positivity hypothesis is assumed.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

/-- Odd-position admissibility with a fixed threshold, for a weight `f`. -/
def OddPosAdm (f : ℕ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ A, Even (above A p).card → (∏ q ∈ above A p, f q) * f p ^ 3 < θ

theorem OddPosAdm_pre (f : ℕ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → OddPosAdm f θ (insert p s) → OddPosAdm f θ s := by
  intro s p hp h q hq hev
  have := h q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
  rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at this
  exact this hev

theorem OddPosAdm_ext (f : ℕ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Prop) : ∀ s p, U p → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) →
    Odd s.card → OddPosAdm f θ s → OddPosAdm f θ (insert p s) := by
  intro s p _ hp hodd h q hq hev
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hq with rfl | hq
  · rw [above_insert_self hp] at hev
    exact absurd hev (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hodd)
  · rw [above_insert_of_lt hp hq] at hev ⊢
    exact h q hq hev

theorem OddPosAdm_empty (f : ℕ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : OddPosAdm f θ ∅ :=
  fun p hp => absurd hp (Finset.notMem_empty p)

/-- Double divisor sums: `∑_{d∣v} ∑_{ba=d} F(b,a) = ∑_{b∣v} ∑_{a∣v} F(b,a)` when `F` is
supported on coprime pairs. -/
theorem sum_divisors_antidiag {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (F : ℕ → ℕ → M) (hF : ∀ b a, F b a ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime b a) :
    ∑ d ∈ v.divisors, ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, F x.1 x.2 =
      ∑ b ∈ v.divisors, ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, F b a := by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', ← Finset.sum_product']
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun y _ _ => y.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy _
    obtain ⟨hd, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy
    obtain ⟨hmul, hd0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have hdv := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd
    rw [Finset.mem_product, Nat.mem_divisors, Nat.mem_divisors]
    exact ⟨⟨(Dvd.intro _ hmul).trans hdv, hv⟩, ⟨(Dvd.intro_left _ hmul).trans hdv, hv⟩⟩
  · intro y1 hy1 _ y2 hy2 _ h
    obtain ⟨-, hx1⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy1
    obtain ⟨-, hx2⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy2
    have e1 := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx1).1
    have e2 := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx2).1
    simp only at h
    have hd : y1.1 = y2.1 := by rw [← e1, ← e2, h]
    exact Sigma.ext hd (heq_of_eq h)
  · intro x hx hF0
    obtain ⟨hb, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_product.1 hx
    have hcop := hF x.1 x.2 hF0
    have hdv : x.1 * x.2 ∣ v :=
      Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hcop (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hb)
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors ha)
    refine ⟨⟨x.1 * x.2, x⟩, ?_, hF0, rfl⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_sigma, Nat.mem_divisors, Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal]
    exact ⟨⟨hdv, hv⟩, rfl, fun h0 => hv (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h0 ▸ hdv))⟩
  · intro y _ _; rfl

namespace ScalarParams

variable {S : ScalarParams}

theorem kappa_even {J : ℕ} (h : Even J) : S.kappa J = S.lamLowPlus := by
  unfold kappa; rw [if_pos h]

theorem kappa_odd {J : ℕ} (h : ¬ Even J) : S.kappa J = S.lamLowMinus := by
  unfold kappa; rw [if_neg h]

theorem hw_support {J a : ℕ} (h : S.hw J a ≠ 0) : S.GoodHigh J a ∧ S.HighAdm a.primeFactors := by
  classical
  unfold hw at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · exact hc
  · exact absurd rfl h

theorem hw_nonneg (J a : ℕ) : 0 ≤ S.hw J a := by
  classical
  unfold hw; split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- The box weight `f(q) = D_{box(q)}`. -/
noncomputable def fBox (S : ScalarParams) (q : ℕ) : ℝ := S.boxEnd (S.boxOf q)

theorem fBox_ge_u0 (hS : S.Good) (q : ℕ) : S.u0 ≤ S.fBox q := boxEnd_ge_u0 hS _

theorem fBox_mono (hS : S.Good) {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p) :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, x ≤ y → S.fBox x ≤ S.fBox y := fun x hx y hy hxy =>
  (boxEnd_le_iff hS).2 (boxOf_mono hS (hA x hx) (hA y hy) hxy)

theorem highAdm_iff (A : Finset ℕ) :
    S.HighAdm A ↔ OddPosAdm S.fBox (S.threshold A.card) A := Iff.rfl

/-- The product of the box values of an odd-position-admissible set is below the threshold. -/
theorem prod_fBox_lt (hS : S.Good) {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p) (hne : A.Nonempty)
    {θ : ℝ} (hadm : OddPosAdm S.fBox θ A) : ∏ q ∈ A, S.fBox q < θ := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hev, hle⟩ := exists_odd_position_witness S.fBox A hne
    (fun x _ => (u0_gt_one hS).le.trans (fBox_ge_u0 hS x)) (fBox_mono hS hA)
  have h1 := hadm p hp hev
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ S.fBox p := (u0_gt_one hS).le.trans (fBox_ge_u0 hS p)
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ above A p, S.fBox q := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x _ =>
    le_trans zero_le_one ((u0_gt_one hS).le.trans (fBox_ge_u0 hS x)))
  have : (∏ q ∈ above A p, S.fBox q) * S.fBox p ^ 2 ≤
      (∏ q ∈ above A p, S.fBox q) * S.fBox p ^ 3 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ hp1 (by norm_num)) h0
  linarith

/-- **Range of `J`**: an admissible set of high primes has at most `ε₀^{-2} = T²` elements. -/
theorem card_le_T_sq (hS : S.Good) {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p)
    (hadm : OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint A) : A.card ≤ S.T ^ 2 := by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp
  have hlt := prod_fBox_lt hS hA hne hadm
  have hge : S.u0 ^ A.card ≤ ∏ q ∈ A, S.fBox q := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_const]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => (u0_pos hS).le) (fun x _ => fBox_ge_u0 hS x)
  have hD : S.Dint = S.u0 ^ (S.T ^ 2) := by
    rw [← u0_pow_T_sq hS, show ((S.T : ℝ)) ^ 2 = ((S.T ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; rfl,
      Real.rpow_natCast]
  have : S.u0 ^ A.card < S.u0 ^ (S.T ^ 2) := by rw [← hD]; linarith
  exact ((pow_lt_pow_iff_right₀ (u0_gt_one hS)).1 this).le

/-! ### Parity -/

/-- **The `J = 0` sector is the entire low upper-sieve weight** `λ⁺_low(d)`. -/
theorem ellX_J0_sector {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ 0 * ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa 0 x.1 * S.hw 0 x.2 = S.lamLowPlus d := by
  classical
  rw [pow_zero, one_mul, kappa_even (⟨0, rfl⟩ : Even 0)]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (d, 1)]
  · have : S.hw 0 1 = 1 := by
      unfold hw
      rw [if_pos]
      refine ⟨⟨squarefree_one, by simp, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
      intro p hp; simp at hp
    rw [this, mul_one]
  · intro x hx hne
    obtain ⟨hmul, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have h2 : x.2 ≠ 1 := by
      intro h; apply hne; ext
      · simpa [h] using hmul
      · exact h
    have : S.hw 0 x.2 = 0 := by
      unfold hw
      rw [if_neg]
      rintro ⟨⟨hsq, -, hc⟩, -⟩
      apply h2
      rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq, Finset.card_eq_zero.1 hc, Finset.prod_empty]
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.2 ⟨mul_one d, hd⟩) h

/-! ### Support and level -/

/-- **Support**: `ℓ_X(d) ≠ 0` only for `d = b·a` with `b` squarefree with all prime factors
low (`< u`), and `a` a squarefree product of high primes with admissible box vector. -/
theorem ellX_support (hS : S.Good) {d : ℕ} (h : S.ellX d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∃ b a, b * a = d ∧ S.kappa J b ≠ 0 ∧
      (Squarefree b ∧ ∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0) ∧
      S.GoodHigh J a ∧ S.HighAdm a.primeFactors := by
  rw [ellX_eq_setForm hS] at h
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hJne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
  have hJne' : ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 * S.hw J x.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hJne; rw [h0, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hJne'
  have hk : S.kappa J x.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxne (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
  have hh : S.hw J x.2 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxne (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  exact ⟨J, hJ, x.1, x.2, (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx).1, hk, kappa_support hk,
    hw_support hh⟩

theorem high_part_le (hS : S.Good) {J a : ℕ} (hg : S.GoodHigh J a)
    (hadm : S.HighAdm a.primeFactors) : (a : ℝ) ≤ S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) := by
  obtain ⟨hsq, hhigh, -⟩ := hg
  have hτ : 0 ≤ 1 + S.tau := by linarith [tau_pos hS]
  have hDint1 : 1 ≤ S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) := Real.one_le_rpow (Dint_gt_one hS).le hτ
  rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
  push_cast
  rcases a.primeFactors.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hemp | hne
  · rw [hemp, Finset.prod_empty]; exact hDint1
  have hle : ∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, (q : ℝ) ≤ ∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, S.fBox q ^ (1 + S.tau) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    intro q hq
    have := (boxOf_spec (hhigh q hq)).2.2
    rwa [boxTop] at this
  rw [Real.finset_prod_rpow a.primeFactors S.fBox (fun q _ => (boxEnd_pos hS _).le)] at hle
  have hlt := prod_fBox_lt hS hhigh hne hadm
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, S.fBox q :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun q _ => (boxEnd_pos hS _).le)
  calc ∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, (q : ℝ) ≤ (∏ q ∈ a.primeFactors, S.fBox q) ^ (1 + S.tau) := hle
    _ ≤ S.threshold a.primeFactors.card ^ (1 + S.tau) := Real.rpow_le_rpow h0 hlt.le hτ
    _ ≤ S.Dint ^ (1 + S.tau) := threshold_rpow_le hS _

/-- **Level**: `ℓ_X(d) ≠ 0 ⇒ d ≤ D_tot = D_low · D_int^{1+τ}`. -/
theorem ellX_level (hS : S.Good) {d : ℕ} (h : S.ellX d ≠ 0) : (d : ℝ) ≤ S.Dtot := by
  obtain ⟨J, -, b, a, rfl, hk, -, hg, hadm⟩ := ellX_support hS h
  have hb := kappa_level hS hk
  have ha := high_part_le hS hg hadm
  rw [← Dlow_mul hS]
  push_cast
  exact mul_le_mul hb ha (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_trans zero_le_one (Dlow_ge_one hS))

/-! ### The pointwise majorant -/

theorem kappa_hw_coprime (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (b a : ℕ) (h : S.kappa J b * S.hw J a ≠ 0) :
    Nat.Coprime b a := by
  have hk : S.kappa J b ≠ 0 := fun h0 => h (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
  have hh : S.hw J a ≠ 0 := fun h0 => h (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  obtain ⟨-, hlow⟩ := kappa_support hk
  obtain ⟨⟨hsq, hhigh, -⟩, -⟩ := hw_support hh
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, ← Nat.Coprime]
  apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
  intro p hp hpb hpa
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; apply hk
    unfold kappa; split_ifs <;> simp [lamLowPlus, lamLowMinus]
  have h1 := hlow p (Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, hpb, hb0⟩)
  have h2 := hhigh p (Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨hp, hpa, hsq.ne_zero⟩)
  exact not_low_of_high hS h2 h1

/-- **`U_X(v) = ∑_J (-1)^J K_J(v) HW_J(v)`** with `K_J(v) = ∑_{b∣v} κ_J(b)`,
`HW_J(v) = ∑_{a∣v} hw_J(a)`. -/
theorem UX_eq_parity_sum (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    S.UX v = ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J *
      ((∑ b ∈ v.divisors, S.kappa J b) * (∑ a ∈ v.divisors, S.hw J a)) := by
  unfold UX
  simp_rw [ellX_eq_setForm hS]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => ?_)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_divisors_antidiag hv (fun b a => S.kappa J b * S.hw J a)
    (fun b a h => kappa_hw_coprime hS b a h), Finset.sum_mul_sum]

/-- The high box sum: `∑_{J ≤ T²} (-1)^J ∑_{a∣v} hw_J(a) ≥ 1_{no high prime divides v}`. -/
theorem high_sum_ge (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) [DecidablePred S.IsHigh] :
    (if v.primeFactors.filter S.IsHigh = ∅ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, S.hw J a := by
  classical
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  set g : ℕ → ℝ := fun a => ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.hw J a with hg
  have hgsupp : ∀ d, g d ≠ 0 → Squarefree d ∧ ∀ p ∈ d.primeFactors, S.IsHigh p := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨J, -, hJ⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hd
    have : S.hw J d ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hJ (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨⟨hsq, hhigh, -⟩, -⟩ := hw_support this
    exact ⟨hsq, hhigh⟩
  rw [show (∑ a ∈ v.divisors, ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.hw J a) =
    ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, g a from rfl, sum_divisors_eq_sum_powerset hv S.IsHigh g hgsupp]
  set Th := v.primeFactors.filter S.IsHigh
  have hThigh : ∀ A ∈ Th.powerset, ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p := fun A hA p hp =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_powerset.1 hA hp)).2
  -- value of `g` on a squarefree product of high primes
  have hgA : ∀ A ∈ Th.powerset, g (∏ p ∈ A, p) =
      if S.HighAdm A ∧ A.card ≤ S.T ^ 2 then (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card else 0 := by
    intro A hA
    have hAp : ∀ p ∈ A, p.Prime := fun p hp => (hThigh A hA p hp).1
    have hpf : (∏ p ∈ A, p).primeFactors = A := Nat.primeFactors_prod hAp
    simp only [hg]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single A.card]
    · unfold hw GoodHigh
      rw [hpf]
      by_cases hc : S.HighAdm A ∧ A.card ≤ S.T ^ 2
      · rw [if_pos ⟨⟨squarefree_prod_primes hAp, hThigh A hA, rfl⟩, hc.1⟩, if_pos hc, mul_one]
      · rw [if_neg hc]
        by_cases hadm : S.HighAdm A
        · have hmem : A.card ∉ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1) := by
            intro hm; exact hc ⟨hadm, Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hm)⟩
          rw [if_pos ⟨⟨squarefree_prod_primes hAp, hThigh A hA, rfl⟩, hadm⟩, mul_one]
          -- this branch is outside the summation range: handled below
          exact absurd (Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 (card_le_T_sq hS (hThigh A hA) (fun p hp hev =>
            lt_of_lt_of_le (hadm p hp hev) (threshold_le_Dint hS _)))) (by
              rwa [Finset.mem_range] at hmem)
        · rw [if_neg (fun h => hadm h.2), mul_zero]
    · intro J _ hJ
      unfold hw GoodHigh
      rw [hpf, if_neg (fun h => hJ h.1.2.2.symm), mul_zero]
    · intro hm
      unfold hw GoodHigh
      rw [hpf]
      by_cases hadm : S.HighAdm A
      · exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_iff.2 (card_le_T_sq hS (hThigh A hA)
          (fun p hp hev => lt_of_lt_of_le (hadm p hp hev) (threshold_le_Dint hS _))))) hm
      · rw [if_neg (fun h => hadm h.2), mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hgA]
  -- compare with the uniform family `OddPosAdm fBox D_int`
  have key := rosser_upper (OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint) S.IsHigh (OddPosAdm_empty _ _)
    (OddPosAdm_pre _ _) (OddPosAdm_ext _ _ _) Th (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2)
  have key' := (Int.cast_le (R := ℝ)).2 key
  push_cast at key'
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq_of_le ?_ key') (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun A hA => ?_))
  · rfl
  · -- termwise comparison
    by_cases hev : Even A.card
    · have : (S.HighAdm A ∧ A.card ≤ S.T ^ 2) ↔ OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint A := by
        unfold HighAdm threshold
        rw [if_pos hev]
        exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, card_le_T_sq hS (hThigh A hA) h⟩⟩
      by_cases h : OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint A
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (this.2 h)]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (this.1 h'))]
    · have hneg : (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card = -1 := Odd.neg_one_pow (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 hev)
      have himp : S.HighAdm A → OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint A := fun h p hp hev' =>
        lt_of_lt_of_le (h p hp hev') (threshold_le_Dint hS _)
      rw [hneg]
      by_cases h : OddPosAdm S.fBox S.Dint A
      · rw [if_pos h]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (himp h'.1))]

/-- **Pointwise lower bound** `U_X(v) ≥ 1_{(v,P(u))=1} · 1_{no high prime divides v}`. -/
theorem UX_ge_rough (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) [DecidablePred S.IsHigh] :
    roughLow S.u0 v * (if v.primeFactors.filter S.IsHigh = ∅ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ S.UX v := by
  rw [UX_eq_parity_sum hS hv]
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ roughLow S.u0 v := by unfold roughLow; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  calc roughLow S.u0 v * (if v.primeFactors.filter S.IsHigh = ∅ then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ roughLow S.u0 v * ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J *
          ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, S.hw J a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (high_sum_ge hS hv) hρ0
    _ = ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ J *
          (roughLow S.u0 v * ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, S.hw J a) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => by ring)
    _ ≤ _ := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun J _ => ?_)
        have hHW : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ v.divisors, S.hw J a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => hw_nonneg J a)
        by_cases hev : Even J
        · rw [hev.neg_one_pow, one_mul, one_mul, kappa_even hev]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (lamLowPlus_sum_ge hv) hHW
        · rw [(Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 hev).neg_one_pow, kappa_odd hev, neg_one_mul, neg_one_mul,
            neg_le_neg_iff]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (lamLowMinus_sum_le hS hv) hHW

/-- **`U_X(v) ≥ 0`** for every `v ≥ 1`. -/
theorem UX_nonneg (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ S.UX v := by
  classical
  refine le_trans ?_ (UX_ge_rough hS hv)
  have : 0 ≤ roughLow S.u0 v := by unfold roughLow; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  exact mul_nonneg this (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)

/-- **Majorant**: `U_X(v) ≥ 1` whenever `v ≥ 1` has no prime factor `≤ z = D_H`. -/
theorem UX_majorant (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ p ∈ v.primeFactors, S.ztop < p) : 1 ≤ S.UX v := by
  classical
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (UX_ge_rough hS hv)
  have hu : S.u0 ≤ S.ztop := boxEnd_ge_u0 hS _
  have h1 : roughLow S.u0 v = 1 := by
    unfold roughLow
    rw [if_pos]
    rw [Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro p hp hlt
    have := hz p hp
    linarith
  have h2 : v.primeFactors.filter S.IsHigh = ∅ := by
    rw [Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro p hp hh
    have := hz p hp
    have := high_le_ztop hS hh
    linarith
  rw [h1, if_pos h2, one_mul]

/-- **The pointwise upper-majorant statement**:
`U_X(v) ≥ 1_{v has no prime factor ≤ z}` and `U_X(v) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem UX_ge_indicator (hS : S.Good) {v : ℕ} (hv : v ≠ 0) [Decidable (∀ p ∈ v.primeFactors, S.ztop < p)] :
    (if ∀ p ∈ v.primeFactors, S.ztop < p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ S.UX v := by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact UX_majorant hS hv h
  · exact UX_nonneg hS hv

/-- **Prime event**: `U_X(p) ≥ 1` for every prime `p > z`. -/
theorem UX_ge_one_of_prime (hS : S.Good) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpz : S.ztop < p) :
    1 ≤ S.UX p := by
  refine UX_majorant hS hp.ne_zero (fun q hq => ?_)
  rw [hp.primeFactors, Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
  rw [hq]; exact hpz

end ScalarParams

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=14321 sha256=a87ab1a4266aa9c1f73dded331b745409beb823e989eee0aa16dd29cc5044573 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/Ownership.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.LowSieve

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: box ownership and the labelled-tuple convention

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

The key combinatorial identity behind the convention `B_P = T_P/γ(P)` (§14, Lichtman §5):
for every `a`,

`∑_{P ∈ 𝐃_J^+} B_P(a) = 1_{a squarefree, all prime factors high, ω(a) = J, ν(a) ∈ 𝐃_J^+}`

where `ν(a)` is the (unique) box vector of `a` — the boxes of its prime factors in decreasing
order (Lichtman's map `ν`, "each integer `p_1 ⋯ p_r` has a unique vector").  This is
`sum_Bcoef_eq_hw`.  Ingredients:

* `Tcount_eq_card_perm` — for good `a`, `T_P(a)` counts the permutations `π` with `ν ∘ π = P`;
* `Tcount_eq_zero` — `T_P(a) = 0` unless `a` is a squarefree product of `J` high primes;
* `perm_count_eq_gamma` — if `ν ∘ π₀ = P` then `#{π : ν ∘ π = P} = γ(P)` (orbit–stabiliser,
  `DomMulAct.stabilizer_card`);
* `eq_of_antitone_comp` — an antitone `P = ν ∘ π` with `ν` antitone forces `P = ν`
  (uniqueness of the nonincreasing ordering, `Tuple.unique_monotone`);
* `boxAdm_nu_iff` — `ν(a) ∈ 𝐃_J^+` (index form) iff the prime-set form `HighAdm`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

/-- Decreasing enumeration `p_1 > p_2 > ⋯ > p_J` of a finite set of naturals. -/
noncomputable def desc (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) (i : Fin J) : ℕ :=
  A.orderEmbOfFin h i.rev

theorem desc_mem (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) (i : Fin J) : desc A h i ∈ A :=
  A.orderEmbOfFin_mem h _

theorem desc_lt_iff (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) {i j : Fin J} :
    desc A h i < desc A h j ↔ j < i := by
  unfold desc
  rw [(A.orderEmbOfFin h).lt_iff_lt, Fin.rev_lt_rev]

theorem desc_strictAnti (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) : StrictAnti (desc A h) :=
  fun _ _ hij => (desc_lt_iff A h).2 hij

theorem desc_injective (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) : Function.Injective (desc A h) :=
  (desc_strictAnti A h).injective

theorem desc_surj (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ A) :
    ∃ i, desc A h i = p := by
  have : p ∈ Set.range (A.orderEmbOfFin h) := by rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]; exact hp
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := this
  exact ⟨j.rev, by simp [desc, hj]⟩

theorem image_desc (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) : univ.image (desc A h) = A := by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hi ▸ desc_mem A h i, fun hp => desc_surj A h hp⟩

theorem prod_desc {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J)
    (f : ℕ → M) : ∏ i, f (desc A h i) = ∏ q ∈ A, f q := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← image_desc A h]
  rw [Finset.prod_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => desc_injective A h hxy)]

theorem above_desc (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) (i : Fin J) :
    above A (desc A h i) = (univ.filter (· < i)).image (desc A h) := by
  ext q
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hlt⟩
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := desc_surj A h hq
    exact ⟨j, (desc_lt_iff A h).1 hlt, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨desc_mem A h j, (desc_lt_iff A h).2 hj⟩

theorem card_above_desc (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J) (i : Fin J) :
    (above A (desc A h i)).card = i := by
  rw [above_desc, card_image_of_injective _ (desc_injective A h),
    show univ.filter (· < i) = Finset.Iio i by ext; simp]
  simp

theorem prod_above_desc {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J)
    (i : Fin J) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ∏ q ∈ above A (desc A h i), f q = ∏ j ∈ univ.filter (· < i), f (desc A h j) := by
  rw [above_desc, Finset.prod_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => desc_injective A h hxy)]

/-- An antitone `P = ν ∘ π` with `ν` antitone forces `P = ν`. -/
theorem eq_of_antitone_comp {J : ℕ} {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β] {ν P : Fin J → β}
    (hν : Antitone ν) (hP : Antitone P) {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin J)} (h : ν ∘ π = P) : P = ν := by
  have h1 : Monotone ((OrderDual.toDual ∘ ν) ∘ π) := by
    rw [Function.comp_assoc, h]; exact hP
  have h2 : Monotone ((OrderDual.toDual ∘ ν) ∘ (Equiv.refl (Fin J) : Equiv.Perm (Fin J))) := by
    simpa using hν
  have := Tuple.unique_monotone h1 h2
  rw [← h]
  funext i
  have := congrFun this i
  simpa using this

/-- If `ν ∘ π₀ = P` then `#{π : ν ∘ π = P} = γ(P) = ∏_b (#P⁻¹(b))!`. -/
theorem perm_count_eq_gamma {J : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {ν P : Fin J → ι}
    {π₀ : Equiv.Perm (Fin J)} (h0 : ν ∘ π₀ = P) :
    (univ.filter (fun π : Equiv.Perm (Fin J) => ν ∘ π = P)).card =
      ∏ b : ι, (univ.filter (fun i => P i = b)).card.factorial := by
  have hstab := DomMulAct.stabilizer_card P
  have hfib : ∀ b : ι, Fintype.card {i // P i = b} = (univ.filter (fun i => P i = b)).card :=
    fun b => Fintype.card_subtype _
  simp only [hfib] at hstab
  rw [← hstab, ← Fintype.card_subtype]
  refine Fintype.card_congr
    { toFun := fun π => ⟨π₀⁻¹ * π.1, ?_⟩
      invFun := fun g => ⟨π₀ * g.1, ?_⟩
      left_inv := fun π => by ext; simp
      right_inv := fun g => by ext; simp }
  · funext i
    have h1 := congrFun π.2 i
    have h2 := congrFun h0 (π₀⁻¹ (π.1 i))
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul, Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [← h2, h1]
  · funext i
    have h1 := congrFun g.2 i
    have h2 := congrFun h0 (g.1 i)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.Perm.coe_mul] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [h2, h1]

namespace ScalarParams

variable {S : ScalarParams}

/-- The prime-set form of Lichtman's `𝐃_J^+` for the box vector of a set `A` of high primes. -/
def HighAdm (S : ScalarParams) (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ A, Even (above A p).card →
    (∏ q ∈ above A p, S.boxEnd (S.boxOf q)) * S.boxEnd (S.boxOf p) ^ 3 < S.threshold A.card

/-- Good arguments for `B_P`: squarefree products of `J` high primes. -/
def GoodHigh (S : ScalarParams) (J a : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Squarefree a ∧ (∀ p ∈ a.primeFactors, S.IsHigh p) ∧ a.primeFactors.card = J

open Classical in
/-- **Set form of the high-prime weight**:
`hw_J(a) = 1_{a = p_1 ⋯ p_J squarefree, all p_i high, ν(a) ∈ 𝐃_J^+}`. -/
noncomputable def hw (S : ScalarParams) (J a : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if S.GoodHigh J a ∧ S.HighAdm a.primeFactors then 1 else 0

/-- The box vector `ν(A)` of a set of high primes (decreasing order). -/
noncomputable def nu (S : ScalarParams) (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J)
    (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p) : Fin J → Fin S.H :=
  fun i => ⟨S.boxOf (desc A h i), (boxOf_spec (hA _ (desc_mem A h i))).1⟩

theorem nu_antitone (hS : S.Good) (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J)
    (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p) : Antitone (S.nu A h hA) := by
  intro i j hij
  show S.boxOf (desc A h j) ≤ S.boxOf (desc A h i)
  exact boxOf_mono hS (hA _ (desc_mem A h j)) (hA _ (desc_mem A h i))
    ((desc_strictAnti A h).antitone hij)

theorem boxAdm_nu_iff (hS : S.Good) (A : Finset ℕ) {J : ℕ} (h : A.card = J)
    (hA : ∀ p ∈ A, S.IsHigh p) : S.BoxAdm J (S.nu A h hA) ↔ S.HighAdm A := by
  unfold BoxAdm HighAdm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hc⟩ p hp hev
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := desc_surj A h hp
    rw [card_above_desc] at hev
    rw [prod_above_desc, h]
    exact hc i hev
  · intro hc
    refine ⟨nu_antitone hS A h hA, fun i hev => ?_⟩
    have := hc (desc A h i) (desc_mem A h i) (by rw [card_above_desc]; exact hev)
    rw [prod_above_desc, h] at this
    exact this

/-- Structure of a labelled tuple: its entries are distinct primes in the boxes. -/
theorem mem_tuples {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {p : Fin J → ℕ} (hp : p ∈ S.tuples J P) :
    Function.Injective p ∧ ∀ i, (p i).Prime ∧ S.InBox (P i) (p i) := by
  classical
  unfold tuples at hp
  rw [mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hp
  exact ⟨hp.2, fun i => (mem_filter.1 (hp.1 i)).2⟩

theorem tuple_prod {J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {p : Fin J → ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ S.tuples J P) :
    S.GoodHigh J (∏ i, p i) ∧ (∏ i, p i).primeFactors = univ.image p := by
  obtain ⟨hinj, hpr⟩ := mem_tuples hp
  have himg : ∀ q ∈ univ.image p, q.Prime := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hq
    exact (hpr i).1
  have hprod : ∏ i, p i = ∏ q ∈ univ.image p, q := by
    rw [Finset.prod_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hinj hxy)]
  unfold GoodHigh
  rw [hprod, Nat.primeFactors_prod himg]
  refine ⟨⟨squarefree_prod_primes himg, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hq
    exact ⟨(hpr i).1, P i, (P i).2, (hpr i).2⟩
  · rw [card_image_of_injective _ hinj]; simp

theorem Tcount_eq_zero {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : ¬ S.GoodHigh J a) : S.Tcount J P a = 0 := by
  unfold Tcount
  rw [card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff]
  intro p hp hpa
  exact ha (hpa ▸ (tuple_prod hp).1)

/-- For good `a`, `T_P(a) = #{π : ν(a) ∘ π = P}`. -/
theorem Tcount_eq_card_perm (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : S.GoodHigh J a) :
    S.Tcount J P a = (univ.filter (fun π : Equiv.Perm (Fin J) =>
      S.nu a.primeFactors ha.2.2 ha.2.1 ∘ π = P)).card := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hsq, hhigh, hcard⟩ := ha
  set A := a.primeFactors with hA
  have hprodA : ∏ q ∈ A, q = a := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq
  unfold Tcount
  symm
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun π _ => fun i => desc A hcard (π i)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro π hπ
    have hπ' := (mem_filter.1 hπ).2
    rw [mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold tuples
      rw [mem_filter, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
      refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i j hij => π.injective (desc_injective A hcard hij)⟩
      have hm := desc_mem A hcard (π i)
      have hhi := hhigh _ hm
      have hbox : S.boxOf (desc A hcard (π i)) = P i := by
        have := congrFun hπ' i
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, nu] at this
        exact congrArg Fin.val this
      have hin := (boxOf_spec hhi).2
      rw [hbox] at hin
      rw [mem_filter, mem_range]
      refine ⟨?_, hhi.1, hin⟩
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_floor hin.2)
    · rw [Equiv.prod_comp π (fun i => desc A hcard i),
        show ∏ i, desc A hcard i = ∏ q ∈ A, q from prod_desc A hcard (fun q => q)]
      exact hprodA
  · intro π₁ _ π₂ _ h
    ext i
    have := congrFun h i
    exact congrArg Fin.val (desc_injective A hcard this)
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hpt, hpa⟩ := mem_filter.1 hp
    obtain ⟨hinj, hpr⟩ := mem_tuples hpt
    have hpA : ∀ i, p i ∈ A := by
      intro i
      rw [hA, Nat.mem_primeFactors]
      refine ⟨(hpr i).1, ?_, hsq.ne_zero⟩
      rw [← hpa]; exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem p (mem_univ i)
    -- `p` is a bijection `Fin J → A`
    let p' : Fin J → A := fun i => ⟨p i, hpA i⟩
    have hp'inj : Function.Injective p' := fun i j hij => hinj (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
    have hp'bij : Function.Bijective p' := by
      rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
      exact ⟨hp'inj, by simp [hcard]⟩
    let d' : Fin J → A := fun i => ⟨desc A hcard i, desc_mem A hcard i⟩
    have hd'bij : Function.Bijective d' := by
      rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card]
      exact ⟨fun i j hij => desc_injective A hcard (congrArg Subtype.val hij), by simp [hcard]⟩
    let e := Equiv.ofBijective d' hd'bij
    let π : Equiv.Perm (Fin J) := (Equiv.ofBijective p' hp'bij).trans e.symm
    have hπ : ∀ i, desc A hcard (π i) = p i := by
      intro i
      have : d' (π i) = p' i := by
        show e (e.symm (p' i)) = p' i
        exact e.apply_symm_apply _
      exact congrArg Subtype.val this
    refine ⟨π, ?_, funext hπ⟩
    rw [mem_filter]
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, funext fun i => ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, nu]
    rw [hπ i]
    exact boxOf_eq hS (hhigh _ (hpA i)) (hpr i).2

theorem gammaP_pos {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : 0 < S.gammaP J P :=
  Finset.prod_pos (fun _ _ => Nat.factorial_pos _)

open Classical in
/-- **Ownership identity**: `∑_{P ∈ 𝐃_J^+} B_P(a) = hw_J(a)`. -/
theorem sum_Bcoef_eq_hw (hS : S.Good) (J a : ℕ) :
    (∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, if S.BoxAdm J P then S.Bcoef J P a else 0) = S.hw J a := by
  classical
  by_cases ha : S.GoodHigh J a
  · set ν := S.nu a.primeFactors ha.2.2 ha.2.1 with hν
    have hzero : ∀ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, P ≠ ν →
        (if S.BoxAdm J P then S.Bcoef J P a else 0) = 0 := by
      intro P hP
      split_ifs with hadm
      · unfold Bcoef
        rw [Tcount_eq_card_perm hS P ha, card_eq_zero.2, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
        rw [filter_eq_empty_iff]
        intro π _ hπ
        exact hP (eq_of_antitone_comp (nu_antitone hS _ _ _) hadm.1 hπ)
      · rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ν (fun P _ hP => hzero P hP) (fun h => absurd (mem_univ _) h)]
    unfold hw
    have hiff := boxAdm_nu_iff hS a.primeFactors ha.2.2 ha.2.1
    by_cases hadm : S.BoxAdm J ν
    · rw [if_pos hadm, if_pos ⟨ha, hiff.1 hadm⟩]
      unfold Bcoef
      rw [Tcount_eq_card_perm hS ν ha,
        perm_count_eq_gamma (π₀ := Equiv.refl _) (by rfl)]
      have := gammaP_pos (S := S) ν
      unfold gammaP at this ⊢
      rw [div_self (by exact_mod_cast this.ne')]
    · rw [if_neg hadm, if_neg (fun h => hadm (hiff.2 h.2))]
  · unfold hw
    rw [if_neg (fun h => ha h.1)]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun P _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · unfold Bcoef; rw [Tcount_eq_zero P ha]; simp
    · rfl

/-- **The complete scalar coefficient in set form** (Lichtman's ownership map `ν`):
`ℓ_X(d) = ∑_{J ≤ ε₀^{-2}} (-1)^J ∑_{ba = d} κ_J(b) hw_J(a)`. -/
theorem ellX_eq_setForm (hS : S.Good) (d : ℕ) :
    S.ellX d = ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1),
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 * S.hw J x.2 := by
  unfold ellX
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => ?_)
  simp_rw [← sum_Bcoef_eq_hw hS J, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => ?_)
  split_ifs <;> simp

end ScalarParams

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=12948 sha256=7fc72b2afdb3bd3398bbfa0180d666ef9fe904a770cc5c94c989c15e5a50f21f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Scalar/RosserCore.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — scalar sieve: the combinatorial Rosser (β-sieve) inequality

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Generic finite combinatorics behind the pointwise sieve inequalities for the
upper/lower linear-sieve supports `𝒟^±(D)` (Pascadi, arXiv:2505.00653v2, Definition 5.1) and for
Lichtman's parity-dependent box supports `𝐃_r^+` (Lichtman, arXiv:2109.02851v2, §5).

A squarefree number is encoded by its (finite) set of prime factors, listed in *decreasing*
order `p_1 > p_2 > ⋯`.  The position of `p ∈ S` in that list is `1 + #{q ∈ S : p < q}`, so
"odd position" means `Even #{q ∈ S : p < q}`.

* `rosserSum D s R = ∑_{S ⊆ R} 1_{D(s ∪ S)} (-1)^{|S|}`;
* `rosserSum_insert` — peeling an element;
* `rosser_upper` / `rosser_lower` — if `D` is closed under deleting the smallest element and
  membership can only fail at odd (resp. even) positions, then
  `∑_{S ⊆ T, D S} (-1)^{|S|} ≥ 1_{T=∅}` (resp. `≤ 1_{T=∅}`);
* `exists_odd_position_witness` / `exists_even_position_witness` — the product of a monotone
  weight `f ≥ 1` over `S` is controlled by the condition at a single odd (resp. even, or first)
  position.  This gives the level bounds of the supports.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

variable {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]

/-- `G(s, R) = ∑_{S ⊆ R} 1_{D(s ∪ S)} (-1)^{|S|}`. -/
def rosserSum (D : Finset α → Prop) [DecidablePred D] (s R : Finset α) : ℤ :=
  ∑ S ∈ R.powerset, if D (s ∪ S) then (-1) ^ S.card else 0

/-- Peeling an element `a ∉ R`: `G(s, R ∪ {a}) = G(s, R) - G(s ∪ {a}, R)`. -/
theorem rosserSum_insert (D : Finset α → Prop) [DecidablePred D] (s R : Finset α) {a : α}
    (ha : a ∉ R) :
    rosserSum D s (insert a R) = rosserSum D s R - rosserSum D (insert a s) R := by
  unfold rosserSum
  rw [Finset.sum_powerset_insert ha, sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun S hS => ?_)
  have haS : a ∉ S := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_powerset.1 hS h)
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem haS,
    show s ∪ insert a S = insert a s ∪ S by
      ext x; simp only [mem_union, mem_insert]; tauto]
  split_ifs <;> simp [pow_succ]

/-- The generic parity-sensitive Rosser inequality.  `E` is the parity of `|s|` at which an
extension by a smaller element is automatic (`Odd` for the upper sieve, `Even` for the lower). -/
theorem rosser_generic (D : Finset α → Prop) [DecidablePred D] (U : α → Prop) (E : ℕ → Prop)
    (hE : ∀ n, E (n + 1) ↔ ¬ E n)
    (hpre : ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → D (insert p s) → D s)
    (hext : ∀ s p, U p → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → E s.card → D s → D (insert p s)) :
    ∀ R : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ R, U x) → ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ s, x < y) →
      (¬ E s.card → (if D s ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) ≤ rosserSum D s R) ∧
      (E s.card → rosserSum D s R ≤ if D s ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
  intro R
  induction R using Finset.induction_on_max with
  | h0 =>
    intro _ s _
    have : rosserSum D s ∅ = if D s ∧ (∅ : Finset α) = ∅ then 1 else 0 := by
      simp [rosserSum]
    exact ⟨fun _ => this.ge, fun _ => this.le⟩
  | step a R hlt ih =>
    intro hU s hRs
    have haR : a ∉ R := fun h => lt_irrefl a (hlt a h)
    have hUR : ∀ x ∈ R, U x := fun x hx => hU x (mem_insert_of_mem hx)
    have hUa : U a := hU a (mem_insert_self a R)
    have has : ∀ y ∈ s, a < y := fun y hy => hRs a (mem_insert_self a R) y hy
    have hRs' : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ s, x < y := fun x hx y hy => hRs x (mem_insert_of_mem hx) y hy
    have hRas : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ insert a s, x < y := by
      intro x hx y hy
      rcases mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy
      · exact hlt x hx
      · exact hRs' x hx y hy
    have hcard : (insert a s).card = s.card + 1 :=
      card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => lt_irrefl a (has a h))
    have hne : ¬ (D s ∧ insert a R = ∅) := fun h => (insert_ne_empty a R) h.2
    rw [rosserSum_insert D s R haR, if_neg hne]
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih hUR s hRs'
    obtain ⟨ih3, ih4⟩ := ih hUR (insert a s) hRas
    rw [hcard] at ih3 ih4
    refine ⟨fun hs => ?_, fun hs => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := ih1 hs
      have h2 := ih4 ((hE _).2 hs)
      have h3 : (if D (insert a s) ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) ≤
          (if D s ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
        by_cases h : D (insert a s) ∧ R = ∅
        · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ⟨hpre s a has h.1, h.2⟩]
        · rw [if_neg h]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      linarith
    · have h1 := ih2 hs
      have h2 := ih3 (fun h => ((hE _).1 h) hs)
      have h3 : (if D (insert a s) ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) =
          (if D s ∧ R = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) := by
        have : D (insert a s) ↔ D s := ⟨hpre s a has, hext s a hUa has hs⟩
        simp only [this]
      linarith

/-- **Upper Rosser inequality**: conditions only at odd positions. -/
theorem rosser_upper (D : Finset α → Prop) [DecidablePred D] (U : α → Prop) (hD0 : D ∅)
    (hpre : ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → D (insert p s) → D s)
    (hext : ∀ s p, U p → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → Odd s.card → D s → D (insert p s))
    (T : Finset α) (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, U x) :
    (if T = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) ≤ ∑ S ∈ T.powerset, if D S then (-1) ^ S.card else 0 := by
  have := (rosser_generic D U Odd (fun n => Nat.odd_add_one) hpre hext T hT ∅
    (by simp)).1 (by simp)
  simpa [rosserSum, hD0] using this

/-- **Lower Rosser inequality**: conditions only at even positions (plus an arbitrary
condition at the first position, encoded in `U`). -/
theorem rosser_lower (D : Finset α → Prop) [DecidablePred D] (U : α → Prop)
    (hpre : ∀ s p, (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → D (insert p s) → D s)
    (hext : ∀ s p, U p → (∀ x ∈ s, p < x) → Even s.card → D s → D (insert p s))
    (T : Finset α) (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, U x) :
    (∑ S ∈ T.powerset, if D S then (-1) ^ S.card else 0) ≤ if T = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0 := by
  have := (rosser_generic D U Even (fun n => Nat.even_add_one) hpre hext T hT ∅
    (by simp)).2 (by simp)
  have h2 : (if D ∅ ∧ T = ∅ then (1 : ℤ) else 0) ≤ if T = ∅ then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  exact (by simpa [rosserSum] using this : _ ≤ _).trans h2

/-! ### Level witnesses -/

/-- The elements of `S` above `p` (the primes preceding `p` in decreasing order). -/
def above (S : Finset α) (p : α) : Finset α := S.filter (fun q => p < q)

theorem above_insert_of_lt {s : Finset α} {p q : α} (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, p < x) (hq : q ∈ s) :
    above (insert p s) q = above s q := by
  ext x
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl | hx, hqx⟩
    · exact absurd (hp q hq) (not_lt.2 hqx.le)
    · exact ⟨hx, hqx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hqx⟩; exact ⟨Or.inr hx, hqx⟩

theorem above_insert_self {s : Finset α} {p : α} (hp : ∀ x ∈ s, p < x) :
    above (insert p s) p = s := by
  ext x
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rfl | hx, hpx⟩
    · exact absurd hpx (lt_irrefl _)
    · exact hx
  · intro hx; exact ⟨Or.inr hx, hp x hx⟩

theorem above_min (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    above S (S.min' hS) = S.erase (S.min' hS) := by
  ext x
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hlt⟩; exact ⟨ne_of_gt hlt, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hx⟩; exact ⟨hx, lt_of_le_of_ne (S.min'_le x hx) (Ne.symm hne)⟩

theorem above_second (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hne : (S.erase (S.min' hS)).Nonempty) :
    above S ((S.erase (S.min' hS)).min' hne) =
      (S.erase (S.min' hS)).erase ((S.erase (S.min' hS)).min' hne) := by
  set m := S.min' hS
  set m2 := (S.erase m).min' hne
  have hm2 : m2 ∈ S.erase m := (S.erase m).min'_mem hne
  have hm2S : m2 ∈ S := mem_of_mem_erase hm2
  have hmm2 : m < m2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (S.min'_le m2 hm2S) (Ne.symm (ne_of_mem_erase hm2))
  ext x
  simp only [above, mem_filter, mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hlt⟩
    exact ⟨ne_of_gt hlt, ne_of_gt (hmm2.trans hlt), hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨h2, h1, hx⟩
    exact ⟨hx, lt_of_le_of_ne ((S.erase m).min'_le x (mem_erase.2 ⟨h1, hx⟩)) (Ne.symm h2)⟩

/-- Two-smallest-elements product bound used by both witnesses. -/
theorem prod_le_second (f : α → ℝ) (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hne : (S.erase (S.min' hS)).Nonempty)
    (hf1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ f x) (hmono : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≤ y → f x ≤ f y) :
    ∏ q ∈ S, f q ≤ (∏ q ∈ (S.erase (S.min' hS)).erase ((S.erase (S.min' hS)).min' hne), f q) *
      f ((S.erase (S.min' hS)).min' hne) ^ 2 := by
  set m := S.min' hS
  set m2 := (S.erase m).min' hne
  have hm : m ∈ S := S.min'_mem hS
  have hm2 : m2 ∈ S.erase m := (S.erase m).min'_mem hne
  have hm2S : m2 ∈ S := mem_of_mem_erase hm2
  have hmm2 : m < m2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (S.min'_le m2 hm2S) (Ne.symm (ne_of_mem_erase hm2))
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase S f hm, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (S.erase m) f hm2]
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x hx => by
    linarith [hf1 x (mem_of_mem_erase (mem_of_mem_erase hx))])
  have h1 := hf1 m hm
  have h2 := hmono m hm m2 hm2S hmm2.le
  have h3 : f m * (f m2 * ∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q) ≤
      f m2 * (f m2 * ∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) h0
  calc f m * (f m2 * ∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q)
      ≤ f m2 * (f m2 * ∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q) := h3
    _ = (∏ q ∈ (S.erase m).erase m2, f q) * f m2 ^ 2 := by ring

theorem prod_le_first (f : α → ℝ) (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hf1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ f x) :
    ∏ q ∈ S, f q ≤ (∏ q ∈ S.erase (S.min' hS), f q) * f (S.min' hS) ^ 2 := by
  have hm : S.min' hS ∈ S := S.min'_mem hS
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase S f hm, mul_comm, pow_two]
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∏ q ∈ S.erase (S.min' hS), f q := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun x hx => by
    linarith [hf1 x (mem_of_mem_erase hx)])
  have := hf1 _ hm
  have h3 : (∏ q ∈ S.erase (S.min' hS), f q) * 1 ≤
      (∏ q ∈ S.erase (S.min' hS), f q) * f (S.min' hS) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this h0
  nlinarith

/-- A monotone weight `f ≥ 1` on a nonempty `S`: the full product is bounded by
`(∏_{above p} f) · f(p)^2` for some `p` at an **odd** position (`Even #above`). -/
theorem exists_odd_position_witness (f : α → ℝ) (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hf1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ f x) (hmono : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≤ y → f x ≤ f y) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, Even (above S p).card ∧ ∏ q ∈ S, f q ≤ (∏ q ∈ above S p, f q) * f p ^ 2 := by
  by_cases hev : Even (S.erase (S.min' hS)).card
  · exact ⟨_, S.min'_mem hS, by rw [above_min]; exact hev,
      by rw [above_min]; exact prod_le_first f S hS hf1⟩
  · have hne : (S.erase (S.min' hS)).Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; intro h; rw [h] at hev; exact hev (by simp)
    have hm2 := (S.erase (S.min' hS)).min'_mem hne
    refine ⟨_, mem_of_mem_erase hm2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [above_second S hS hne, card_erase_of_mem hm2]
      rcases Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 hev with ⟨k, hk⟩
      rw [hk]; simp
    · rw [above_second S hS hne]; exact prod_le_second f S hS hne hf1 hmono

/-- A monotone weight `f ≥ 1` on a nonempty `S`: the full product is bounded by
`(∏_{above p} f) · f(p)^2` for some `p` at an **even** position, or for the **largest**
element (first position, `above = ∅`). -/
theorem exists_even_position_witness (f : α → ℝ) (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hf1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ f x) (hmono : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≤ y → f x ≤ f y) :
    ∃ p ∈ S, (Odd (above S p).card ∨ above S p = ∅) ∧
      ∏ q ∈ S, f q ≤ (∏ q ∈ above S p, f q) * f p ^ 2 := by
  have hbase := prod_le_first f S hS hf1
  rw [← above_min] at hbase
  by_cases hodd : Odd (S.erase (S.min' hS)).card
  · exact ⟨_, S.min'_mem hS, Or.inl (by rw [above_min]; exact hodd), hbase⟩
  · by_cases hemp : S.erase (S.min' hS) = ∅
    · exact ⟨_, S.min'_mem hS, Or.inr (by rw [above_min]; exact hemp), hbase⟩
    have hne : (S.erase (S.min' hS)).Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hemp
    have hm2 := (S.erase (S.min' hS)).min'_mem hne
    refine ⟨_, mem_of_mem_erase hm2, Or.inl ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [above_second S hS hne, card_erase_of_mem hm2]
      rcases Nat.not_odd_iff_even.1 hodd with ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl; simp at hk; exact hemp hk
      obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk0
      rw [hk]; exact ⟨k', by omega⟩
    · rw [above_second S hS hne]; exact prod_le_second f S hS hne hf1 hmono

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.RosserCore

/-!
# Erdős #287 — the actual parity-sensitive scalar sieve coefficient `ℓ_X`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Literal definitions of `sources/physical_spec.md` §§13–15, with the precise conventions taken
from the original sources:

* Pascadi, arXiv:2505.00653v2, **Definition 5.1** (`𝒟^±(D)`, `𝐃_r^±(D)`) and the standard weights
  `λ^±_d = μ(d) 1_{d ∈ 𝒟^±(D)}`;
* Lichtman, arXiv:2109.02851v2, **§5** (the Proposition at the start of §5, the box grid
  `D^{ε²(1+τ)^j}`, the parity-dependent `𝐃_r^+`, the multiplicity factor `γ`, and the weights
  `λ^{(r)}_{(D_1,…,D_r)} = λ_{(D_1,…,D_r)} * λ^{(r)}` of `(lamD1Dr)`, `(lambdapm)`).

Levels (§13): `ε₀ = 1/T`, `τ = ε₀⁹`, `D_tot = X^{59/100}`, `D_int = D_tot^{1/(1+ε₀+τ)}`,
`u = D_int^{ε₀²}`, `D_low = D_int^{ε₀}`.  (Lichtman's `D` is our `D_int`; his `D^ε` is `D_low`;
his `u = D^{ε²}` is `u0`.)

Low primes: `p < u` (Lichtman: `b ∣ P(u)`, `P(u) = ∏_{p<u} p`).
High boxes: `I_j = (D_j, D_j^{1+τ}]` with `D_j = u^{(1+τ)^j}`, for the indices `j < H` with
`D_j ≤ √D_int` (Lichtman: `D_r ≤ ⋯ ≤ D_1 ≤ √D`).

A squarefree number is encoded by its set of prime factors; the decreasing enumeration
`p_1 > p_2 > ⋯` gives `p` the position `1 + #{q ∈ S : p < q}` (`Sieve.above`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

/-- Pascadi Def. 5.1, `𝒟^+(D)` on squarefree numbers (encoded by their prime sets):
`p_1 ⋯ p_{j-1} p_j^3 ≤ D` for every odd position `j`. -/
def DplusSet (D : ℝ) (S : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ S, Even (above S p).card → (∏ q ∈ above S p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ D

/-- Pascadi Def. 5.1, `𝒟^-(D)`: `p_1 ⋯ p_{j-1} p_j^3 ≤ D` for every even position `j`, and
`p_1^2 ≤ D` for the largest prime `p_1`. -/
def DminusSet (D : ℝ) (S : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ p ∈ S, Odd (above S p).card → (∏ q ∈ above S p, (q : ℝ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ D) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ S, above S p = ∅ → (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ D)

/-- The scalar parameters: the scale `X` and the reciprocal integer `T` (`ε₀ = 1/T`). -/
structure ScalarParams where
  X : ℝ
  T : ℕ

namespace ScalarParams

variable (S : ScalarParams)

/-- `ε₀ = 1/T`. -/
noncomputable def eps0 : ℝ := 1 / (S.T : ℝ)
/-- `τ = ε₀⁹`. -/
noncomputable def tau : ℝ := S.eps0 ^ 9
/-- `D_tot = X^{59/100}`. -/
noncomputable def Dtot : ℝ := S.X ^ ((59 : ℝ) / 100)
/-- `D_int = D_tot^{1/(1+ε₀+τ)}`. -/
noncomputable def Dint : ℝ := S.Dtot ^ (1 / (1 + S.eps0 + S.tau))
/-- `u = D_int^{ε₀²}` (low/high prime cutoff, bottom of the box grid). -/
noncomputable def u0 : ℝ := S.Dint ^ (S.eps0 ^ 2)
/-- `D_low = D_int^{ε₀}` (level of the low-prime weights). -/
noncomputable def Dlow : ℝ := S.Dint ^ S.eps0

/-! ### Low-prime weights -/

/-- A low prime: `p < u`. -/
def IsLow (p : ℕ) : Prop := p.Prime ∧ (p : ℝ) < S.u0

open Classical in
/-- **`λ⁺_low`**: `μ(b) 1_{b ∣ P(u)} 1_{b ∈ 𝒟^+(D_low)}`. -/
noncomputable def lamLowPlus (b : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Squarefree b ∧ (∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0) ∧ DplusSet S.Dlow b.primeFactors
  then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius b : ℝ) else 0

open Classical in
/-- **`λ⁻_low`**: `μ(b) 1_{b ∣ P(u)} 1_{b ∈ 𝒟^-(D_low)}`. -/
noncomputable def lamLowMinus (b : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Squarefree b ∧ (∀ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) < S.u0) ∧ DminusSet S.Dlow b.primeFactors
  then (ArithmeticFunction.moebius b : ℝ) else 0

/-- **`κ_J`**: `λ⁺_low` for even high parity `J`, `λ⁻_low` for odd `J`. -/
noncomputable def kappa (J : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := if Even J then S.lamLowPlus else S.lamLowMinus

/-! ### High-prime box grid -/

/-- Box endpoints `D_j = u^{(1+τ)^j}` (Lichtman: `D^{ε²(1+τ)^j}`). -/
noncomputable def boxEnd (j : ℕ) : ℝ := S.u0 ^ ((1 + S.tau) ^ j)

/-- Top of box `j`: `D_j^{1+τ}`. -/
noncomputable def boxTop (j : ℕ) : ℝ := S.boxEnd j ^ (1 + S.tau)

open Classical in
/-- Number of boxes: the least `j` with `D_j > √D_int` (the grid is `{j : D_j ≤ √D_int}`). -/
noncomputable def H : ℕ :=
  if h : ∃ j, Real.sqrt S.Dint < S.boxEnd j then Nat.find h else 0

/-- `p` lies in box `j`: `D_j < p ≤ D_j^{1+τ}`. -/
def InBox (j : ℕ) (p : ℕ) : Prop := S.boxEnd j < p ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S.boxTop j

/-- A high prime: a prime owned by some box of the grid. -/
def IsHigh (p : ℕ) : Prop := p.Prime ∧ ∃ j < S.H, S.InBox j p

open Classical in
/-- The (unique, see `boxOf_spec`) box owning a high prime. -/
noncomputable def boxOf (p : ℕ) : ℕ := if h : ∃ j, j < S.H ∧ S.InBox j p then Nat.find h else 0

/-- Lichtman's threshold: `D_int` for even `r`, `D_int^{1/(1+τ)}` for odd `r`. -/
noncomputable def threshold (J : ℕ) : ℝ := if Even J then S.Dint else S.Dint ^ (1 / (1 + S.tau))

/-- **Lichtman's `𝐃_J^+`** for a labelled box vector `P = (P_1, …, P_J)` (`P_1 ≥ ⋯ ≥ P_J`,
box values `D_{P_i}`): for every odd position `m ≤ J`,
`D_{P_1} ⋯ D_{P_{m-1}} D_{P_m}^3 < D_int` (`J` even), `< D_int^{1/(1+τ)}` (`J` odd).
(`0`-indexed: position `m = i+1` is odd iff `i` is even.) -/
def BoxAdm (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : Prop :=
  Antitone P ∧ ∀ i : Fin J, Even (i : ℕ) →
    (∏ i' ∈ univ.filter (· < i), S.boxEnd (P i')) * S.boxEnd (P i) ^ 3 < S.threshold J

open Classical in
/-- Labelled tuples of pairwise distinct primes, the `i`-th in box `P_i`. -/
noncomputable def tuples (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : Finset (Fin J → ℕ) :=
  (Fintype.piFinset fun i => (range (⌊S.boxTop (P i)⌋₊ + 1)).filter
    (fun p => p.Prime ∧ S.InBox (P i) p)).filter Function.Injective

open Classical in
/-- **`T_P(a)`**: number of labelled tuples of pairwise distinct primes in the boxes `P` with
product `a`. -/
noncomputable def Tcount (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (a : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((S.tuples J P).filter (fun p => ∏ i, p i = a)).card

/-- **`γ(P) = ∏_I m_I!`**, `m_I` the multiplicity of box `I` in `P`. -/
noncomputable def gammaP (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) : ℕ :=
  ∏ b : Fin S.H, (univ.filter (fun i => P i = b)).card.factorial

/-- **`B_P(a) = T_P(a)/γ(P)`** (the single canonical labelled-tuple convention). -/
noncomputable def Bcoef (J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (a : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (S.Tcount J P a : ℝ) / (S.gammaP J P : ℝ)

/-! ### The complete scalar coefficient -/

open Classical in
/-- **The complete parity-sensitive scalar coefficient** (§15; Lichtman `(lambdapm)`):
`ℓ_X(d) = ∑_{0 ≤ J ≤ ε₀^{-2}} ∑_{P ∈ 𝐃_J^+} (-1)^J ∑_{ba = d} κ_J(b) B_P(a)`. -/
noncomputable def ellX (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H,
    if S.BoxAdm J P then
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ J * ∑ x ∈ d.divisorsAntidiagonal, S.kappa J x.1 * S.Bcoef J P x.2
    else 0

/-- **`U_X(v) = ∑_{d ∣ v} ℓ_X(d)`**. -/
noncomputable def UX (v : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ d ∈ v.divisors, S.ellX d

/-- The top of the box grid, `z = D_H = u^{(1+τ)^H}`. -/
noncomputable def ztop : ℝ := S.boxEnd S.H

/-- Standing hypotheses on the parameters: `T ≥ 2` and `X > 1`. -/
structure Good : Prop where
  T_two : 2 ≤ S.T
  X_gt : 1 < S.X

end ScalarParams

end Erdos287.Physical.Sieve

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3243 sha256=0737906d686d3e490478c68e5a5e69624feddfa91f9fc9b4fe5281e1cec2c43d path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/SourceAudit.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Bridge
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.TypeII.Instance

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source completion: axiom audit and negative controls

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Each `#print axioms` line must report only `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (or a
subset): no `sorryAx`, no `Lean.ofReduceBool`, no custom axiom.
-/

open Erdos287.Physical

#print axioms Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams.lamLowMinus_sum_le

/-- The multiplicative split `U_{lr} = U_l U_r` (used by `typeII_split_Z`) genuinely needs
`(l, r) = 1`: it fails at `l = r = 2`. -/

    Erdos287.Physical.TypeII.Uz (2 * 2) 1 ≠
