@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6203 sha256=3125376a8574983234bad70df780c87674f12964c2bce5abb3b92838e578e79f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/Tail.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.OneSidedSevenBlock
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Remainder
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Presieve

/-!
# Erdős #287 — physical source: the physical remainder plugged into the one-sided tail boundary

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.  Every theorem here is CONDITIONAL.**

The existing tail consumer `tail_of_remainder_littleO_oneSided` only uses the remainder as a
function of the scale.  Here it is restated for an arbitrary remainder function
(`OneSidedFrameworkFor`, `tail_of_littleO_for`; `framework_iff` shows the old framework is the
special case `R = (S.T X).RSigmaP`), and then instantiated with the **literal physical
remainder** `physicalFamily.R X = R_Σ^P(X)` built in `Physical/Remainder.lean`:

* `physDataAt P₀ X` — the physical data at scale `X` with the actual presieve `W = physW X`;
* `physDataAt_wgood` — the presieve hypotheses hold for all large `X` (proved);
* `physical_littleO_of_rel_base` — `R_rel = o(target)` and `R_base = o(target)` imply
  `R_Σ^P = o(target)` (via the proved exact centering `R_Σ^P = R_rel + R_base`);
* `Tail287_of_physical` — **conditional**: the one-sided seven-block framework for the physical
  remainder, plus `R_rel = o`, `R_base = o`, imply `Tail287Statement`.

The framework, `R_rel = o(𝒩_X I)` and `R_base = o(𝒩_X I)` remain explicit hypotheses.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.Physical

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87 Erdos287.PostV87V90R Erdos287.CurrentTail
  Erdos287.SourceChain

/-- The one-sided seven-block framework, for an arbitrary remainder function `R`. -/
structure OneSidedFrameworkFor (R target : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  errors : ∃ e₁ e₂ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ ε > 0, ∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X0, e₁ X ≤ ε ∧ e₂ X ≤ ε) ∧
    ∀ X0 : ℕ, ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M →
      ∃ X ≥ X0, ∃ (K : ℕ) (C : AffineContactCompiler 7 2 K) (F : FiniteWeights) (H : ℕ),
        OneSidedSevenBlockDictionary F (blockCount C) (e₁ X) (e₂ X) (R X) (target X) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → WindowControl C W.a W.M H t

/-- The old framework is the special case `R X = (S.T X).RSigmaP`. -/
theorem framework_iff {ι : Type*} (S : TailSourceFamily ι) :
    OneSidedSevenBlockTailFramework S ↔
      OneSidedFrameworkFor (fun X => (S.T X).RSigmaP) S.target :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.errors⟩, fun h => ⟨h.errors⟩⟩

/-- **Tail boundary for an arbitrary remainder function** (conditional). -/
theorem tail_of_littleO_for {R target : ℕ → ℝ} (Fw : OneSidedFrameworkFor R target)
    (h : IsLittleOTarget R target) : Tail287Statement := by
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, he, hscale⟩ := Fw.errors
  obtain ⟨X1, hX1⟩ := h (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨X2, hX2⟩ := he (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := hscale (max X1 X2)
  refine ⟨M0, fun A hA => ?_⟩
  by_contra hlt
  push_neg at hlt
  set W := ofCounterexample hA
  have ha : 1 < W.a := ofCounterexample_one_lt_a hA
  have hM : M0 ≤ W.M := by rw [ofCounterexample_M]; exact hlt
  obtain ⟨X, hX, K, C, F, H, D, hctrl⟩ := hM0 W ha hM
  have hR : |R X| ≤ 1 / 2 * target X := by
    simpa using hX1 X ((le_max_left _ _).trans hX)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hX2 X ((le_max_right _ _).trans hX)
  have hq : |R X| / target X ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ D.NI_pos]; linarith
  exact seven_block_contact_false_oneSided W C F D (by linarith) (by linarith) hctrl

/-- The physical data at scale `X`: fixed slopes/test function from `P₀`, scale `X`, and the
actual presieve modulus `W = physW X`. -/
noncomputable def physDataAt (P₀ : PhysData) (X : ℕ) : PhysData :=
  { P₀ with W := physW X, X := X }

/-- The presieve hypotheses hold at the physical `W` for all large `X`. -/
theorem physDataAt_wgood (P₀ : PhysData) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < P₀.a i)
    (hinj : Function.Injective P₀.a) : ∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X0, (physDataAt P₀ X).WGood := by
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0⟩ := wgood_eventually P₀ ha hinj
  refine ⟨⌈Y0⌉₊, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  have hX' : Y0 ≤ (X : ℝ) := (Nat.le_ceil Y0).trans (by exact_mod_cast hX)
  have h := hY0 X hX'
  exact ⟨h.a_pos, h.W_pos, h.slope, h.diff⟩

/-- A scale-indexed physical source: physical data and scalar sieve at each scale, with the
normalisation `target X = 𝒩_X I(F)`. -/
structure PhysicalFamily where
  P : ℕ → PhysData
  S : ℕ → ScalarSieve
  target : ℕ → ℝ

namespace PhysicalFamily

variable (F : PhysicalFamily)

/-- The literal physical remainder `R_Σ^P(X)` of the family. -/
noncomputable def R (X : ℕ) : ℝ := (F.P X).RSigmaP (F.S X)

/-- The relative part `R_rel(X)`. -/
noncomputable def Rrel (X : ℕ) : ℝ := (F.P X).Rrel (F.S X)

/-- The base part `R_base(X)`. -/
noncomputable def Rbase (X : ℕ) : ℝ := (F.P X).Rbase (F.S X)

/-- `R_rel = o(target)`, `R_base = o(target)` ⟹ `R_Σ^P = o(target)` (exact centering). -/
theorem physical_littleO_of_rel_base
    (hgood : ∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X0, (F.P X).WGood ∧ (F.S X).Good (F.P X).W)
    (hrel : IsLittleOTarget F.Rrel F.target) (hbase : IsLittleOTarget F.Rbase F.target) :
    IsLittleOTarget F.R F.target := by
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0⟩ := hgood
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨X1, hX1⟩ := hrel.add hbase ε hε
  refine ⟨max X0 X1, fun X hX => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hP, hS⟩ := hX0 X ((le_max_left _ _).trans hX)
  have := hX1 X ((le_max_right _ _).trans hX)
  unfold R
  rw [PhysData.RSigmaP_eq_rel_add_base hP (F.S X) hS]
  exact this

/-- **Conditional tail theorem with the literal physical remainder.**  Hypotheses: the
one-sided seven-block framework for `R_Σ^P`, the presieve/support conditions for large `X`,
and `R_rel = o(𝒩_X I)`, `R_base = o(𝒩_X I)`.  NOT unconditional. -/
theorem Tail287_of_physical (Fw : OneSidedFrameworkFor F.R F.target)
    (hgood : ∃ X0 : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X0, (F.P X).WGood ∧ (F.S X).Good (F.P X).W)
    (hrel : IsLittleOTarget F.Rrel F.target) (hbase : IsLittleOTarget F.Rbase F.target) :
    Tail287Statement :=
  tail_of_littleO_for Fw (F.physical_littleO_of_rel_base hgood hrel hbase)

end PhysicalFamily

end Erdos287.Physical

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=16352 sha256=47e886949725c4a9bd876dae21271e1258afa7ffced9f5d52d28c940e912c29f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/TypeII/Cells.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.TypeII.HeathBrown

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Type-II source: dyadic Heath–Brown cells and the coefficients `α_n`, `β_m`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Following Maynard (arXiv:2006.07088v1, proof of Theorem 1.1 after Lemma 5.3): apply
`heathBrown_three`, keep the roughness condition `P^-(n) ≥ z₀`, and put each of the six variables
`n_1, n_2, n_3, m_1, m_2, m_3` into a dyadic interval `[2^e, 2^{e+1})`.

* `hbVar j i` — the six variable sequences of the `j`-th Heath–Brown term (`j = 1,2,3`):
  `n_1 ↦ log n_1`, `n_2, n_3 ↦ 1`, `m_1, m_2, m_3 ↦ μ(m) 1_{m ≤ z}`; unused variables are the
  Dirichlet unit `δ`;
* `hbTerm j = ∏_i hbVar j i` and `hbTerm_eq` — this is `log * ζ^{j-1} * M_z^j`;
* `rough z₀`, `roughVar` — the roughness indicator `1_{P^-(n) ≥ z₀}` inserted in every variable;
  `rough_mul_apply` — exact for rough `n` (`P^-` is completely multiplicative in this sense);
* `dy e f` — dyadic restriction; `cellSeq j z₀ e = ∏_i dy (e i) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar j i))`;
* `prod_eq_sum_cells` — exact dyadic decomposition for `n < 2^E`;
* `alphaSeq`, `betaSeq` — for a branch with critical variable `c`, `α = dy (e c) (var c)` and
  `β = ∏_{i ≠ c} dy (e i) (var i)`; `cellSeq_eq_alpha_mul_beta`;
* `abs_alpha_le` — `|α_n| ≤ 1 + log n`; `alpha_support` — `α_n ≠ 0 ⇒ 2^{e_c} ≤ n < 2^{e_c+1}`;
* `abs_betaSeq_le` — `|β_m| ≤ (1 + log m)^5 d_5(m)`; `divisorPow_le` — `d_k(m) ≤ τ(m)^{k-1}`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators ArithmeticFunction.Moebius ArithmeticFunction.zeta
open Finset ArithmeticFunction

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

/-- The six Heath–Brown variable sequences of the `j`-th term (`j ∈ {1,2,3}`), indexed by
`i : Fin 6 = (n_1, n_2, n_3, m_1, m_2, m_3)`. -/
noncomputable def hbVar (z : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin 6) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  match i with
  | 0 => log
  | 1 => if 2 ≤ j then (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) else 1
  | 2 => if 3 ≤ j then (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) else 1
  | 3 => Mz z
  | 4 => if 2 ≤ j then Mz z else 1
  | 5 => if 3 ≤ j then Mz z else 1

/-- The `j`-th Heath–Brown convolution `∏_i hbVar j i`. -/
noncomputable def hbTerm (z j : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ∏ i, hbVar z j i

theorem hbTerm_one (z : ℕ) : hbTerm z 1 = log * Mz z := by
  simp [hbTerm, Fin.prod_univ_succ, hbVar]

theorem hbTerm_two (z : ℕ) : hbTerm z 2 = log * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Mz z ^ 2 := by
  simp [hbTerm, Fin.prod_univ_succ, hbVar]; ring

theorem hbTerm_three (z : ℕ) :
    hbTerm z 3 = log * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ 2 * Mz z ^ 3 := by
  simp [hbTerm, Fin.prod_univ_succ, hbVar]; ring

/-- **Heath–Brown in six-variable form**: for `n < (z+1)^3`,
`Λ(n) = 3 hbTerm₁(n) - 3 hbTerm₂(n) + hbTerm₃(n)`. -/
theorem heathBrown_cells (z : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < (z + 1) ^ 3) :
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n =
      3 * hbTerm z 1 n - 3 * hbTerm z 2 n + hbTerm z 3 n := by
  rw [hbTerm_one, hbTerm_two, hbTerm_three]
  exact heathBrown_three z hn

/-! ### Roughness -/

/-- `P^-(n) ≥ z₀`: every prime factor of `n` is at least `z₀`. -/
def Rough (z₀ n : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, z₀ ≤ p

instance (z₀ n : ℕ) : Decidable (Rough z₀ n) := by unfold Rough; infer_instance

open Classical in
/-- Insert the roughness indicator `1_{P^-(n) ≥ z₀}` into a sequence. -/
noncomputable def roughVar (z₀ : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun n => if Rough z₀ n then f n else 0, by simp⟩

theorem roughVar_apply (z₀ : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    roughVar z₀ f n = if Rough z₀ n then f n else 0 := rfl

theorem rough_of_dvd {z₀ a n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (ha : a ∣ n) (h : Rough z₀ n) : Rough z₀ a :=
  fun p hp => h p (Nat.primeFactors_mono ha hn hp)

theorem rough_mul {z₀ a b : ℕ} (ha : Rough z₀ a) (hb : Rough z₀ b) : Rough z₀ (a * b) := by
  intro p hp
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha0
  · simp at hp
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb0
  · simp at hp
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul ha0.ne' hb0.ne', Finset.mem_union] at hp
  rcases hp with hp | hp
  · exact ha p hp
  · exact hb p hp

/-- For rough `n`, roughness can be inserted in both factors of a convolution. -/
theorem rough_mul_apply (z₀ : ℕ) (f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : Rough z₀ n) :
    (f * g) n = (roughVar z₀ f * roughVar z₀ g) n := by
  classical
  rw [mul_apply, mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hmul, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
  rw [roughVar_apply, roughVar_apply,
    if_pos (rough_of_dvd hn0 (Dvd.intro _ hmul) hn),
    if_pos (rough_of_dvd hn0 (Dvd.intro_left _ hmul) hn)]

/-- Roughness inserted in all factors of a finite convolution product, for rough `n`. -/
theorem rough_prod_apply {ι : Type*} (z₀ : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, Rough z₀ n → (∏ i ∈ s, f i) n = (∏ i ∈ s, roughVar z₀ (f i)) n := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro n _; simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, rough_mul_apply z₀ _ _ hn, mul_apply,
      mul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hmul, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have h2 : Rough z₀ x.2 := rough_of_dvd hn0 (Dvd.intro_left _ hmul) hn
    congr 1
    rw [roughVar_apply, if_pos h2, ih h2]

/-! ### Dyadic cells -/

open Classical in
/-- Dyadic restriction `f · 1_{[2^e, 2^{e+1})}`. -/
noncomputable def dy (e : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun n => if 2 ^ e ≤ n ∧ n < 2 ^ (e + 1) then f n else 0, by simp⟩

theorem dy_apply (e : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    dy e f n = if 2 ^ e ≤ n ∧ n < 2 ^ (e + 1) then f n else 0 := rfl

open Classical in
/-- Truncation `f · 1_{n < 2^E}`. -/
noncomputable def truncE (E : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun n => if n < 2 ^ E then f n else 0, by simp⟩

theorem truncE_apply (E : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    truncE E f n = if n < 2 ^ E then f n else 0 := rfl

theorem truncE_eq_sum_dy (E : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    truncE E f = ∑ e ∈ range E, dy e f := by
  ext n
  rw [sum_apply', truncE_apply]
  simp_rw [dy_apply]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  by_cases hE : n < 2 ^ E
  · rw [if_pos hE]
    -- exactly one dyadic block contains `n`
    have hlog : 2 ^ Nat.log 2 n ≤ n ∧ n < 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 n + 1) :=
      ⟨Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn.ne', Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) n⟩
    have hmem : Nat.log 2 n ∈ range E := by
      rw [Finset.mem_range]
      by_contra h; push_neg at h
      have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < 2 by norm_num) h
      omega
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Nat.log 2 n)]
    · rw [if_pos hlog]
    · intro e _ hne
      rw [if_neg]
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      apply hne
      exact (Nat.log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow h1 h2).symm
    · intro h; exact absurd hmem h
  · rw [if_neg hE]
    refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e he => ?_)).symm
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨-, h2⟩
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < 2 by norm_num) (Finset.mem_range.1 he)
    apply hE; calc n < 2 ^ (e + 1) := h2
      _ ≤ 2 ^ E := this

/-- Truncating every factor does not change a convolution product below `2^E`. -/
theorem prod_truncE_apply {ι : Type*} (E : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction ℝ) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, n < 2 ^ E → (∏ i ∈ s, f i) n = (∏ i ∈ s, truncE E (f i)) n := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro n _; simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, mul_apply, mul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hmul, hn0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    have h1 : x.1 < 2 ^ E := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)
      (Dvd.intro _ hmul)) hn
    have h2 : x.2 < 2 ^ E := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)
      (Dvd.intro_left _ hmul)) hn
    rw [truncE_apply, if_pos h1, ih h2]

/-- **Exact dyadic decomposition**: for `n < 2^E`,
`(∏_i f_i)(n) = ∑_{e ∈ [0,E)^6} (∏_i dy (e i) f_i)(n)`. -/
theorem prod_eq_sum_cells (E : ℕ) (f : Fin 6 → ArithmeticFunction ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 2 ^ E) :
    (∏ i, f i) n = ∑ e ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 6 => range E), (∏ i, dy (e i) (f i)) n := by
  classical
  rw [prod_truncE_apply E univ f hn]
  simp_rw [truncE_eq_sum_dy]
  rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum, sum_apply']

/-- The cell sequence of a dyadic Heath–Brown cell (with roughness). -/
noncomputable def cellSeq (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ∏ i, dy (e i) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar z j i))

/-- **Rough Heath–Brown term as a sum of dyadic cells** (`n` rough, `n < 2^E`). -/
theorem hbTerm_eq_sum_cells (z z₀ j E : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hr : Rough z₀ n) (hn : n < 2 ^ E) :
    hbTerm z j n = ∑ e ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 6 => range E), cellSeq z z₀ j e n := by
  unfold hbTerm cellSeq
  rw [rough_prod_apply z₀ univ _ hr, prod_eq_sum_cells E _ hn]

/-! ### Branch coefficients -/

/-- **`α_n`**: the critical variable `c` of the cell `e` of the `j`-th term. -/
noncomputable def alphaSeq (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  dy (e c) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar z j c))

/-- **`β_m`**: the convolution of the five complementary variables. -/
noncomputable def betaSeq (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ∏ i ∈ univ.erase c, dy (e i) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar z j i))

theorem cellSeq_eq_alpha_mul_beta (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) :
    cellSeq z z₀ j e = alphaSeq z z₀ j e c * betaSeq z z₀ j e c := by
  unfold cellSeq alphaSeq betaSeq
  exact (Finset.mul_prod_erase univ (fun i => dy (e i) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar z j i)))
    (mem_univ c)).symm

theorem abs_hbVar_le (z j : ℕ) (i : Fin 6) (n : ℕ) : |hbVar z j i n| ≤ 1 + Real.log n := by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_natCast_nonneg n
  have hMz : |Mz z n| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Mz_apply]; split_ifs
    · exact_mod_cast abs_moebius_le_one
    · simp
  have hζ : |(ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) n| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [natCoe_apply, zeta_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
  have h1 : |(1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) n| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [one_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [hbVar] <;> (try split_ifs) <;>
    first
    | (rw [log_apply, abs_of_nonneg hlog]; linarith)
    | linarith

theorem abs_roughVar_le {z₀ : ℕ} {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} {n : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h : |f n| ≤ B) : |roughVar z₀ f n| ≤ B := by
  classical
  rw [roughVar_apply]; split_ifs
  · exact h
  · simpa using hB

theorem abs_dy_le {e : ℕ} {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} {n : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h : |f n| ≤ B) : |dy e f n| ≤ B := by
  rw [dy_apply]; split_ifs
  · exact h
  · simpa using hB

/-- **Coefficient bound** `|α_n| ≤ 1 + log n`. -/
theorem abs_alpha_le (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) (n : ℕ) :
    |alphaSeq z z₀ j e c n| ≤ 1 + Real.log n := by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log n := by linarith [Real.log_natCast_nonneg n]
  exact abs_dy_le h0 (abs_roughVar_le h0 (abs_hbVar_le z j c n))

/-- **Support** of `α`: the dyadic block `[2^{e_c}, 2^{e_c+1})`, and only rough `n`. -/
theorem alpha_support (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) {n : ℕ}
    (h : alphaSeq z z₀ j e c n ≠ 0) : 2 ^ e c ≤ n ∧ n < 2 ^ (e c + 1) ∧ Rough z₀ n := by
  classical
  unfold alphaSeq at h
  rw [dy_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h with hd
  · refine ⟨hd.1, hd.2, ?_⟩
    rw [roughVar_apply] at h
    split_ifs at h with hr
    · exact hr
    · exact absurd rfl h
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- Generic convolution bound: if every factor is bounded by `B_i` on `[0, M]`, then
`|(∏ f_i)(m)| ≤ (∏ B_i) d_{|s|}(m)` for `m ≤ M`. -/
theorem abs_prod_apply_le {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
    (B : ι → ℝ) (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ B i) (M : ℕ) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ a ≤ M, |f i a| ≤ B i) :
    ∀ m ≤ M, |(∏ i ∈ s, f i) m| ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, B i) *
      (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ s.card) m := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro m _
    simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.card_empty, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [one_apply]; split_ifs <;> simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro m hm
    have hBs : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ B i := fun i hi => hB i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    have hfs : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ a ≤ M, |f i a| ≤ B i := fun i hi => hf i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha, pow_succ',
      mul_apply, coe_zeta_mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
    rw [Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' (fun x y => |f a x * (∏ i ∈ s, f i) y|)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d hd => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hdm, hm0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisors.1 hd
    have hd1 : m / d ≤ M := (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans hm
    have hd2 : d ≤ M := (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0) hdm).trans hm
    rw [abs_mul]
    have h1 := hf a (mem_insert_self a s) (m / d) hd1
    have h2 := ih hBs hfs d hd2
    calc |f a (m / d)| * |(∏ i ∈ s, f i) d|
        ≤ B a * ((∏ i ∈ s, B i) * (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ s.card) d) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (hB a (mem_insert_self a s))
      _ = B a * (∏ i ∈ s, B i) * (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ s.card) d := by ring

/-- `d_k(m) = (ζ^k)(m) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem zetaPow_nonneg (k m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ k) m := by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, one_apply]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', coe_zeta_mul_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => ih d)

/-- **Divisor bound** `d_k(m) ≤ τ(m)^{k-1}` (`k ≥ 1`, `m ≥ 1`). -/
theorem divisorPow_le (k : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ (k + 1)) m ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ k := by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_add, pow_one, natCoe_apply, zeta_apply, if_neg hm]; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ' _ (k + 1), coe_zeta_mul_apply]
    calc ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ (k + 1)) d
        ≤ ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ k := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun d hd => ?_)
          obtain ⟨hdm, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisors.1 hd
          have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := fun h => hm (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h ▸ hdm))
          refine (ih hd0).trans ?_
          apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd hm hdm)
      _ = (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, pow_succ]; ring

/-- **Coefficient bound for `β`**: `|β_m| ≤ (1 + log m)^5 d_5(m)`, with `d_5(m) ≤ τ(m)^4`. -/
theorem abs_betaSeq_le (z z₀ j : ℕ) (e : Fin 6 → ℕ) (c : Fin 6) {m : ℕ} :
    |betaSeq z z₀ j e c m| ≤ (1 + Real.log m) ^ 5 *
      (((ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ 5) m := by
  have hcard : (univ.erase c).card = 5 := by rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (mem_univ c)]; simp
  have hlogm : 0 ≤ Real.log m := Real.log_natCast_nonneg m
  have h := abs_prod_apply_le (univ.erase c) (fun i => dy (e i) (roughVar z₀ (hbVar z j i)))
    (fun _ => 1 + Real.log m) (fun _ _ => by linarith) m (fun i _ a ha => by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log a := by linarith [Real.log_natCast_nonneg a]
      refine (abs_dy_le h0 (abs_roughVar_le h0 (abs_hbVar_le z j i a))).trans ?_
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha0
      · simp [hlogm]
      · have : Real.log a ≤ Real.log m :=
          Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast ha0) (by exact_mod_cast ha)
        linarith) m le_rfl
  rw [Finset.prod_const, hcard] at h
  unfold betaSeq
  exact h

end Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Factorization.Decomposition
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.TypeII.OrderingB

/-!
# Erdős #287 — the constructed Type-II coefficient (no free split parameter)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

This replaces the externally supplied `SplitRule σ` of `TypeII/Instance.lean`.  The Type-II
coefficient of an atom `λ = (J, P, χ)` (Pascadi colouring `c = atomColour δ N J P`) is

`c_{ξ,λ}(l, r) = Γ_ξ (-1)^J w_{J,P} · a₁(l) · (a₂ * a₃)(r) · 1[P ∈ 𝐃_J^+] 1[(f_ξ, l r) = 1]`

with `a₁ = κ_J * γ_{0,χ}`, `a₂ = γ_{1,χ}`, `a₃ = γ_{2,χ}`.  Proved:

* `physCoefAtom_reassemble` — summing the split coefficient over all atoms and all `(l, r)`
  returns **exactly** `Γ_ξ ∑_d 1[(f_ξ,d)=1] ℓ_X(d) g(d)` (each scalar term once; no packet
  multiplicity or designated-coordinate sum is introduced);
* `physCoefAtom_coprime` — every nonzero coefficient has `(l, r) = 1` and `(f_ξ, l r) = 1`;
* `physCoefAtom_abs_le` — `|c_{ξ,λ}(l,r)| ≤ |Γ_ξ| w_{J,P}` (one-bounded factors; the split of
  `r` into colours 1 and 2 is unique, `abs_conv12_le`);
* `physCoefAtom_ranges` — Pascadi ranges of the factors: `l ≤ N X^{-δ}`, `r = a₂ a₃` with
  `a₂ ≤ E₁`, `a₃ ≤ E₂`, `N² E₁ E₂² ≤ D_low² X^{1-δ}`, `N² E₁⁵ E₂² ≤ D_low² X^{2-δ}`;
* `typeII_source_decomp` — the independently defined scalar Type-II source
  `Γ ∑_d 1[(f,d)=1] ℓ_X(d) (I_d - U_d)(v)` equals
  `∑_λ ∑_{l,r} c_{ξ,λ}(l,r) (I_l h_r + h_l U_r)(v)` (exact Type-II split, atom by atom);
* `physOB` / `physOB_source_eq_T` — each atom's `I_l h_r` part is the actual Ordering-B cell
  built from **the same atom coefficient** (selected before the Cauchy step), and its
  independently defined source equals `T_ξ`.
-/

open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

open Erdos287.Physical.Sieve Erdos287.Physical.Sieve.ScalarParams Erdos287.Physical.Factor

/-- Box sums of a Dirichlet convolution. -/
lemma sum_box_conv (A B : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ r ∈ Ico 1 K, (if l * r < K then A l * B r * h (l * r) else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (A * B) d * h d := by
  classical
  have hanti : ∀ d ∈ Ico 1 K, d.divisorsAntidiagonal =
      (Ico 1 K ×ˢ Ico 1 K).filter (fun x => x.1 * x.2 = d) := by
    intro d hd
    rw [mem_Ico] at hd
    ext x
    simp only [Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_Ico]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hx, -⟩
      have h1 : x.1 ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at hx; omega
      have h2 : x.2 ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hx; omega
      have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right x.1 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h2)
      have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left x.2 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h1)
      refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩, hx⟩ <;> omega
    · rintro ⟨-, hx⟩; exact ⟨hx, by omega⟩
  have hR : ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (A * B) d * h d = ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 K ×ˢ Ico 1 K,
      if x.1 * x.2 = d then A x.1 * B x.2 * h (x.1 * x.2) else 0 := by
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => ?_)
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, hanti d hd, sum_filter, sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => ?_)
    split_ifs with hx
    · rw [hx]
    · simp
  rw [hR]
  conv_rhs => rw [sum_comm, sum_product]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun l hl => sum_congr rfl (fun r hr => ?_))
  rw [sum_ite_eq]
  rw [mem_Ico] at hl hr
  have hpos : 1 ≤ l * r := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  simp only [mem_Ico]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)

variable (S : ScalarParams)

open Classical in
/-- **The constructed Type-II coefficient of an atom** `λ = (J, P, χ)` (Pascadi colouring). -/
noncomputable def physCoefAtom (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (l r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if S.BoxAdm J P ∧ Nat.Coprime f (l * r) then
    Γ * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P)) *
      (S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ l *
        (S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 1 *
          S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 2) r)
  else 0

variable {S}

open Classical in
/-- **Lossless reassembly of `ℓ_X` from the constructed Type-II coefficients.** -/
theorem physCoefAtom_reassemble (hS : S.Good) (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f K : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
      ∑ l ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ r ∈ Ico 1 K,
        (if l * r < K then physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r * g (l * r) else 0) =
      Γ * ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * g d else 0 := by
  -- the right-hand side, atom by atom
  have hR : Γ * ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * g d else 0) =
      ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
        ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ *
          (S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 1 * S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 2)) d *
          (if S.BoxAdm J P ∧ Nat.Coprime f d then
            Γ * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P)) * g d else 0) := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    have hd : ∀ d ∈ Ico 1 K, Γ * (if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * g d else 0) =
        ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
          (S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ *
            (S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 1 * S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 2)) d *
            (if S.BoxAdm J P ∧ Nat.Coprime f d then
              Γ * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ J * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P)) * g d else 0) := by
      intro d _
      rw [ellX_tensor hS (S.atomColour δ N)]
      by_cases hc : Nat.Coprime f d
      · rw [if_pos hc, sum_mul, mul_sum]
        refine sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => ?_)
        rw [sum_mul, mul_sum]
        refine sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => ?_)
        by_cases hP : S.BoxAdm J P
        · rw [if_pos hP, if_pos ⟨hP, hc⟩, mul_sum, sum_mul, mul_sum]
          refine sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
          rw [← mul_assoc (S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ)]
          ring
        · rw [if_neg hP]; simp [hP]
      · rw [if_neg hc, mul_zero]; simp [hc]
    rw [sum_congr rfl hd, sum_comm]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => ?_)
    rw [sum_comm]
    refine sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => ?_)
    rw [sum_comm]
  rw [hR]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)))
  rw [← sum_box_conv]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => ?_))
  by_cases h1 : l * r < K
  · simp only [if_pos h1, physCoefAtom]
    by_cases h2 : S.BoxAdm J P ∧ Nat.Coprime f (l * r)
    · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos h2]; ring
    · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg h2]; ring
  · simp only [if_neg h1]

/-- The split of `r` into colours 1 and 2 is unique, so `|γ₁ * γ₂| ≤ 1`. -/
theorem abs_conv12_le (hS : S.Good) {J : ℕ} (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (c : ℕ → Fin 3)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (r : ℕ) :
    |(S.colFactor J P c χ 1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 2) r| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply]
  refine abs_sum_le_one_of_unique _ _ ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx y hy hfx hfy
    obtain ⟨hxm, hr0⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
    obtain ⟨hym, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hy
    obtain ⟨hx1, sx1, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS (left_ne_zero_of_mul hfx)
    obtain ⟨hx2, sx2, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS (right_ne_zero_of_mul hfx)
    obtain ⟨hy1, sy1, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS (left_ne_zero_of_mul hfy)
    obtain ⟨hy2, sy2, -⟩ := colFactor_support hS (right_ne_zero_of_mul hfy)
    -- the colour-1 part is determined by its factorization
    have key : ∀ (a b : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → a * b = r →
        (∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ a → S.chiAt χ p = 1) → (∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ b → S.chiAt χ p = 2) →
        ∀ p, a.factorization p = if S.chiAt χ p = 1 then r.factorization p else 0 := by
      intro a b ha hb hab h1 h2 p
      rw [← hab, Nat.factorization_mul ha hb, Finsupp.add_apply]
      by_cases hp : p.Prime
      · split_ifs with hc
        · have : ¬ p ∣ b := fun hd => by have := h2 p hp hd; rw [hc] at this; exact absurd this (by decide)
          rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd this, add_zero]
        · have : ¬ p ∣ a := fun hd => hc (h1 p hp hd)
          rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd this]
      · simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp]
    have e1 : x.1 = y.1 := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq hx1 hy1
      intro p
      rw [key x.1 x.2 hx1 hx2 hxm (fun p hp hd => (sx1 p hp hd).2) (fun p hp hd => (sx2 p hp hd).2),
        key y.1 y.2 hy1 hy2 hym (fun p hp hd => (sy1 p hp hd).2) (fun p hp hd => (sy2 p hp hd).2)]
    have e2 : x.2 = y.2 := by
      have : x.1 * x.2 = x.1 * y.2 := by rw [hxm, e1, hym]
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx1) this
    exact Prod.ext e1 e2
  · intro x _
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_one₀ (abs_colFactor_le hS P c χ 1 _) (abs_nonneg _) (abs_colFactor_le hS P c χ 2 _)

/-- **Coefficient bound**: `|c_{ξ,λ}(l,r)| ≤ |Γ_ξ| w_{J,P}`. -/
theorem physCoefAtom_abs_le (hS : S.Good) (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f J : ℕ) (P : Fin J → Fin S.H)
    (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (l r : ℕ) :
    |physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r| ≤ |Γ| * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) := by
  unfold physCoefAtom
  split_ifs
  · rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (atomWeight_nonneg P _)]
    have h1 := abs_lowFactor_le hS P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ l
    have h2 := abs_conv12_le hS P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ r
    have hw := atomWeight_nonneg P (S.atomColour δ N J P)
    have : |S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ l| *
        |(S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 1 *
          S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 2) r| ≤ 1 :=
      mul_le_one₀ h1 (abs_nonneg _) h2
    calc |Γ| * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) *
          (|S.lowFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ l| *
            |(S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 1 *
              S.colFactor J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) χ 2) r|)
        ≤ |Γ| * S.atomWeight J P (S.atomColour δ N J P) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hw)
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  · simp only [abs_zero]; exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (atomWeight_nonneg P _)

/-- Every nonzero constructed coefficient has `(l, r) = 1` and `(f, l r) = 1`. -/
theorem physCoefAtom_coprime (hS : S.Good) {δ N Γ : ℝ} {f J : ℕ} {P : Fin J → Fin S.H}
    {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {l r : ℕ} (h : physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r ≠ 0) :
    Nat.Coprime l r ∧ Nat.Coprime f (l * r) ∧ S.BoxAdm J P := by
  unfold physCoefAtom at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · refine ⟨lowFactor_coprime_high hS (P := P) (c := S.atomColour δ N J P) (χ := χ) ?_ ?_,
      hc.2, hc.1⟩
    · intro h0; apply h; rw [h0]; ring
    · intro h0; apply h; rw [h0]; ring
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- **Pascadi ranges of the constructed coefficient's factors.** -/
theorem physCoefAtom_ranges (hS : S.Good) {δ N Γ : ℝ} (hA : AtomParams S δ N) {f J : ℕ}
    {P : Fin J → Fin S.H} {χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3} {l r : ℕ}
    (h : physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r ≠ 0) :
    let c := S.atomColour δ N J P
    let E₁ := cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 1 J
    let E₂ := cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 2 J
    (l : ℝ) ≤ N * S.X ^ (-δ) ∧
      (∃ a₂ a₃ : ℕ, a₂ * a₃ = r ∧ (a₂ : ℝ) ≤ E₁ ∧ (a₃ : ℝ) ≤ E₂) ∧
      N ^ 2 * E₁ * E₂ ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (1 - δ) ∧
      N ^ 2 * E₁ ^ 5 * E₂ ^ 2 ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (2 - δ) := by
  intro c E₁ E₂
  have hP := (physCoefAtom_coprime hS h).2.2
  unfold physCoefAtom at h
  rw [if_pos ⟨hP, (physCoefAtom_coprime hS (by unfold physCoefAtom; exact h)).2.1⟩] at h
  have hl : S.lowFactor J P c χ l ≠ 0 := fun h0 => h (by simp [c, h0])
  have hr : (S.colFactor J P c χ 1 * S.colFactor J P c χ 2) r ≠ 0 :=
    fun h0 => h (by simp [c, h0])
  obtain ⟨s1, s2, s3⟩ := atomColour_spec hA hP
  have hDl := Dlow_ge_one hS
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := by
    have := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith [hS.X_gt] : (0 : ℝ) < S.X) (2 * δ)).trans_le hA.N_lo
    exact ((div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by linarith)).1 this).le
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (lowFactor_support hS hl).trans ?_
    calc S.Dlow * cprod (S.boxVec J P) c 0 J ≤ S.Dlow * (N / S.Dlow * S.X ^ (-δ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s1 (by linarith)
      _ = N * S.X ^ (-δ) := by field_simp
  · rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply] at hr
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hr
    obtain ⟨-, -, h1⟩ := colFactor_support hS (left_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    obtain ⟨-, -, h2⟩ := colFactor_support hS (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    exact ⟨y.1, y.2, (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hy).1, h1, h2⟩
  · calc N ^ 2 * E₁ * E₂ ^ 2 = S.Dlow ^ 2 * ((N / S.Dlow) ^ 2 * E₁ * E₂ ^ 2) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (1 - δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s2 (by positivity)
  · calc N ^ 2 * E₁ ^ 5 * E₂ ^ 2 = S.Dlow ^ 2 * ((N / S.Dlow) ^ 2 * E₁ ^ 5 * E₂ ^ 2) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ S.Dlow ^ 2 * S.X ^ (2 - δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left s3 (by positivity)

open Classical in
/-- **Exact Type-II decomposition of the scalar source, atom by atom**: for every `v`,
`Γ ∑_d 1[(f,d)=1] ℓ_X(d) (I_d - U_d)(v) = ∑_λ ∑_{l,r} c_{ξ,λ}(l,r) (I_l h_r + h_l U_r)(v)`. -/
theorem typeII_source_decomp (hS : S.Good) (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f K A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (v : ℕ) :
    Γ * ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * (Iz A B d v - Uz d v) else 0) =
      ∑ J ∈ range (S.T ^ 2 + 1), ∑ P : Fin J → Fin S.H, ∑ χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3,
        ∑ l ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ r ∈ Ico 1 K,
          (if l * r < K then physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r *
            (Iz A B l v * hz A B r v + hz A B l v * Uz r v) else 0) := by
  rw [← physCoefAtom_reassemble hS δ N Γ f K (fun d => Iz A B d v - Uz d v)]
  refine sum_congr rfl (fun J _ => sum_congr rfl (fun P _ => sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ =>
    sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => ?_)))))
  split_ifs
  · by_cases h0 : physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · rw [typeII_split_Z (physCoefAtom_coprime hS h0).1]
  · rfl

/-- **The actual Ordering-B cell of an atom**: the coefficient is the constructed atom
coefficient (the same atom is selected before the Cauchy step). -/
noncomputable def physOB (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f c A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (L R Nn M : ℕ) (J : ℕ)
    (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (alpha beta : ℕ → ℝ) : OBData where
  f := f
  c := c
  A := A
  B := B
  L := L
  R := R
  N := Nn
  M := M
  coef := physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ
  alpha := alpha
  beta := beta

/-- For each atom, the independently defined Type-II source equals the Ordering-B cell sum
`T_ξ` of the cell built from the constructed coefficient. -/
theorem physOB_source_eq_T (δ N Γ : ℝ) (f c A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (L R Nn M J : ℕ)
    (P : Fin J → Fin S.H) (χ : Fin S.Kc → Fin 3) (α β : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ n, α n ≠ 0 → Nn ≤ n ∧ n < 2 * Nn) (hβ : ∀ m, β m ≠ 0 → M ≤ m ∧ m < 2 * M)
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 4 * Nn * M ≤ K) :
    ∑ l ∈ Ico L (2 * L), ∑ r ∈ Ico R (2 * R), physCoefAtom S δ N Γ f J P χ l r *
      ∑ v ∈ range K, (α * β) v *
        ((physOB (S := S) δ N Γ f c A B L R Nn M J P χ α β).res v * Iz A B l v * hz A B r v) =
      (physOB (S := S) δ N Γ f c A B L R Nn M J P χ α β).T :=
  OBData.source_eq_T (D := physOB (S := S) δ N Γ f c A B L R Nn M J P χ α β) α β
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hα hβ hK

end Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Type-II source: the Heath–Brown identity (Maynard, arXiv:2006.07088v1, Lemma 5.3)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Maynard's Lemma 5.3 is printed as

`Λ(n) = ∑_{j=1}^k (-1)^j C(k,j) ∑_{n = n_1⋯n_j m_1⋯m_j, m_i ≤ 2x^{1/k}} μ(m_1)⋯μ(m_j) log n_1`
(`n ≤ 2x`).

**Repair.** The sign `(-1)^j` is a misprint: with it the right-hand side equals `-Λ(n)`
(`maynard_printed_sign_eq_neg`), so the printed identity is false for every prime power `n`
(`maynard_printed_sign_false`, e.g. `n = 2`).  The correct sign is `(-1)^{j-1}`:

* `heathBrown` — for every `z, k` and every `n < (z+1)^k`,
  `Λ(n) = ∑_{j=1}^k (-1)^{j+1} C(k,j) (log * ζ^{j-1} * M_z^j)(n)`, with
  `M_z(m) = μ(m) 1_{m ≤ z}` the truncated Möbius function;
* `heathBrown_three` — the case `k = 3` (three truncated Möbius variables, three smooth
  variables, one of them carrying `log`), as used in Maynard's §5 and in the spec §20;
* `heathBrown_maynard_range` — Maynard's range: `n ≤ 2x`, `z = ⌊2x^{1/k}⌋` satisfies
  `n < (z+1)^k`.

All proofs are algebra in the commutative ring of arithmetic functions:
`(1 - ζ M_z)` vanishes on `n ≤ z` (Möbius inversion), so `(1 - ζ M_z)^k` vanishes below
`(z+1)^k`; expand binomially and use `Λ * ζ = log`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators ArithmeticFunction.Moebius ArithmeticFunction.zeta
open Finset ArithmeticFunction

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

/-- The truncated Möbius function `M_z(m) = μ(m) 1_{m ≤ z}`. -/
noncomputable def Mz (z : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
  ⟨fun n => if n ≤ z then (μ n : ℝ) else 0, by simp⟩

theorem Mz_apply (z n : ℕ) : Mz z n = if n ≤ z then (μ n : ℝ) else 0 := rfl

/-- `f` vanishes on `n < A`. -/
def VanishBelow (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (A : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ n < A, f n = 0

theorem VanishBelow.mul {f g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} {A B : ℕ} (hf : VanishBelow f A)
    (hg : VanishBelow g B) : VanishBelow (f * g) (A * B) := by
  intro n hn
  rw [mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hmul, -⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx
  by_cases h1 : x.1 < A
  · rw [hf _ h1, zero_mul]
  · by_cases h2 : x.2 < B
    · rw [hg _ h2, mul_zero]
    · push_neg at h1 h2
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul h1 h2
      omega

theorem VanishBelow.pow {f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ} {A : ℕ} (hf : VanishBelow f A) (k : ℕ) :
    VanishBelow (f ^ k) (A ^ k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn
    simp only [pow_zero] at hn ⊢
    have : n = 0 := by omega
    subst this; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
    exact ih.mul hf

theorem vanishBelow_one_left (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : VanishBelow f 1 := by
  intro n hn
  have : n = 0 := by omega
  subst this; simp

/-- `1 - ζ M_z` vanishes on `n ≤ z`. -/
theorem one_sub_zeta_Mz_vanish (z : ℕ) : VanishBelow (1 - (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Mz z) (z + 1) := by
  intro n hn
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_apply, ArithmeticFunction.neg_apply, coe_zeta_mul_apply]
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, Mz z i = ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, (μ i : ℝ) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
    rw [Mz_apply, if_pos ((Nat.divisor_le hi).trans (by omega))]
  rw [hsum]
  have : ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, (μ i : ℝ) = ((μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) n := by
    rw [coe_mul_zeta_apply]; simp
  rw [this, coe_moebius_mul_coe_zeta]
  ring

theorem sum_apply' {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) n = ∑ i ∈ s, f i n := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, add_apply, ih]

theorem natCast_mul_apply (c : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((c : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * f) n = c * f n := by
  induction c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ c ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, one_mul, add_apply, ih]; push_cast; ring

theorem neg_one_pow_mul_apply (m : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (((-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ m * f) n = (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * f n := by
  induction m generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, show (-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * f = -f from neg_one_mul f, ih,
      ArithmeticFunction.neg_apply, pow_succ]
    ring

/-- **Heath–Brown's identity** (corrected sign): for `n < (z+1)^k`,
`Λ(n) = ∑_{j=1}^{k} (-1)^{j-1} C(k,j) (log * ζ^{j-1} * M_z^j)(n)` (index shifted `j ↦ j+1`). -/
theorem heathBrown (z k : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < (z + 1) ^ k) :
    Λ n = ∑ j ∈ range k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (k.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
      ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j * Mz z ^ (j + 1)) n := by
  set g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Mz z with hg
  have hv : VanishBelow (Λ * (1 - g) ^ k) ((z + 1) ^ k) := by
    have := (vanishBelow_one_left Λ).mul ((one_sub_zeta_Mz_vanish z).pow k)
    rwa [one_mul] at this
  have h0 := hv n hn
  have hexp : (1 - g) ^ k = ∑ m ∈ range (k + 1),
      ((-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ m * g ^ m) * (k.choose m : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) := by
    rw [show (1 - g) = -g + 1 by ring, add_pow]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [one_pow, mul_one, neg_pow g m]
  rw [hexp, Finset.mul_sum, sum_apply', Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h0
  have hterm0 : (Λ * (((-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ 0 * g ^ 0) *
      (k.choose 0 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ))) n = Λ n := by simp
  have htermS : ∀ j, (Λ * (((-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * g ^ (j + 1)) *
      (k.choose (j + 1) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ))) n =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ j * (k.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
        (((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j * Mz z ^ (j + 1)) n)) := by
    intro j
    have : Λ * (((-1 : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * g ^ (j + 1)) *
        (k.choose (j + 1) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) = (-1) ^ (j + 1) *
        ((k.choose (j + 1) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) *
          ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j * Mz z ^ (j + 1))) := by
      rw [hg, mul_pow, pow_succ' (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) j, ← vonMangoldt_mul_zeta]
      ring
    rw [this, neg_one_pow_mul_apply, natCast_mul_apply, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hterm0] at h0
  simp only [htermS, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h0
  linarith

/-- **Heath–Brown with `k = 3`**: three truncated Möbius variables and three smooth variables
(`log * ζ^{j-1} * M_z^j`, `j = 1, 2, 3`), valid for `n < (z+1)^3`. -/
theorem heathBrown_three (z : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < (z + 1) ^ 3) :
    Λ n = 3 * ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Mz z) n
      - 3 * ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Mz z ^ 2) n
      + ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ 2 * Mz z ^ 3) n := by
  rw [heathBrown z 3 hn]
  have c1 : (3 : ℕ).choose 1 = 3 := rfl
  have c2 : (3 : ℕ).choose 2 = 3 := rfl
  have c3 : (3 : ℕ).choose 3 = 1 := rfl
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, pow_zero, pow_one, mul_one, zero_add,
    c1, c2, c3]
  push_cast
  ring

/-- **Maynard's printed sign gives `-Λ`**: with `(-1)^j` in place of `(-1)^{j-1}` the right-hand
side of Lemma 5.3 is exactly `-Λ(n)`. -/
theorem maynard_printed_sign_eq_neg (z k : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < (z + 1) ^ k) :
    ∑ j ∈ range k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (k.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
      ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j * Mz z ^ (j + 1)) n = -Λ n := by
  rw [heathBrown z k hn, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [pow_succ]; ring

/-- **Negative control**: the identity as printed (sign `(-1)^j`) is false, e.g. at
`n = 2`, `k = 1`, `z = 2`. -/
theorem maynard_printed_sign_false :
    ¬ ∀ z k n : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → n < (z + 1) ^ k →
      Λ n = ∑ j ∈ range k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * (k.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
        ((log : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j * Mz z ^ (j + 1)) n := by
  intro h
  have h2 := h 2 1 2 le_rfl (by norm_num)
  rw [maynard_printed_sign_eq_neg 2 1 (by norm_num)] at h2
  have hpos : 0 < Λ 2 := by
    rw [vonMangoldt_apply_prime Nat.prime_two]
    exact Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  linarith

/-- **Maynard's range**: for `n ≤ 2x` and `z = ⌊2 x^{1/k}⌋`, `n < (z+1)^k` (`k ≥ 1`). -/
theorem heathBrown_maynard_range {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x) : n < (⌊2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))⌋₊ + 1) ^ k := by
  have hz : 2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ)) < (⌊2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hpow : (2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))) ^ k = 2 ^ k * x := by
    rw [mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast (x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))), ← Real.rpow_mul hx.le,
      one_div_mul_cancel (by exact_mod_cast (show k ≠ 0 by omega)), Real.rpow_one]
  have h1 : (2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))) ^ k < ((⌊2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) ^ k :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ hz hpos (by omega)
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk
  have : (n : ℝ) < ((⌊2 * x ^ (1 / (k : ℝ))⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k := by
    push_cast
    rw [hpow] at h1
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast this

end Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5011 sha256=6651859b1836e04e49358afe7f0aa85dea46c34ac4fd38ee438cc84a2942395e path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/Physical/TypeII/Instance.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Scalar.Bound
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.TypeII.OrderingB

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Type-II source: the physical coefficient `c_{ξ,l,r}`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

The Type-II coefficient is generated from the *actual* scalar coefficient `ℓ_X`
(`Sieve.ScalarParams.ellX`) through a factorization rule `d ↦ (l, r)`:

`c_{ξ,l,r} = Γ_ξ · ℓ_X(l r) · 1[σ(l r) = (l, r)] · 1[(f_ξ, l r) = 1]`.

* `SplitRule` — a map `σ : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ` with `σ(d) = (l, r) ⇒ l r = d`, `(l, r) = 1`.
  The physical source (Pascadi Prop. 5.2) only asserts the *existence* of an
  anatomy-dependent well-factorable split; its precise choice is **not** pinned down by the
  source, so it is kept as an explicit parameter here (this is the BLOCKED item of the report).
* `physCoef_abs_le` — `|c_{ξ,l,r}| ≤ |Γ_ξ| (T² + 1)`.
* `physCoef_coprime` — every nonzero coefficient has `(l, r) = 1`, so `typeII_split_Z`
  applies to it.
* `physCoef_reassemble` — **lossless reassembly**: for any test function `g`,
  `∑_{l,r} c_{ξ,l,r} g(l r) 1[l r < K] = Γ_ξ ∑_{1 ≤ d < K} 1[(f_ξ,d)=1] ℓ_X(d) g(d)`:
  each scalar term `ℓ_X(d)` is counted exactly once, with no new weights introduced.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

/-- A factorization rule `d ↦ (l, r)` with `l r = d` and `(l, r) = 1`. -/
structure SplitRule where
  σ : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ
  mul_eq : ∀ d, (σ d).1 * (σ d).2 = d
  coprime : ∀ d, Nat.Coprime (σ d).1 (σ d).2

open Classical in
/-- **The physical Type-II coefficient**
`c_{ξ,l,r} = Γ_ξ ℓ_X(l r) 1[σ(l r) = (l,r)] 1[(f_ξ, l r) = 1]`. -/
noncomputable def physCoef (S : Sieve.ScalarParams) (σ : SplitRule) (Γ : ℝ) (f : ℕ)
    (l r : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if σ.σ (l * r) = (l, r) ∧ Nat.Coprime f (l * r) then Γ * S.ellX (l * r) else 0

theorem physCoef_abs_le {S : Sieve.ScalarParams} (hS : S.Good) (σ : SplitRule) (Γ : ℝ)
    (f l r : ℕ) : |physCoef S σ Γ f l r| ≤ |Γ| * ((S.T : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1) := by
  unfold physCoef
  split_ifs
  · rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Sieve.ScalarParams.abs_ellX_le hS _) (abs_nonneg _)
  · simp only [abs_zero]; positivity

theorem physCoef_coprime {S : Sieve.ScalarParams} {σ : SplitRule} {Γ : ℝ} {f l r : ℕ}
    (h : physCoef S σ Γ f l r ≠ 0) : Nat.Coprime l r ∧ Nat.Coprime f (l * r) := by
  unfold physCoef at h
  split_ifs at h with hc
  · refine ⟨?_, hc.2⟩
    have := σ.coprime (l * r)
    rwa [hc.1] at this
  · exact absurd rfl h

/-- **Lossless reassembly** of the scalar coefficient from the Type-II coefficients. -/
theorem physCoef_reassemble (S : Sieve.ScalarParams) (σ : SplitRule) (Γ : ℝ) (f K : ℕ)
    (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ l ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ r ∈ Ico 1 K,
        (if l * r < K then physCoef S σ Γ f l r * g (l * r) else 0) =
      Γ * ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * g d else 0 := by
  classical
  set G : ℕ → ℝ := fun d => if Nat.Coprime f d then Γ * S.ellX d * g d else 0 with hG
  have hσmem : ∀ d ∈ Ico 1 K, σ.σ d ∈ Ico 1 K ×ˢ Ico 1 K := by
    intro d hd
    rw [mem_Ico] at hd
    have hm := σ.mul_eq d
    have h1 : (σ.σ d).1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hm; omega
    have h2 : (σ.σ d).2 ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hm; omega
    have hl := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (σ.σ d).1 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h2)
    have hr := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (σ.σ d).2 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h1)
    simp only [mem_product, mem_Ico]
    omega
  have hR : Γ * ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (if Nat.Coprime f d then S.ellX d * g d else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ Ico 1 K, ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 K ×ˢ Ico 1 K, if σ.σ d = x then G (x.1 * x.2) else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos (hσmem d hd), σ.mul_eq d, hG]
    simp only
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [hR]
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l hl => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr => ?_))
  rw [mem_Ico] at hl hr
  have hfib : ∀ d ∈ Ico 1 K, (if σ.σ d = (l, r) then G ((l, r).1 * (l, r).2) else 0) =
      if d = l * r then (if σ.σ (l * r) = (l, r) then G (l * r) else 0) else 0 := by
    intro d _
    by_cases h : σ.σ d = (l, r)
    · have hd : d = l * r := by rw [← σ.mul_eq d, h]
      subst hd; simp [h]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      by_cases hd : d = l * r
      · subst hd; simp [h]
      · simp [hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfib, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  have hpos : 1 ≤ l * r := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  by_cases hK : l * r < K
  · rw [if_pos hK, if_pos (mem_Ico.2 ⟨hpos, hK⟩)]
    unfold physCoef
    simp only [hG]
    by_cases h1 : σ.σ (l * r) = (l, r) <;> by_cases h2 : Nat.Coprime f (l * r) <;> simp [h1, h2]
  · rw [if_neg hK, if_neg (by rw [mem_Ico]; omega)]

end Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.Profile
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Physical.TypeII.Cells

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Type-II source: the literal Ordering-B square `V_ξ`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

Literal objects of `sources/physical_spec.md` §§23–24, with the actual masks:

* `Iz A B s v = 1_{A v ≡ B (mod s)}` (`B ∈ ℤ`: the reduced pair `B_{jℓ}` may be negative),
  `Uz s v = 1_{(v,s)=1}/φ(s)`, `hz = Iz - Uz`;
* `typeII_split_Z` — `I_{lr} - U_{lr} = I_l (I_r - U_r) + (I_l - U_l) U_r` for coprime `l, r`;
* `OBData` — one separated Type-II cell: modulus `f`, residue `c`, `(A, B)`, dyadic scales
  `L, R, N, M`, coefficients `coef l r = c_{ξ,l,r}`, `α`, `β`;
* `OBData.inner l m = ∑_{r∼R} c_{ξ,l,r} ∑_{n∼N} α_n 1_{mn≡c (f)} I_l(mn) h_r(mn)`;
* `OBData.V = ∑_{l∼L} ∑_m Ψ(m/M) |inner l m|²` with the explicit plateau profile `Ψ`
  (`physPsi`); `V_eq_range` — the `m`-range is lossless (`Ψ(m/M) = 0` for `m ≥ 5M/2`);
* `OBData.T = ∑_{l∼L} ∑_{m∼M} β_m inner l m` and `T_sq_le` — **first Cauchy**
  `|T|² ≤ (∑_{l∼L} ∑_{m∼M} |β_m|²) V`;
* `V_expand` — **Ordering-B expansion** of the square (pairs `(r₁,n₁)`, `(r₂,n₂)`, the `m`-sum
  innermost, all masks retained);
* `base_congruence` — every nonzero term of the expansion has `(n₁n₂, fl) = 1` and
  `n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod fl)`;
* `source_eq_T` — the independently defined Type-II source
  `∑_{l,r} c_{ξ,l,r} ∑_v (α * β)(v) 1_{v≡c (f)} I_l(v) h_r(v)` equals `T`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287.Physical.TypeII

open Classical in
/-- `I_s(v) = 1_{A v ≡ B (mod s)}`. -/
noncomputable def Iz (A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (s v : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if (A : ℤ) * v ≡ B [ZMOD s] then 1 else 0

open Classical in
/-- `U_s(v) = 1_{(v,s)=1} / φ(s)`. -/
noncomputable def Uz (s v : ℕ) : ℝ := if Nat.Coprime v s then 1 / (Nat.totient s : ℝ) else 0

/-- `h_s = I_s - U_s`. -/
noncomputable def hz (A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (s v : ℕ) : ℝ := Iz A B s v - Uz s v

theorem Iz_mul {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (v : ℕ) :
    Iz A B (l * r) v = Iz A B l v * Iz A B r v := by
  unfold Iz
  have key := Int.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul (a := (A : ℤ) * v) (b := B) (m := l) (n := r)
    (by simpa using hlr)
  push_cast
  by_cases h1 : (A : ℤ) * v ≡ B [ZMOD l] <;> by_cases h2 : (A : ℤ) * v ≡ B [ZMOD r]
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_pos (key.1 ⟨h1, h2⟩)]; ring
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, if_neg (fun h => h2 (key.2 h).2)]; ring
  · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (fun h => h1 (key.2 h).1)]; ring
  · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (fun h => h1 (key.2 h).1)]; ring

theorem Uz_mul {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (v : ℕ) : Uz (l * r) v = Uz l v * Uz r v := by
  unfold Uz
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hlr, Nat.cast_mul]
  by_cases h1 : Nat.Coprime v l <;> by_cases h2 : Nat.Coprime v r
  · rw [if_pos (Nat.Coprime.mul_right h1 h2), if_pos h1, if_pos h2]; field_simp
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h2 (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Dvd.intro_left _ rfl) h)), if_neg h2]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h1 (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Dvd.intro _ rfl) h)), if_neg h1]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => h1 (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Dvd.intro _ rfl) h)), if_neg h1]
    ring

/-- **Exact Type-II split** (§23) with the integer residue `B`. -/
theorem typeII_split_Z {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (A : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (v : ℕ) :
    Iz A B (l * r) v - Uz (l * r) v = Iz A B l v * hz A B r v + hz A B l v * Uz r v := by
  unfold hz; rw [Iz_mul hlr, Uz_mul hlr]; ring

/-- One separated Type-II cell (§24): `x = MN`, `l ∼ L`, `r ∼ R`, `n ∼ N`, `m ∼ M`. -/
structure OBData where
  f : ℕ
  c : ℕ
  A : ℕ
  B : ℤ
  L : ℕ
  R : ℕ
  N : ℕ
  M : ℕ
  coef : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
  alpha : ℕ → ℝ
  beta : ℕ → ℝ

namespace OBData

variable (D : OBData)

open Classical in
/-- The residue mask `1_{v ≡ c (mod f)}`. -/
noncomputable def res (v : ℕ) : ℝ := if v ≡ D.c [MOD D.f] then 1 else 0

/-- `inner l m = ∑_{r∼R} c_{ξ,l,r} ∑_{n∼N} α_n 1_{mn≡c (f)} I_l(mn) h_r(mn)`. -/
noncomputable def inner (l m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), D.coef l r * ∑ n ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N),
    D.alpha n * D.res (m * n) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n) * hz D.A D.B r (m * n)

/-- **The actual Ordering-B square**
`V_ξ = ∑_{l∼L} ∑_m Ψ(m/M) |∑_{r∼R} c_{ξ,l,r} ∑_{n∼N} α_n 1_{mn≡c (f)} I_l(mn) h_r(mn)|²`. -/
noncomputable def V : ℝ :=
  ∑ l ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ m ∈ range (3 * D.M + 1),
    physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) * D.inner l m ^ 2

/-- The Type-II cell sum `T_ξ = ∑_{l∼L} ∑_{m∼M} β_m inner l m`. -/
noncomputable def T : ℝ :=
  ∑ l ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), D.beta m * D.inner l m

variable {D}

/-- The `m`-range of `V` is lossless: `Ψ(m/M) = 0` for `m > 3M`. -/
theorem V_eq_range (hM : 0 < D.M) {K : ℕ} (hK : 3 * D.M ≤ K) :
    D.V = ∑ l ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ m ∈ range (K + 1),
      physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) * D.inner l m ^ 2 := by
  unfold V
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro m hm; simp only [mem_range] at hm ⊢; omega
  · intro m hm hm'
    simp only [mem_range, not_lt] at hm hm'
    have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < D.M := by exact_mod_cast hM
    have : (5 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) / D.M := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hMr]
      have : (3 * D.M + 1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm'
      linarith
    rw [physPsi_eq_zero (Or.inr this), zero_mul]

/-- **First Cauchy**: `|T_ξ|² ≤ (∑_{l∼L} ∑_{m∼M} |β_m|²) V_ξ`. -/
theorem T_sq_le (hM : 0 < D.M) :
    D.T ^ 2 ≤ (∑ _ ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), D.beta m ^ 2) * D.V := by
  unfold T
  rw [← Finset.sum_product', ← Finset.sum_product']
  refine (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => D.beta x.2)
    (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => D.inner x.1 x.2)).trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  unfold V
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => ?_)
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < D.M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  calc ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), D.inner l m ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) * D.inner l m ^ 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_)
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hm
        have hp : 1 ≤ physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) := by
          apply physPsi_plateau
          · rw [le_div_iff₀ hMr, one_mul]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : D.M ≤ m)
          · rw [div_le_iff₀ hMr]
            have : (m : ℝ) < 2 * D.M := by exact_mod_cast h2
            linarith
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D.inner l m)]
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ range (3 * D.M + 1), physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) * D.inner l m ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        · intro m hm; simp only [mem_Ico, mem_range] at hm ⊢; omega
        · intro m _ _; exact mul_nonneg (physPsi_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)

/-- **Ordering-B expansion**: opening the square, with the `m`-sum innermost and all masks
retained. -/
theorem V_expand :
    D.V = ∑ l ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ r₁ ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), ∑ r₂ ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R),
      ∑ n₁ ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N), ∑ n₂ ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N),
        D.coef l r₁ * D.coef l r₂ * D.alpha n₁ * D.alpha n₂ *
          ∑ m ∈ range (3 * D.M + 1), physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) *
            (D.res (m * n₁) * D.res (m * n₂) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n₁) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n₂) *
              hz D.A D.B r₁ (m * n₁) * hz D.A D.B r₂ (m * n₂)) := by
  unfold V
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) * D.inner l m ^ 2 =
      ∑ r₁ ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), ∑ r₂ ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R),
        ∑ n₁ ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N), ∑ n₂ ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N),
          D.coef l r₁ * D.coef l r₂ * D.alpha n₁ * D.alpha n₂ *
            (physPsi ((m : ℝ) / D.M) *
              (D.res (m * n₁) * D.res (m * n₂) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n₁) *
                Iz D.A D.B l (m * n₂) * hz D.A D.B r₁ (m * n₁) * hz D.A D.B r₂ (m * n₂))) := by
    intro m
    unfold inner
    rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r₁ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r₂ _ => ?_)
    rw [show ∀ (a b c S1 S2 : ℝ), a * (b * S1 * (c * S2)) = (a * b * c) * (S1 * S2) by
      intros; ring, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n₁ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n₂ _ => ?_)
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => key m)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r₁ _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r₂ _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n₁ _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n₂ _ => ?_)
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end OBData

/-- **Ordering B preserves the physical base**: if `m n_i ≡ c (mod f)` and
`A m n_i ≡ B (mod l)` for `i = 1, 2`, with `(c, f) = 1`, `(B, l) = 1` and `(f, l) = 1`, then
`(n₁ n₂, f l) = 1` and `n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod f l)`. -/
theorem base_congruence {f l A m n₁ n₂ : ℕ} {c B : ℤ} (hcf : IsCoprime c (f : ℤ))
    (hBl : IsCoprime B (l : ℤ)) (hfl : Nat.Coprime f l)
    (h1 : (m : ℤ) * n₁ ≡ c [ZMOD f]) (h2 : (m : ℤ) * n₂ ≡ c [ZMOD f])
    (h3 : (A : ℤ) * m * n₁ ≡ B [ZMOD l]) (h4 : (A : ℤ) * m * n₂ ≡ B [ZMOD l]) :
    IsCoprime ((n₁ : ℤ) * n₂) ((f : ℤ) * l) ∧ (n₁ : ℤ) ≡ n₂ [ZMOD (f * l : ℕ)] := by
  -- coprimality transfers along congruences
  have cop_of_modEq : ∀ {x y q : ℤ}, x ≡ y [ZMOD q] → IsCoprime y q → IsCoprime x q := by
    intro x y q hxy hy
    have : x = y + q * ((x - y) / q) := by
      rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (Int.ModEq.dvd hxy.symm)]; ring
    rw [this]
    exact hy.add_mul_left_left _
  have hm1f : IsCoprime ((m : ℤ) * n₁) f := cop_of_modEq h1 hcf
  have hm2f : IsCoprime ((m : ℤ) * n₂) f := cop_of_modEq h2 hcf
  have hA1l : IsCoprime ((A : ℤ) * m * n₁) l := cop_of_modEq h3 hBl
  have hA2l : IsCoprime ((A : ℤ) * m * n₂) l := cop_of_modEq h4 hBl
  have hmf : IsCoprime (m : ℤ) f := hm1f.of_mul_left_left
  have hAml : IsCoprime ((A : ℤ) * m) l := hA1l.of_mul_left_left
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply IsCoprime.mul_left
    · exact IsCoprime.mul_right hm1f.of_mul_left_right hA1l.of_mul_left_right
    · exact IsCoprime.mul_right hm2f.of_mul_left_right hA2l.of_mul_left_right
  · have hf : (n₁ : ℤ) ≡ n₂ [ZMOD f] := by
      have hd : (f : ℤ) ∣ (m : ℤ) * (n₂ - n₁) := by
        have := Int.ModEq.dvd (h1.trans h2.symm); rw [mul_sub]; exact this
      exact (Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2 (hmf.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hd))
    have hl : (n₁ : ℤ) ≡ n₂ [ZMOD l] := by
      have hd : (l : ℤ) ∣ ((A : ℤ) * m) * (n₂ - n₁) := by
        have := Int.ModEq.dvd (h3.trans h4.symm); rw [mul_sub]; exact this
      exact (Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2 (hAml.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hd))
    push_cast
    exact (Int.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul (by simpa using hfl)).1 ⟨hf, hl⟩

/-- Convolution against a dyadically supported pair: for `α` supported on `[N, 2N)` and
`β` on `[M, 2M)`, `∑_{v < K} (α * β)(v) G(v) = ∑_{n∼N} ∑_{m∼M} α_n β_m G(mn)` once `K ≥ 4NM`. -/
theorem sum_conv_dyadic (α β : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) {N M K : ℕ}
    (hα : ∀ n, α n ≠ 0 → N ≤ n ∧ n < 2 * N) (hβ : ∀ m, β m ≠ 0 → M ≤ m ∧ m < 2 * M)
    (hK : 4 * N * M ≤ K) (G : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ v ∈ range K, (α * β) v * G v =
      ∑ n ∈ Ico N (2 * N), ∑ m ∈ Ico M (2 * M), α n * β m * G (m * n) := by
  simp_rw [ArithmeticFunction.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', ← Finset.sum_product']
  refine Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun y _ _ => y.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy hne
    have h1 : α y.2.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by rw [h]; ring)
    have h2 : β y.2.2 ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by rw [h]; ring)
    rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_Ico]
    exact ⟨hα _ h1, hβ _ h2⟩
  · intro y1 hy1 _ y2 hy2 _ h
    obtain ⟨-, hx1⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy1
    obtain ⟨-, hx2⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy2
    have e1 := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx1).1
    have e2 := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx2).1
    simp only at h
    have hd : y1.1 = y2.1 := by rw [← e1, ← e2, h]
    exact Sigma.ext hd (heq_of_eq h)
  · intro x hx hne
    obtain ⟨hn, hm⟩ := Finset.mem_product.1 hx
    obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hn
    obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.1 hm
    have hN : 0 < N := by
      by_contra h0; push_neg at h0; interval_cases N; omega
    have hM : 0 < M := by
      by_contra h0; push_neg at h0; interval_cases M; omega
    refine ⟨⟨x.1 * x.2, x⟩, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range, Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal]
      refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_⟩
      · have : x.1 * x.2 < (2 * N) * (2 * M) := Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hn2 hm2
        nlinarith
      · exact Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)
    · simpa [mul_comm x.2 x.1] using hne
  · intro y hy _
    obtain ⟨-, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.1 hy
    have e := (Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hx).1
    simp only
    rw [← e, mul_comm y.2.1 y.2.2]

namespace OBData

variable {D : OBData}

/-- **The independently defined Type-II source equals the Ordering-B cell sum**:
`∑_{l∼L} ∑_{r∼R} c_{ξ,l,r} ∑_{v<K} (α * β)(v) 1_{v≡c (f)} I_l(v) h_r(v) = T_ξ`. -/
theorem source_eq_T (α β : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hαD : ∀ n, D.alpha n = α n)
    (hβD : ∀ m, D.beta m = β m)
    (hα : ∀ n, α n ≠ 0 → D.N ≤ n ∧ n < 2 * D.N) (hβ : ∀ m, β m ≠ 0 → D.M ≤ m ∧ m < 2 * D.M)
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 4 * D.N * D.M ≤ K) :
    ∑ l ∈ Ico D.L (2 * D.L), ∑ r ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), D.coef l r *
      ∑ v ∈ range K, (α * β) v * (D.res v * Iz D.A D.B l v * hz D.A D.B r v) = D.T := by
  unfold T inner
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
  simp_rw [sum_conv_dyadic α β hα hβ hK]
  calc ∑ r ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), D.coef l r * ∑ n ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N), ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M),
        α n * β m * (D.res (m * n) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n) * hz D.A D.B r (m * n))
      = ∑ r ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), ∑ n ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N),
          D.coef l r * (α n * β m * (D.res (m * n) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n) *
            hz D.A D.B r (m * n))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => ?_)
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ m ∈ Ico D.M (2 * D.M), ∑ r ∈ Ico D.R (2 * D.R), ∑ n ∈ Ico D.N (2 * D.N),
          D.coef l r * (α n * β m * (D.res (m * n) * Iz D.A D.B l (m * n) *
            hz D.A D.B r (m * n))) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
        rw [hαD, hβD]
        ring

end OBData

end Erdos287.Physical.TypeII
