import RequestProject.Erdos287.CurrentTail.ExponentLedger

/-!
# Erdős #287 — source chain: quantitative `T_H^{7/128}` and the final `391/256` ledger

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Source level: `MESSAGE_LEVEL_SOURCE`
(request §9–§10; source pack §17 (TH.1)–(TH.3)).

## §9 — `7/128` is *derived*, not inserted

* `PascadiSpectralY θQ θR θH δ θexc` — the **narrow spectral provider**: for every input of
  the `E₂` shape there are `Y, Z ≥ 0` with `|𝒦|² ≤ Y Z` (Proposition-3.4 placement of `T_H`
  into `Y`), `Y ≤ T_H^{θexc/2} Y₀` (Proposition 3.8 with exceptional exponent `θexc`), and
  `Y₀ Z ≤ C² (x^{-δ} · trivial)²`.  It mentions no #287 object.
* `exc_exponent_chain` — `(7/32)/2 = 7/64`, `(7/64)/2 = 7/128`.
* `th_exponent_propagation` — `θexc ≤ 7/32`, `T_H ≥ 1`, `|𝒦|² ≤ YZ`, `Y ≤ T_H^{θexc/2} Y₀`
  give `|𝒦| ≤ √(Y₀ Z) · T_H^{7/128}`.
* `QuantitativeTH_of_spectralY` — `PascadiSpectralY … θexc` with `θexc ≤ 7/32` **implies** the
  previous provider `QuantitativeTH` (whose `7/128` was a parameter).  So `QuantitativeTH`
  is no longer an independent provider.
* `TH_le_f1_power` — `T_H ≤ f₁ ≤ x^σ` gives `T_H^{7/128} ≤ x^{7σ/128}`.

## §10 — the final exponent ledger

* `FinalLedger` — the six named costs (Fourier enlargement, phase cost, colour separation,
  packet norm, spectator exponent) and the Cauchy square root.
* `messageLedger` — the instantiation consistent with the supplied total: Fourier `1`,
  phase `0`, colour `7/128` (via `T_H ≤ f₁ ≤ x^σ`), packet norm `2`, spectator `0` (only
  logarithms, paid by the reciprocal-density norm).  Only the total `391/256` is supplied;
  the split is the one already used by the `CurrentTail` ledger.
* `messageLedger_coefficient` — after the Cauchy square root the coefficient is `391/256`.
* `ledger_391_iff` — `391/256 · σ < ε/2 ⟺` the `CurrentTail` net saving with `c_H = 1` is
  positive.
* `TH3_of_sigma_lt` — explicit threshold: `σ < 128 ε / 391` gives `391/256 · σ < ε/2`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.SourceChain

open Erdos287.CurrentTail

/-! ### §9 exponent propagation -/

theorem exc_exponent_chain : ((7 : ℚ) / 32) / 2 = 7 / 64 ∧ ((7 : ℚ) / 64) / 2 = 7 / 128 := by
  constructor <;> norm_num

/-- **Exponent propagation.**  `θexc ≤ 7/32`, `T_H ≥ 1`, `|𝒦|² ≤ YZ`, `Y ≤ T_H^{θexc/2} Y₀`,
`Y₀, Z ≥ 0` ⟹ `|𝒦| ≤ √(Y₀ Z) · T_H^{7/128}`. -/
theorem th_exponent_propagation {K Y Y0 Z TH θexc : ℝ} (hθ : θexc ≤ 7 / 32) (hTH : 1 ≤ TH)
    (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y0) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hKY : K ^ 2 ≤ Y * Z) (hY : Y ≤ TH ^ (θexc / 2) * Y0) :
    |K| ≤ Real.sqrt (Y0 * Z) * TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) := by
  have hTH0 : 0 < TH := by linarith
  have h1 : K ^ 2 ≤ TH ^ (θexc / 2) * (Y0 * Z) := by
    calc K ^ 2 ≤ Y * Z := hKY
      _ ≤ TH ^ (θexc / 2) * Y0 * Z := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hY hZ
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h2 : TH ^ (θexc / 2) ≤ (TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hTH0.le]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hTH (by push_cast; linarith)
  have h3 : K ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (Y0 * Z) * TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hY0 hZ)]
    calc K ^ 2 ≤ TH ^ (θexc / 2) * (Y0 * Z) := h1
      _ ≤ (TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128)) ^ 2 * (Y0 * Z) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (mul_nonneg hY0 hZ)
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h3 (by positivity) |> fun h => abs_le.2 h

/-- **Narrow spectral provider (Pascadi Prop. 3.4 + 3.8 shape, exceptional exponent `θexc`).**
Statement only about the bilinear Kloosterman form of arbitrary bounded coefficients. -/
def PascadiSpectralY (θQ θR θH δ θexc : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, ∀ (Qset Rset Hset : Finset ℕ) (α β γ : ℕ → ℝ) (TH : ℝ),
    E2Hypotheses x Qset Rset Hset α β γ θQ θR θH TH →
      ∃ Y Y0 Z : ℝ, 0 ≤ Y0 ∧ 0 ≤ Z ∧
        (kloostermanForm Qset Rset Hset α β γ) ^ 2 ≤ Y * Z ∧
        Y ≤ TH ^ (θexc / 2) * Y0 ∧
        Y0 * Z ≤ (C * x ^ (-δ) * trivialSize Qset Rset Hset α β γ) ^ 2

theorem trivialSize_nonneg (Qset Rset Hset : Finset ℕ) (α β γ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ trivialSize Qset Rset Hset α β γ := by
  unfold trivialSize
  have h1 : 0 ≤ ∑ q ∈ Qset, |α q| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ r ∈ Rset, |β r| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have h3 : 0 ≤ ∑ h ∈ Hset, |γ h| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
  positivity

/-- **`QuantitativeTH` is derived** from the narrow spectral provider with `θexc ≤ 7/32`. -/
theorem QuantitativeTH_of_spectralY {θQ θR θH δ θexc : ℝ} (hθ : θexc ≤ 7 / 32)
    (h : PascadiSpectralY θQ θR θH δ θexc) : QuantitativeTH θQ θR θH δ := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, x0, hx0⟩ := h
  refine ⟨C, hC, max x0 1, fun x hx Qset Rset Hset α β γ TH hE => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
  obtain ⟨Y, Y0, Z, hY0, hZ, hKY, hY, hYZ⟩ := hx0 x (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx) Qset Rset
    Hset α β γ TH hE
  have hprop := th_exponent_propagation hθ hE.TH_ge_one hY0 hZ hKY hY
  have hT := trivialSize_nonneg Qset Rset Hset α β γ
  have hxpos : 0 < x ^ (-δ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (Y0 * Z) ≤ C * x ^ (-δ) * trivialSize Qset Rset Hset α β γ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
    exact hYZ
  have hTHpos : 0 ≤ TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith [hE.TH_ge_one]) _
  calc |kloostermanForm Qset Rset Hset α β γ|
      ≤ Real.sqrt (Y0 * Z) * TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) := hprop
    _ ≤ C * x ^ (-δ) * trivialSize Qset Rset Hset α β γ * TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hTHpos
    _ = C * TH ^ (((THLossExponent : ℚ) : ℝ)) * x ^ (-δ) *
          trivialSize Qset Rset Hset α β γ := by
        rw [THLossExponent]; push_cast; ring

/-- `T_H ≤ f₁ ≤ x^σ` ⟹ `T_H^{7/128} ≤ x^{7σ/128}`. -/
theorem TH_le_f1_power {TH f1 x σ : ℝ} (hTH : 0 ≤ TH) (h1 : TH ≤ f1) (h2 : f1 ≤ x ^ σ)
    (hx : 0 < x) : TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) ≤ x ^ (7 * σ / 128) := by
  calc TH ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) ≤ (x ^ σ) ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow hTH (h1.trans h2) (by norm_num)
    _ = x ^ (7 * σ / 128) := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx.le]; ring_nf

/-! ### §10 final ledger -/

/-- The six named costs (coefficients of `σ` in the exponent of `x`). -/
structure FinalLedger where
  fourier : ℚ
  phase : ℚ
  colour : ℚ
  packetNorm : ℚ
  spectator : ℚ

/-- Total loss before the Cauchy square root. -/
def FinalLedger.total (L : FinalLedger) : ℚ :=
  L.fourier + L.phase + L.colour + L.packetNorm + L.spectator

/-- Coefficient after the Cauchy square root. -/
def FinalLedger.afterCauchy (L : FinalLedger) : ℚ := L.total / 2

/-- The message-level instantiation (see the module docstring for provenance). -/
def messageLedger : FinalLedger where
  fourier := 1
  phase := 0
  colour := 7 / 128
  packetNorm := 2
  spectator := 0

/-- **The supplied coefficient `391/256`.** -/
theorem messageLedger_coefficient : messageLedger.afterCauchy = 391 / 256 := by
  unfold FinalLedger.afterCauchy FinalLedger.total messageLedger; norm_num

/-- The colour cost is exactly the `T_H` exponent `7/128` (with `T_H ≤ f₁ ≤ x^σ`). -/
theorem messageLedger_colour : messageLedger.colour = THLossExponent := rfl

/-- **`391/256 · σ < ε/2` ⟺ positive net saving** in the `CurrentTail` ledger with `c_H = 1`. -/
theorem ledger_391_iff (ε σ : ℚ) :
    (391 / 256) * σ < ε / 2 ↔ 0 < (ExponentData.mk ε σ 1).netSaving := by
  simp only [ExponentData.netSaving, ExponentData.grossSaving, ExponentData.fourierLoss,
    ExponentData.thLoss, ExponentData.populationLoss, THLossExponent]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

/-- **(TH.3) from an explicit threshold**: `σ < 128 ε / 391` ⟹ `391/256 · σ < ε/2`. -/
theorem TH3_of_sigma_lt {ε σ : ℚ} (h : σ < 128 * ε / 391) : (391 / 256) * σ < ε / 2 := by
  linarith

/-- A concrete admissible choice: `σ = 64 ε / 391` leaves the margin `ε/4`. -/
theorem TH3_margin (ε : ℚ) : ε / 2 - (391 / 256) * (64 * ε / 391) = ε / 4 := by ring

end Erdos287.SourceChain

@@END_FILE@@

import RequestProject.Erdos287.CurrentTail.RelativeBDH

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V100R source chain: exact Type-II split, relative centering, Ordering-B square

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Append-only layer over
`RequestProject/Erdos287/CurrentTail/`; nothing there is modified.

Source level: the formulas of §2.1–§2.4 of the V100R/V100R2 request message (the literal
V100R texts were not present in the repository; see the report).

Kernel-proved here:

* `typeII_split` (§2.1) — for coprime `l, r` and every `v`,
  `I_{lr}(v) - U_{lr}(v) = I_l(v)(I_r(v) - U_r(v)) + (I_l(v) - U_l(v)) U_r(v)`, where
  `I_s(v) = 1_{Av ≡ B (s)}` and `U_s(v) = 1_{(v,s)=1}/φ(s)`;
* `secondTerm_eq_DeltaRel` (§2.2) — the second Type-II term, summed against `α` over the
  physical condition `mn ≡ c (f)`, is exactly `Δ_{α^{(r)}}^{f, c m̄}(l, B·\overline{Am})`, where
  `α^{(r)}_m(n) = α(n) U_r(mn)`.  Both inverses carry explicit unit hypotheses
  (`m · m̄ ≡ 1 (f)`, `(Am) · w ≡ 1 (l)`); `A` is never cancelled modulo `f`;
* `card_fibre_le` / `residueFibre_card_le` (§2.3) — the map `m ↦ (m mod f, m mod l)` on an
  interval of length `L` has fibres of size `≤ L/(fl) + 1` (coprime `f, l`), the genuine
  reciprocal `1/f` density per `l`-class;
* `physical_pair_congr` / `orderingB_physical_square` (§2.4) — the physical congruences
  `m n_i ≡ c (f)`, `A m n_i ≡ B (l)` imply `n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod fl)`; first Cauchy is applied to the
  physical sum *before* any character expansion.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.SourceChain

open Erdos287.CurrentTail

/-! ### §2.1 Exact Type-II split -/

/-- `I_s(v) = 1_{A v ≡ B (mod s)}`. -/
noncomputable def Iind (A B s v : ℕ) : ℝ := ind (A * v ≡ B [MOD s])

/-- `U_s(v) = 1_{(v,s)=1} / φ(s)`. -/
noncomputable def Uind (s v : ℕ) : ℝ := ind (Nat.Coprime v s) / (Nat.totient s : ℝ)

theorem ind_and (P Q : Prop) [Decidable P] [Decidable Q] :
    ind (P ∧ Q) = ind P * ind Q := by
  unfold ind; by_cases hP : P <;> by_cases hQ : Q <;> simp [hP, hQ]

theorem ind_congr {P Q : Prop} [Decidable P] [Decidable Q] (h : P ↔ Q) : ind P = ind Q := by
  unfold ind; by_cases hP : P
  · simp [hP, h.1 hP]
  · simp [hP, (not_congr h).1 hP]

/-- `I_{lr} = I_l · I_r` for coprime `l, r` (CRT). -/
theorem Iind_mul {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (A B v : ℕ) :
    Iind A B (l * r) v = Iind A B l v * Iind A B r v := by
  unfold Iind
  rw [← ind_and]
  exact ind_congr (Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul hlr).symm

/-- `U_{lr} = U_l · U_r` for coprime `l, r`. -/
theorem Uind_mul {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (v : ℕ) :
    Uind (l * r) v = Uind l v * Uind r v := by
  unfold Uind
  rw [Nat.totient_mul hlr, Nat.cast_mul, show ind (Nat.Coprime v (l * r)) =
    ind (Nat.Coprime v l) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r) by
      rw [← ind_and]; exact ind_congr Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right]
  ring

/-- **§2.1 Exact Type-II split.**
`I_{lr} - U_{lr} = I_l (I_r - U_r) + (I_l - U_l) U_r` for coprime `l, r`. -/
theorem typeII_split {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (A B v : ℕ) :
    Iind A B (l * r) v - Uind (l * r) v =
      Iind A B l v * (Iind A B r v - Uind r v) + (Iind A B l v - Uind l v) * Uind r v := by
  rw [Iind_mul hlr, Uind_mul hlr]; ring

/-- The summed form of the split against any weight. -/
theorem typeII_split_sum {l r : ℕ} (hlr : Nat.Coprime l r) (A B : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ v ∈ S, w v * (Iind A B (l * r) v - Uind (l * r) v) =
      ∑ v ∈ S, w v * (Iind A B l v * (Iind A B r v - Uind r v)) +
        ∑ v ∈ S, w v * ((Iind A B l v - Uind l v) * Uind r v) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
  rw [typeII_split hlr]; ring

/-! ### §2.2 Relative centering source -/

/-- Multiplying by a unit modulo `f` with explicit inverse: `m n ≡ c ↔ n ≡ c m̄`. -/
theorem mul_modEq_iff_of_inv {f m minv n c : ℕ} (hinv : m * minv ≡ 1 [MOD f]) :
    m * n ≡ c [MOD f] ↔ n ≡ c * minv [MOD f] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    calc n = 1 * n := (one_mul n).symm
      _ ≡ (m * minv) * n [MOD f] := (hinv.symm).mul_right n
      _ = minv * (m * n) := by ring
      _ ≡ minv * c [MOD f] := h.mul_left minv
      _ = c * minv := by ring
  · intro h
    calc m * n ≡ m * (c * minv) [MOD f] := h.mul_left m
      _ = c * (m * minv) := by ring
      _ ≡ c * 1 [MOD f] := hinv.mul_left c
      _ = c := mul_one c

/-- The `l`-condition of the physical sum: `A m n ≡ B (l) ↔ n ≡ B · \overline{Am} (l)`. -/
theorem affine_modEq_iff_of_inv {l A m w n B : ℕ} (hinv : (A * m) * w ≡ 1 [MOD l]) :
    A * (m * n) ≡ B [MOD l] ↔ n ≡ B * w [MOD l] := by
  rw [← mul_assoc]; exact mul_modEq_iff_of_inv hinv

/-- An explicit inverse modulo `l` forces coprimality with `l`. -/
theorem coprime_of_inv {l a w : ℕ} (h : a * w ≡ 1 [MOD l]) : Nat.Coprime a l := by
  have h1 : Nat.Coprime (a * w) l := by
    have := (Nat.ModEq.gcd_eq h)
    rw [Nat.gcd_one_left] at this
    exact this
  exact Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (dvd_mul_right a w) h1

/-- `α^{(r)}_m(n) = α(n) U_r(mn)` — the coefficient carrying the `r`-mean. -/
noncomputable def alphaR (α : ℕ → ℝ) (r m : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := α n * Uind r (m * n)

/-- **§2.2 Relative centering source.**  For fixed `m` with explicit inverses
`m · m̄ ≡ 1 (mod f)` and `(Am) · w ≡ 1 (mod l)`, the second Type-II term summed over the
physical condition `mn ≡ c (mod f)` is the relative discrepancy
`Δ_{α^{(r)}_m}^{f, c m̄}(l, B w)`.  (`A` is not cancelled modulo `f`; only the unit
hypothesis modulo `l` is used for the `l`-condition.) -/
theorem secondTerm_eq_DeltaRel (S : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℝ) {A B f c l r m minv w : ℕ}
    (hm : m * minv ≡ 1 [MOD f]) (hAm : (A * m) * w ≡ 1 [MOD l]) :
    ∑ n ∈ S.filter (fun n => m * n ≡ c [MOD f]),
        α n * ((Iind A B l (m * n) - Uind l (m * n)) * Uind r (m * n)) =
      DeltaRel S (alphaR α r m) f (c * minv) l (B * w) := by
  have hml : Nat.Coprime m l :=
    Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left m A) (coprime_of_inv hAm)
  unfold DeltaRel
  rw [Finset.filter_congr (fun n _ => mul_modEq_iff_of_inv (n := n) (c := c) hm)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
  unfold alphaR Iind Uind
  rw [ind_congr (affine_modEq_iff_of_inv (n := n) (B := B) hAm),
    ind_congr (show Nat.Coprime (m * n) l ↔ Nat.Coprime n l from
      ⟨fun h => Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left n m) h,
       fun h => Nat.Coprime.mul_left hml h⟩)]
  ring

/-! ### §2.3 Residue-fibre density -/

/-- Pairwise-congruent elements of an interval of length `L` number at most `L/q + 1`. -/
theorem card_fibre_le {q : ℕ} (M0 L : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ)
    (hT : T ⊆ Finset.Ico M0 (M0 + L)) (hcong : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≡ y [MOD q]) :
    T.card ≤ L / q + 1 := by
  have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ T, (x - M0) / q ∈ Finset.range (L / q + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have := Finset.mem_Ico.1 (hT hx)
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have : (x - M0) / q ≤ L / q := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
    omega
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => (x - M0) / q) T := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hx' := Finset.mem_Ico.1 (hT hx)
    have hy' := Finset.mem_Ico.1 (hT hy)
    have hc : x - M0 ≡ y - M0 [MOD q] := by
      have h := hcong x hx y hy
      have h2 : (x - M0) + M0 ≡ (y - M0) + M0 [MOD q] := by
        rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hx'.1, Nat.sub_add_cancel hy'.1]
      exact Nat.ModEq.add_right_cancel' M0 h2
    have e1 := Nat.div_add_mod (x - M0) q
    have e2 := Nat.div_add_mod (y - M0) q
    simp only at hxy
    unfold Nat.ModEq at hc
    rw [hxy, hc] at e1
    omega
  calc T.card ≤ (Finset.range (L / q + 1)).card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    _ = L / q + 1 := Finset.card_range _

/-- **§2.3 Residue-fibre density.**  For coprime `f, l` the fibre of
`m ↦ (m mod f, m mod l)` over any pair of classes `(a, b)`, inside an interval of length `L`,
has at most `L/(fl) + 1` elements. -/
theorem residueFibre_card_le {f l : ℕ} (hfl : Nat.Coprime f l)
    (M0 L a b : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Ico M0 (M0 + L)).filter (fun m => m ≡ a [MOD f] ∧ m ≡ b [MOD l])).card ≤
      L / (f * l) + 1 := by
  refine card_fibre_le M0 L _ (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2
  have hy' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hy).2
  exact (Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul hfl).1
    ⟨hx'.1.trans hy'.1.symm, hx'.2.trans hy'.2.symm⟩

/-- Real-valued form: fibre size `≤ L/(fl) + 1`, i.e. density `1/f` per `l`-class. -/
theorem residueFibre_density {f l : ℕ} (hfl : Nat.Coprime f l)
    (M0 L a b : ℕ) :
    ((((Finset.Ico M0 (M0 + L)).filter
      (fun m => m ≡ a [MOD f] ∧ m ≡ b [MOD l])).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (L : ℝ) / ((f : ℝ) * l) + 1 := by
  have h := residueFibre_card_le hfl M0 L a b
  have hdiv : ((L / (f * l) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) / ((f : ℝ) * l) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_mul]; exact Nat.cast_div_le
  calc _ ≤ ((L / (f * l) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    _ = ((L / (f * l) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

/-! ### §2.4 Ordering-B square from the physical congruences -/

/-- **Physical congruences ⟹ `n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod fl)`.** -/
theorem physical_pair_congr {f l A B c m n1 n2 : ℕ} (hmf : Nat.Coprime m f)
    (hAml : Nat.Coprime (A * m) l) (hfl : Nat.Coprime f l)
    (h1f : m * n1 ≡ c [MOD f]) (h2f : m * n2 ≡ c [MOD f])
    (h1l : A * m * n1 ≡ B [MOD l]) (h2l : A * m * n2 ≡ B [MOD l]) :
    n1 ≡ n2 [MOD f * l] := by
  refine (Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul hfl).1 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.ModEq.cancel_left_of_coprime (by rw [Nat.gcd_comm]; exact hmf)
      (h1f.trans h2f.symm)
  · exact Nat.ModEq.cancel_left_of_coprime (by rw [Nat.gcd_comm]; exact hAml)
      (h1l.trans h2l.symm)

/-- The physical condition of the first-Cauchy source. -/
abbrev physCond (f l A B c m n : ℕ) : Prop := m * n ≡ c [MOD f] ∧ A * m * n ≡ B [MOD l]

/-- **§2.4 Ordering-B square.**  First Cauchy applied to the physical sum (no character
expansion), the square opened into pairs, and every pair in the support satisfies
`n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod fl)` (given the unit hypotheses on every `m` in the outer support). -/
theorem orderingB_physical_square (Mset S : Finset ℕ) (β α : ℕ → ℝ) {f l A B c : ℕ}
    (hfl : Nat.Coprime f l) (hunit : ∀ m ∈ Mset, Nat.Coprime m f ∧ Nat.Coprime (A * m) l) :
    (∑ m ∈ Mset, β m * ∑ n ∈ S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n), α n) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ m ∈ Mset, β m ^ 2) *
        ∑ m ∈ Mset, ∑ p ∈ S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n) ×ˢ
          S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n), α p.1 * α p.2 ∧
    ∀ m ∈ Mset, ∀ p ∈ S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n) ×ˢ
          S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n), p.1 ≡ p.2 [MOD f * l] := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Mset β
      (fun m => ∑ n ∈ S.filter (fun n => physCond f l A B c m n), α n)
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_product]
  · intro m hm p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_product] at hp
    have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp.1).2
    have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp.2).2
    exact physical_pair_congr (hunit m hm).1 (hunit m hm).2 hfl h1.1 h2.1 h1.2 h2.2

end Erdos287.SourceChain

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.Separation

/-!
# Erdős #287 — final-Astra-audit upstream repairs (kernel-proved parts)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**  Manuscript / referee status labels are
metadata and appear in no hypothesis below.

1. **Upper linear-sieve support** `𝒟⁺(D)`: `UpperSieveSupport D ps` (primes in decreasing
   order, odd-prefix conditions `p₁⋯p_{m-1} p_m³ < D`); `upperSieveSupport_prod_lt` proves
   that membership implies `d < D`.  The *well-factorability* of `𝒟⁺(D)` needed to export the
   three critical inequalities is stated exactly as `UpperSieveWellFactorable` (purely
   combinatorial; not proved here — see the report).
2. **V97 noncritical coverage**: `large_count_le_two` (at most two variables exceed `1/3`),
   `complement_one_large`, `complement_two_large` (the complementary product `U`),
   `prefix_hits_window` (a run of small variables has a partial product in any window of
   length `≥` the largest small variable), `TwoLargeEstimate` (the exact analytic estimate
   `|𝒟(Q,b)| ≤ Λ(x/(QN₁) + UQ^{1/2})`) and `twoLarge_cell_saving` (exponent summation).
3. **Scalar-majorant level normalisation**: `pair_coefficient` —
   `D_tot = x^{59/100} = D^{1+ε₀+τ}` ⟹ `2 log x / log D = (200/59)(1+ε₀+τ)`;
   `pair_coefficient_safety` — `(200/59)(1+10⁻³) + 1/295 = 17/5 - 1/295 < 17/5`.
6. **Partition placement**: `partition_after_power_saving` (a subpower partition count times a
   fixed power saving is still a power saving) and the regression
   `partition_on_log_saving_fails` (a subpower count `exp((log log x)^5)` times any
   inverse-logarithmic saving `(log x)^{-A}` is unbounded).
-/

namespace Erdos287.SourceChain

/-! ### 1. Upper linear-sieve support -/

/-- Product of the first `m` entries. -/
def prefixProd (ps : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) : ℕ := (ps.take m).prod

/-- **Upper linear-sieve support** `d = p₁ ⋯ p_r ∈ 𝒟⁺(D)`: primes, strictly decreasing, and for
every odd `m ≤ r`, `p₁ ⋯ p_{m-1} · p_m³ < D`. -/
def UpperSieveSupport (D : ℕ) (ps : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime) ∧ ps.Pairwise (· > ·) ∧
    ∀ m < ps.length, m % 2 = 0 → prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! ^ 3 < D

theorem prefixProd_succ (ps : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < ps.length) :
    prefixProd ps (m + 1) = prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! := by
  unfold prefixProd
  rw [List.take_add_one, List.prod_append]
  simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hm, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD]

/-- **Membership implies `d < D`** (for `D > 1`). -/
theorem upperSieveSupport_prod_lt {D : ℕ} (hD : 1 < D) {ps : List ℕ}
    (h : UpperSieveSupport D ps) : ps.prod < D := by
  obtain ⟨hpr, hdec, hodd⟩ := h
  have hpos : ∀ p ∈ ps, 1 ≤ p := fun p hp => (hpr p hp).one_lt.le
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd ps.length with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · -- even length `2k`
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk0
    · have : ps = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
      subst this; simpa using hD
    · -- last two entries: index `2k-2` (odd position `m = 2k-2`, even index) and `2k-1`
      set m := 2 * k - 2 with hm
      have hm1 : m + 1 < ps.length := by omega
      have hm0 : m < ps.length := by omega
      have hcond := hodd m hm0 (by omega)
      have hlt : ps[m + 1]! < ps[m]! := by
        have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hdec m (m + 1) hm0 hm1 (by omega)
        simpa [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hm0,
          List.getElem?_eq_getElem hm1] using this
      have hprod : ps.prod = prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! * ps[m + 1]! := by
        rw [← prefixProd_succ ps m hm0, ← prefixProd_succ ps (m + 1) hm1]
        unfold prefixProd; rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega)]
      have hpm : 1 ≤ ps[m]! := by
        have := hpos (ps[m]'hm0) (List.getElem_mem hm0)
        simpa [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hm0] using this
      rw [hprod]
      calc prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! * ps[m + 1]! ≤ prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! * ps[m]! :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlt.le
        _ ≤ prefixProd ps m * ps[m]! ^ 3 := by
            rw [pow_succ, pow_two, mul_assoc]
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega))
        _ < D := hcond
  · -- odd length `2k+1`: last index `2k` is an even index
    have hm0 : 2 * k < ps.length := by omega
    have hcond := hodd (2 * k) hm0 (by omega)
    have hprod : ps.prod = prefixProd ps (2 * k) * ps[2 * k]! := by
      rw [← prefixProd_succ ps (2 * k) hm0]
      unfold prefixProd; rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega)]
    have hpm : 1 ≤ ps[2 * k]! := by
      have := hpos (ps[2 * k]'hm0) (List.getElem_mem hm0)
      simpa [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hm0] using this
    rw [hprod]
    calc prefixProd ps (2 * k) * ps[2 * k]! ≤ prefixProd ps (2 * k) * ps[2 * k]! ^ 3 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by
            calc ps[2 * k]! = ps[2 * k]! ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
              _ ≤ ps[2 * k]! ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hpm (by norm_num))
      _ < D := hcond

/-- **Well-factorability of `𝒟⁺(D)`** (Iwaniec; the combinatorial input behind Pascadi
Prop. 5.2's factorisation export): every support element splits as `d = d₁ d₂` with
`d₁ ≤ D₁`, `d₂ ≤ D₂` whenever `D₁ D₂ = D`.  Exact statement only. -/
def UpperSieveWellFactorable : Prop :=
  ∀ (D D1 D2 : ℕ) (ps : List ℕ), 1 ≤ D1 → 1 ≤ D2 → D1 * D2 = D → UpperSieveSupport D ps →
    ∃ d1 d2 : ℕ, d1 * d2 = ps.prod ∧ d1 ≤ D1 ∧ d2 ≤ D2

/-! ### 2. V97 noncritical coverage -/

/-- At most two of finitely many non-negative exponents summing to `1` exceed `1/3`. -/
theorem large_count_le_two {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → ℝ) (he : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i)
    (hsum : ∑ i ∈ s, e i = 1) {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 / 3 ≤ b) :
    (s.filter (fun i => b < e i)).card ≤ 2 := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 : ∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => b < e i), e i ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hsum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      (fun i hi _ => he i hi)
  have h2 : ((s.filter (fun i => b < e i)).card : ℝ) * b <
      ∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => b < e i), e i := by
    have hne : (s.filter (fun i => b < e i)).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.1 (by omega)
    calc ((s.filter (fun i => b < e i)).card : ℝ) * b =
          ∑ _i ∈ s.filter (fun i => b < e i), b := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ < _ := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hne (fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2)
  have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (s.filter (fun i => b < e i)).card := by exact_mod_cast hc
  nlinarith

/-- One large variable `e₁ > b`: the complementary exponent `u = 1 - e₁ < 1 - b`. -/
theorem complement_one_large {e1 b : ℝ} (h : b < e1) : 1 - e1 < 1 - b := by linarith

/-- Two large variables: `u = 1 - e₁ - e₂ < 1 - 2b`. -/
theorem complement_two_large {e1 e2 b : ℝ} (h1 : b < e1) (h2 : b < e2) :
    1 - e1 - e2 < 1 - 2 * b := by linarith

/-- **Window lemma.** For non-negative steps each at most `L`, whose total is at least `a`,
some prefix sum lies in `[a, a + L]`. -/
theorem prefix_hits_window (l : List ℝ) {a L : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hl : ∀ y ∈ l, 0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L) (htot : a ≤ l.sum) :
    ∃ m ≤ l.length, a ≤ (l.take m).sum ∧ (l.take m).sum ≤ a + L := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp at htot ⊢; linarith, by simp; linarith⟩
  | cons y t ih =>
    have hy := hl y (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    by_cases hya : a ≤ y
    · exact ⟨1, by simp, by simpa using hya, by simp; linarith [hy.2]⟩
    · push_neg at hya
      obtain ⟨m, hm, h1, h2⟩ := ih (a := a - y) (by linarith)
        (fun z hz => hl z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)) (by simp at htot; linarith)
      exact ⟨m + 1, by simp; omega, by simp; linarith, by simp; linarith⟩

/-- **Two-large-variable analytic estimate** (exact statement, external): for the bilinear
divisor-in-progression sum `𝒟(Q,b)` with one large variable of size `N₁` and complementary
product `U`, `|𝒟(Q,b)| ≤ Λ (x/(QN₁) + U Q^{1/2})`. -/
def TwoLargeEstimate (Dqb Λ x Q N1 U : ℝ) : Prop :=
  |Dqb| ≤ Λ * (x / (Q * N1) + U * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))

/-- **Exponent summation for a two-large cell**: with `N₁ = x^{n₁}`, `U ≤ x^u`, `Q ≤ x^θ`,
summing over `Q` moduli costs a factor `Q`, giving `Λ (x^{1-n₁} + x^{u + 3θ/2})`. -/
theorem twoLarge_cell_saving {x Q N1 U Λ Dqb n1 u θ : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hN1 : N1 = x ^ n1) (hU : U ≤ x ^ u) (hQθ : Q ≤ x ^ θ)
    (h : TwoLargeEstimate Dqb Λ x Q N1 U) :
    Q * |Dqb| ≤ Λ * (x ^ (1 - n1) + x ^ (u + 3 / 2 * θ)) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  unfold TwoLargeEstimate at h
  have e1 : Q * (x / (Q * N1)) = x ^ (1 - n1) := by
    rw [hN1, Real.rpow_sub hx0, Real.rpow_one]; field_simp
  have e2 : Q * (U * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ≤ x ^ (u + 3 / 2 * θ) := by
    have hq : Q * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = Q ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hQ.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have hq2 : Q ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ x ^ (3 / 2 * θ) := by
      calc Q ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (x ^ θ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hQ.le hQθ (by norm_num)
        _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]; ring_nf
    calc Q * (U * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) = U * Q ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) := by rw [← hq]; ring
      _ ≤ x ^ u * x ^ (3 / 2 * θ) := mul_le_mul hU hq2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0]
  calc Q * |Dqb| ≤ Q * (Λ * (x / (Q * N1) + U * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hQ.le
    _ = Λ * (Q * (x / (Q * N1)) + Q * (U * Q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))) := by ring
    _ ≤ Λ * (x ^ (1 - n1) + x ^ (u + 3 / 2 * θ)) := by
        rw [e1]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hΛ

/-! ### 3. Scalar-majorant level normalisation -/

/-- **Pair coefficient**: `D_tot = x^{59/100} = D^{1+ε₀+τ}` ⟹ `2 log x / log D = (200/59)(1+ε₀+τ)`. -/
theorem pair_coefficient {x D ε0 τ : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (hD : 0 < D) (hk : 0 < 1 + ε0 + τ)
    (hlevel : x ^ ((59 : ℝ) / 100) = D ^ (1 + ε0 + τ)) :
    2 * Real.log x / Real.log D = 200 / 59 * (1 + ε0 + τ) := by
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have h := congrArg Real.log hlevel
  rw [Real.log_rpow (by linarith), Real.log_rpow hD] at h
  have hlD : Real.log D = 59 / 100 * Real.log x / (1 + ε0 + τ) := by
    field_simp; linarith
  rw [hlD]; field_simp; ring

/-- `200/59` alone is **not** the complete coefficient once `ε₀ + τ > 0`. -/
theorem pair_coefficient_exceeds {ε0 τ : ℝ} (h : 0 < ε0 + τ) :
    (200 : ℝ) / 59 < 200 / 59 * (1 + ε0 + τ) := by nlinarith

/-- **Exact rational safety calculation.** -/
theorem pair_coefficient_safety :
    (200 : ℚ) / 59 * (1 + 1 / 1000) + 1 / 295 = 17 / 5 - 1 / 295 ∧
      (200 : ℚ) / 59 * (1 + 1 / 1000) + 1 / 295 < 17 / 5 := by norm_num

/-! ### 6. Placement of the cross-coprime partition -/

/-- Partition multiplicity applied **after** a fixed power saving: still a power saving. -/
theorem partition_after_power_saving {P : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hP : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, P x ≤ x ^ η) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0, P x * x ^ (-κ) ≤ x ^ (-κ / 2) :=
  subpower_absorbed_by_power hP hκ

/-- **Regression**: a subpower partition count `exp((log log x)^5)` multiplied by a merely
inverse-logarithmic saving `(log x)^{-A}` is unbounded, for every `A`. -/
theorem partition_on_log_saving_fails (A C : ℝ) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, 1 < x ∧ C < Real.exp (Real.log (Real.log x) ^ 5) * Real.log x ^ (-A) := by
  set B := Real.log (max C 1)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Real.log_nonneg (le_max_right _ _)
  set t := |A| + B + 2
  have ht : 2 ≤ t := by have := abs_nonneg A; linarith
  refine ⟨Real.exp (Real.exp t), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Real.exp_zero]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (Real.exp_pos _)
  · rw [Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), Real.log_exp,
      ← Real.exp_add]
    have ht4 : t ≤ t ^ 4 := by
      have : 1 ≤ t ^ 3 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have hA : -A * t ≥ -|A| * t := by have := le_abs_self A; nlinarith
    have key : B < t ^ 5 + -A * t := by nlinarith
    calc C ≤ max C 1 := le_max_left _ _
      _ = Real.exp B := (Real.exp_log (by positivity)).symm
      _ < Real.exp (t ^ 5 + Real.log (Real.exp t) * -A) := by
          rw [Real.log_exp]; exact Real.exp_lt_exp.2 (by linarith)
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.log_exp]

end Erdos287.SourceChain

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.ActualAtom
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.SpectralExponent

/-!
# Erdős #287 — actual atom → positive `W₄`: source algebra, narrow providers and ledgers

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**
`AstraActualAtomW4 = PaperCandidate`, `V101ActualAtomW4 = PaperCandidate`,
`IndependentAudit = Pending` (documentation only).

Kernel-proved:

* `source_to_W4` — first Cauchy + representation multiplicity: for one-bounded outer coefficients
  and an inner sum depending on the outer variable only through `π(ω) = (b', z, k)`,
  `|∑_ω a_ω G(π ω)|² ≤ #Ω · m · ∑_{β} |G β|²`, where `m` bounds the fibres of `π`.
* `W4` — the positive square (a weighted sum of squared norms; no bound encoded in it),
  `W4_nonneg`, `fixedA_domination` (the positive-stage map `b' = A₀ b`, injective, only applied
  to the already-formed positive square).
* `cauchy_prefactor`, `cauchy_prefactor_bound` — `(QR²S²)⁻² · N²R²S/f = N²/(fQ²R²S³)`, with the
  regressions `regr_drop_inv_f`, `regr_Q_not_Q2`, `regr_q_independent`.
* `pascadiInner` — the **audited** Pascadi term `FC² + B₀CS² + FCHS`; `regr_old_FHS` shows the
  superseded `FC² + B₀CS² + FHS` is a different function (so it cannot be substituted), and
  `pascadiInner_ge_old` that the audited term dominates it for `C ≥ 1`.
* Three **separate** narrow providers `W4DiagEstimate`, `W4RamEstimate`, `W4SpecEstimate`
  (diagonal, Ramanujan, spectral) and `W4_bound_of_pieces` combining them.
* `packet_exponent` — `|K| ≤ C₀ f^κ N²/(Q x^ε)`, `F^♯ = (M/f)K`, `𝓑 ≤ MQL`, `x = MN` ⟹
  `√(𝓑|F^♯|) ≤ (x/f) f^{(κ+1)/2} x^{-ε/2} √(C₀L)`; instantiated as `astra_packet_391`
  (`κ = 263/128 ⟹ 391/256`) and `v101_packet_775` (`κ = 647/128 ⟹ 775/256`).
* `astra_strong_to_weak` — `f^{199/128} x^{-3ε+ρ₀} ≤ f^{263/128} x^{-ε}` when `ρ₀ ≤ 2ε`.
* `astra_kernel_ledger`, `v101_kernel_ledger` — the exponent decompositions
  `199/128 = 3/2 + 7/128`, `263/128 = 2 + 7/128`, `647/128 = 4 + 1 + 7/128`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.SourceChain

/-! ### Source → positive `W₄` (first Cauchy + multiplicity) -/

/-- **First Cauchy + representation multiplicity.** -/
theorem source_to_W4 {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (Ω : Finset α) (π : α → β) (a : α → ℂ)
    (G : β → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (ha : ∀ ω ∈ Ω, ‖a ω‖ ≤ 1)
    (hm : ∀ b, (Ω.filter (fun ω => π ω = b)).card ≤ m) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ Ω, a ω * G (π ω)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ω.card * (m * ∑ b ∈ Ω.image π, ‖G b‖ ^ 2) := by
  have h1 : ‖∑ ω ∈ Ω, a ω * G (π ω)‖ ≤ ∑ ω ∈ Ω, ‖G (π ω)‖ := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω hω => ?_))
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (ha ω hω)
  have h2 : (∑ ω ∈ Ω, ‖G (π ω)‖) ^ 2 ≤ Ω.card * ∑ ω ∈ Ω, ‖G (π ω)‖ ^ 2 :=
    sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
  have h3 : ∑ ω ∈ Ω, ‖G (π ω)‖ ^ 2 ≤ m * ∑ b ∈ Ω.image π, ‖G b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comp (fun b => ‖G b‖ ^ 2) π, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => ?_)
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hm b) (sq_nonneg _)
  calc ‖∑ ω ∈ Ω, a ω * G (π ω)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ ω ∈ Ω, ‖G (π ω)‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ _ := h2
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

/-- **The positive square** `𝒲₄ = ∑_{β ∈ T} w(β) |inner(β)|²` (definition only). -/
noncomputable def W4 {β : Type*} (T : Finset β) (w : β → ℝ) (inner : β → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b ∈ T, w b * ‖inner b‖ ^ 2

theorem W4_nonneg {β : Type*} (T : Finset β) (w : β → ℝ) (inner : β → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ b ∈ T, 0 ≤ w b) : 0 ≤ W4 T w inner :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b hb => mul_nonneg (hw b hb) (sq_nonneg _))

/-- `source_to_W4` lands in `𝒲₄` with unit weights. -/
theorem source_to_W4' {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (Ω : Finset α) (π : α → β) (a : α → ℂ)
    (G : β → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (ha : ∀ ω ∈ Ω, ‖a ω‖ ≤ 1)
    (hm : ∀ b, (Ω.filter (fun ω => π ω = b)).card ≤ m) :
    ‖∑ ω ∈ Ω, a ω * G (π ω)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ω.card * (m * W4 (Ω.image π) (fun _ => 1) G) := by
  simpa [W4] using source_to_W4 Ω π a G m ha hm

/-- **Fixed-`A` positive domination** `W_{A₀}(B₀,C₀,F₀) ≤ W₁(A₀B₀,C₀,F₀)`: an injective
positive-stage map `ι` (e.g. `b ↦ A₀ b`) with `w ≤ w₁ ∘ ι`, `inner = inner₁ ∘ ι` and
`ι(T) ⊆ T₁` gives domination, provided the target weights are non-negative.  It concerns the
already-formed positive square only. -/
theorem fixedA_domination {β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] (T : Finset β) (T1 : Finset γ)
    (ι : β → γ) (hinj : Set.InjOn ι T) (hsub : T.image ι ⊆ T1) (w : β → ℝ) (w1 : γ → ℝ)
    (inner : β → ℂ) (inner1 : γ → ℂ) (hw : ∀ b ∈ T, w b ≤ w1 (ι b))
    (hw1 : ∀ g ∈ T1, 0 ≤ w1 g) (hin : ∀ b ∈ T, inner b = inner1 (ι b)) :
    W4 T w inner ≤ W4 T1 w1 inner1 := by
  unfold W4
  calc ∑ b ∈ T, w b * ‖inner b‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b ∈ T, w1 (ι b) * ‖inner1 (ι b)‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b hb => by
          rw [hin b hb]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hw b hb) (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = ∑ g ∈ T.image ι, w1 g * ‖inner1 g‖ ^ 2 := (Finset.sum_image (f := fun g => w1 g * ‖inner1 g‖ ^ 2) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ g ∈ T1, w1 g * ‖inner1 g‖ ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun g hg _ =>
          mul_nonneg (hw1 g hg) (sq_nonneg _))

/-- The multiplication map `b ↦ A₀ b` is injective for `A₀ ≠ 0`. -/
theorem mulLeft_injOn {A0 : ℤ} (hA : A0 ≠ 0) (T : Finset ℤ) :
    Set.InjOn (fun b => A0 * b) T := fun _ _ _ _ h => mul_left_cancel₀ hA h

/-! ### The Cauchy prefactor `N²/(fQ²R²S³)` -/

theorem cauchy_prefactor {N Q R S f : ℝ} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hS : S ≠ 0) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    (1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2)) ^ 2 * (N ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S / f) = N ^ 2 / (f * Q ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S ^ 3) := by
  field_simp

/-- **Load-bearing Cauchy prefactor.**  `K = (QR²S²)⁻¹ Σ`, `|Σ|² ≤ #Ω · 𝒲₃`,
`#Ω ≤ N²R²S/f` ⟹ `|K|² ≤ N²/(fQ²R²S³) · 𝒲₃`. -/
theorem cauchy_prefactor_bound {N Q R S f K Sg W3 card : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hS : 0 < S) (hf : 0 < f) (hW3 : 0 ≤ W3) (hK : K = 1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2) * Sg)
    (hSg : Sg ^ 2 ≤ card * W3) (hcard : card ≤ N ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S / f) :
    K ^ 2 ≤ N ^ 2 / (f * Q ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S ^ 3) * W3 := by
  rw [hK, mul_pow, ← cauchy_prefactor hQ.ne' hR.ne' hS.ne' hf.ne']
  have hc : 0 ≤ (1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  calc (1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2)) ^ 2 * Sg ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2)) ^ 2 * (card * W3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSg hc
    _ ≤ (1 / (Q * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2)) ^ 2 * (N ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S / f * W3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hW3) hc
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Regression: dropping the `1/f` density changes the prefactor (`f = 2`). -/
theorem regr_drop_inv_f :
    (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3) ≠ 1 ^ 2 / (1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3) := by norm_num

/-- Regression: replacing `Q²` by `Q` changes the prefactor (`Q = 2`). -/
theorem regr_Q_not_Q2 :
    (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (1 * 2 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3) ≠ 1 ^ 2 / (1 * 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3) := by norm_num

/-- Regression: treating `q` as an independent outer variable multiplies the outer count by `Q`,
which does not give the stated prefactor (`Q = 2`). -/
theorem regr_q_independent :
    (1 / ((2 : ℝ) * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2)) ^ 2 * (1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 * 2 / 1) ≠
      1 ^ 2 / (1 * 2 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3) := by norm_num

/-! ### The audited Pascadi term and the three narrow `W₄` providers -/

/-- **Audited Pascadi term** `FC² + B₀CS² + FCHS`. -/
def pascadiInner (F C B0 S H : ℝ) : ℝ := F * C ^ 2 + B0 * C * S ^ 2 + F * C * H * S

/-- The superseded transcription `FC² + B₀CS² + FHS` (kept only for the regression). -/
def pascadiInnerOld (F C B0 S H : ℝ) : ℝ := F * C ^ 2 + B0 * C * S ^ 2 + F * H * S

/-- **Regression**: the old `FHS` term is a different function, so it cannot feed the chain. -/
theorem regr_old_FHS : pascadiInner 1 2 0 1 1 ≠ pascadiInnerOld 1 2 0 1 1 := by
  unfold pascadiInner pascadiInnerOld; norm_num

/-- For `C ≥ 1` (and non-negative data) the audited term dominates the old one: a bound proved
with the old term is *weaker than claimed* and does not imply the audited bound. -/
theorem pascadiInner_ge_old {F C B0 S H : ℝ} (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) : pascadiInnerOld F C B0 S H ≤ pascadiInner F C B0 S H := by
  unfold pascadiInner pascadiInnerOld
  have : F * H * S ≤ F * C * H * S := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ F * H * S := by positivity
    nlinarith
  linarith

/-- The spectral right-hand side with the audited term. -/
noncomputable def specRHS (Λ T F C B0 S H : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Λ * T ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 64) * (1 + C * Real.sqrt F / (S ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2) * H)) ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 32) *
    (H * S ^ 2 * Real.sqrt F * Real.sqrt (pascadiInner F C B0 S H))

/-- **Narrow provider 1 (diagonal)**: `W_diag ≤ Λ · S H F C B₀`. -/
def W4DiagEstimate (Wdiag Λ S H F C B0 : ℝ) : Prop := Wdiag ≤ Λ * (S * H * F * C * B0)

/-- **Narrow provider 2 (Ramanujan)**: `W_Ram ≤ Λ · S² H² F B₀`. -/
def W4RamEstimate (Wram Λ S H F B0 : ℝ) : Prop := Wram ≤ Λ * (S ^ 2 * H ^ 2 * F * B0)

/-- **Narrow provider 3 (spectral)**, with the audited Pascadi term and the `T^{7/64}`
exceptional loss. -/
def W4SpecEstimate (Wspec Λ T F C B0 S H : ℝ) : Prop := Wspec ≤ specRHS Λ T F C B0 S H

/-- The three providers combine (no hidden fourth input beyond the structural split
`𝒲₄ ≤ W_diag + W_Ram + W_spec`). -/
theorem W4_bound_of_pieces {W Wd Wr Ws Λ T F C B0 S H : ℝ} (hsplit : W ≤ Wd + Wr + Ws)
    (hd : W4DiagEstimate Wd Λ S H F C B0) (hr : W4RamEstimate Wr Λ S H F B0)
    (hs : W4SpecEstimate Ws Λ T F C B0 S H) :
    W ≤ Λ * (S * H * F * C * B0) + Λ * (S ^ 2 * H ^ 2 * F * B0) + specRHS Λ T F C B0 S H := by
  unfold W4DiagEstimate W4RamEstimate W4SpecEstimate at *; linarith

/-! ### `T_H` propagation: `T^{7/64}` inside `𝒲₄` becomes `T^{7/128}` after the square root -/

theorem TH_sqrt_propagation {T W0 : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    Real.sqrt (T ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 64) * W0) = T ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) * Real.sqrt W0 := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hT _), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hT]
  norm_num

/-- `T_H(ω) ≤ Af` gives `T_H^{7/128} ≤ (Af)^{7/128}`. -/
theorem TH_le_Af_power {T A f : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hle : T ≤ A * f) :
    T ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) ≤ (A * f) ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 128) :=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow hT hle (by norm_num)

/-! ### Packet exponents -/

/-- **Generic packet exponent.** -/
theorem packet_exponent {M N Q f x K Fsh Bc C0 L κ ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hf : 0 < f) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hx : x = M * N)
    (hK : |K| ≤ C0 * f ^ κ * N ^ 2 / Q * x ^ (-ε)) (hF : Fsh = M / f * K)
    (hB : Bc ≤ M * Q * L) :
    Real.sqrt (Bc * |Fsh|) ≤
      x / f * (f ^ ((κ + 1) / 2) * x ^ (-(ε / 2)) * Real.sqrt (C0 * L)) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by rw [hx]; positivity
  have hfa : |Fsh| ≤ M / f * (C0 * f ^ κ * N ^ 2 / Q * x ^ (-ε)) := by
    rw [hF, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < M / f)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK (by positivity)
  have hprod : Bc * |Fsh| ≤ (x / f * (f ^ ((κ + 1) / 2) * x ^ (-(ε / 2)) * Real.sqrt (C0 * L))) ^ 2 := by
    calc Bc * |Fsh| ≤ (M * Q * L) * (M / f * (C0 * f ^ κ * N ^ 2 / Q * x ^ (-ε))) :=
          mul_le_mul hB hfa (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (x / f) ^ 2 * (f * f ^ κ) * x ^ (-ε) * (C0 * L) := by
          rw [hx]; field_simp
      _ = _ := by
          have e1 : f * f ^ κ = (f ^ ((κ + 1) / 2)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hf.le,
              show (κ + 1) / 2 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 + κ by push_cast; ring,
              Real.rpow_add hf, Real.rpow_one]
          have e2 : x ^ (-ε) = (x ^ (-(ε / 2))) ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx0.le]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
          rw [e1, e2, mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg hC0 hL)]
          ring
  calc Real.sqrt (Bc * |Fsh|) ≤ Real.sqrt ((x / f * (f ^ ((κ + 1) / 2) * x ^ (-(ε / 2)) *
        Real.sqrt (C0 * L))) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hprod
    _ = _ := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)

/-- **Astra final packet exponent `391/256`** from the (weaker) kernel target `f^{263/128}`. -/
theorem astra_packet_391 {M N Q f x K Fsh Bc C0 L ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hf : 0 < f) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hx : x = M * N)
    (hK : |K| ≤ C0 * f ^ ((263 : ℝ) / 128) * N ^ 2 / Q * x ^ (-ε)) (hF : Fsh = M / f * K)
    (hB : Bc ≤ M * Q * L) :
    Real.sqrt (Bc * |Fsh|) ≤ x / f * (f ^ ((391 : ℝ) / 256) * x ^ (-(ε / 2)) * Real.sqrt (C0 * L)) := by
  have h := packet_exponent hM hN hQ hf hC0 hL hx hK hF hB
  rwa [show ((263 : ℝ) / 128 + 1) / 2 = 391 / 256 by norm_num] at h

/-- **V101 final packet exponent `775/256`** from the kernel exponent `647/128`. -/
theorem v101_packet_775 {M N Q f x K Fsh Bc C0 L ε : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hf : 0 < f) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hx : x = M * N)
    (hK : |K| ≤ C0 * f ^ ((647 : ℝ) / 128) * N ^ 2 / Q * x ^ (-ε)) (hF : Fsh = M / f * K)
    (hB : Bc ≤ M * Q * L) :
    Real.sqrt (Bc * |Fsh|) ≤ x / f * (f ^ ((775 : ℝ) / 256) * x ^ (-(ε / 2)) * Real.sqrt (C0 * L)) := by
  have h := packet_exponent hM hN hQ hf hC0 hL hx hK hF hB
  rwa [show ((647 : ℝ) / 128 + 1) / 2 = 775 / 256 by norm_num] at h

/-- **Astra strong ⟹ weak target**: for `f ≥ 1`, `x ≥ 1`, `ρ₀ ≤ 2ε`,
`f^{199/128} x^{-3ε+ρ₀} ≤ f^{263/128} x^{-ε}`. -/
theorem astra_strong_to_weak {f x ε ρ0 : ℝ} (hf : 1 ≤ f) (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hρ : ρ0 ≤ 2 * ε) :
    f ^ ((199 : ℝ) / 128) * x ^ (-3 * ε + ρ0) ≤ f ^ ((263 : ℝ) / 128) * x ^ (-ε) := by
  have h1 : f ^ ((199 : ℝ) / 128) ≤ f ^ ((263 : ℝ) / 128) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hf (by norm_num)
  have h2 : x ^ (-3 * ε + ρ0) ≤ x ^ (-ε) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx (by linarith)
  exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)

/-- Astra kernel ledger: `199/128 = 3/2 + 7/128` (phase complexity `7/128`), weak target
`263/128 = 2 + 7/128`. -/
theorem astra_kernel_ledger :
    (199 : ℚ) / 128 = 3 / 2 + 7 / 128 ∧ (263 : ℚ) / 128 = 2 + 7 / 128 ∧
      ((263 : ℚ) / 128 + 1) / 2 = 391 / 256 := by norm_num

/-- V101 kernel ledger: residue atomisation `4`, Fourier enlargement `1`, phase complexity
`7/128`: `647/128`; final `775/256`. -/
theorem v101_kernel_ledger :
    (4 : ℚ) + 1 + 7 / 128 = 647 / 128 ∧ ((647 : ℚ) / 128 + 1) / 2 = 775 / 256 := by norm_num

/-- The Astra route is strictly stronger than V101 at both levels. -/
theorem astra_beats_v101 : (263 : ℚ) / 128 < 647 / 128 ∧ (391 : ℚ) / 256 < 775 / 256 := by
  norm_num

end Erdos287.SourceChain

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=15471 sha256=8de0b4747896a417657cddaccce7d9a0f6107a9c0f24f297da31ea952529d035 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/ZeroModeCovariance.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain.TypeIISplit

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V100R source chain: zero-mode covariance (§2.5)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 IS NOT BANKED.**

For moduli `r₁, r₂ ≥ 1` with `g = (r₁,r₂)`, `L = [r₁,r₂]` and the centred indicators
`X_r^a(v) = 1_{v ≡ a (r)} - 1_{(v,r)=1}/φ(r)`, the complete finite-residue identity is

  `∑_{v mod L} X_{r₁}^{a₁}(v) X_{r₂}^{a₂}(v) = 1_{a₁ ≡ a₂ (g)} - 1/φ(g)`     (units `a₁, a₂`),

and, after inserting the tiny-base and `l` congruences (one class modulo the coprime
`q = fl`), the normalised version over a complete residue system modulo `flL` is

  `(1/(fl[r₁,r₂])) (1_{a₁ ≡ a₂ (g)} - 1/φ(g))`.

Kernel-proved:

* `primeFactors_lcm'`, `totient_lcm_mul_totient_gcd` — `φ([a,b]) φ((a,b)) = φ(a) φ(b)`;
* `unitsFibre_card_mul_totient` — for `r ∣ L` and a unit `a (mod r)`, the number of units
  modulo `L` reducing to `a` is `φ(L)/φ(r)` (via `ZMod.unitsMap_surjective`);
* `card_two_congr` — generalised CRT count: `#{v < L : v ≡ a₁ (r₁), v ≡ a₂ (r₂)} = 1_{a₁≡a₂ (g)}`;
* `zeroMode_covariance` — the identity above;
* `sum_crt_lift` and `zeroMode_covariance_full` — the normalised `1/(fl[r₁,r₂])` version.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.SourceChain

open Erdos287.CurrentTail

/-! ### Totient identities -/

theorem primeFactors_lcm' {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (Nat.lcm a b).primeFactors = a.primeFactors ∪ b.primeFactors := by
  ext p
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Nat.mem_primeFactors, ne_eq, Nat.lcm_eq_zero_iff, ha, hb,
    or_self, not_false_eq_true, and_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hd⟩
    have : p ∣ a * b := hd.trans (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul a b)
    exact (hp.dvd_mul.1 this).imp (fun h => ⟨hp, h⟩) (fun h => ⟨hp, h⟩)
  · rintro (⟨hp, h⟩ | ⟨hp, h⟩)
    · exact ⟨hp, h.trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b)⟩
    · exact ⟨hp, h.trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right a b)⟩

/-- `φ([a,b]) · φ((a,b)) = φ(a) · φ(b)`. -/
theorem totient_lcm_mul_totient_gcd {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Nat.totient (Nat.lcm a b) * Nat.totient (Nat.gcd a b) = Nat.totient a * Nat.totient b := by
  have key : ((Nat.totient (Nat.lcm a b) * Nat.totient (Nat.gcd a b) : ℕ) : ℚ) =
      ((Nat.totient a * Nat.totient b : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors, Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors,
      Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors a, Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors b,
      primeFactors_lcm' ha hb, Nat.primeFactors_gcd ha hb]
    have h1 := Finset.prod_union_inter (s₁ := a.primeFactors) (s₂ := b.primeFactors)
      (f := fun p : ℕ => (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹))
    have h2 : ((Nat.lcm a b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((Nat.gcd a b : ℕ) : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) * b := by
      exact_mod_cast (by rw [mul_comm]; exact Nat.gcd_mul_lcm a b)
    calc _ = (((Nat.lcm a b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((Nat.gcd a b : ℕ) : ℚ)) *
          ((∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors ∪ b.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)) *
            ∏ p ∈ a.primeFactors ∩ b.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℚ)⁻¹)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h1, h2]; ring
  exact_mod_cast key

/-! ### Fibres of the unit reduction map -/

/-- For `r ∣ L` and a unit `a` modulo `r`, the units modulo `L` lying over `a` number
`φ(L)/φ(r)`. -/
theorem unitsFibre_card_mul_totient {r L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (hrL : r ∣ L) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : Nat.Coprime a r) :
    ((range L).filter (fun v => Nat.Coprime v L ∧ v ≡ a [MOD r])).card * Nat.totient r =
      Nat.totient L := by
  haveI : NeZero L := ⟨hL.ne'⟩
  have hr : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hrL hL
  haveI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  classical
  have hfib : ∀ y : (ZMod r)ˣ,
      (univ.filter (fun g : (ZMod L)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hrL g = y)).card =
      (univ.filter (fun g : (ZMod L)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hrL g =
        ZMod.unitOfCoprime a ha)).card := fun y =>
    MonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range (ZMod.unitsMap hrL) (ZMod.unitsMap_surjective hrL y)
      (ZMod.unitsMap_surjective hrL _)
  have htot : (univ.filter (fun g : (ZMod L)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hrL g =
        ZMod.unitOfCoprime a ha)).card * Nat.totient r = Nat.totient L := by
    calc _ = ∑ y : (ZMod r)ˣ,
          (univ.filter (fun g : (ZMod L)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hrL g = y)).card := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => hfib y), Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul,
            Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, mul_comm]
      _ = (univ : Finset (ZMod L)ˣ).card :=
          (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient]
  rw [← htot]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun v hv => ZMod.unitOfCoprime v (Finset.mem_filter.1 hv).2.1)
    ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    apply Units.ext
    simp [ZMod.unitsMap_def, ZMod.unitOfCoprime]
    exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hv).2.2
  · intro v hv w hw hvw
    have := congrArg (fun u : (ZMod L)ˣ => ((u : ZMod L)).val) hvw
    simp [ZMod.unitOfCoprime, ZMod.val_natCast] at this
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hv).1),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hw).1)] at this
  · intro g hg
    refine ⟨(g : ZMod L).val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      refine ⟨ZMod.val_lt _, ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime g, ?_⟩
      have hg' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hg).2
      have := congrArg (fun u : (ZMod r)ˣ => (u : ZMod r)) hg'
      simp [ZMod.unitsMap_def, ZMod.unitOfCoprime] at this
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, ← ZMod.cast_natCast hrL, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
      exact this
    · apply Units.ext; simp [ZMod.unitOfCoprime]

/-! ### Generalised CRT count -/

/-- `#{v < [r₁,r₂] : v ≡ a₁ (r₁), v ≡ a₂ (r₂)} = 1_{a₁ ≡ a₂ (mod (r₁,r₂))}`. -/
theorem card_two_congr {r1 r2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < r1) (h2 : 0 < r2) (a1 a2 : ℕ) :
    (((range (Nat.lcm r1 r2)).filter (fun v => v ≡ a1 [MOD r1] ∧ v ≡ a2 [MOD r2])).card : ℝ) =
      ind (a1 ≡ a2 [MOD Nat.gcd r1 r2]) := by
  have hL : 0 < Nat.lcm r1 r2 := Nat.lcm_pos h1 h2
  unfold ind
  split_ifs with hc
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := Nat.chineseRemainder' (n := r1) (m := r2) hc
    have hk : (range (Nat.lcm r1 r2)).filter (fun v => v ≡ a1 [MOD r1] ∧ v ≡ a2 [MOD r2]) =
        {k % Nat.lcm r1 r2} := by
      ext v
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_singleton]
      have hkL1 : k % Nat.lcm r1 r2 ≡ k [MOD r1] :=
        Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_left r1 r2) (Nat.mod_modEq k _)
      have hkL2 : k % Nat.lcm r1 r2 ≡ k [MOD r2] :=
        Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.dvd_lcm_right r1 r2) (Nat.mod_modEq k _)
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hv, hv1, hv2⟩
        have h := Nat.mod_lcm (hv1.trans (hkL1.trans hk1).symm) (hv2.trans (hkL2.trans hk2).symm)
        unfold Nat.ModEq at h
        rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ hL)] at h
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hL, hkL1.trans hk1, hkL2.trans hk2⟩
    rw [hk]; simp
  · have : (range (Nat.lcm r1 r2)).filter (fun v => v ≡ a1 [MOD r1] ∧ v ≡ a2 [MOD r2]) = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
      rintro v - ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
      exact hc ((Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left r1 r2) hv1).symm.trans
        (Nat.ModEq.of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_right r1 r2) hv2))
    rw [this]; simp

/-! ### The zero-mode covariance identity -/

theorem coprime_iff_of_modEq {a b n : ℕ} (h : a ≡ b [MOD n]) :
    Nat.Coprime a n ↔ Nat.Coprime b n := by
  unfold Nat.Coprime; rw [h.gcd_eq]

/-- Centred indicator `X_r^a(v) = 1_{v ≡ a (r)} - 1_{(v,r)=1}/φ(r)`. -/
noncomputable def Xc (r a v : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ind (v ≡ a [MOD r]) - ind (Nat.Coprime v r) / (Nat.totient r : ℝ)

theorem sum_ind_eq_card (s : Finset ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ∑ v ∈ s, ind (P v) = ((s.filter P).card : ℝ) := by
  unfold ind; rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

/-- Cross term: `∑_{v<L} 1_{v≡a (r)} 1_{(v,r')=1} = φ(L)/φ(r)` for a unit `a (mod r)`. -/
theorem cross_term {r r' L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (hrL : r ∣ L)
    (hcop : ∀ v, Nat.Coprime v r ∧ Nat.Coprime v r' ↔ Nat.Coprime v L) {a : ℕ}
    (ha : Nat.Coprime a r) :
    ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a [MOD r]) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r') =
      (Nat.totient L : ℝ) / (Nat.totient r : ℝ) := by
  have hr : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hrL hL
  have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient r := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hr
  have h := unitsFibre_card_mul_totient hL hrL ha
  have hcast : ((((range L).filter (fun v => Nat.Coprime v L ∧ v ≡ a [MOD r])).card : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (Nat.totient r : ℝ) = (Nat.totient L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  rw [eq_div_iff hφ.ne', ← hcast]
  have : ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a [MOD r]) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r') =
      ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (Nat.Coprime v L ∧ v ≡ a [MOD r]) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
    rw [← ind_and]
    refine ind_congr ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨(hcop v).1 ⟨(coprime_iff_of_modEq h1).2 ha, h2⟩, h1⟩,
      fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h2, ((hcop v).2 h1).2⟩⟩
  rw [this, sum_ind_eq_card]

/-- **§2.5 Zero-mode covariance (complete finite-residue identity).**
For units `a₁ (mod r₁)`, `a₂ (mod r₂)`:
`∑_{v mod [r₁,r₂]} X_{r₁}^{a₁}(v) X_{r₂}^{a₂}(v) = 1_{a₁ ≡ a₂ ((r₁,r₂))} - 1/φ((r₁,r₂))`. -/
theorem zeroMode_covariance {r1 r2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < r1) (h2 : 0 < r2) {a1 a2 : ℕ}
    (ha1 : Nat.Coprime a1 r1) (ha2 : Nat.Coprime a2 r2) :
    ∑ v ∈ range (Nat.lcm r1 r2), Xc r1 a1 v * Xc r2 a2 v =
      ind (a1 ≡ a2 [MOD Nat.gcd r1 r2]) - 1 / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd r1 r2) : ℝ) := by
  set L := Nat.lcm r1 r2
  set g := Nat.gcd r1 r2
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.lcm_pos h1 h2
  have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h1
  have hcop : ∀ v, Nat.Coprime v r1 ∧ Nat.Coprime v r2 ↔ Nat.Coprime v L := fun v => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩
      exact Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul r1 r2) (Nat.Coprime.mul_right a b)
    · intro h; exact ⟨Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Nat.dvd_lcm_left r1 r2) h,
        Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Nat.dvd_lcm_right r1 r2) h⟩
  have hcop' : ∀ v, Nat.Coprime v r2 ∧ Nat.Coprime v r1 ↔ Nat.Coprime v L :=
    fun v => and_comm.trans (hcop v)
  have hA : ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a1 [MOD r1]) * ind (v ≡ a2 [MOD r2]) =
      ind (a1 ≡ a2 [MOD g]) := by
    rw [← card_two_congr h1 h2, ← sum_ind_eq_card]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => (ind_and _ _).symm)
  have hB := cross_term hL (Nat.dvd_lcm_left r1 r2) hcop ha1
  have hC := cross_term hL (Nat.dvd_lcm_right r1 r2) hcop' ha2
  have hD : ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (Nat.Coprime v r1) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r2) =
      (Nat.totient L : ℝ) := by
    rw [show ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (Nat.Coprime v r1) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r2) =
        ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (Nat.Coprime L v) from Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => by
          rw [← ind_and]; exact ind_congr ((hcop v).trans Nat.coprime_comm)),
      sum_ind_eq_card, Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]
  have hφ1 : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient r1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 h1
  have hφ2 : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient r2 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 h2
  have hφg : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient g := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hg
  have hid : (Nat.totient L : ℝ) * Nat.totient g = Nat.totient r1 * Nat.totient r2 := by
    exact_mod_cast totient_lcm_mul_totient_gcd h1.ne' h2.ne'
  have expand : ∑ v ∈ range L, Xc r1 a1 v * Xc r2 a2 v =
      ∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a1 [MOD r1]) * ind (v ≡ a2 [MOD r2]) -
        (∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a1 [MOD r1]) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r2)) / Nat.totient r2 -
        (∑ v ∈ range L, ind (v ≡ a2 [MOD r2]) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r1)) / Nat.totient r1 +
        (∑ v ∈ range L, ind (Nat.Coprime v r1) * ind (Nat.Coprime v r2)) /
          (Nat.totient r1 * Nat.totient r2) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
    unfold Xc; ring
  have hg' : 1 / (Nat.totient g : ℝ) = Nat.totient L / (Nat.totient r1 * Nat.totient r2) := by
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hφg.ne' (by positivity), one_mul, ← hid]
  rw [expand, hA, hB, hC, hD, hg']
  field_simp
  ring

/-! ### Normalised version over a complete system modulo `q L` (`q = fl`) -/

/-- Lifting through one class modulo a coprime `q`: for `L`-periodic `F`,
`∑_{v < qL, v ≡ c (q)} F(v) = ∑_{u < L} F(u)`. -/
theorem sum_crt_lift {q L : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hL : 0 < L) (hqL : Nat.Coprime q L) (c : ℕ)
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ v, F v = F (v % L)) :
    ∑ v ∈ (range (q * L)).filter (fun v => v ≡ c [MOD q]), F v = ∑ u ∈ range L, F u := by
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun v => v % L) (fun u => (Nat.chineseRemainder hqL c u : ℕ))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro v _; simp only [Finset.mem_range]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hL
  · intro u _
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨Nat.chineseRemainder_lt_mul hqL c u hq.ne' hL.ne',
      (Nat.chineseRemainder hqL c u).2.1⟩
  · intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hv
    have h1 := (Nat.chineseRemainder hqL c (v % L)).2
    have h := (Nat.modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul hqL).1
      ⟨h1.1.trans hv.2.symm, h1.2.trans (Nat.mod_modEq v L)⟩
    unfold Nat.ModEq at h
    simp only
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.chineseRemainder_lt_mul hqL c _ hq.ne' hL.ne'),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv.1] at h
  · intro u hu
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hu
    have h2 := (Nat.chineseRemainder hqL c u).2.2
    simp only
    unfold Nat.ModEq at h2
    rw [h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hu]
  · intro v _; exact hF v

theorem Xc_periodic {r a L : ℕ} (hrL : r ∣ L) (v : ℕ) : Xc r a v = Xc r a (v % L) := by
  have h : v % L ≡ v [MOD r] := Nat.ModEq.of_dvd hrL (Nat.mod_modEq v L)
  unfold Xc
  rw [ind_congr (show v ≡ a [MOD r] ↔ v % L ≡ a [MOD r] from ⟨h.trans, h.symm.trans⟩),
    ind_congr (show Nat.Coprime v r ↔ Nat.Coprime (v % L) r from
      (coprime_iff_of_modEq h).symm)]

/-- **§2.5, normalised form.**  Averaging over a complete residue system modulo
`fl[r₁,r₂]`, restricted to one class modulo `q = fl` (coprime to `[r₁,r₂]`):
`(1/(q[r₁,r₂])) ∑ X_{r₁}^{a₁} X_{r₂}^{a₂} = (1/(q[r₁,r₂])) (1_{a₁≡a₂ (g)} - 1/φ(g))`. -/
theorem zeroMode_covariance_full {f l r1 r2 : ℕ} (hf : 0 < f) (hl : 0 < l) (h1 : 0 < r1)
    (h2 : 0 < r2) (hcop : Nat.Coprime (f * l) (Nat.lcm r1 r2)) (c : ℕ) {a1 a2 : ℕ}
    (ha1 : Nat.Coprime a1 r1) (ha2 : Nat.Coprime a2 r2) :
    (1 / ((f * l * Nat.lcm r1 r2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ∑ v ∈ (range (f * l * Nat.lcm r1 r2)).filter (fun v => v ≡ c [MOD f * l]),
          Xc r1 a1 v * Xc r2 a2 v =
      (1 / ((f * l * Nat.lcm r1 r2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        (ind (a1 ≡ a2 [MOD Nat.gcd r1 r2]) - 1 / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd r1 r2) : ℝ)) := by
  rw [sum_crt_lift (Nat.mul_pos hf hl) (Nat.lcm_pos h1 h2) hcop c _
    (fun v => by
      rw [Xc_periodic (Nat.dvd_lcm_left r1 r2) v, Xc_periodic (Nat.dvd_lcm_right r1 r2) v]),
    zeroMode_covariance h1 h2 ha1 ha2]

end Erdos287.SourceChain

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4625 sha256=edb246758c4db2b6be549b83ce1783ffff3325009b06bc620dae783044a6a6ce path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/audit.sh@@
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Erdős #287 — SourceChain subtree: token / firewall / build / checker / negative-control audit.
# Run from anywhere:  bash RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain/audit.sh
# Every check fails loudly (non-zero exit).  ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  TAIL-287 NOT BANKED.
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
SUB=RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain
FILES="$SUB/*.lean RequestProject/Erdos287/SourceChain.lean"
fail=0
bad() { echo "FAIL: $*"; fail=1; }
strip() { perl -0pe 's{/-.*?-/}{}gs; s{--[^\n]*}{}g' "$1"; }

echo "== 1. forbidden tokens in code (comments/docstrings stripped)"
probe=$(printf 'theorem t : True := by\n  sorry\n' | perl -0pe 's{/-.*?-/}{}gs; s{--[^\n]*}{}g')
echo "$probe" | grep -Pq '\bsorry\b' || bad "scanner self-test failed"
for f in $FILES; do
  code=$(strip "$f")
  for pat in '\bsorry\b' '\badmit\b' '^\s*axiom\b' '\bunsafe\b' '\bnative_decide\b' \
             '\bbv_decide\b' 'implemented_by' '\bopaque\b' '\bextern\b' 'ofReduceBool' \
             'False\.elim' '^\s*instance\b' '\bexact\?' ; do
    if echo "$code" | grep -Pq "$pat"; then bad "$f matches $pat"; fi
  done
done

echo "== 2. no unconditional tail theorem and no alias of the conditional ones"
for f in $FILES; do
  code=$(strip "$f")
  if echo "$code" | grep -Pq '^\s*(theorem|def|abbrev|lemma)\s+\S*Unconditional'; then
    bad "$f declares an 'Unconditional' tail object"
  fi
  if echo "$code" | grep -Pq ':=\s*(Tail287_of_AnalyticProviders|Tail287_of_MinimalAnalyticProviders|Tail287_of_NarrowProviders)\s*$'; then
    bad "$f aliases a conditional tail theorem"
  fi
done

echo "== 3. CurrentTail / W3 / W2.984 / historical subtrees and ARISTOTLE_SUMMARY.md unchanged"
BASE=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1)
if ! git diff --quiet "$BASE" -- RequestProject/Erdos287/CurrentTail RequestProject/Erdos287/CurrentTail.lean \
     RequestProject/Erdos287/W3Publication RequestProject/Erdos287/W3Publication.lean \
     RequestProject/Erdos287/W2984Publication RequestProject/Erdos287/W2984Publication.lean \
     RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R.lean \
     RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87 ARISTOTLE_SUMMARY.md; then
  bad "protected files modified"
fi

echo "== 4. narrow build (runs #sc_assert_all_std_axioms, provider firewalls, DAG decides)"
if ! lake build RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain > /tmp/sc_build.log 2>&1; then
  tail -30 /tmp/sc_build.log; bad "narrow build failed"
fi
if grep -q "declaration uses 'sorry'" /tmp/sc_build.log; then bad "build reports sorry"; fi

echo "== 5. fresh kernel re-check with the installed checker"
CHK=""
for c in leanchecker lean4checker; do
  if lake env which "$c" > /dev/null 2>&1; then CHK=$c; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$CHK" ]; then bad "no kernel checker found"; else
  echo "checker: $CHK"
  if ! lake env "$CHK" --fresh RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain > /tmp/sc_check.log 2>&1; then
    tail -20 /tmp/sc_check.log; bad "$CHK --fresh failed"
  fi
fi

echo "== 6. negative controls (each must FAIL to elaborate)"
mk() { cat > "/tmp/sc_neg$1.lean"; }
mk 1 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
namespace Erdos287.SourceChain
theorem bad_sorry : 1 = 2 := by sorry
end Erdos287.SourceChain
#sc_assert_all_std_axioms
X
mk 2 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
namespace Erdos287.SourceChain
theorem bad_native : 10 < 20 := by native_decide
end Erdos287.SourceChain
#sc_assert_all_std_axioms
X
mk 3 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
-- the retired Ordering A must not reach the tail
example : Erdos287.SourceChain.scReachable .orderingA .conditionalTail = true := by decide
X
mk 4 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
-- metadata must not feed a mathematical node
example : (Erdos287.SourceChain.SCNode.refereePending,
    Erdos287.SourceChain.SCNode.conditionalTail) ∈ Erdos287.SourceChain.scEdges := by decide
X
mk 5 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
-- the conditional tail does not feed global #287 directly
example : (Erdos287.SourceChain.SCNode.conditionalTail,
    Erdos287.SourceChain.SCNode.globalErdos287) ∈ Erdos287.SourceChain.scEdges := by decide
X
mk 6 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.SourceChain
-- the 391/256 ledger is not satisfied for sigma = 1/3
example : (391 / 256 : ℚ) * (1 / 3) < 1 / 4 := by norm_num
X
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  if lake env lean "/tmp/sc_neg$i.lean" > "/tmp/sc_neg$i.log" 2>&1; then
    bad "negative control $i unexpectedly elaborated"
  else
    echo "negative control $i rejected (as expected)"
  fi
done

if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then echo "AUDIT PASSED"; else echo "AUDIT FAILED"; exit 1; fi

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=7130 sha256=3731fdd502ce52f4b985382e40ffd68ccd6ff156a05d73a2d32315d09a669a00 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/TopLayer.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.Defs

/-!
# Erdős Problem #287 — top-layer congruence and obstructions

Let `A` be a finite set of positive integers with `∑_{a∈A} 1/a = 1`, let `p` be a prime,
`e = topExp A p` the maximal `p`-adic valuation, and `A_p^{max} = topLayer A p`.

If `e ≥ 1`, writing each `a ∈ A_p^{max}` as `a = p^e · m_a` with `p ∤ m_a`
(so `m_a = ordCompl[p] a`), we have

`∑_{a ∈ A_p^{max}} m_a⁻¹ ≡ 0 (mod p)`.

We deduce the singleton/pair/triple obstructions.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

namespace Erdos287

/-
**Top-layer congruence.** With `m_a = ordCompl[p] a = a / p^e`, the sum of the
mod-`p` inverses of the cofactors over the top `p`-adic layer vanishes in `ZMod p`.
-/
theorem topLayer_congruence
    (A : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1)
    (he : 1 ≤ topExp A p) :
    (∑ a ∈ topLayer A p, (((ordCompl[p] a : ℕ) : ZMod p))⁻¹) = 0 := by
  have h_mul_ne_zero : ( (∏ a ∈ A, (a / p ^ (Nat.factorization a p))):ZMod p ) ≠ 0 := by
    haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ;
    exact fun x hx => Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp ( ne_of_gt ( hpos x hx ) );
  have h_identity : (∑ a ∈ A, (p ^ (topExp A p - Nat.factorization a p) * (∏ b ∈ A.erase a, (b / p ^ Nat.factorization b p)) : ℕ)) = p ^ topExp A p * (∏ a ∈ A, (a / p ^ Nat.factorization a p)) := by
    -- Multiply both sides of the equation by $p^e * N$ to clear the denominators.
    have h_mul : (∑ a ∈ A, (p ^ topExp A p * (∏ b ∈ A, (b / p ^ Nat.factorization b p)) : ℚ) / a) = p ^ topExp A p * (∏ a ∈ A, (a / p ^ Nat.factorization a p)) := by
      simp_all +decide [ div_eq_mul_inv, ← Finset.mul_sum _ _ _ ];
    convert h_mul using 1;
    rw [ ← @Nat.cast_inj ℚ ] ; push_cast ; rw [ Finset.sum_congr rfl ];
    intro a ha; rw [ eq_div_iff ( Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr <| ne_of_gt <| hpos a ha ) ] ; rw [ ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ ha ] ; simp +decide [ mul_comm ] ;
    rw [ Nat.cast_div ( Nat.ordProj_dvd _ _ ) ( by aesop ) ] ; ring;
    field_simp;
    rw [ show ( p : ℚ ) ^ topExp A p = p ^ ( Nat.factorization a p ) * p ^ ( topExp A p - Nat.factorization a p ) by rw [ ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le ( show Nat.factorization a p ≤ topExp A p from Finset.le_sup ( f := fun a => Nat.factorization a p ) ha ) ] ] ; push_cast ; ring;
  have h_identity_mod : (∑ a ∈ A, (p ^ (topExp A p - Nat.factorization a p) * (∏ b ∈ A.erase a, (b / p ^ Nat.factorization b p)) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
    norm_cast ; simp_all +decide;
    rw [ zero_pow ( by linarith ), MulZeroClass.zero_mul ];
  have h_identity_mod_top : (∑ a ∈ topLayer A p, (∏ b ∈ A.erase a, (b / p ^ Nat.factorization b p) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
    have h_identity_mod_top : (∑ a ∈ A \ topLayer A p, (p ^ (topExp A p - Nat.factorization a p) * (∏ b ∈ A.erase a, (b / p ^ Nat.factorization b p)) : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
      refine' Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => _;
      simp_all +decide [ Finset.mem_sdiff ];
      rw [ zero_pow ] <;> norm_num;
      exact Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt ( lt_of_le_of_ne ( Finset.le_sup ( f := fun a => Nat.factorization a p ) hx.1 ) fun h => hx.2 <| Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ hx.1, h ⟩ );
    simp_all +decide [ topLayer ];
    convert h_identity_mod_top using 2 ; aesop;
  convert congr_arg ( fun x : ZMod p => x * ( ∏ a ∈ A, ( a / p ^ a.factorization p : ZMod p ) ) ⁻¹ ) h_identity_mod_top using 1;
  · rw [ Finset.sum_mul _ _ _ ];
    refine' Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => _;
    rw [ ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ ( Finset.mem_coe.mpr ( Finset.mem_of_mem_filter _ hx ) ), mul_comm ];
    haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff ] ;
  · ring

/-
The top `p`-adic layer cannot be a singleton (when `e ≥ 1`).
-/
theorem topLayer_card_ne_one
    (A : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1)
    (he : 1 ≤ topExp A p) :
    (topLayer A p).card ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have h_singleton : ∃ a, topLayer A p = {a} := by
    exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp h;
  -- By `topLayer_congruence A p hp hpos hsum he`, `∑ x ∈ topLayer A p, ((ordCompl[p] x : ZMod p))⁻¹ = 0`.
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h_singleton
  have h_sum : ((ordCompl[p] a : ZMod p))⁻¹ = 0 := by
    have := topLayer_congruence A p hp hpos hsum he; simp_all +decide [ Finset.sum_singleton ] ;
  haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide ;
  rw [ ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] at h_sum ; exact Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp ( ne_of_gt ( hpos a ( Finset.mem_filter.mp ( ha.symm ▸ Finset.mem_singleton_self _ ) |>.1 ) ) ) h_sum;

/-
**Two-element obstruction.** If the top layer is `{a₁, a₂}` with cofactors
`m₁, m₂`, then `p ∣ m₁ + m₂`.
-/
theorem topLayer_two_obstruction
    (A : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1)
    (he : 1 ≤ topExp A p)
    {a₁ a₂ : ℕ} (ha : topLayer A p = {a₁, a₂}) (hne : a₁ ≠ a₂) :
    p ∣ (ordCompl[p] a₁ + ordCompl[p] a₂) := by
  have h_cong : (((ordCompl[p] a₁ : ℕ) : ZMod p))⁻¹ + (((ordCompl[p] a₂ : ℕ) : ZMod p))⁻¹ = 0 := by
    convert topLayer_congruence A p hp hpos hsum he using 1;
    rw [ ha, Finset.sum_pair hne ];
  haveI := Fact.mk hp; rw [ ← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ; simp_all +decide [ add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg ] ;
  rw [ inv_eq_iff_eq_inv ] at h_cong ; aesop

/-
**Three-element obstruction.** If the top layer is `{a₁, a₂, a₃}` with cofactors
`m₁, m₂, m₃`, then `p ∣ m₁m₂ + m₁m₃ + m₂m₃`.
-/
theorem topLayer_three_obstruction
    (A : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1)
    (he : 1 ≤ topExp A p)
    {a₁ a₂ a₃ : ℕ} (ha : topLayer A p = {a₁, a₂, a₃})
    (h₁₂ : a₁ ≠ a₂) (h₁₃ : a₁ ≠ a₃) (h₂₃ : a₂ ≠ a₃) :
    p ∣ (ordCompl[p] a₁ * ordCompl[p] a₂ + ordCompl[p] a₁ * ordCompl[p] a₃
          + ordCompl[p] a₂ * ordCompl[p] a₃) := by
  have h_cong : (∑ a ∈ ({a₁, a₂, a₃} : Finset ℕ), ((ordCompl[p] a : ℕ) : ZMod p)⁻¹) = 0 := by
    have := topLayer_congruence A p hp hpos hsum he; aesop;
  have h_inv_ne_zero : (a₁ / p ^ (Nat.factorization a₁ p) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 ∧ (a₂ / p ^ (Nat.factorization a₂ p) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 ∧ (a₃ / p ^ (Nat.factorization a₃ p) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    have h_inv_ne_zero : ∀ a ∈ ({a₁, a₂, a₃} : Finset ℕ), (a / p ^ (Nat.factorization a p) : ℕ) ≠ 0 ∧ ¬(p ∣ (a / p ^ (Nat.factorization a p) : ℕ)) := by
      intro a ha; have := topLayer_subset A p; simp_all +decide [ Finset.ext_iff ] ;
      exact ⟨ Nat.le_of_dvd ( hpos a ( this ( by aesop ) ) ) ( Nat.ordProj_dvd _ _ ), Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp ( hpos a ( this ( by aesop ) ) |> ne_of_gt ) ⟩;
    haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ ← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ;
  haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ ← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ;
  grind

end Erdos287
@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6146 sha256=53cad4145f3120c12d325e950a870e3595c1dee8c6c3a0c09389d837d029ee97 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/Window.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.TopLayer
import RequestProject.Erdos287.Cnum

/-!
# Erdős Problem #287 — prime-power window exclusion

If `A ⊆ {1,…,M}` with `∑_{a∈A} 1/a = 1`, `q = p^e ≤ M`, `j = ⌊M/q⌋`, and `p > C(j)`,
then no element of `A` is divisible by `q`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

namespace Erdos287

/-
If the mod-`p` inverse sum of a finite set `S` of positive integers coprime to `p`
vanishes in `ZMod p`, then `p` divides the numerator of `∑_{s∈S} 1/s`.
-/
theorem dvd_num_of_sum_inv_zero (S : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ s ∈ S, 0 < s) (hcop : ∀ s ∈ S, ¬ p ∣ s)
    (h0 : (∑ s ∈ S, ((s : ZMod p))⁻¹) = 0) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ (∑ s ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / s).num := by
  have h_num : (∑ s ∈ S, (s : ℚ)⁻¹).num * (∏ s ∈ S, s) ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
    have h_num : (∑ s ∈ S, (s : ℚ)⁻¹).num * (∏ s ∈ S, s) = (∑ s ∈ S, (∏ t ∈ S \ {s}, t)) * (∑ s ∈ S, (s : ℚ)⁻¹).den := by
      have h_num : (∑ s ∈ S, (s : ℚ)⁻¹) * (∏ s ∈ S, s) = (∑ s ∈ S, (∏ t ∈ S \ {s}, t)) := by
        push_cast [ Finset.sum_mul _ _ _ ];
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => by rw [ inv_mul_eq_div, div_eq_iff ( Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr <| ne_of_gt <| hpos x hx ) ] ; rw [ Finset.prod_eq_prod_diff_singleton_mul hx ] ;
      rw [ ← Rat.num_div_den ( ∑ s ∈ S, ( s : ℚ ) ⁻¹ ) ] at h_num;
      rw [ div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff ] at h_num <;> norm_cast at * ; aesop;
    haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff ] ;
    have h_sum_zero : (∑ s ∈ S, (∏ t ∈ S \ {s}, (t : ZMod p))) = (∏ s ∈ S, (s : ZMod p)) * (∑ s ∈ S, (s : ZMod p)⁻¹) := by
      rw [ Finset.mul_sum _ _ _ ];
      refine' Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => _;
      rw [ ← Finset.prod_sdiff ( Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx ), Finset.prod_singleton ];
      rw [ mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ ( by rw [ Ne.eq_def, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ; exact hcop x hx ), mul_one ];
    aesop;
  simp_all +decide [ ← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff ];
  haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff ] ;
  exact h_num.resolve_right fun ⟨ a, ha, ha' ⟩ => hcop a ha ha'

/-
**Prime-power window exclusion.** If `A ⊆ {1,…,M}`, `∑ 1/a = 1`, `q = p^e ≤ M`,
`j = ⌊M/q⌋`, and `p > C(j)`, then no element of `A` is divisible by `q`.

The hypothesis `hqM : p^e ≤ M` is included because it is part of the stated problem,
but the proof does not use it: if `p^e > M`, no element `a ≤ M` can be divisible by `p^e`,
so the conclusion holds trivially.
-/
theorem primePower_window_exclusion
    (A : Finset ℕ) (M p e : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a)
    (hAM : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ M)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1)
    (he : 1 ≤ e)
    (hqM : p ^ e ≤ M)
    (hpC : C (M / p ^ e) < (p : ℤ)) :
    ∀ a ∈ A, ¬ (p ^ e ∣ a) := by
  contrapose! hpC; haveI := Fact.mk hp; simp_all +decide [ div_eq_mul_inv ] ;
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀A, ha₀q⟩ : ∃ a₀ ∈ A, p ^ e ∣ a₀ := hpC
  set E := A.sup (fun a => Nat.factorization a p)
  have hE_ge_e : e ≤ E := by
    exact le_trans ( Nat.le_of_not_lt fun h => absurd ( Nat.dvd_trans ( pow_dvd_pow _ h ) ha₀q ) ( Nat.pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd ( ne_of_gt ( hpos a₀ ha₀A ) ) hp ) ) ( Finset.le_sup ( f := fun a => Nat.factorization a p ) ha₀A )
  have hE_nonempty : (topLayer A p).Nonempty := by
    -- Since $E$ is the supremum of the $p$-adic valuations of elements in $A$, there must be some $a \in A$ such that $Nat.factorization a p = E$.
    obtain ⟨a, haA, haE⟩ : ∃ a ∈ A, Nat.factorization a p = E := by
      exact Finset.exists_max_image _ _ ⟨ a₀, ha₀A ⟩ |> fun ⟨ a, ha₁, ha₂ ⟩ => ⟨ a, ha₁, le_antisymm ( Finset.le_sup ( f := fun a => Nat.factorization a p ) ha₁ ) ( Finset.sup_le fun x hx => ha₂ x hx ) ⟩;
    exact ⟨ a, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ haA, haE ⟩ ⟩
  have hsum_cong : (∑ a ∈ topLayer A p, ((ordCompl[p] a : ZMod p))⁻¹) = 0 := by
    convert topLayer_congruence A p hp hpos _ _ using 1;
    · grind;
    · exact le_trans he hE_ge_e;
  -- Let `S := (topLayer A p).image (fun a => ordCompl[p] a)`.
  set S := (topLayer A p).image (fun a => ordCompl[p] a) with hS_def
  have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨ _, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hE_nonempty.choose_spec ⟩
  have hS_subset : S ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (M / p ^ e) := by
    intro s hs; obtain ⟨ a, ha, rfl ⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs; simp_all +decide [ topLayer ] ;
    exact ⟨ Nat.div_pos ( Nat.le_of_dvd ( hpos a ha.1 ) ( ha.2 ▸ Nat.ordProj_dvd _ _ ) ) ( pow_pos hp.pos _ ), Nat.div_le_div_right ( hAM a ha.1 ) |> le_trans <| Nat.div_le_div_left ( pow_le_pow_right₀ hp.one_lt.le hE_ge_e ) <| pow_pos hp.pos _ ⟩
  have hS_pos : ∀ s ∈ S, 0 < s := by
    exact fun s hs => Finset.mem_Icc.mp ( hS_subset hs ) |>.1
  have hS_not_div : ∀ s ∈ S, ¬ p ∣ s := by
    intro s hs; obtain ⟨ a, ha, rfl ⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs; exact Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp ( ne_of_gt ( hpos a ( topLayer_subset _ _ ha ) ) ) ;
  have hS_sum_inv_zero : (∑ s ∈ S, ((s : ZMod p))⁻¹) = 0 := by
    rw [ Finset.sum_image ] ; aesop;
    intros a ha b hb hab; have := Nat.div_mul_cancel ( Nat.ordProj_dvd a p ) ; have := Nat.div_mul_cancel ( Nat.ordProj_dvd b p ) ; simp_all +decide ;
    simp_all +decide [ topLayer ]
  have hS_num_div : (p : ℤ) ∣ (∑ s ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / s).num := by
    convert dvd_num_of_sum_inv_zero S p hp hS_pos hS_not_div _ using 1 ; aesop
  have hS_num_le_C : (∑ s ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / s).num ≤ C (M / p ^ e) := by
    convert num_le_C ( M / p ^ e ) S hS_nonempty hS_subset using 1
  have hS_num_pos : 0 < (∑ s ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / s).num := by
    exact Rat.num_pos.mpr ( Finset.sum_pos ( fun x hx => one_div_pos.mpr <| Nat.cast_pos.mpr <| hS_pos x hx ) hS_nonempty )
  have h_contra : (p : ℤ) ≤ (∑ s ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / s).num := by
    exact Int.le_of_dvd hS_num_pos hS_num_div
  linarith [hS_num_le_C]

end Erdos287

import Mathlib
import RequestProject.HostileAudit.BalancedSevenSP2SourceAdapter
import RequestProject.HostileAudit.GeneralModulusConductorSplitLargeSieve
import RequestProject.HostileAudit.SmallROwnerCapacity
import RequestProject.HostileAudit.ShiuHypothesisCompiler
